Na obiara bobɔɔ onipa a ɔfirii adi bɛhyiaa no no, na Siriafoɔ dwaneeɛ, na Israelfoɔ tii wɔn. Siria hene Ben-Hadad deɛ, ɔtenaa pɔnkɔ so ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ dwaneeɛ.
Na Israel hene firii adi kɔbobɔɔ apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam no, na ɔde okunkɛseɛ kunkum Siriafoɔ no.
Akyire yi, odiyifoɔ no kɔɔ Israel hene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Kɔ na kɔhyɛ wo ho den, na hunu deɛ wobɛyɛ ɛfiri sɛ sɛ afe kɔ bɛhyia a, Siria hene bɛba wo so.”

Siria hene nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wɔn Nyankopɔn yɛ mmepɔ Nyankopɔn. Ɛno nti na wɔn ho yɛɛ den senee yɛn no. Enti ma yɛne wɔn nkɔko wɔ asase a ɛda fam so [Asaseta], na hwɛ sɛ yɛn ho renyɛ den nsene wɔn anaa.
Na yei na yɛ: Yiyi ahemfo no nyinaa firi mu, na fa amradofoɔ sisi wɔn ananmu.

Afei kan asraafoɔdɔm a wɔn dodoɔ te sɛ asraafoɔdɔm a wohweree wɔn no, na apɔnkɔ nhyɛ apɔnkɔ anan na nteaseɛnam nhyɛ nteaseɛnam anan na yɛne wɔn nkɔko wɔ asase a ɛda fam so, na hwɛ sɛ yɛn ho renyɛ den nsene wɔn anaa.” Enti ɔtiee wɔn nne, na ɔyɛɛ saa.
Na afe kɔ bɛhyiaeɛ no, Ben-Hadad boaboaa Siriafoɔ ano, na wɔsiim kɔɔ Afek sɛ wɔne Israel rekɔko.
Na wɔboaboaa Israelfoɔ nso ano, na wɔmaa wɔn deɛ wɔhia, na wɔfirii adi sɛ wɔrekɔhyia wɔn; Israelfoɔ kyeree nsraban sɛ nnwankuo nketewa mmienu wɔn anim, nanso Siriafoɔ no deɛ, wɔhyɛɛ asase no so ma.

Ɛnna Nyankopɔn nipa no bɛn Israel hene bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Ɛsiane sɛ Siriafoɔ aka sɛ: “Awurade yɛ mmepɔ Nyankopɔn na ɔnyɛ asase a ɛda fam Nyankopɔn” nti, mede dɔm kɛseɛ yi nyinaa bɛhyɛ wo nsa na moahunu sɛ mene Awurade.’”
Na wɔkyeree nsraban nnanson; yeinom anim kyerɛ yeinom anim. Da a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɛko no firii aseɛ, na da koro, Israelfoɔ kunkum Siriafoɔ mmarima mpem ɔha (100,000) a wɔnam fam.
Nanso wɔn a wɔkaeɛ no dwane kɔɔ Afek kuro no mu; ɛnna ɔfasuo no bu guu mmarima mpem aduonu nson a wɔkaeɛ no soɔ. Ben-Hadad deɛ, ɔdwaneeɛ, na ɔkɔhyɛɛ pia mu wɔ kuro no mu.

Ɛnna ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛate sɛ Israel fie ahemfo yɛ ahemfo a wɔyɛ adɔeɛ. Enti yɛsrɛ wo, ma yɛmfa ayitoma mmobɔ yɛn asene na yɛmfa nhoma mmobɔ yɛn ti nkɔ Israel hene nkyɛn. Ebia ɔbɛkora wo kra so.”

Enti wɔfaa ayitoma bobɔɔ wɔn asene na wɔde nhoma bobɔɔ wɔn ti kɔɔ Israel hene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ w’akoa Ben-Hadad aka nie, ‘Mesrɛ wo, ma me kra ntena nkwa mu.’” Ɛnna ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: “Ɔda so te ase anaa? Me nua ne no.”

Ɛnna mmarima no faa no sɛ asɛmpa na ɛreba, na ɔno ara ne tirim asɛm na waka no, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Ben-Hadad yɛ wo nua.” Na ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Monkɔfa no mmra.” Enti Ben-Hadad baa ne nkyɛn, na ntɛm ara ɔmaa no foro bɛtenaa teaseɛnam no mu.

Ɛnna Ben-Hadad ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nkuro a me papa gye firii wo papa nsam no, mɛsan adane ama; yi mmorɔno wɔ Damasko fa sɛdeɛ me papa nso yii bi faa wɔ Samaria no.” Na Ahab nso kaa sɛ: “Me nso, me ne wo bɛyɛ apam yei ho na magya wo kwan ama woakɔ.” Na ɔne no yɛɛ apam gyaa no kwan maa no kɔeɛ.
Na ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri adiyifoɔ no asefoɔ mu nam Awurade asɛm so ka kyerɛɛ ne yɔnko sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, bɔ me.” Nanso ɔbarima no ammɔ no.
Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ woantie Awurade nne nti, berɛ a worefiri me nkyɛn akorɔ yi, gyata bɛku wo.” Ɛno akyi no, ɔfirii ne nkyɛn kɔeɛ na ɔkɔhyiaa gyata maa no kum no.
Na ɔkɔhunuu ɔbarima foforɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔno nso sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, bɔ me.” Ɛnna ɔbarima no bɔɔ no; ɔbɔɔ no piraa no.
Afei odiyifoɔ no kɔ kɔgyinaa kwan so twɛnee ɔhene no, na ɔde biribi kataa n’anim.

Berɛ a ɔhene no rebɛtwam no, ɔfrɛɛ ɔhene kaa sɛ: “W’akoa firi kɔɔ ɛko no mfimfini; na hwɛ! na ɔbarima bi refiri ɛko no mu akɔ, na ɔde obi bɛhyɛɛ me nsa ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Hwɛ ɔbarima yi so. Sɛ ɔyera a, wo kra bɛsi ne kra ananmu, anyɛ saa a, wobɛkari dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ baako ahyɛ mu.’
Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a w’akoa redi akɔneaba no, hwɛ, onipa no dwaneeɛ.” Ɛnna Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Saa na w’atemmuo bɛyɛ. Wo ara na woabua.”
Ntɛm ara na ɔyii adeɛ no firii n’anim, na Israel hene hunuu onipa ko a ɔyɛ, sɛ ɔfiri adiyifoɔ no mu.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Sɛ woama ɔbarima a makyerɛ sɛ wɔnsɛe no afiri wo nsa nti, wo kra bɛsi ne kra ananmu, na wo man bɛsi ne man ananmu.’”
N’ano siiɛ no, Israel hene de n’ani kyerɛɛ ne fie; na wayɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ na waboto, na ɔkɔɔ Samaria.
21: Ahemfo 21
Enti Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Nabot sɛ: “Fa wo bobeturo no ma me ɛ, na memfa nyɛ mfikyifuo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛbɛn me fie; mɛma wo bobeturo a ɛyɛ sene yei de asi ananmu. Anaa wopɛ nso a, mɛma wo sika de atua ka.”
Nanso Nabot ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: “Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛgyina Awurade anim de m’agyanom agyapadeɛ ama woɔ.”
Ɛnna Ahab de awerɛhoɔ baa ne fie mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ, asɛm a Yesreelni Nabot ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Meremfa m’agyanom agyapadeɛ mma wo” no nti. Na ɔbɛdaa ne mpa so danee n’ani, na wannidi.
Ɛnna ne yere Yesebel baa ne nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wo honhom abotoɔ na wonnidie yi?”

Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ne yere sɛ: “Me ne Yesreelni Nabot kasaeɛ, na meka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Fa wo bobeturo no ma me, na memma wo sika mfa ntua ka. Anaa wopɛ nso a, ma memma wo bobeturo foforɔ nsi ananmu.’ Nanso ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Meremfa me bobeturo no mma wo.’”
Ɛnna ne yere Yesebel ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ wo na wodi Israel so hene? Sɔre didi na ma w’akoma ntɔ wo yam. Me ara mede Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo no bɛma wo.”
Enti ɔtwerɛɛ krataa Ahab din mu de ɔhene nsɔano sɔɔ ano, na ɔde krataa no kɔmemaa kurom hɔ mpanimfoɔ ne mmapɔmma a wɔne Nabot teɛ no.
Nsɛm a ɔtwerɛɛ no krataa no mu ne sɛ: “Monka mma wɔnni mmuada, na momma Nabot ntena nnipa no ti.
Afei momma mmarima ahuhufoɔ mmienu ntena n’anim na wɔnni adanseɛ ntia no sɛ, ‘Woadome Onyankopɔn ne ɔhene!’ Afei momfa no mfiri adi nkɔsi no aboɔ mma no nwu.”
Enti ne kuromfoɔ no, mpanimfoɔ ne mmapɔmma a wɔwɔ ne kurom hɔ no yɛɛ deɛ Yesebel de nkra brɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no, wɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no krataa a ɔde kɔmaa wɔn no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Wɔka maa wɔdii mmuada, na wɔmaa Nabot tenaa nnipa no ti.

Mmarima ahuhufoɔ mmienu bɛtenaa n’anim, na mmarima ahuhufoɔ no dii adanseɛ tiaa no, kyerɛ sɛ, wɔdii adanseɛ tiaa Nabot wɔ nnipa no anim sɛ: “Nabot adome Onyankopɔn ne ɔhene!” Afei wɔde no firii adi kɔɔ kurotia, na wɔkɔsii no aboɔ maa no wuiɛ.
Ɛnna wɔsoma kɔka kyerɛɛ Yesebel sɛ: “Wɔasi Nabot aboɔ ama no awu.”
Berɛ a Yesebel tee sɛ wɔasi Nabot aboɔ ama no awuo no, ɛhɔ ara na Yesebel ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: “Sɔre kɔfa Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo a wamfa amma wo annye sika no, na Nabot nte nkwa mu bio, wawu.”
Berɛ a Ahab tee sɛ Nabot awuo no, ntɛm ara na ɔsɔre kɔɔ Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo no mu sɛ ɔrekɔfa.
Na Awurade asɛm baa Tisbini Elia [Elijah] nkyɛn sɛ:
“Sɔre kɔhyia Israel hene Ahab a ɔwɔ Samaria no. Ɔwɔ Nabot bobeturo no mu, wakɔ hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔfa.

Kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie: “Woakum obi asan afa n’adeɛ?”’ San ka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade aka nie: “Baabi a nkraman taferee Nabot mogya no, ɛhɔ ara na nkraman bɛtafere wo nso wo mogya.”’”
Ɛnna Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: “Woahu me, O me tamfo?” na ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Mahu wo. ‘Ɛsiane sɛ woatɔn wo ho sɛ wobɛyɛ Awurade ani so bɔne nti,
hwɛ, mede mmusuo reba wo so; mɛpra w’akyi nyinaa akɔ, na matwa Ahab fie barima biara atwene, Israel nipahunu a ɔnni ɔboafoɔ anaa ɔdehyeɛ mpo.
Na mɛyɛ wo fie sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fie ne Ahiya ba Baasa fie, bɔne a woayɛ de ahyɛ me abufuo ne bɔne a woama Israel nso ayɛ nti.’
Na Yesebel nso, deɛ Awurade aka wɔ ne ho ne sɛ, ‘Nkraman na ɛbɛdi Yesebel nam wɔ Yesreel asase no soɔ.
Ahab ho nipa biara a ɔbɛwu kuro mu no, nkraman na ɛbɛdi ne nam, na deɛ ɔbɛwu wuram no, ewiem nnomaa na ɛbɛdi ne nam.
Ampa, obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛɛ n’adeɛ sɛ Ahab a ɔtɔn ne ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Awurade ani so bɔne, a ne yere Yesebel nso piapiaa no no.
Na ɔyɛɛ akyiwadeɛ a ɛnyɛ koraa kɔdii abosom fi akyi, sɛdeɛ Amorifoɔ a Awurade pamoo wɔn firii Israelfoɔ anim nyinaa yɛeɛ no.’”
Berɛ a Ahab tee nsɛm yi no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔsuanee n’atadeɛ mu, na ɔde atweaatam kataa ne ho; ɔdii mmuada na ɔdaa atweaatam mu na ɔnantee awerɛhoɔ mu.
Ɛnna Awurade asɛm baa Tisbini Elia nkyɛn sɛ:
“Woahunu sɛdeɛ me nti Ahab abrɛ ne ho aseɛ no? Ɛsiane sɛ wabrɛ ne ho ase m’anim nti, meremfa mmusuo no mma wɔ ne nna mu. Ne ba nna mu na mede mmusuo no bɛba ne fie.”
22: Ahemfo 22
Na ɛbaa sɛ afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, Yuda hene Yehosafat kɔɔ Israel hene nkyɛn.
Ɛnna Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: “Monnim sɛ Ramot-Gilead yɛ yɛn dea? Nanso yɛn deɛ, yɛte hɔ komm na yɛnnye mfirii Siria hene nsam?”

Na asɛm a ɔbisaa Yehosafat ne sɛ: “Wo ne me bɛkɔ Ramot-Gilead so ne wɔn akɔko anaa?” Ɛnna Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: “Me ne wo nyinaa yɛ nipa baako. Me man ne wo man nso yɛ baako. M’apɔnkɔ ne w’apɔnkɔ yɛ baako.”
Na Yehosafat san ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: “Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, anka bisa Awurade anom asɛm ansa.”
Ɛnna Israel hene boaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano, mmarima bɛyɛ ahanan, na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: “Me ne Ramot-Gilead nkɔko, anaa mennyae?” Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Kɔ, na Awurade de wɔn bɛhyɛ ɔhene nsa.”
Ɛnna Yehosafat bisaa sɛ: “Awurade diyifoɔ foforɔ biara nni hɔ bio anaa? Momma yɛmfa ne so mmisa.”

Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: “Baako da so wɔ hɔ a yɛbɛtumi afa ne so abisa Awurade, nanso me deɛ metane no, mempɛ n’asɛm koraa ɛfiri sɛ ɔnhyɛɛ me ho nkɔm pa da, sɛ bɔne nko ara na ɔka. Ɔne Imla ba Mikaia.” Nanso Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mma ɔhene nnka saa.”
Ɛnna Israel hene frɛɛ ahemfie mpanimfoɔ no bi, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Kɔfa Imla ba Mikaia bra ntɛm.”
Saa berɛ no, na Israel hene ne Yuda hene Yehosafat tete wɔn nhennwa so hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ wɔ Samaria kuro pono ano ayuporobea hɔ, na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa gyinagyina wɔn anim hyehyɛɛ nkɔm.
Na Kenaana ba Sedekia yɛɛ dadeɛ mmɛn, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade aka nie, ‘Yei na wode bɛpempem Siriafoɔ no de akɔsi sɛ wobɛtɔre wɔn aseɛ.’”
Adiyifoɔ nkaeɛ no nyinaa nso hyehyɛɛ nkɔm korɔ no ara sɛ: “Kɔ Ramot-Gilead so na kɔdi nkonim, na Awurade de wɔn bɛhyɛ ɔhene nsa.”
Na deɛ wɔsomaa no sɛ ɔnkɔfrɛ Mikaia mmra no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ! Adiyifoɔ no nyinaa de anokorɔ aka asɛmpa akyerɛ ɔhene, enti ma w’asɛm nyɛ sɛ wɔn deɛ no, na ka asɛmpa.”
Nanso Mikaia kaa sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, deɛ Awurade bɛka akyerɛ me no, ɛno ara na me nso mɛka.”
Berɛ a ɔbɛduruu ɔhene anim no, ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Mikaia, yɛne Ramot-Gilead nkɔko, anaa yɛnnyae?” Ɛhɔ ara na ɔbuaa ɔhene sɛ: “Monkɔ na monkɔdi nkonim, na Awurade de wɔn bɛhyɛ ɔhene nsa.”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mprɛ ahe na memma wo nka ntam nkyerɛ me sɛ nokorɛ na woka na  ɛnyɛ atorɔ kɛkɛ wɔ Awurade din mu?”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, mehunu Israel sɛ wɔabɔ wɔn nyinaa ahwete wɔ mmepɔ no so sɛ nnwan a wɔnni hwɛfoɔ. Na Awurade aka sɛ: ‘Yeinom nni wura. Enti ma obiara nsan nkɔ ne fie asomdwoeɛ mu.’”
Ɛnna Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ asɛm a mekaeɛ no na ɛda hɔ yi, sɛ ‘ɔrenhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa bi da, na mmom nkɔm bɔne’?”
Na odiyifoɔ no toaa so sɛ: “Enti tie deɛ Awurade wɔ ka: Mehunu Awurade sɛ ɔte n’ahennwa soɔ a ɔsoro asafodɔm nyinaa gyinagyina ne nifa ne ne benkum.
Na Awurade bisaa sɛ, ‘Hwan na ɔbɛkɔ akɔdaadaa Ahab ama no ne Ramot-Gilead akɔko na watɔ?’ Afei oyi ka sei, na oyi nso aka sei.
Akyire yi, honhom bi firi bɛgyinaa Awurade anim kaa sɛ: ‘Me na mɛkɔ akɔdaadaa no.’ Ɛnna Awurade bisaa no sɛ, ‘Wobɛyɛ no sɛn?’
Na ɔno nso buaa sɛ, ‘Mɛkɔ akɔyɛ atorɔ honhom wɔ n’adiyifoɔ no nyinaa anom.’ Ɛnna Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ, ‘Wobɛtumi adaadaa no ampa; deɛ worekɔyɛ no, ɛbɛyɛ yie. Enti kɔ na kɔyɛ saa.’
Enti hunu sɛ Awurade de atorɔ honhom na ahyɛ w’adiyifoɔ yi nyinaa anom, nanso mmusuo na Awurade aka afa wo ho.”
Ɛnna Kenaana ba Sedekia twe bɛn Mikaia bɛbɔɔ no sotorɔ bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛhefa na Awurade honhom nam sianee me ho ne wo bɛkasaeɛ?”
Na Mikaia buaa no sɛ: “Ɛda a wobɛhyɛn pia mu akɔhunta no na wobɛhunu baabi a ɛnam baeɛ.”
Ɛnna Israel hene no kaa sɛ: “Momfa Mikaia nkɔma amrado Amon ne ɔhene ba Yoas.
Na monka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ: ‘Deɛ ɔhene aka nie: “Momfa saa akoa yi nto nneduadan mu, na momma no ahohiahia aduane nni ne ahohiahia nsuo nnom nkɔsi sɛ mɛba asomdwoeɛ mu.”’”
Ɛnna Mikaia kaa sɛ: “Sɛ wosan ba asomdwoeɛ mu paa a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ Awurade na ɔne me kasaeɛ.” Na ɔka kaa ho sɛ: “Mo nyinaa nso montie bi.”
Na Israel hene ne Yuda hene Yehosafat kɔɔ Ramot-Gilead so.
Ɛnna Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: “Mɛsakra me ho akɔ akono, nanso wo deɛ, hyɛ wo ntadeɛ.” Enti Israel hene sakraa ne ho na ɔkɔɔ akono hɔ.
Na Siria hene no ahyɛ ne nteaseɛnam so asahene aduasa mmienu no sɛ: “Mo ne kumaa anaa ɔkɛseɛ nnko, Israel hene nko ara na momfa mo ani nsi ne soɔ.”
Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a nteaseɛnam so asahene no hunuu Yehosafat pɛ, wɔkeka kyerɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ: “Ampa, Israel hene no nie.” Enti wɔkɔɔ ne so sɛ wɔne no rekɔko. Ɛnna Yehosafat teateaam hwehwɛɛ ɔboafoɔ.
Enti berɛ a nteaseɛnam so asahene no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ Israel hene ne no no, ntɛm ara na wɔgyaee n’akyiridie.

Na ɔbarima bi too n’agyan a n’ani nna, na ɛkɔwɔɔ Israel hene no mmɔtoam ne nkataboɔ no ntam. Enti ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ ne teaseɛnam kafoɔ no sɛ: “Dane wo ho na fa me firi akono ha kɔ, na wɔapira me pira bɔne.”
Ɛko no mu yɛɛ den saa da no, na wɔde ɔhene no gyinaa teaseɛnam no mu de n’ani kyerɛɛ Siriafoɔ no, na ɛduruu anwummerɛ no na wawu; n’apirakuro no mogya nwunu guu ɛko teaseɛnam no mu.
Na wɔpae no nsraban no nyinaa mu awiatɔ berɛ sɛ: “Obiara nkɔ ne kuro mu, na obiara nkɔ n’asase so!”
Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a ɔhene wuiɛ. Wɔde no baa Samaria, na wɔsiee ɔhene wɔ Samaria.
Na wɔkɔhohoroo teaseɛnam no mu wɔ Samaria abura no ho, na nkraman bɛtaferee ne mogya, nnwamanfoɔ nso dwaree hɔ, sɛdeɛ Awurade asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no kyerɛ.
Ahab ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne asommɛn fie a ɔsiiɛ, ne nkuro a ɔkyekyereeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Ahab ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na ne ba Ahasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Asa ba Yehosafat bɛdii Yuda so hene wɔ Israel hene Ahab afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu.
Yehosafat bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduasa nnum, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonu nnum wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Asuba a ɔyɛ Silhi babaa.

Na ɔhene no nantee ne papa Asa akwan nyinaa so, na wammane amfiri ho, na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade ani so. Gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no nko na amfiri hɔ. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ.
Na asomdwoeɛ tenaa Yehosafat ne Israel hene ntam.
Na Yehosafat ho nsɛm a aka, ne nnwuma akɛseɛ ne n’akodie no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Asɔrefie mmarima nnwamanfoɔ a wɔkaeɛ wɔ ne papa Asa berɛ soɔ no, ɔtuu wɔn ase firii asase no so.
Na ɔhene bi nni Edom; ɔhene abadiakyire na na ɔhwɛ akyire sɛ ɔhene.
Yehosafat yeyɛɛ Tarsis ahyɛn a ɔde bɛkɔ Ofir akɔfa sika kɔkɔɔ, nanso antumi ankɔ ɛfiri sɛ ɛsɛesɛee wɔ Esion-Geber.
Ɛnna Ahab ba Ahasia ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: “Ma me nkoa mmɛka wo nkoa ho, ahyɛn no mu,” nanso Yehosafat ampene.
Na Yehosafat ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ ne nana Dawid Kuro mu, na ne ba Yehoram bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahab ba Ahasia bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria, Yuda hene Yehosafat afe a ɛtɔ so dunson mu, na ɔdii Israel so mfeɛ mmienu.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne, na ɔfaa ne papa kwan so ne ne maame kwan so ne Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no kwan so.
Ɔsom Baal, na ɔsɔree no, na ɔhyɛɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn abufuo sɛdeɛ ne papa yɛeɛ no ara.

1: Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔahwete kɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia no mu, amamfrafoɔ a wɔayi wɔn,
sɛdeɛ Agya Nyankopɔn nim a ɔnim dada no teɛ no, wɔ honhom ahoteɛ mu, de kɔ asoɔmmerɛ ne Yesu Kristo mogya dwira mu: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ nnɔɔso mma mo.
Nhyira nka yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyankopɔn ne Agya a ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso nti ɔnam Yesu Kristo sɔreɛ a ɔfiri awufoɔ mu sɔreeɛ no so awo yɛn foforɔ kɔ anidasoɔ a emu wɔ nkwa mu,
ne apɛgyadeɛ a ɛmporɔ, na ɛho nni dɛm, na ɛmpa mu, a wɔde asie ɔsoro ama mo,
a wɔnam gyidie so wɛn mo wɔ Nyankopɔn tumi mu de kɔ nkwagyeɛ a wɔasiesie sɛ wɔrebɛyi no adie ɛberɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu. Gyidie nam amanehunu so duru ne pɛyɛ mu
Yei mu na modi ahurisie kɛseɛ, ɛwom sɛ seesei deɛ, ɛtwa sɛ wɔde sɔhwɛ ahodoɔ ho mo werɛ kakra,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhunu sɛ mo gyidie a wɔasɔ ahwɛ, a ɛsom bo sene sika a wɔasɔ ahwɛ wɔ gya mu nanso ɛsɛeɛ no de ayeyie ne anidie ne animuonyam bɛba wɔ Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu.
Ɛwom sɛ monhuu no da deɛ, nanso modɔ no. Ɔno na monhu no seesei deɛ, nanso mogye no di, na mode anigyeɛ a ɛnni kabea a animuonyam wom di ahurisie kɛse,
sɛ monya mo gyidie awieeɛ a ɛne mo kra nkwagyeɛ no.
Saa nkwagyeɛ yi na adiyifoɔ a wɔhyɛɛ adom a mobɛnya no ho nkɔm no de mmɔdemmɔ hwehwɛɛ mu, na wɔpɛɛpɛɛ mu yie.
Wɔkɔɔ so hwehwɛɛ mu hwɛɛ berɛ pɔtee anaa berɛ korɔ a honhom a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no kyerɛ wɔ Kristo ho berɛ a ɛdii Kristo amanehunu ne animuonyam a ɛbɛdi so aba ho adanseɛ no.

Wɔyii no adi kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn ho na wɔsomeeɛ, na mmom mo na wɔde nneɛma a afei na wɔaka ho asɛm no resom mo, na wɔnam wɔn a wɔde Honhom Kronkron a wɔsomaa no firii soro kaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ mo no so. Yeinom mu na abɔfoɔ mpo pɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mu. Ahosiesie, ahosohwɛ, ɔsetie ne ahoteɛ
Enti mommɔ mo adwene abɔsoɔ, mo ani nna hɔ, na momma mo ani nna adom a wɔde rebrɛ mo Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu no so koraa.
Monyɛ sɛ asoɔmmerɛ mma, na monnni akɔnnɔ a na mowɔ berɛ a na monnim hwee no akyi,
na mmom te sɛdeɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo no yɛ kronkron no, mo nso monyɛ kronkron abrabɔ nyinaa mu,
na wɔatwerɛ sɛ: “Monyɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ kronkron.”
Bio nso, sɛ mofrɛ Agya a ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔbu atɛn sɛdeɛ obiara adwuma teɛ no a, momfa suro mmɔ mo bra mo ahɔhobea tena berɛ yi mu;
Na monhunu sɛ wɔamfa nneɛma a ɛporɔ, dwetɛ anaa sika kɔkɔɔ, na ɛgyee mo firii mo abrabɔ hunu a mo agyanom de gyaa mo no mu,
na mmom wɔde Kristo a ɔte sɛ adwammaa a ɔnni dɛm ne nkekaeɛ no mogya a ne boɔ yɛ den no na ɛgyee mo.
Ɔno na wɔyii no sieeɛ ansa na wɔrehyɛ wiase aseɛ, na wɔayi no akyerɛ, berɛ a ɛdi akyire yi mu ama mo,
a monam ne so gye Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu na ɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam no die no, na mo gyidie ne anidasoɔ atena Nyankopɔn mu.
Afei a moayɛ aso ama nokorɛ no de adwira mo kra a deɛ afiri mu aba ne onuadɔ a nkontompo nnim no, momfiri akomam nnodɔ mo ho mo ho dendeenden.
Na wɔamfiri aba a ɛporɔ mu, na mmom wɔfiri deɛ ɛmporɔ mu, nam Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ a ɔte hɔ daa no asɛm so na ɛwoo mo,
Ɛfiri sɛ “ɔhonam nyinaa te sɛ wira, na onipa animuonyam nyinaa te sɛ wira nhwiren; wira no hye na ne nhwiren po,
nanso Awurade asɛm deɛ, ɛte hɔ daa.” Na yei ne asɛmpa a wɔaka akyerɛ mo no.
2: Petro 2
na monyɛ sɛ nkɔkoaa a wɔawo wɔn foforɔ, na mompɛ asɛm no nufosuo kronkron mapa, na monam so anyini akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu,
berɛ a moaka ahwɛ sɛ Awurade yam yɛ no.
Ɔno na moba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɛboɔ a ɛte ase a nnipa apo no, nanso Onyankopɔn ayi no a ɔsom bo ma no,
mo nso momma wɔmfa mo sɛ aboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu nto aban, na moayɛ honhom mu dan, asɔfokuo kronkron, sɛ mobɛbɔ honhom mu afɔdeɛ a ɛnam Yesu Kristo so sɔ Nyankopɔn ani.
Na ɛwɔ Twerɛnsɛm no mu sɛ: “Hwɛ mereto boɔ bi wɔ Sion, ɛboɔ a wɔayie, tweaso tiboɔ a ɛsom bo; na deɛ ɔgye no die no ani renwu.”
Enti mo mmom na ɔsom bo ma mo, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛ agyidifoɔ; na wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no deɛ, “ɛboɔ a adansifoɔ no poeɛ no abɛyɛ tweatiboɔ,”
ne “suntiboɔ ne suntiduatoɔ botan ama wɔn.” Wɔn na wɔsunti, ɛfiri sɛ wɔntie asɛm no. Ɛno nso nti na wɔayi wɔn asi hɔ. Kristofoɔ pa yɛ nokorɛ Israel
Nanso mo deɛ, moyɛ abusua a wɔayi wɔn, ahene asɔfokuo, ɔman kronkron, ɔman a wafa wɔn ayɛ Ɔno ara ne deɛ, sɛ monka deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo firi esum mu baa ne hann a ɛyɛ nwanwa mu no ayeyie nkyerɛ.
Mo a kane no na monyɛ ɔman, na afei moayɛ Nyankopɔn man, mo a moannya mmɔborɔhunu da, na afei deɛ, moanya mmɔborɔhunu.
Adɔfoɔ, metu mo fo sɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ sɛ montwe mo ho mfiri honam akɔnnɔ a ɛne ɔkra no di asie no ho.

Na mommɔ abrabɔ pa wɔ amanaman mu, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mo mu sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no, wɔhwɛ mo nneyɛɛ pa no a, wɔahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, “nsra hwɛ da” no. Ɔsetie a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ma wiasɛ sodifoɔ
Mommrɛ mo ho ase mma nnipa nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa, Awurade nti: Ɔhene a ɔyɛ pumpuni oo,
anaa amradofoɔ a ɔsoma wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔtwe nnebɔneyɛfoɔ aso ne papayɛfoɔ ayeyie ho oo.
Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mode papayɛ si nnipa a wɔnni adwene no nkwaseasɛm ano,
sɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde ahofadie no ayɛ bɔnepɛ so nkatasoɔ, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nkoa.
Monni nnipa nyinaa ni, monnɔ anuanom nyinaa, monsuro Nyankopɔn, monni ɔhene ni. Ɛsɛ asomfoɔ sɛ wɔdi nokorɛ daa
Nkoa, momfa suro nyinaa mmrɛ mo ho ase mma mo wuranom, ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ na wɔdwoɔ nko, na mmom wɔn a wɔn asɛm yɛ den nso.
Na yei yɛ adom, sɛ Nyankopɔn ho ahonim nti, obi de awerɛhoɔ hunu amane a ɛntene, nanso ɔgyina mu.
Na sɛ moyɛ bɔne ma wɔboro mo na mode boasetɔ gyina mu a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ soɔ? Na mmom sɛ moyɛ papa, na mohunu amane na mode boasetɔ gyina mu a, yei na ɛyɛ adom, Nyankopɔn anim.
Na yei nti na wɔfrɛɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Kristo mpo hunuu amane maa mo, na ɔgyaa mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ monni n’anammɔn akyi pɛɛ.
Ɔno na wanyɛ bɔne biara, na wɔanhunu nnaadaasɛm nso n’anom.
Ɔno na berɛ a wɔsopaa (wɔyaa) no no, wanyɛ bi antua ka. Berɛ a ɔrehunu amane no, wanhunahuna obiara, na mmom ɔkɔɔ so de ne ho hyɛɛ deɛ ɔbu atɛntenenee no nsa.
Ɔno ara na ɔsoaa yɛn bɔne wɔ ɔno ara ne honam mu wɔ dua no soɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛgye yɛn afiri bɔne a yɛawu ama no no mu na yɛatena ase ama tenenee. Ɔno na wɔde ne mmaa ntampeɛ asa mo yareɛ.
Na anka mote sɛ nnwan a wɔayera; nanso seesei moasane aba mo kra Hwɛfoɔ ne Wɛmfoɔ no nkyɛn.
3: Petro 3
sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mo abrabɔ a ɛho teɛ wɔ osuro mu.
Na mommma mo ahosiesie nnyɛ nnipa ani so deɛ, mmɛsawɔ ne sikahyɛ anaa ntadehyɛ mu,
na mmom momma no nyɛ akomam nipa a wahunta, honhom a ɛyɛ komm na ɛdwoɔ, adeɛ a ɛmporɔ; yei na ɛsom bo Onyankopɔn anim.
Saa ara na tete no, mmaa kronkron a wɔde wɔn ho too Onyankopɔn soɔ no siesiee wɔn ho brɛɛ wɔn ho ase maa wɔn ara wɔn kununom,
sɛdeɛ Sara tiee Abraham na ɔfrɛɛ no “me wura” no. Na sɛ mokɔ so yɛ papa na moansuro ahudeɛ biara a, ɛnneɛ na moabɛyɛ ne mma.

Okununom, nso ne wɔn yerenom ntena saa ara wɔ nimdeɛ mu, na monni mmaa no ni sɛ anwenneɛ a nyɛ den, ɛfiri sɛ mo ne wɔn nyinaa yɛ nkwa a wɔde adom mo no adedifoɔ, na mo mpaebɔ kwan ansi. Baakoyɛ, ɔdɔ, ahobrɛaseɛ ne fafirie
Afei mo nyinaa nyɛ adwenkorɔ, na monnya tema, monnodɔ mo ho sɛ anuanom, monnya ayamhyehyeɛ, ne ahobrɛaseɛ adwene,
na mommfa bɔne nntua bɔne ka, nso mommfa ɔyɛ nntua ɔyɛ ka, na mmom monhyira, ɛfiri sɛ yei nti na wɔfrɛɛ mo na mo nsa aka nhyira.
Na “deɛ ɔdɔ nkwa na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhunu nna pa no, ma no nto ne kɛtrɛma nnareka adebɔne ho, na n’ano anka nnaadaasɛm.
Ma no ntwe ne ho mfiri bɔne ho na ɔnyɛ papa; ɔnhwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ na ɔnni akyire.
Na Awurade ani wɔ ateneneefoɔ so, na n’aso abue ama wɔn mpaebɔ; nanso Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne.”
Na sɛ modi papa akyiri a, hwan na ɔbɛha mo?
Na sɛ tenenee nti mohunu amane nso a, nhyira ne mo. Na monnsuro wɔn ho hu, na mommma mo akoma nntu.
Na mommu Awurade Kristo kronkron wɔ mo akoma mu, na monyɛ krado berɛ biara sɛ mode anoyie bɛma obiara a ɔbɛbisa anidasoɔ a ɛwɔ mo mu no ho asɛm, nanso monyɛ no ɔdwoɔ ne obuo a emu dɔ mu.
Monkura ahonim pa mu na wɔn a wɔka mo abrabɔ pa wɔ Kristo mu ho asɛmmɔne no ani awu asɛm a wɔka tia mo no ho. Nhyira a ɛfiri Yesu amanehunu mu ba
Na sɛ mohunu amane adepa ho, na Onyankopɔn pɛ no saa a, ɛyɛ sene sɛ mobɛhunu amane bɔne ho.
Ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu bɔne ho amane prɛko, deɛ ɔtene hunuu amane maa wɔn a wɔntene, sɛ ɔde yɛn bɛkɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. Ɔno na wɔkuu no honam mu nanso wɔmaa no tenaa ase honhom mu.
Ɛno mu nso na ɔkɔ kɔkaa asɛm kyerɛɛ ahonhom a wɔwɔ afiase,
a wɔyɛɛ asoɔden berɛ a Onyankopɔn de abodwokyɛreɛ twɛnee wɔ Noa nna no mu, nna a na wɔreyɛ adaka no mu. Emu na akra kakraa bi a wɔn ano si nwɔtwe nyaa nkwa nsuo no mu.
Deɛ ɛyɛ ne nsɛsoɔ nso na seesei ɛgye yɛn nkwa; ɛno ne asubɔ a ɛnyɛ honam ho fi a wɔyie, na mmom adebisa a wɔde to Onyankopɔn anim de pɛ ahonim pa a ɛnam Yesu Kristo wusɔreɛ soɔ.
Ɔno na ɔkɔɔ ɔsoro no, ɔte Nyankopɔn nifa; na abɔfoɔ ne ahoɔden ne tumi mu no nyinaa abrɛ wɔn ho ase ama no.
4: Petro 4
na honam mu asetena berɛ a aka no, wantena ase amma nnipa akɔnnɔ bio, na mmom watena ase ama Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ.
Na ɛdɔɔso sɛ yɛn asetena berɛ a atwa mu no, yɛsɛe berɛ yɛɛ deɛ amanaman mufoɔ no pɛ, sɛ yɛnantee ahohwie, akɔnnɔ, nsaborɔ, agobɔne, didimeeɛ ne abosonsom a wɔkyire mu.
Ɛsiane sɛ afei mo ne wɔn ntu mmirika nkɔ saa ahohwie dontorie no mu nti, ɛyɛ wɔn nwanwa na wɔka mo ho nsɛmmɔne.
Nanso saa nnipa yi bɛbu akonta akyerɛ deɛ wayɛ krado sɛ ɔbɛbu ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ atɛn no.
Na yei nti na wɔkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ awufoɔ nso, na wɔabu wɔn atɛn sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ honam mu, na wɔatena ase sɛdeɛ ɛfata Onyankopɔn wɔ honhom fam mu.
Nanso adeɛ nyinaa awieeɛ abɛn. Enti momma mo adwene mu nte na mo ani nna hɔ mma mpaebɔ.
Na ne titire no, momfa ɔdɔ a emu yɛ den nnodɔ mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdɔ kata bɔne pii so.
Monnyegye mo ho hɔhoɔ a anwiinwii biara nnim.
Sɛdeɛ mo nyinaa nyinyaa adom akyɛdeɛ no, momfa nsom mo ho mo ho sɛ Nyankopɔn adom ahodoɔ no ho afieahwɛfoɔ pa.

Sɛ obi ka asɛm a, ma no nka no sɛ Nyankopɔn nsɛm kronkron. Sɛ obi som a, ma no nsom sɛ ɛfiri ahoɔden a Onyankopɔn de ma mu, na wɔnam Yesu Kristo so ahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, ade nyinaa mu. Ɔno na animuonyam ne tumi wɔ no daa daa. Amen. Amaneɛ a Kristo nti wɔhunu
Adɔfo, mommma amanehunu gya a asɔ wɔ mo mu sɛ wɔde resɔ mo ahwɛ no nnyɛ mo sɛ ade foforɔ, te sɛ ade foforɔ bi na ɛreyɛ mo;
na mmom, sɛdeɛ moayɛ Kristo amanehunu no fafafoɔ no, momma mo ani nnye, na sɛ wɔyi n’animuonyam no adi a, mode ahosan ama mo ani agye nso.
Sɛ Kristo din nti wɔbɔ mo ahohora a, nhyira ne mo, ɛfiri sɛ animuonyam ne Nyankopɔn honhom wɔ mo so.
Nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ mo mu biara hunu amane sɛ owudini anaa ɔkorɔmfoɔ anaa ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ anaa deɛ ɔde ne ho gyegye afoforɔ nsɛm mu.
Na sɛ obi hunu amane sɛ Okristoni a, ɔmmma n’ani nnwu, na mmom ɔnkɔ so nhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam edin yi mu. Atemmuo a ɛyɛ hu no mfitiaseɛ
Na ɛberɛ no aduru sɛ atemmuo firi aseɛ Nyankopɔn fie. Na sɛ ɛfiri yɛn so kane a, ɛbɛwie wɔn a wɔntie Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no sɛn?
“Na sɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛgye ɔteneneeni mpo a, ɛnneɛ ɛhe na deɛ ɔmfɛre Onyankopɔn ne ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ bɛgyina?”
Enti wɔn a wɔhunu amane sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ teɛ no nso mfa wɔn kra nhyɛ Ɔbɔadeɛ nokwafoɔ, na wɔnkɔ so ara wɔ papayɛ mu.
5: Petro 5
Monyɛne Nyankopɔn nnwankuo a wɔwɔ mo mu no. Monhwɛ wɔn so, ɛnyɛ ɔhyɛ so, na mmom ɔdɔ mu, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ; ɛnyɛ adufudepɛ nti, na mmom akoma a ɛpɛ nti;
ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔdi asafotoɔ no so bakoma, na mmom monyɛ nhwɛsoɔ mma nnwankuo no.
Na sɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ panin no yi ne ho adi a, moanya animuonyam abotire a ɛnsɛe da.
Saa ara na mo mmɔfra nso, mommrɛ mo ho ase nhyɛ mo mpanimfoɔ ase. Aane, mo nyinaa momfira ahobrɛaseɛ, na monsom mo ho mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn si ahantanfoɔ kwan, na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.
Enti mommrɛ mo ho ase nhyɛ Onyankopɔn tumi nsa no ase, na wama mo so, berɛ a ɛsɛ mu,
Momfa mo dadwene ne mo haw nyinaa nto ne so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdwene mo ho.
Moma mo ani nna hɔ, monwɛn, ɛfiri sɛ mo tamfo bonsam no nenam sɛ gyata a ɔrebobom, hwehwɛ deɛ ɔbɛnya no amene no.
Ɔno na momfa gyidie nnyina hɔ pintinn nsi no kwan, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ amanehunu no ara na wɔde ato mo nuanom a wɔwɔ wiase nyinaa soɔ sɛ wɔnhunu.
Na adom nyinaa Nyankopɔn a wafrɛ mo aba ne daa animuonyam no mu Kristo mu no, ɔno ara na sɛ monya hunu amane kakra ansa a, ɔbɛsiesie mo pɛ, ɔbɛma mo ase atim, ɔbɛhyɛ mo den, na wama moanya nnyinasoɔ.
Ɔno na tumi wɔ no daa daa. Amen.
Menam onua a mebu no nokwafoɔ, Silwano, so atwerɛ mo nsɛm kakraa bi a mede bɛhyɛ mo nkuran adi mo adanseɛ sɛ yei paa ne Onyankopɔn nokorɛ adom no; ɛno mu na moabɛgyina mu yi.
Asafo a ɛwɔ Babilon a wɔayi wɔn sɛ mo ara no kyea mo, na saa ara na me ba Marko nso kyea mo.
Momfa ɔdɔ mfeano nkyeakyea mo ho. Asomdwoeɛ nka mo a mowɔ Kristo Yesu mu nyinaa. Amen.

1: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfiri Ramataim-Sofim, Efraim bepɔ so a ne din de Elkana. Na ɔyɛ Suf ba Tohu ba Elihu ba Yeroham ba; a ɔyɛ Efratini.
Na ɔwɔ yerenom mmienu, baako din de Hanah, na baako nso din de Penina. Na Penina wɔ mma, na Hanah deɛ, ɔnni ba.
Afe biara, na ɔbarima yi firi ne kurom kɔ sɛ ɔrekɔkoto asɔre na wabɔ afɔdeɛ ama asafo Awurade wɔ Shilo. Na ɛhɔ na na Eli mma mmienu, Hofni ne Finehas, di Awurade asɔfoɔ.
Na da biara a Elkana bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no, ɔma ne yere Penina ne ne mma mmarima ne ne mma mmaa nyinaa kyɛfa, obiara ne ne deɛ.
Na Hanah deɛ, ɔma no kyɛfa mmienu. Ɛfiri sɛ Hanah na na ɔdɔ no, nanso na Awurade ato ne yafunu mu.
Ne kora no nso yii no ahi sɛ ɔde bɛhuru ne bo, ɛfiri sɛ na Awurade ato ne yafunu mu.
Na saa na na ɔyɛ no afe biara; berɛ biara, sɛ ɔforo kɔ Awurade fie a, saa ara na ɔyi no ahi, ɛno nti na ɔsu, na ɔnnidi.
Ɛnna ne kunu Elkana ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hanah, adɛn nti na wosu, na adɛn nti na wonnidie, na adɛn nti na w’akoma abotoɔ? Menyɛ mma wo nsene mma mmarima du anaa?”
Na berɛ a wɔdidii Shilo na wɔnom wieeɛ no, Hanah sɔreeɛ, nso na ɔsɔfoɔ Eli te adwa so Awurade asɔrefie no aponnwa ho.
Na ne kra werɛ hoe, na ɔbɔɔ Awurade mpaeɛ, na ɔsuu pii.

Na ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: “O asafo Awurade, sɛ wohwɛ w’afenaa amanehunu na wokae me, na wo werɛ amfiri w’afenaa, na woma w’afenaa ɔbabarima a, ɛnneɛ mede no bɛma Awurade ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na yiwan renka ne ti.”
Na berɛ a ɔgu so rebɔ mpaeɛ tenteenten Awurade anim no nyinaa, na Eli rehwɛ n’ano.
Hanah deɛ, ɔkasaa n’akoma mu, na n’ano na ɔbesebeseeɛ; ne nne deɛ, wɔante. Nanso Eli buu no sɛ waboro nsa.
Ɛnna Eli ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Da bɛn na wobɛboro nsa akɔsie? Yi wo nsa no firi w’ani so.”
Na Hanah buaa sɛ: “Ɛnte saa, me wura! Meyɛ ɔbaa a me honhom abotoɔ; bobesa ne mmosa deɛ, mennom bi, na mmom mahwie me kra agu Awurade anim.
Mmu w’afenaa sɛ ɔbaa huhuni, ɛfiri sɛ me haw ne m’awerɛhoɔ dodoɔ mu na makasa abɛsi sɛsɛɛ yi.”
Ɛnna Eli buaa sɛ: “Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ, na Israel Nyankopɔn mma wo w’abisadeɛ a wode too n’anim no.”
Na ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Ma w’afenaa nnya w’anim adom.” Na ɔsiim kɔ kɔdidiiɛ, na n’anim ammoto bio.
Na wɔsɔree anɔpatutuutu kɔkotoo sɔree Awurade anim, na wɔsan baa wɔn fie wɔ Rama. Na Elkana kɔɔ ne yere Hanah ho, na Awurade kaee no.
Na afe kɔ bɛhyiaeɛ no, Hanah nyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo ne din Samuel, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa sɛ, “Awurade nkyɛn na mesrɛɛ no.”
Berɛ duruiɛ, na ɔbarima Elkana ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ afirinhyia afɔdeɛ ama Awurade na ɔde ne bɔhyɛ adeɛ ama.
Na Hanah deɛ, wankɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: “Sɛ abɔfra no twa nufoɔ ara pɛ a, mede no bɛkɔ, na wakɔpue Awurade anim, na watena hɔ daa.”
Ɛnna ne kunu Elkana ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ, na tena fie kɔsi sɛ wobɛtwa no nufoɔ. Awurade asɛm ara na ɔmma no mmra mu.” Na ɔbaa no tenaa fie hwɛɛ ne ba kɔsii sɛ ɔtwaa no nufoɔ.
Enti berɛ a ɔtwaa no nufoɔ no, ntɛm ara na ɔfaa no kaa ne ho, na ɔfaa nantwinini a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, ne esiam efa baako ne bobesa ahina ma, na ɔde no baa Awurade fie wɔ Shilo. Na abɔfra no nnyiniiɛ.
Na wɔkum nantwinini no, na wɔde abɔfra no brɛɛ Eli.
Ɛnna ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “O Me wura, Sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, me wura, mene ɔbaa a ɔbɛgyinaa wo nkyɛn ha bɔɔ Awurade mpaeɛ no.
Abɔfra yi ho mpaeɛ na mebɔɔ sɛ Awurade nyɛ m’abisadeɛ a mede too n’anim no mma me no.
Na me nso mede no rema Awurade. Ne nna a ɔde bɛtena aseɛ nyinaa, mede no ama Awurade.” Na ɔkotoo sɔree Awurade wɔ hɔ.
2: Samuel 2 “M’akoma di Awurade mu ahurisie, Awurade mu na wɔama m’abɛn soɔ. M’anom atrɛ m’atamfo so, ɛfiri sɛ m'ani gye wo nkwagyeɛ mu.
Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ kronkron sɛ Awurade, na obiara nni hɔ sɛ wo; Ɔbotan bi nni hɔ sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn.
Mommfa ahomasoɔ nnkasa bebree, Mommma nsɛnhunu biara mmfiri mo anom, Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn nimdefoɔ, Na ɔno na ɔkari nneyɛɛ nyinaa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ahoɔdenfoɔ tadua bubu, Nanso wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ ahoɔden dɔɔso.
Wɔn a wɔmee no, wɔbɛdi paa ansa na wɔanya aduane, Nanso ɛkɔm renne wɔn a wɔdi kɔm bio. Nanso ɔbaa a ɔwɔ mma bebree no yɛ ɔhokwafoɔ.
Awurade na ɔkum na ɔma nkwa, Deɛ ɔma nnipa siane kɔ Asamando mu, na ɔma wɔfiri hɔ ba.
Awurade ma onipa di hia, na ɔno na ɔma onipa di yie, Ɔno na ɔbrɛ onipa aseɛ, na ɔno na ɔma onipa soɔ.

Ɔno na ɔma mmɔborɔni so firi mfuturo mu, Na ɔma ohiani so firi sumina so, Sɛ ɔde wɔn bɛtena adehyeɛ mu; na wama wɔn anya animuonyam adwa so atena. Na asase nnyinasoɔ yɛ Awurade dea, na ɔde wiase asi soɔ.
Ɔbɔ n’ahotefoɔ nan ho ban, Na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ deɛ, esum mu na wɔbɛma wɔaka wɔn ano atom, Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ ahoɔden so na onipa nam bɛdi nkonim.
Wɔn a wɔne Awurade di asie no, ehu bɛka wɔn awie pasaa; Wɔn na ɔbɛma aprannaa abobom wɔ soro agu wɔn soɔ. Awurade na ɔbɛbu asase ano nyinaa atɛn, Na wama deɛ wasra no no abɛn so.”
Afei Elkana kɔɔ ne fie wɔ Rama. Abɔfra no deɛ, ɔbɛyɛɛ Awurade somfoɔ wɔ ɔsɔfoɔ Eli anim.
Na Eli mma mmarima no asɛe; na wɔmmu Awurade.
Na asɔfoɔ adeɛ a wɔyɛ ɔman no ne sɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no, sɛ wɔrenoa nam no a, ɔsɔfoɔ no somfoɔ de adinam a ano yɛ mmiɛnsa ba,
na ɔde abɛbɔ ɛsɛn anaa kwansɛn anaa dadesɛn anaa kukuo no mu. Deɛ adinam no bɛyi aba biara, ɔsɔfoɔ no fa. Saa na wɔde yɛɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔbaa Shilo nyinaa.
Bio nso, ansa na wɔbɛhye sradeɛ no, ɔsɔfoɔ no somfoɔ ba, na ɔbɛka kyerɛ deɛ ɔrebɔ afɔdeɛ no sɛ: “Ma me nam ma wɔntoto mma ɔsɔfoɔ no, na nammono mmom na ɔbɛgye no wo nkyɛn, na ɛnyɛ nam a wɔanoa.”
Nanso sɛ onii no ka kyerɛ no sɛ: “Ma wɔnni kan nhye sradeɛ no ansa, na ɛno akyi no wobɛtumi afa deɛ wo kra kɔn dɔ biara” a, ɔka sɛ: “Dabi, fa ma me seesei ara; anyɛ saa a, mɛfa no ahoɔden so!”
Na asomfoɔ no bɔne dɔɔso pii Awurade anim, ɛfiri sɛ mmarima no buu Awurade afɔrebɔdeɛ animtia.
Nanso Samuel deɛ,  ɔsomee wɔ Awurade anim; na ɔyɛ abɔfra a ɔhyɛ nwera asɔfotadeɛ.
Afei nso na ne maame pam nwera atadeɛ nsasini ma no, na ɔde brɛ no daa afirinhyia, berɛ a ɔne ne kunu ba bɛbɔ afirinhyia afɔdeɛ no.
Na Eli hyira Elkana ne ne yere sɛ: “Deɛ wode afɛm Awurade no, Awurade mma wonnya asefoɔ mfiri ɔbaa yi mu mfa nhyɛ deɛ wode afɛm no no ananmu.” Afei wɔsiim kɔɔ wɔn kurom.
Ɛnna Awurade twaa n’ani bɛhwɛɛ Hanah, na ɔnyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔwoo mma mmarima mmiɛnsa ne mma mmaa mmienu. Na abɔfra Samuel nyinii Awurade anim.
Na Eli abɔ akɔkoraa posoposo, na ɔtee deɛ ne mma mmarima no de reyɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa ne sɛdeɛ wɔne mmaa a wɔsom ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano da no nyinaa.
Deɛ na daa ɔka kyerɛ wɔn ne sɛ: “Adɛn nti na moyɛ nneɛma a ɛtete saa? Deɛ mete fa mo ho firi ɔmanfoɔ no nyinaa nkyɛn yɛ bɔne nko ara.
Dabi, me mma, nsɛm a wɔrekeka no Awurade man mu a mereteteɛ no nyɛ, momma Awurade man no fom.
Sɛ onipa yɛ onipa bɔne a, Onyankopɔn bɛpata ama no, na sɛ onipa yɛ Awurade bɔne deɛ a, hwan na ɔbɛpa kyɛw ama no?” Nanso wɔantie wɔn papa nne, ɛfiri sɛ afei deɛ na Awurade pɛ sɛ ɔkunkum wɔn.
Saa berɛ no nyinaa na abɔfra Samuel gu so renyini, na Awurade ne nnipa nyinaa pɛɛ n’asɛm.
Na Onyankopɔn nipa bi baa Eli nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade aka nie, ‘Ɛnyɛ me na meyii me ho adi kyerɛɛ wo nana fiefoɔ berɛ a na wɔwɔ Egypt na wɔyɛ nkoa wɔ Farao fie no?

Nnyɛ me na meyii no firii Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ ɔnni me sɔfoɔ na ɔmforo m’afɔrebukyia na ɔmma ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wisie ne ne hwa mforo nkɔ soro, na ɔnhyɛ asɔfotadeɛ m’anim, na me nso mede deɛ Israelfoɔ de bɔ afɔdeɛ egya soɔ nyinaa bɛma wo nana fiefoɔ?
Adɛn nti na motiatia m’afɔrebɔ ne m’ayɛyɛdeɛ a mahyɛ no me tenabea hɔ no soɔ, na wodi wo mma ni sene me, sɛ mobɛdi me man Israel afɔrebɔdeɛ mu deɛ ɛyɛ nyinaa de adɔ sradeɛ?

“‘Ɛno nti, Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn asɛm nie: “Me ara na mekaa sɛ, wo fie ne wo nana fie deɛ, wɔbɛnante m’anim akɔsi daa.” Nanso seesei deɛ, deɛ Awurade aka nie: “Ɛmpare me koraa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔdi me ni no, me nso mɛdi wɔn ni, na wɔn a wɔbu me animtia no, meremfa wɔn nyɛ hwee.”
Hwɛ! Nna bi reba a mɛtwa wo basa ne wo nana fie basa atwene, na akɔkoraa renka wo fie.
Nneɛma pa a wɔbɛyɛ ama Israel nyinaa mu no, wo deɛ, ɔtamfo na wobɛhu no me tenabea hɔ; akɔkoraa deɛ, ebi renka wo fie da.
Nanso wo ho nipa bi wɔ hɔ a merentwa no ntwene mfiri m’afɔrebukyia no ho sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛma w’ani asɛe na wo kra abotoɔ; na wo fiefoɔ dodoɔ no ara bɛwuwu nnipa nkrantɛ ano.
Yei ne sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛbɛba wo mma mmarima mmienu, Hofni ne Finehas so ama woahunu: Wɔn mmienu nyinaa bɛwuwu da koro.
Na mɛma ɔsɔfoɔ nokwafoɔ bi so afa. Deɛ ɛwɔ m’akomam ne deɛ ɛwɔ me kra mu na ɔbɛyɛ; na mɛkyekyere efie a ɛtim hɔ ama no, na ɔbɛnante deɛ masra no no anim daa.
Na ɛbɛba sɛ obiara a ɔbɛka wo fie no bɛba abɛkoto no agye dwetɛbena ne paanoo kurukuruwa na waka sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo fa me hyɛ asɔfodwuma no baako mu na manya paanoo sini bi adi.”’”
3: Samuel 3
Na ɛberɛ no mu, ɛbaa sɛ da bi na Eli da ne daberɛ; na n’ani so ayɛ wisiwisi na ɔnhunu adeɛ yie.
Na Onyankopɔn kanea no nnya nnumiiɛ, na Samuel da Awurade asɔrefie hɔ, baabi a Onyankopɔn adaka no wɔ no.
Na Awurade frɛɛ Samuel, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Menie.”
Ɛnna ɔtuu mmirika kɔɔ Eli nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: “Menie; worefrɛ me.” Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Memfrɛɛ wo. San kɔda.” Ɛnna ɔkɔdaeɛ.
Na Awurade frɛɛ no bio sɛ: “Samuel!” Na Samuel sɔreeɛ na ɔkɔɔ Eli nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: “Menie; wofrɛɛ me.” Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Me ba, memfrɛɛ wo. San kɔda.”
Nso Samuel deɛ, na ɔnnya nhunuu Awurade, na na wɔnnya mfirii aseɛ nyii Awurade asɛm nkyerɛɛ no.
Na Awurade kɔɔ so frɛɛ bio ne mprɛnsa soɔ sɛ: “Samuel!” Ɛnna ɔsɔreeɛ na ɔkɔɔ Eli nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: “Menie, na wofrɛɛ me.” Ɛnna Eli hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade na ɔrefrɛ abɔfra no.
Enti Eli ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Kɔda, na sɛ ɔfrɛ wo a ka sɛ, ‘Awurade, kasa na w’akoa retie.’” Na Samuel kɔdaa ne daberɛ.
Na Awurade ba bɛgyinaa hɔ frɛɛ sɛ kane no sɛ: “Samuel, Samuel!” Ɛnna Samuel kaa sɛ: “Kasa, na w’akoa retie.”
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Hwɛ! Merebɛyɛ adeɛ bi wɔ Israel, na obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, n’aso mmienu nyinaa mu bɛyɛ no kyeoo.
Ɛda no na mɛma deɛ maka atia Eli fie nyinaa aba mu firi mfitiaseɛ de kɔsi awieeɛ.
Na maka kyerɛ no sɛ merebu ne fie atɛn akɔsi daa, amumuyɛ no nti, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim sɛ ne mma no reyɛ atantanneɛ, nanso wanka wɔn anim.
Ɛno nti na maka ntam agu Eli fie so sɛ, afɔrebɔ anaa ayɛyɛdeɛ biara rentumi mpepa Eli fie bɔne ho asotwe a ɛrebɛba no da biara da.”
Na Samuel daa hɔ kɔsii anɔpa. Na ɔbuebuee Awurade fie apono no. Na Samuel suroo sɛ ɔbɛka deɛ ɔhunuiɛ no akyerɛ Eli.
Ɛnna Eli frɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Me ba Samuel!” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Menie.”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Asɛm bɛn na ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ? Mesrɛ wo mfa nhunta me. Sɛ wode asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no baako mpo hunta me a, Onyankopɔn ntua wo ka na ɔnsan mfa bi nka ho.”
Enti Samuel kaa nsɛm no nyinaa kyerɛɛ no, na wamfa biribiara anhunta no. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ Awurade. Deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ no, ma no nyɛ.”
Na Samuel nyiniiɛ, na Awurade dii n’akyi, na wamma ne nsɛm mu biara antɔ fam. [Kyerɛ sɛ: Asɛm biara a Samuel kaeɛ no baa mu].
Na Israel nyinaa, ɛfiri Dan kɔsi Beer-Seba, hunuu sɛ Samuel na wɔde no asi hɔ sɛ ɔnyɛ Awurade diyifoɔ.
Na Awurade yii ne ho adi bio wɔ Shilo, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade nam Awurade asɛm so yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Samuel wɔ Shilo.
4: Samuel 4
Na Filistifoɔ twaa mpasua de hyiaa Israel, na ɛko no yɛɛ den maa Israel dii nkoguo Filistifoɔ anim, na wɔkunkum mmarima bɛyɛ mpem nnan wɔ akono, ɛko mpasua no so.

Na berɛ a ɔman no baa nsraban no mu no, Israel mpanimfoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Adɛn nti na Awurade ama yɛadi nkoguo wɔ Filistifoɔ anim nnɛ yi? Momma yɛnkɔfa Awurade apam adaka no mfiri Shilo mmra yɛn nkyɛn, na ɛmmra yɛn mu mmɛgye yɛn mfiri yɛn atamfo nsam.”
Enti ɔman no soma kɔɔ Shilo kɔfaa asafo Awurade a ɔte kerubim ntam no apam adaka no baeɛ. Na Eli mma mmarima mmienu no, Hofni ne Finehas, wɔ Nyankopɔn apam adaka no ho.
Na berɛ a Awurade apam adaka no bɛduruu nsraban no mu ara pɛ, Israelfoɔ nyinaa bɔɔ ose kɛseɛ maa asase wosoeɛ.
Filistifoɔ no nso tee osebɔ no, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Hebrifoɔ nsraban mu osebɔ kɛseɛ yi ase ne sɛn?” Akyire yi wɔtee sɛ Awurade adaka no na aba nsraban no mu.
Na Filistifoɔ no suroeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn aba nsraban no mu!” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Buei, yɛnnue, asɛm sei bi nsii da!
Buei, yɛnnue! Hwan na ɔbɛgye yɛn afiri Onyankopɔn tumfoɔ yi nsam? Onyankopɔn yi na ɔde ɔhaw nyinaa bi kunkum Egyptfoɔ wɔ serɛ no soɔ no.
Mo Filistifoɔ, monnya akokoɔduro, monyɛ mmarima na moansom Hebrifoɔ no sɛdeɛ wɔasom mo no; monyɛ mmarima na monko!”
Enti Filistifoɔ no koeɛ, na Israel dii nkoguo maa obiara dwane kɔɔ ne ntomadan mu; wɔkum wɔn okunkɛseɛ paa, na Israel mmarima mpem aduasa (30,000) a wɔnam fam totɔeɛ.
Bio Onyankopɔn adaka no nso, wɔfaeɛ, na Eli mma mmienu no, Hofni ne Finehas, wuwuiɛ.
Na Benyamini bi firi mpasua no mu tuu mmirika baa Shilo da no ara; na wasuane n’atadeɛ mu, de dɔteɛ agu ne tirim.
Enti berɛ a ɔduruiɛ no, na Eli te adwa so wɔ kwankyɛn rehwɛ kwan, ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn adaka no nti na ne bo ntɔ ne yam. Na ɔbarima no kɔbɔɔ amanneɛ kuro no mu, na kuro no nyinaa bɔɔ bena.
Na Eli tee benabɔ no, na ɔbisaa sɛ: “Hooyɛ a meteɛ yi ase ne sɛn?” Na ɔbarima no yɛɛ ntɛm kɔbɔɔ Eli amanneɛ.
Na Eli adi mfeɛ aduɔkron nwɔtwe, na n’ani so ayɛ wisiwisi ama ɔnhunu adeɛ yie.
Na ɔbarima no ka kyerɛɛ Eli sɛ: “Mene deɛ ɔfiri mpasua mu baeɛ no; mpasua no mu na mefiri dwane baa nnɛ.” Ɛnna ɔbisaa sɛ: “Me ba, asɛm bɛn na asie?”

Na ɔbɔfoɔ no buaa sɛ: “Israel adwane Filistifoɔ anim, ɔman no adi nkoguo kɛse, na wɔakum ɔman no mu nnipa pii nso; na wo mma mmarima mmienu no, Hofni ne Finehas, awuwu, na Nyankopɔn adaka no nso, wɔafa.”

Berɛ a ɔbɔɔ Nyankopɔn adaka no ho asɛm ara pɛ, na ɔfiri n’adwa so muni faa n’akyi hwee fam wɔ ɛpono no ho, na ne kɔn mu bu maa no wuiɛ ɛfiri sɛ na wabɔ akɔkoraa na na ne mu nso yɛ duru; na wabu Israel atɛn mfeɛ aduanan.

Saa berɛ no, na n’ase, Finehas yere anyinsɛn, na n’awoɔ reyɛ aduru. Na berɛ a ɔtee sɛ wɔafa Nyankopɔn adaka no, na n’ase barima ne ne kunu nso awuwuo no, ɔkotoo sɛ ɔrewo ɛfiri sɛ awoɔ kaa no amonom hɔ ara.
Na berɛ a ɔbaa no ɔrewuo no, mmaa a wɔgyinagyina ne nkyɛn no kaa sɛ: “Nsuro, ɛfiri sɛ woawo ɔbabarima.” Nanso wammua, na wamfa n’akoma ankɔ so.
Na ɔtoo abɔfra no din Ikabod, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Animuonyam afiri Israel mu kɔ.” Nyankopɔn adaka a wɔafa ne n’ase barima ne ne kunu nti na ɔkaa saa.
Enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Animuonyam afiri Israel mu kɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔafa Nyankopɔn adaka no.”
5: Samuel 5
Na Filistifoɔ no de Nyankopɔn adaka no kɔɔ Dagon fie, na wɔde kɔsii Dagon nkyɛn.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a Asdodfoɔ sɔree anɔpatutuutu no, na Dagon ahwe ase ama n’anim butu fam Awurade adaka no anim. Enti wɔmaa Dagon so, na wɔsan de no sii ne sibea.

Na adeɛ kyeeɛ, da a ɛdi hɔ a wɔsɔree anɔpatutuutu no, hwɛ, na Dagon ahwe ase a n’anim butu fam Awurade adaka no anim; na Dagon ti ne n’abakɔn mmienu no atete gugu kwan ano. Ne kuntunsini a ɛte sɛ apataa no nko na ɛkaeɛ.
Ɛno nti na ɛde bɛsi nnɛ no, Dagon asɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔkɔ Dagon fie nyinaa ntia Dagon aponnwa a ɛwɔ Asdod no soɔ no.
Na Awurade nsa yɛɛ den Asdodfoɔ so, na ɔmaa wɔn ho popoeɛ na ɔmaa mpɔmpɔ bobɔɔ wɔn, kyerɛ sɛ Asdod ne ne mpɔtamu hɔfoɔ nyinaa.
Na berɛ a Asdodfoɔ bɛhunuu sɛ aba saa no, wɔkaa sɛ: “Mommma Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no nntena yɛn nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa ayɛ den yɛne yɛn nyame Dagon so.”

Enti wɔsoma kɔboaboaa Filistifoɔ ahemfo no nyinaa ano baa wɔn nkyɛn, na wɔbisaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no?” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Momfa Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no nkɔ Gat.” Enti wɔde Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no kɔɔ hɔ.
Na wɔde kɔɔ hɔ no, ɛbaa sɛ Awurade nsa baa kuro no so maa wɔn ho yeraa wɔn papaapa, na ɔbobɔɔ kurom hɔfoɔ, ɛfiri kumaa so kɔsi kɛseɛ so, maa mpɔmpɔ bobɔɔ wɔn.
Enti wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no kɔɔ Ekron. Berɛ a Nyankopɔn adaka no duruu Ekron no, ɛhɔ ara na Ekronfoɔ no teateaam sɛ: “Wɔde Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no aba yɛn nkyɛn de rebɛkunkum yɛn ne yɛn man!”

Enti wɔsoma kɔboaboaa Filistifoɔ ahemfo no nyinaa ano, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Momfa Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no mfiri ha nsan nkɔsi ne sibea, na anku yɛn ne yɛn man.” Deɛ ɛteɛ ne sɛ, na ahoyera a ɛkum nnipa asi kuro no mu nyinaa. Na Nyankopɔn nsa yɛɛ den paa wɔ hɔ.
Na kuro no mufoɔ a wɔanwuwuo no, mpɔmpɔ bobɔɔ wɔn, na kuro no sufrɛ foro kɔduruu ɔsoro.
6: Samuel 6
Ɛnna Filistifoɔ no frɛɛ asɔfoɔ ne akɔmfoɔ no bisaa wɔn sɛ: “Yɛnyɛ Awurade adaka no dɛn? Monkyerɛ yɛn adekodeɛ a yɛmfa nka ho nkɔ ne sibea.”
Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ mode Israel Nyankopɔn adaka no rekɔ a, mommfa nsapan nnkɔ. Momfa asodie afɔdeɛ nka ho nkɔma no. Ɛno na wɔbɛsa mo yareɛ, na mobɛhunu deɛ enti a ne nsa mfirii mo soɔ no.”

Ɛnna wɔbisaa sɛ: “Asodie afɔdeɛ bɛn na yɛmfa nka ho nkɔma no?” Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Momfa sika kɔkɔɔ nyɛ mpɔmpɔ num ne sika nkura nnum, sɛdeɛ Filistifoɔ ahemfo no dodoɔ teɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhaw korɔ no ara na ɛwɔ mo nyinaa ne mo ahemfo soɔ.
Na monyɛ mo mpɔmpɔ no nsɛsoɔ ne mo nkura a wɔresɛe mo asase no nsɛsoɔ, na momfa animuonyam mma Israel Nyankopɔn. Ebia ɔbɛma ne nsa ayɛ hare wɔ mo ne mo nyame ne mo asase so.
Na adɛn nti na moyɛ mo akoma dendeenden sɛdeɛ Egypt ne Farao yɛɛ wɔn akoma dendeenden no? Ɛnyɛ berɛ a ɔde ɔhaw baa wɔn so wieeɛ no ansa na wɔgyaee wɔn maa wɔkɔɔ wɔn kwan?
Afei monyɛ teaseɛnam foforɔ, na momfa anantwibereɛ mmienu a wɔma nufoɔ a wɔmfaa kɔndua biara ntoo wɔn so da, na momfa anantwie no nsesa teaseɛnam no, na montete wɔn mma no mfiri wɔn ho nkɔ fie.
Na momfa Awurade adaka no nsi teaseɛnam no so, na momfa sika nneɛma a mode rekɔbɔ asodie afɔdeɛ ama no no ngu adaka ketewa mu nsi nkyɛn, na monnya no kwan ma no ɛnkɔ.
Afei monhwɛ: sɛ ɛfa ne kwan so kɔ n’asase so, Bet-Semes a, ɛnneɛ na ɛyɛ ɔno na wayɛ yɛn bɔne kɛseɛ yi; sɛ anyɛ saa a, ɛnneɛ na yɛahunu sɛ ɛnyɛ ne nsa na ɔde aka yɛn; asiane bi na asiane yɛn.”
Enti nkurɔfoɔ no yɛɛ saa. Wɔfaa anantwibereɛ mmienu a wɔma nufoɔ de wɔn sesaa teaseɛnam no, na wɔtoo wɔn mma no mu wɔ fie.
Afei wɔde Awurade adaka no sii teaseɛnam no so, na wɔde adaka ketewa no ne sika nkura ne wɔn mpɔnpɔ nsɛsoɔ no kaa ho.

Na anantwie no faa kwan tee kɔɔ Bet-Semes kwan so. Tempɔn korɔ no ara so na wɔfaeɛ, na wɔrekɔ nyinaa na wɔresu. Wɔammane ankɔ nifa anaa benkum. Na saa berɛ no nyinaa na Filistifoɔ ahemfo no di wɔn akyi; wɔdii wɔn akyi kɔduruu Bet-Semes hyeɛ so.
Na Bet-Semesfoɔ retwa ayuo wɔ asasetamaa no so. Na berɛ a wɔmemaa wɔn ani so na wɔhunuu Adaka no, wɔdii ahurisie sɛ wɔahunu.
Na teaseɛnam no duruu Bet-Semesni Yosua afuo mu, na ɛgyinaa hɔ, baabi a ɛboɔ kɛseɛ bi wɔ no. Na wɔpaepaee teaseɛnam no nnua no, na wɔde anantwie no bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ maa Awurade.

Ɛnna Lewifoɔ no yii Awurade adaka no sii hɔ, ne adaka ketewa a ɛka ho a sika nneɛma wɔ mu no, na wɔde sii ɛboɔ kɛseɛ no so. Ɛnna Bet-Semesfoɔ no bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na wɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Awurade saa da no.
Na Filistifoɔ ahemfo nnum no hunuiɛ, na wɔsan wɔn akyi kɔɔ Ekron saa da no.
Na Yeinom ne sika mpɔnpɔ a Filistifoɔ no de kɔbɔɔ asodie afɔdeɛ maa Awurade no: Asdod deɛ baako, Gasa deɛ baako, Askelon deɛ baako, Gat deɛ baako, na Ekron deɛ nso baako.

Na sɛdeɛ Filistifoɔ ahemfo nnum no nkuro dodoɔ teɛ no, saa na wɔyɛɛ sika nkura no, ɛfiri kuro a wɔabɔ ho ban so kɔsi petee mu nkuraa so. Ɛboɔ kɛseɛ a wɔde Awurade adaka no sii soɔ no ayɛ adanseɛ wɔ Bet-Semesni Yosua afuo no mu de bɛsi nnɛ.
Nanso Awurade adaka a Bet-Semesfoɔ hwɛeɛ mu no nti, ɔkunkum wɔn. Ɔkum wɔn mu mmarima aduɔson ne nnipa mpem aduonum. Na ɔman no dii awerɛhoɔ ɛfiri sɛ Awurade de okunkɛseɛ kunkum ɔman no mufoɔ.
Ɛnna Bet-Semesfoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina Awurade, Onyankopɔn kronkronni yi anim, na hwan nkyɛn na ɔmfiri yɛn nkyɛn nkorɔ?”
Na wɔtuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Kiriat-Yearimfoɔ nkyɛn sɛ: “Filistifoɔ no de Awurade adaka no asan aba, na mommra mmɛfa nkɔ mo nkyɛn.”
7: Samuel 7
Ɛbaa sɛ ɛfiri da a Adaka no baa Kiriat-Yearim no, ɛkyɛree hɔ; ɛdii mfeɛ aduonu wɔ hɔ, na Israel fie nyinaa dii awerɛhoɔ hwehwɛɛ Awurade akyiri kwan.

Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Israel fie nyinaa sɛ: “Sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa resane aba Awurade nkyɛn a, ɛnneɛ monyi ananafoɔ anyame a ɛwɔ mo nkyɛn ne Astarot ahoni no mfiri mo mu, na momfa mo akoma mu nyinaa nni Awurade akyi na monsom ɔno nko ara, na ɔbɛgye mo afiri Filistifoɔ no nsam.”
Na Israelfoɔ no yiyii Baal anyame no ne Astarot ahoni no firii wɔn mu, na wɔsom Awurade nko ara.
Ɛnna Samuel kaa sɛ: “Mommoaboa Israel nyinaa ano mmɛhyia Mispa, na memmɔ Awurade mpaeɛ mma mo.”
Enti wɔboaboaa wɔn ho ano bɛhyiaa Mispa, na wɔsaa nsuo hwie guu fam Awurade anim, na wɔdii abuada saa da no. Na wɔkaa no ɛhɔ sɛ: “Yɛayɛ Awurade bɔne.” Na Samuel bu Israelfoɔ atɛn wɔ Mispa.
Na Filistifoɔ no tee sɛ Israelfoɔ aboaboa wɔn ano wɔ Mispa, na Filistifoɔ ahemfo no tu baa Israel so. Berɛ a Israelfoɔ no teeɛ no, Filistifoɔ no nti wɔsuroeɛ.
Ɛnna Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Nnyae osu a woresu afrɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn ama yɛn no, na ɔnnye yɛn mfiri Filistifoɔ nsam.”
Na Samuel faa adwammaa a ɔnum nufoɔ na ɔde no bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mu maa Awurade, na Samuel su frɛɛ Awurade maa Israel, na Awurade gyee ne so.

Ɛbaa sɛ Samuel gu so rebɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no, Filistifoɔ no twe bɛnee sɛ wɔne Israel rebɛko. Na Awurade maa aprannaa boboom dendeenden guu Filistifoɔ no so saa da no de maa wɔn adwene tu fraeɛ, na wɔdii nkoguo Israel anim.
Ɛnna Israel mmarima firii adi firi Mispa kɔtii Filistifoɔ no, na wɔkunkum wɔn ara kɔsii Bet-Kar anafoɔ.
Na Samuel faa boɔ, na ɔde sii Mispa ne Shen ntam, na ɔtoo ne din Ebeneser. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade de yɛn abɛsie nie.”
Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a wɔdii Filistifoɔ so nkonim, na wɔamma Israel asase so bio, na Samuel nna nyinaa, Awurade nsa ko tiaa Filistifoɔ no.

Na nkuro a Filistifoɔ gye firii Israel nsam no, ɛsan bɛdii Israel nsam nkakrankakra, ɛfiri Ekron kɔsi Gat; ɛho nsase nso, Israel gye firii Filistifoɔ nsam. Na asomdwoeɛ baa Israelfoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ntam.
Na Samuel buu Israel atɛn ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na ɔtutuu akwan afe afe kɔɔ Betel ne Gilgal ne Mispa hyiaeɛ, na ɔbuu Israel atɛn wɔ mmeammea yi nyinaa.
Nanso na ɔsan ba Rama ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na na ne fie wɔ, na ɛhɔ na ɔbuu Israel atɛn. Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ maa Awurade.
8: Samuel 8
Na n’abakan din de Yoel, na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no din de Abiya; wɔbuu atɛn wɔ Beer-Seba.
Ne mma amfa n’akwan so; wɔdii mfasobɔne akyi, wɔgyee adanmudeɛ, na wɔdanee atemmuo ani.
Na Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa boaa wɔn ho ano baa Samuel nkyɛn wɔ Rama,
bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ! Wo deɛ, woabɔ akora, na wo mma no nso amfa w’akwan so. Enti si yɛn so hene na ɔmmu yɛn atɛn sɛ amanaman a aka no nyinaa.”
Na ɛyɛɛ Samuel ani so bɔne sɛ wɔkaa sɛ: “Ma yɛn ɔhene na ɔmmu yɛn atɛn” no, na Samuel bɔɔ Awurade mpaeɛ.
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Deɛ ɔman no aka nyinaa, tie wɔn ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ wo na wɔapo woɔ; me mmom na wɔapo me sɛ mennni wɔn so hene.
Ɛfiri da a mede wɔn firi Egypt baeɛ bɛsi nnɛ, deɛ wɔayɛ de apo me akɔsom anyame foforɔ no nyinaa, saa ara na wɔde reyɛ woɔ yi.
Enti tie wɔn, na kasa kyerɛ wɔn, na kyerɛ wɔn ɔhene a ɔbɛdi wɔn soɔ no atemmudeɛ.”
Na Samuel kaa Awurade nsɛm no nyinaa kyerɛɛ ɔman a wɔbisaa ne hɔ ɔhene no.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Yei ne ɔhene a ɔbɛdi mo soɔ no atemmudeɛ: Ɔbɛfa mo mma mmarima, na ɔde wɔn akɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mu, na ebinom bɛtu mmirika adi ne nteaseɛnam anim;
ɔde wɔn bɛyɛ apem apem so ahwɛfoɔ ne aduonum aduonum so ahwɛfoɔ, na ebinom bɛfuntum n’asase na wɔatwa ne nnɔbaeɛ, na wɔn na wɔbɛyeyɛ n’akodeɛ ne ne nteaseɛnam ho nneɛma.
Na ɔde mo mma mmaa bɛyɛ adufrafoɔ ne aduannoafoɔ ne paanootofoɔ.
Mo mfuo ne mo bobe nturo ne mo ngodua nturo mu deɛ ɛyɛ no, ɔbɛfa na ɔde ama ne nkoa.
Na ɔbɛgye mo mfuo mu aba ne mo bobeturo mu aba so ntotosoɔ du du ama n’ahemfie mpanimfoɔ ne ne nkoa.
Na ɔbɛfa mo nkoa ne mo mfenaa ne mo mmeranteɛ pa, ne mo mmoa mu deɛ ɛyɛ, ne mo mfunumu de wɔn ayɛ n’adwuma.
Ɔbɛgye mo nnwan so ntotosoɔ du du, na mobɛyɛ ne nkoa.
Na ɛda no, mo hene a moayi no no adi mo soɔ no nti, mobɛsu, nanso Awurade rennye mo so saa da no.”
Nanso ɔman no antie Samuel, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Dabi, ɔhene ara na ɔbɛdi yɛn soɔ.
Na yɛn nso yɛbɛyɛ sɛ aman a aka no nyinaa, na yɛn hene bɛbu yɛn atɛn na wadi yɛn anim ako yɛn ko ama yɛn.”
Na Samuel tiee ɔman no nsɛm no nyinaa, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Awurade.
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Tie wɔn na si ɔhene ma no nni wɔn so.” Na Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Israel mmarima no sɛ: “Obiara nkɔ ne kuro mu.”
9: Samuel 9
Na ɔwɔ ɔbabarima bi a ne din de Saul, aberanteɛ a ne ho yɛ fɛ a Israelni biara nni hɔ a ɔsene no ahoɔfɛ mu; ɛfiri ne mmatiri rekɔ no, na ɔware sene obiara, wɔ ɔman no mu.
Na Saul papa Kis mfunumu yeraeɛ. Enti Kis ka kyerɛɛ ne ba Saul sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, fa asomfoɔ no baako ka wo ho, na sɔre kɔhwehwɛ mfunumu no.”
Na wɔkɔfaa Efraim mmepɔ so kɔfaa Salisa asase so, nanso wɔanhu wɔn. Afei wɔkɔtwaam Saalim asase so, nanso na wɔnni hɔ. Na ɔkɔfaa Benyaminfoɔ asase so, nanso wɔanhu wɔn.
Na berɛ a wɔkɔduruu Suf asase soɔ no, Saul ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ a ɔka ne ho no sɛ: “Bra ma yɛnsan nkɔ na me papa annyae mfunumu no akyiridie ammɛdwene yɛn ho mmom.”
Ɛnna ɔsomfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ! Onyankopɔn nipa bi wɔ kuro yi mu, a n'anim yɛ nyam paa. Asɛm biara a ɔbɛka ba mu. Ma yɛnkɔ hɔ seesei ara. Ebia ɔbɛkyerɛ yɛn kwan a yɛmfa soɔ.”
Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: “Sɛ yɛkɔ a, ɛdeɛn na yɛde bɛkɔ akɔma ɔbarima no? Paanoo a ɛwɔ yɛn nneɛma mu asa, na hwee nni hɔ a yɛde bɛkyɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no. Ɛdeɛn na yɛwɔ?”
Na ɔsomfoɔ no san ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Hwɛ! Mekura dwetɛ dwetɛbena abupɛn nnan mu baako; mɛtumi de ama Nyankopɔn nipa no na wakyerɛ yɛn deɛ yɛmfa.”
Akane no, sɛ ɔbarima bi rekɔbisa Onyankopɔn hɔ adeɛ wɔ Israel a, anka deɛ ɔbɛka ne sɛ: “Ma yɛnkɔhunu ɔdehunufoɔ no.” Deɛ wɔfrɛ no odiyifoɔ nnɛ no, kane no, na wɔfrɛ no ɔdehunufoɔ.
Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: “Deɛ woaka no yɛ. Bra ma yɛnkɔ.” Na wɔkɔɔ kuro a Nyankopɔn nipa no wom no mu.
Na berɛ a wɔreforo akɔ kuro no mu no, wɔhunuu mmabaa bi sɛ wɔrekɔsa nsuo. Ɛnna wɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: “Ɛha na ɔdehunufoɔ no wɔ anaa?”
Ɛnna wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Ɔwɔ ha. Hwɛ! Ɔwɔ mo anim. Monka mo ho ɛfiri sɛ waba kurom ha nnɛ, na ɔman no wɔ afɔdeɛ bi bɔ wɔ sorɔnsorɔnbea hɔ nnɛ.

Sɛ moduru kuro no mu ara pɛ a, mobɛhu no ansa na wakɔ sorɔnsorɔnbea hɔ akɔdidi; ɔman no rennidi kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛkɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔhyira afɔdeɛ no soɔ. Ɔhyira so wie ansa na wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn aba no adidi. Enti momforo nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno deɛ, berɛ yi mu ara na mobɛhu no.”
Na wɔforo kɔɔ kuro no mu. Na berɛ a wɔreyɛ aduru kuro no mu no, hwɛ, na Samuel refiri adi abɛhyia wɔn aforo akɔ sorɔnsorɔnbea hɔ.
Da a adeɛ rebɛkye ama Saul aba no, Awurade yii Samuel asotire sɛ:

“Ɔkyena saa berɛ yi mɛsoma ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Benyamin asase so aba wo nkyɛn, na sra no ngo na fa no si me man Israel so panin; ɔno na ɔbɛgye me man afiri Filistifoɔ nsam, ɛfiri sɛ mahunu me man amanehunu, na wɔn sufrɛ abɛduru me nkyɛn.”
Na Samuel hunuu Saul, na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔbarima a meka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ, ‘Oyi na ɔbɛdi me man soɔ’ no nie.”
Na Saul twe bɛnee Samuel wɔ kuro pono no ano, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo ka kyerɛ me, ɛhe na ɔdehunufoɔ no fie wɔ?”
Ɛnna Samuel buaa Saul sɛ: “Mene ɔdehunufoɔ no. Foro di m’anim kɔ sorɔnsorɔnbea hɔ, na mo ne me bɛdidi nnɛ na anɔpa magya mo kwan, na deɛ ɛwɔ w’akomam nyinaa, mɛka akyerɛ wo.
Na wo mfunumu a wɔyeraa nnansa ne nnɛ no, mfa w’adwene nto so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔahu wɔn. Na hwan na Israel nneɛma pa nyinaa wɔ no? Ɛnyɛ wo ne wo papa fie nyinaa dea anaa?”

Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Me deɛ, meyɛ Benyaminni; ɛnyɛ Israel mmusuakuo mu ketewa no mu na mefire? Na Benyamin abusuakuo mu mmusua nyinaa no, ɛnyɛ m’abusua ne ketewa koraa? Enti adɛn nti na woka saa asɛm yi kyerɛ me?”
Afei Samuel faa Saul ne ne somfoɔ no, na ɔde wɔn baa adidibea hɔ, na ɔde wɔn tenaa baabi titire wɔ wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn no mu; na wɔyɛ mmarima bɛyɛ aduasa.
Akyire yi, Samuel ka kyerɛɛ oduannoafoɔ no sɛ: “Fa nankum a mede maa woɔ a meka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ, ‘Fa sie’ no bra.”

Ɛnna oduannoafoɔ no kɔfaa ne srɛ ne deɛ ɛtua soɔ no, na ɔde bɛsii Saul anim. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ wɔde sieeɛ no nie. Fa si w’anim. Di, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde asie ama wo abɛpem berɛ a wɔahyɛ yi na ama wo ne wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn no adidie.” Enti Saul ne Samuel didii saa da no.
Na wɔwieeɛ no, wɔsiane firii sorɔnsorɔnbea hɔ kɔɔ kuro no mu, na ɔne Saul kasaa wɔ dan atifi.
Afei wɔsɔree anɔpahema, na adeɛ rekye no, Samuel frɛɛ Saul ɛdan atifi hɔ sɛ: “Sɔre, na mennya wo kwan.” Ɛnna Saul sɔreeɛ, na wɔn mmienu nyinaa, ɔne Samuel, firii adi.

Na berɛ a wɔresiane afiri kuro no mu no, Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Ka kyerɛ ɔsomfoɔ no sɛ ɔmmɛsene nni yɛn anim nkɔ”, enti ɔbɛsene kɔeɛ; “na wo deɛ, gyina hɔ na menka asɛm a Onyankopɔn aka no nkyerɛ wo.”
10: Samuel 10

Sɛ ɛnnɛ wofiri me nkyɛn rekɔ a, wobɛhunu mmarima mmienu wɔ Rachel damena nkyɛn wɔ Selsa, Benyamin asase so, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Mfunumu a wokɔhwehwɛɛ wɔn no, wɔahu wɔn, na wo papa agyae mfunumu no akyiridie redwene mo ho sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na menyɛ wɔ me ba yi ho?”’

Na firi hɔ toa so kɔ w’anim ara kɔduru Tabor dua kɛseɛ no ase, na ɛhɔ na wobɛhyia mmarima mmiɛnsa a wɔrekɔ Nyankopɔn anim wɔ Betel; baako kura mmirekyie mma mmiɛnsa, baako kura paanoo nkuruwankuruwa mmiɛnsa na baako nso so bobesa ahina ma.
Na wɔbɛkyea  wo, na wɔama wo paanoo mmienu; gye no wɔn nsam.

Ɛno akyi no, wobɛduru Nyankopɔn kokoɔ no so, baabi a Filistifoɔ asraafoɔdɔm wɔ no. Na ɛbɛba sɛ woduru kuro no mu a, wobɛhyia adiyifoɔ kuo bi a wɔresiane afiri sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ a nkurɔfoɔ rebɔ asankuo ne mpintin ne abɛn ne sankuten di wɔn anim na wɔrehyɛ nkɔm.
Na Awurade honhom bɛsi wo so, na wo ne wɔn nyinaa ahyɛ nkɔm, na wobɛdane ayɛ onipa foforɔ.
Na saa nsɛnkyerɛnne yi ba mu ma wo a, yɛ deɛ wobɛtumi biara, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn di w’akyi.
Di m’anim siane kɔ Gilgal, na hwɛ! mɛsiane aba wo nkyɛn abɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. Twɛn nnanson kɔsi sɛ mɛba wo nkyɛn, na mabɛkyerɛ wo deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ.”
Ɛbaa sɛ ɔdanee ne ho sɛ ɔrefiri Samuel nkyɛn akɔ ara pɛ, Onyankopɔn danee n’akoma yɛɛ no foforɔ, na nsɛnkyerɛnne yi nyinaa sisii saa da no.
Enti wɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ kokoɔ no so, na adiyifoɔ kuo bi bɛhyiaa no; ɛhɔ ara na Onyankopɔn honhom sii ne soɔ, na ɔfirii aseɛ hyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ wɔn mu.
Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔn a wɔni no kane no hunuu no no, hwɛ, na ɔne adiyifoɔ no rehyɛ nkɔm. Enti nkurɔfoɔ bisabisaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ Kis ba yi? Saul nso ka adiyifoɔ no ho anaa?”
Na ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri hɔ buaa sɛ: “Na wɔn kannifoɔ ne hwan?” Ɛno nti na abɛyɛ akasabebuo sɛ: “Saul nso ka adiyifoɔ no ho anaa?”
Afei berɛ a ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm no wieeɛ no, ɔkɔɔ sorɔnsorɔnbea hɔ.
Akyire yi, Saul papa nua bisaa ɔne ne somfoɔ no sɛ: “Mokɔɔ he?” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛkɔhwehwɛɛ mfunumu no, na yɛkɔkyinkyinii sɛ yɛbɛhu wɔn a, nanso yɛanhu wɔn. Enti yɛkɔɔ Samuel nkyɛn.”
Ɛnna Saul papa nua no kaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo ka kyerɛ me, ɛdeɛn na Samuel ka kyerɛɛ mo?”
Ɛnna Saul buaa ne papa nua no sɛ: “Ɔka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ wɔahunu mfunumu no.” Nanso ahennie no ho asɛm a Samuel kaeɛ no deɛ, wanka ankyerɛ no.
Na Samuel frɛfrɛɛ ɔman no bɛhyiaa Awurade anim wɔ Mispa;
na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn aka nie, ‘Ɛyɛ me na meyii Israel firii Egypt, na megyee mo firii Egyptfoɔ nsam ne ahennie a wɔhyɛɛ mo soɔ no nyinaa nso nsam.

Na mo deɛ, ɛnnɛ moapo mo Nyankopɔn a ɔgyee mo firii mo haw ne mo amanehunu nyinaa mu no, na moaka sɛ: “Dabi, ɔhene ara na si no yɛn soɔ.” Enti afei mommɛgyina Awurade anim sɛdeɛ mo mmusuakuo ne mo apem apem dodoɔ teɛ.’”
Enti Samuel maa Israel mmusuakuo no nyinaa twe bɛnee, na wɔyii Benyamin abusuakuo no.
Afei ɔmaa Benyamin abusuakuo no twe bɛnee, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ, na wɔyii Matrifoɔ abusua no, na wɔyii Kis ba Saul. Na wɔhwehwɛɛ no, nanso wɔanhu no.
Ɛnna wɔbisaa Awurade bio sɛ: “Ɔbarima no abɛduru ha anaa?” Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, wakɔhunta nneɛma no mu.”
Enti wɔde mmirika kɔfaa no firii hɔ baeɛ. Na berɛ a ɔbɛgyinaa ɔman no mu no, na ɔware sene nnipa a aka no nyinaa, ɛfiri ne mmatiri rekorɔ.
Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: “Moahunu deɛ Awurade ayi no no, sɛ obiara nte sɛ no ɔman yi nyinaa mu?” Na ɔman no nyinaa bɔɔ ose kaa sɛ: “Ɔhene nnya nkwa daa!”
Afei Samuel kaa ahennie no ho nhyehyɛeɛ kyerɛɛ ɔman no, na ɔtwerɛɛ no nwoma mu de kɔtoo Awurade anim. Na Samuel gyaa ɔman no nyinaa kwan maa obiara kɔɔ ne fie.
Na Saul nso kɔɔ ne fie wɔ Gibea, na mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ a Onyankopɔn aka wɔn akoma no ne no kɔeɛ.
Na nnipa hunu bi kaa sɛ: “Oyi deɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn agye yɛn?” Na wɔbuu no animtia, na wɔamfa akyɛdeɛ biara ammrɛ no. Nanso ɔyɛɛ sɛ deɛ ɔnteɛ.
11: Samuel 11
Na Ammonni Nahas ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Nhyehyɛeɛ yi na mɛgyina so ne mo ayɛ apam, ɛne sɛ, mɛtutu mo mu biara ani nifa na mede ayɛ ahohora ato Israel nyinaa so.”
Ɛnna Yebes mpanimfoɔ nso ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ma yɛn nnanson, na yɛbɛsoma abɔfoɔ akɔ Israel nsase nyinaa so, na sɛ yɛannya ɔgyefoɔ biara a, ɛnneɛ yɛbɛfiri adi aba wo nkyɛn.”
Na abɔfoɔ no kɔɔ Saul kuro Gibea mu kɔkaa asɛm no kuro no mufoɔ asom, na kuro no mufoɔ nyinaa memaa wɔn nne so suiɛ.
Na Saul firi wuram reba a ɔreka mmoa, na Saul bisaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ kuro yi a wɔresu yi?” Ɛnna wɔkaa nsɛm a Yebes mmarima aka no kyerɛɛ no.
Na berɛ a Saul tee asɛm no, Onyankopɔn honhom sii ne so, na ne bo fuu kɛse.

Enti ɔfaa anantwie mmienu, na ɔtwitwaa wɔn mu asinasini de hyɛɛ abɔfoɔ no nsa sɛ wɔmfa nkɔ Israel nsase nyinaa so, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Obiara a ɔwɔ yɛn mu a ɔremfiri adi mmɛdi Saul ne Samuel akyi no, sei na wɔbɛyɛ n’anantwie!” Na Awurade ho hu tɔɔ ɔman no so, na wɔfirii adi sɛ onipa baako.
Enti ɔkan wɔn wɔ Besek; na Israelfoɔ ano si mpem ahasa (300,000), na Yuda mmarima ano si mpem aduasa (30,000).

Afei wɔka kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ a wɔbaeɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ monkɔka nkyerɛ mmarima a wɔwɔ Yebes a ɛwɔ Gilead nie, ‘Ɔkyena sɛ awia mu reyɛ den a, mobɛnya ɔgyeɛ.’” Ɛnna abɔfoɔ no bɛka kyerɛɛ Yebes mmarima, na wɔdii ahurisie.
Ɛno nti Yebes mmarima no kɔka kyerɛɛ Ammonfoɔ sɛ: “Ɔkyena yɛbɛfiri adi aba mo nkyɛn, na deɛ ɛtene mo ani soɔ biara, momfa nyɛ yɛn.”
Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Saul kyɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ no mu mmiɛnsa, na wɔbɔ wuraa Ammonfoɔ nsraban mu ahemadakye kɔkunkum wɔn kɔsii awia ketee. Wɔn a ɛkaeɛ nso, wɔbɔɔ wɔn hwete maa wɔn mu mmienu mpo anka faako.
Ɛnna ɔman no keka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Hwannom na wɔse, ‘Saul na ɔbɛyɛ yɛn so hene anaa?’ no. Momfa wɔn mmra mma yɛnkunkum wɔn.”
Nanso Saul kaa sɛ: “Monnkum obiara saa da yi, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnnɛ, Awurade agye nkwa wɔ Israel.”
Akyire yi, Samuel ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Mommra mma yɛnkɔ Gilgal na yɛnyɛ ahennie no foforɔ wɔ hɔ.”
Enti ɔman no nyinaa kɔɔ Gilgal, na wɔsii Saul hene Awurade anim wɔ Gilgal. Afei wɔbɔɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ Awurade anim, na Saul ne Israel mmarima nyinaa dii ahurisie kɛse wɔ hɔ.
12: Samuel 12
Monhwɛ, ɔhene a ɔbɛdi mo anim no nie! Me deɛ, mabɔ akora na mafu dwono, na me mma nso, mo mu na wɔwɔ; me deɛ, mefiri me mmɔfraase anante mo anim de abɛduru nnɛ.

Me na megyina ha yi. Monka no Awurade ne deɛ wasra no yi anim: Hwan nantwie anaa n’afunumu na magyeɛ, na hwan na masisi no anaa mahyɛ ne soɔ? Hwan nsam na magye adanmudeɛ de akata m’ani? Monka mma menhyɛ mo ananmu.”
Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Wonsisii yɛn, wonhyɛɛ yɛn so, na wonnyee yɛn mu biara nsam hwee.”
Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Ɛnnɛ Awurade yɛ danseni mo anim, na deɛ wasra no yi nso yɛ danseni sɛ moanhunu hwee me nsam.” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔne danseni.”
Na Samuel nso ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Awurade yɛ danseni; ɔno na ɔfaa Mose ne Aaron na ɔyii mo agyanom firii Egypt asase soɔ.
Enti afei monnyinagyina ha na memmɔ mo soboɔ Awurade anim, na menka adetenenee a Awurade ayɛ ama mo ne mo agyanom nyinaa nkyerɛ mo.
“Berɛ a Yakob kɔɔ Egypt no na Egyptfoɔ no hyɛɛ wɔn soɔ, na mo agyanom firii aseɛ su frɛɛ Awurade, na Awurade somaa Mose ne Aaron maa wɔdii mo agyanom anim firii Egypt maa wɔbɛtenaa ha.
Nanso wɔn werɛ firii Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn, enti ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Hasor sahene Sisera nsa, ne Filistifoɔ nsa, ne Moab hene nsa, na wɔn nyinaa ko tiaa wɔn.
Na wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade sɛ, ‘Yɛayɛ bɔne, na yɛagya Awurade akɔsom Baal anyame ne Astarot ahoni. Afei gye yɛn firi yɛn atamfo nsam na yɛnsom wo.’
Ɛnna Awurade somaa Yerubaal ne Bedan ne Yefta ne Samuel, na ɔgyee mo firii mo atamfo a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia nsam maa motenaa ase dwoodwoo.
Berɛ a mohunuu sɛ Ammonfoɔ hene Nahas aba mo soɔ no, moka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Dabi, ɔhene ara na ɔbɛdi yɛn soɔ!’ nso saa berɛ no nyinaa na Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛ mo Hene.
Na afei ɔhene a moayi no, deɛ mobisaeɛ no, ɔnie; seesei Awurade asi mo so hene.
Sɛ mosuro Awurade na mosom no na motie ne nne, na moante Awurade ahyɛdeɛ so atua a, Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn bɛka mo ne ɔhene a ɔbɛdi mo soɔ no nyinaa ho.
Na sɛ moantie Awurade nne na mote Awurade ahyɛdeɛ so atua a, Awurade nsa bɛda mo so sɛdeɛ ɛdaa mo agyanom soɔ no.
Afei mommɛgyina ha na monhwɛ ade kɛseɛ a Awurade rebɛyɛ mo ani soɔ yi.
Ɛnnɛ nyɛ ayuo twa berɛ anaa? Nanso mɛsu afrɛ Awurade na wama aprannaa abobom na nsuo atɔ, na mohwɛ a, moahunu sɛ bɔne a moayɛ no dɔɔso Awurade ani so, sɛ mobisaa ɔhene.”
Ɛnna Samuel su frɛɛ Awurade, na Awurade maa aprannaa boboom na nsuo tɔɔ saa da no, enti ɔman no nyinaa suroo Awurade ne Samuel kɛse.
Na ɔman no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Bɔ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn mpaeɛ ma wo nkoa, na yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛwuwuo, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn bɔne nyinaa akyi no, yɛadi amumuyɔsɛm abisa ɔhene.”
Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Monnsuro. Mo deɛ, moanya ayɛ bɔne yi nyinaa. Nanso monnnane mmfiri Awurade akyi, na mmom momfa mo akoma nyinaa nsom Awurade.
Monnnane nnkɔdi ahuhudeɛ a mfasoɔ biara nni soɔ na ɛntumi nnye nkwa akyi, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ ahuhudeɛ.
Na Awurade din kɛseɛ no nti, ɔrennya ne man, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade asi ne bo sɛ ɔde mo bɛyɛ ne man.
Na me nso, ɛmpare me sɛ mɛyɛ Awurade bɔne na magyae sɛ mɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo. Mɛkyerɛ mo deɛ ɛyɛ ne kwampa.
Awurade na monsuro no, na momfa mo akoma nyinaa nsom no nokorɛ mu; monkae nneɛma akɛseɛ a wayɛ ama mo no.
Nanso sɛ mosene mo kɔn yɛ bɔne a, wɔbɛpra mo akɔ, mo ne mo hene nyinaa.”
13: Samuel 13

Na Saul yii mmarima mpem mmiɛnsa firii Israelfoɔ mu; mpem mmienu bɛkaa Saul ho wɔ Mikmas ne Betel mmepɔ so, na apem nso kɔkaa Yonatan ho wɔ Benyaminfoɔ kuro Gibea so. Ɔman no nkaeɛ nso, ɔgyaa wɔn kwan maa obiara kɔɔ ne ntomadan mu.
Na Yonatan kunkum Filistifoɔ asraafoɔdɔm a wɔwɔ Geba no, na Filistifoɔ no teeɛ. Ɛnna Saul maa wɔhyɛnee abɛn asase no nyinaa so kaa sɛ: “Hebrifoɔ, montie!”
Na wɔka maa Israel nyinaa tee sɛ: “Saul akunkum Filistifoɔ asraafoɔdɔm, na seesei Israel ama wɔn ho ayɛ Filistifoɔ no ahi.” Enti wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔman no sɛ wɔmmɛdi Saul akyi wɔ Gilgal.

Filistifoɔ no nso boaboaa wɔn ho ano sɛ wɔne Israelfoɔ rebɛko; wɔde nteaseɛnam mpem aduasa ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpem nsia ne nnipa a wɔn dodoɔ te sɛ mpoano anwea, na wɔforo kɔ kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Mikmas, Bet-Awen apueeɛ.
Na Israel mmarima hunuu sɛ wɔn ho akyere wɔn paa ɛfiri sɛ ɔman no ho hiahiaa wɔn. Ɛnna ɔman no dwane kɔhuntaa abodan ne amena ne abotan ne ntokuro ne nsubura mu.
Hebrifoɔ no bi mpo twaa Yordan kɔɔ Gad ne Gilead asase so. Saul deɛ, na ɔda so wɔ Gilgal, na nnipa no nyinaa de ahopopoɔ dii n’akyi.
Na ɔtwɛnee ara nnanson sɛdeɛ Samuel hyɛeɛ no, nanso Samuel amma Gilgal, na na ɔman no rehwete firi ne nkyɛn.
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Momfa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no mmra me nkyɛn.” Na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no.
Na berɛ a ɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wieeɛ ara pɛ, ɔnkɔhwɛ a, Samuel na ɛreba yi. Na Saul firii adi sɛ ɔrekɔhyia no na wahyira no.
Ɛnna Samuel bisaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi?” Na Saul buaa sɛ: “Mehunuu sɛ ɔman no ahwete afiri me nkyɛn, na wo nso woamma nna a wohyɛeɛ no mu, na Filistifoɔ no nso aboaboa wɔn ano wɔ Mikmas.
Enti mesee me ho sɛ, ‘Filistifoɔ yi bɛsiane aba me so wɔ Gilgal, nanso menhwehwɛɛ Awurade anim adom.’ Enti mehyɛɛ me ho bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no.”
Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Woadi nkwaseasɛm paa. Woanni Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a ɔhyɛɛ woɔ no so; sɛ wodii so a, anka Awurade bɛma w’ahennie atim Israel so afebɔɔ.
Nanso seesei deɛ, w’ahennie renkyɛre. Awurade bɛhwehwɛ ɔbarima a n’akoma da ne soɔ, na Awurade de no bɛsi ne man so panin, ɛfiri sɛ woanyɛ deɛ Awurade hyɛɛ woɔ no.”
Afei Samuel siim firii Gilgal foro kɔɔ Benyaminfoɔ kuro Gibea mu, na Saul kanee ɔman no, wɔn a na wɔda so ka ne ho no; na wɔn dodoɔ bɛyɛ mmarima ahansia (600).
Na Saul ne ne ba Yonatan ne wɔn a wɔda so ka wɔn ho no te Benyaminfoɔ kuro Geba mu. Filistifoɔ no nso kyeree nsraban wɔ Mikmas.
Na afomfafoɔ akuo mmiɛnsa firii Filistifoɔ nsraban mu baeɛ. Kuo baako te faa Ofra kwan so kɔɔ Sual asase so,
kuo foforɔ nso de wɔn ani kyerɛ Bet-Horon kwan so, na kuo a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no nso de wɔn ani kyerɛ kwan a ɛkɔ ɛhyeɛ a ɛhwɛ Seboim bɔn no so, wɔ serɛ so.
Na ɔtomfoɔ biara nni Israel asase so baabiara, ɛfiri sɛ Filistifoɔ kaa sɛ: “Yɛmpɛ sɛ Hebrifoɔ no bɛbɔ nkrantɛ anaa pea.”
Enti sɛ Israelni biara pɛ sɛ ɔse n’asɔ anaa ne sɔsɔ anaa n’akuma anaa ne kantankrankyi a, ɔsiane kɔ Filistifoɔ mu.
Sɛ wɔse asɔ anaa sɔsɔ anaa adinam a ano yɛ mmiɛnsa anaa akuma, anaasɛ wɔsiesie poma a wɔde ka nantwie a, wɔgye dwetɛbena abupɛn mmiɛnsa mu mmienu.
Sɛ ɛduru da a wɔrekɔ ko a, wɔnhunu ɔman no muni biara a ɔka Saul ne Yonatan ho a ɔkura nkrantɛ anaa pea ne nsam; Saul ne ne ba Yonatan nko ara na wɔkura bie.
Na Filistifoɔ awɛmfoɔ dɔm firii adi kɔfaa Mikmas afaeɛ.
14: Samuel 14
Na Saul wɔ Gibea kurotia, granate akutuo dua a ɛsi Migron no ase, na nnipa a wɔka ne ho bɛyɛ mmarima ahansia.
Na Awurade sɔfoɔ Eli a na ɔwɔ Shilo ba Finehas ba Ikabod nua Ahitab ba Ahiya na na ɔhyɛ asɔfotadeɛ no. Ɔman no deɛ, na wɔnnim sɛ Yonatan kɔ hɔ.
Na baabi a na Yonatan pɛ sɛ ɔfa twa kɔ Filistifoɔ awɛmfoɔ dɔm soɔ no, na ɔbotan a ano yɛ nnam wɔ fa ha, na ɔbotan a ano yɛ nnam wɔ fa ha nso; baako din de Boses, na baako nso din de Sene.
Baako ani kyerɛ atifi fam Mikmas ntentensoɔ, na baako a ɛwɔ anafoɔ fam no nso ani kyerɛ Geba.

Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ a ɔkura n’akodeɛ no sɛ: “Bra ma yɛntwa nkɔ momonotofoɔ yi awɛmfoɔ dɔm no mu. Ebia Awurade bɛdi ama yɛn ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ den mma Awurade sɛ ɔnam pii anaa kakraa bi so bɛgye nkwa.”
Ɛnna n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛ deɛ ɛwɔ w’akomam biara. Dane wo ho kɔ baabiara a wopɛ sɛ wokorɔ. Meka wo ho deɛ w’akoma pɛ biara mu.”
Na Yonatan kaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, yɛretwa akɔ nkurɔfoɔ no mu, akɔyi yɛn ho adi akyerɛ wɔn.
Sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔka kyerɛ yɛn sɛ, ‘Monnyina hɔ nkɔsi sɛ yɛbɛba abɛto mo!’ a, ɛnneɛ yɛbɛgyina baabi a yɛwɔ, na yɛremforo nkɔ wɔn nkyɛn.
Na sɛ wɔka sɛ, ‘Momforo mmra yɛn so!’ a, ɛnneɛ yɛbɛforo akɔ, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade de wɔn bɛhyɛ yɛn nsa; yei na ɛbɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne ama yɛn.”
Ɛnna wɔn mmienu no yii wɔn ho adi kyerɛɛ Filistifoɔ awɛmfoɔ dɔm no. Na Filistifoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Monhwɛ sɛ Hebrifoɔ no refiri adi firi ntokuro a wɔkɔhuntaa mu no mu.”

Ɛnna awɛmfoɔ dɔm no ka kyerɛɛ Yonatan ne n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no sɛ: “Momforo mmra yɛn so, na yɛbɛkyerɛ mo biribi!” Ɛhɔ ara na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no sɛ: “Foro di m’akyi, na Awurade de wɔn bɛhyɛ Israel nsa.”
Na Yonatan de ne nsa ne ne nan foroeɛ, na n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no dii n’akyi, na wɔtotɔɔ Yonatan anim, na n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no kunkum dii n’akyi.
Nnipa a Yonatan ne n’akodeɛkurafoɔ dii kan kunkum wɔn asase a ne kɛseɛ te sɛ nantwie mpamho funtum kwan fa soɔ no, wɔbɛyɛ mmarima aduonu.
Ɛnna ahopopoɔ sii nsraban no mu, wuram hɔ ne awɛmfoɔ dɔm no nyinaa soɔ, na afomfoɔ dɔm no mpo ho popoeɛ, na asase wosoeɛ maa no danee ahopopoɔ a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn hɔ.
Na Saul awɛmfoɔ a wɔwɔ Benyaminfoɔ kuro Gibea mu no hunuiɛ, na hwɛ! nnipa no rehwete fa ha sene ha.
Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔka ne ho no sɛ: “Monkan nnipa no na yɛnhunu deɛ wafiri yɛn mu korɔ.” Berɛ a wɔkan nnipa no, wɔhunuu sɛ Yonatan ne n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no nni hɔ.
Afei Saul ka kyerɛɛ Ahiya sɛ: “Fa Nyankopɔn adaka no bɛn ha!” Saa da no, na Nyankopɔn adaka no wɔ Israelfoɔ no nkyɛn.
Berɛ a Saul gu so ne ɔsɔfoɔ no rekasa no nyinaa na Filistifoɔ nsraban mu kitikitiyɛ no rekɔ so, na emu yɛɛ den. Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Gyae.”
Na Saul ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ho ano. Berɛ a wɔkɔduruu akono hɔ no, na obiara atwe nkrantɛ ne yɔnko so; kitikitiyɛ no yɛɛ kɛseɛ paa.
Na Hebrifoɔ a berɛ bi wɔkɔkaa Filistifoɔ ho a wɔne wɔn foro baa nsraban a atwa hɔ ahyia mu no, wɔn nso baa Israelfoɔ a wɔka Saul ne Yonatan ho no afa.
Israel mmarima a wɔkɔhuntaa Efraim mmepɔ soɔ no nyinaa tee sɛ Filistifoɔ no adwane, na wɔn nso tu saa wɔn ne wɔn kɔkoeɛ.
Na Awurade gyee Israel ɛda no, na ɛko no kɔpuee Bet-Awen.

Saa da no, na Israel mmarima abrɛ, nanso Saul kaa ntam guu ɔman no so sɛ: “Ɔbarima a wantwɛn ankɔsi sɛ mɛtɔ m’atamfo so werɛ na ɔbɛdidie ansa na nwunu adwoɔ no, nnome nka no!” Na ɔmanfoɔ no biara amfa aduane anka n’ano.
Na ɔmanfoɔ no nyinaa kɔduruu kwaeɛ mu, na na ɛwoɔ wɔ asase no so.
Na berɛ a ɔmanfoɔ no duruu kwaeɛ no mu no, hwɛ! na ɛwoɔ resosɔ, nanso obiara amfa ne nsa ankɔ n’ano ɛfiri sɛ ɔman no suroo ntam no.
Yonatan deɛ, berɛ a ne papa kaa ntam guu ɔman no soɔ no, wante, enti ɔtenee poma a ɛkura no no de ano kaa ɛwoɔkyɛm, na ɔde ne nsa kɔɔ n’ano, na n’ani so daa hɔ.
Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ no baako kaa sɛ: “Wo papa aka ntam agu ɔman no so sɛ, ‘Nnome nka obiara a ɔbɛdidi nnɛ!’” Na ɔman no brɛeɛ.
Na Yonatan kaa sɛ: “Me papa de mmusuo aba ɔman yi so. Monhwɛ, ɛwoɔ kakra a mede kaa m’ano mpo ama m’ani so atete me.
Sɛ ɔman yi dii asadeɛ a ɛfiri wɔn atamfo hɔ no bi nnɛ a, hwɛ deɛ anka ɛbɛba! Afei anka ɔkum kɛseɛ na Filistifoɔ kum no bɛyɛ.”
Ɛda no, wɔbobɔɔ Filistifoɔ firii Mikmas kɔsii Ayalon, na ɔman no brɛɛ yie.
Na ɔman no tu guu asadeɛ no so faa nnwan ne anantwie ne anantwie mma kunkum wɔn fam, na ɔman no dii nam no wɔn mogya mu.
Ɛnna wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ɔman no reyɛ Awurade bɔne; wɔredi nam no wɔn mogya mu.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Moafom. Deɛ ɛdi kan, mommuni ɛboɔ kɛseɛ mmrɛ me.”

Ɛno akyi no, Saul kaa sɛ: “Monkyini ɔmanfoɔ no so, na monka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Obiara mfa ne nantwie ne ne dwan mmra me nkyɛn ha, na ɔmmɛku no ha nni, na monnyɛ Awurade bɔne nnni no ne mogya mu.’” Ɛnna ɔmanfoɔ no mu biara de ne nantwie a ɛkura no anadwo no baeɛ, na ɔbɛkum no hɔ.
Na Saul sii afɔrebukyia maa Awurade. Ɛno ne afɔrebukyia a ɛdi kan a ɔsi maa Awurade.

Akyire yi, Saul kaa sɛ: “Momma yɛnsiane nkɔti Filistifoɔ no anadwo yi na yɛnkɔfom wɔn nneɛma nkɔsi sɛ adeɛ bɛkye, na mommma yɛnnnya wɔn mu onipa baako mpo.” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Deɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ biara, yɛ.” Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Momma yɛntwe mmɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ ha.”
Enti Saul bisaa Onyankopɔn sɛ: “Mensiane nkɔti Filistifoɔ no anaa? Wode wɔn bɛhyɛ Israel nsa?” Nanso wamma no mmuaeɛ saa da no.
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Ɔman no mu atitire nyinaa, montwe mmɛn ha, na yɛnhwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛeɛ a bɔne yi aba nnɛ.
Sɛ Awurade, Israel Gyefoɔ no te aseɛ yi, sɛ ɛfiri me ba Yonatan mpo a, owuo na ɔbɛwuo.” Nanso ɔman no muni biara amma no mmuaeɛ.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa sɛ: “Monnyina fa baako, na me ne me ba Yonatan nso bɛgyina fa baako.” Ɛnna ɔman no ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Deɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ no, yɛ.”
Na Saul ka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ: “O Israel Nyankopɔn, adɛn nti na wommua w'akoa nnɛ yi? Fa Tumim so ma nokorɛ nna adi!” Enti ɛbɔɔ Yonatan ne Saul, na ɔman no firii mu firiiɛ.
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Mommɔ me ne me ba Yonatan so ntonto.” Na ɛbɔɔ Yonatan.
Afei Saul bisaa Yonatan sɛ: “Ka kyerɛ me, ɛdeɛn na woyɛeɛ?” Enti Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nokwasɛm nie, mede me nsam poma ano kaa ɛwoɔ kakra kaa m’ano. Menie! Momma menwu!”
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Yonatan, sɛ mamma woanwu a, Onyankopɔn ntua me ka na ɔmfa bi nka ho.”

Nanso ɔman no ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Yonatan a wayɛ ade kɛseɛ de agye Israel sei na ɔrebɛwuo? Ɛmpare yɛn! Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, ne tiri nwi baako mpo rentɔ fam, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔde no ayɛ adwuma nnɛ.” Enti ɔman no gyee Yonatan nkwa, na wanwu.
Saul gyaee Filistifoɔ no akyiridie, na Filistifoɔ no nso kɔɔ wɔn baabi.
Na Saul hyɛɛ n’ahennie mu den Israel so, na ɔne n’atamfo nyinaa ko hyiaeɛ—Moabfoɔ ne Ammonfoɔ ne Edomfoɔ ne Soba ahemfo ne Filistifoɔ. Baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nso, ɔdii nim.
Ɔyɛɛ n’adeɛ akokoɔduro so, na ɔkunkum Amalekfoɔ, na ɔgyee Israel firii afomfoɔ nsam.
Saul mma mmarima a ɔwoo wɔn ne Yonatan ne Yiswi ne Malki-Sua, na ne mma mmaa mmienu no nso, na wɔfrɛ panin no Merab na wɔfrɛ kumaa no Mikal.
Saul yere nso, na wɔfrɛ no Ahinoam, Ahimahas ba, na ne sahene nso wɔfrɛ no Abner a ɔyɛ Saul papa nua Ner ba.
Na Saul papa ne Kis, na Abiel ba ne Abner papa Ner.
Saul nna nyinaa, ɛko no mu yɛɛ den Filistifoɔ so. Sɛ Saul hunu ɔbarima a ne ho yɛ den anaa ɔbarima kokoɔdurofoɔ biara a, ɔde no bata ne ho.
15: Samuel 15
Deɛ asafo Awurade aka nie, ‘Deɛ Amalek de yɛɛ Israel berɛ a wɔfiri Egypt reba, sɛ wɔsɔre tiaa no kwan mu no, mɛma wɔatua wɔn so ka.
Enti kɔ na kɔkunkum Amalekfoɔ na sɛe wɔne deɛ wɔwɔ nyinaa pasaa, nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, kunkum wɔn nyinaa, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, abɔfra ne deɛ ɔtua nufoɔ ano, nantwie ne odwan, yoma ne afunumu.’”
Ɛnna Saul frɛfrɛɛ ɔman no, na ɔkan wɔn wɔ Telaim, mmarima mpem ahanu (200,000) a wɔnam fam ne Yuda mmarima mpem du (10,000).
Na Saul kɔeɛ ara kɔduruu Amalek kuro mu, na wɔkɔtetɛɛ subɔn no ho.

Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ Kenifoɔ sɛ: “Monkɔ, momfiri ha mfiri Amalekfoɔ mu nkɔ, na mampra mo amfra wɔn. Mo deɛ, moyɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa adɔeɛ berɛ a wɔfiri Egypt reba no.” Enti Kenifoɔ no firii Amalekfoɔ mu kɔeɛ.
Ɛno akyi no, Saul kɔkunkum Amalekfoɔ firi Hawila de kɔsii Sur a ɛwɔ Egypt anim no.
Na ɔkyeree Amalek hene Agag animono, na ɔman no nkaeɛ deɛ, ɔde nkrantɛ kunkum wɔn nyinaa.

Na Agag ne nnwan ne anantwie ne mmoa a wɔadɔ sradeɛ ne adwennini no mu deɛ ɛyɛ ne nneɛma pa nyinaa, Saul ne ɔman no huu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na wɔampɛ sɛ wɔsɛe wɔn. Adeɛ biara a ɛyɛ tan na ɛnyɛ mma hwee deɛ, wɔsɛee ne nyinaa pasaa.
Ɛnna Awurade asɛm baa Samuel nkyɛn sɛ:
“Manu me ho sɛ mede Saul sii hene, ɛfiri sɛ wadane afiri m’akyi, na m’asɛm nso, wanni so.” Asɛm no haa Samuel, na ɔsu frɛɛ Awurade anadwo no nyinaa.
Na Samuel sɔree ntɛm sɛ ɔrekɔhyia Saul anɔpa. Nanso wɔbɔɔ Samuel amanneɛ sɛ: “Saul baa Karmel, na hwɛ! wasi nkaeɛdum ama ne ho, na wadane ne ho atwam asiane kɔ Gilgal.”
Na Samuel kɔduruu Saul nkyɛn, na Saul ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “O Awurade nipa, nhyira nka wo. Mayɛ deɛ Awurade kaeɛ no.”
Ɛnna Samuel bisaa sɛ: “Na ɛdeɛn ne nnwan su a ɛgu m’asom ne anantwie su a meteɛ yi?”

Na Saul buaa sɛ: “Wɔde firi Amalekfoɔ mu na ɛbaeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔman no huu nnwan ne anantwie no mu deɛ ɛyɛ no mmɔbɔ sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, na deɛ ɛkaeɛ no deɛ, yɛasɛe ne nyinaa pasaa.”
Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Gyae! Ma menka deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me nnora anadwo nkyerɛ wo.” Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Kasa!”
Ɛnna Samuel kaa sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ berɛ a na woyɛ ketewa w’ani soɔ no na wɔyɛɛ wo Israel mmusuakuo so panin, na Awurade sraa woɔ de wo sii Israel so hene?
Akyire yi, Awurade somaa wo sɛ kɔyɛ adwuma bi, na ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Kɔ na kɔsɛe Amalekfoɔ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no pasaa; na wo ne wɔn nko nkɔsi sɛ wobɛhye wɔn ase pasaa.’
Ɛnneɛ adɛn nti na woantie Awurade nne, na woatu agu asadeɛ so ayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ Awurade ani so bɔne yi?”
Nanso Saul ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Na sɛ matie Awurade nne, na adwuma a Awurade somaa me sɛ menkɔyɛ no, makɔyɛ, na mede Amalek hene Agag aba, na Amalek deɛ, masɛe no pasaa.
Na asadeɛ a wɔaka sɛ wɔnsɛe no no mu nnwan ne anantwie a ɛyɛ paa no, ɔman no afa sɛ wɔde rebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade wo Nyankopɔn wɔ Gilgal.”
Ɛnna Samuel kaa sɛ: “Awurade pɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne okum afɔdeɛ sene ɔsetie a wobɛtie ama Awurade anaa? Hwɛ! Ɔsetie yɛ sene afɔdeɛ, na asoyɛ kyɛn adwennini sradeɛ,
na atuateɛ ne abosonkɔm nyinaa yɛ bɔne korɔ, na aniammɔnho ne asumansɛm ne terafim ahonisom nyinaa yɛ adekorɔ. Ɛsiane sɛ woapo Awurade asɛm nti, ɔno nso apo wo sɛ nni hene.”
Na Saul ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Mayɛ bɔne, na mabu Awurade ahyɛdeɛ ne w’asɛm so, ɛfiri sɛ mesuroo ɔman no, na metiee wɔn nne.
Enti mesrɛ wo, fa me bɔne kyɛ me, na wo ne me nkɔ na menkɔkoto Awurade.”
Nanso Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Me ne wo renkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ woapo Awurade asɛm, na Awurade nso apo wo sɛ nni Israel so hene.”
Berɛ a Samuel danee ne ho sɛ ɔrekɔ ara pɛ na Saul sɔɔ n’atadeɛ ngugusoɔ ano, na ɛsuanee.
Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Awurade asuane Israel ahennie no afiri wo nsam nnɛ, na wo yɔnko a ɔyɛ sene woɔ na ɔde bɛma no.
Na Israel Nimuonyamfoɔ no nso, ɔrenni atorɔ, na ɔrennu ne ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔdasani na wanu ne ho.”
Ɛnna ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Mayɛ bɔne. Na afei mesrɛ wo, hyɛ me animuonyam me man mpanimfoɔ ne Israel anim, na wo ne me nkɔ na menkɔkoto Awurade wo Nyankopɔn.”
Enti Samuel dii Saul akyi ne no kɔeɛ, na Saul kɔkotoo Awurade.
Ɛno akyi no, Samuel kaa sɛ: “Momfa Amalek hene Agag mmrɛ me ha.” Na Agag de anigyeɛ kɔɔ n’anim, na Agag kaa no ne tirim sɛ: “Ampa, saa berɛ yi deɛ, owuo yea atwam kɔ.”
Nanso Samuel kaa sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ wo nkrantɛ maa mmaa hweree wɔn mma no, saa ara na wo maame nso bɛdi mmasugya asene mmaa nyinaa.” Samuel kaa saa no, ɔtwitwaa Agag mu asinasini Awurade anim wɔ Gilgal.
Na Samuel siim kɔɔ Rama, na Saul nso kɔɔ ne fie wɔ Saul kuro Gibea mu.
Na Samuel anhu Saul bio kɔsii ne wuda, ɛfiri sɛ Samuel kɔdii Saul ho awerɛhoɔ. Awurade nso nuu ne ho sɛ ɔde Saul sii Israel so hene.
16: Samuel 16
Ɛnna Samuel kaa sɛ: “Mɛyɛ dɛn akorɔ? Sɛ Saul te a, ɔbɛku me.” Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa nantwie ba na kɔ, na ka sɛ, ‘Maba sɛ merebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade.’
Na frɛ Yese bra afɔrebɔ no ase, na me nso mɛkyerɛ wo deɛ yɛ, na woasra deɛ mɛkyerɛ woɔ no ama me.”
Ɛnna Samuel yɛɛ deɛ Awurade kaeɛ no. Berɛ a ɔduruu Betlehem a kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ hunuu no no, wɔn ho popoeɛ, enti wɔbisaa sɛ: “Woaba no asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ so. Afɔdeɛ a merebɛbɔ ama Awurade nti na mebaeɛ. Monnwira mo ho na mo ne me nkɔ afɔrebɔ no ase.” Na ɔdwiraa Yese ne ne mma no, na ɔfrɛɛ wɔn baa afɔrebɔ no ase.
Na berɛ a wɔbaeɛ a n’ani bɔɔ Eliab soɔ no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ampa, deɛ Awurade asra no no na ɔwɔ n’anim yi.”

Nanso Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Samuel sɛ: “Nhwɛ sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ ne ne tenten ne ne kɛseɛ, na mempɛ no. Ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ onipa hwɛ adeɛ na Onyankopɔn hwɛ, ɛfiri sɛ onipa dasani hwɛ deɛ ɛtua aniwa, na Awurade deɛ, ɔhwɛ akoma mu.”
Na Yese frɛɛ Abinadab maa ɔbɛtwaam Samuel anim, nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Oyi nso Awurade nyii no.”
Afei Yese maa Samma nso bɛtwaam, nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Oyi nso Awurade nyii no.”
Enti Yese maa ne mma mmarima no mu nson bɛtwaam Samuel anim, nanso Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Yese sɛ: “Awurade nyii yeinom biara.”
