Ɛnna Samuel bisaa Yese sɛ: “Wo mma mmarima no nyinaa nie anaa?” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Kumaa koraa no nni ha bi; ɔde nnwan kɔ adidi.” Ɛnna Samuel ka kyerɛɛ Yese sɛ: “Soma ma wɔnkɔfa no mmra, ɛfiri sɛ yɛrentena ase gye sɛ waba ansa.”
Enti ɔsoma kɔfaa no baeɛ. Na ɔbere, na ɔyɛ aberanteɛ a n’animma yɛ fɛ na ne ho nso yɛ fɛ. Ɛnna Awurade kaa sɛ: “Sɔre sra no, na ɔno ara nie!”
Enti Samuel faa abɛn a ngo wom no, na ɔsraa no ne nuanom mu. Na Awurade honhom sii Dawid so, ɛfiri saa da no rekorɔ. Akyire yi, Samuel sɔre siim kɔɔ Rama.
Na Awurade honhom firii Saul so, na Awurade maa honhom bɔne bɛhaa no.
Na Saul nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn ama honhom bɔne reha wo.
Yɛn wura, yɛsrɛ wo, ka ma wo nkoa a wɔwɔ w’anim yi nkɔhwehwɛ obi a ɔnim sankuo bɔ yie, na sɛ Onyankopɔn ma honhom bɔne no ba wo so a, ɔde ne nsa abɔ ama wo ho atɔ wo.”
Enti Saul ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa no sɛ: “Monkɔhwehwɛ obi a ɔnim bɔ yie mma me, na momfa no mmrɛ me.”
Na n’asomfoɔ no baako bɛkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ! Mahunu Betlehemni Yese ba bi a ɔnim bɔ yie; ɔyɛ ɔbarima kokoɔdurofoɔ a ne ho yɛ den ne ɔkofoɔ, ɔnim kasa, na ɔyɛ ɔbarima mu, na Awurade nso di n’akyi.”
Ɛnna Saul somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Yese hɔ sɛ: “Ma wo ba Dawid a ɔhwɛ nnwan no mmra me nkyɛn.”
Enti Yese faa afunumu, paanoo ne kotokuo a bobesa wom ne abirekyie ba, na ɔde hyɛɛ ne ba Dawid nsa sɛ ɔmfa nkɔma Saul.
Na Dawid baa Saul nkyɛn bɛsom no; ɔpɛɛ n’asɛm yie, na ɔbɛyɛɛ n’akodeɛkurafoɔ.
Na Saul soma kɔɔ Yese hɔ sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma Dawid ntoa so nsom me, na wanya m’anim adom.”
Enti sɛ ɛba sɛ Onyankopɔn ma honhom no ba Saul so a, na Dawid afa sankuo no de ne nsa abɔ, na Saul ho atɔ no ama n’asom adwo no, na honhom bɔne no afiri ne so kɔ.
17: Samuel 17
Na Saul ne Israel mmarima nso boaa wɔn ho ano kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Ela asasetamaa no so, na wɔtwaa ɛko mpasua sɛ wɔrekɔhyia Filistifoɔ no akɔko.
Na Filistifoɔ no gyinagyina bepɔ so wɔ fa ha, na Israelfoɔ no nso gyinagyina bepɔ so wɔ fa nohoa, na subɔn da wɔn ntam.
Na katakyie bi firi Filistifoɔ nsraban mu baeɛ; a ne din de Goliat, a ɔfiri Gat, na ne tenten yɛ basafa nsia ne saama.
Na ɔde kɔbere kyɛ ahyɛ ne ti, na ɔhyɛ akotadeɛ abono-abono, na n’akotadeɛ mu kɔbere mu duro yɛ nnwetɛbena mpemnum (5,000).
Na kɔbere nkataho kata ne nan ho, na kɔbere pɛmɛ wɔ ne mmatiri so.
Ne pea dua te sɛ ntomanwemfoɔ nsadua, na ne pea ti dadeɛ mu duro yɛ nnwetɛbena ahansia; na obi kura ɛkyɛm kɛseɛ di n’anim.

Na ɔbɛgyinaa hɔ teaam frɛɛ Israel, wɔn mpasua so, ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Adɛn nti na moafiri adi abɛtwa mpasua sɛ morebɛko? Menyɛ Filistini, na mo nso monyɛ Saul nkoa? Monyi ɔbarima baako na momma no nsiane mmɛhyia me.
Sɛ ɔtumi ne me ko na ɔku me a, yɛbɛyɛ mo nkoa. Na sɛ nso metumi no na meku no a, mo nso mobɛyɛ yɛn nkoa na moasom yɛn.”
Na Filistini no toaa so sɛ: “Ɛnnɛ metwa Israel mpasua mpoa. Momma me ɔbarima na me ne no nko!”
Na berɛ a Saul ne Israel nyinaa tee Filistini no nsɛm no, ehu kɛseɛ kaa wɔn, na wɔsuroo paa.
Na Dawid yɛ Efratani bi a ɔfiri Yuda kuro Betlehem mu a ne din de Yese no ba. Na ɔwɔ mma mmarima nwɔtwe. Saul nna no mu no, na ɔbarima no abɔ akora dada, na ne mfeɛ kɔ anim yie.

Na Yese mma mmarima mmiɛnsa a wɔyɛ mpanimfoɔ paa no kɔeɛ. Wɔdii Saul akyi kɔɔ ɛko; ne mma mmarima mmiɛnsa a wɔkɔɔ ɛko no din ne Eliab a ɔyɛ abakan, Abinadab a ɔtɔ so mmienu, ne Samma a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa.
Na Dawid ne kumaa koraa, na mpanimfoɔ mmiɛnsa no dii Saul akyi.
Na Dawid taa firi Saul nkyɛn san kɔhwɛ ne papa nnwan wɔ Betlehem.
Na Filistini no bɛgyina ne gyinaberɛ anɔpatutuutu ne anwummerɛ biara; ɔyɛɛ saa adaduanan.
Ɛnna Yese ka kyerɛɛ ne ba Dawid sɛ: “Fa nkyeweɛ efa baako ne paanoo du yi, na ka wo ho fa kɔma wo nuanom wɔ nsraban no mu.
Na fa nufosuo a akyenkyene du yi kɔma apem so panin no; afei nso hwɛ sɛdeɛ wo nuanom no ho teɛ, na fa nkra bi firi wɔn hɔ bra.”
Nso saa berɛ yi nyinaa na Saul ne wɔn ne Israel mmarima a aka no nyinaa wɔ Ela asasetamaa no so ne Filistifoɔ no rekɔko.

Enti Dawid sɔree anɔpahema de nnwan no hyɛɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ nsa na ɔfaa nneɛma no kɔeɛ sɛdeɛ Yese hyɛɛ no no. Berɛ a ɔduruu nsraban no ano no, na asraafoɔdɔm no rekɔ mpasua so, na wɔmaa ɛko nteamu so bɔɔ ose.
Na Israelfoɔ ne Filistifoɔ no baa mpasua no ano, ɛdɔm ani kyerɛ ɛdɔm.
Ɛhɔ ara na Dawid gyaa nneɛma a ɛkura no no hyɛɛ deɛ ɔhwɛ nneɛma soɔ no nsa, na ɔtuu mmirika kɔɔ mpasua no ano. Ɔkɔeɛ no, ɔkɔkyeaa ne nuanom.
Berɛ a ɔne wɔn rekasa no, hwɛ, Filistifoɔ no katakyie a ne din de Goliat a ɔfiri Gat no firii Filistifoɔ mpasua no so baeɛ, na ɔbɛkekaa nsɛm a daa ɔka no, na Dawid nso teeɛ.
Israel mmarima no deɛ, berɛ a wɔhunuu ɔbarima no, ne nti wɔn nyinaa dwaneeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro yie.

Na Israel mmarima no kekaa sɛ: “Moahunu ɔbarima a ɔreforo aba yi? Israel mpoatwa nti na ɔreforo aba. Obiara a ɔbɛtumi aku no no, ɔhene bɛma no ahonyadeɛ pii na ɔde ne babaa nso ama no, na ɔbɛma ne papa fie ade ne ho wɔ Israel.”

Na Dawid bisaa mmarima a wɔgyina ne nkyɛn no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na wɔbɛyɛ ama ɔbarima a ɔbɛku saa Filistini yi na wayi ahohorabɔ afiri Israel soɔ no? Hwan koraa ne Filistini momonotoni yi a ɔretwa Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no mpasua mpoa yi?”
Na nkurɔfoɔ no kaa asɛm dada no ara kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sei na wɔbɛyɛ ama ɔbarima a ɔbɛku no no.”

Na ne nua panin Eliab tee sɛ ɔne mmarima no rekasa, na Eliab bo fuu Dawid dendeenden na ɔkaa sɛ: “Wobaa ha bɛyɛɛ dɛn? Na hwan na wode nnwan kakra no gyaa no ɛserɛ so hɔ? Menim sɛ woyɛ ahantan, na bɔne wɔ w’akomam, ɛfiri sɛ wobaa ha sɛ worebɛhwɛ ɛko no bi.”
Na Dawid kaa sɛ: “Mayɛ dɛn? Ɛnyɛ asɛm kwa na mebisaeɛ?”
Ɛnna ɔdanee ne ho firii ne nkyɛn, na ɔde n’ani kyerɛɛ onipa foforɔ bisaa no asɛm korɔ no ara a ɔbisaeɛ no, na obiara de asɛm dada no ara na ɛmaa no mmuaeɛ.
Na wɔtee nsɛm a Dawid kaeɛ no, na wɔde kɔtoo Saul anim. Enti ɔmaa no baeɛ.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Mma ɔbarima biara akoma nntu. W’akoa bɛkɔ ne Filistini yi akɔko.”
Na Saul ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Worentumi ne Filistini no nkɔko, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ abɔfra, na ɔno deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔbarima kofoni firi ne mmɔfraase.”
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “W’akoa rehwɛ ne papa nnwan, na gyata bɛkyere adwammaa firi nnwankuo no mu, anaa sisire nso bɛkyere bi a,
mefiri adi ti no kɔbɔ no, na meyi no firi n’anom. Na sɛ ɔsɔre baa me soɔ a, mesɔ n’abɔdwe bɔ no hwee hɔ kum no.
W’akoa akum gyata ne sisire nyinaa, na Filistini momonotoni yi bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako ɛfiri sɛ wasopa Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no mpasua.”
Na Dawid ka kaa ho sɛ: “Awurade a ɔgyee me firii gyata ne sisire nsam no, ɔno na ɔbɛgye me afiri Filistini yi nsam.” Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Kɔ. Awurade nni w’akyi.”
Afei Saul de ne ntadeɛ hyehyɛɛ Dawid, na ɔde kɔbere kyɛ hyɛɛ ne ti, na ɔde akotadeɛ nso hyɛɛ no.

Na Dawid de ne nkrantɛ bɔɔ n’atadeɛ no so, na ɔyɛɛ sɛ ɔrekɔ, nanso wantumi, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnsɔ nhwɛɛ da. Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Merentumi mfa yeinom nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ mensɔ nhwɛɛ da.” Enti Dawid yiyi firii ne ho.

Na ɔfaa ne poma kuraa ne nsam na ɔyii mmoseaa akokwa nnum a ɛho yɛ tonomtonom firii subɔn no mu de guu ne nnwanhwɛfoɔ kotokuo a ɔde ayɛ bɔtɔ no mu, na ɔkuraa n’ataaboɔ ne nsam, na ɔtwe bɛn Filistini no nkakrankakra.
Filistini no nso baa n’anim, na ɔtwe bɛn Dawid nkakrankakra; na ɔbarima a ɔso kyɛm kɛseɛ no di n’anim.
Berɛ a Filistini no maa n’ani soɔ a ɔhunuu Dawid no, ɔbuu no animtia, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ abɔfra a ɔbere na ne ho nso yɛ fɛ.
Enti Filistini no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Meyɛ kraman na wode poma aba me so?” Na Filistini no frɛɛ n’anyame domee Dawid.
Afei Filistini no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Wo deɛ bra m’anim, na mede wo nam bɛma wiem nnomaa ne wuram mmoa.”
Ɛnna Dawid nso ka kyerɛɛ Filistini no sɛ: “Wode nkrantɛ ne pea ne pɛmɛ na ɛreba me soɔ, na me deɛ, mede asafo Awurade, Israel mpasua no Nyankopɔn a woasopa no no din na ɛreba wo soɔ.

Ɛnnɛ da yi, Awurade de wo bɛhyɛ me nsa, na mɛku wo na matwa wo tiri afiri so, na mede Filistifoɔ dɔm no afunu bɛma wiem nnomaa ne asase so mmoa nnɛ, na asase so aman nyinaa ahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn bi wɔ Israel.
Na badwa yi nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ ɛnyɛ nkrantɛ ne pea na Awurade de gye nkwa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛko no yɛ Awurade dea, na ɔde mo bɛhyɛ yɛn nsa.”
Ɛnna Filistini no yɛɛ sɛ ɔreba abɛhyia Dawid, na Dawid yɛɛ ntɛm tuu mmirika kɔɔ mpasua no so kɔhyiaa Filistini no.
Na Dawid tenee ne nsa hyɛɛ ne kotokuo no mu yii boɔ wɔ mu, na ɔde hyɛɛ ataaboɔ no mu to bɔɔ Filistini no moma so, na ɛboɔ no wuraa ne tirim, na ɔhwee ase maa n’anim butuu fam.
Enti Dawid de ataaboɔ ne ɛboɔ dii Filistini no so nkonim, na ɔbɔɔ Filistini no hwee hɔ kum no; na Dawid nkura nkrantɛ ne nsam.
Na Dawid tutuu mmirika kɔgyinaa Filistini no so, na ɔsɔɔ ne nkrantɛ mu twe firii ne bɔha mu de twaa ne tiri firii so kum no. Berɛ a Filistifoɔ no hunuu sɛ wɔn brane no awuo no, wɔdwaneeɛ.
Ɛnna Israel ne Yuda mmarima sɔre bɔɔ ose na wɔtaa Filistifoɔ no kɔduruu bɔn no mu ne Ekron kuro pono ano nohoa, na Filistifoɔ apirafoɔ no totɔɔ kwan so firi Saaraim kɔduruu Gat ne Ekron nohoa.
Afei Israelfoɔ no san firii Filistifoɔ no a wɔtaa wɔn so dendeenden no akyi, na wɔbɛfom wɔn nsraban no mu nneɛma.
Ɛnna Dawid faa Filistini no ti, na ɔde baa Yerusalem, na n’akodeɛ no nso, ɔde guu ne ntomadan mu.
Berɛ a Saul hunuu sɛ Dawid refiri adi akɔhyia Filistini no, ɔbisaa ɔsahene Abner sɛ: “Abner, hwan ba ne aberantewaa yi?” Na Abner kaa sɛ: “O ɔhene, sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, mennim!”
Enti ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Kɔbisa deɛ ne ba ne aberantewaa yi.”
Enti berɛ a Dawid kɔkum Filistini no wieeɛ a ɔresan aba no, Abner faa no de no baa Saul anim, na na Filistini no ti kura ne nsam.
Afei Saul bisaa no sɛ: “Aberanteɛ, hwan ba ne wo?” na Dawid buaa sɛ: “W’akoa Yese, Betlehemni no, ba ne me.”
18: Samuel 18
Ɛnna Saul faa no saa da no ne no tenaeɛ, na wamma no ansan ankɔ ne papa fie.
Na Yonatan ne Dawid yɛɛ apam, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdɔɔ no sɛ ɔno ara ne kra.
Bio nso, Yonatan yii ne ngugusoɔ a ɛhyɛ no no maa Dawid, ne ne ntadeɛ a aka ne ne nkrantɛ ne n’agyan ne n’abɔsoɔ.
Na Dawid firi adi kɔ baabiara a Saul soma no no a, ɔde nyansa yɛ adeɛ ma biribiara kɔ so, enti Saul de no too mmarima akofoɔ no ano, na ɛsɔɔ ɔman no nyinaa ne Saul nkoa nso ani.
Sɛ Dawid kɔkunkum Filistifoɔ na wɔresan aba a, mmaa firi Israel nkuro nyinaa mu de nnwom ne asa ba bɛhyia Ɔhene Saul; wɔde mpintin ne ahurisie ne asankuwa.
Na mmaa a wɔredi ahurisie no bɔ gye so sɛ: Na Dawid akum ne mpem du mu.”
Na Saul bo fuu pii, ɛfiri sɛ asɛm yi anyɛ no abodwo, enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Wɔde mpem du ama Dawid, na me deɛ, wɔde apem na ama me, na ɛdeɛn na aka no bio sɛ wɔde ahennie no bɛma no?”
Na ɛfiri da no rekorɔ no, Saul tuu n'ani saa Dawid.
Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Onyankopɔn maa honhom bɔne baa Saul so, enti ɔyɛɛ sɛ odiyifoɔ wɔ fie hɔ; na Dawid de ne nsa rebɔ sankuo sɛdeɛ ɔyɛ daa no, na na pea kura Saul nsam.
Na Saul too pea no, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mɛwɔ Dawid afam dan no ho!” nanso Dawid danee ne ho firii n’anim mprenu.
Na Saul suroo Dawid ɛfiri sɛ na Awurade di n’akyi, nso Saul deɛ, na wafiri ne nkyɛn.
Enti Saul yii no firii ne nkyɛn, na ɔsii no apem so panin, na ɔdii ɔman no anim kɔɔ ɔsa daa.
Dawid nyaa nkɔsoɔ n’akwan nyinaa mu, na Awurade dii n’akyi.
Na Saul hunuu sɛ ne biribiara kɔ soɔ no, ɔsuroo no.
Na Israel ne Yuda nyinaa dɔɔ Dawid, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔdi wɔn anim kɔɔ ɔsa.

Na Saul ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Hwɛ, me babaa panin Merab nie. Ɔno na mede no bɛma wo awareɛ. Ɔkokoɔdurofoɔ ara na yɛ ma me, na ko ma Awurade.” Saul deɛ, ɔkaa no ne tirim sɛ: “Meremfa me nsa nka no, Filistifoɔ na wɔn nsa bɛka no.”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Hwan ne me, na me nkurɔfoɔ, me papa abusua yɛ deɛn wɔ Israel na mabɛyɛ ɔhene ase?”
Nanso berɛ duruu sɛ wɔde Saul babaa Merab bɛma Dawid no, na wɔde no ama Meholani Adriel awareɛ dada.
Na Saul babaa Mikal dɔ Dawid, na berɛ a wɔka kyerɛɛ Saul no, asɛm no yɛɛ no anigyeɛ.
Na Saul kaa sɛ: “Mede no bɛma no, na ayɛ no fidie, na Filistifoɔ de wɔn nsa aka no.” Enti Saul ka kyerɛɛ Dawid ne mprenu soɔ sɛ: “wobɛyɛ m’ase nnɛ.”
Afei nso Saul hyɛɛ n'asomfoɔ no sɛ: “Monkɔka nkyerɛ Dawid kokoam sɛ: ‘Hwɛ! Ɔhene pɛ w’asɛm, na ne nkoa nyinaa dɔ wo. Enti bɛyɛ ɔhene ase.’”
Na Saul nkoa kaa nsɛm yi guu Dawid asom, nanso Dawid kaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ ade ketewa mo ani so sɛ mɛyɛ ɔhene ase, me a meyɛ ohiani, na wɔmmu me hwee yi?”
Na Saul nkoa no kɔbɔɔ no amanneɛ sɛ: “Nsɛm yi na Dawid kaeɛ.”

Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Monkɔka nkyerɛ Dawid sɛ, ‘Ɛnyɛ tiriadeɛ bi na ɔhene pɛ, na mmom ɔnkɔtwa Filistifoɔ mmarima ɔha dua ano wedeɛ mmra, na ɔmfa nni ɔhene atamfo so werɛ.’” Nanso na Saul abɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔnam Filistifoɔ nsa so bɛma Dawid atɔ.
Enti ne nkoa no kɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Dawid, na ɛyɛɛ Dawid fɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔhene ase. Nna no nnya nnuruiɛ no,

Dawid sɔreeɛ, na ɔne ne mmarima no siim kɔkunkum Filistifoɔ mmarima ahanu, na Dawid de wɔn dua ano wedeɛ baeɛ, na wɔkan maa no soeɛ, na ɔde maa ɔhene, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhene ase. Na Saul de ne babaa Mikal maa no awareɛ.
Saul de n’ani too fam hunuu sɛ Awurade di Dawid akyi. Na Saul babaa Mikal nso dɔɔ no.
Dawid nti Saul suroo pii, na Dawid bɛyɛɛ Saul tamfo daa.
Na Filistifoɔ asafohene firii adi bɛkoeɛ, na da biara a wɔbɛba no, ɛsi Dawid yie sene Saul nkoa nyinaa, na na wɔbɔ ne din anidie mu sɛ.
19: Samuel 19
Nanso Saul ba Yonatan deɛ, na ɔpɛ Dawid asɛm yie. Enti Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Me papa Saul rehwehwɛ wo aku wo. Enti mesrɛ wo hwɛ wo ho yie anɔpa, na tena ahuntaeɛ mu baabi, na fa wo ho sie.
Na me deɛ, mɛfiri adi akɔgyina me papa nkyɛn wɔ wuram hɔ, baabi a wowɔ no, na me ne me papa bɛkasa ama wo, na mɛhunu deɛ ɛbɛsie na mabɛka akyerɛ wo.”
Ɛno nti Yonatan kaa Dawid ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ ne papa Saul sɛ: “Mma ɔhene nnyɛ n’akoa Dawid bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnyɛɛ wo bɔne bi, na wayɛ nnwuma pa pii ama wo.
Ɔde ne kra too ne nsam kɔkum Filistini no maa Awurade de nkonimdie kɛseɛ gyee Israel nyinaa. Wohunuiɛ, na wodii ahurisie. Ɛnneɛ adɛn nti na wopɛ sɛ woyɛ mogya a ɛdi bem bɔne, na wokum Dawid kwa?”
Na Saul tiee Yonatan nne, na Saul kaa ntam sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, wɔrenku no.”
Ɛnna Yonatan frɛɛ Dawid, na Yonatan kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ no. Afei Yonatan de Dawid brɛɛ Saul, na ɔbɛtenaa n’anim sɛ kane no.
Akyire yi, ɛko sii bio, na Dawid firii adi ne Filistifoɔ kɔkoeɛ, na ɔde okunkɛseɛ kunkum wɔn, na wɔdwane firii n’anim.
Na Awurade maa honhom bɔne baa Saul so berɛ a ɔte ne fie. Na pea kura ne nsam, na na Dawid de ne nsa rebɔ sankuo.
Na Saul hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔde pea no ɛwɔ Dawid afam ɛdan no ho, nanso ɔtwee ne ho firii Saul anim maa pea no wɔɔ ɛdan no mu. Ɛnna Dawid dwaneeɛ, na ɔfirii hɔ anadwo no.
Akyire yi, Saul somaa abɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔwɛn Dawid fie na wɔnku no anɔpa, nanso Dawid yere Mikal ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ woannye wo kra anadwo yi a, ɔkyena wɔbɛku wo.”
Ɛhɔ ara na Mikal maa Dawid faa mpomma mu sii fam, na ɔfirii adi de mmirika dwaneeɛ.
Ɛnna Mikal faa terafim honi de too mpa no soɔ, na ɔde abirekyie nwi sumiiɛ too atifi, na ɔde ntoma kataa so.
Na Saul somaa abɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔfa Dawid, na ne yere kaa sɛ: “Ɔyare.”
Ɛnna Saul somaa abɔfoɔ no sɛ wɔnkɔhwɛ Dawid, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monkɔfa no mfiri mpa no so mmrɛ me, na menku no.”
Na abɔfoɔ no kɔɔ hɔ no, wɔnkɔhwɛ a, terafim honi na ɛda mpa no soɔ yi, na abirekyie nwi ntoma gu atifi.
Ɛnna Saul bisaa Mikal sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woadaadaa me saa na woama me tamfo adwane korɔ?” Na Mikal buaa Saul sɛ: “Ɔno ara na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Ma menkɔ! Adɛn nti na menku woɔ?’”
Dawid deɛ, ɔde mmirika dwaneeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ Samuel nkyɛn wɔ Rama kɔkaa deɛ Saul de ayɛ no nyinaa kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔne Samuel firii hɔ kɔtenaa Naiot.
Akyire yi, nkurɔfoɔ kɔbɔɔ Saul amanneɛ sɛ: “Hwɛ! Dawid kɔ Naiot wɔ Rama.”

Ntɛm ara na Saul somaa abɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔfa Dawid. Berɛ a wɔhunuu adiyifoɔ mpanimfoɔ no sɛ wɔrehyɛ nkɔm na Samuel gyina hɔ rehwɛ wɔn soɔ no, Onyankopɔn honhom baa Saul abɔfoɔ no so, na wɔn nso hyehyɛɛ nkɔm saa ara.
Berɛ a wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Saul no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ foforɔ, na wɔn nso yɛɛ sɛ adiyifoɔ. Enti Saul somaa abɔfoɔ bio, ne mprɛnsa soɔ, na wɔn nso yɛɛ sɛ adiyifoɔ.
Ɛnna ɔno nso kɔɔ Rama. Berɛ a ɔkɔduruu abura kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Seku no ho no, ɔbisaa sɛ: “Ɛhe na Samuel ne Dawid wɔ?” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Wɔwɔ Naiot wɔ Rama.”
Ɔfiri hɔ no, ɔtoaa so kɔduruu Naiot wɔ Rama, na ɔno nso, Onyankopɔn honhom baa ne so, na berɛ a ɔrekɔ no, ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm kɔsii sɛ ɔduruu Naiot wɔ Rama.
Na ɔno nso yii ne ntadeɛ guu hɔ, na ɔno nso yɛɛ sɛ odiyifoɔ wɔ Samuel anim, na ɔde adagya daa hɔ da mu no nyinaa ne anadwo mu no nyinaa. Ɛno nti na wɔka sɛ: “Saul nso ka adiyifoɔ no ho anaa?”
20: Samuel 20
Ɛnna ɔno nso ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛmpare wo! Worenwu. Hwɛ! Me papa renyɛ ade kɛseɛ anaa ade ketewa bi, gye sɛ wayi me asotire. Adɛn nti na me papa de asɛm yi bɛhunta me? Ɛnte saa da.”

Nanso Dawid kaa ntam kaa ho, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Wo papa nim sɛ manya w’anim adom, enti ɔbɛka sɛ, ‘Mommma Yonatan nnhunu yei, anyɛ saa a, ɛbɛyɛ no ya.’ Nanso, sɛ Awurade te aseɛ na wo kra nso te aseɛ yi, nammɔn pɛ na ɛda me ne owuo ntam!”
Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Deɛ wo kra bɛka biara mɛyɛ ama wo.”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yonatan sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ɔkyena yɛ bosome foforɔ, na ɛsɛ sɛ me ne ɔhene tena ase didie, nanso gya me kwan ma menkɔ na memfa me ho nkɔhunta wuram nkɔsi da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no anwummerɛ.
Sɛ wo papa hunu sɛ menni hɔ a, ka sɛ, ‘Dawid srɛɛ me kwan sɛ ɔretu mmirika akɔ ne kurom Betlehem, ɛfiri sɛ abusua no nyinaa wɔ afirinhyia afɔrebɔ bi wɔ hɔ.’
Sɛ ɔka sɛ, ‘Ɛnyɛ hwee!’ a, ɛnneɛ na ɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ ma w’akoa. Na sɛ ne bo fu a, ɛnneɛ hunu sɛ wadwene me ho bɔne.
Na yɛ w’akoa adɔeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade apam na wo ne w’akoa ayɛ. Nanso sɛ amumuyɛ bi wɔ me mu a, wo ara ku me, na adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wode me hyɛ wo papa nsa?”
Ɛnna Yonatan kaa sɛ: “Ɛmpare wo! Sɛ mehunu sɛ me papa anya adwene sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wo bɔne a, merenka nkyerɛ wo anaa?”
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yonatan sɛ: “Sɛ wo papa ka asɛmmɔne bi kyerɛ wo a, hwan na ɔbɛka akyerɛ me?”
Ɛnna Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Wo deɛ, bra ma yɛmfiri adi nkɔ wuram.” Enti wɔn mmienu firii adi kɔɔ wuram.

Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn nyɛ ɔdanseni sɛ, ɔkyena anaa ɔkyena akyi saa berɛ yi, mɛhwɛ me papa adwene, na sɛ ɔwɔ Dawid ho adwempa a, mɛsoma aba wo nkyɛn abɛyi wo asotire.
Na sɛ ɛsɔ me papa ani sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wo bɔne, na manyi wo asotire, na mannya wo kwan amma woankɔ asomdwoeɛ mu a, Awurade ntua Yonatan ka na ɔmfa bi nka ho. Awurade nni w’akyi sɛdeɛ ɔdi me papa akyi no.
Na se meda so mete aseɛ yi, fa Awurade nokorɛ adɔeɛ yɛ me, na manwu.
Nyi w’adɔeɛ mfiri me fie da biara da. Na sɛ Awurade twa Dawid atamfo a wɔwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa gu a,
Yonatan din deɛ, mma wɔnntwa mmfiri Dawid fie. Ma Awurade mmisa mfiri Dawid atamfo nsam.”
Enti Yonatan san kaa Dawid ntam, ɔdɔ a ɔdɔ no nti; sɛdeɛ ɔdɔ ɔno ara ne kra no, saa na ɔdɔɔ no.
Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔkyena yɛ bosome foforɔ, na wɔrenhu wo, ɛfiri sɛ wo tenaberɛ bɛda mpan.
Ɛda a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, obiara bɛhunu sɛ wonni hɔ; na bra baabi a asɛm no baeɛ no, deɛ wokɔhuntaeɛ no, na tena boɔ yi ho.
Na mɛto agyan mmiɛnsa afa ho akɔ baabi a mede bɛkyerɛ no.

Na hwɛ! mɛsoma ɔsomfoɔ no sɛ, ‘Kɔhwehwɛ agyan no.’ Sɛ meka kyerɛ ɔsomfoɔ no sɛ, ‘Hwɛ! Agyan no wɔ wo nkyɛn hɔ na sesa bra’ a, ɛnneɛ bra, ɛfiri sɛ sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, ɛkyerɛ sɛ asomdwoeɛ wɔ hɔ ma wo, na asɛm biara nni hɔ.
Nanso sɛ meka kyerɛ abɔfra no sɛ, ‘Hwɛ! Agyan no wɔ nohoa’ a, ɛnneɛ kɔ, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade agya wo kwan.
Na asɛm a yɛaka yi, deɛ me ne wo mmienu nyinaa aka yi, ma Awurade wɔ me ne wo ntam daa.”
Ɛnna Dawid de ne ho kɔhuntaa wuram hɔ. Na bosome foforɔ duruiɛ no, ɔhene tenaa n’adwa so sɛ ɔrebɛdidi.
Na ɔhene tenaa n’adwa so sɛdeɛ ɔyɛ daa no, adwa a ɛsi dan ho no, na Yonatan ne no tena dii nhwɛanimu, na Abner nso tenaa Saul nkyɛn. Dawid adwa no deɛ, na ɛda hɔ.
Na Saul anka hwee ɛda no, na ɔkaa ne tirim sɛ: “Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ biribi ayɛ no, nti ne ho nte, ampa ara ne ho nte.”
Na ɛda a ɛdi bosome foforɔ no akyi, da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, na Dawid adwa no da hɔ ara. Enti Saul bisaa ne ba Yonatan sɛ: “Adɛn nti na nnora ne nnɛ nyinaa Yese ba no ammɛdidie?”
Ɛnna Yonatan buaa Saul sɛ: “Dawid srɛɛ me kwan sɛ ɔrekɔ Betlehem.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wo, gya me kwan, ɛfiri sɛ yɛwɔ abusua afɔrebɔ wɔ kuro no mu, na me nua ahyɛ me sɛ memmra. Enti sɛ manya w’anim adom a, mesrɛ wo, ma memmɔ hwii nkɔ nkɔhwɛ me nuanom no.’ Ɛno nti na wamma ɔhene pono ho yi.”
Ɛnna Saul bo fuu Yonatan pii, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo, abaawa tuatefoɔ ba. Menhunuu sɛ woafa Yese ba no adamfoɔ de rehyɛ wo ara wo ho ne wo maame adagya aniwuo.
Nna dodoɔ a Yese ba no da so te ase asase soɔ yi, wo ne w’ahennie rentim da. Enti soma ma wɔnkɔfa no mmrɛ me, ɛfiri sɛ ɔfata owuo.”
Ɛnna Yonatan bisaa ne papa Saul sɛ: “Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔku no? Ɛdeɛn na wayɛ?”
Ɛnna Saul too pea sɛ ɔde rewɔ no, na Yonatan hunuu sɛ ne papa asi ne bo sɛ ɔbɛku Dawid.
Ɛhɔ ara na Yonatan de abufuo sɔre firii pono no ho, na wannidi bosome foforɔ no da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, ɛfiri sɛ Dawid asɛm no yɛɛ no ya, ɛfiri sɛ, ne papa guu n’anim ase.
Na anɔpa no, Yonatan pue kɔɔ wuram baabi a Dawid ne no hyehyɛeɛ no, na ɔsomfoɔ kumaa bi kaa ne ho.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, tu mmirika na kɔhwehwɛ agyan a merebɛtoɔ no.” Na ɔsomfoɔ no tuu mmirika, na ɔno nso too agyan no traa no.
Berɛ a ɔsomfoɔ no kɔeɛ ara kɔduruu baabi a Yonatan too agyan no kɔguiɛ no, Yonatan teaam ɔsomfoɔ no akyi sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ w’anim nohoa na agyan no wɔ?”
Na Yonatan teaam ɔsomfoɔ no akyi sɛ: “Ma wo ho nyɛ ha! Yɛ no ntɛm! Nnyina faako!” Na Yonatan somfoɔ no tasee agyan no, na ɔbaa ne wura nkyɛn.
Nso ɔsomfoɔ no deɛ, na ɔnnim deɛ ɛrekɔ soɔ; Yonatan ne Dawid nko ara na na wɔnim asɛm no.
Ɛno akyi no, Yonatan de n’akodeɛ no maa ne somfoɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Kɔ, fa kɔ kuro no mu.”

Na ɔsomfoɔ no kɔeɛ. Dawid deɛ, ɔsɔre firii nkyɛn hɔ baabi, anafoɔ fam baeɛ. Ɛnna ɔde n’anim butuu fam, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase mprɛnsa, na obiara fee ne yɔnko ano, na obiara sui ne yɔnko maa Dawid deɛ boroo so.

Na Yonatan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn mmienu nyinaa aka ntam Awurade din mu sɛ, ‘Awurade ntena me ne wo ne m’asefoɔ ne w’asefoɔ ntam nkɔsi daa.’” Ɛnna Dawid sɔre siim kɔɔ ne kwan, na Yonatan nso kɔɔ kuro no mu.
21: Samuel 21

Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek sɛ: “Ɔhene na asoma me asɛm bi ho, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Mma obiara nnhunu deɛ enti a meresoma woɔ ne ɛho ahyɛdeɛ a mede ama woɔ no ho hwee.’ Na me ne mmeranteɛ no nso ahyehyɛ sɛ yɛbɛhyia wɔ baabi.
Na afei, ɛdeɛn na ɛwɔ wo nsam? Ma me paanoo nnum anaa biribiara a wobɛnya.”
Nanso ɔsɔfoɔ no buaa Dawid sɛ: “Menni paanoo hunu biara me nsam, gye paanoo kronkron na ɛwɔ hɔ, sɛ mmeranteɛ no atwe wɔn ho afiri mmaa ho nko ara deɛ a.”

Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Ampa, wɔmma mmaa mmɛn yɛn berɛ biara a yɛbɛkɔ akɔdi dwuma bi no. Ɛkwan hunu a yɛtuiɛ no mpo na mmeranteɛ no adeɛ ho te, na nnɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn adeɛ ho teɛ yi na ɛremma saa?”
Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no de ade kronkron no maa no, ɛfiri sɛ na paanoo biara nni hɔ sɛ paanoo a wɔayi afiri Awurade anim no; da a wɔyiyiiɛ no wɔde paanoohyeɛ a wɔato no foforɔ guu hɔ.
Saa da no, na Saul nkoa no baako a wɔasianka no [wɔato no mu] Awurade anim wɔ hɔ; na ne din de Doeg, Edomni a ɔyɛ Saul nnwanhwɛfoɔ so panin no.
Na Dawid san bisaa Ahimelek sɛ: “Wonni biribiara te sɛ pea anaa nkrantɛ wɔ ha? Mamfa me nkrantɛ ne m’akodeɛ ankura, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛhia sɛ medi ɔhene asɛm no ho dwuma ntɛm.”

Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Filistini Goliat a wokum no Ela bonhwa mu nkrantɛ no nie, hwɛ, ɛno na wɔde ntoma akyekyere ho wɔ asɔfotadeɛ no akyi no. Sɛ ɛno na wopɛ a, fa, ɛfiri sɛ foforɔ biara nni hɔ sɛ ɛno.” Na Dawid nso kaa sɛ: “Ɛso bi nni hɔ; fa ma me.”
Na Saul nti, Dawid sɔre toaa so dwanee saa da no, na ɔkɔduruu Gat hene Akis nkyɛn.
Na Akis nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ Dawid, asase no so hene no nie? Ɛnyɛ oyi na wɔtoo ne ho dwom asa mu kaa sɛ, Na Dawid akum ne mpem du’ no?”
Na Dawid de nsɛm yi siee n’akoma mu, na Gat hene Akis nti, ɔsuroo pii.
Enti ɔyɛɛ ne ho sɛ bɔdamfoɔ wɔn anim, boapa dii abɔdansɛm wɔn nsam, na ɔsensanee kuro no apono no ho, na ɔmaa ne ntasuo siane faa n’abɔdwesɛ mu.
Ɛnna Akis ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa no sɛ: “Hwɛ, moahunu sɛ ɔbarima yi abɔ dam, na ɛdeɛn nti na mode no abrɛ me?
Adɛn, mehia abɔdamfoɔ nti na mode oyi abrɛ me sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ abɔdansɛm nkyerɛ me yi? Oyi nso mmra me fie anaa?”
22: Samuel 22
Na mmarima a wɔn ho akyere wɔn nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔdede aka nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔn werɛ ahoɔ nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ho ano kɔɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔdii wɔn so safohene. Mmarima bɛyɛ ahanan na wɔkɔkaa ne ho.
Akyire yi, Dawid firii hɔ kɔɔ Mispa wɔ Moab, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Moab hene sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma me papa ne me maame mmɛtena mo nkyɛn nkɔsi sɛ mɛhunu deɛ Onyankopɔn bɛyɛ me.”
Enti ɔde wɔn tenaa Moab hene nkyɛn, na wɔne no tenaeɛ, nna a Dawid dii no bepɔ so atenaeɛ hɔ nyinaa.
Ɛnna odiyifoɔ Gad ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Nkɔ so ntena bepɔ so atenaeɛ hɔ. Firi hɔ na kɔ Yuda asase so.” Enti Dawid siim kɔɔ Heret kwaeɛ mu.
Na Saul tee sɛ wɔahunu baabi a Dawid ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no wɔ. Na Saul te Gibea, tamarisk dua no ase wɔ kokoɔ bi so kura ne pea ne nsam, na ne nkoa nyinaa gyinagyina ne ho.

Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa a wɔgyinagyina ne ho no sɛ: “Mo Benyaminfoɔ, montie. Yese ba no nso bɛmema mo nyinaa mfuo ne bobe nturo anaa? Ɔbɛyɛ mo nyinaa apem apem so ahwɛfoɔ ne ɔha ha so ahwɛfoɔ anaa?

Sɛɛ mo nyinaa moabɔ me ho pɔ. Me ara me ba ne Yese ba no ayɛ apam, na obiara anyi me asotire, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔdi me ho ya na ɔdwene me ho a ɔbɛyi me asotire sɛ me ara me ba ama m’akoa so atia me ama no akɔtɛ me nnɛ a merekasa yi.”
Ɛnna Edomni Doeg a wɔde no asi Saul nkoa soɔ no buaa sɛ: “Mehunuu sɛ Yese ba no baa Ahitab ba Ahimelek nkyɛn wɔ Nob.
Na ɔbisaa Awurade maa no, na ɔmaa no akwansoduane, na ɔde Filistini Goliat nkrantɛ no maa no.”
Ɛhɔ ara na ɔhene somaa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ Ahitab ba ɔsɔfoɔ Ahimelek mmra, ɔne ne papa fie nyinaa, asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Nob no. Enti wɔn nyinaa baa ɔhene anim.
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Ahitab ba, mesrɛ wo tie!” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Menie, me wura.”
Na Saul ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na moabɔ me ho pɔ, wo ne Yese ba no, na womaa no aduane ne nkrantɛ, na wobisaa Onyankopɔn maa no, sɛ ɔnsɔre me so na ɔntetɛ me nnɛ a merekasa yi?”
Ɛnna Ahimelek buaa ɔhene sɛ: “Wo nkoa nyinaa mu no, hwan na ɔte sɛ Dawid, ɔnokwafoɔ a ɔyɛ ɔhene ase ne w’awɛmfoɔ so panin a wɔdi no ni wo fie?
Ɛnnɛ na merefiri aseɛ abisa Onyankopɔn ama no anaa? Ɛmpare me! Mma ɔhene mmfa asɛm bi nnto n’akoa ne me papa fie nyinaa so, na yei nyinaa, ketewaa oo, kɛseɛ oo, w’akoa nnim ho hwee.”
Nanso ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Ahimelek, owuo na wobɛwuo, wo ne wo papa fie nyinaa.”

Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ awɛmfoɔ a wɔgyinagyina ne ho no sɛ: “Monnane mo ho nkunkum Awurade asɔfoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔne Dawid adi nsawɔsoɔ; wɔhunuu sɛ ɔredwane nanso wɔanyi me asotire!” Na ɔhene nkoa no ampɛ sɛ wɔtene wɔn nsa ka Awurade asɔfoɔ no to hyɛ wɔn soɔ.
Afei ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Doeg sɛ: “Dane wo ho na to hyɛ asɔfoɔ no so!” Ɛhɔ ara na Edomni Doeg danee ne ho to hyɛɛ asɔfoɔ no soɔ. Ɛda no, ɔkunkum mmarima aduɔwɔtwe nnum a wɔhyehyɛ nwera asɔfotadeɛ no.
Na Asɔfoɔ no kuro Nob mpo, ɔde nkrantɛ kunkum emu nnipa; ɔde nkrantɛ kunkum mmarima ne mmaa, mmɔfra ne nkɔkoaa, anantwie ne mfunumu ne nnwan.
Nanso Ahitab ba Ahimelek ba baako a wɔfrɛ no Abiatar nyaa ne ho tetee, na ɔdwane kɔdii Dawid akyi.
Na Abiatar ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Saul akunkum Awurade asɔfoɔ no.”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abiatar sɛ: “Ɛda no, na Edomni Doeg wɔ hɔ, enti na menim sɛ sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ biara, ɔbɛka akyerɛ Saul. Me na mayɛ wo papa fie akra nyinaa bɔne.
Wo deɛ, tena me nkyɛn. Nsuro, na deɛ ɔrehwehwɛ me kra no hwehwɛ wo nso wo kra, na wohia sɛ mebɔ wo ho ban.”
23: Samuel 23
Na Dawid bisaa Awurade sɛ: “Menkɔ na menkɔkunkum Filistifoɔ yi?” Na Awurade buaa Dawid sɛ: “Kɔ, kɔkunkum Filistifoɔ no na gye Keila.”
Ɛnna Dawid mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, Yuda fa ha a yɛwɔ yi mpo, yɛsuro, na sɛ yɛkɔ Keila na yɛne Filistifoɔ mpasua so dɔm kɔko deɛ a, ɛnneɛ yɛnnim deɛ ɛbɛsie!”
Enti Dawid san bisaa Awurade bio. Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɔre, siane kɔ Keila, ɛfiri sɛ mede Filistifoɔ no bɛhyɛ wo nsa.”
Enti Dawid ne ne mmarima no kɔɔ Keila ne Filistifoɔ kɔkoeɛ, na wɔfaa wɔn nyɛmmoa kɔeɛ, na wɔde okunkɛseɛ kunkum wɔn; enti Dawid gyee Keilafoɔ.
Na berɛ a Ahimelek ba Abiatar redwane akɔ Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Keila no, ɔde asɔfotadeɛ no kuraa ne nsam kɔeɛ.
Na wɔkɔbɔɔ Saul amanneɛ sɛ: “Dawid aba Keila.” Na Saul kaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn atɔn no ahyɛ me nsa; wato ne ho mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkɔ kuro a apono ne mmeamu deda ano mu.”
Enti Saul frɛfrɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ wɔnkɔko na wɔnsiane nkɔ Keila na wɔnkɔtwa Dawid ne ne mmarima no ho nhyia.
Na Dawid tee sɛ Saul rebɔ ne ho pɔ bɔne. Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar sɛ: “Fa asɔfotadeɛ no bra ha.”
Ɛnna Dawid kaa sɛ: “O Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, w’akoa ate sɛ me nti, Saul pɛ sɛ ɔba Keila bɛsɛe kuro yi.
Keilafoɔ de me bɛhyɛ ne nsa anaa? Saul bɛsiane aba ha ampa sɛdeɛ w’akoa ateɛ no? O Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, mekoto mesrɛ wo, ka kyerɛ w’akoa.” Ɛnna Awurade kaa sɛ: “Ɔbɛsiane aba.”
Na Dawid kaa sɛ: “Keilafoɔ de me ne me mmarima no bɛhyɛ Saul nsa anaa?” Ɛnna Awurade buaa sɛ: “Wɔde mo bɛhyɛ ne nsa.”
Ntɛm ara na Dawid ne ne mmarima bɛyɛ ahansia no sɔreeɛ, na wɔfirii Keila nante kɔɔ baabiara a wɔbɛnya. Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ kɔbɔɔ Saul amanneɛ sɛ Dawid adwane afiri Keila kɔ, enti wannya ankɔ hɔ.
Na Dawid kɔtenaa serɛ so bepo so atenaeɛ ahodoɔ no mu, na ɔtenaa Sif serɛ so mmepɔ mu. Saul hwehwɛɛ no daa, nanso Onyankopɔn anyi no anhyɛ ne nsa.
Na Dawid hunuu sɛ Saul afiri adi rebɛhwɛhwɛ no aku no. Nso na Dawid wɔ Sif serɛ so wɔ Hores.
Ɛnna Saul ba Yonatan sɔreeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hores kɔhyɛɛ ne nsam den Onyankopɔn din mu.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nsuro, ɛfiri sɛ me papa Saul nsa renka wo, na wo na wobɛdi Israel so hene, na mɛyɛ w’abadiakyire; me papa Saul mpo nim saa.”
Na wɔn mmienu no yɛɛ apam Awurade anim, na Dawid kɔɔ so tenaa Hores, na Yonatan deɛ, ɔkɔɔ ne fie.
Akyire yi, Sif mmarima foro kɔɔ Saul nkyɛn wɔ Gibea kɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ Dawid na ɔhunta yɛn nkyɛn wɔ atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Hores, Hakila kokoɔ a ɛwɔ ɛserɛ pataa no anafoɔ fam no soɔ no?
Na afei, O ɔhene, sɛdeɛ wo kra hwehwɛ sɛ wosiane ba no, siane bra, na yɛn nso yɛbɛyi no ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.”
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Awurade nhyira nka mo, ɛfiri sɛ moahu me mmɔbɔ.
Mesrɛ mo, monkɔ so nhwehwɛ mu yie, na monhwɛ nhunu baabi a ɔhyɛ ne onii ko a ɔhunuu no no, ɛfiri sɛ mate sɛ ɔyɛ onitefoɔ sɛ.
Monhwɛ na monhunu huntabea biara a ɔhuntahunta no nyinaa, na momfa ɛho adanseɛ mmrɛ me, na me ne mo bɛkɔ. Na sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔwɔ asase no so a, mɛkyini ahwehwɛ no Yuda mpempem nyinaa mu.”
Enti wɔsɔre dii Saul anim kɔɔ Sif. Saa berɛ no na Dawid ne ne mmarima no wɔ Maon serɛ so, wɔ Araba, Yesimon anafoɔ fam.
Akyire yi, Saul ne ne mmarima no ba bɛhwehwɛɛ no. Berɛ a wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔsiane kɔhyɛɛ ɔbotan mu, na ɔtenaa Maon serɛ so hɔ. Na Saul teeɛ no, ɔtii Dawid wɔ Maon serɛ no so.

Ɛduruu baabi no, na Saul nam bepɔ no fa ha, na Dawid ne ne mmarima no nso nam bepɔ no fa ha. Na Saul nti, na Dawid repɛ ntɛm afiri hɔ. Saa berɛ no nyinaa, na Saul ne ne mmarima no rebɛn Dawid ne ne mmarima no apɛ wɔn akye wɔn.
Nanso ɔbɔfoɔ baa Saul nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛ ntɛm bra, na Filistifoɔ abɛto ahyɛ asase no so!”
Enti Saul gyaee Dawid akyiridie, na ɔkɔhyiaa Filistifoɔ no. Ɛno nti na wɔbɛfrɛɛ hɔ Dwaneeɛ Botan no.
Na Dawid firii hɔ foro kɔtenaa En-Gedi bepɔ so atenaeɛ mu.
24: Samuel 24
Na Saul faa mmarima mpem mmiɛnsa a wɔayi wɔn afiri Israel nyinaa sɛ wɔrekɔhwehwɛ Dawid ne ne mmarima no wɔ abotan so mmirekyie atenaeɛ, abotan kwaboo no so.
Na ɔkɔduruu aboɔ nnwammuo a ɛwɔ kwan soɔ no ho. Na ɔbodan bi wɔ hɔ, enti Saul kɔɔ mu sɛ ɔrekɔgya ne nan, na na Dawid ne ne mmarima no nso tete ɔbodan no mu nohoa.

Ɛnna Dawid mmarima no keka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Awurade reka akyerɛ wo nnɛ da yi sɛ, ‘Hwɛ! mede wo tamfo bɛhyɛ wo nsa, na deɛ ɛsɔ w’ani biara, fa yɛ no.’” Enti Dawid sɔre yɛɛ brɛoo kɔtwaa Saul atadeɛ ngugusoɔ ano.
Nanso ɛno akyi no, Dawid akoma bɔɔ no paripari sɛ watwa Saul atadeɛ ngugusoɔ ano.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mmarima no sɛ: “Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛgyina Awurade anim ayɛ adeɛ a ɛte saa atia me wura a Awurade asra no na matene me nsa aka no, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade asra no.”
Enti Dawid de nsɛm yi siankaa ne mmarima no, na wamma wɔansɔre antia Saul. Saul deɛ, ɔsɔre firii ɔbodan no mu sii so kɔɔ ne kwan.
Ɛno akyi no, Dawid sɔre firii adi firii ɔbodan no mu, na ɔteaam frɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Me wura ɔhene!” Ɛnna Saul danee n’ani hwɛɛ n’akyi, na Dawid bɔɔ ne mu ase kotoe de n’anim butuu fam.
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woretietie nkurɔfoɔ ano sɛ, ‘Hwɛ! Dawid repɛ wo adi wo bɔne’?
Ɛnnɛ da yi, wode w’ani ahunu sɛdeɛ Awurade de wo hyɛɛ me nsa wɔ ɔbodan no mu nnɛ; wɔkaa sɛ menku wo, nanso mehuu wo mmɔbɔ, na mekaa sɛ, ‘Meremfa me nsa nka me wura ɛfiri sɛ Awurade asra no.’

Hwɛ, m'agya, hwɛ sɛ w’atadeɛ ngugusoɔ ano kura me nsam. Metwaa w’atadeɛ ngugusoɔ ano nanso manku wo. Hwɛ na hunu sɛ bɔne anaa atuateɛ bi nni me nsam, na menyɛɛ wo bɔne biara, nanso wo deɛ, worepɛ me aku me.
Awurade mmu me ne wo ntam atɛn; na Awurade na ɔbɛtɔ werɛ wo nsam ama me, na me nsa deɛ, meremfa nka wo.
Sɛdeɛ tete bɛ no ka no, ‘Abɔnefoɔ so na bɔne fire,’ na me nsa deɛ, meremfa nka wo.
Hwan na Israel hene atu di n’akyi yi? Hwan na woreti no yi? Kraman funu akyi, Sommorɔ baako pɛ yi?
Awurade nyɛ ɔtemmufoɔ, na ɔmmu me ne wo ntam atɛn, na ɔnhunu na ɔnni m’asɛm mma me, na ɔmmu me atɛn nyi me mfiri wo nsam.”
Na berɛ a Dawid kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Saul wieeɛ no, Saul kaa sɛ: “Me ba Dawid, wo nne na meteɛ yi anaa?” Na Saul maa ne nne so suiɛ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Wotene sene me, ɛfiri sɛ wode papa atua me ka, na me deɛ, mede bɔne atua wo ka.
Wo deɛ, woama nnipa ahunu papa a woayɛ me nnɛ yi, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yii me hyɛɛ wo nsa, nanso woanku me.
Sɛ ɛba sɛ onipa nya ne tamfo a, ɔbɛma no de ne ho sɔnn akɔ anaa? Ɛno nti Awurade de adepa bɛtua wo ka ɛfiri sɛ woayɛ me saa nnɛ da yi.
Afei hwɛ! menim sɛ wo na wobɛdi hene, na wo nsam na Israel ahennie bɛgyina.
Enti ka me ntam Awurade din mu sɛ worentwa m’asefoɔ a wɔbɛdi m’akyi aba no ngu, na worempepa me din mfiri me m'agya fie.”
Ɛnna Dawid kaa Saul ntam, na afei Saul kɔɔ ne fie. Na Dawid ne ne mmarima no deɛ, wɔforo kɔɔ bepɔ so atenaeɛ no mu.
25: Samuel 25
Na ɔbarima bi tenaa ase wɔ Maon a n’adwuma wɔ Karmel. Na ɔbarima no yɛ onipa kɛseɛ paa; na ɔwɔ nnwan mpem mmiɛnsa ne mmirekyie apem, na na ɔretwitwa ne nnwan ho wɔ Karmel.
Na ɔbarima no din de Nabal, na ne yere din de Abigail. Na ne yere no nim nyansa wɔ adwempa yie na ne ho nso yɛ fɛ, na ne kunu deɛ, na n’asɛm yɛ den na ne nneyɛɛ nyɛ; na ɔyɛ Kaleb aseni.
Na Dawid tee no serɛ so hɔ sɛ Nabal retwitwa ne nnwan ho nwi.
Enti Dawid somaa mmeranteɛ du, na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ mmeranteɛ no sɛ: “Monkɔ Karmel, Nabal nkyɛn na monkɔbisa sɛdeɛ ne ho teɛ, me din mu.
Mokɔ a, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Asomdwoeɛ nka wo, asomdwoeɛ nka wo fie, na asomdwoeɛ nka deɛ wowɔ nyinaa.
Na afei, mate sɛ woretwitwa nnwan ho. Yɛne wo nnwanhwɛfoɔ no ara na ɛtenaeɛ. Yɛampoopoo wɔn, na nna a wɔde tenaa Karmel nyinaa, wɔn biribiara anyera.
Bisabisa wo ara wo mmarima no, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo, enti ma me mmarima no nnya w’anim adom, ɛfiri sɛ yɛaba afahyɛ da. Enti yɛsrɛ wo, deɛ wo nsa bɛka biara, fa ma wo nkoa ne wo ba Dawid.’”
Ɛnna Dawid mmarima no kɔeɛ, na wɔkɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ Nabal wɔ Dawid din mu, na wɔtwɛneeɛ.
Nanso Nabal buaa Dawid nkoa no sɛ: “Hwan ne Dawid, na hwan ne Yese ba no? Nnansa yi, nkoa a wɔdwane firi wɔn wuranom nkyɛn adɔɔso.
Memfa m’aduane ne me nsuo ne me nam a makum atwitwa ama me nnwan ho twitwafoɔ no mma mmarima a mennim deɛ wɔfire anaa?”
Ɛnna Dawid mmarima no danee wɔn ho sii kwan soɔ, na wɔsan kɔ kɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛɛ no.

Ɛhɔ ara na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne mmarima no sɛ: “Obiara mfa ne nkrantɛ mmɔ n’asene!” Enti obiara faa ne nkrantɛ bɔɔ n’asene, na Dawid nso de ne nkrantɛ bɔɔ n’asene. Na wɔdii Dawid akyi, mmarima bɛyɛ ahanan, na ahanu tenaa wɔn nneɛma no ho.
Nso na mmarima no baako akɔka akyerɛ Nabal yere Abigail sɛ: “Hwɛ, Dawid tuu abɔfoɔ firii serɛ so bɛkyeaa yɛn wura, nanso wɔteatea wɔn poopoo wɔn.
Na mmarima no yɛ ma yɛn sɛ, wɔampoopoo yɛn, na nna a yɛne wɔn nantee wuram no nyinaa, yɛn biribiara anyera da.
Wɔyɛɛ sɛ ɔfasuo wɔ yɛn ho awia ne anadwo, nna a yɛne wɔn wɔ hɔ rehwɛ nnwan no nyinaa.
Na afei hwɛ na hunu deɛ wobɛyɛ, na mmusuo na ɛrebɛba yɛn wura ne ne fie nyinaa soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima huhuni a obi ntumi nkasa nkyerɛ no.”

Ɛhɔ ara na Abigail yɛɛ ntɛm faa paanoo ahanu ne bobesa nsuhina mmienu ma, ne nnwan nnum a wɔasiesie, ne nkyeweɛ susukoraa nnum, ne bobe taterɛ ɔha, ne borɔdɔma aba a wɔabɔ no ntoantoa ahanu, na ɔde soaa mfunumu.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mmeranteɛ no sɛ: “Monsene nni m'anim, na mɛdi mo akyi.” Na ne kunu Nabal deɛ, wanka hwee ankyerɛ no.
Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a ɔte afunumu no so resiane bepɔ no ahuntaeɛ mu no, ɔnkɔhwɛ a Dawid ne ne mmarima na wɔresiane ba yi. Enti ɔkɔhyiaa wɔn.
Dawid deɛ, na waka sɛ: “Ɔbrɛ na mabrɛ agu kwa sɛ mebɔɔ oyi nneɛma nyinaa ho ban ɛserɛ no soɔ; deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa baako mpo anyera, nanso hwɛ, bɔne na ɔde retua papa a meyɛeɛ so ka.
Sɛ ɛbɛduru ɔkyena anɔpa na magya ɔbarima bi wɔ ne fie a, Onyankopɔn ntua Dawid atamfo ka na ɔmfa bi nka ho.”
Berɛ a Abigail hunuu Dawid ara pɛ, ɔyɛɛ ntɛm si firii afunumu no so, na ɔkotoo Dawid anim na ɔde n’anim butuu fam.
Afei ɔhwee ne nan ase kaa sɛ: “O me wura, ma asodie no mmra me so mmom; mesrɛ wo, ma w’afenaa nkasa w’asom, na tie w’afenaa asɛm.
Mesrɛ wo, mma me wura mmfa n’akoma nnkɔ ɔbarima huhuni Nabal yi so, na sɛdeɛ ne din teɛ no saa na ɔteɛ. Ne din de Nabal, na agyimisɛm te ne mu. W’afenaa deɛ, manhunu me wura mmarima a wosomaa wɔn no.
Enti me wura, sɛ Awurade te aseɛ na wo kra nso te aseɛ yi, Awurade ayi wo afiri mu na woammɛdi mogya ho fɔ, sɛ wode wo ara wo nsa bɛtɔ werɛ. Na ma w’atamfo ne wɔn a wɔpɛ me wura bɔne no nyɛ sɛ Nabal.
Na afei, akyɛdeɛ a w’afenaa de abrɛ me wura yi, fa ma mmeranteɛ a wɔdi me wura anammɔn akyi no.
Enti mesrɛ wo, fa w’afenaa bɔne kyɛ no, na Awurade bɛkyekyere efie a ɛtim hɔ daa ama me wura, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ko na me wura reko; bɔne deɛ, wɔrenhunu bi wo mu wo nna nyinaa.
Na sɛ onipa sɔre ti wo na ɔhwehwɛ wo kra a, Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyekyere me wura kra wɔ nkwa boaa mu, ne nkyɛn; nanso w’atamfo kra deɛ, ɔbɛto no sɛ adeɛ a ɛfiri ataaboɔ mu.
Na sɛ Awurade nya yɛ me wura papa a waka wɔ wo ho no nyinaa na ɔde wo si Israel so hene a,
me wura werɛ renho na n'akoma remmɔ no paripari sɛ waka mogya agu kwa anaa sɛ me wura no ara atɔ were. Na Awurade yɛ me wura yie a, kae w’afenaa.”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abigail sɛ: “Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔsomaa wo bɛhyiaa me nnɛ yi!
Nhyira nka wo nyansa, na nhyira nka wo sɛ woayi me afiri mogya ho afɔdie mu na me ara mamfa me nsa antɔ werɛ.
Na ampa ara sɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a wamma manyɛ wo bɔne no nso te aseɛ yi, sɛ woanyɛ ntɛm ammɛhyia me a, anka adeɛ bɛkye anɔpa no na ɛnkaa Nabal fie barima baako mpo.”
Ɛnna Dawid gyee deɛ ɔde brɛɛ no no ne nsam, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Foro kɔ wo fie asomdwoeɛ mu. Hwɛ, matie wo nne, na mahwɛ w’anim.”

Akyire yi Abigail kɔɔ Nabal nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtoo sɛ wato pono wɔ fie sɛ ɔhene bi pono, a Nabal ani agye n’akomam, na waboro sei sram; na wanka asɛm ketewa anaa kɛseɛ bi ankyerɛ ne kunu kɔsii sɛ adeɛ kyeeɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ adeɛ kyee anɔpa a nsa no atete Nabal ani soɔ no, ne yere kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ no, na n’akoma wuu ne mu, na ɔyɛɛ sɛ boɔ.
Na bɛyɛ dadu no, Awurade bɔɔ Nabal maa no wuiɛ.

Na Dawid tee sɛ Nabal awu no, ɔkaa sɛ: “Nhyira nka Awurade a wadi m’asɛm ayi m’ahohoraa na wayi me afiri Nabal nsam na wamma n’akoa anyɛ bɔne, na Awurade ama Nabal bɔne adane agu n’atifi!” Na Dawid somaa sɛ wɔnkɔka nkyerɛ Abigail sɛ ɔbɛware no.
Enti Dawid nkoa no kɔɔ Abigail nkyɛn wɔ Karmel, na wɔne no kɔkasaa sɛ: “Dawid asoma yɛn wo nkyɛn sɛ ɔrebɛfa wo aware.”
Ɛhɔ ara na ɔsɔre bɔɔ ne mu aseɛ, na ɔde n’anim butuu fam kaa sɛ: “W’afenaa nie, na mɛyɛ abaawa ahohoro me wura nkoa nan ho.”
Ɛnna Abigail yɛɛ ntɛm sɔreeɛ, na ɔtenaa afunumu so, na ne mmaawa nnum dii n’akyi, na ɔsiim ne Dawid abɔfoɔ no kɔeɛ, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yere.
Na Dawid afa Ahinoam a ɔfiri Yesreel nso, na mmaa mmienu no nyinaa bɛyɛɛ ne yerenom.
Na Saul deɛ, na ɔde ne babaa Mikal, Dawid yere no ama Lais ba Palti a ɔfiri Galim no aware.
26: Samuel 26
Ɛnna Saul sɔre siane kɔɔ Sif serɛ soɔ, ɔne Israel mmarima mpem mmiɛnsa a wɔayi wɔn, sɛ wɔrekɔhwehwɛ Dawid wɔ Sif serɛ so.
Na Saul kyeree nsraban wɔ Hakila kokoɔ a ɛkyerɛ Yesimon no so, wɔ ɛkwan ho. Saa berɛ no na Dawid te serɛ so, na ɔhunuu sɛ Saul adi n’akyi aba serɛ no so hɔ.
Enti Dawid somaa akwansrafoɔ kɔhwɛɛ sɛ Saul aba hɔ ampa a.

Akyire yi, Dawid sɔreeɛ, na ɔsiim kɔɔ baabi a Saul akyere nsraban no, na Dawid hunuu baabi a Saul ne Ner ba Abner a ɔyɛ ne sahene no deda; na Saul da nsraban no mu, na nnipa no akyere nsraban atwa ne ho ahyia.
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa Hitini Ahimelek ne Seruia ba Abisai, Yoab nua no sɛ: “Hwan na ɔbɛsiane ne me akɔ Saul nkyɛn nsraban no mu?” Na Abisai kaa sɛ: “Me na me ne wo bɛkɔ.”
Na Dawid ne Abisai siim kɔɔ nkurɔfoɔ no mu anadwo; na hwɛ! na Saul ada wɔ nsraban no mu, na ne pea si fam n’atifi, na Abner ne nnipa no nyinaa adeda atwa ne ho ahyia.
Ɛnna Abisai ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Onyankopɔn ayi wo tamfo ahyɛ wo nsa nnɛ. Enti afei, mesrɛ wo, ma memfa pea nwɔ no baako pɛ nsi fam, merenwɔ no mprenu.”
Nanso Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai sɛ: “Nni no awu, na hwan na watene ne nsa aka deɛ Awurade asra no na wafa ne ho adi pɛn?”
Na Dawid toaa so kaa sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, Awurade na ɔbɛbɔ no; anyɛ saa nso a, ne da bɛduru ama no awu, anaa ɔbɛkɔ ɔsa ama wɔapra no akɔ.
Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛgyina Awurade anim atene me nsa aka deɛ Awurade asra no! Enti mesrɛ wo, fa pea a ɛsi n’atifi no ne nsuo kuruwa no ma yɛnkɔ.”
Enti Dawid faa pea ne nsuo kuruwa no firii Saul atifi, na wɔsii kwan so; obiara anhu wɔn, na obiara nso ante wɔn nka, na obiara annyane; na wɔn nyinaa adeda, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade na ɔmaa wɔdaa hatee.
Afei Dawid twaam kɔɔ ɛfa nohoa kɔgyinaa bepɔ so wɔ akyiri; na ɛkwan a ɛda wɔn ntam no ware.
Ɛnna Dawid teaam frɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ no ne Ner ba Abner sɛ: “Abner ee, enti merefrɛ yi wonnye so?” Na Abner buaa sɛ: “Wo hwan na worefrɛ ɔhene yi?”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abner sɛ: “Wonyɛ barima anaa? Hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ wɔ Israel? Adɛn nti na woanwɛn wo wura ɔhene yi? Obi baa hɔ sɛ anka ɔrebɛdi wo wura ɔhene awu.
Deɛ woayɛ yi nyɛ. Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, mo nyinaa mofata wuo, ɛfiri sɛ moanwɛn mo wura a Awurade asra no no. Afei monhwɛ deɛ ɔhene pea ne nsuo kuruwa a na ɛsi n’atifi no wɔ.”
Ɛnna Saul hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ Dawid nne, na ɔbisaa sɛ: “Me ba Dawid, wo nne na meteɛ yi anaa?” Na Dawid buaa sɛ: “Me wura ɔhene, ɛyɛ me nne.”
Na ɔtoaa so kaa sɛ: “Adɛn nti na me wura di n’akoa akyiri seyie? Ɛdeɛn na mayɛ? Anaasɛ bɔne bɛn na ɛwɔ me nsam?

Enti afei, mesrɛ wo, me wura ɔhene, tie w’akoa nsɛm a mereka yi: Sɛ Awurade na ɔrepiapia wo tia me a, ma no nnye me nsam afɔdeɛ. Na sɛ ɛyɛ nnipa mma nso a, ɛnneɛ wɔadome wɔn Awurade anim ɛfiri sɛ wɔapamo me nnɛ afiri Awurade agyapadeɛ ho sɛdeɛ menni kyɛfa bi wɔ mu, na wɔaka sɛ, ‘Kɔ, na kɔsom anyame foforɔ!’
Na afei mma me mogya nnhwie nngu fam wɔ faako a ɛnyɛ Awurade anim; sommorɔ baako pɛ yi na Israel hene afiri adi rekɔhwehwɛ no sɛdeɛ obi pamo akokɔhwedeɛ wɔ mmepɔ soɔ yi.”
Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Mayɛ bɔne. Me ba Dawid, san bra na merenyɛ wo bɔne bio, ɛfiri sɛ me kra asom bo w’ani so nnɛ. Hwɛ! madi nkwaseasɛm, na mafom pii.”
Na Dawid kaa sɛ: “Ɔhene pea no nie, ma mmeranteɛ no baako mmra mmɛgye.
Na Awurade na ɔbɛtua obiara ka, sɛdeɛ obiara tenenee ne ne nokorɛdie teɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnnɛ Awurade de wo hyɛɛ me nsa, nanso mampɛ sɛ metene me nsa ka deɛ Awurade asra no.
Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛnnɛ wo kra ayɛ adekɛseɛ m’ani soɔ no, saa ara na ma me kra nso nyɛ adekɛseɛ Awurade ani soɔ, na ɔnyi me mfiri ahohiahia nyinaa mu.”
Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Nhyira nka wo, me ba Dawid. Ɛnyɛ nnwuma nko na wode wo nsa bɛyɛ na mmom wobɛdi nkonim nso.” Na Dawid siim kɔɔ ne kwan, na Saul nso san kɔɔ baabi a ɔfiri baeɛ.
27: Samuel 27
Enti Dawid sɔreeɛ, na ɔne mmarima ahansia a wɔka ne ho no twaam kɔɔ Maok ba Akis, Gat hene no hɔ.
Na Dawid kɔɔ so tenaa Akis nkyɛn wɔ Gat, ɔne ne mmarima no, obiara ne ne fiefoɔ, Dawid ne ne yerenom mmienu no, Yesreelni Ahinoam ne Karmelni Abigail, Nabal yere no.
Akyire yi, wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ Dawid adwane kɔ Gat, enti wankɔ so anhwehwɛ no bio.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Akis sɛ: “Sɛ manya w’anim adom a, ma wɔmma me baabi wɔ nkuraaseɛ nkuro no baako mu na mentena hɔ; adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ w’akoa ne wo tena adehyeɛ kuro mu?”
Enti Akis de Siklag maa no saa da no. Ɛno nti na Siklag abɛyɛ Yuda ahemfo kuro de bɛsi nnɛ no.
Nna dodoɔ a Dawid de tenaa Filistifoɔ akuraa ase no yɛ afe ne abosome nnan.
Na Dawid ne ne mmarima no foro kɔ kɔfom Gesurfoɔ ne Gersifoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ nneɛma; wɔn na na wɔtete asase no soɔ firi teteete kɔpem Sur de kɔsi Egypt asase soɔ.
Na Dawid kɔto hyɛɛ asase no so, na wankora ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa biara nkwa so; ɔfaa anantwie ne nnwan ne mfunumu ne yoma ne ntadeɛ, na ɔsan kɔɔ Akis nkyɛn.
Ɛnna Akis bisaa sɛ: “Ɛhe na mokɔɔ afom nnɛ?” Na Dawid kaa sɛ: “Yɛkɔɔ Yuda anafoɔ ne Yerameelfoɔ anafoɔ ne Kenifoɔ anafoɔ.”

Ɔbarima oo, ɔbaa oo, Dawid ankora obiara nkwa so amfa no amma Gat, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa sɛ: “Anyɛ a wɔbɛkɔ akɔka deɛ yɛayɛ sɛ, ‘Sei na Dawid ayɛ.’” Nna a ɔde tenaa Filistifoɔ akuraa ase hɔ nyinaa, saa ara na ɔyɛeɛ.
Enti Akis gyee Dawid diiɛ, na ɔkaa no ne tirim sɛ: “Ampa ara ne ho abɔn ne man Israel, na ɔbɛyɛ m’akoa daa.”
28: Samuel 28
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Akis sɛ: “Ɛno nti na wo ara wobɛhunu deɛ w’akoa bɛyɛ no.” Na Akis ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Ɛno nti na mede wo bɛsi me tiri so ɔwɛmfoɔ daa no.”
Na Samuel awu, na Israel nyinaa asu no ama wɔasie no ne kurom Rama. Na Saul nso atu akɔmfoɔ ne asumanfoɔ afiri asase no so.
Ɛnna Filistifoɔ boaboaa wɔn ho ano, na wɔbɛkyeree nsraban wɔ Sunem. Enti Saul nso boaboaa Israel nyinaa ano, na wɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Gilboa.
Na berɛ a Saul hunuu Filistifoɔ nsraban no, ɔsuroeɛ na n’akoma tuu papaapa.
Na Saul hwehwɛɛ Awurade akyiri kwan, nanso Awurade ammua no; wamfa daeɛ so anaa Urim so anaa adiyifoɔ so.
Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: “Monkɔhwehwɛ kɔmfobaa bi mma me, na menkɔ ne hɔ abisa.” Na ne nkoa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, kɔmfobaa bi wɔ En-Dor.”

Enti Saul sakraa ne ho hyɛɛ ntade foforɔ, na ɔne mmarima mmienu siim kɔeɛ, na wɔkɔduruu ɔbaa no nkyɛn anadwo. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, fa asumansɛm so hyɛ me nkɔm, na ma onipa a mɛbɔ ne din akyerɛ woɔ no mforo mmra.”
Nanso ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo ara wonim deɛ Saul ayɛ, sɛ watu akɔmfoɔ ne asumanfoɔ ase afiri asase yi soɔ. Enti adɛn na worebɛsum me kra fidie ama wɔaku me yi?”
Ntɛm ara na Saul kaa no ntam Awurade din mu sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, asɛm yi ho afɔdie biara remmɛda wo so!”
Ɛnna ɔbaa no bisaa sɛ: “Hwan na wopɛ sɛ mema no foro ba?” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ma Samuel mforo mmra.”
Berɛ a ɔbaa no hunuu “Samuel” no, ɔfirii aseɛ de nne kɛseɛ teateaam, na ɔbisaa Saul sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woadaadaa me, berɛ a wo ara wone Saul no?”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nsuro. Ɛdeɛn na wohunuiɛ?” Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Saul sɛ: “Mehunuu onyame bi sɛ ɔreforo firi asase ase ba.”

Ɛhɔ ara na ɔbisaa ɔbaa no sɛ: “Ne su te sɛn?” Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Akɔkoraa bi a ɔhyɛ atadeɛ yuu na mehunuu no sɛ ɔreforo ba.” Ɛnna Saul hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ “Samuel,” na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase koto de n’anim butuu fam.

Na “Samuel” bisaa Saul sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woaha me ama wɔafrɛ me aba?” Ɛnna Saul kaa sɛ: “Me ho akyere me paa, ɛfiri sɛ Filistifoɔ ne me reko, na Onyankopɔn nso apa m’akyi na ɔmmua me bio; ɔmfa adiyifoɔ so na ɔmfa adaeɛso so. Ɛno nti na mafrɛ wo sɛ kyerɛ me deɛ menyɛ no.”
Ɛnna “Samuel” kaa sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade apa w’akyi abɛyɛ wo tamfo deɛ a, adɛn nti na worehwehwɛ m’akyiri kwan?
Deɛ Awurade nam me so kaeɛ no, ɛno ara na ɔbɛyɛ; Awurade bɛhwim ahennie no afiri wo nsam na ɔde ama wo yɔnko Dawid.
Woantie Awurade nne, na woanyɛ n’abufuhyeɛ a ɛtia Amalek no ho adeɛ, ɛno nti Awurade bɛyɛ wo saa adeɛ yi nnɛ.
Na Awurade de wo ne Israel nso bɛhyɛ Filistifoɔ nsa, na ɔkyena, wo ne wo mma bɛba abɛka me ho. Israel nsraban no, Awurade de bɛhyɛ Filistifoɔ nsa.”
Ɛhɔ ara na Saul twa hwee fam birim na ɔbeaa hɔ, na ɔsuroo papaapa, “Samuel” asɛm no nti. Afei nso na ahoɔden bi nni ne mu, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnnidii da mu no nyinaa ne anadwo mu no nyinaa.
Ɛnna ɔbaa no baa Saul nkyɛn bɛhunuu sɛ asɛm no aha no pii abɔ hu. Enti ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, w’afenaa atie wo nne, na mede me kra ato me nsam ayɛ deɛ woka kyerɛɛ me no.
Enti afei mesrɛ wo, wo nso tie w’afenaa nne na ma memfa paanoo kakra mmɛsi w’anim na di, na woanya ahoɔden de akɔ wo kwan.”
Nanso wampene, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Merennidi.” Na ne nkoa ne ɔbaa no srɛɛ no ara. Afei ɔtiee wɔn, na ɔsɔre firii fam tenaa mpa so.
Na ɔbaa no wɔ nantwie ba kɛseɛ bi wɔ fie hɔ. Enti ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kum no, na ɔfaa esiam fete de too paanoo a mmɔreka nnim.
Na ɔde sii Saul ne ne nkoa no anim, na wɔdiiɛ. Ɛnna wɔsɔreeɛ, na wɔsiim kɔɔ anadwo no.
29: Samuel 29
Na Filistifoɔ ahemfo bɛtwaam, ɔha ha, ne apem apem, na Dawid nso ne ne mmarima kaa Akis ho dii akyire bɛtwaam.

Ɛnna Filistifoɔ akunini no bisaa sɛ: “Na Hebrifoɔ yi ɛ?” Na Akis ka kyerɛɛ Filistifoɔ akunini no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ Israel hene Saul akoa Dawid a ɔne me atena ha afe anaa mfeɛ mmienu no nie? Ɛfiri da a ɔdane baa m’afa de bɛsi nnɛ, menhunuu adebɔne biara ne ho.”

Ɛnna Filistifoɔ akunini no bo fuu no, na Filistifoɔ akunini no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ma ɔbarima no nsan nkɔ, ma no nsan nkɔ baabi a wode ama no no; mma no ne yɛn nnkɔ ɛko no na wansɔre antia yɛn ɛko no mu. Ɛdeɛn adeɛ na oyi de bɛpata ne wura? Ɛnyɛ yɛn mmarima no tiri?
Ɛnyɛ oyi ne Dawid a wɔde asa bɔ gyee ne so sɛ, ‘Saul akum n’apem, na Dawid akum ne mpem du no nie anaa?”

Ɛnna Akis frɛɛ Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, wotene, na me deɛ, anka ɛyɛ ma me sɛ wo ne me bɛdi akɔneaba ɔsa mu; ɛfiri da a wobaa ha de bɛsi nnɛ, menhunuu bɔne bi wo ho. Nanso asafohene no na ɛmpɛ woɔ.
Enti, san kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu na wo ho anyɛ Filistifoɔ ahemfo no ahi.”
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa Akis sɛ: “Adɛn, mayɛ dɛn, na ɛdeɛn na woahu no w’akoa ho firi da a mebaa w’anim bɛsi nnɛ a enti merentumi nkɔ ne me wura ɔhene atamfo nkɔko yi?”
Na Akis buaa Dawid sɛ: “Menim sɛ woyɛ wɔ m’ani so sɛ Onyankopɔn bɔfoɔ. Filistifoɔ akunini no na wɔse, ‘Mma no ne yɛn nnkɔ ɛko no.’
Enti sɔre anɔpatutuutu, wo ne wo wura nkoa a wo ne wɔn baeɛ no; sɛ mosɔre ahemadakye na anim tete a, monkɔ.”
Ɛnna Dawid ne ne mmarima no sɔree ntɛm anɔpa sɛ wɔresan akɔ Filistifoɔ asase so, na Filistifoɔ no deɛ, wɔforo kɔɔ Yesreel.
30: Samuel 30
na wɔfaa mmaa ne biribiara a ɛwɔ hɔ nnommum, ɛfiri kumaa so kɔsi kɛseɛ so. Wɔankum obiara, na mmom wɔtwee wɔn sii kwan so kɔeɛ.
Berɛ a Dawid ne ne mmarima no baa kuro no mu no, hwɛ, na wɔde gya ahye, na wɔn yerenom ne wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa nso, wɔafa wɔn nnommum kɔ.
Ɛnna Dawid ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no maa wɔn nne so suiɛ kɔsii sɛ wɔannya ahoɔden ansu bio.
Dawid yerenom mmienu no, Yesreelni Ahinoam ne Abigail, Karmelni Nabal yere no nso, na wɔafa wɔn nnommum kɔ.
Dawid ho hiahiaa no papaapa ɛfiri sɛ nnipa no kaa sɛ wɔbɛsi no aboɔ; wɔn nyinaa bo fuiɛ, wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa no nti. Na Dawid hyɛɛ ne ho den Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn mu.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Ahimelek ba ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, fa asɔfotadeɛ no bra me nkyɛn.” Na Abiatar de asɔfotadeɛ no baa Dawid nkyɛn.
Na Dawid bisaa Awurade sɛ: “Menti afomfoɔ yi anaa? Mɛto wɔn?” Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ti wɔn, na wobɛto wɔn, na gyeɛ nso, wobɛgye.”
Ɛhɔ ara na Dawid sii kwan soɔ, ɔne mmarima ahansia a wɔka ne ho no, na wɔkɔeɛ ara kɔduruu Besor subɔn no ho, na mmarima a wɔantumi antoa soɔ no gyinaeɛ hɔ.
Na Dawid ne mmarima ahanan toaa so tii wɔn, na mmarima ahanu a wɔabrɛ a wɔantumi antwa Besor subɔn no gyinaeɛ hɔ.
Na wɔhunuu Egyptni barima bi wɔ wuram hɔ. Enti wɔfaa no kɔmaa Dawid, na wɔmaa no paanoo diiɛ, na wɔmaa no nsuo nomeeɛ.
Na wɔsan maa no borɔdɔma a wɔabɔ no toa ne bobe taterɛ mmienu. Na ɔdiiɛ, na n'ani so baee no, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnnidii na ɔnnom nsuo nnansa, awia ne anadwo.
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa no sɛ: “Hwan nipa ne wo, na ɛhe na wofire?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Meyɛ akoa a mefiri Egypt, Amalekni bi akoa ne me, nanso me wura agya me ha ɛfiri sɛ nnansa nie na meyareeɛ.
Yɛn na yɛkɔfom Keretifoɔ anafoɔ fam ne Yuda asase ne Kaleb anafoɔ de gya hyee Siklag no.”
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa no sɛ: “Wobɛdi m’anim de me akɔ afomfoɔ no nkyɛn?” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ka me ntam Onyankopɔn din mu sɛ worenku me, na worenyi me nhyɛ me wura nsa, na mɛdi w’anim akɔ afomfoɔ no nkyɛn.”
Ɛnna ɔde no siane kɔeɛ, na asadeɛ pii a nkurɔfoɔ no akɔfa afiri Filistifoɔ asase soɔ ne Yuda asase soɔ no nyinaa nti, na wɔato pono sensam fam hɔ nyinaa redidi nom na wɔregye wɔn ani.
Na Dawid kunkum wɔn firi anɔpahema kɔsii anwummerɛ, na ɔsɛee wɔn; wɔn mu baako mpo anka, gye mmeranteɛ ahanan na wɔtenatenaa yoma so dwaneeɛ.
Na Dawid gyee deɛ Amalekfoɔ no faeɛ nyinaa; Dawid yerenom mmienu no nso, ɔgyee wɔn.
Wɔn nsa kaa wɔn biribiara, ɛfiri kumaa so kɔsi kɛseɛ so, wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa ne asadeɛ no ne nneɛma a wɔfaeɛ no nyinaa. Dawid gyee biribiara.
Enti Dawid faa wɔn nnwan ne wɔn anantwie nyinaa, na wɔde wɔn dii wɔn mmoa no anim baeɛ. Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Dawid asadeɛ nie.”

Na Dawid bɛduruu mmarima ahanu a na wɔabrɛ a wɔantumi ne Dawid ankɔ a wɔmaa wɔtenaa Besor subɔn ho no nkyɛn, na wɔfirii adi sɛ wɔrebɛhyia Dawid ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no. Berɛ a Dawid bɛn wɔn no, ɔbisaa wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔn ho teɛ.

Nanso mmarima a wɔne Dawid kɔeɛ no mu nnipa bɔne ne ahuhufoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Ɛnam sɛ wɔne yɛn ankɔ nti yɛremma wɔn asadeɛ a yɛakɔgyeɛ no bi, gye obiara yere ne ne mma na yɛde wɔn bɛma wɔn ama wɔadi wɔn anim akorɔ.”
Ɛnna Dawid kaa sɛ: “Me nuanom, monnyɛ deɛ Awurade de ama yɛn no saa, ɛfiri sɛ wabɔ yɛn ho ban de afomfoɔ a wɔbaa yɛn soɔ no ahyɛ yɛn nsa.
Hwan na ɔne mo bɛyɛ adwene asɛm yi ho? Sɛdeɛ wɔn a wɔkɔɔ ɔsa no bie kyɛfa teɛ no, saa na wɔn a wɔtenaa nneɛma ho no nso kyɛfa bɛyɛ. Obiara bɛnya bi.”
Ɛfiri saa da no, ɔde yɛɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ wɔ Israel de bɛsi nnɛ.
Berɛ a Dawid bɛduruu Siklag no, ɔde asadeɛ no bi kɔmaa Yuda mpanimfoɔ a wɔyɛ ne nnamfonom no sɛ: “Hwɛ, Awurade atamfo mu asadeɛ a wɔde rebɛkyɛ mo nie.”
Ɔde bi kɔmaa wɔn a wɔwɔ Betel, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Ramot a ɛwɔ anafoɔ fam, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Yatir,
ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Aroer, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Sifmot, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Estemoa,
ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Rakal, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Yerameelfoɔ nkuro mu, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Kenifoɔ nkuro mu,
ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Horma, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Borasan, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Atak,
ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Hebron, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ mmeammea a Dawid ne ne mmarima no kyinkyinii hɔ no nyinaa.
31: Samuel 31
Na Filistifoɔ no tu saa Saul ne ne mma no, na Filistifoɔ no nyaa Saul mma, Yonatan ne Abinadab ne Malki-Sua kumm wɔn.
Na ɛko no mu yɛɛ den maa Saul; ɛduruu baabi no, agyantofoɔ no, mmarima a wɔkura tadua no, nyaa no, na agyantofoɔ no piraa no pira bɔne.

Ɛnna Saul ka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔkura n’akodeɛ no sɛ: “Twe wo nkrantɛ fa wɔ me mu na momonotofoɔ yi ammɛ wɔ me na wɔammɛgoro me atɔprɛ.” Nanso n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no ampɛ sɛ ɔyɛ saa, ɛfiri sɛ na ehu kɛseɛ aka no. Enti Saul faa nkrantɛ no na ɔhwee so.
Berɛ a n’akodeɛkurafoɔ no hunuu sɛ Saul awuo no, ɔno nso hwee ne nkrantɛ so ne no wuiɛ.
Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a Saul ne ne mma mmiɛnsa ne n’akodeɛkurafoɔ ne ne mmarima nyinaa wuwuu saa da no.

Berɛ a Israel mmarima a wɔwɔ asasetamaa no so ne Yordan mpɔtamu hɔ hunuu sɛ Israel asraafoɔ no adwane, na Saul ne ne mma nso awuwuo no, wɔdwane firii wɔn nkuro no mu; ɛnna Filistifoɔ no ba bɛtenatenaa hɔ.
Ɛbaa sɛ, adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Filistifoɔ no baa sɛ wɔrebɛyiyi awufoɔ no ho nneɛma, na wɔkɔpuee Saul ne ne mma mmiɛnsa no so sɛ wɔawuwu gu Bepɔ Gilboa so.
Ɛnna wɔtwaa ne ti, faa n’akodeɛ, na wɔkɔɔ Filistifoɔ asase so baabiara kɔbɔɔ wɔn abosomfie ne ɔmanfoɔ no amanneɛ.
Afei wɔde n’akodeɛ no kɔguu Astarot ahoni fie, na wɔde n’amu no kɔsɛnee Bet-San ɔfasuo ho.
Na nnipa a wɔwɔ Yebes-Gilead no tee deɛ Filistifoɔ de ayɛ Saul.
Ntɛm ara na mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ no nyinaa sɔre nantee anadwo no nyinaa kɔɔ hɔ, na wɔkɔyii Saul amu ne ne mma no nso amu firii Bet-San fasuo no ho, na wɔbaa Yebes bɛhyee no hɔ.
Na wɔfaa wɔn nnompe kɔsiee no tamarisk dua a ɛwɔ Yebes no ase, na wɔdii mmuada nnanson.

1: Paulo ne Silwano ne Timoteo de kɔma Tesalonikafoɔ asafo a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo mu: Tesalonikafoɔ abrabɔ ne wɔn gyidie
Da biara, yɛda Onyankopɔn ase ma mo nyinaa, na yɛbɔ mo din wɔ yɛn mpaebɔ mu,
na daa yɛkae mo gyidie adwuma, ne adwumaden a mofiri ɔdɔ mu yɛ ne yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ho anidasoɔ mu boasetɔ, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agya no anim,
anuanom a Onyankopɔn dɔ mo, yɛnim sɛ wayi mo,
ɛfiri sɛ yɛn asɛmpa no amma mo nkyɛn sɛ kasa ara kwa, na mmom ɛbaa ahoɔden ne Honhom Kronkron ne awerɛhyem a emu yɛ den mu nso, sɛdeɛ monim sɛ mo nti yɛbɔɔ yɛn bra faeɛ wɔ mo mu no.
Na mosuasuaa yɛne Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ mode Honhom Kronkron mu anigyeɛ gyee asɛm no ahohia pii mu,
na ama moayɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama agyidifoɔ a wɔwɔ Makedonia ne Akaia no nyinaa.
Ɛfiri sɛ, ɛfiri mo mu na Awurade asɛm no hyetaeɛ (ɛbɔ peteeɛ), ɛnyɛ Makedonia ne Akaia nko, na mmom mo gyeɛ a mogye Onyankopɔn die no atrɛ aduru mmaa nyinaa, ma enti ɛnhia sɛ yɛka ho asɛm biara.
Na wɔn ara wɔka ɛkwan a yɛfaa so baa mo nkyɛn no ho asɛm, ne sɛdeɛ modane firii mo ahoni ho baa Onyankopɔn nkyɛn sɛ morebɛsom Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ ne ɔnokwafoɔ no;
sɛ morebɛtwɛn ne Ba a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no afiri soro, Yesu a wɔgye yɛn firi abufuo a ɛreba no mu.
2: Tesalonikafoɔ 2
Na ɛwom sɛ yɛadi kan ahunu amane, na wɔabɔ yɛn adapaa wɔ Filipi sɛdeɛ monim no deɛ, nanso yɛyɛɛ nnam wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn mu, sɛ yɛbɛka Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ mo, ɔko bebree mu.
Na yɛn afotusɛm no mfiri nnaadaa anaa adwemmɔne mu, na ɛnnam nsisie mu,
na mmom sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn akari yɛn ahunu sɛ yɛfata sɛ ɔde asɛmpa no hyɛ yɛn nsa no, saa ara na yɛkasa, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom wɔn a wɔsɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔkari yɛn akoma hwɛ no ani.
Na sɛdeɛ monim no, Onyankopɔn ne yɛn danseni, yɛnkaa adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm da, nso yɛmfaa asɛm biara nyɛɛ anibereɛ nkatasoɔ,
saa ara nso na yɛanhwehwɛ nnipa anim animuonyam amfiri mo anaa afoforɔ nkyɛn, ɛwom sɛ anka yɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ yɛyɛ yɛn ho akɛseɛ sɛ Kristo asomafoɔ.
Nanso yɛyɛɛ mo brɛbrɛ sɛdeɛ ɔbaatan ma n’ani ku ɔno ara ne mma ho no.
Na ɛsiane sɛ yɛpɛ mo asɛm yie nti, yɛpɛɛ sɛ anka ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn asɛmpa no nko na yɛne mo bɛkyɛ, na mmom yɛn ara yɛn kra nso bi, ɛfiri sɛ moayɛ yɛn adɔfo.
Na anuanom, mokae yɛn adwumaden ne yɛn brɛ. Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na yɛremfa adesoa biara nto mo so nti, yɛyɛɛ adwuma anadwo ne awia na yɛatumi aka Onyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ mo.
Mo ne Onyankopɔn ne adansefoɔ sɛdeɛ yɛyɛɛ yɛn ho kronkron ne tenenee ne nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm maa mo agyidifoɔ.
Na sɛdeɛ monim no, yɛtuu mo nyinaa fo mmaako mmaako, sɛdeɛ agya bi yɛ ne mma, na yɛhyɛɛ mo den, na yɛdii mo adanseɛ,
sɛ monnante sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ Onyankopɔn a wafrɛ mo akɔ n’ahennie ne n’animuonyam mu no. Tesalonikafoɔ boasetɔ wɔ ɔtaa mu

Yei nti nso na yɛda Onyankopɔn ase daa, ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a mogyee Onyankopɔn asɛm a mote firii yɛn hɔ no, moannye no sɛ nnipa asɛm, na mmom sɛ Onyankopɔn asɛm, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ ampa, ɛno nso na ɛyɛ mo a mogye die no mu adwuma.
Na mo anuanom, mosuasuaa Onyankopɔn asafo ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Yudea no wɔ Kristo Yesu mu, ɛfiri sɛ mo nso mohunuu amane wɔ mo ara mo manfoɔ nsam, sɛdeɛ wɔn nso wɔhunuu amane wɔ Yudafoɔ nsam no;
wɔn na wɔkum Awurade Yesu mpo ne adiyifoɔ no, na wɔtaa yɛn. Nso wɔnsɔ Nyankopɔn ani, na wɔne nnipa nyinaa di asie.
Wɔbara yɛn sɛ yɛnnkasa nnkyerɛ amanaman no, na wɔannye wɔn nkwa, wɔde hyɛ wɔn bɔne ma daa, nso abufuo no anya aba wɔn so awie.
Anuanom, yɛn fam deɛ, berɛ tiaa bi a wɔmaa yɛne mo dii ntetemu honam mu na ɛnyɛ akoma mu no, yɛbɔɔ yɛn ho mmɔden biara sɛ yɛbɛhunu mo anim, anigyina pii mu.
Ne saa nti yɛpɛɛ sɛ yɛba mo nkyɛn; me Paulo, titire, prɛko ne mprenu so, nanso Satan sii yɛn kwan.
Na ɛdeɛn ne yɛn anidasoɔ anaa yɛn anigyeɛ anaa yɛn ahurisidie abotire—ɛnyɛ mo anaa—wɔ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo anim wɔ ne mmaeɛ mu?
Na mone yɛn animuonyam ne yɛn anigyeɛ.
3: Tesalonikafoɔ 3
na yɛsomaa Timoteo a ɔyɛ yɛn nua ne Onyankopɔn somfoɔ ne yɛn yɔnko dwumayɛni wɔ Kristo asɛmpa mu no, sɛ ɔmmɛhyɛ mo den na ɔntu mo fo mo gyidie ho.
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ahohia yi mma obi nhinhim. Ɛfiri sɛ mo ara monim sɛ yei ara na ɛtwa sɛ yɛfa mu.
Na yɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no nso, yɛka kyerɛɛ mo ansa sɛ yɛbɛhunu amane, sɛdeɛ ɛbaeɛ na monim no.
Yei nti me nso, mesɔ mu a na ɛnsɔ bio no, mesomae, na mahunu mo gyidie mu, na amma sɛ ebia ɔsɔhwɛfoɔ no asɔ mo ahwɛ, ama yɛn mmɔdemmɔ adwuma no ayɛ ɔkwa.
Nanso afei ara na Timoteo afiri mo hɔ aba yɛn nkyɛn abɛka mo gyidie ne mo dɔ ho asɛmpa ne sɛdeɛ mokɔ so kae yɛn yie berɛ nyinaa, na mo ani agyina pɛ sɛ mohu yɛn sɛdeɛ yɛn nso yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhu mo no.
Yei nti, anuanom, mo gyidie ama yɛn werɛ akyekyerɛ wɔ mo ho, yɛn amanehunu ne ahohia nyinaa mu,
ɛfiri sɛ sɛ mogyina pintinn Awurade mu a, yɛnya ahoɔden tena ase.
Na aseda bɛn na yɛbɛtumi ada Onyankopɔn ase wɔ mo ho, anigyeɛ nyinaa a mo nti yɛn ani agye yɛn Nyankopɔn anim no ho?
Awia ne anadwo yɛsrɛ pii sɛ yɛbɛhunu mo anim, na yɛama mo gyidie awie mayɛ. Ɔsomafoɔ no srɛɛ adeɛ maa n’akenkanfoɔ no
Afei, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Agya no ara, ne yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nnyegye yɛn taataa mmra mo nkyɛn.
Bio nso, Awurade mma monnɔɔso na mommoro so ɔdɔ a mode dodɔ mo ho mo ho ne nnipa nyinaa no mu, sɛdeɛ yɛn nso yɛdɔ mo no,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ mo akoma den a mo ho nni asɛm, kronkronyɛ mu, yɛn Nyankopɔn ne Agya anim, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo mmaeɛ a n’ahotefoɔ nyinaa ka ne ho no.
4: Tesalonikafoɔ 4
Na monim ahyɛdeɛ a yɛnam Awurade Yesu so de maa mo no.
Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mo ho bɛteɛ, sɛ mobɛtwe mo ho afiri adwamammɔ ho;
sɛ mo mu biara bɛhunu sɛdeɛ ɔbɛhyɛ ɔno ara ne nipadua so wɔ ahoteɛ ne anidie mu,
ɛnyɛ akɔnnɔ anibereɛ mu sɛ amanaman mufoɔ a wɔnnim Onyankopɔn no,
sɛ obiara nntra nnkɔsisi ne nua asɛm bi mu, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ne yeinom nyinaa mu weretɔfoɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛka kyerɛɛ mo kane, na yɛdii mo adanseɛ no.
Ɛnyɛ efideɛ nti na Onyankopɔn frɛɛ yɛn, na mmom ahoteɛ mu ntira.
Enti deɛ ɔte atua no nte onipa bi so atua, na mmom Onyankopɔn a ɔde ne Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ mo mu no. Onuadɔ ne adwuma mu nokorɛdie
Na ɛdefa onuadɔ ho deɛ, ɛnhia sɛ metwerɛ ho asɛm brɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn akyerɛkyerɛ mo sɛ monnodɔ mo ho;
na ampa, moda no adi kyerɛ anuanom nyinaa wɔ Makedonia baabiara. Nanso, anuanom, yɛtu mo fo sɛ, monkɔ so nyɛ mmoro so,
na momfa nyɛ mo botaeɛ sɛ mobɛtena hɔ komm adi mo ara mo fie asɛm, na mode mo nsa ayɛ adwuma, sɛdeɛ yɛhyɛɛ mo no;
na moanante sɛdeɛ ɛfata, wɔn a wɔwɔ akyire no anim, na biribiara anhia mo.
Afei nso anuanom, yɛmpɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔadeda owuo mu no ho asɛm bɛhunta mo, na mo werɛ anho sɛ wɔn a aka a wɔnni anidasoɔ no.
Na sɛ yɛwɔ gyidie sɛ Yesu wuiɛ na wasɔre bio a, saa ara nso na Onyankopɔn nam Yesu so de wɔn a wɔawuwuo no bɛka ne ho aba.
Na yei na yɛnam Awurade asɛm so ka kyerɛ mo, sɛ yɛn, ateasefoɔ a yɛbɛtena ase akɔsi Awurade mmaeɛ mu no, renni wɔn a wɔawuwuo no anim kan;
ɛfiri sɛ Awurade no ara de nteamu a emu yɛ den, ɔbɔfo panin nne ne Onyankopɔn totorobɛnto bɛsiane afiri soro, na wɔn a wɔawuwu Kristo mu no bɛdi kan asɔre.
Ɛno akyi no, wɔbɛfa yɛn, ateasefoɔ a yɛaka no, ne wɔn nyinaa mununkum mu akɔhyia Awurade wɔ ewiem; na saa na yɛne Awurade bɛtena daa.
Ne saa nti momfa nsɛm yi nkyekyere mo ho mo ho werɛ.
5: Tesalonikafoɔ 5
Na mo ara monim yie sɛ Awurade da no bɛba sɛdeɛ owifoɔ ba anadwo no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na berɛ a wɔbɛka sɛ: Yɛwɔ asomdwoeɛ ne ahotɔ no! mpofirem ara na ɔsɛeɛ bɛba wɔn so sɛdeɛ awoko yea ba ɔbaa a ɔnyem soɔ; na wɔrentumi nnwane ɛkwan biara so.
Nanso, mo anuanom, monni esum mu, na ɛda no abɛto mo sɛ owifoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ mo nyinaa yɛ hann mma ne adekyeeɛ mma. Yɛnyɛ anadwo anaa esum dea.
Ne saa nti, mommma yɛnnna sɛ wɔn a aka no, na mmom momma yɛnwɛn na yɛn ani nna hɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔda no da anadwo, na wɔn a wɔboro nsa no boro anadwo.
Na yɛn a yɛyɛ adekyeeɛ dea no, yɛmma yɛn ani nna hɔ, na yɛnhyɛ gyidie ne ɔdɔ nkataboɔ ne nkwagyeɛ anidasoɔ sɛ dadeɛ kyɛ;
ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn anyi yɛn amma abufuo, na mmom ɔyii yɛn sɛ yɛmfa Awurade Yesu Kristo so nnya nkwagyeɛ.
Ɔno na ɔwu maa yɛn sɛ yɛnyane oo, yɛda oo, yɛne no ntena nkwa mu.
Enti montutu mo ho fo na obiara mpia ne yɔnko, sɛdeɛ moreyɛ no ara.
Afei anuanom, yɛsrɛ mo sɛ momfa obuo mma wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden wɔ mo mu na wɔdi mo so mpanin Awurade mu na wɔtu mo foɔ no;
na momfa anidie soronko mma wɔn ɔdɔ mu ɛsiane adwuma a wɔreyɛ no nti. Mo ne mo ho mo ho ntena asomdwoeɛ mu.
Berɛ korɔ no ara mu no, anuanom, yɛtu mo fo sɛ monkasa nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔnenam basabasa, monkyekyere wɔn a wɔabotoɔ werɛ, monsɔ wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ mu, montɔ mo bo ase mma nnipa nyinaa.
Monhwɛ na obi amfa bɔne antua obi bɔne so ka, na mmom berɛ nyinaa monhwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ mma mo ho mo ho ne afoforɔ nyinaa.
Mo ani nnye berɛ nyinaa.
Monnnyae mpaebɔ da.
Ade nyinaa mu momfa aseda mma. Yei na Onyankopɔn pɛ wɔ mo fam Kristo Yesu mu.
Monnnum Honhom no.
Mommmu nkɔmhyɛsɛm animtia.
Monsɔ adeɛ nyinaa nhwɛ; na monsɔ deɛ ɛyɛ no mu den.
Montwe mo ho mfiri bɔne su nyinaa ho.
Afei asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn no ara nte mo ho koraa. Na wɔnkora mo honhom ne mo kra ne mo nipadua so mma no nni mu akwan nyinaa so mu a ɛho remma asɛm biara yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo mmaeɛ mu.
Ɔnokwafoɔ ne deɛ ɔfrɛ mo no, ɔno nso na ɔbɛyɛ.
Anuanom, mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn.
Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea anuanom nyinaa.
Mehyɛ mo Awurade mu sɛ monkenkan krataa yi nkyerɛ anuanom nyinaa.
Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo. Amen.

1: Paulo, Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn ne Kristo Yesu a ɔno ne yɛn anidasoɔ no hyɛeɛ no,
de kɔma Timoteo a ɔyɛ ɔba pa wɔ gyidie mu: Adom, mmɔborɔhunu, ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu nka wo. Timoteo adwuma titire wɔ Efeso
Sɛdeɛ berɛ a merekɔ Makedonia no mesrɛɛ wo sɛ tena Efeso no, saa ara na seesei nso meresrɛ woɔ na woatu ebinom fo sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ biara,
anaa wɔtie anansesɛm ne anatoɔ "abusua santen" ho nsɛm a ɛnkɔsi hwee, a ɛho wɔ nsɛmmisa mmom sene Nyankopɔn fiehwɛ a ɛwɔ gyidie mu no.
Na afotusɛm no botaeɛ ne ɔdɔ a ɛfiri akoma kronn ne ahonim pa ne gyidie a nkontompo nni mu mu.
Ɛno na ebinom amane afiri yeinom ho kɔ nsɛnhuhuo mu,
na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ mmarakyerɛfoɔ, nanso wɔnte nsɛm a wɔka no ne deɛ wɔgye gyina mu dendeenden no ase.
Na yɛnim sɛ Mmara no yɛ, sɛ obi di so sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ ne kwan so a,

na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhunu nokwasɛm yi sɛ, ɛnyɛ ateneneefoɔ nti na wɔhyɛɛ mmara, na mmom mmaratofoɔ ne asobrakyefoɔ, amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔnsuro Onyankopɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, wɔn a wɔn ho nteɛ na wɔn ho agu fi, wɔn a wɔkum wɔn agyanom ne wɔn nanom, awudifoɔ,
adwamammɔfoɔ, mmarima a wɔne mmarima da, wɔn a wɔkyere nkurɔfoɔ sie, atorofoɔ, wɔn a wɔka ntanhunu, ne biribi foforɔ biara a ɛne nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no di asie,
sɛdeɛ nhyira Nyankopɔn no animuonyam asɛmpa a wɔde ahyɛ me nsa no teɛ no.
Na meda yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu a ɔhyɛɛ me den no ase, ɛfiri sɛ wabu me ɔnokwafoɔ de me ahyɛ ɔsom adwuma no mu,
ɛwom, berɛ bi a atwam no na meyɛ mmusubɔfoɔ, metaa nkurɔfoɔ, na meyɛɛ aniammɔnho. Nanso wɔhuu me mmɔbɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na mennim deɛ mereyɛ, na gyidie a na mennie nti na meyɛɛ saa.
Na yɛn Awurade adom dɔɔso boroo so, gyidie ne ɔdɔ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu mu.
Nokwasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye tom koraa ne sɛ Kristo Yesu baa wiase bɛgyee nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nkwa. Me na medi kan wɔ wɔn a wɔte saa no mu.
Nanso, wɔhuu me mmɔbɔ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Kristo Yesu bɛfa me a medi kan no so ayi n’abodwokyɛreɛ nyinaa adie, de ayɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama wɔn a wɔbɛgye no adie akɔ daa nkwa mu.
Afei mmerɛ santen hene, Onyankopɔn koro a ɔmporɔ, na wɔnhu no no, anidie ne animuonyam nka no, mmerɛ santen mfesanten. Amen.
Me ba Timoteo, ahyɛdeɛ yi na mede hyɛ wo nsa, sɛdeɛ nkɔmhyɛ a wɔkaa no wo ho kane no teɛ no, na woafa yeinom so ako ɛko pa no,
na nya gyidie ne ahonim pa a ebinom apia ato nkyɛn ama wɔn gyidie agu asuo mu no.
Wɔn mu binom ne Himeneo ne Aleksandro, a mede wɔn ama Satan sɛ wɔntwe wɔn aso na ama wɔasua sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔka abususɛm.
2: Timoteo 2
mma ahemfo ne wɔn a wɔdi tumi nyinaa, na yɛatena ase komm, na yɛn ho adwo yɛn, onyamesom pa ne abrabɔ a ɛho yɛ nyam nyinaa mu.
Na yei yɛ, na ɛsɔ yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn ani;
ɔno na ɔpɛ sɛ wɔgye nnipa nyinaa nkwa na wɔba nokorɛ nimdeɛ mu.
Na Onyankopɔn koro na ɔwɔ hɔ, ne Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ntamgyinafoɔ koro, ɔno ne Onipa Kristo Yesu,
a ɔde ne ho maa sɛ agyedeɛ maa nnipa nyinaa sɛ ɛnyɛ adanseɛ ɛberɛ a wɔahyɛ mu.
Ɛno na wɔabɔ din ahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafoɔ ne ɔsomafoɔ, meka nokorɛ, menni atorɔ, amanaman mufoɔ kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ gyidie ne nokorɛ mu.
Enti mepɛ sɛ mmarima bɔ mpaeɛ wɔ mmaa nyinaa, ma nsa a ɛho teɛ so, a abufuo ne akyinnyeɛ nni mu.
Saa ara nso na mmaa nhyɛ ntadeɛ a ɛsɛ, mfa ani a ɛwu adeɛ ne adwenemuteɛ nkeka wɔn ho, ɛnyɛ mmɛsawɔ anaa sika kɔkɔɔ anaa nhwene pa anaa ntadeɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den kɛse mu,
na mmom deɛ ɛfata mmaa a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔsom Onyankopɔn, wɔ nnwuma pa mu.
Ɔbaa nyɛ komm mfiri ahobrɛaseɛ nyinaa mu nsua adeɛ.
Memma ɔbaa kwan sɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ anaasɛ ɔnni ɔbarima so tumi, na mmom sɛ ɔnyɛ komm.
Ɛfiri sɛ Adam na wɔdii kan bɔɔ no ansa na wɔrebɔ Hawa.
Afei nso ɛnyɛ Adam na wɔdaadaa no, na mmom ɔbaa no na wɔdaadaa no maa no too mmara.
Nanso sɛ ɔkɔ so tena gyidie ne ɔdɔ ne ahoteɛ ne adwenemteɛ mu a, ɔnam abawoɔ so bɛnya nkwa.
3: Timoteo 3 Sɛ obi pɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ adwuma a, na wapɛ adwuma pa.
Enti ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ yɛ obi a asɛm nni ne ho, ɔyɛ okunu a ne yere yɛ baako, n’ani so da hɔ, n’adwenem mu teɛ, ɔyɛ ne ho wesee, ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔtumi kyerɛkyerɛ,
ɔnyɛ ɔsadweam (kɔwensani), ɔnyɛ pupopupo, na mmom ɔdwoɔ, ɔmpɛ ntɔkwa, ɔnyɛ sikanibereɛ,
ɔdi ɔno ara ne fie so yie, ne mma brɛ wɔn ho ase ma no anidie nyinaa mu;
na sɛ obi nnim sɛdeɛ ɔbɛdi ɔno ara ne fie so a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwɛ Onyankopɔn asafo so?
Ɔnyɛ abɛɛfo, na wanhoran anhwe ase sɛdeɛ ɔbonsam hwee aseɛ atemmuo mu no.
Bio nso, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔnni asafo no mu di ne ho adanse pa, na wanhwe ahohora ne ɔbonsam fidie mu. Esu a ɛfata asomfoɔ ne wɔn yerenom
Saa ara na asafo mu asomfoɔ nso anim nyɛ duro, wɔnnyɛ ano nta, wɔnyɛ asadweam, wɔnnyɛ adufudepɛfoɔ,
na wɔmfa gyidie ahuntasɛm no nsie ahonim a emu teɛ mu.
Afei nso, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsɔ yeinom hwɛ sɛ wɔfata ansa, na sɛ asɛm biara nni wɔn ho a, wɔama wɔasom.
Saa ara na wɔn yerenom nso anim nyɛ duru; wɔnnyɛ nsekubɔfoɔ, wɔn ani so nna hɔ, na wɔnni ade nyinaa mu nokorɛ.
Na asafo mu asomfoɔ nyɛ okunu a ne yere yɛ baako, a ɔdi ne mma ne ɔno ara ne fie so sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ.
Na wɔn a wɔsom yie no nya nnyinasoɔ pa ne nnam bebree, gyidie a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu mu.
M’ani da so sɛ mɛba wo nkyɛn nnansa yi ara deɛ, nanso meretwerɛ yeinom abrɛ wo ansa,
na sɛ ɛba sɛ mekyɛ a, woahunu kwan a ɛsɛ sɛ wofa so bɔ wo bra Onyankopɔn fie a ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no asafo, nokorɛ dum ne ne nnyinasoɔ no mu.

Na adeɛ a wɔpae mu ka sɛ ɛso ne onyamesom pa ahuntasɛm no: ‘Onyankopɔn yii ne ho adi honam mu, wɔbuu no bem honhom mu, ɔyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ, wɔkaa ne ho asɛm amanaman mu, wɔgyee no dii wɔ wiase, wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro animuonyam mu.’
4: Timoteo 4
atorofoɔ nkontompo nti. Wɔn na nhyehyeɛ ano atwa wɔ wɔn ara wɔn ahonim mu.
Wɔsi awareɛ ho kwan ka sɛ, wɔntua wɔn ho nnuane a Onyankopɔn bɔɔ sɛ agyidifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔahunu nokorɛ mfa aseda nni bie no.
Na Onyankopɔn abɔdeɛ nyinaa yɛ, na sɛ obi de aseda gye a, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔpo biribiara;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔde Onyankopɔn asɛm ne mpaebɔ na ɛte ho.
Sɛ wode yeinom kyerɛ anuanom a, wobɛyɛ Kristo Yesu somfo pa a wɔde gyidie ne nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a wodii akyire no nsɛm ayɛne no.
Na mmerewa anansesɛm ahuhuo no deɛ, gu, na bɔ onyamesom pa ho mmɔden.
Na honam mu mmɔdemmɔ ho mfasoɔ sua, na onyamesom pa ho wɔ mfasoɔ, ade nyinaa mu, na ɛwɔ nkwa a ɛwɔ hɔ yi ne deɛ ɛrebɛba no ho bɔhyɛ.
Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye tom koraa.
Yei nti na yɛyɛ adwumaden na yɛyere yɛn ho, ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ani ato Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no so; ɔno na ɔyɛ nnipa nyinaa Agyenkwa, ne titire no agyidifoɔ.
Yeinom na tu ho fo na kyerɛkyerɛ!
Mma obiara mmmu aberanteɛ a woyɛ no abomfiaa. Mmom no, yɛ nhwɛsoɔ ma agyidifoɔ wɔ kasa, abrabɔ, ɔdɔ, gyidie, ne ahoteɛ mu.
Ma w’ani nku badwam akenkan, afotuo, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho kɔsi sɛ mɛba.
Mmu w’ani ngu adom akyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ wo mu no so, deɛ wɔnam nkɔmhyɛ ne mpanimfoɔ nsa a wɔde guu wo soɔ no so de maa woɔ no.
Dwendwene yeinom ho; fa w’akoma nyinaa si so, na ama wo nkɔsoɔ ada adi nnipa nyinaa anim.
Ma w’ani mmra wo ho ne wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so berɛ nyinaa, na tena mu, na sɛ woyɛ saa a, wobɛgye wo ho ne wɔn a wɔtie woɔ no nkwa.
5: Timoteo 5
mmaa mpanimfoɔ sɛ ɛnanom, mmabaa sɛ nua mmaanom, wɔ ahoteɛ nyinaa mu.
Di mmaa akunafoɔ a wɔyɛ akunafoɔ ampa no ni.
Na sɛ okunafoɔ bi wɔ mma anaa mmanana a, ma wɔnsua sɛ wɔbɛdi kan ada onyamesom pa adi wɔ wɔn ara afie na wɔntua wɔn awofoɔ ka sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ, ɛfiri sɛ yei na ɛsɔ Onyankopɔn ani.
Na deɛ ɔyɛ okunafoɔ ampa, na aka ne nko no, ɔde n’ani to Nyankopɔn so, na ɔkura nkotosrɛ ne mpaebɔ mu anadwo ne awia.
Na deɛ ɔbɔ ahohwie no deɛ, ɔyɛ teaseawuo.
Enti yeinom ho na hyɛ wɔn, na wɔannya wɔn ho asɛm bi anka.
Na sɛ obi nhwɛ ɔno ara ne nnipa, ne ne titire no, ne fiefoɔ a, wapa gyidie no, na ɔyɛ onipa bɔne sene deɛ ɔnnye nnie mpo.
Ansa na wɔde okunafoɔ bi din bɛka ho no, na wadi mfeɛ aduosia, na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ okunu baako yere,
deɛ wɔdi ne ho adanseɛ sɛ ɔyɛɛ nnwuma pa, ɔtetee mma, ɔgyee ahɔhoɔ, ɔhohoroo ahotefoɔ nan ho, ɔboaa wɔn a wɔwɔ ahohia mu, ɔde nsiyɛ dii adwuma pa biara akyi.
Nanso mfa akunafoɔ a wɔnnyiniiɛ nka ho, ɛfiri sɛ sɛ ɛba sɛ Kristo ho fono wɔn a, na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔwareɛ,
na wɔnya atemmuo ɛfiri sɛ wɔapa wɔn kane gyidie no.
Berɛ korɔ no ara nso wɔsua aniha, nenam afie afie mu kwa; na ɛnyɛ aniha nko na wɔyɛ, na mmom wɔdi nsekuro de wɔn ho gyegye nkurɔfoɔ nsɛm mu nso, na wɔkeka nsɛm a ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔka.
Enti mepɛ sɛ akunafoɔ a wɔnnyiniiɛ no wareɛ, na wɔwo mma hwɛ fie soɔ, na wɔamma ɔtamfo annya hokwan ansopa (ɔnni atɛm).
Ɛfiri sɛ, ebinom amane akɔdi Satan akyi dada.
Sɛ ɔbaa gyidini bi wɔ akunafoɔ a, ɔnhwɛ wɔn, na ɔmmma no nnyɛ asafo no adesoa, na wɔahwɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ akunafoɔ ampa no.
Mpanimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ asafo no so yie no, wɔmfa anidie mmɔho nni wɔn, ne titire no, wɔn a wɔyɛ asɛnka ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho adwuma.
Na twerɛsɛm no ka sɛ: “Nkyekyere nantwie ano berɛ a ɔreporo ayuo”; afei: “Odwumayɛni akatua sɛ no.”
Ntie asafo mu panin ho kwaadubɔ, gye sɛ ɛgyina adansefoɔ mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa anom asɛm so.
Wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no, yi wɔn atɛn wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa anim, na ama wɔn a aka no nso asuro.
Mehyɛ wo Onyankopɔn ne Kristo Yesu ne abɔfoɔ a wɔayi wɔn no anim sɛ di yeinom ho dwuma a womfa ahoperɛ mmu atɛn, na womfa nyiyimu nyɛ biribiara.
Mfa wo nsa ngu obi so ntɛm, nanso mfa wo ho mfra ebinom bɔne mu. Sie wo ho kronn.
Nnom nsuo nko bio, na mmom wo yafunu ne yareɛ a wotaa yareɛ nti, nom bobesa kakra.
Nnipa binom bɔne da adi pefee de kɔ atemmuo mu, na ebinom deɛ nso di wɔn akyi.
Saa ara na nnwuma pa nso da adi pefee, na deɛ ɛnna adie mpo no, ɛso ntumi nkata.
6: Timoteo 6

Bio nso, mma wɔn a wɔwɔ awuranom agyidifoɔ no mmmu wɔn animtia ɛsiane sɛ wɔyɛ anuanom nti. Na mmom, wɔnyi wɔn yam nsom wɔn yie, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔnya wɔn adwuma pa so mfasoɔ no yɛ agyidifoɔ ne adɔfo. Yeinom na kyerɛkyerɛ, na tu ho foɔ.
Sɛ obi kyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ na wannye yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nsɛm a ɛyɛ papa no ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfata onyamesom pa antom a,
ɛnneɛ na ɔyɛ ahomasoɔ, na ɔnnim hwee, na mmom ɔyare akyinnyegyeɛ ne nokotwire a deɛ ɛfiri mu ba ne nitan, kunsunkunsum, nsekuro, nnipa ho adwemmɔne,
mansotwe a ɛsɛ nnipa a wɔn adwene mu asɛeɛ, na nokorɛ abɔ wɔn a wɔsusu sɛ onyamesom pa yɛ adeɛ a wɔde pɛ mfasoɔ.
Na onyamesom pa a abodwoɔ wɔ mu yɛ adenya kɛse.
Ɛfiri sɛ yɛamfa hwee amma wiase, na yɛrentumi nso mfa hwee mfiri mu nkɔ.
Enti sɛ yɛwɔ yɛn ano aduane ne deɛ yɛde bɛkata yɛn ho a, momma ɛno ara nnɔɔso mma yɛn.
Nanso wɔn a wɔrepɛ wɔn ho anya no hwe sɔhwɛ ne afidie ne nkwasea akɔnnɔ a ɛnyɛ mma nnipa na ɛtwe wɔn kɔgu ɔsɛeɛ ne ɔyera mu mu.
Na bɔne nyinaa nhini ne sikapɛ a ebinom dii akyire yeraa kwan na wɔde yea pii wowɔɔ wɔn ho.
Nanso wo, O, Onyankopɔn nipa deɛ, dwane firi yeinom ho. Mmom no, di adetenenee, onyamesom pa, gyidie, ɔdɔ, boasetɔ, ne ɔdwoɔ akyi.
Ko gyidie ko pa no, sɔ daa nkwa a wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ woɔ na wopaee mu kaa no yie adansefoɔ pii anim no mu.
Megyina Onyankopɔn a ɔma nneɛma nyinaa nkwa no ne Kristo Yesu, ɔdanseni a ɔgyinaa Pontio Pilato anim paee mu kaa no yie, no anim hyɛ wo
sɛ di ahyɛdeɛ no so a womma nkekaeɛ anaa asɛm biara mma ho kɔsi yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ahoyie mu.
Ɛno na ɔbɛda no adi wɔ ɛberɛ a wɔahyɛ mu, deɛ ɔhyira no daa ne Otumfoɔ koro pɛ no, ahene mu Hene ne awuranom mu Awurade no,
deɛ ɔno nko wɔ daa nkwa a owuo nni mu, na ɔte hann a wɔntumi mmɛn ho mu, deɛ onipa mu biara nhunuu no da na obiara ntumi nhu no no. Ɔno na anidie ne daa tumi wɔ no. Amen.

Adefoɔ a wɔwɔ wiase, kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnnwene akokurokosɛm, anaasɛ wɔmmfa wɔn ani nnto ahonyadeɛ a ɛnni hɔ daa so, na mmom wɔmfa wɔn ani nto Onyankopɔn a ɔma yɛn nneɛma nyinaa ma no dɔɔso sɛ yɛnnie no so,
sɛ wɔnyɛ papa, nnya wɔn ho nnwuma pa fam, wɔmmue wɔn nsam, na wɔnkyɛ adeɛ,
na wɔnto fapem pa nsie yie mma daakye, na ama wɔatumi asɔ nokorɛ nkwa no mu.
O Timoteo, hwɛ deɛ wɔde ahyɛ wo nsa no so, na dane wo ho firi nsɛnhuhuo a ɛho nteɛ ne “nimdeɛ” a wɔboa frɛ no saa no akyinnyesɛm no ho.
Ɛno na ebinom de tuu wɔn ho a ama wɔamane afiri gyidie no ho.

1: Na Dawid ba Solomon yɛɛ den n’ahennie mu, na Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn dii n’akyi na ɔmaa no yɛɛ kɛseɛ paa.
Na Solomon kasa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa, apem apem ne ɔha ha so mpanimfoɔ, ne atemmufoɔ ne Israel mpanimfoɔ a wɔyɛ agyanom abusuafie mpanimfoɔ nyinaa.
Ɛnna Solomon ne asafo a wɔka ne ho nyinaa kɔɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ Gibeon no; ɛhɔ na na Nyankopɔn ahyiaeɛ ntomadan a Awurade akoa Mose yɛɛ no serɛ soɔ no wɔ.
Nanso Nyankopɔn adaka no deɛ, na Dawid akɔfa afiri Kiriat-Yearim aba baabi a Dawid siesie maa no no, ɛfiri sɛ na wasi ntomadan ama no Yerusalem.
Na kɔbere afɔrebukyia a Hur ba Uri ba Besalel yɛeɛ no si Awurade tenabea no anim, na ɛhɔ na Solomon ne asafo no hwehwɛɛ Onyankopɔn akyiri kwan daa.
Ɛnna Solomon bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ maa Awurade, kɔbere afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim no soɔ, na ɔde mmoa apem bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ so.
Saa anadwo no, Onyankopɔn yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Solomon na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Bisa me deɛ wopɛ! Ɛdeɛn na menyɛ mma woɔ?”
Ɛnna Solomon ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: “Wo na woyɛɛ me papa Dawid adɔeɛ kɛseɛ na woayɛ me ɔhene asi n’ananmu.
O Awurade Nyankopɔn, ma bɔ a wohyɛɛ me papa Dawid no mmra mu; wo na woasi me hene nnipa dodoɔ yi soɔ, nnipa a wɔn dodoɔ te sɛ asase so anwea yi.
Ma me nyansa ne nimdeɛ a mede bɛdi ɔman yi anim akɔ na m'aba, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ wo a, anka hwan na ɔbɛtumi abu wo man kɛseɛ yi atɛn?”

Ɛnna Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Solomon sɛ: “Ɛsiane sɛ yei na ɛwɔ w’akoma mu na woammisa ahonyadeɛ anaa sika ne animuonyam anaa w’atamfo kra anaa nna dodoɔ, na mmom woabisa nyansa ne nimdeɛ sɛ wode bɛbu me man a mede wo asi wɔn so hene no atɛn nti,
nyansa ne nimdeɛ no, mede rema wo, na ahonyadeɛ ne sika ne animuonyam nso, mɛma wo deɛ ahemfo a wɔdii w’anim no biara annya bi da, na obiara a ɔbɛdi w’akyi aba nso rennya bi.”
Ɛnna Solomon firii sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ Gibeon no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no anim, baa Yerusalem, na ɔkɔɔ so dii Israel so.
Na Solomon boaboaa nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ ano, na ɔnyaa nteaseɛnam apem ahanan (1,400) ne apɔnkɔ mpem dumienu (12,000), na ɔde ne nyinaa kɔɔ nteaseɛnam nkuro mu ne ɔhene nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ɔhene maa dwetɛ ne sika dɔɔso pii wɔ Yerusalem sɛ aboɔ, na ɔmaa ntweneduro dɔɔso pii sɛ akyee nnua a ɛwɔ Sefela.
Na wɔkra Salomon apɔnkɔ no firi Egypt ne Kue, Kue na na ɔhene adwadifoɔ no tɔ wɔn tua ka.

Na wɔtɔ nteaseɛnam a wɔde firi Egypt baeɛ no biara nnwetɛbena ahansia (600), na wɔtɔ pɔnkɔ biara nso nnwetɛbena ɔha aduonum (150). Na saa na Hitifoɔ ahemfo ne Siria ahemfo yɛeɛ. Wɔnam adwadifoɔ no so na ɛkraeɛ.
2: Ɛnna Solomon bɔɔ ne tirim sɛ, ɔbɛsi efie ama Awurade din, ne n’ahennie.
Berɛsosɛm 2
Bio nso Solomon soma kɔɔ Tiro hene Hiram nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ wo ne me papa Dawid yɛeɛ, na wode ntweneduro brɛɛ no maa no de sii fie tenaa mu no,

hwɛ, me nso merebɛsi fie ama Awurade me Nyankopɔn din na ayɛ kronkron ama no ahye aduhwam a ɛyɛ hwam n’anim, na mede paanoo a wɔde kyerɛ daa, ne anɔpa ne anwummerɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ama no homeda homeda, ne bosome foforɔ, ne Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn afahyɛ berɛ mu. Yei ne Israel amanneɛ de kɔsi daa.
Na efie a merebɛsie no so, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ kɛse sene anyame nyinaa.
Hwan na ɔwɔ ahoɔden a ɔbɛtumi asi fie ama no? Ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro mpo ntumi nkora no, na me ne hwan a mɛsi fie ama no? Deɛ mɛtumi ayɛ ara ne sɛ mɛsi na wɔahye afɔrebɔdeɛ n’anim.

Enti ma me ɔbarima a ne ho akokwa a ɔbɛtumi ayɛ sika ne dwetɛ ne kɔbere ne dadeɛ ne tankɔkɔɔ ne deɛ ɛbere dum ne ahoma bruu, ho adwuma na ɔnim nsamaa yiyie, ma no mmɛka mmarima a wɔn ho akokwa a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem a me papa Dawid yiyii wɔn sii hɔ no ho.
Brɛ me Lebanon ntweneduro, popaw nnua, ne algum [abako] nnua, na menim sɛ wo nkoa nim Lebanon nnua twa yie, me nkoa ne wo nkoa bɛbom ayɛ adwuma no.
Ma wɔnsiesie nnua pii mma me, na efie a merebɛsie no so na ɛyɛ nwanwa yie.
Hwɛ! wo nkoa nnuapaefoɔ a wotwa nnua no mɛma wɔn ayuo susukoraa mpem aduonu; ne atokoɔ susukoraa mpem aduonu, ne bobesa nhina mpem aduonu; ne ngo, nhina mpem aduonu.”
Ɛnna Tiro hene Hiram twerɛɛ krataa brɛɛ Solomon sɛ: “Awurade dɔ ne man nti na ɔde wo asi wɔn so hene.”
