Yei nko na Awurade mfa nkyɛ w’akoa: Sɛ me wura kɔ Rimon fie sɛ ɔrekɔkoto asɔre wɔ hɔ, na sɛ ɔtwere me nsa so a, ɛbɛma makoto wɔ Rimon fie; sɛ mekoto wɔ Rimon fie saa a, ɛnneɛ mesrɛ sɛ Awurade mfa ɛno nkyɛ w’akoa.”
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ.” Enti ɔsiim firii ne nkyɛn twaa kwantiaa kakra bi.

Na Nyankopɔn nipa Elisa somfoɔ Gehasi kaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, me wura agyaa Siriani Naaman yi ama no kɔ kwa, na wannye deɛ ɔde baeɛ no ne nsam. Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, mɛtu mmirika ati no na makɔgye biribi ne nsam.”
Enti Gehasi de mmirika tii Naaman. Berɛ a Naaman hunuu sɛ obi de mmirika di n’akyi no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔsi firii ne teaseɛnam mu kɔhyiaa no, na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?”

Ɛnna ɔbuaa sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ mu. Me wura na asoma me sɛ memmɛka nkyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Hwɛ! Mmeranteɛ mmienu bi a wɔfiri adiyifoɔ no mma mu firi Efraim mmepɔ so aba me nkyɛn seesei ara. Enti mesrɛ wo, ma wɔn dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ baako ne ntadeɛ mmienu.’”

Ɔkaa saa no, Naaman nso kaa sɛ: “O gye talente mmienu mpo.” Ɔsrɛɛ no ara, na afei ɔkyekyeree dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ mmienu wɔ mmɔtɔ mmienu mu de ntadeɛ mmienu kaa ho, na ɔde maa n’asomfoɔ mmienu, na wɔsoa dii n’anim.
Berɛ a ɔduruu kokoɔ no ho no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔgyee nneɛma no wɔn nsam de kɔguu fie, na ɔgyaa wɔn kwan. Enti wɔsan kɔeɛ.
Ɔno deɛ, ɔba bɛgyinaa ne wura anim. Ɛnna Elisa bisaa no sɛ: “Gehasi, ɛhe na wofiri reba yi?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “W’akoa nkɔɔ baabiara.”

Ɛnna ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Berɛ a ɔbarima no si friii ne teaseɛnam mu bɛhyiaa woɔ no, m’akoma ankɔ bi anaa? Saa berɛ yi na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye dwetɛ anaa ntadeɛ anaa ngo nnua anaa bobe nturo anaa nnwan anaa anantwie anaa nkoa anaa mfenaa?
Ɛno nti Naaman kwata bɛfam wo ne w’asefoɔ ho daa.” Ɛhɔ ara na ɔfirii n’anim kɔeɛ, na kwata adware no fitaa sɛ sukyerɛmma.
6: Na adiyifoɔ mma no ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: “Hwɛ! Faako a yɛte wɔ wo nkyɛn ha yi sua dodo ma yɛn.
Ahemfo 6
Na baako ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛsrɛ wo, bɛka wo nkoa ho ma yɛnkɔ.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mɛkɔ.”
Enti ɔne wɔn siim kɔeɛ. Wɔkɔduruu Yordan ho, na wɔfirii aseɛ bubuu nnua no.
Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a baako rebu ne dua no, akuma no hɔn tɔɔ nsuo no mu. Ɛnna ɔteaam sɛ: “O me wura, yɛkɔsrɛeɛ oo!”
Ɛnna Nyankopɔn nipa no bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛhe na ɛtɔeɛ?” Na ɔkyerɛɛ no hɔ. Ɛhɔ ara na ɔtwaa dua bi to too hɔ, na ɛmaa akuma no bɛtɛɛ ani.
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Ma so fa.” Ntɛm ara na ɔtenee ne nsa faeɛ.
Na Siria hene ne Israel dii ako, na ɔne ne nkoa tuu agyina sɛ: “Ɛha ne ha na mo ne me bɛkyere nsraban.”
Ɛnna Nyankopɔn nipa no soma kɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: “Hwɛ yie na woamfa ha, ɛfiri sɛ ɛha na Siriafoɔ nam reba.”
Enti Israel hene soma kɔɔ faako a Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ no no. Ɔbɔɔ no kɔkɔ mprɛ pii, ɛnyɛ prɛko na ɛnyɛ mprenu nko.
Ɛnna Siria hene bo fuu asɛm yi ho, na ɔfrɛɛ ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkyerɛ me deɛ ɔwɔ yɛn mu a ɔwɔ Israel hene afa.”
Na ne nkoa no baako kaa sɛ: “Me wura ɔhene, yɛn mu biara nni n’afa, na mmom ɛyɛ Elisa, odiyifoɔ a ɔwɔ Israel no na ɔka nsɛm a woka no wo pia mu no kyerɛ Israel hene.”
Enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Monkɔhwɛ baabi a ɔwɔ na mensoma nkɔfa no mmra.” Ɛnna wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no akyire yi sɛ: “Ɔwɔ Dotan.”
Ɛhɔ ara na ɔsoma maa wɔde apɔnkɔ ne ɛko nteaseɛnam ne asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ kɔɔ hɔ. Wɔduruu hɔ anadwo, na wɔtwaa kuro no ho hyiaeɛ.

Berɛ a Nyankopɔn nipa no somfoɔ sɔree anɔpa na ɔfirii adie no, ɔnkɔhwɛ a, asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ bi na wɔde apɔnkɔ ne ɛko nteaseɛnam atwa kuro no ho ahyia yi. Ɛhɔ ara na ne somfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ao me wura! Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn?”
Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Nsuro, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔka yɛn ho no dɔɔso sene wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho.”

Na Elisa bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: “O Awurade, mesrɛ wo, bue n’ani na ɔnhunu.” Ntɛm ara na Awurade buee ɔsomfoɔ no ani, na ɔhunuu deɛ ɛrekɔ soɔ; ɔbɛhwɛ a, egya apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam na ayɛ mmepɔ no so ma atwa Elisa ho nyinaa ahyia yi.
Berɛ a nkurɔfoɔ no yɛɛ sɛ wɔreba Elisa soɔ no, ɔbɔɔ Awurade mpaeɛ sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, fa anifira bɔ ɔman yi.” Enti ɔde anifira bɔɔ wɔn sɛdeɛ Elisa kaeɛ no.
Afei Elisa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ kwan no nie, na ɛnyɛ kuro no nie. Monni m’akyi na memfa mo nkɔ barima a morehwehwɛ no no hɔ.” Nanso ɔdii wɔn anim de wɔn kɔɔ Samaria.
Berɛ a wɔduruu Samaria ara pɛ, Elisa kaa sɛ: “O Awurade, bue nkurɔfoɔ yi ani na wɔnhunu adeɛ.” Ntɛm ara na Awurade buee wɔn ani, na wɔhunuu adeɛ; wɔnkɔhwɛ a, Samaria mfimfini na wɔwɔ yi.
Berɛ a Israel hene hunuu wɔn no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔbisaa Elisa sɛ: “Memmobɔ wɔn nku wɔn anaa, m'agya, memmobɔ wɔn nku wɔn anaa?”
Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Mmobɔ wɔn nku wɔn. Wɔn a wode wo nkrantɛ ne w’agyan afa wɔn nnommum na ɛsɛ sɛ wokunkum wɔn anaa? Fa aduane ne nsuo si wɔn anim na wɔnnidi nnom na wɔnkɔ wɔn wura nkyɛn.”
Enti ɔtoo pono kɛseɛ maa wɔn; wɔdidi nomeeɛ, na ɛno akyi no ɔgyaa wɔn kwan maa wɔkɔɔ wɔn wura nkyɛn. Siria afomfoɔ no ansan amma Israel asase so bio.
Yei akyi no Siria hene Ben-Hadad boaboaa n’asraafoɔdɔm nyinaa ano kɔtwaa Samaria ho hyiaeɛ.

Ankyɛ na ɛkɔm kɛseɛ bi sii Samaria. Na hwɛ, wɔtwaa wɔn ho hyiaeɛ, na wɔtenaa hɔ kɔsii sɛ afei deɛ na afunumu ti mpo boɔ yɛ nnwetɛbena aduɔwɔtwe, na aborɔnoma bini, kab susudeɛ baako mu nkyɛmu nnan boɔ yɛ nnwetɛbena nnum.
Ɛbaa sɛ Israel hene retwam ɔfasuo no ho no, ɔbaa bi teaam ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “O me wura ɔhene, boa me!”
Ɛnna ɔbuaa sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade annye wo a, ɛhe na mɛfa agye woɔ? Ayuporobea anaa nsakyiamena mu?”
Afei ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na ɛha woɔ?” Na ɔbaa no buaa sɛ: “Ɔbaa yi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Fa wo ba bra ma yɛnwe no nnɛ, na ɔkyena me nso mede me ba bɛba ama yɛawe no.’
Enti yɛnoaa me ba no weeɛ. Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, meka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Wo nso fa wo ba no bra ma yɛnwe no.’ Nanso ɔde ne ba no kɔhuntaeɛ.”
Na ɛbaa sɛ, berɛ a ɔhene tee ɔbaa no asɛm no, ntɛm ara na ɔsunsuanee n’atadeɛ mu; berɛ a ɔretwam ɔfasuo no ho no, ɔmanfoɔ no hunuu no, na hwɛ! na ɔfira atweaatam n’atadeɛ ase.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ ɛnnɛ mema Safat ba Elisa ti tua so a, Onyankopɔn ntua me ka na ɔnsan mfa bi nka ho!”

Na Elisa te ɔno ara ne fie, na mpanimfoɔ no tete ne nkyɛn. Na ɔhene no somaa obi dii n’anim kɔɔ hɔ. Ɔbɔfoɔ no nnya nnuruu ne nkyɛn no, ɔka kyerɛɛ mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: “Moahunu sɛ wudini ba no asoma sɛ wɔmmɛtwa me ti? Sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ no bɛduru pɛ a, monhwɛ nto pono no mu, na mompia pono no nsi no kwan. Ɛnyɛ ne wura nan ase pim pim na ɛdi n’akyi yi?”
Na ɔgu so ne wɔn rekasa no, ɔbɔfoɔ no bɛduruu ne nkyɛn, na ɔhene no kaa sɛ: “Mmusuo yi firi Awurade. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mekɔ so twɛn Awurade bio?”
7: Ɛnna Elisa kaa sɛ: “Montie Awurade asɛm. Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ esiam susukoraa baako boɔ bɛyɛ dwetɛbena baako, na atokoɔ susukoraa mmienu boɔ bɛyɛ dwetɛbena baako wɔ Samaria kuro pono ano.’”
Ahemfo 7
Na mmarima akwatafoɔ baanan bi wɔ kuro no pono ano, na wɔkeka kyerɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ: “Adɛn nti na yɛretena ha awuo yi?

Sɛ yɛka sɛ, ‘Momma yɛnkɔ kuro no mu’ berɛ a ɛkɔm wɔ kuro no mu a, yɛbɛwuwu wɔ hɔ. Na sɛ yɛtena ha nso a, yɛbɛwuwu. Enti momma yɛmmɔ nwura Siriafoɔ nsraban no mu. Sɛ wɔgye yɛn nkwa a, yɛbɛtena nkwa mu, na sɛ wɔkunkum yɛn nso a, na yɛawu.”
Ɛnna wɔsɔree anwummerɛ a esum aba kɔɔ Siriafoɔ nsraban no mu; wɔkɔeɛ ara kɔduruu Siriafoɔ nsraban no ano, na hwɛ! wɔanhunu obiara wɔ hɔ.

Na Awurade ama Siriafoɔ no ate ɛko nteaseɛnam, apɔnkɔ, ne asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ nka wɔ wɔn nsraban no mu. Enti wɔkeka kyerɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ: “Hwɛ! Israel hene na wakɔbɔ Hitifoɔ ahemfo ne Egypt ahemfo paa ama wɔreba yɛn soɔ no oo!”
Ntɛm ara na wɔsɔre dwanee anwummerɛ a esum aba no, na wɔgyaa wɔn ntomadan ne wɔn apɔnkɔ ne wɔn mfunumu—wɔdwane gyee wɔn kra nkwa gyaa nsraban no saa ara.

Berɛ a akwatafoɔ yi bɛduruu nsraban no ano no, wɔwuraa ntomadan baako mu, na wɔdidi nomeeɛ, na wɔsesaa dwetɛ ne sika ne ntadeɛ firii hɔ de kɔsieeɛ. Ɛno akyi no, wɔsan baa ntomadan foforɔ mu, na wɔsesaa nneɛma firii hɔ de kɔsieeɛ.
Afei wɔkeka kyerɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ: “Deɛ yɛreyɛ yi nyɛ. Ɛnnɛ yɛ anigyeɛ da! Sɛ yɛtwentwɛn yɛn nan ase, na yɛtenatena ho ma adeɛ kye a, asodie na ɛbɛba yɛn soɔ. Enti momma yɛnkɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ ahemfie.”

Ɛnna wɔba bɛfrɛɛ kuro pono ano ahwɛfoɔ no, na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Yɛkɔɔ Siriafoɔ nsraban mu, na hwɛ! yɛanhunu obiara na yɛante obiara nka wɔ hɔ, gye apɔnkɔ ne mfunumu a wɔamantam wɔn ne ntomadan a wɔagya hɔ saa ara.”
Ɛhɔ ara na apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no frɛeɛ na wɔkɔbɔɔ amanneɛ wɔ ahemfie.

Ntɛm ara na ɔhene sɔree anadwo, na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asomfoɔ sɛ: “Momma menka deɛ Siriafoɔ pɛ sɛ wɔde yɛ yɛn. Wɔnim sɛ ɛkɔm de yɛn, enti wɔafiri wɔn nsraban mu akɔhunta wuram, na wɔaka sɛ, ‘Sɛ wɔfiri kuro no mu ba a, yɛbɛkye wɔn animono, na yɛabɔ awura kuro no mu.’”

Ɛnna n’asomfoɔ no baako ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma nnipa mfa kuro no mu apɔnkɔ a aka no nnum nkɔ. Hwɛ! Wɔn nso wɔte sɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔaka kuro yi mu no ara. Wɔte sɛ Israelfoɔ dodoɔ a wɔawuwuo no ara. Na ma yɛnsoma wɔn mma wɔnkɔhwɛ.”
Enti wɔfaa nteaseɛnam mmienu ne apɔnkɔ, na ɔhene somaa wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ Siriafoɔ nsraban no mu, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monkɔ na monkɔhwɛ.”
Ɛnna wɔdii wɔn akyi ara kɔduruu Yordan ho, na hwɛ! ntadeɛ ne anwenneɛ a ahoperɛ nti Siriafoɔ a wɔredwane no toto guiɛ no ayɛ kwan no so ma. Enti abɔfoɔ no sane bɛbɔɔ ɔhene amanneɛ.
Ɛnna ɔman no firii adi kɔfom Siriafoɔ nsraban no mu nneɛma; enti esiam susukoraa baako boɔ bɛyɛɛ dwetɛbena baako, na atokoɔ susukoraa mmienu boɔ bɛyɛɛ dwetɛbena baako sɛdeɛ Awurade kaeɛ no.
Na ɔhene yii okunini a ɔtwere ne nsa soɔ no sɛ ɔnhwɛ kuro pono no ano; na ɔman no tiatiaa ne so wɔ pono no ano maa no wuu sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no kaeɛ berɛ a ɔhene baa ne nkyɛn a ɔkasaeɛ no.

Enti sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no, ɛbaa mu saa sɛ: “Esiam susukoraa baako boɔ bɛyɛ dwetɛbena baako, na atokoɔ susukoraa mmienu boɔ bɛyɛ dwetɛbena baako wɔ Samaria kuro pono ano ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ.”
Nanso ɔsafohene no buaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade reyɛ ɔsoro mpomma mpo a, anka asɛm yi bɛtumi aba mu?” Na ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Wode w’ani na ɛbɛhunu, nanso ebi renka w’ano.”
Enti saa na ɛtoo no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔman no tiatiaa ne so wɔ kuro pono no ano maa no wuiɛ.
8: Na Elisa adi kan aka akyerɛ ɔbaa a ɔnyanee ne babarima no sɛ: “Sɔre na kɔ, wo ne wo fiefoɔ, na kɔyɛ hɔhoɔ baabiara a wobɛnya ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ama ɛkɔm reba, na ɛbɛba asase yi so mfeɛ nson.”
Ahemfo 8
Berɛ a mfeɛ nson no baa awieeɛ no, ɔbaa no firii Filistifoɔ asase so san baeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsu akyerɛ ɔhene sɛ wɔmfa ne fie ne n’asase mma no.
Na ɔhene ne Nyankopɔn nipa no somfoɔ Gehasi rekasa, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ka nneɛma akɛseɛ a Elisa ayɛ no nyinaa kyerɛ me ɛ.”

Berɛ a ɔgu so reka sɛdeɛ ɔnyanee obi a wawuo no, hwɛ, ɔbaa a ɔnyanee ne babarima no de su baa ɔhene anim sɛ wɔmfa ne fie ne n’asase mma no. Ɛhɔ ara na Gehasi kaa sɛ: “Me wura ɔhene, ɔbaa no nie, na ne ba a Elisa nyanee no no nso nie.”

Ɛnna ɔhene bisaa ɔbaa no deɛ ɛsiiɛ, na ɔno nso kaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ no. Afei ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ahemfie panin bi sɛ: “Fa ne biribiara ne nnɔbaeɛ a ɛfiri da a ɔfirii ha kɔeɛ bɛsi sɛsɛɛ asase no asoɔ nyinaa ma no.”
Na Elisa kɔɔ Damasko. Saa berɛ no na Siria hene Ben-Hadad yare. Enti wɔkɔbɔɔ no amanneɛ sɛ: “Nyankopɔn nipa no abɛduru ha.”
Ɛnna ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Hasael sɛ: “Fa akyɛdeɛ na kɔ Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn na fa ne so bisa Awurade ma me sɛ, ‘Me yareɛ no bɛkɔ anaa?’”
Enti Hasael faa akyɛdeɛ kɔhyiaa no, Damasko nneɛma pa nyinaa bi, yoma aduanan nnesoa, na ɔkɔgyinaa n’anim kaa sɛ: “Wo ba Ben-Hadad, Siria hene asoma me sɛ memmɛbisa wo sɛ, ‘Me yareɛ no bɛkɔ anaa?’”
Ɛnna Elisa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Wo ho bɛtɔ wo deɛ,’ nanso Awurade akyerɛ me sɛ owuo na ɔbɛwuo.”
Afei ɔhwɛɛ no haa kɔsii sɛ ɛyɛɛ no ahometeɛ. Na Nyankopɔn nipa no suiɛ.

Ɛnna Hasael bisaa no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na me wura resu yi?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛfiri sɛ menim bɔne a wobɛyɛ Israelfoɔ. Wode gya bɛhye wɔn nkuro a ɛyɛ den, wode nkrantɛ bɛkunkum wɔn nnɔmmarima, wobɛtete wɔn mmɔfra mu, na wɔn apemfoɔ nso, wobɛpaepae wɔn mu.”
Ɛnna Hasael kaa sɛ: “W’akoa, ɔkraman yi, ne hwan a ɔbɛtumi ayɛ adekɛseɛ yi?” Nanso Elisa kaa sɛ: “Awurade ayi akyerɛ me sɛ wo na wobɛyɛ Siria hene.”
Ɛno akyi no, ɔfirii Elisa nkyɛn kɔɔ ne wura hɔ, na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ woɔ?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Wo ho bɛtɔ wo.’”
Na ɛbaa sɛ adeɛ kyeeɛ no, ɔfaa kuntu bɔɔ nsuo mu de kataa ɔhene no anim maa no wuiɛ. Na Hasael bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahab ba, Israel hene Yehoram afe a ɛtɔ so nnum mu, berɛ a Yehosafat dii adeɛ wɔ Yuda no, Yuda hene Yehosafat ba Yehoram bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduasa mmienu, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ nwɔtwe wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ɔfaa Israel ahemfo akwan so sɛdeɛ Ahab fiefoɔ yɛeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ Ahab babaa na ɔwaree no, na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne.
Nanso Awurade ampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe Yuda, n’akoa Dawid nti, ɛfiri sɛ na waka sɛ ɔbɛma ɔno ne ne mma anya kanea daa.
Ne nna mu no, Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa ase, na wɔsii wɔn so hene.
Enti Yoram kɔɔ Sair, ɔne nteaseɛnam a ɛka ne ho nyinaa. Na ɔsɔree anadwo kɔkunkum Edomfoɔ a wɔatwa ɔne nteaseɛnam so asahene no ho ahyia no, na nkurɔfoɔ no dwane kokɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
Ne nyinaa akyi no, Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa ase de bɛsi nnɛ. Saa berɛ no ara, Libnafoɔ nso tee atua.
Yoram ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yoram ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ Dawid Kuro mu. Na ne ba Ahasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahab ba, Israel hene Yehoram afe a ɛtɔ so dumienu mu na Yuda hene Yehoram ba Ahasia bɛdii hene.
Ahasia bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu mmienu, na ɔdii hene afe baako wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Atalia a ɔyɛ Israel hene Omri ba nana.
Na ɔfaa Ahab fiefoɔ akwan so, na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ Ahab fiefoɔ yɛeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔwaree Ahab fie, na ɔbɛyɛɛ wɔn busuani.
Enti ɔne Ahab ba Yoram boom ne Siria hene Hasael kɔkoo wɔ Ramot-Gilead, nanso Siriafoɔ bɔɔ Yoram piraa no.

Enti Ɔhene Yoram san n’akyi kɔsaa ne ho yareɛ wɔ Yesreel ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a ɔne Siria hene Hasael kɔkoeɛ no, Siriafoɔ no piraa no wɔ Rama. Na Yehoram ba, Yuda hene Ahasia kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ Ahab ba Yoram wɔ Yesreel, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyare.
9: Na odiyifoɔ Elisa frɛɛ adiyifoɔ mma no baako ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Bɔ w’abɔsoɔ na fa ngotoa yi kura wo nsam, na kɔ Ramot-Gilead.
Ahemfo 9
Afei fa toa no na hwie ngo no gu n’atifi, na ka sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie: “Meresra wo asi wo Israel so hene.”’ Ɛno akyi no, bue pono no na dwane, ntwɛn.”
Ɛnna ɔsomfoɔ no, kyerɛ sɛ, odiyifoɔ no somfoɔ no, siim kɔɔ Ramot-Gilead.
Berɛ a ɔkɔɔ hɔ no, hwɛ, na asahene no atenatena ase. Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔsahene, mewɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ wo.” Na Yehu bisaa no sɛ: “Yɛn mu hwan?” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔsahene, ɛyɛ wo ara.”
Enti ɔsɔre kɔɔ fie hɔ na ɔhwiee ngo no guu n’atifi, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie, ‘Meresra wo asi wo Awurade man Israel so hene.
Na twitwa wo wura Ahab fiefoɔ gu, na mɛma Yesebel atua me nkoa adiyifoɔ no ne Awurade nkoa nyinaa mogya ho ka.
Na Ahab fie nyinaa ase bɛtɔre; mɛtwa Ahab fie barima biara atwene, Israel nipahunu a ɔnni ɔboafoɔ anaa ɔdehyeɛ mpo.
Na mɛyɛ Ahab fie sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fie ne Ahiya ba Baasa fie.
Na Yesebel nso, nkraman na ɛbɛdi ne nam wɔ Yesreel asase no so, na ɔrennya obiara nsie no.’” Ɔkaa saa no, ɔbuee pono no dwaneeɛ.
Ɛnna Yehu kɔɔ ne wura nkoa no nkyɛn, na wɔbisaa no sɛ: “Biribiara yɛ bɔkɔɔ anaa? Ɛdeɛn nti na bɔdamfoɔ yi baa wo nkyɛn?” Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mo ara monim barima yi ne ne nsɛnkeka.”
Nanso wɔkaa sɛ: “Wɔboa oo! Ka mu nokorɛ kyerɛ yɛn.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Sei ne sei na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie: “Meresra wo asi wo Israel so hene.”’”
Ɛhɔ ara na wɔn nyinaa de ahoɔherɛ yiyii wɔn ntoma sesɛɛ fam, atwedeɛ no ara soɔ, na wɔhyɛnee abɛn kaa sɛ: “Yehu abɛyɛ hene!”
Na Nimsi ba Yehosafat ba Yehu bɔɔ Yoram ho pɔ. Saa berɛ no, na Yoram rewɛn wɔ Ramot-Gilead, ɔne Israel nyinaa, Siria hene Hasael nti.

Akyire yi Ɔhene Yehoram san n’akyi kɔsaa ne ho yareɛ wɔ Yesreel ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a ɔne Siria hene Hasael kɔkoeɛ no, Siriafoɔ piraa no. Ɛnna Yehu kaa sɛ: “Sɛ mo ne me yɛ adwene a, ɛnneɛ mommma obiara nnnwane mmfiri kuro no mu nnkɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ Yesreel.”
Na Yehu tenaa teaseɛnam mu siim kɔɔ Yesreel, ɛfiri sɛ na Yoram da hɔ, na Yuda hene Ahasia nso kɔ hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ Yoram.

Na ɔwɛmfoɔ gyina Yesreel abantenten no so, na ɔhunuu sɛ Yehu ne ne dɔm reba ahoɔden so. Ɛhɔ ara na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mehunu nnipadɔm bi sɛ wɔreba ahoɔden so.” Ɛnna Yehoram kaa sɛ: “Soma ɔpɔnkɔsotefoɔ ma no nkɔhyia wɔn na ɔmmisa sɛ, ‘Asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?’”

Enti obi a ɔte pɔnkɔ soɔ kɔhyiaa no na ɔkaa sɛ: “Deɛ ɔhene aka nie, ‘Asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?’” Ɛnna Yehu kaa sɛ: “Wonim deɛ wɔfrɛ no ‘asomdwoeɛ’? Dane wo ho bɛdi m’akyi!” Ɛnna ɔwɛmfoɔ no kɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ: “Ɔbɔfoɔ no kɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn nanso wansan amma.”
Enti ɔsomaa ɔpɔnkɔsotefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu, na ɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn no, ɔkaa sɛ: “Deɛ ɔhene aka nie, ‘Asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?’” Ɛnna Yehu kaa sɛ: “Wonim deɛ wɔfrɛ no ‘asomdwoeɛ’? Dane wo ho bɛdi m’akyi!”
Ɛnna ɔwɛmfoɔ no kɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ: “Ɔkɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn nanso wansan amma. Na teaseɛnam no ka te sɛ Nimsi ba nana Yehu deɛ; ɔka no sɛdeɛ wabɔ dam.”

Ɛnna Yehoram kaa sɛ: “Monsiesie teaseɛnam no!” Enti ɔsiesiee ne ko teaseɛnam no maa no, na Israel hene Yehoram ne Yuda hene Ahasia tenatenaa wɔn ko nteaseɛnam mu. Wɔsiim sɛ wɔrekɔhyia Yehu, na wɔkɔtoo no Yesreelni Nabot asase no so.

Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a Yehoram hunuu Yehu no, ntɛm ara na ɔkaa sɛ: “Yehu, asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?” Ɛnna ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na asomdwoeɛ atumi aba berɛ a wo maame Yesebel adwamammɔ ne n’abayigorɔ bebrebe no da so rekɔ soɔ yi?”
Ntɛm ara na Yehoram danee ne ho sɛ ɔredwane, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ahasia sɛ: “wanya yɛn: Atirisopamsɛm nie, O Ahasia!”
Ɛhɔ ara na Yehu twee agyan to wɔɔ Yehoram abasa ntam maa agyan no hwiree n’akomam, na ɔtwa hwee ne teaseɛnam no mu.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ ne boafoɔ Bidkar sɛ: “Ma no so to no twene Yesreelni Nabot asase no so; na kae sɛ na me ne wo nyinaa ka teaseɛnam di ne papa Ahab akyi berɛ a Awurade kaa atemmusɛm yi tiaa no sɛ:
‘“Ampa, mehunuu Nabot mogya ne ne mma mogya nnora,” Awurade na ɔseɛ, “na mɛtua wo ɛso ka asase yi so,” Awurade na ɔseɛ.’ Enti ma no so to no twene asase no so sɛdeɛ Awurade aka no.”

Na Yuda hene Ahasia hunuiɛ no, ɔdwane faa turom dan kwan no so. Akyire yi Yehu tii no, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔka ho! Mommɔ ɔno nso!” Enti wɔbɔɔ no piraa no berɛ a ɔte teaseɛnam mu rekɔ Gur a ɛbɛn Yibleam no. Ɔtoaa so ara kɔduruu Megido, na ɔwuu hɔ.
Na ne nkoa de no too teaseɛnam mu de no kɔɔ Yerusalem, na wɔsiee no ne damena mu kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ Dawid Kuro mu.
Na Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so dubaako mu na Ahasia bɛdii Yuda so hene.
Na Yehu bɛduruu Yesreel, na Yesebel nso teeɛ. Ɔde adubire kekaa n’ani akyi, na ɔsiesiee ne tiri ho fɛfɛɛfɛ, na ɔhwɛɛ fam, mpomma mu.
Na Yehu kɔɔ mu kɔduruu ɛpono no ano. Na ɔbaa no bisaa no sɛ: “Simri a ɔkum ne wura no, ɛsii no yie anaa?”
Ɛnna ɔno nso maa n’ani so hwɛɛ mpomma no mu, na ɔbisaa sɛ: “Hwan na ɔwɔ m’afa, hwan?” Ɛhɔ ara na ahemfie mpanimfoɔ mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa firi hɔ hwɛɛ no wɔ fam hɔ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monto no nhwe fam!” Na wɔtoo no hwee fam, na ne mogya no bi bɔ petee ɔfasuo ne apɔnkɔ no ho, na ɔtwi faa ne so.
Afei ɔkɔɔ mu kɔdidiiɛ na ɔnomeeɛ, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monkɔfa ɔbaa a wɔadome no no na monsie no ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔhene babaa.”
Berɛ a wɔkɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔsie no no, wɔanhu ne ho hwee sɛ ne tikwankoraa ne ne nan ase ne ne nsayam.
Berɛ a wɔsan bɛbɔɔ no amanneɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Tisbini Elia so kaeɛ no na aba mu sɛ, ‘Nkraman na ɛbɛdi Yesebel nam wɔ Yesreel asase no soɔ.
Na Yesebel funu bɛyɛ sumina, Yesreel asase no so na obi anka sɛ: “Yesebel nie.”’”
10: Na Ahab wɔ mma mmarima aduɔson wɔ Samaria. Enti Yehu twerɛɛ krataa de soma kɔɔ Samaria kɔmemaa Yesreel atitire, mpanimfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ Ahab mma soɔ no sɛ:
Ahemfo 10
monhwehwɛ mo wura mma no mu deɛ ɔyɛ paa a asɛm nni ne ho, na momfa no nsi ne n'agya adwa so. Na monko mma mo wura fie.”
Na ehu kɛseɛ kaa wɔn, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ahemfo mmienu mpo antumi annyina n’anim, na yɛn na yɛbɛtumi agyina?”

Enti efiepanin no ne kuro so hwɛfoɔ no ne mpanimfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ mma no soɔ no soma kɔka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: “Yɛyɛ wo nkoa, enti deɛ wobɛka akyerɛ yɛn biara, yɛbɛyɛ. Yɛrensi obiara hene. Deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ biara, yɛ.”

Na ɔtwerɛɛ wɔn krataa a ɛtɔ so mmienu sɛ: “Sɛ mowɔ m’afa na sɛ me nne na mobɛtie a, ɛnneɛ montwitwa mo wura mma mmarima a wɔwɔ mo nkyɛn no ti, na mommra me nkyɛn ɔkyena saa berɛ yi wɔ Yesreel.” Saa berɛ no, na ɔhene mma mmarima aduɔson no wɔwɔ kuro no mu atitire nkyɛn a wɔretete wɔn.
Berɛ a wɔn nsa kaa krataa no ara pɛ, wɔfaa ɔhene mma aduɔson no kunkum wɔn, na wɔde wɔn ti guu nkɛntɛn mu, na wɔsoma de kɔmaa no wɔ Yesreel.
Ɛnna ɔbɔfoɔ bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wɔde ɔhene mma no tiri aba.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mommoaboa ano akuo mmienu mfa ngu kwan no ano nkɔsi anɔpa.”
Ɛduruu anɔpa no, ɔfirii adi. Na ɔgyinaa hɔ ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: “Moyɛ ateneneefoɔ. Me deɛ, mebɔɔ me wura ho pɔ kuu no; nanso hwan na ɔkum yeinom nyinaa?
Enti monhunu sɛ Awurade asɛm biara nni hɔ a Awurade aka atia Ahab fiefoɔ a ɛbɛtɔ fam na ɛremma mu. Awurade na ayɛ asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Elia so kaeɛ no.”
Afei nso, Yehu kunkum obiara a ɔkaa Ahab fie wɔ Yesreel ne n’akunini ne ne mfɛfoɔ ne n’asɔfoɔ nyinaa, na obiara anka amma no bio.
Na ɔsɔre siim sɛ ɔrekɔ Samaria. Na ɔduruu nnwanhwɛfoɔ fie a wɔmantam nnwan wom no wɔ kwan no so.
Na Yehu hyiaa Yuda hene Ahasia nuanom. Ɛnna ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ, “Ɛhefoɔ ne mo?” na wɔbuaa sɛ: “Yɛyɛ Ahasia nuanom, na yɛrekɔ akɔhwɛ sɛdeɛ ɔhene mma ne ɔhemmaa mma no ho teɛ.”
Ntɛm ara na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monkye wɔn animono!” Ɛnna wɔkyee wɔn animono na wɔkunkum wɔn wɔ fie a wɔmantam nnwan wom no abura ho; na wɔyɛ mmarima aduanan mmienu, na wɔannya baako mpo.

Ɔfiri hɔ rekɔ no, ɔhunuu Rekab ba Yehonadab sɛ ɔrebɛhyia no. Na ɔkyeaa no, ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “W’akoma di mume ho sɛdeɛ m’akoma di muwo ho no anaa?” Ɛnna Yehonadab kaa sɛ: “Ɛte saa.” “Sɛ saa a, ɛnneɛ fa wo nsa to me nsayam.” Enti ɔde ne nsa too ne nsayam. Na ɔmaa no foro bɛtenaa teaseɛnam no mu bi.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Bɛsene kɔgya me na kɔhwɛ ninkunu a meretwe ama Awurade.” Na wɔmaa no tenaa teaseɛnam no mu ne no kɔeɛ.
Na ɔbɛduruu Samaria, na ɔkunkum Ahab ho nnipa a wɔaka Samaria nyinaa kɔsii sɛ ɔtɔree wɔn ase sɛdeɛ Awurade asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ Elia no teɛ.
Bio nso, Yehu boaboaa ɔman no nyinaa ano hyiae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Ahab som Baal kakraa bi. Yehu deɛ, ɔbɛsom no bebree.

Enti momfrɛfrɛ Baal adiyifoɔ no nyinaa, wɔn a wɔsom no ne asɔfoɔ no nyinaa mmra me nkyɛn. Monnnya baako mpo, ɛfiri sɛ merebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ kɛseɛ ama Baal. Obiara a wamma aseɛ no, ɔrentena nkwa mu.” Nanso na Yehu pɛ sɛ ɔkunkum Baal asomfoɔ no nti na ɔde aniteɛ yɛɛ saa no.
Na Yehu kaa sɛ: “Momfa nto dwa na wɔnyɛ nhyiamu titire mma Baal.” Enti wɔde too dwa.
Ɛno akyi no, Yehu de nkra kɔɔ Israel nyinaa, na Baal asomfoɔ no nyinaa bɛhyiaam. Baako mpo anka a wamma bie. Wɔbaa Baal fie hɔ maa Baal fie hɔ nyinaa yɛɛ ma kyeree so.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔhwɛ ntadeɛ dan soɔ no sɛ: “Fa ntadeɛ brɛ Baal asomfoɔ no nyinaa.” Enti ɔde ntadeɛ no brɛɛ wɔn.
Ɛnna Yehu ne Rekab ba Yehonadab baa Baal fie hɔ. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Baal asomfoɔ no sɛ: “Monhwehwɛ mo mu yie na Awurade asomfoɔ no biara ammɛfra mo mu; momma no nka Baal asomfoɔ nko ara.”

Afei wɔbaa sɛ wɔrebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na Yehu de mmarima aduɔwɔtwe gyinagyinaa abɔnten twɛneeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sɛ mo mu bi ma mmarima a mede wɔn bɛhyɛ mo nsa no bi dwane a, ɛnneɛ ne kra bɛsi onii no kra ananmu.”

Berɛ a ɔwiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no, ɛhɔ ara na Yehu ka kyerɛɛ awɛmfoɔ ne akunini no sɛ: “Mommra mmɛkunkum wɔn! Mommma obiara mmfiri adi.” Ɛnna awɛmfoɔ ne akunini no firii aseɛ de nkrantɛ kunkum wɔn, na wɔtotoo wɔn guu abɔnten, na wɔkɔeɛ ara kɔduruu Baal abosonnan no mu.
Ɛnna wɔyiyii Baal fie hɔ abosom adum no firii adie, na wɔhyee ne nyinaa.
Bio nso, wɔbubuu Baal honi no, na Baal fie no nso wɔbubuiɛ, na wɔde yɛɛ agyananbea [Tiafi] de bɛsi nnɛ.
Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a Yehu tuu Baal ase firii Israel.
Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no nko na Yehu antwe ne ho amfiri ho; ɛno ne sika anantwie mma a na baako si Betel na baako nso si Dan no.

Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: “Sɛ woadi asɛmpa na woayɛ deɛ ɛtene m’ani soɔ, na woayɛ deɛ ɛwɔ m’akomam sɛ mede bɛyɛ Ahab fiefoɔ nyinaa nti, wobɛnya mma a wɔbɛtena Israel ahennwa soɔ de akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nnan so.”
Nanso Yehu anhwɛ amfa n’akoma nyinaa annante Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn mmara mu. Wannane amfiri Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no ho.
Saa nna no mu na Awurade firii aseɛ twitwaa Israel nsase nkakrankakra; Hasael kɔɔ so kunkum wɔn wɔ Israel nsase nyinaa so,
ɛfiri Yordan ho kɔsi awiapueeɛ, Gileadfoɔ nsase nyinaa, Gadfoɔ ne Rubenfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ deɛ, ɛfiri Aroer a ɛbɛn Arnon subɔn ne Gilead ne Basan nso.
Yehu ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne nnwuma akɛseɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yehu ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no Samaria, na ne ba Yehoahas bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Nna a Yehu de dii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria no si mfeɛ aduonu nwɔtwe.
11: Na Ahasia maame Atalia hunuu sɛ ne ba no awu. Enti ɔsɔre kunkum adehyeɛ asefoɔ no nyinaa.
Ahemfo 11
Na ɔne no tenaa Awurade fie hɔ ahuntaeɛ mu mfeɛ nsia berɛ a Atalia dii asase no so hemmaa no.

Na afe a ɛtɔ so nson mu no, Yehoiada soma kɔfrɛɛ Kari awɛmfoɔ ne ammirikatufoɔ ɔha ha so mpanimfoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn wɔ Awurade fie, na ɔne wɔn yɛɛ apam maa wɔkaa ntam wɔ Awurade fie hɔ, na ɛno akyi no, ɔde ɔhene ba no kyerɛɛ wɔn.
Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Deɛ monyɛ nie: Mo mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako mmra homeda, na mommɛwɛn ahemfie no yie;
na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nkɔ Sur Pono no ano, na nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso mmɛgyina ɛpono a ɛwɔ ammirikatufoɔ no akyi no ano; obiara nnyina ne gyinabea nwɛn efie no yie.
Na mo mu akuo mmienu a wɔwɛn homeda no, wɔn nso nwɛn Awurade fie no yie, ɔhene no nti.
Na obiara mfa n’akodeɛ nkura ne nsam, na montwa ɔhene no ho nhyia. Obiara a ɔbɛba awɛmfoɔ no mu no, monku no. Na montena ɔhene ho, n'adifire ne ne muba mu.”
Enti ɔha ha so mpanimfoɔ no yɛɛ deɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada kaeɛ no nyinaa. Na wɔfaa wɔn mu mmarima a wɔreba hɔ homeda abɛsom ne wɔn a wɔabɛsom na wɔrekɔ homeda no baeɛ, na wɔbaa ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada nkyɛn.
Afei ɔsɔfoɔ no de Ɔhene Dawid mpea ne akyɛm nketewa a ɛwɔ Awurade fie hɔ no maa ɔha ha so mpanimfoɔ no.
Na awɛmfoɔ no nyinaa faa wɔn akodeɛ kurakuraa wɔn nsam, na wɔgyinagyinaa fie no benkum ne ne nifa so ne afɔrebukyia no ho ne fie no ho, na wɔtwaa ɔhene no ho hyiaeɛ.
Ɛnna ɔde ɔhene ba no firii adi baeɛ, na ɔde ahemmotire bɔɔ ne ti, na ɔde Adanseɛ no hyɛɛ ne nsa. Wɔsraa no, na wɔsii no hene. Afei wɔbobɔɔ wɔn nsam kaa sɛ: “Ɔhene nnya nkwa daa!”
Berɛ a Atalia tee gyegyeegye sɛ ɔman no retu mmirika no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔbaa nkurɔfoɔ no nkyɛn Awurade fie hɔ.

Ɔhwɛeɛ no, ɔhunuu sɛ ɔhene no gyina edum no ho sɛdeɛ amanneɛ teɛ, na mpanimfoɔ ne ntotorobɛnto wɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn, na ɔman no mu nnipa nyinaa redi ahurisie na wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto. Ɛhɔ ara na Atalia suanee n’atadeɛ mu na ɔteaam sɛ: “Atirisopam! Atirisopam!”

Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada frɛɛ ɔha ha so mpanimfoɔ ne asraafoɔ so mpanimfoɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Montwe no mfiri nnipa no mu, na obiara a ɔbɛdi n’akyi no, momfa nkrantɛ nku no!” Na ɔsɔfoɔ no aka sɛ: “Monnku no Awurade fie.”
Enti wɔde wɔn nsa sɔɔ ne mu, na wɔde no bɛduruu apɔnkɔ pono no ano, ahemfie hɔ, na wɔkum no wɔ hɔ.
Ɛnna Yehoiada de apam too Awurade ne ɔhene no ne ɔman no nyinaa ntam sɛ wɔbɛyɛ Awurade man; na ɔmaa ɔhene no ne ɔman no nso yɛɛ bi.

Ɛno akyi no, ɔman no mu nnipa nyinaa kɔɔ Baal fie hɔ, na wɔdwirii n’afɔrebukyia no guiɛ; wɔbubuu n’ahoni no pasaa, na Baal sɔfoɔ Mattan nso, wɔkum no afɔrebukyia no anim. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no de ahwɛfoɔ sisii Awurade fie so.

Afei ɔfaa ɔha ha so mpanimfoɔ ne Kari awɛmfoɔ ne ammirikatufoɔ ne ɔman no mu nnipa nyinaa sɛ wɔmfa ɔhene no mfiri Awurade fie hɔ mmra. Enti wɔfaa awɛmfoɔ pono no mu kɔɔ ahemfie hɔ, na ɔhene no tenaa ahennwa no so.
Na ɔman no mu nnipa nyinaa kɔɔ so dii ahurisie, na asomdwoeɛ baa kuro no mu. Atalia deɛ, wɔde nkrantɛ kuu no ahemfie hɔ.
Yehoas bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ nson.
12: Na Yehu afe a ɛtɔ so nson mu no, Yehoas bɛdii hene, na ɔdii adeɛ mfeɛ aduanan wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne maame din de Sibiya a ɔfiri Beer-Seba.
Ahemfo 12
Nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no nko na amfiri hɔ. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ.
Na Yehoas ka kyerɛɛ asɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Ayɛyɛdeɛ kronkron sika a wɔde ba Awurade fie nyinaa, ankorankoro toɔ, obiara kra ti sika, ne sika biara a ɛbɛka obi akomam sɛ ɔde bɛba Awurade fie no,
ma asɔfoɔ no nnyegye mfiri wɔn amannifoɔ nkyɛn, na wɔnsiesie fie no baabi a asɛeɛ.”
Ɛduruu Ɔhene Yehoas afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa mu no, na asɔfoɔ no nsiesiee baabi a asɛesɛe wɔ fie hɔ no.

Enti Ɔhene Yehoas frɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada ne asɔfoɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Adɛn nti na monsiesiee baabi a asɛesɛe wɔ fie hɔ no? Ɛno nti afei monnnyegye sika mmfiri mo amannifoɔ nkyɛn bio, na momfa sika no mma na wɔmfa nsiesie baabi a asɛesɛe wɔ fie hɔ no.”
Ɛnna asɔfoɔ no penee so sɛ wɔrennyegye sika mfiri ɔman no nkyɛn bio, na wɔrensiesie baabi a asɛesɛe wɔ fie hɔ no.

Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada faa adaka bi, na ɔtuu ne mmuasoɔ no mu tokuro de sii afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn wɔ nifa so, deɛ wɔfa ba Awurade fie no; ɛhɔ na asɔfoɔ no, wɔn a wɔhwɛ pono ano no de sika a wɔde baa Awurade fie no nyinaa kɔguiɛ.
Na sɛ wɔhunu sɛ sika pii aba adaka no mu a, ntɛm ara ɔhene twerɛfoɔ ne ɔsɔfo panin no ba bɛkyekyere, na wɔkan sika a wɔnya no Awurade fie no.
Afei wɔde sika a wɔakan no hyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔde wɔn asisi Awurade fie soɔ no nsa, na wɔde tua dua adwumfoɔ ne adansifoɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma Awurade fie hɔ no ka,

na wɔde bi nso tua abantofoɔ ne abopaefoɔ no ka, na wɔde bi tɔ nnua a wɔapaeɛ ne aboɔ a wɔapaeɛ a wɔde bɛsiesie baabi a asɛesɛe wɔ Awurade fie hɔ no, na wɔde bi nso tuatua biribiara a wɔyɛ de siesiee fie no ho ka.
Nanso wɔamfa sika a wɔde ba Awurade fie no bi anyɛ Awurade fie hɔ dwetɛ asɛn ne adumgya ne nyaawa ne ntotorobɛnto ne sika nneɛma ne dwetɛ nneɛma no biara;
mmom, wɔde sika no maa adwumayɛfoɔ no, na wɔn nso wɔde siesiee Awurade fie no.
Na nnipa a wɔde sika hyɛɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔmfa mma adwumayɛfoɔ no, wɔne wɔn ammu ho nkonta, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛɛ adwuma no nokorɛdie mu.
Asodie afɔdeɛ sika ne bɔne afɔdeɛ sika no deɛ, wɔamfa amma Awurade fie hɔ, na wɔde maa asɔfoɔ no.
Saa berɛ no, Siria hene Hasael foro kɔɔ Gat so ne no kɔkoeɛ, na ɔgye faeɛ; ɛno akyi no, Hasael de n’ani sii Yerusalem so sɛ ɔne wɔn rebɛko.

Ɛnna Yuda hene Yehoas sesaa ayɛyɛdeɛ kronkron a ne nananom, Yuda ahemfo Yehosafat ne Yehoram ne Ahasia, ayɛ no kronkron no, ne n’ayɛyɛdeɛ kronkron ne sika a ɛwɔ Awurade fie ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu no nyinaa, na ɔsoma de kɔmaa Siria hene Hasael. Ɛnna ɔfirii Yerusalem so kɔeɛ.
Yehoas ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Nanso Yehoas nkoa sɔre bɔɔ ne ho pɔ, na wɔkum no wɔ Milo aban no ho, ɛkwan a ɛkɔ Sila no so.
Ne nkoa Simeat ba Yosakar, ne Somer ba Yehosabad na wɔbɔɔ no, na ɔwuiɛ. Na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ Dawid Kuro mu, na ne ba Amasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
13: Ahasia ba, Yuda hene Yehoas afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa mu no, na Yehu ba Yehoahas bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ dunson.
Ahemfo 13
Awurade bo fuu Israel pii, enti ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ Siria hene Hasael ne Hasael ba Ben-Hadad nsa, wɔn nna nyinaa.
Akyire yi, Yehoahas hwehwɛɛ Awurade, na Awurade tiee no; ɔhunuu nhyɛsoɔ a ɛbaa Israel soɔ, nhyɛsoɔ a Siria hene de baa wɔn soɔ no.
Enti Awurade maa Israel ɔgyefoɔ maa wɔfirii Siria nsam, na Israelfoɔ tenatenaa wɔn afie mu sɛ kane no.
Nanso Yeroboam fie bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no deɛ, wɔantwe wɔn ho amfiri ho. Ɛno ara mu na wɔnanteeɛ; bosom dua no nso amfiri Samaria.
Na wɔannya dɔm biara amma Yehoahas gye apɔnkɔsotefoɔ aduonum ne nteaseɛnam du ne mmarima mpem du a wɔnam fam, ɛfiri sɛ Siria hene kunkum wɔn, na ɔyɛɛ wɔn sɛ ayuporobea mfuturo.
Yehoahas ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne nnwuma akɛseɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yehoahas ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no Samaria, na ne ba Yehoas bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yuda hene Yoas afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nson mu no, Yehoahas ba Yoas bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ dunsia.
Na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne. Wannane amfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no mu biara ho. Ɛno ara mu na ɔnanteeɛ.
Na Yoas ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne nnwuma akɛseɛ, ne sɛdeɛ ɔne Yuda hene Amasia koeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yoas ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na Yeroboam bɛtenaa n’adwa so. Wɔsiee Yoas wɔ Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo ho.
Elisa yaree yareɛ a ɛde no bɛkɔ wuo mu. Enti Israel hene Yoas siim kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔsuu n’anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: “M'agya, m'agya, Israel teaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ!”
Ɛnna Elisa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa tadua ne agyan.” Enti ɔfaa tadua ne agyan kuraeɛ.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: “Fa wo nsa sɔ tadua no mu.” Na ɔde ne nsa sɔɔ mu, na Elisa nso de ne nsa guu ɔhene no nsa so.

Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Bue apueeɛ mpomma no.” Na ɔbueeɛ. Ɛnna Elisa kaa sɛ: “To!” Na ɔtoeɛ. Afei ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade nkonimdie agyan nie; Siria so nkonimdie agyan nie! Wobɛbɔ Siria wɔ Afek akɔsi sɛ wobɛwie wɔn koraa.”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Sesa agyan no.” Ɛnna ɔsesaeɛ. Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: “Fa bobɔ fam.” Na ɔde bɔɔ hɔ mprɛnsa na ɔgyaeeɛ.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no bo fuu no, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Anka ɛsɛ sɛ wode bɔ hɔ mprɛ nnum anaa nsia! Ɛno deɛ, anka wobɛbɔ Siria awie wɔn koraa, nanso seesei deɛ, mprɛnsa pɛ na wobɛbɔ Siria.”
Ɛno akyi no, Elisa wuiɛ na wɔsiee no. Na Moab afomfoɔ ba asase no so afe biara mfitiaseɛ.

Berɛ bi na wɔrekɔsie ɔbarima bi, wɔnkɔhwɛ a, afomfoɔ no na wɔreba yi. Ntɛm ara na wɔtoo ɔbarima no too baabi a wɔsiee Elisa no, na wɔdwanee. Berɛ a ɔbarima no amu kaa Elisa nnompe no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔbaa nkwa mu, na ɔsɔre gyinaa ne nan so.
Na Siria hene Hasael haa Israel, Yehoahas nna nyinaa mu.
Nanso apam a Awurade ne Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob yɛeɛ no nti, ɔdom wɔn huu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na ɔtwaa n’ani hwɛɛ wɔn na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe wɔn; wanto wɔn amfiri n’anim antwene bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Siria hene Hasael wuiɛ, na ne ba Ben-Hadad bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Yehoahas ba Yoas san gyee nkuro a wɔgye firii ne papa Yehoahas nsam ɛko mu no firii Hasael ba Ben-Hadad nkyɛn. Yoas dii ne so nkonim mprɛnsa, na ɔgyee Israel nkuro no bio.
14: Yehoahas ba, Israel hene Yoas afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu no, Yuda hene Yoas ba Amasia bɛdii hene.
Ahemfo 14
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade ani so, nanso wanto ne nana Dawid. Deɛ ne papa Yoas yɛeɛ no, ɛno ara bi na ɔno nso yɛeɛ.
Nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no nko na amfiri hɔ. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ.
Berɛ a ahennie no timm ne nsam ara pɛ na ɔkunkum ne nkoa a wɔkum ne papa, ɔhene no.

Awudifoɔ no mma deɛ, wanku wɔn, na ɔyɛɛ deɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara nwoma no mu sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ sɛ: “Monnkum agyanom deɛ wɔn mma ayɛ ho nti, na monnkum mma deɛ wɔn agyanom ayɛ ho nti; na mmom obiara bɔne na monhwɛ ho nku no.”
Ɔno na ɔkunkum Edomfoɔ wɔ Nkyene Bɔn no mu, mmarima mpem du, na ɔgyee Sela wɔ ɛko no mu, na ɔtoo hɔ din Yokteel de bɛsi nnɛ.
Saa berɛ no, Amasia tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Yehu ba Yehoahas ba, Israel hene Yehoas nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Bra ma yɛmfa nsi ani.”

Na Israel hene Yehoas nso soma kɔka kyerɛɛ Yuda hene Amasia sɛ: “Lebanon nkasɛɛ-nkasɛɛ soma kɔka kyerɛɛ Lebanon tweneduro sɛ, ‘Fa wo babaa ma me babarima nware.’ Nanso, Lebanon wuram aboa bi a ɔretwam tiatiaa nkasɛɛ-nkasɛɛ no so kuu no.
Woaka Edom agu, enti w’akoma ama ne ho so. Fa w’animuonyam na hwɛ so tena wo fie. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wodi aperepereɛ na wo ne Yuda nyinaa ahwe aseɛ?”
Nanso Amasia antie. Enti Israel hene Yehoas kɔeɛ, na ɔne Yuda hene Amasia de kɔsii ani wɔ Bet-Semes, Yuda asase so.
Na Yuda dii nkoguo wɔ Israel anim maa obiara dwane kɔɔ ne ntomadan mu.

Na Yuda hene Amasia, Yehoas ba, Ahasia ba no deɛ, Israel hene Yehoas kyee no wɔ Bet-Semes, na ɔde no baa Yerusalem, na ɔbɛbuu Yerusalem fasuo no guu mu, ɛfiri Efraim Pono ano kɔsi Ntwea Pono no ano, basafa ahanan.
Ɔsesaa sika ne dwetɛ ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ Awurade fie nyinaa ne ahemfie hɔ akoradeɛ, na ɔfaa ebinom nnommum kaa ho san kɔɔ Samaria.
Yehoas ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne nnwuma akɛseɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔne Yuda hene Amasia koeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yehoas ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo ho, na ne ba Yeroboam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Israel hene Yoas, Yehoahas ba no wuo akyi no, Yuda hene Amasia, Yehoas ba no, tenaa ase mfeɛ dunum kaa ho.
Amasia ho nsɛm a aka no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Akyire yi, wɔ bɔɔ ne ho pɔ wɔ Yerusalem, enti ɔdwane kɔɔ Lakis; nanso wɔsoma tii no Lakis kɔkuu no wɔ hɔ.
Enti wɔde no too apɔnkɔ so bɛsiee no Yerusalem kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ Dawid Kuro mu.
Afei Yuda man no nyinaa faa Asaria a saa berɛ no na wadi mfeɛ dunsia no, na wɔsii no hene maa no dii ne papa Amasia adeɛ.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elat na ɔsan de maa Yuda berɛ a ɔhene no ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ no.
Yoas ba, Yuda hene Amasia afe a ɛtɔ so dunum mu no, Israel hene Yoas ba Yeroboam bɛdii hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ aduanan baako.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne. Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no, wannane amfiri emu biara ho.
Ɔno na ɔsan gyee Israel ahyeɛ maa wɔn, ɛfiri Hamat kɔsi po a ɛwɔ Araba no ano, sɛdeɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Yona, Amitai ba, odiyifoɔ a ɔfiri Gat-Hefer so kaeɛ no teɛ.
Na Awurade hunuu amanehunu pii a Israel faa mu no. Na ɛyɛ nwono papa, ɛfiri sɛ na akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ ne ɔboafoɔ bi nni Israel.
Nanso na Awurade ahyɛ bɔ sɛ ɔrempepa Israel din mfiri ɔsoro ase. Enti ɔnam Yehoas ba Yeroboam nsa so gyee wɔn.
Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne nnwuma akɛseɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔdii ako na ɔsan de Damasko ne Hamat maa Yuda wɔ Israel no, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yeroboam ne n’agyanom Israel ahemfo no kɔdaeɛ, na ne ba Sakaria bɛdii n’adeɛ.
15: Israel hene Yeroboam afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson mu no, Yuda hene Amasia ba Asaria bɛdii hene.
Ahemfo 15
Ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade ani so sɛdeɛ ne papa Amasia yɛeɛ no ara.
Gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no nko na amfiri hɔ. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ.
Akyire yi, Awurade de yareɛ bɔɔ ɔhene no, na ɔyaree kwata kɔsii ne wuda; ɔkɔtenaa ne fie, na ɔhene no ba Yotam na ɔhwɛɛ fie no soɔ, na ɔno na ɔbuu ɔman no mu nnipa atɛn.
Asaria ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Asaria ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ Dawid Kuro mu, na ne ba Yotam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nwɔtwe mu no, Yeroboam ba Sakaria bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria abosome nsia.
Na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ n’agyanom yɛeɛ no. Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no, wannane amfiri ho.
Na Yebes ba Salum bɔɔ ne ho pɔ, na ɔbɔɔ no kuu no wɔ Yibleam, na ɔbɛdii n’adeɛ.
Sakaria ho nsɛm a aka no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Saa na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: “Wobɛnya mma a wɔbɛtena Israel ahennwa soɔ de akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nnan so.” Na ɛbaa mu saa.
Yebes ba Salum bɛdii hene wɔ Yuda hene Usia afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nkron mu, na ɔdii adeɛ bosome baako pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ Samaria.
Na Gadi ba Menahem siim firii Tirsa kɔɔ Samaria, na ɔkɔbɔɔ Yebes ba Salum kuu no wɔ Samaria, na ɔbɛdii n’adeɛ.
Salum ho nsɛm a aka ne pɔ a ɔbɔeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Saa berɛ no, Menahem firi Tirsa kɔsɛee Tifsa ne deɛ ɛwom nyinaa ne ne nsase; ɛfiri sɛ wɔanhini no nti, ɔsɛee no. Emu apemfoɔ nso, ɔpaepaee wɔn nyinaa mu.
Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nkron mu no, Gadi ba Menahem bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ du.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne. Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no, wannane amfiri emu biara ho, ne nna nyinaa mu.
Na Asiria hene Pul baa asase no so. Enti Menahem maa Pul dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ apem sɛ ɔnsɔ ne mu mmoa no mma ahennie no nyɛ den ne nsam.
Israelfoɔ nkyɛn na Menahem gyegyee dwetɛ no, adefoɔ no nyinaa hɔ; ɔgyee obiara hɔ dwetɛ nnwetɛbena aduonum, na ɔde maa Asiria hene. Ɛno nti Asiria hene sanee n’akyi, na wantena asase no so hɔ.
Menahem ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Menahem ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na ne ba Pekahia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum mu no, na Menahem ba Pekahia bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ mmienu.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne. Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no, wannane amfiri ho.
Na ne kunini Remalia ba Peka bɔɔ ne ho pɔ, na ɔne Gileadfoɔ aduonum bɔɔ no kuu no wɔ Samaria ahemfie abantenten no mu, ɔne Argob ne Arie. Ɔkum no, na ɔbɛdii n’adeɛ.
Pekahia ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Yuda hene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum mmienu mu no, na Remalia ba Peka bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ aduonu.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne. Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Israel nso yɛɛ bɔne no, wannane amfiri ho.
Israel hene Peka nna mu no, Asiria hene Tiglat-Pilesa bɛfaa Eyon ne Abel-Bet-Maaka ne Yanoa ne Kedes ne Hasor ne Gilead ne Galilea, Naftali nsase nyinaa, na ɔfaa wɔn nnommum kɔɔ Asiria.
Na Ela ba Hosea bɔɔ Remalia ba Peka ho pɔ, na ɔbɔɔ no kuu no, na ɔbɛdii n’adeɛ Usia ba Yotam afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu mu.
Peka ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Remalia ba, Israel hene Peka afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu na Yuda hene Usia ba Yotam bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu nnum, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dunsia wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Yerusa a ɔyɛ Sadok babaa.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade ani so. Sɛdeɛ ne papa Usia yɛeɛ no, saa na ɔno nso yɛeɛ.
Gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no nko na amfiri hɔ. Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ. Ɔno na ɔsii Awurade fie pono a ɛwɔ atifi fam no.
Yotam ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Nna no mu na Awurade maa Siria hene Resin ne Remalia ba Peka kɔɔ Yuda soɔ.
Na Yotam ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ ne nana Dawid Kuro mu, na ne ba Ahas bɛdii n’adeɛ.
16: Remalia ba Peka afe a ɛtɔ so dunson mu na Yuda hene Yotam ba Ahas bɛdii hene.
Ahemfo 16
Nanso Israel ahemfo akwan so na ɔfaeɛ; ɔmaa ɔno ara ne ba mpo faa gya mu de no bɔɔ afɔdeɛ nam so yɛɛ akyiwadeɛ a amanaman a Awurade pamoo wɔn firii Israelfoɔ anim yɛeɛ no bi.
Na ɔkɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na ɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea ne nkokoɔ so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa bi ase.
Saa berɛ no mu na Siria hene Resin ne Remalia ba Peka a ɔyɛ Israel hene no baa Yerusalem so sɛ wɔne wɔn rebɛko, na wɔkaa Ahas hyɛɛ mu, nanso wɔantumi wɔn.
Berɛ no ara mu na Siria hene Resin san gyee Elat maa Edom, na ɔpamoo Yudafoɔ no firii Elat maa Edomfoɔ no kɔɔ hɔ kɔtenaa hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Enti Ahas tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Asiria hene Tiglat-Pilesa nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Meyɛ w’akoa ne wo ba, enti bra bɛgye me firi Siria hene nsam ne Israel hene nsam na wɔasɔre aba me so.”
Ahas sesaa dwetɛ ne sika a ɛwɔ Awurade fie ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu no, na ɔsoma maa wɔde kɔmaa Asiria hene sɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ.
Ɛnna Asiria hene tiee no, na Asiria hene kɔɔ Damasko kɔgyeeɛ; ɔde emu nnipa kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Kir, na ɔkum Resin.
Na Ɔhene Ahas siim kɔhyiaa Asiria hene Tiglat-Pilesa wɔ Damasko, na ɔkɔhunuu afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Damasko no. Enti Ɔhene Ahas soma maa wɔde afɔrebukyia no nsususoɔ ne ne yɛbea nyinaa kɔmaa ɔsɔfoɔ Uriya.
Na ɔsɔfoɔ Uriya sii afɔrebukyia no. Sɛdeɛ Ɔhene Ahas soma firii Damasko bɛka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Uriya no, saa ara na ɔyɛɛ no de twɛnee sɛ Ɔhene Ahas bɛfiri Damasko aba.
Berɛ a ɔhene firi Damasko baeɛ no, ɔhene bɛhunuu afɔrebukyia no, na ɔhene twe bɛnee afɔrebukyia no, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ so.
Na ɔtoaa so bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’aduane afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ɔhwiee afɔrebɔ nsa guu so na ɔpetee n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya nso wɔ so.
Na kɔbere afɔrebukyia a ɛsi Awurade anim no, ɔyi firii fie no anim, n’afɔrebukyia no ne Awurade fie no ntam, na ɔde bɛsii n’afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn wɔ atifi fam.

Na Ɔhene Ahas hyɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Uriya sɛ: “Afɔrebukyia kɛseɛ no so na bɔ anɔpa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne anwummerɛ aduane afɔdeɛ ne ɔhene hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’aduane afɔdeɛ ne asase no so nnipa nyinaa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ, na hwie wɔn afɔrebɔ nsa gu so; ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya ne afɔrebɔ mogya no nyinaa nso, pete no so. Kɔbere afɔrebukyia no deɛ, mɛhwɛ deɛ mede bɛyɛ.”
Na ɔsɔfoɔ Uriya yɛɛ deɛ Ɔhene Ahas hyɛeɛ no nyinaa.

Bio nso, Ɔhene Ahas twitwaa nnaka a wɔde twe nsuo no ho nhyehyɛmu ntraantraa no mu asinasini, na ɔyiyii asɛn no firii so; ɔyii po no firii kɔbere anantwie a ɛtaa wɔn akyi no so, na ɔde sii mmoseaa bi so.
Homeda abrannaa a wɔakuru soɔ a wɔasi no fie hɔ ne ɔhene abɔnten kwan ano no nso, ɔyi firii Awurade fie hɔ, Asiria hene nti.
Ahas ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Ahas ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho wɔ Dawid Kuro mu, na ne ba Hesekia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
17: Yuda hene Ahas afe a ɛtɔ so dumienu mu no, na Ela ba Hosea bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ nkron.
Ahemfo 17
Ɔno na Asiria hene Salmaneser baa ne soɔ, na Hosea bɛyɛɛ n’akoa na ɔfirii aseɛ tuaa toɔ maa no.

Nanso Asiria hene hunuu sɛ Hosea pɛ sɛ ɔte atua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Egypt hene a wɔfrɛ no So nkyɛn, na ɛtoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtua ma Asiria hene no, wantua sɛdeɛ na ɔyɛ kane mfeɛ mu no. Enti Asiria hene kyekyeree no too afiase too ne mu.
Asiria hene tu baa asase no nyinaa so, na ɔbaa Samaria bɛtwaa ho hyiaa mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.
Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so nkron mu na Asiria hene dii Samaria so nkonim, na ɔde Israelfoɔ kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Asiria, na ɔde wɔn kɔtenatenaa Hala ne Habor wɔ asubɔnten Gosan ho ne Mediafoɔ nkuro mu.
Na deɛ ɛmaa no baa saa ne sɛ, Israelfoɔ yɛɛ bɔne tiaa Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wɔn firii Egypt asase so wɔ Egypt hene Farao nsam no, na wɔkɔsom anyame foforɔ;
na wɔnantee amanaman a Awurade pamoo wɔn firii Israelfoɔ anim no ahyɛdeɛ mu, ne Israel ahemfo ahyɛdeɛ a wɔn ara wɔhyehyɛeɛ mu.
Na Israelfoɔ yɛɛ Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn ani so bɔne, na wɔsisii sorɔnsorɔmmea wɔn nkuro nyinaa mu, ɛfiri awɛmfoɔ aban so kɔsi kuro a wɔabɔ ho ban so;
wɔsisii abosom adum ne abosonnua wɔ nkokoɔ atenten so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa bi ase;
wɔkɔɔ so hyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea no so sɛ amanaman a wɔn nti Awurade de wɔn kɔɔ nkoasom mu no, na wɔyɛɛ nneɛma bɔne de hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo.
Wɔsom abosom fi a Awurade kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnyɛ saa adeɛ yi” no;

Na Awurade nam n’adiyifoɔ nyinaa ne adehunufoɔ nyinaa so bɔɔ Israel ne Yuda kɔkɔ sɛ: “Monnane mfiri mo akwammɔne ho, na monni me mmara nsɛm ne m’ahyɛdeɛ so sɛdeɛ mmara a mede maa mo agyanom na menam me nkoa adiyifoɔ so de brɛɛ mo no teɛ”.
Nanso wɔantie na wɔsensenee wɔn kɔn sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom a wɔannye Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn annie no sensenee wɔn kɔn no;

wɔpoo n’ahyɛdeɛ ne apam a ɔne wɔn agyanom yɛeɛ ne ne nkaesɛm a ɔde bɔɔ wɔn kɔkɔ no, na wɔkɔdii abosonhuhuo akyi, na wɔn nso bɛyɛɛ ahuhufoɔ, na wɔsuasuaa amanaman a atwa wɔn ho ahyia a Awurade hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnyɛ sɛ wɔn no nyinaa.
Na wɔgyaa Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa, na wɔyeyɛɛ dadeɛ ahoni, anantwie mma mmienu, na wɔyɛɛ bosom dua, na wɔkotoo ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na wɔsom Baal;
wɔmaa wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa faa gya mu na wɔhyehyɛɛ abosonkɔm kɔɔ abisa, na wɔtɔn wɔn ho yɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne de hyɛɛ no abufuo.
Enti Awurade bo fuu Israel pii, na ɔyii wɔn firii n’anim. Wamma obiara anka, gye Yuda abusuakuo no nko.
Yuda mpo anni Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, na mmom Israel ahemfo ahyɛdeɛ a wɔn ara wɔhyehyɛeɛ no mu na wɔnanteeɛ.
Ɛno nti Awurade poo Israel asefoɔ nyinaa na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase de wɔn hyɛɛ afomfoɔ nsa kɔsii sɛ ɔtoo wɔn firii n’anim tweneeɛ.
Na ɔtee Israel firii Dawid fie ho, na wɔde Nebat ba Yeroboam sii hene; Yeroboam danee Israel firii Awurade akyi, na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ bɔne kɛse.
Na Israelfoɔ nantee Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa mu. Wɔantwe wɔn ho amfiri ho,
kɔsii sɛ Awurade too Israel firii n’anim tweneeɛ sɛdeɛ ɔnam ne nkoa adiyifoɔ no nyinaa so kaeɛ no. Enti Israel firii wɔn asase so kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Asiria de bɛsi nnɛ.
Ɛnna Asiria hene de nnipa firi Babilon ne Kuta ne Awa ne Hamat ne Sefarwayim bɛtenatenaa Samaria nkuro mu, na wɔbɛsii Israelfoɔ ananmu, na wɔfaa Samaria tenatenaa ɛhɔ nkuro mu.
Berɛ a wɔbɛtenaa hɔ foforɔ no, na wɔnsuro Awurade. Enti Awurade maa agyata kɔɔ wɔn mu kɔkunkum wɔn mu binom.

Ɛnna wɔsoma kɔka kyerɛɛ Asiria hene sɛ: “Amanaman a woafa wɔn nnommum de wɔn akɔtenatena Samaria nkuro mu no, ɛsiane sɛ wɔnnim sɛdeɛ wɔsom asase no Nyame nti, ɔsoma agyata ba wɔn mu; na hwɛ! ku ara na wɔrekunkum wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ obiara nnim sɛdeɛ wɔsom asase no Nyame.”
Ɛnna Asiria hene hyɛɛ sɛ: “Momfa asɔfoɔ a mofaa wɔn nnommum wɔ hɔ no baako nkɔ hɔ, na ɔnkɔtena hɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔsom asase no Nyame.”
Enti asɔfoɔ a wɔfaa wɔn nnommum firii Samaria no baako kɔɔ hɔ, na ɔkɔtenaa Betel kyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔnsom Awurade.
Nanso amanaman no biara yɛɛ ne nyame, na wɔde wɔn sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ adan a Samariafoɔ sisiiɛ no mu. Ɔman biara yɛɛ ne deɛ wɔ kuro a wɔte mu no mu.
Babilonfoɔ yɛɛ Sukot-Benot, na Kutfoɔ yɛɛ Nergal, na Hamatfoɔ nso yɛɛ Asima.
Awafoɔ yɛɛ Nibhas ne Tartak, na Sefarwayimfoɔ hyee wɔn mma egya mu maa Sefarwayimfoɔ anyame Adramelek ne Anamelek.
Wɔsuroo Awurade, na wɔyeyɛɛ wɔn man mufoɔ asɔfoɔ wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ maa wɔdii wɔn anim som wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ adan no mu.
Wɔsuroo Awurade deɛ, nanso wɔn ara wɔn anyame na wɔsom wɔn, sɛdeɛ amanaman a wɔyii wɔn firii wɔn mu kɔɔ nkoasom mu no som teɛ.

Ɛde bɛsi nnɛ no, wɔda so ara som sɛdeɛ na wɔyɛ kane no. Wɔn mu biara ansom Awurade, na n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmusɛm ne ne mmara ne mmara nsɛm a Awurade de maa Yakob a ɔbɛfrɛɛ no Israel no mma nso, wɔn mu biara anni so;
ɛhɔ na Awurade ne wɔn yɛɛ apam na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnsuro anyame foforɔ, monnkoto wɔn, monnsom wɔn, na mommmɔ afɔdeɛ mmma wɔn.
Na mmom Awurade a ɔde tumi kɛseɛ ne nsa a watene mu yii mo firii Egypt no, ɔno na monnsuro no, na ɔno na monkoto no, na mommɔ afɔdeɛ mma no.
Na ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm ne mmara ne mmara nsɛm a ɔtwerɛ maa mo no, monhwɛ nni so daa; na monnsuro anyame foforɔ.
Na apam a me ne mo ayɛ no, mommma mo werɛ mmfiri; monnsuro anyame foforɔ.
Na mmom Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nko ara na monnsuro no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔbɛgye mo afiri mo atamfo nyinaa nsam.”
Nanso wɔantie, na mmom wɔsom sɛdeɛ wɔsom kane no.
Amanaman yi suroo Awurade deɛ, nanso wɔn ahoni a wɔasene na wɔsom wɔn. Wɔn mma ne wɔn mma nana nso, sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom yɛeɛ no, saa ara na wɔn nso ayɛ de abɛsi nnɛ.
18: Ɛbaa sɛ Ela ba, Israel hene Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, na Yuda hene Ahas ba Hesekia bɛdii hene.
Ahemfo 18
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade ani so sɛdeɛ ne nana Dawid yɛeɛ no ara.

Ɔno na ɔyiyii sorɔnsorɔmmea no, na ɔbubuu abosom adum no pasaa, ɔtwaa bosom dua no, na ɔbubuu kɔbere ɔwɔ a Mose yɛeɛ no nso pasaa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛde bɛsi saa berɛ no, na Israelfoɔ hye aduhwam ma no, na wɔfrɛ no kɔbere ɔwɔ honi no sɛ Nehustan.
Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn so na ɔde ne ho toeɛ; n’akyi no, obiara amma sɛ ɔno, Yuda ahemfo mu, obiara anni n’anim saa.
Ɔbataa Awurade ho. Wannane amfiri n’akyi, na mmom ɔdii Awurade mmara nsɛm a ɔhyɛɛ Mose no so.
Na Awurade dii n’akyi. Ɔyɛɛ n’adeɛ nyansa mu wɔ biribiara mu; ɔtee Asiria hene so atua, na wansom no.
Ɔno na ɔkunkum Filistifoɔ kɔduruu Gasa ne n’ahyeɛ so, ɛfiri awɛmfoɔ abantenten so kɔsii kuro a wɔabɔ ho ban so.
Na Ɔhene Hesekia afe a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛyɛ Ela ba, Israel hene Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so nson mu no, Asiria hene Salmaneser baa Samaria so bɛtwaa ho hyiaeɛ.
Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa rekɔ awieeɛ no, ɔdii so nkonim; Hesekia afe a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛyɛ Israel hene Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so nkron mu na wɔdii Samaria so nkonim.
Ɛno akyi no, Asiria hene de Israelfoɔ kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Asiria, na ɔde wɔn kɔtenatenaa Hala ne Habor wɔ asubɔnten Gosan ho ne Mediafoɔ nkuro mu,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔantie Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn nne, na mmom wɔbuu n’apam so, kyerɛ sɛ, deɛ Awurade akoa Mose hyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa; wɔantie na wɔanyɛ.
Na ɔhene Hesekia afe a ɛtɔ so dunan mu no, Asiria hene Senaherib baa Yuda nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban no nyinaa so bɛfaeɛ.

Ɛnna Yuda hene Hesekia soma kɔɔ Asiria hene nkyɛn wɔ Lakis sɛ: “Mayɛ bɔne. San firi me so, na deɛ wode bɛto me soɔ biara, mɛtua.” Enti Asiria hene kaa sɛ Yuda hene Hesekia ntua dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ahasa ne sika dwetikɛseɛ aduasa.
Na Hesekia de dwetɛ a ɛwɔ Awurade fie ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu no nyinaa maa no.
Saa berɛ no, Hesekia twitwaa Awurade asɔrefie no apono ne aponnwa a Yuda hene Hesekia de sika duraa ho no, na ɔde maa Asiria hene.

Na Asiria hene somaa Tartan ne Rabsaris ne Rabsake firii Lakis de asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ kaa wɔn ho sɛ wɔnkɔ Ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem, enti wɔsiim kɔɔ Yerusalem. Wɔkɔeɛ no, wɔkɔgyinaa atifi fam tadeɛ no suka ho, tempɔn a ɛkɔ ntomasifoɔ asase soɔ no so.
Na wɔteaam frɛɛ ɔhene no, na Hilkia ba Eliakim a ɔyɛ fiepanin, ne Sebna a ɔyɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ, ne Asaf ba Yoa a ɔyɛ ɔhene krakye bɛhyiaa wɔn.
Ɛnna Rabsake ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkɔka nkyerɛ Hesekia sɛ, ‘Deɛ ɔhenkɛseɛ, Asiria hene, seɛ nie: “Ɛdeɛn koraa na wode wo ho ato soɔ yi?
Wosusu sɛ anosɛm nko yɛ akodie ho nyansa ne mmaninyɛ! Hwɛ, hwan koraa na wode wo ho ato ne so a enti woate atua atia me yi?
Wo ara hwɛ! Egypt na wode wo ho ato ne soɔ, demmire a emu abuo a sɛ onipa twere a ɛbɛwɔ ne nsam ahwire mu yi. Saa na Egypt hene Farao teɛ ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to ne soɔ nyinaa.

Na sɛ moka kyerɛ me sɛ, ‘Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛde yɛn ho ato ne so’ a, ɛnyɛ ɔno ara na Hesekia atutu ne sorɔnsorɔmmea ne n’afɔrebukyia na waka akyerɛ Yuda ne Yerusalem sɛ: ‘Afɔrebukyia yi anim na monkoto wɔ Yerusalem’ no?”’
Afei wopɛ a, wo ne me wura Asiria hene nto nkyea na memma wo apɔnkɔ mpem mmienu, na hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi anya mmarima atenatena so anaa.
Na sɛ nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ nti na wode wo ho ato Egypt so a, wobɛyɛ dɛn atumi ako atia me wura nkoa nkumaa no mu amrado baako mpo?
Wogye di sɛ Awurade amma me kwan a anka mɛba sɛ merebɛsɛe ha? Awurade na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Kɔ asase yi so na kɔsɛe no.’”
Ɛnna Hilkia ba Eliakim ne Sebna ne Yoa ka kyerɛɛ Rabsake sɛ: “Yɛsrɛ wo, wo ne wo nkoa nka Siria kasa, na yɛte; wo ne yɛn nnka Yudafoɔ kasa mmma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ fasuo no soɔ no nnte.”
Nanso Rabsake ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mo wura ne mo nti na me wura somaa me sɛ memmɛka nsɛm yi anaa? Ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔtete fasuo no soɔ nti, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma wɔadi wɔn tiafi na wɔanom wɔn dwonsɔ sɛ mo ara?”
Afei Rabsake gyinaa yie, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam wɔ Yudafoɔ kasa mu kaa sɛ: “Montie ɔhenkɛseɛ, Asiria hene no, asɛm.
Deɛ ɔhene aka nie, ‘Mommma Hesekia nnnaadaa mo, na ɔrentumi nnye mo mfiri me nsam.
Monnni Hesekia akyi mmfa mo ho nnto Awurade so nnka sɛ: “Ɔgyeɛ na Awurade bɛgye yɛn, na ɔremfa kuro yi nhyɛ Asiria hene nsa.”
Monntie Hesekia, na Asiria hene aka sɛ: “Mongo mo ho mma me na mommra me nkyɛn na obiara nni ɔno ara ne bobe ne ne borɔdɔma, na ɔnnom ɔno ara n’abura mu nsuo,

nkɔsi sɛ mɛba abɛfa mo akɔ asase a ɛte sɛ mo ara mo asase soɔ, asase a ayuo ne nsa foforɔ wɔ soɔ, asase a paanoo ne bobe nturo wɔ soɔ, asase a ngodua ne ɛwoɔ wɔ soɔ, na moatena nkwa mu, na moanwuwu. Monntie Hesekia ɛfiri sɛ sɛ ɔka sɛ, ‘Awurade bɛgye yɛn’ a, na ɔredaadaa mo.
Amanaman no anyame no bi atumi agye ne nkurɔfoɔ afiri Asiria hene nsam pɛn?
Hamat ne Arpad anyame no wɔ he? Sefarwayim ne Hena ne Iwa anyame no nso wɔ he? Wɔatumi agye Samaria afiri me nsam anaa?
Amanaman no anyame nyinaa mu hwan na watumi agye ne man afiri me nsam a enti Awurade bɛtumi agye Yerusalem afiri me nsam?”’”
Nanso nkurɔfoɔ no yɛɛ komm na wɔanka asɛm biara, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔhene aka sɛ: “Mommmua no.”
Ɛnna Hilkia ba Eliakim a ɔyɛ efiepanin, ne Sebna a ɔyɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ, ne Asaf ba Yoa a ɔyɛ ɔhene krakye sunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu kɔɔ Hesekia nkyɛn, na wɔkaa Rabsake nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
19: Berɛ a Ɔhene Hesekia tee asɛm no ara na ɔsuanee n’atadeɛ mu na ɔfiraa atweaatam kɔɔ Awurade fie.
Ahemfo 19
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ Hesekia aka nie, ‘Ɛnnɛ yɛ ahohiahia ne animka ne nsopa da, ɛfiri sɛ mma abɛduru awotwaa ano, nanso ahoɔden nni hɔ a wɔde bɛwo wɔn.

Ebia Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn bɛte Rabsake nsɛm no nyinaa; ɔno na ne wura Asiria hene asoma no sɛ ɔmmɛsopa Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no. Na nsɛm a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ateɛ no nti, ɔbɛma no abu ho akonta. Ɛno nti bɔ mpaeɛ ma wɔn a wɔaka wɔ ha no.’”
Enti Ɔhene Hesekia nkoa no kɔɔ Yesaia nkyɛn.
Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkɔka nkyerɛ mo wura sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie: “Mma nsɛm a Asiria hene nkoa aka atia me a woteeɛ no mmmɔ wo hu.
Hwɛ, mede honhom bi bɛhyɛ ne mu, na ɔbɛte amanneɛbɔ bi na wasan akɔ n’asase so, na mɛma no atɔ nkrantɛ ano wɔ ɔno ara n’asase so.”’”
Afei Rabsake san n’akyi kɔeɛ, na ɔkɔtoo sɛ Asiria hene ne Libna reko. Saa berɛ no na wate sɛ wafiri Lakis.
Na ɔhene no ate sɛ Etiopia hene Tirhaka aba sɛ ɔne no rebɛko. Enti ɔsan somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Hesekia nkyɛn sɛ:
“Monkɔka nkyerɛ Yuda hene Hesekia sɛ, ‘Mma wo Nyankopɔn a wode wo ho ato ne soɔ no nnnaadaa wo sɛ: “Wɔremfa Yerusalem nhyɛ Asiria hene nsa.”
Hwɛ, wo ara woate deɛ Asiria ahemfo de yɛɛ nsase no nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔsɛee wɔn pasaa no; wo na wobɛnya wo tiri adidi mu anaa?
Aman a m’agyanom sɛee wɔn no anyame tumi gyee wɔn anaa? Wɔtumi gyee Gosan ne Haran ne Resef ne Eden mma a na wɔwɔ Tel-Asar no?
Ɛhe na Hamat hene ne Arpad hene ne Sefarwayim ne Hena ne Iwa nkuro so ahemfo no wɔ?’”
Ɛnna Hesekia gyee krataa no firii abɔfoɔ no nsam kenkaneeɛ, na Hesekia kɔɔ Awurade fie kɔtrɛɛ mu wɔ Awurade anim.
Na Hesekia bɔɔ mpaeɛ Awurade anim sɛ: “O Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a wote kerubim soɔ, wo nko ara wone Nyankopɔn, asase so ahennie nyinaa so. Wo na woyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase.
O Awurade, yɛ aso na tie. Awurade, bue w’ani, na hwɛ, na tie nsɛm a Senaherib asoma sɛ wɔmfa mmɛtwa Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no mpoa.
O Awurade, ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ Asiria ahemfo asɛe amanaman ne wɔn nsase,
na wɔtoo wɔn anyame guu egya mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnyɛ anyame, na mmom wɔyɛ nnipa nsa ano adwuma, nnua ne aboɔ, enti wɔsɛee wɔn.
Enti afei, O Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛsrɛ wo, gye yɛn firi ne nsam na asase so ahennie nyinaa nhunu sɛ wo, Awurade, wo nko ara ne Onyankopɔn.”
Na Amos ba Yesaia soma kɔka kyerɛɛ Hesekia sɛ: “Deɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Mpaeɛ a woabɔ no Asiria hene Senaherib ho no, mate.
Awurade asɛm a waka atia no nie: “Sion babaa, ɔbaabunu no, abu wo animtia, na wo ho yɛ no sere. Yerusalem babaa no awoso ne ti wɔ w’akyi.
Hwan na woatwa no mpoa akasa atia no yi? Hwan na woama wo nne so wɔ ne soɔ Na wohaahaa w’ani kyerɛ no yi? Wode atia Israel Kronkronni no!

Wonam abɔfoɔ so atwa Awurade mpoa aka sɛ, ‘Mede me nteaseɛnam bebree no bɛkɔ, Mede bɛforo akɔ mmepɔ atifi, Na makɔ Lebanon akyirikyiri nohoa; Mɛtwitwa ne ntweneduro atenten no ne ne popaw nnua fɛfɛ no agu. Mɛhyɛn mu akɔduru ne tenabea a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri nohoa, ne kwaeɛbirentuo mu.
Me na matutu fam na manom amannɔne nsuo, Na mede me nammuromu ama Egypt Nil nsuka nyinaa awe.’
Adɛn wonteeɛ anaa, sɛ mebɔɔ me tirim sɛ mɛyɛ akyɛ? Ɛfiri tete na mehyɛ too hɔ. Na wobɛma nkuro a ɛyɛ den adane amamfo a wɔayɛ no pasaa.
Na emu nnipa nsam bɛhodwo; Ehu bɛka wɔn na wɔn anim agu ase. Wɔbɛyɛ sɛ asase so wura ne serɛ mono, Wɔbɛyɛ sɛ dan so serɛ a apueeɛ mframa ama no ahoa.
Nanso menim w'asetena, ne w'adifire ne wo muba nyinaa, Na menim sɛdeɛ w’ani abere me soɔ,

Ɛsiane sɛ wabɔ me so dam, na w'ahantan aforo abɛduru m'aso mu nti, me nso mede me daawa bɛwura wo hwene mu na mede me nnareka ato w’ano, Na ɛkwan a wofaa so baa ha no, ɛno ara so na mɛma woafa akorɔ.”

“‘Yei bɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne ama wo: Afe yi, mobɛdi ntwakaeɛ a afifire; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, mobɛdi aba a ɛno ara afifire; nanso afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no deɛ, mongu aba na montwa, na monyɛ bobe nturo na monni mu aba.
Na Yuda fiefoɔ a wɔafiri mu aka no bɛgye nhini akɔ fam, na wɔbɛnyini akɔ soro na wɔaso aba.
Na nkaefoɔ bi bɛfiri Yerusalem aba, na nnipa a wɔafiri mu aka bɛfiri Bepɔ Sion so aba. Asafo Awurade ninkuntwe na ɛbɛyɛ yei.
“‘Ɛno nti na Awurade aka yei afa Asiria hene ho no: “Ɔremma kuro yi mu, na ɔrento agyan mma ha; ɔremfa ɛkyɛm mma ha, na ɔrensi akoban wɔ ho.
Awurade na ɔseɛ, ɛkwan a ɔfaa so baeɛ no ara so na ɔbɛfa akorɔ, na ɔremma kuro yi mu.
Na ko na mɛko agye kuro yi, me ara ne m’akoa Dawid nti.”’”
Na anadwo no ara Awurade bɔfoɔ firi kɔkunkum Asiriafoɔ nsraban no mu nnipa mpem ɔha aduɔwɔtwe nnum (185,000). Berɛ a nkurɔfoɔ sɔree anɔpatutuutu no, wɔnkɔhwɛ a, wɔn nyinaa afunu sam hɔ.
Ɛno nti Asiria hene Senaherib san n’akyi kɔeɛ, na ɔkɔtenaa Niniwe.
Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a ɔkɔɔ ne nyame Nisrok fie kɔkotoeɛ no, ɔno ara ne mma Adramelek ne Sareser de nkrantɛ kumm no, na wɔdwane kɔɔ Ararat asase so. Na ne ba Esar-Haddon bɛdii n’adeɛ.
20: Berɛ bi owuyareɛ bɔɔ Hesekia. Na Amos ba odiyifoɔ Yesaia baa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Hyɛ wo fie nsamanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wobɛwu, na worennya nkwa.’”
Ahemfo 20
“O Awurade, mesrɛ wo, kae sɛdeɛ mede nokorɛdie ne akoma mu anante w’anim, na mayɛ deɛ ɛsɔ w’ani biara.” Na Hesekia suu pii.
Na ɛbaa sɛ Yesaia nnya mfirii ahemfie adihɔ no, Awurade asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ:

“San w’akyi na kɔka kyerɛ me man kannifoɔ Hesekia sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade, wo nana Dawid Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: “Mate wo mpaebɔ no. Mahunu wo nisuo, hwɛ, mɛsa wo yareɛ. Da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wobɛforo akɔ Awurade fie.
Na mede mfeɛ dunum bɛka wo nna ho, na mɛgye wo ne kuro yi afiri Asiria hene nsam, na mɛbɔ kuro yi ho ban, me ne m’akoa Dawid nti.”’”
Na Yesaia toaa so kaa sɛ: “Momfa borɔdɔma a wɔabɔ no toa mmra.” Enti wɔkɔfa de bɛtaree mpɔmpɔ no so, na nkakrankakra, ne ho tɔɔ no.
Saa berɛ no, Hesekia bisaa Yesaia sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn ne sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Awurade bɛsa me yareɛ na mɛforo akɔ Awurade fie hɔ da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa?”
Ɛnna Yesaia kaa sɛ: “Yei ne sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛfiri Awurade hɔ a ɛbɛma woahunu sɛ Awurade bɛyɛ deɛ waka no: Wopɛ sɛ sunsum no kɔ animu ntwedeɛ du anaa ɛsan n'akyi ntwedeɛ du?”
Na Hesekia kaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ sunsum bɛkɔ animu ntwedeɛ du sene sɛ ɛbɛsan akyire ntwedeɛ du.”
Ɛnna odiyifoɔ Yesaia maa ne nne so kyerɛɛ Awurade, na ɔmaa sunsum no siane n'akyi ntwedeɛ du; ɛsan n'akyi ntwedeɛ du wɔ Ahas ntwedeɛ no so.
Saa berɛ no, Baladan ba, Berodak-Baladan a ɔyɛ Babilon hene no soma maa wɔde nkrataa ne akyɛdeɛ kɔmaa Hesekia, ɛfiri sɛ ɔtee sɛ Hesekia yareeɛ.

Hesekia tiee wɔn, na ɔde n’adekoradan mu nneɛma nyinaa kyerɛɛ wɔn, dwetɛ ne sika ne balsam ngo ne ngo pa ne n’akodeɛ korabea ne biribiara a ɛwɔ n’akoraeɛ. Biribiara nni Hesekia fie ne n’ahemman mu a wamfa ankyerɛ wɔn.
Afei odiyifoɔ Yesaia baa Ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: “Asɛm bɛn na mmarima yi kaeɛ, na ɛhe na wɔfiri baa wo nkyɛn?” Ɛnna Hesekia buaa sɛ: “Wɔfiri akyirikyiri asase so na ɛbaeɛ, Babilon tɔnn.”
Na ɔsan bisaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na wɔhunuu no wo fie?” Ɛnna Hesekia kaa sɛ: “Wɔhunuu biribiara a ɛwɔ me fie. Biribiara nni m’akoraeɛ a mamfa ankyerɛ wɔn.”
Ɛnna Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ Hesekia sɛ: “Tie Awurade asɛm yi,
‘“Hwɛ! Nna bi reba, na deɛ ɛwɔ wo fie a w’agyanom de asie abɛsi nnɛ no nyinaa wɔbɛsoa akɔ Babilon. Biribiara renka,” Awurade asɛm nie.
“Na wɔbɛfa wo ara wo mma a wɔbɛfiri wo mu aba, mmɔfra a wobɛwo wɔn, no bi akɔ ama wɔakɔyɛ nhenkwaa wɔ Babilon hene ahemfie.”’”
Ɛnna Hesekia ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ: “Awurade asɛm a woaka no yɛ.” Na ɔtoaa so kaa sɛ: “Sɛ asomdwoeɛ ne nokorɛ bɛtena hɔ me berɛ so a, ɛyɛ, anaa meboa?”
Hesekia ho nsɛm a aka ne ne nnwuma akɛseɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ tadeɛ ne suka, na ɔde nsuo baa kuro no mu no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Hesekia ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na ne ba Manase bɛdii n’adeɛ.
21: Manase bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ dumienu, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonum nnum wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Hefsiba.
Ahemfo 21
Enti sorɔnsorɔmmea a ne papa Hesekia bubuiɛ no, ɔsan sisiiɛ, na ɔsisii afɔrebukyia maa Baal; ɔsii bosom dua sɛdeɛ Israel hene Ahab yɛeɛ no; ɔkotoo ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na ɔsom wɔn.
Na Awurade fie a Awurade kaa ho asɛm sɛ: “Yerusalem na me din bɛtena” no, ɔsisii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ.
Afei nso ɔsisii afɔrebukyia maa ɔsoro asafo nyinaa wɔ Awurade fie adihɔ mmienu hɔ.
Na ɔmaa ɔno ara ne babarima faa gya mu de no bɔɔ afɔdeɛ, na ɔdii nkonyaayie akyi, ɔkɔɔ abisa, na ɔne akɔmfoɔ ne adunsinfoɔ goroeɛ. Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne kɔɔ akyiri paa de hyɛɛ no abufuo.

Bio nso, ɔde bosom dua a wasene no sɛ ohoni no kɔsii fie hɔ, efie a Awurade kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Dawid ne ne ba Solomon no sɛ: “Efie yi ne Yerusalem a mayi afiri Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu no na mede me din bɛto soɔ akɔsi daa.
Na sɛ Israel hwɛ di deɛ mahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa, mmara a m’akoa Mose hyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa so a, me nso meremma wɔn nan mfiri asase a mede maa wɔn agyanom no so nkɔkyinkyini bio.”
Nanso wɔantie, na Manase daadaa wɔn maa wɔyɛɛ bɔne senee aman a Awurade sɛee wɔn firii Israelfoɔ anim no.
Na Awurade nam ne nkoa adiyifoɔ no so ne wɔn kasaa daa sɛ:
“Ɛsiane sɛ Yuda hene Manase ayɛ akyiwadeɛ yi nti, wayɛ bɔne kyɛn deɛ Amorifoɔ a wɔdii n’anim no yɛeɛ nyinaa, na ɔde n’abosom fi no ama Yuda nso ayɛ bɔne.
Ɛno nti sɛ Awurade, Israel, Nyankopɔn seɛ sɛ nie, ‘Hwɛ, mede mmusuo reba Yerusalem ne Yuda so, na obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, n’aso mmienu nyinaa mu bɛyɛ no kyeoo.
Na susuhoma a wɔde too Samaria soɔ ne susudua a wɔde too Ahab fie soɔ no, ɛno na mɛtwe mu Yerusalem soɔ; mɛpepa Yerusalem korakora sɛdeɛ obi pepa ayowa mu na ɔdane butuo no.
Na mɛpo m’agyapadeɛ nkaeɛ no, na mede wɔn bɛhyɛ wɔn atamfo nsa, na afomdeɛ ne asadeɛ na wɔbɛyɛ ama wɔn atamfo nyinaa,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛɛ m’ani so bɔne, na wɔhyɛɛ me abufuo firii da a wɔn agyanom firii Egypt baeɛ de bɛsi nnɛ da yi.’”
Bio nso, Manase hwiee mogya a ɛdi bem bebree pa guiɛ kɔsii sɛ ɔde hyɛɛ Yerusalem nyinaa ma, ɛfiri ano kɔsi ano, ɛsono bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ a ɛnam so maa Yuda nso yɛɛ bɔne Awurade ani soɔ no.
Manase ho nsɛm a aka, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne bɔne no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Manase ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na wɔsiee no ne fie mfikyifuo mu, Usa mfikyifuo no, na ne ba Amon bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Amon bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu mmienu, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ mmienu wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Mesulemet a ɔyɛ Harus a ɔfiri Yotba no ba.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ ne papa Manase yɛeɛ no.
Akwan a ne papa faa soɔ no nyinaa mu na ɔnanteeɛ, na ɔsom abosom fi a ne papa someeɛ no, na ɔkotoo wɔn.
Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a ɔgyaa Awurade, n’agyanom Nyankopɔn no, na wannante Awurade kwan mu.
Na Amon nkoa bɔɔ ne ho pɔ, na wɔkum ɔhene wɔ ɔno ara ne fie.
Nanso asase no sofoɔ kunkum wɔn a wɔbɔɔ Ɔhene Amon ho pɔ no nyinaa, na asase no sofoɔ de ne ba Yosia sii hene maa no dii n’adeɛ.
Amon ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na wɔsiee no ne damena mu wɔ Usa mfikyifuo no mu, na ne ba Yosia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
22: Yosia bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ nwɔtwe, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduasa baako wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne maame din de Yedida a ɔyɛ Adaia a ɔfiri Boskat no ba.
Ahemfo 22
Ɔhene Yosia afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe mu no, ɔhene somaa Mesulam ba Asalia ba ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan kɔɔ Awurade fie sɛ:
“Kɔ ɔsɔfo panin Hilkia nkyɛn, na ka kyerɛ no sɛ sika a wɔde ba Awurade fie hɔ a apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no boaboa ano firi ɔman no nkyɛn no, ɔmmu ho nkonta mma.
Ma wɔmfa nhyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ no nsa, kyerɛ sɛ, wɔn a wɔdeda adwuma no ano wɔ Awurade fie hɔ no, na wɔde ama nnipa a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ Awurade fie hɔ no ama wɔde asiesie fie no,
adwumfoɔ ne adansifoɔ ne abantofoɔ no, na wɔde bi atɔ nnua a wɔapaeɛ ne aboɔ a wɔapaeɛ a wɔde bɛsiesie fie hɔ.
Nnipa a wɔde sika bɛhyɛ wɔn nsa no deɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔma wɔbu ho nkonta, ɛfiri sɛ nokorɛdie mu na wɔreyɛ adwuma no.”
Akyire yi ɔsɔfo panin Hilkia ka kyerɛɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan sɛ: “Mmara nwoma no, makɔhunu no Awurade fie hɔ.” Enti Hilkia de nwoma no maa Safan, na ɔfirii aseɛ kenkaneeɛ.
Na ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan baa ɔhene anim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Sika a ɛwɔ fie hɔ no, wo nkoa ahwie de ahyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ, ahwɛfoɔ no nsa wɔ Awurade fie hɔ.”
Afei ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia de nwoma bi ama me.” Ɛnna Safan firii aseɛ kenkanee no ɔhene anim.
Na berɛ a ɔhene tee mmara nwoma no mu nsɛm ara pɛ, ɔsunsanee ne ntadeɛ mu.
Ɛnna ɔhene hyɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia ne Safan ba Ahikam ne Mikaia ba Akbor ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan ne ɔhene akoa Asaia sɛ:

“Monkɔ nkɔbisa Awurade mma me ne ɔman no ne Yuda nyinaa, nwoma a wɔahunu yi mu nsɛm nti, na Awurade abufuo a aba yɛn soɔ no so, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn agyanom antie nwoma yi mu nsɛm anyɛ sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ wom afa yɛn ho no nyinaa.”

Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia ne Ahikam ne Akbor ne Safan ne Asaia kɔɔ odiyifoɔbaa Hulda, ntadeɛ sohwɛfoɔ Harhas ba Tikwa ba Salum yere, no nkyɛn; saa berɛ no, na odiyifoɔbaa no te Yerusalem kuro foforɔ no mu, na wɔkɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔno nso ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Deɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie, ‘Monkɔka nkyerɛ ɔbarima a ɔsomaa mo me nkyɛn no sɛ:
“Deɛ Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Hwɛ, mede mmusuo reba kuro yi ne wɔn a wɔtete mu no so; nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma a Yuda hene akenkan no mu nyinaa, mede reba;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya me akɔhye aduhwam ama anyame foforɔ, sɛ wɔde wɔn nsa ano adwuma nyinaa bɛhyɛ me abufuo; enti m’abufuo bɛdɛre atia kuro yi a ɛrennum.’”’
Na Yuda hene a ɔsomaa mo sɛ mommɛbisa Awurade anom asɛm no, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ: ‘Deɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: “Nsɛm a woateɛ no,

sɛ woanyɛ w’akoma den na wobrɛɛ wo ho ase Awurade anim berɛ a wotee nsɛm a maka atia kuro yi ne wɔn a wɔtete mu sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ahodwirideɛ ne nnome, na wosuanee w’atadeɛ mu suu m’anim nti, me nso mate,” Awurade na ɔseɛ.
“Ɛno nti hwɛ, mɛboaboa wo akɔka w’agyanom ho [wobɛwu], na wɔbɛwu akɔ wo damena mu asomdwoeɛ mu, na w’ani renhunu mmusuo a mede reba kuro yi soɔ no.”’” Enti wɔde mmuaeɛ no kɔmaa ɔhene.
23: Na ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔboaboaa Yuda ne Yerusalem mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ano baa ne nkyɛn.
Ahemfo 23

Ɔhene gyinaa edum no ho, na ɔyɛɛ apam Awurade anim sɛ ɔbɛdi Awurade akyi, na ɔde n’akoma nyinaa ne ne kra nyinaa bɛdi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ so, na wadi apam no mu nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu no so. Na ɔman no nyinaa suaee sɛ wɔbɛdi apam no so.

Na ɔhene hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo panin Hilkia ne asɔfoɔ a wɔdi hɔ no ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no sɛ wɔnyiyi anwenneɛ a wɔyɛ maa Baal ne bosom dua no ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa no mfiri Awurade asɔredan no mu. Afei ɔkɔhyee ne nyinaa wɔ Yerusalem kurotia, Kidron ho mfuwa mu, na ɔde ɛho nso no kɔɔ Betel.

Na ananafoɔ anyame no asɔfoɔ hunu a Yuda ahemfo de wɔn sisii hɔ sɛ wɔnhye aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ wɔ Yuda nkuro mu ne mmeaeɛ a ɛbembɛn Yerusalem no, ɔguu wɔn adwuma no; wɔn a na wɔhye aduhwam ma Baal ne awia ne bosome ne sodiak nsorommakuo ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa nso, ɔguu wɔn adwuma no.
Afei nso, ɔyii bosom dua no firii Awurade fie hɔ de kɔɔ Yerusalem kurotia, Kidron subɔn no mu, na ɔhyee no Kidron subɔn no mu, na ɔyam no muhumuhu, na ɔtoo mfuturo no guu ɔmanfoɔ no mma adamena so.
Bio nso, asɔrefie mmarima nnwamanfoɔ no, ɔbubuu wɔn adan a ɛwɔ Awurade fie hɔ no, baabi a na mmaa no nwene ntwamutam ma bosom dua no.

Ɛnna ɔde asɔfoɔ no nyinaa firi Yuda nkuro mu baa sɛ ɔbɛgu sorɔnsorɔmmea a asɔfoɔ no hye aduhwam wɔ hɔ no ho fi, ɛfiri Geba kɔsi Beer-Seba; ɔbubuu kuro pono ano sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ kuro sohwɛfoɔ Yosua pono ano no, faako a ɛwɔ kuro pono no benkum soɔ no, deɛ wɔfa hyɛn kuro no mu no.
Na sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfoɔ no deɛ, wɔamma Awurade afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no anim, nanso wɔdii paanoo a mmɔreka nnim, wɔn nuanom mu.
Na Tofet a ɛwɔ Hinom mma bɔn mu no, ɔguu ho fi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a obiara remma ne babarima anaa ne babaa mfa gya mu mma Molek bio.
Afei nso wamma apɔnkɔ a Yuda ahemfo de maa awia no amfa ahemfie panin Natan-Melek adidibea a ɛwɔ ntwonoo mu hɔ no amma Awurade fie hɔ bio, na ɔde gya hyee nteaseɛnam a wɔde maa awia no.

Na afɔrebukyia a Yuda ahemfo yeyɛeɛ a ɛwowɔ Ahas abansoro pia atifi ne afɔrebukyia a Manase sisii no Awurade fie adihɔ mmienu no, ɔhene bubuiɛ na ɔyam no hɔ, na ɔtoo mfuturo no guu Kidron subɔn no mu.

Na sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwowɔ Yerusalem anim wɔ Ɔsɛeɛ Bepɔ no nifa soɔ, deɛ Israel hene Solomon sisi maa Sidonfoɔ akyiwadeɛ Astoret ne Moabfoɔ akyiwadeɛ Kemos ne Ammonfoɔ atantanneɛ Milkom no, ɔhene guu ho fi.
Ɔbubuu abosom adum no mu asinasini na ɔtwitwaa abosonnua no, na ɔde nnipa nnompe hyɛɛ hɔ ma.

Bio nso, Betel afɔrebukyia no ne sorɔnsorɔmmea a Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no yɛeɛ no, ɔbubuu saa afɔrebukyia no ne sorɔnsorɔmmea no. Afei ɔhyee sorɔnsorɔmmea no, na ɔyam no muhumuhu, na ɔhyee bosom dum no.

Berɛ a Yosia danee ne ho no, ɔhunuu adamena a ɛwowɔ bepɔ no soɔ no. Enti ɔsoma maa wɔkɔfaa adamena no mu nnompe bɛhyee no afɔrebukyia no so de guu ho fi, sɛdeɛ Awurade asɛm a Nyankopɔn nipa no ka too hɔ no teɛ.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: “Nkaeɛboɔ bɛn na mehunu no ha yi?” Na kuro no mufoɔ ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn nipa a ɔfiri Yuda baeɛ a ɔkaa deɛ wode ayɛ Betel afɔrebukyia yi ho asɛm too hɔ no damena.”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Momma no nna hɔ nhome. Mma obiara nnka ne nnompe.” Enti wɔanka ne nnompe ne odiyifoɔ a ɔfiri Samaria baeɛ no nnompe.
Bio nso, sorɔnsorɔmmea afie a ɛwowɔ Samaria nkuro mu a Israel ahemfo sisi de hyɛɛ Onyankopɔn abufuo no, Yosia yiyii ne nyinaa, na ɔyɛɛ no sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ Betel deɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na ɔde sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfoɔ a na wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔhyee nnipa nnompe wɔ so. Ɛno akyi no, ɔsan kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Afei ɔhene hyɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: “Monni twam mma Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no apam nwoma yi mu no.”
Ɛfiri atemmufoɔ a wɔbuu Israel atɛn no nna mu ne Israel ne Yuda ahemfo nyinaa nna mu no, na wɔnnii twam bi saa da.
Nanso Ɔhene Yosia afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe mu no, wɔdii twam yi maa Awurade wɔ Yerusalem.

Afei nso adebisafoɔ ne asumanfoɔ ne terafim honi ne abosom fi ne akyiwadeɛ a abɛpue Yuda asase soɔ ne Yerusalem no, Yosia tuu aseɛ na ama no adi mmara no mu nsɛm so, deɛ wɔatwerɛ no nwoma a ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia kɔhunuu no Awurade fie hɔ mu no.
N’anim no, ɔhene biara amma sɛ ɔno a ɔde n’akoma nyinaa ne ne kra nyinaa ne n’ahoɔden nyinaa dane baa Awurade nkyɛn sɛdeɛ Mose mmara no teɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, na n’akyi nso, obiara ansɔre a ɔte sɛ ɔno.
Nanso, ne nyinaa akyi no, Awurade annane amfiri n’abufuhyeɛ kɛseɛ no ho, abufuhyeɛ a ɛdɛree Yuda soɔ, Manase nneɛma bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ de hyɛɛ no abufuo no nti.
Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Yuda nso mɛto no afiri m’anim atwene sɛdeɛ metoo Israel tweneeɛ no; mɛto kuro a mafa yi, Yerusalem ne efie yi atwene, efie a mekaa sɛ, ‘Me din bɛtena hɔ’ no.”
Yosia ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa wɔ Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Ne nna mu na Egypt hene Farao Neko baa Asiria hene nkyɛn wɔ asubɔnten Eufrate ho, na Ɔhene Yosia firii adi sɛ ɔne no de rekɔsi ani, nanso berɛ a ɔhunuu no ara na ɔkum no wɔ Megido.
Enti ne nkoa de n’amu too teaseɛnam mu firii Megido kɔɔ Yerusalem, na wɔsiee no ne damena mu. Ɛnna asase no sofoɔ faa Yosia ba Yehoahas, na wɔsraa no sii no hene maa no dii ne papa adeɛ.
Yehoahas bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Hamutal a ɔyɛ Yeremia a ɔfiri Libna no ba.
Ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ n’agyanom yɛeɛ no ara.
Farao Neko guu no nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn wɔ Ribla, Hamat asase so, na wamma no anni hene bio wɔ Yerusalem, na ɔmaa asase no tuaa dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne sika dwetikɛseɛ baako.
Afei, Farao Neko de Ɔhene Yosia ba Eliakim sii hene maa no dii ne papa Yosia adeɛ, na ɔsesaa ne din frɛɛ no Yehoiakim. Yehoahas deɛ, ɔde no kɔɔ Egypt, na ɛhɔ na ɔkɔwuiɛ.

Yehoiakim de dwetɛ ne sika no maa Farao. Ɔman no nkyɛn na ɔgyegyee toɔ, na ɔde dwetɛ no maa Farao sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no no. Ɔgyegyee dwetɛ ne sika toɔ no firii ɔmanfoɔ no nkyɛn sɛdeɛ obiara toɔ a wɔatwa ama no teɛ, na ɔde maa Farao Neko.
Yehoiakim bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu nnum, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dubaako wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Sebida a ɔyɛ Pedaia a ɔfiri Ruma no ba.
Na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ n’agyanom yɛeɛ no ara.
24: Ne nna mu na Babilon hene Nebukadnesar tu baeɛ, na Yehoiakim bɛyɛɛ n’akoa mfeɛ mmiɛnsa. Nanso ɔdanee ne ho sɔre tee atua.
Ahemfo 24
Awurade asɛm so na yei nam baa Yuda soɔ sɛ ɔbɛyi no afiri n’anim, Manase bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa,
ne afei mogya a ɛdi bem a ɔhwie guiɛ na ɔde mogya a ɛdi bem hyɛɛ Yerusalem ma no nti. Na Awurade ampɛ sɛ ɔde bɛfirie.
Yehoiakim ho nsɛm a aka ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛ so nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Yehoiakim ne n’agyanom kɔdaeɛ, na ne ba Yehoiakin bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Egypt hene amfiri n’asase so amma bio da, ɛfiri sɛ Babilon hene faa Egypt hene nneɛma nyinaa, ɛfiri Egypt subɔn ho kɔsi asubɔnten Eufrate ho.
Yehoiakin bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Nehusta a ɔyɛ Elnatan a ɔfiri Yerusalem no babaa.
Na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ ne papa yɛeɛ no ara.
Saa berɛ no mu na Babilon hene Nebukadnesar nkoa baa Yerusalem soɔ, na wɔbɛtwaa kuro no ho hyiaeɛ.
Na Babilon hene Nebukadnesar baa kuro no so berɛ a na ne nkoa atwa ho ahyia no.
Akyire yi, Yuda hene Yehoiakin firii adi kɔɔ Babilon hene nkyɛn, ɔne ne maame ne n’asomfoɔ ne ne mmapɔmma ne n’ahemfie mpanimfoɔ; Babilon hene faa no dommum, n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe mu.
Afei ɔfaa Awurade fie akoradeɛ nyinaa ne ahemfie akoradeɛ no kɔeɛ, na ɔtwitwaa sika anwenneɛ a Israel hene Solomon yɛɛ no Awurade asɔredan mu no nyinaa mu asinasini sɛdeɛ Awurade kaeɛ no.

Na ɔde Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa ne mmapɔmma no nyinaa ne mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ a wɔn ho yɛ den no nyinaa, ne adwumfoɔ ne abantofoɔ no nyinaa, nnipa mpem du, kɔɔ nkoasom mu. Wɔannya obiara gye asase no so mmɔborɔfoɔ ahiafoɔ nko.
Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a ɔfaa Yehoiakin kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Babilon, na ɔhene maame ne ɔhene yerenom ne n’ahemfie mpanimfoɔ ne asase no so atitire nso, ɔde wɔn firi Yerusalem kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Babilon.
Na Babilon hene de mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ a wɔn ho yɛ den nyinaa, nnipa mpemnson, ne adwumfoɔ ne abantofoɔ apem, ne mmarima a wɔkɔ ɔsa nyinaa kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Babilon.
Bio nso, Babilon hene tuu Yehoiakin adeɛ so yɛɛ ne papa nua Matania hene sii n’ananmu, na ɔsesaa ne din frɛɛ no Sedekia.
Sedekia bɛdii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu baako, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dubaako wɔ Yerusalem. Ne maame din de Hamutal a ɔyɛ Yeremia a ɔfiri Libna no babaa.
Na ɔyɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ Yehoiakim yɛeɛ no ara.
Nneɛma a ɛsisii Yerusalem ne Yuda yi na ɛmaa Awurade bo fuiɛ, kɔsii sɛ ɔtoo wɔn firii n’anim tweneeɛ. Na Sedekia tee Babilon hene so atua.
25: Ɛbaa sɛ n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so nkron, bosome a ɛtɔ so du, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du no, Babilon hene Nebukadnesar baeɛ; ɔne n’asraafoɔdɔm nyinaa baa Yerusalem so bɛtwaa ho hyiaeɛ, na wɔsii akoban twaa ho nyinaa hyiaeɛ.
Ahemfo 25
Bosome a ɛtɔ so nnan no da a ɛtɔ so nkron no, ɛkɔm no mu yɛɛ den wɔ kuro no mu; na aduane bi nni hɔ mma ɔmanfoɔ no.

Ɛnna wɔtuu kuro no mu tokuro, na mmarima a wɔkɔ ɔsa no nyinaa dwanee anadwo kɔfaa afasuo mmienu a ɛwɔ ɔhene turo ho no ntam pono no mu kɔeɛ; saa berɛ no, na Kaldeafoɔ no atwa kuro no ho nyinaa ahyia. Ɔhene no nso de n’ani kyerɛɛ Araba.
Na Kaldea asraafoɔdɔm no de mmirika tii ɔhene no, na wɔkɔtoo no Yeriko asasetamaa no so; na n’asraafoɔdɔm a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinaa hweteeɛ.
Ɛnna wɔkyee ɔhene no de no kɔmaa Babilon hene wɔ Ribla, na ɔbuu no atɛn.
Wɔkunkum Sedekia mma mmarima wɔ n’anim, na Sedekia nso, ɔbobɔɔ n’ani. Afei ɔde kɔbere nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn guu no, na ɔde no kɔɔ Babilon.
Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no da a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛyɛ Ɔhene Nebukadnesar, Babilon hene, no afe a ɛtɔ so dunkron no, awɛmfoɔ so panin Nebusaradan, Babilon hene akoa, no baa Yerusalem.
Na ɔhyee Awurade fie ne ahemfie no ne Yerusalem afie nyinaa; ɔde gya hyee otitire biara fie.
Na Yerusalem afasuo a atwa ho ahyia nyinaa, Kaldea asraafoɔdɔm a wɔka awɛmfoɔ so panin no ho no nyinaa dwiri guiɛ.
Ɔmanfoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔgyaa wɔn kuro no mu, ne wɔn a wɔdane kɔɔ Babilon hene afa, ne nnipa a wɔaka no, awɛmfoɔ so panin Nebusaradan de wɔn kɔɔ nkoasom mu.
Na awɛmfoɔ so panin no gyaa asase no so ahiafoɔ no bi sɛ wɔnyɛ bobe nturo mu adwumayɛfoɔ ne apaafoɔ.
Na kɔbere adum a ɛwɔ Awurade fie no ne nsutwe nnaka ne kɔbere po a ɛwɔ Awurade fie hɔ no, Kaldeafoɔ no bubuu no asinasini, na wɔde ɛho kɔbere no kɔɔ Babilon.
Na deɛ wɔde sesa nso ne sofi ne adumgya ne nkuruwa ne kɔbere nneɛma a wɔde som no nyinaa, wɔsesa kɔeɛ.
Na egya nkukuwa ne nyaawa a wɔde sika amapa ayɛ ne deɛ wɔde dwetɛ amapa ayɛ no, awɛmfoɔ so panin no sesa kɔeɛ.
Na adum mmienu no ne ɛpo baako no ne nsutwe nnaka a Solomon yeyɛɛ no Awurade fie hɔ no, nneɛma yi nyinaa ho kɔbere deɛ, wɔantumi ankari.

Adum no biara tenten yɛ basafa dunwɔtwe, na wɔde kɔbere na ɛyɛɛ ɛso ntaasoɔ no; ntaasoɔ no tenten yɛ basafa mmiɛnsa; atena ne granate akutuo a atwa ntaasoɔ no ho ahyia no, kɔbere na wɔde yɛɛ ne nyinaa; saa ara na edum a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ho atena nso teɛ.
Bio nso, awɛmfoɔ so panin no faa ɔsɔfo panin Seraia ne ɔsɔfoɔ Sefania a ɔdi ne soɔ ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ mmiɛnsa;

na kuro no mu nso, ɔfaa ahemfie panin baako a ɔda asraafoɔ ano, ne mmarima a wɔkɔ ɔhene anim no nnum a wɔwɔ kuro no mu, ne ɔsahene no twerɛfoɔ a ɔboaboa dɔm ano wɔ asase no soɔ, ne ɔmanfoɔ no mu mmarima aduosia a wɔwɔ kuro no mu;
awɛmfoɔ so panin Nebusaradan de wɔn kɔmaa Babilon hene wɔ Ribla.
Na Babilon hene bobɔɔ wɔn kuukumm wɔn wɔ Ribla, Hamat asase so. Saa na ɛyɛeɛ a Yuda firii n’asase so kɔɔ nkoasom mu.
Na ɔmanfoɔ a wɔkaa Yuda asase so a Babilon hene Nebukadnesar gyaa wɔn hɔ no, ɔde Safan ba Ahikam ba Gedalia dii wɔn so amrado.
