Berɛ a asahene no nyinaa ne wɔn mmarima tee sɛ Babilon hene ayi Gedalia no, ntɛm ara na wɔbaa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa; Netania ba Ismael, ne Karea ba Yohanan, ne Netofani Tanhumet ba Seraia, ne Maakatni no ba Yaasania, ne wɔn mmarima na wɔbaeɛ.
Ɛnna Gedalia kaa ntam kyerɛɛ wɔne wɔn mmarima no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnsuro sɛ mobɛsom Kaldeafoɔ no. Montena asase no so na monsom Babilon hene, na ɛbɛsi mo yie.”

Ɛbaa sɛ bosome a ɛtɔ so nson mu no, Elisama ba Netania ba Ismael a ɔfiri adehyeɛ abusua mu no baeɛ, ɔne mmarima du, na wɔbɔɔ Gedalia kuu no, na wɔkunkum Yudafoɔ ne Kaldeafoɔ a wɔka ne ho wɔ Mispa no nso.
Ɛno akyi no, nnipa no nyinaa, ɛfiri kumaa so kɔsi kɛseɛ so, ne asahene no sɔreeɛ, na wɔkɔɔ Egypt, ɛfiri sɛ Kaldeafoɔ no nti wɔsuroeɛ.

Berɛ a Yuda hene Yehoiakin kɔɔ nkoasom mu no, n’afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nson, bosome a ɛtɔ so dumienu no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson, afe a Babilon hene Ewil-Merodak bɛyɛɛ ɔhene no, ɔmaa Yuda hene Yehoiakin so firii nneduafie mu;
na ɔkasaa ayamyɛ so kyerɛɛ no, na ɔmaa n’ahennwa so maa no senee ahemfo a wɔka ne ho wɔ Babilon no nhennwa.
Na ɔyii n’afiase ntadeɛ, na ɔdidii n’anim daa, ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na deɛ wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma no no, ɛfiri ɔhene nkyɛn na wɔde maa no daa, da biara ne ne deɛ, ne nkwa nna nyinaa.

1: Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo akoa ne ɔsomafoɔ, de kɔma wɔn a wɔanya gyidie a ɛsom bo sɛ yɛn deɛ no ara wɔ yɛn Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo tenenee mu:
Adom ne asomdwoeɛ nnɔɔso mma mo, Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Yesu ho nimdeɛ mu,
sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn nam ne tumi so ama yɛn biribiara a ɛfa nkwa ne onyamesom pa ho kwa no, deɛ ɔnam animuonyam ne mmaninyɛ so afrɛ yɛn no ho nimdeɛ mu.
Ɛno na ɔnam yeinom so ama yɛn bɔhyɛ akɛseakɛseɛ a ɛsom bo kwa, na sɛ moanya adwane akɔnnɔ mu porɔeɛ a ɛwɔ wiase a, moafa yeinom so anya Onyankopɔn su no bi.
Yei nti na mo nso monyɛ deɛ mobɛtumi biara mfa ɔbra pa nka mo gyidie ho, na momfa nimdeɛ nka ɔbra pa ho;
na momfa anidahɔ nka mo nimdeɛ ho, momfa boasetɔ nka mo anidahɔ ho, na momfa onyamesom pa nka mo boasetɔ ho;
na momfa onuadɔ nka mo nyamesom pa ho, na momfa ɔdɔ amapa nka mo nuadɔ ho.
Na sɛ yeinom nyinaa wɔ mo mu na ɛbu so a, ɛremma monyɛ anihafoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔnso aba yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ho nimdeɛ fam.
Na deɛ yeinom abɔ no no yɛ obia ɔnhunu akyiri adeɛ yie papa, kyerɛ sɛ onifirani, na ne werɛ nso afiri sɛ wɔahohoro ne ho afiri bɔne a wayɛ atwam no ho.
Yei nti, anuanom, monyɛ deɛ mobɛtumi biara nhyɛ frɛ a wɔafrɛ mo ne yi a wɔayi mo no mu den; na sɛ mokɔ so yɛ saa a, morensunti da.
Na saa na wɔbɛma mo kwan aboro soɔ akɔ yɛn Awurade ne yɛn Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo daa ahennie no mu.
Enti meremma m’ani mpa so sɛ mɛkae mo yeinom daa, nanso monim dada, na moatim nokorɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ yi mu.
Nanso mebu no sɛ ɛtene sɛ, mete ntomadan yi mu yi, mede nkaeɛ kanyane mo,
na menim sɛ ɛrenkyɛ koraa na mapa me ntomadan yi agu baabi sɛdeɛ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nso ayi akyerɛ me no.
Enti berɛ nyinaa mɛyɛ deɛ mɛtumi biara na sɛ mefiri wiase a, moatumi akae yeinom da biara. Kristo animuonyam hran ho adansedie
Na ɛnyɛ anansesɛm a wɔtoo no nyansam akyi na yɛdi kaa mo yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi ne ne ba no ho asɛm, na mmom yɛyɛɛ n’animuonyam kɛseɛ no ho adansefoɔ a na yɛn ani tua.
Na ɔnyaa anidie ne animuonyam firii Agya Nyankopɔn hɔ berɛ a animuonyam kɛseɛ no kaa nsɛm te sɛ yei kyerɛɛ no no sɛ: “Oyi ne me Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’ani no.”
Na yei ne nne a yɛte firii soro berɛ a na yɛne no wɔ bepɔ kronkron no soɔ no. Anyamesɛm di Kristo ba a ɔbɛba bio no ho adanseɛ
Enti wɔahyɛ nkɔmhyɛsɛm no mu den ama yɛn; ɛno na sɛ mohwɛ no yie sɛ kanea a ɛhyerɛn baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ sum, de kɔsi sɛ adeɛ bɛkye na adekyeeɛ nsoromma no pue mo akoma mu a, moyɛ no yie.
Na deɛ ɛdi kan koraa no, monhunu sɛ Twerɛnsɛm mu nkɔmhyɛ biara nni hɔ a ɛfiri nnipa nkyerɛaseɛ mu.
Na nkɔmhyɛ mfaa onipa pɛ so mmaa da, na mmom Nyankopɔn nnipa kronkron so, sɛdeɛ Honhom Kronkron no hyɛɛ wɔn no na wɔkasaeɛ.
2: Na adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ nso wɔ ɔman no mu, sɛdeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ bɛba mo mu nso. Wɔn na wɔde ɔsɛeɛ fekusɛm bɛba abɛhyɛ mu, na wɔapa Awurade a ɔtɔɔ wɔn na ɔgyee wɔn no mpo, na wɔn ara de ɔsɛeɛ bɛba wɔn ho so ntɛm.
Petro 2
Afei anibereɛ nti, wɔnam nnaadaasɛm so bɛpɛ mo ho mfasoɔ. Wɔn na ɛfiri tete wɔn atemmuo ntwentwɛn aseɛ, na wɔn sɛeɛ ntɔ nko. Tete mmerɛ mu asotwe ne ɔgyeɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ
Na sɛ Onyankopɔn amma abɔfoɔ a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no amfa wɔn ho anni, na mmom ɔde esum kabii ahoma kyeree wɔn guu Asamando amanehunu bunu mu sɛ wɔnkora wɔn so mma atemmuo a;
na wamma tete wiase no amfa wɔn ho anni, na ɔkoraa Noa a ɔyɛ tenenee sɛnkafoɔ no ne nnipa nson so berɛ a ɔde nsuyire bɛsɛee amumuyɛfoɔ wiase no so a;
na sɛ ɔdanee Sodom ne Gomora nkuro nso, na ɔde ɔsɛeɛ buu wɔn fɔ de wɔn yɛɛ sɛnnahɔ (nhwɛsoɔ) maa wɔn a akyire yi wɔbɛyɛ amumuyɛdeɛ,
na ɔgyee ɔteneneeni Lot a amumuyɛfoɔ no ahohwibra maa ne ho hiahiaa no no a,
deɛ ɔbarima a ɔtene yi hunuiɛ na ɔteeɛ berɛ a ɔne wɔn teɛ da biara da no maa ne kra a ɛtene no ho yeraa no ɛsiane wɔn mmaratodeɛ no nti,
yeinom nyinaa kyerɛ sɛ Awurade nim sɛdeɛ ɔbɛgye wɔn a wɔde fɛreɛ som no afiri sɔhwɛ mu, na wama wɔatwe wɔn a wɔntene aso de wɔn asie ama atemmuo da,
ne titire no, wɔn a wɔdi honam akyiri, efi ho akɔnnɔ mu, na wɔte tumidie atua. Wɔyɛ aniɛdenfoɔ, ahopɛfoɔ, wɔn ho mpopo sɛ wɔbɛka animuonyamfoɔ ho nsɛmmɔne. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ su
Nanso abɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne tumi a ɛso no nka nsɛmmɔne mmu wɔn atɛn Awurade anim.
Nanso yeinom deɛ, wɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔnni adwene a wɔn su ne sɛ wɔawo wɔn sɛ wɔnkyere wɔn nsɛe wɔn. Wɔka deɛ wɔnnim ho nsɛmmɔne, wɔbɛsɛe wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ mu,

na wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛntene so akatua. Wɔbu honam akɔnnɔ a wɔdi akyire awiaberɛ no sɛ anigyedeɛ. Wɔyɛ nkekaeɛ ne dɛm, na deɛ wɔn ani gye ho ara ne sɛ wɔde atorɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ bɛdaadaa mo berɛ a wɔne mo bom didie no.
Wɔwɔ ani a awaresɛeɛ ahyɛ no ma a ɛntumi nkwati bɔne, na wɔto akra a wɔn ase ntimiiɛ no bradɛ. Wɔwɔ akoma a aben anibereɛ mu; na wɔyɛ mmɔfra a wɔadome wɔn.
Wɔagya ɔkwan tenenee no akɔfom kwan, wɔakɔfa Beor ba Balaam kwan so; ɔno na na ɔpɛ adebɔne so akatua,
nanso ɔnyaa ne mmarato ho atɛnyie. Afunumu a ɔntumi nkasa de onipa nne kasaeɛ, sii odiyifoɔ no abɔdansɛm no kwan.
Yeinom yɛ asubura a nsuo nnim, suwisie a mframa a ano yɛ den bɔ no korɔ; wɔn na wɔakora esum kabii so ama wɔn.
Na wɔkeka akokurokosɛm a mfasoɔ biara nni soɔ, na wɔnam ɔhonam akɔnnɔ ne ahohwibra so to wɔn a afei na wɔatete wɔn ho afiri nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ho no bradɛ.
Wɔhyɛ wɔn bɔ sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn faahodie, nanso wɔn ara yɛ ɔporɔeɛ nkoa. Ɛfiri sɛ deɛ adi obi so nkonim no, ɛno na ɛyɛ no akoa.
Na sɛ wɔnam Awurade ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo ho nimdeɛ so adwane wiase fi, na wɔsane de wɔn ho kɔhyɛ adekorɔ no ara mu bio ma ɛfa wɔn nnommum a, ɛnneɛ na wɔn tebea asɛe koraa sene kane deɛ no.
Sɛ wɔnnim tenenee kwan no a, anka ɛyɛ mmom sene sɛ wɔabɛhunu no fann na akyire yi wɔatwe wɔn ho afiri ahyɛdeɛ kronkron a wɔde ama wɔn no ho.
Na ayɛ wɔn, sɛdeɛ nokorɛ bɛ no seɛ sɛ: “Ɔkraman sane kɔ ɔno ara ne feɛ ho, na prako a wɔadware no sane kɔyantam dontorie (atɛkyɛ) mu.”
3: Adɔfo, yei ne krataa a ɛtɔ so mmienu a meretwerɛ abrɛ mo, te sɛ deɛ ɛdi kan no, merekaekae mo de akanyan mo adwene ama emu ada hɔ fann, Nnipa ntie atemmuo no ho kɔkɔbɔ
Petro 3
Monhunu yei kane sɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire no mu, fɛdifoɔ a wɔdi wɔn ara wɔn akɔnnɔ akyire de fɛdie bɛba;
abɛka sɛ: “Ne mmaeɛ a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ no wɔ he? Na ɛfirii sɛ agyanom dedaeɛ yi, ade nyinaa te sɛdeɛ ɛte firi adebɔ mfitiaseɛ.”
Wɔboapa ma wɔn werɛ firi sɛ, ɛfiri tete no na ɔsoro wɔ hɔ dada, ne asase sɛ ɛfiri nsuo mu na ɛbaeɛ, na ɛfiri nsuo mu na ɛbɛtimm hɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn asɛm soɔ,
na ɛnam so na nsuo yiri sɛee wiase a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no.
Nanso ɛnam asɛm korɔ no ara so na wɔakora ɔsoro ne asase a ɛwɔ hɔ yi so ama egya de retwɛn atemmuo ne amumuyɛfoɔ sɛeɛ da no.
Nanso, adɔfo, mommma adeɛ baako yi nnhunta mo, sɛ da koro yɛ Awurade sɛ mfeɛ apem, na mfeɛ apem nso yɛ no sɛ da koro.
Awurade nkyɛ ne bɔhyɛ ho sɛdeɛ ebinom bu no sɛ ɛkyɛreɛ no, na mmom ɔwɔ mo ho aboterɛ ɛfiri sɛ ɔmpɛ sɛ obiara bɛyera, na mmom ɔpɛ sɛ obiara nya adwensakra.
Nanso Awurade da no bɛba sɛdeɛ owifoɔ ba anadwo, emu na ɔsoro de kukurududu bɛtwam akorɔ, na ewie mu mfitiasedeɛ bɛhye asɛe, na asase ne mu nnwuma bɛhye.
Enti sɛ yeinom nyinaa bɛsɛe a, nnipa bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ wɔ abrabɔ kronkron ne nyamesom pa mu,
sɛ motwɛn na morepɛ Nyankopɔn da no ba ntɛm yi? Ɛno mu na ɔsoro bɛsɔ ogya asɛeɛ, na wiem mfitiasedeɛ anane ahye.
Na sɛdeɛ ne bɔhyɛ teɛ no, yɛretwɛn ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ, a tenenee te mu.
Enti, adɔfo, ɛsiane sɛ moretwɛn yeinom nti, monyɛ deɛ mobɛtumi biara mma no mmɛhu mo sɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni nkekaeɛ ne dɛm biara wɔ asomdwoeɛ mu;
na mommu yɛn Awurade abodwokyɛre no sɛ nkwagyeɛ, sɛdeɛ yɛn nua dɔfo Paulo nso de ne nyansa a wɔde ama no twerɛɛ mo no,

na ɔkaa yeinom ho asɛm sɛdeɛ ɔtaa yɛ wɔ ne nkrataa nyinaa mu no. Emu na nsɛm a ne nteaseɛ yɛ den wɔ, na wɔn a wɔnsuaa adeɛ na wɔn ase ntimiiɛ no kyinkyim no sɛdeɛ wɔkyinkyim Twerɛnsɛm a aka no ma no kɔwie wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ mu.
Enti, adɔfo, ɛsiane sɛ monim yei dada nti, monhwɛ mo ho so yie na mmaratofoɔ amfa wɔn nnebɔne no antwe mo ankɔ, na berɛ a moatim yi moanhwe ase.
Na mmom monnyini yɛn Awurade ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo adom ne nimdeɛ mu. Ɔno na animuonyam nka no seesei ne daa. Amen.

1: Na Saul wuo akyi a Dawid afiri adi akɔkunkum Amalekfoɔ aba no, Dawid san bɛtenaa Siklag nnanu.
Na ne nnansa soɔ no, hwɛ! na ɔbarima bi firi nsraban no mu, Saul nkyɛn, reba a wasunsuane n’atadeɛ mu na dɔteɛ gu n’atifi [Tirim]. Berɛ a ɔduruu Dawid nkyɛn no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase kotoo fam.
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛhe na wofiri reba yi?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Israel nsraban mu na mefiri adwane aba yi.”
Na Dawid san bisaa no sɛ: “Nneɛma kɔɔ so sɛn? Mesrɛ wo, ka kyerɛ me.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔman no adwane afiri akono hɔ, na wɔn mu pii atotɔ na wɔawuwu; Saul ne ne ba Yonatan nso awuwu.”
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa aberanteɛ a ɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no no sɛ: “Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wohunuu sɛ Saul ne ne ba Yonatan awuwu ampa?”
Ɛnna aberanteɛ a ɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no no kaa sɛ: “Mekɔpuee Bepɔ Gilboa so, na mehunuu sɛ Saul twere ne pea, na hwɛ! na nteaseɛnam sotefoɔ ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ no ato no awie.
Berɛ a ɔtwaa n’ani no, ɔhunuu me, na ɔfrɛɛ me, na megyee no so sɛ, ‘Menie!’
Ɛnna ɔbisaa me sɛ, ‘Wone hwan?’ Na meka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Meyɛ Amalekni.’
Afei ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wo, twe bɛn me na ku me, ɛfiri sɛ merehunu amane, na me kra da so wɔ me mu.’
Enti metwe bɛn no kum no, ɛfiri sɛ n’ahweaseɛ akyi no, mehunuu sɛ ɔrentumi ntena nkwa mu bio. Afei mefaa abotire a ɛbɔ ne tire ne ne nsa so nkapo sɛ mede rebrɛ me wura wɔ ha.”
Ɛnna Dawid sɔɔ n’atadeɛ mu suanee mu, na mmarima a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa nso yɛɛ saa.
Na wɔtwaa adwo suiɛ, na wɔdii mmuada maa Saul ne ne ba Yonatan ne Awurade man ne Israel fie kɔsii anwummerɛ, nkrantɛ ano a wɔtotɔeɛ nti.
Afei Dawid bisaa aberanteɛ a ɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no no sɛ: “Wofiri he?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Meyɛ Amalekni hɔhoɔ bi a wabɛsoɛ ha ba.”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woansuro sɛ wobɛtene wo nsa asɛe deɛ Awurade asra no no?”
Na Dawid frɛɛ ne mmeranteɛ no baako ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Twe bɛn no na bɔ no.” Enti ɔbɔɔ no hwee fam maa no wuiɛ.
Afei Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo ara wo mogya ho afɔdie ngu w’atifi ɛfiri sɛ w’ano na adi adanseɛ atia wo sɛ, ‘Me ara na mekum deɛ Awurade asra no’ no.”
Na Dawid twaa Saul ne ne ba Yonatan ho kwadwom yi,
na ɔkaa sɛ wɔnkyerɛ Yudafoɔ mma. Hwɛ! wɔatwerɛ no Yasar nwoma no mu:
“O Israel, w’animuonyam na atɔ wɔ wo sorɔnsorɔmmea yi. Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na mmarima ahoɔdenfoɔ atotɔ yi!
Monnka ho asɛm wɔ Gat; Mommmɔ no dawuro wɔ Askelon mmɔnten so, Na Filistifoɔ mma mmaa ani annye, Na momonotofoɔ mma mmaa anni ahurisie.
Mo, Gilboa mmepɔ, mma bosuo anaa nsuo nntɔ nngu mo so, na mma ayɛyɛdeɛ kronkron mmfifi mo nsase so, Ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na wɔguu ahoɔdenfoɔ kyɛm ho fi, Saul kyɛm no, wɔamfa ngo ansra ho.
Atɔfoɔ mogya ne ahoɔdenfoɔ sradeɛ, Na Saul nso nkrantɛ amfiri ho amma kwa.
Saul ne Yonatan, wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ ahomeka a wɔdɔ wɔn ho, wɔn nkwa nna mu ne owuo mu nso, wɔn mu antete. Wɔn ho yɛ hare sene akɔdeɛ,
O Israel mma mmaa, monsu Saul, Na ɔno na ɔde tankɔkɔɔ fɛfɛ firaa mo, Na ɔde sika agudeɛ guu mo ntadeɛ soɔ.
Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ahoɔdenfoɔ atotɔ ɛko mu yi! Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na Yonatan atɔ wɔ wo sorɔnsorɔmmea!
O me nua Yonatan, me ho hiahia me, wo nti, W’asɛm yɛɛ mɛ fɛ sɛ. Ɔdɔ a wodɔɔ me no yɛ nwanwa, ɛsene mmaa dɔ koraa.
Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ahoɔdenfoɔ atotɔ,
2: Ɛbaa sɛ yei akyi no, Dawid bisaa Awurade sɛ: “Memforo nkɔ Yuda nkuro no bi mu anaa?” Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Foro kɔ.” Na Dawid san bisaa sɛ: “Ɛhe na memforo nkorɔ?” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Kɔ Hebron.”
Samuel 2
Na Dawid de mmarima a wɔka ne ho no nso kɔeɛ, obiara ne n’abusua, na wɔkɔtenatenaa Hebron nkuro mu.
Ɛnna Yuda mmarima baa hɔ bɛsraa Dawid ngo sii no Yuda fie so hene wɔ hɔ. Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Yebes-Gileadfoɔ na wɔsiee Saul.”
Enti Dawid tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Yebes-Gileadfoɔ nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Awurade nhyira mo sɛ moayɛ mo wura Saul adɔeɛ sei, na moasie no.
Na afei Awurade ne mo nni no adɔeɛ ne nokorɛdie so, na me nso me ne mo bɛdi no papayɛ mu, sɛ moayɛ yei nti.
Enti monhyɛ mo nsam den na monnya akokoɔduro, ɛfiri sɛ mo wura Saul awu, na me na Yuda fie asra me ngo de me asi wɔn so hene.”
Afei Saul asraafoɔ no safohene, Ner ba Abner, faa Saul ba Is-Boset, na ɔde no twa kɔɔ Mahanaim,
na ɔsii no hene wɔ Gilead ne Asurifoɔ ne Yesreel ne Efraim ne Benyamin ne Israel nyinaa so.
Saul ba Is-Boset bɛdii Israel so hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduanan, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ mmienu. Yuda fie nko ara na wɔdii Dawid akyi.
Nna dodoɔ a Dawid de dii Yuda fie so hene wɔ Hebron no yɛ mfeɛ nson ne abosome nsia.
Akyire yi, Ner ba Abner ne Saul ba Is-Boset nkoa firii Mahanaim kɔɔ Gibeon.
Na Seruia ba Yoab ne Dawid nkoa nso firii adi, na akyire yi wɔn nyinaa kɔhyiaa Gibeon tadeɛ no ho; wɔtenatenaa ase, yeinom wɔ tadeɛ no fa ha, na yeinom nso wɔ tadeɛ no fa ha.
Akyiri Abner ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Yɛmma mmeranteɛ no nsɔre ɛ, na wɔmfa nsi ani mma yɛnhwɛ.” Ɛnna Yoab kaa sɛ: “Wɔnsɔre ɛ.”
Enti wɔsɔre kan wɔn ho, na wɔkɔhyiaeɛ; Benyamin ne Saul ba Is-Boset nkurɔfoɔ yɛ dumienu, na Dawid asomfoɔ nso yɛ dumienu.
Sɛ oyi sɔ ne yɔnko ti a, na ɔde ne nkrantɛ awɔ ne mfem, na wɔn nyinaa atotɔ prɛko. Enti wɔfrɛ hɔ sɛ Helkat-Hasurim a ɛwɔ Gibeon.
Na ntɔkwa no mu yɛɛ den yie saa da no, na Abner ne Israel mmarima dii nkoguo wɔ Dawid nkoa no anim.
Saa berɛ no, na Seruia mma mmarima mmiɛnsa no, Yoab ne Abisai ne Asahel wɔ hɔ; na Asahel nan ase yɛ hare sɛ ɔtwe a ɔwɔ wuram.
Na Asahel tu saa Abner, na wampɛ sɛ ɔmane firi Abner akyi kɔ nifa anaa benkum.
Ɛnna Abner twaa n’ani hwɛɛ n’akyi kaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ wo Asahel anaa?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ me a.”
Ɛnna Abner ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa w’ani kyerɛ nifa anaa benkum kɔkye mmeranteɛ no baako na yi deɛ wobɛnya wɔ ne ho biara fa.” Nanso Asahel ampɛ sɛ ɔgyae n’akyiridie.
Ɛnna Abner san ka kyerɛɛ Asahel sɛ: “San firi m’akyi kɔ. Adɛn nti na woreyɛ ama mabɔ wo ahwe fam yi? Anka mɛyɛ dɛn apagya m’ani ahwɛ wo nua Yoab?”
Nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔsan. Enti Abner de ne pea no to wɔɔ ne yam maa pea no puee n’akyi, na ɔhwee fam wuu hɔ ara. Na ɛbaa sɛ obiara duru baabi a Asahel hwee fam wuiɛ no a, na wagyina hɔ komm.
Ɛnna Yoab ne Abisai tii Abner. Awia rekɔtɔ no, wɔbɛduruu Amma kokoɔ a ɛda Gia anim, Gibeon serɛ so kwan soɔ no so.
Na Benyaminfoɔ no boaboaa wɔn ho ano gyinaa Abner akyi, na wɔyɛɛ kuo baako kɔgyinaa kokoɔ bi atifi.
Ɛnna Abner frɛɛ Yoab kaa sɛ: “Enti nkrantɛ bɛdi nam daa? Wonnim sɛ awerɛhoɔ na ɛde bɛba? Ɛnneɛ da bɛn na wobɛka akyerɛ nnipa no sɛ wɔnsan mfiri wɔn nuanom akyi?”
Ɛnna Yoab kaa sɛ: “Sɛ Onyankopɔn te aseɛ yi, sɛ woankasa a, anka gye anɔpa na nnipa no bɛsan, ama obiara agyae ne nua akyiridie.”
Enti Yoab hyɛnee abɛn no, na nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa gyinaeɛ, na wɔanti Israel bio, na wɔanko bio.
Na Abner ne ne mmarima nso siim kɔfaa Araba anadwo no nyinaa, na wɔkɔtwaa Yordan, na wɔnante faa bɔn no mu nyinaa kɔpuee Mahanaim.
Yoab deɛ, ɔsan firii Abner akyi, na ɔboaboaa nnipa no nyinaa ano. Na wɔahwere Dawid nkoa no mu nnipa dunkron ne Asahel.
Na Dawid nkoa no kunkum Benyaminfoɔ ne Abner nkurɔfoɔ no; mmarima ahasa aduosia na wɔwuwuiɛ.
Na wɔfaa Asahel kɔsiee no ne papa asieeɛ wɔ Betlehem. Ɛnna Yoab ne ne mmarima no nantee anadwo no nyinaa, na adeɛ kyee wɔn wɔ Hebron.
3: Na akodie a ɛbɛdaa Saul fie ne Dawid fie ntam no kyɛree; Dawid kɔɔ so yɛɛ den, na Saul fie deɛ, ɛbrɛɛ ase da biara.
Samuel 3
Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Kileab a ɔne Karmelni Nabal yere Abigail woo no no, na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne Absalom, Gesur hene Talmai babaa Maaka ba no.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnan ne Hagit ba Adoniya, na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnum ne Abital ba Sefatia.
Deɛ ɔtɔ so nsia ne Dawid yere Egla ba Yitream. Yeinom na wɔwoo wɔn maa Dawid wɔ Hebron.
Na berɛ a Saul fie ne Dawid fie ntam akodie no rekɔ soɔ no nyinaa, na Abner rehyɛ ne dibea den wɔ Saul fie.
Na Saul wɔ mpena bi a ne din de Rispa a ɔyɛ Aiya babaa. Akyire yi, Is-Boset ka kyerɛɛ Abner sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wokɔɔ me papa mpena no ho?”

Ɛnna asɛm a Is-Boset kaeɛ no nti Abner bo fuu dendeenden, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Meyɛ kraman wɔ Yuda? Mayɛ wo papa Saul fie ne ne nuanom ne ne nnamfo paa adɔeɛ abɛsi nnɛ, na menyii wo nhyɛɛ Dawid nsa, nanso nnɛ worebɔ me kwaadu wɔ bɔne a meyɛɛ no ɔbaa ho nti.
Sɛdeɛ Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid no, sɛ manyɛ saa amma no a, Onyankopɔn ntua Abner ka na ɔmfa bi nka ho,
sɛ wɔbɛma ahennie no afiri Saul fie, na wɔde Dawid ahennwa asi Israel ne Yuda so, afiri Dan akɔsi Beer-Seba.”
Na wantumi amfa asɛm biara ammua Abner bio ɛfiri sɛ na ɔsuro no.
Ɛhɔ ara na Abner tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: “Hwan na asase no yɛ ne dea?” Na ɔde kaa ho sɛ: “Ɛne me nyɛ apam, na hwɛ, mɛboa wo adane Israel nyinaa aba wo nkyɛn.”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ! Me ne wo bɛyɛ apam. Adeɛ baako pɛ na merebisa afiri wo hɔ, ɛne sɛ, ‘Mma m’anim, gye sɛ wode Saul babaa Mikal abrɛ me ansa na woabɛhunu m’anim.’”
Bio nso Dawid tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Saul ba Is-Boset nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa me yere Mikal a mede Filistifoɔ mmarima ɔha dua ano wedeɛ gyee no awareɛ no ma me.”
Enti Is-Boset soma maa wɔkɔfaa no firii ne kunu Paltiel a ɔyɛ Lais ba no nkyɛn.
Na ɔrekɔ no, ne kunu no nso dii n’akyi; ɔde su dii n’akyi ara kɔduruu Bahurim. Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “San w’akyi kɔ!” Ɛnna ɔsan kɔeɛ.
Na Abner de nkra akɔma Israel mpanimfoɔ sɛ: “Ɛfiri tete na mopɛɛ sɛ Dawid di mo so hene.
Enti afei monkeka mo ho, na Awurade no ara na ɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, ‘M’akoa Dawid nsa so na menam bɛgye me man Israel afiri Filistifoɔ ne wɔn atamfo nyinaa nsam.’”
Na Abner ne Benyaminfoɔ nso kasaeɛ, na ɛno akyi no, Abner kɔkaa deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ Israel ani soɔ nyinaa ne deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ Benyamin fie nyinaa ani soɔ kyerɛɛ Dawid wɔ Hebron.
Berɛ a Abner ne mmarima aduonu baa Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron no, Dawid too pono maa Abner ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no.

Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Ma mensɔre nkɔ na menkɔboaboa Israel nyinaa ano mmra me wura ɔhene nkyɛn na wɔne wo nyɛ apam, na woadi hene sɛdeɛ wo kra pɛ biara.” Enti Dawid gyaa Abner kwan maa no kɔɔ asomdwoeɛ mu.
Ɛbaa sɛ na Dawid nkoa ne Yoab akɔfom nneɛma reba, na asadeɛ a wɔde reba no dɔɔso. Saa berɛ no, na Abner nni Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, ɛfiri sɛ na wagya no kwan ama no kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu.
Yoab ne dɔm a ɛka ne ho no nyinaa bɛduruiɛ, na nkurɔfoɔ bɛbɔɔ Yoab amanneɛ sɛ: “Ner ba Abner baa ɔhene nkyɛn, na wagya no kwan ama no kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu.”
Ɛnna Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi? Hwɛ! Abner baa wo nkyɛn. Adɛn nti na woagyaa no ama no kɔ saa kwa yi?
Wo ara wonim Ner ba Abner; ɔbaa sɛ ɔrebɛdaadaa wo na wahunu wo korɔ ne wo ba mu, na wahunu biribiara a woreyɛ.”
Na Yoab kaa saa no, ɔfirii adi firii Dawid nkyɛn, na ɔtuu abɔfoɔ maa wɔtii Abner, na wɔmaa no firii Sira abura no ho san baeɛ; na Dawid nnim ho hwee.
Berɛ a Abner san baa Hebron no, Yoab de no kɔɔ nkyɛn, kuro pono no mu sɛ ɔrekɔka asɛm bi akyerɛ no kokoam. Nanso ɔde pea wɔɔ ne yam wɔ hɔ maa no wuiɛ, ne nua Asahel mogya nti.
Na akyire yi a Dawid teeɛ no, ntɛm ara na ɔkaa sɛ: “Me ne m’ahennie di Ner ba Abner mogya ho bem kɔsi daa wɔ Awurade anim.
Ɛnsan mmɛgu Yoab, ne ne papa fie nyinaa atifi, na mma ɔbarima a ne ho sene anaa kwatani anaa deɛ ɔtwere poma anaa onipa a ɔtɔ nkrantɛ ano anaa deɛ aduane abɔ no mmpa Yoab fie!”
Na Yoab ne ne nua Abisai kum Abner ɛfiri sɛ ɔkum wɔn nua Asahel wɔ Gibeon ko no mu.
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yoab ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa sɛ: “Monsunsuane mo ntadeɛ mu, na momfira atweaatam [Ayitoma] na monsu nni Abner anim.” Ɔhene Dawid nso dii ahomankaa no akyi.
Na wɔsiee Abner wɔ Hebron; ɔhene maa ne nne so suu Abner wɔ asieeɛ hɔ, na ɔman no nyinaa nso suiɛ.
Na ɔhene twaa Abner ho kwadwom sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ kwasea wuo na ɛsɛ sɛ Abner nso wuo anaa?
Wɔankyekyere wo nsa, Na wɔamfa kɔbere nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn angu wo nan. Sɛdeɛ obi tɔ amumuyɛ mma anim na woatɔ yi.” Na ɔman no nyinaa suu no bio.

Akyire yi, ɔman no nyinaa baa sɛ wɔrebɛkorɔkorɔ David ama no adidi saa da no, nanso Dawid kaa ntam sɛ: “Sɛ medidi anaa mede biribi ka m’ano ansa na awia akɔtɔ a, Onyankopɔn ntua me ka na ɔmfa bi nka ho!”
Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuiɛ, na ɛsɔɔ wɔn ani. Sɛ adeɛ biara a ɔhene yɛeɛ teɛ no, yei nso sɔɔ ɔman no nyinaa ani.
Na ɔman no nyinaa ne Israel nyinaa hunuu saa da no sɛ, sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔhene na ɔmaa wɔkum Ner ba Abner.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: “Monnim sɛ ɔsafohene ne onipa kɛseɛ na atɔ nnɛ wɔ Israel yi?
Wɔasra me asi me hene deɛ, nanso ɛnnɛ meyɛ mmerɛ, na saa mmarima yi, Seruia mma yi yɛ den ma me dodo. Deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no, Awurade ntua no ka sɛdeɛ ɔno ara ne bɔne teɛ.”
4: Na berɛ a Saul ba Is-Boset tee sɛ Abner awu wɔ Hebron no, ne nsam goeɛ, na Israelfoɔ nyinaa nso yɛɛ basaa.
Samuel 4
Na Beerotfoɔ no dwane kɔɔ Gitaim, na wɔkɔyɛɛ ahɔhoɔ wɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.

Na Saul ba Yonatan wɔ ɔbabarima bi a ɔyɛ obubuafoɔ [Apakye]. Deɛ ɛbaeɛ ne sɛ, berɛ a wɔfiri Yesreel bɛkaa deɛ ato Saul ne Yonatan no, na wadi mfeɛ nnum, na ɔbaa a ɔhwɛ no no faa no sɛ ɔde no redwane. Berɛ a ɔbaa no de ahopopoɔ redwane no, abɔfra no hwee fam, na ɔbubuiɛ. Ne din de Mefiboset.
Ɛnna Beerotni Rimon mma Rekab ne Baanah siim kɔɔ Is-Boset fie awia ketee; nso na wada awianna.
Na wɔkɔɔ fie no mfimfini yɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ mmarima a wɔrepɛ ayuo, na wɔde adeɛ wɔɔ ne yam. Na Rekab ne ne nua Baanah dwaneeɛ a obiara anhu wɔn.
Berɛ a wɔkɔɔ fie hɔ no, na ɔda ne mpa so wɔ pia mu, na wɔde sekan wɔɔ no kum no, na wɔtwaa ne ti, na wɔde ne tiri no sii kwan so nantee anadwo no nyinaa kɔɔ Araba.
Ɛnna wɔde Is-Boset ti no kɔmaa Dawid wɔ Hebron, na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Wo tamfo Saul a na ɔrepɛ wo kra no ba Is-Boset tiri nie. Na ɛnnɛ, Awurade atɔ werɛ ama me wura ɔhene wɔ Saul ne n’asefoɔ so.”
Nanso Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Beerotni Rimon mma Rekab ne ne nua Baanah sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade a ɔgyee me kra firii ahohiahia nyinaa mu te aseɛ yi,
berɛ a obi bɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Hwɛ, Saul awu’ na ɛyɛɛ n’ani so sɛ wabɛka asɛmpa no, mesɔɔ ne mu kum no Siklag de tuaa n'asɛm no so ka,
na sɛ nnipa abɔnefoɔ akɔkum ɔteneneeni ɔno ara ne fie wɔ ne mpa so a, ɛnneɛ ɛdeɛn na mɛyɛ wɔn? Meremmisa ne mogya mfiri mo nsam na merenyi mo mfiri asase so?”
Ɛnna Dawid hyɛɛ ne mmeranteɛ no, na wɔkum wɔn twitwaa wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan, na wɔkɔsɛn wɔn Hebron tadeɛ no ho. Na wɔfaa Is-Boset tiri no kɔsiee no Abner asieeɛ hɔ wɔ Hebron.
5: Ɛnna Israel mmusuakuo no nyinaa baa Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron bɛkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo dompe ne wo honam.
Samuel 5
Enti Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, na Ɔhene Dawid ne wɔn yɛɛ apam Awurade anim wɔ Hebron, na wɔsraa Dawid de no sii Israel so hene.
Dawid bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduasa, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduanan.
Ɔdii Yuda so hene mfeɛ nson ne abosome nsia wɔ Hebron, na ɔdii Israel ne Yuda nyinaa so hene mfeɛ aduasa mmiɛnsa wɔ Yerusalem.

Ɛnna ɔhene ne ne mmarima kɔɔ Yerusalem sɛ wɔne Yebusifoɔ a wɔtete asase no soɔ no rekɔko, nanso wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Woremma ha; anifirafoɔ ne mpakye na wɔbɛpamo woɔ.” Wɔn adwene yɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Dawid remma hɔ.”
Ne nyinaa akyi no, Dawid kɔfaa Sion abandenden no, kyerɛ sɛ, Dawid Kuro no.

Ɛnna Dawid kaa no saa da no sɛ: “Obiara a ɔbɛto ahyɛ Yebusifoɔ soɔ no, ma no mfa suka no mu nkɔ mpakye ne anifirafoɔ a wɔyɛ Dawid kra atamfo no so!” Ɛno nti na wɔka sɛ: “Onifirani ne apakye remma fie hɔ.”
Afei Dawid kɔtenaa abandenden no mu, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Dawid Kuro. Na Dawid firii aseɛ sisii adan hyiaeɛ; ɔde firii Milo ne ne mfimfini.
Na Dawid yɛɛ kɛseɛ ara, na asafo Nyankopɔn Awurade dii n’akyi.
Na Tiro [Tyre] hene Hiram somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn de tweneduro nnua ne dua adwumfoɔ ne abantofoɔ kaa ho kɔeɛ, na wɔfirii aseɛ sii fie maa Dawid.
Na Dawid hunuu sɛ Awurade ama n’ahennie atim Israel so, na ne man Israel nti, wama n’ahennie so.
Berɛ a Dawid firi Hebron baeɛ no, ɔfefaa mpena ne yerenom pii wɔ Yerusalem, na wɔsan woo mma mmarima ne mma mmaa bebree maa Dawid bio.
Mma a wɔwoo wɔn maa no Yerusalem no din nie: Shammua, Sobab, Natan ne Solomon,
ne Ibhar, Elisua, Nefeg ne Yafia,
ne Elisama, Eliada ne Elifelet.
Filistifoɔ no tee sɛ wɔasra Dawid asi no hene wɔ Israel so. Enti Filistifoɔ no nyinaa bɛhwehwɛɛ Dawid. Berɛ a Dawid teeɛ no, ɔsiane kɔɔ aban no mu.
Na Filistifoɔ no baeɛ, na wɔbɛnantenantee Refaim asasetamaa no so.
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa Awurade sɛ: “Menkɔ Filistifoɔ no so? Wode wɔn bɛhyɛ me nsa anaa?” Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Kɔ, na mede Filistifoɔ no bɛhyɛ wo nsa.”
Enti Dawid kɔɔ Baal-Perasim, na Dawid kunkum wɔn wɔ hɔ. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade adi m’anim abu afa m’atamfo so sɛdeɛ nsuo bu fa nneɛma soɔ no.” Ɛno na ɛmaa ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Baal-Perasim.
Na wɔgyigyaa wɔn ahoni wɔ hɔ, na Dawid ne ne mmarima no sesa de kɔeɛ.
Akyire yi, Filistifoɔ no baa bio, na wɔbɛnantenantee Refaim asasetamaa no so.
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa Awurade, nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Nkɔhyia wɔn. Kɔ na kɔfiri wɔn akyi bra, na to hyɛ wɔn so wɔ baka nnua no anim.
Sɛ ɛba sɛ wote nnyegyeeɛ a ɛte sɛ nnipa nanteɛ wɔ baka nnua no so a, keka wo ho saa berɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ saa berɛ no na Awurade adi w’anim rekɔkunkum Filistifoɔ asraafoɔ no.”
Enti Dawid yɛɛ saa; ɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ no no ara, na ɔkunkum Filistifoɔ no firi Geba de kɔeɛ ara kɔsii Geser.
6: Ɛnna Dawid san boaboaa Israel mmarima akantinka nyinaa ano; na wɔn dodoɔ si mpem aduasa.
Samuel 6
Nanso teaseɛnam foforɔ bi so na wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no siiɛ, na wɔde firii Abinadab fie a ɛwɔ kokoɔ soɔ no; Abinadab mma Ussa ne Ahio dii teaseɛnam foforɔ no anim.
Enti wɔde firii Abinadab fie a ɛwɔ kokoɔ soɔ no—na Nyankopɔn adaka no; Ahio na ɔdii Adaka no anim.
Na Dawid ne Israel fie nyinaa de nnwontoɔ nneɛma a wɔde popaw nnua ayɛ nyinaa bi ne asankuten ne asankuo ne mpintin ne nnɔnnɔmma ne nnawuta dii ahurisie Awurade anim.
Na wɔde nkakrankakra bɛduruu Nakon ayuporobea hɔ, na ɛhɔ na Ussa tenee ne nsa kɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn adaka no mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɛkaa kakraa bi sɛ anka anantwie no redane ahwe hɔ.
Ɛhɔ ara na Awurade bo fuu Ussa, na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ no hwee fam sɛ ɔyɛɛ aniammɔnho saa, na ɔwuu Nyankopɔn adaka no ho.
Ɛnna Dawid bo fuu sɛ Awurade abufuo adɛre atia Ussa. Na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Peres-Ussa de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Dawid suroo Awurade saa da no, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Awurade adaka no aba me nkyɛn?”
Na Dawid ampɛ sɛ ɔde Awurade adaka no ba ne nkyɛn wɔ Dawid Kuro mu. Enti Dawid maa wɔde mane kɔɔ Gitni Obed-Edom fie.
Na Awurade adaka no sii Gitni Obed-Edom fie abosome mmiɛnsa, na Awurade kɔɔ so hyiraa Obed-Edom ne ne fie nyinaa.

Akyire yi, wɔbɛbɔɔ Ɔhene Dawid amanneɛ sɛ: “Nyankopɔn adaka no nti, Awurade ahyira Obed-Edom fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa.” Ɛnna Dawid kɔfaa Nyankopɔn adaka no firii Obed-Edom fie ahurisie mu sɛ ɔde rekɔ Dawid Kuro mu.
Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a wɔn a wɔso Awurade adaka no tuu anammɔn nsia no, ntɛm ara na ɔde nantwinini ne aboa a wadɔre bɔɔ afɔdeɛ.
Saa berɛ no, na Dawid hyɛ nwera pa asɔfotadeɛ, na na Dawid de n’ahoɔden nyinaa resa wɔ Awurade anim.
Na Dawid ne Israel fie nyinaa de osebɔ ne mmɛnhyɛn de Awurade adaka no baeɛ.
Berɛ a wɔde Awurade adaka no duruu Dawid Kuro mu no, Saul babaa Mikal hwɛɛ mpomma mu, na ɔhunuu sɛ Ɔhene Dawid rehurihuri, na ɔresa twa ne ho Awurade anim, na ɔbuu ɔhene animtia n’akomam.
Na wɔde Awurade adaka no baeɛ, na wɔde bɛsii ne sibea wɔ ntomadan a Dawid si maa no no mu. Ɛnna Dawid bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ Awurade anim.
Na berɛ a Dawid wiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no, ɔde asafo Awurade din hyiraa ɔman no.
Bio nso ɔmaa ɔmanfoɔ no, Israel ɔman mu no nyinaa, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa biara, paanoo mua baako ne nankum ne bobe aba taterɛ, na ɛno akyi no, ɔmanfoɔ no nyinaa kokɔɔ wɔn fie.

Ɛnna Dawid san kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhyira ne fie, na Saul babaa Mikal firii adi bɛhyiaa Dawid, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Animuonyam bɛn ara na Israel hene ahyɛ ne ho nnɛ yi sɛ wapa ne ho ne nkoa mfenaa anim sɛdeɛ mmarima ahuhufoɔ no bi pa ne ho nyinaa no!”
Na Dawid buaa Mikal sɛ: “Awurade a ɔfirii w'agya ne ne fie nyinaa akyi bɛyii me de me yɛɛ Awurade man Israel so panin no anim na megoroeɛ, na mɛdi ahurisie bio Awurade anim.
Na mɛbrɛ me ho ase akyɛn saa koraa, na mɛyɛ m’ani so famfamni; na mfenaa a wokaa wɔn ho asɛm no, wɔn ara wɔn anim na mɛhyɛ me ho animuonyam.”
Enti Saul babaa Mikal deɛ, wanwo ba kɔsii ne wuda.
7: Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a ɔhene bɛtenaa ne fie, na Awurade maa no home firii n’atamfo nyinaa ho hyiaeɛ no,
Samuel 7
Ɛnna Natan ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Deɛ ɛda w’akoma soɔ biara, kɔ na kɔyɛ, na Awurade di w’akyi.”
Ɛbaa sɛ saa anadwo no, Awurade asɛm baa Natan nkyɛn sɛ:
“Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ m’akoa Dawid sɛ, ‘Deɛ Awurade aka nie: “Wo na wobɛsi fie ama matena mu anaa?
Ɛfiri da a mekɔyii Israelfoɔ firii Egypt baeɛ de bɛsi nnɛ, mentenaa efie mu da, ntomadan mu ara na madi akɔneaba.
Berɛ a menantee Israelfoɔ mu no nyinaa, da bɛn na meka kyerɛɛ Israel mmusuakuo a mehyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛn me man Israel no bi sɛ, ‘Adɛn nti na monsii tweneduro fie mmaa me?’”’
Afei yei na ka kyerɛ m’akoa Dawid, ‘Deɛ asafo Awurade aka nie: “Me na meyii wo firii mmoa adidibea sɛ gyae mmoa akyiridie na bɛdi me man Israel so hene.
Na mɛdii w’akyi baabiara a wokɔeɛ, na mɛtwaa w’atamfo nyinaa firii w’anim, na mɛma woanya din kɛseɛ sɛ asase so atitire no bi din.
Na mɛsiesie baabi ama me man Israel na mede wɔn akɔdua hɔ; ɛhɔ na wɔbɛtena, na biribiara renha wɔn adwene bio. Amumuyɔfoɔ asefoɔ biara renteetee wɔn bio sɛ kane nna no,
nna a mede atemmufoɔ sisii me man Israel soɔ no. Mɛma woahome afiri w’atamfo nyinaa nsam. “‘“Na Awurade aka akyerɛ wo sɛ efie na Awurade bɛkyekyere ama woɔ.
Sɛ wo nna wie duru na wo ne w’agyanom kɔda asamando a, mɛma w’aseni bi so afiri w’asene mu w’akyi, na mɛma n’ahennie atim.
Ɔno na ɔbɛsi fie ama me din, na mɛma n’ahennwa atim afebɔɔ.
Me na mɛyɛ n’agya, na ɔno nso ayɛ me ba. Sɛ ɔyɛ bɔne nso a, mede nnipa abaa ne nnipa mma mpire bɛtea no.
Na m’adɔeɛ deɛ, ɛremfiri ne so sɛdeɛ meyi firii Saul a metuu no w’anim soɔ no.
Wo fie ne w’ahennie bɛtim w’anim afebɔɔ, na w’ahennwa nso bɛtim afebɔɔ.”’”
Sɛdeɛ nsɛm yi nyinaa ne anisoadehunu yi nyinaa teɛ no, saa na Natan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid.
Yei akyi no, Ɔhene Dawid bɛtenaa Awurade anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: “O Awurade Nyankopɔn, hwan ne me, na me fie yɛ deɛn a wode me abɛduru ha yi?
Nanso yei nyinaa yɛ w’ani so ade ketewa bi, O Awurade Nyankopɔn; woasan aka deɛ ɛbɛba w’akoa fie so daakye-daakye, na yei ne mmara a wode ama adasamma, O Awurade Nyankopɔn.
Na ɛdeɛn bio na Dawid nkɔ so nka nkyerɛ woɔ, O Awurade Nyankopɔn? Wo na wonim w’akoa yie.
W’asɛm nti woayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ yi nyinaa sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ w’akoma mu, na woama w’akoa ahunu.
Enti na woso kokuroo no, O Awurade Nyankopɔn; obiara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ woɔ, na Onyame biara nni hɔ sɛ wo, sɛdeɛ nsɛm a yɛde yɛn aso ateɛ no nyinaa teɛ no.

Na ɔman baako bɛn na ɛwɔ asase so a ɛte sɛ wo man Israel, a Onyankopɔn gyee wɔn faa sɛ ne ɔman? Ɔman bɛn na wonam wɔn so ayɛ anwanwadwuma akɛseɛ de agye din? Ɛnyɛ wo man a wogyee wɔn firii Egypt, a wɔn nti wopamoo amanaman no ne wɔn anyame no?
Na woasiesie wo man Israel afa de  wɔn ayɛ wo man daa, na wo, Awurade na woayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
“Afei O Awurade Nyankopɔn, ma asɛm a woaka afa w’akoa ne ne fie ho no ntim daa, na yɛ sɛdeɛ woaka no.
Na wo din bɛkorɔn daa, na nkurɔfoɔ nka sɛ, ‘Asafo Awurade ne Israel Nyankopɔn,’ na ma w’akoa Dawid fie ntim w’anim pintinn.
Na wo, O asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn na woayi no adi akyerɛ w’akoa sɛ, ‘Mɛkyekyere fie ama wo.’ Ɛno nti na w’akoa anya akokoɔduro rebɔ wo saa mpaeɛ yi.
Na afei, O Awurade Nyankopɔn, wone Onyankopɔn, na wo nsɛm yɛ nokorɛ, na wode adepa yi ahyɛ w’akoa bɔ.
Enti ma no nyɛ wo fɛ na hyira w’akoa fie na ɛntena w’anim daa ɛfiri sɛ wo, O Awurade Nyankopɔn, wo na woaka, na wo nhyira mu na wɔbɛhyira w’akoa fie daa.”
8: Akyire yi, ɛbaa sɛ Dawid kaa Filistifoɔ no guiɛ, na ɔdii wɔn so nkonim, na Dawid gyee Meteg-Amma firii Filistifoɔ no nsam.
Samuel 8
Na Dawid kum Soba hene Rehob ba Hadadeser berɛ a na ɔresan akɔko agye asubɔnten Eufrate ho nkuro no.

Na Dawid ko gyee apɔnkɔsotefoɔ apem ahanson (1,700) ne mmarima mpem aduonu (20,000) a wɔnam fam firii ne nsam. Ɛnna Dawid twitwaa nteaseɛnam apɔnkɔ no nyinaa nantin ntini, na ɔgyaa nteaseɛnam apɔnkɔ no mu ɔha.
Berɛ a Siriafoɔ a wɔwɔ Damasko no baa sɛ wɔrebɛboa Soba hene Hadadeser no, Dawid kunkum Siriafoɔ mmarima mpem aduonu mmienu (22,000).
Afei, Dawid de asraafoɔdɔm kɔguu Siria a ɛwɔ Damasko, na Siriafoɔ bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa a wɔtua toɔ ma no. Na Awurade bɔɔ Dawid ho ban maa no dii nim wɔ baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nyinaa.
Afei nso Dawid gyegyee sika kɔkɔɔ akyɛm a na ɛkurakura Hadadeser nkoa no, na ɔde baa Yerusalem.
Na Ɔhene Dawid faa kɔbere bebree pa firii Hadadeser nkuro Beta ne Berotai mu kɔeɛ.
Na Hamat hene Toi tee sɛ Dawid aka Hadadeser asraafoɔdɔm no nyinaa agu.

Enti Toi somaa ne ba Yoram kɔɔ Ɔhene Dawid nkyɛn kɔkyeaa no, na ɔmaa no amo sɛ ɔne Hadadeser ako aka no aguo, deɛ ɛwom ne sɛ, na Hadadeser taa ne Toi di ako, na ɔde dwetɛ ne sika ne kɔbere nneɛma nyinaa bi kɔmaa no.
Ɔhene Dawid hyiraa yeinom nyinaa so maa Awurade, sɛdeɛ ɔhyiraa dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ a ɔgye firii amanaman a ɔdii wɔn so nkonim no nyinaa nkyɛn soɔ no;
ɛfiri Siria ne Moab ne Ammon asefoɔ ne Filistifoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ nsam ne Soba hene Rehob ba Hadadeser asadeɛ mu.
Na berɛ a Dawid kɔkaa Edomfoɔ mpem dunwɔtwe (18,000) guiɛ wɔ Nkyene Bɔn no mu baeɛ no, ɔgyee din.
Na ɔde asraafoɔdɔm kɔguu Edom; ɔde asraafoɔdɔm no kɔguu Edom baabiara, na Edomfoɔ nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa. Na Awurade bɔɔ Dawid ho ban maa no dii nim baabiara a ɔkɔeɛ nyinaa.
Na Dawid kɔɔ so dii Israel nyinaa so hene; Dawid buu atɛn na ɔdii asɛntenenee maa ne man nyinaa daa.
Na Seruia ba Yoab na ɔda asraafoɔ no ano, na Ahilud ba Yehosafat nso ne ɔhene krakye [Ɔtwerɛ nsɛm de sie].
Na Ahitab ba Sadok ne Abiatar ba Ahimelek na wɔyɛ asɔfoɔ, na Seraia nso ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ.
Na Yehoiada ba Benaia na ɔda Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ no ano, na Dawid mma no nso yɛ asɔfoɔ.
9: Na Dawid bisaa sɛ: “Obi da so wɔ hɔ a waka Saul fie a Yonatan nti mɛtumi ayɛ no adɔeɛ anaa?”
Samuel 9
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Obi nni Saul fie bio a mede Onyankopɔn adɔeɛ bɛyɛ no?” Ɛnna Siba ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Yonatan babarima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ bubuafoɔ [Apakye].”
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Ɔwɔ he?” Ɛnna Siba ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ɔwɔ Amiel ba Makir fie wɔ Lo-Debar.”
Ntɛm ara na Ɔhene Dawid soma maa wɔkɔfaa no firii Amiel ba Makir fie wɔ Lo-Debar baeɛ.
Berɛ a Saul ba Yonatan ba Mefiboset duruu Dawid nkyɛn no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔkoto de n’anim butuu fam. Na Dawid kaa sɛ: “Mefiboset!” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “W’akoa nie.”
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nsuro, na wo papa Yonatan nti mɛyɛ wo adɔeɛ, na mɛdane wo nana Saul asase nyinaa ama wo, na woadidi me pono so daa.”
Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔkotoeɛ na ɔkaa sɛ: “W’akoa ne hwan a woatwa w’ani ahwɛ kraman funu a ɔte sɛ me yi?”
Na ɔhene frɛɛ Saul somfoɔ Siba, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Adeɛ biara a ɛyɛ Saul ne ne fie nyinaa dea no, mede ama wo wura ba nana no.

Enti dɔ asase no ma no, wo ne wo mma ne wo nkoa, na fa ɛso nnɔbaeɛ bra na wo wura ba nana fiefoɔ nnya aduane nni. Wo wura ba nana Mefiboset deɛ, ɔbɛdidi me pono so daa.” Na Siba wɔ mma mmarima dunum ne nkoa aduonu.
Na Siba ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Deɛ me wura ɔhene hyɛɛ sɛ menyɛ mma n’akoa nyinaa no, ɛno ara na w’akoa bɛyɛ; enti ɔhene kaa sɛ, Mefiboset deɛ ɔnnidi me pono so sɛ ɔhene mma no bi.”
Na Mefiboset wɔ ɔbabarima kumaa bi a ne din de Mika, na wɔn a wɔte Siba fie nyinaa yɛ Mefiboset nkoa.
Na Mefiboset tenaa Yerusalem, na ɔdidii ɔhene pono so daa. Na ɔyɛ obubuafoɔ tɔ gu ne nan mmienu so.
10: Akyire yi, ɛbaa sɛ Ammonfoɔ hene wuiɛ, na ne ba Hanun bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Samuel 10

Ɛnna Ammon mpanimfoɔ bisaa wɔn wura Hanun sɛ: “Wogye di sɛ Dawid pɛ sɛ ɔdi wo papa ni w’anim nti na wasoma sɛ wɔmmɛkyekyere wo werɛ yi? Wonnye nni sɛ Dawid rebɛhwehwɛ kuro yi mu de apɛ kwan a ɔbɛfa so adane abutuo nti na wasoma ne nkoa aba wo nkyɛn yi?”
Enti Hanun kyee Dawid nkoa no yii wɔn abɔdwesɛ fa, na ɔtwitwaa wɔn ntadeɛ so bɛsii wɔn to, na ɔmaa wɔkɔeɛ.
Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid. Ɛhɔ ara na ɔsoma kɔhyiaa mmarima no ɛfiri sɛ na wɔagu wɔn anim ase pɔtɔɔ; na ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Montena Yeriko nkɔsi sɛ mo abɔdwesɛ bɛfu kuhaa ansa na moasan aba.”

Akyire yi, Ammonfoɔ no hunuu sɛ wɔn ho abɔn Dawid [David bo afu wɔn]. Ɛno nti Ammonfoɔ no soma kɔbɔɔ Siriafoɔ a wɔwɔ Bet-Rehob ne Siriafoɔ a wɔwɔ Soba paa, mmarima a wɔnam fam mpem aduonu (20,000), ne Maaka hene nnipa apem (1,000) ne Tob mmarima mpem dumienu (12,000).
Na Dawid teeɛ no, ɔmaa Yoab ne nnɔmmarima no ne asraafoɔ nkaeɛ no nyinaa kɔɔ hɔ.
Na Ammonfoɔ kɔtwaa ɛko mpasua wɔ kurotia, na Siriafoɔ a wɔwɔ Soba ne Rehob ne Tob ne Maaka mmarima nso kɔgyinagyinaa petee mu.
Berɛ a Yoab hunuu sɛ dɔm no bi wɔ n’anim ne n’akyi nyinaa no, ntɛm ara na ɔyii Israel mmarima akantinka no bi kɔɔ mpasua so kɔhyiaa Siriafoɔ no.
Na ɔde dɔm a aka no maa ne nua Abisai sɛ wɔntwa ɛko mpasua nkɔhyia Ammonfoɔ no.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ Siriafoɔ no ahoɔden boro me so a, bra bɛgye me; na sɛ Ammonfoɔ nso ahoɔden boro wo so a, me nso mɛba abɛgye wo.
Hyɛ wo ho den, na yɛmfa akokoɔduro nni mma yɛn man ne yɛn Nyankopɔn nkuro, na Awurade deɛ, deɛ ɛyɛ n’ani soɔ na ɔbɛyɛ.”
Ɛnna Yoab ne ne dɔm no kɔɔ wɔn anim kɔhyiaa Siriafoɔ no wɔ ko no mu, na wɔdwane firii n’anim.
Na Ammonfoɔ no hunuu sɛ Siriafoɔ adwane, enti wɔn nso wɔdwane firii Abisai anim, na wɔsan kɔɔ kuro no mu. Yei akyi no, Yoab gyaee Ammonfoɔ no akyiridie na ɔsan kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Berɛ a Siriafoɔ no hunuu sɛ wɔadi nkoguo Israel anim no, wɔboaboaa wɔn ano hyiaeɛ.
Na Hadadeser soma kɔfaa Siriafoɔ a wɔwɔ asubɔnten kɛseɛ no ho no baa Helam, na Hadadeser sahene Sobak na ɔdii wɔn anim.
Asɛm no duruu Dawid asom ara pɛ na, ɔboaboaa Israel nyinaa ano kɔtwaa Yordan kɔɔ Helam. Siriafoɔ twaa mpasua kɔhyiaa Dawid, na wɔne no koeɛ.
Nanso Siriafoɔ no dwane firii Israel anim, na Dawid kunkum Siriafoɔ ahanson (700) a wɔtete nteaseɛnam mu ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpem aduanan (40,000), na ɔsahene Sobak nso, ɔbɔɔ no maa no wuu hɔ.
Na berɛ a ahemfo a wɔyɛ Hadadeser nkoa no nyinaa hunuu sɛ wɔadi nkoguo Israel anim no, ɛhɔ ara na wɔne Israel yɛɛ asomdwoeɛ apam, na wɔsom wɔn, na Siriafoɔ suroo sɛ wɔbɛko agye Ammonfoɔ bio.
11: Na ɛbaa sɛ afe kɔ bɛhyiaeɛ, na berɛ a ahemfo firi kɔ ɔsa no, Dawid somaa Yoab a ne nkoa ka ne ho ne Israel nyinaa sɛ wɔnkɔsɛe Ammonfoɔ na wɔntwa Raba ho nhyia. Saa berɛ no, Dawid tenaa Yerusalem.
Samuel 11
Ɛnna Dawid soma kɔbisaa ɔbaa no ho asɛm, na obi kaa sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ Eliam ba Bat-Seba, Hitini Uria yere no nie?”
Na Dawid somaa abɔfoɔ kɔfaa no. Enti ɔbaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔne no daeɛ. Nso na ɛyɛ berɛ a na wɔadwira ne ho afiri ne nsabuo mu. Na ɔsan kɔɔ ne fie.
Na ɔbaa no nyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔsoma kɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Manyinsɛn.”
Ɛnna Dawid soma kɔɔ Yoab nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ma Hitini Uria mmra me nkyɛn.” Na Yoab maa Uria kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn.
Na berɛ a Uria duruu Dawid nkyɛn no, ɔbisaa no sɛdeɛ Yoab ne dɔm no ho teɛ, ne sɛdeɛ ɔsa no rekɔ soɔ.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Uria sɛ: “Kɔ wo fie kɔhohoro wo nan ase.” Enti Uria firii ahemfie hɔ kɔeɛ, na wɔde ɔhene akyɛdeɛ firi dii n’akyi.
Nanso Uria kɔdaa ahemfie pono no ano, ɔne ne wura nkoa a aka no nyinaa, na wankɔ ne fie.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Uria ankɔ ne fie.” Ɛnna Dawid bisaa Uria sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ kwan na wofiri baeɛ? Adɛn nti na woankɔ wo fie?”

Na Uria ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Onyankopɔn adaka no ne Israel ne Yuda tete asese mu, na me wura Yoab ne me wura nkoa abobɔ nsraban wɔ wuram, na me deɛ, menkɔ me fie nkɔdidi na mennom na me ne me yere nna anaa? Sɛ wote aseɛ na wo kra nso te aseɛ yi, merenyɛ adeɛ a ɛte saa!”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Uria sɛ: “Tena ha nnɛ nso, na ɔkyena mɛgya wo kwan ama woakɔ.” Enti Uria tenaa Yerusalem saa da no ne n’adekyeeɛ.
Na Dawid san frɛɛ no bio maa ɔbɛdidi nomee n’anim, na ɔmaa no boroeɛ. Nanso anwummerɛ no, ɔfirii adi kɔdaa ne mpa so, ɔne ne wura nkoa, na wankɔ ne fie.
Na adeɛ kyee anɔpa no, Dawid twerɛɛ krataa de hyɛɛ Uria nsam sɛ ɔmfa nkɔma Yoab.
Na ɔtwerɛɛ no krataa no mu sɛ: “Momma Uria nkɔgyina baabi a ɛko no mu yɛ den paa, na montwe mo ho mfiri n’akyi, na wɔmmɔ no mma no nwu.”
Berɛ a Yoab rehwɛ kuro no, ɔmaa Uria kɔgyinaa baabi a ɔnim sɛ nnɔmmarima wɔ.
Na berɛ a kuro no mu mmarima firii adi ne Yoab bɛkoeɛ no, dɔm a wɔyɛ Dawid nkoa no bi totɔeɛ, na Hitini Uria nso wuiɛ.
Ɛnna Yoab somaa sɛ wɔnkɔka ɔsa no mu nsɛm nyinaa nkyerɛ Dawid.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ɔbɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Sɛ woka ɔsa no mu nsɛm nyinaa kyerɛ ɔhene wie,
na sɛ ɔhene bo fu, na ɔbisa wo sɛ, ‘Adɛn nti na mobɛn kuro no saa kɔkoeɛ? Na monnim sɛ wɔbɛfiri ɔfasuo no so atoto agyan awowɔ mo anaa?
Hwan na ɔbɔɔ Yerubeset ba Abimelek kum no? Ɛnyɛ ɔbaa na ɔfiri ɔfasuo so too oyuyammoɔ bɔɔ no maa no wuu wɔ Tebes? Adɛn nti na mobɛn ɔfasuo no saa?’ a, wo nso ka sɛ, ‘W’akoa Uria, Hitini no nso awu.’”
Enti ɔbɔfoɔ no siim kɔeɛ, na ɔkɔkaa asɛm a Yoab de somaa no no nyinaa kyerɛɛ Dawid.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Mmarima no ho yɛɛ den senee yɛn; wɔfiri baa yɛn so wuram hɔ, na yɛtu saa wɔn ara kɔduruu kuro pono no ano.
Na agyantofoɔ no firi ɔfasuo no so toto baa wo nkoa so, na ɔhene nkoa no bi wuwuiɛ, na w’akoa Uria, Hitini no nso awu.”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ɔbɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Sei na kɔka kyerɛ Yoab, ‘Mma asɛm yi nha wo koraa, na nkrantɛ twa benkum twa nifa. Ma wo ko no mu nyɛ den wɔ kuro no so, na dwiri gu.’ Na hyɛ no nkuran.”
Na Uria yere no tee sɛ ne kunu Uria awuo no, ɔsuu ne wura.
Berɛ a ɔgyam no wieeɛ no, ntɛm ara na Dawid soma kɔfaa no baa ne fie, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yere. Na ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa no. Nanso adeɛ a Dawid yɛeɛ no ansɔ Awurade ani.
12: Ɛnna Awurade somaa Natan kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn. Na ɔkɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mmarima mmienu tenaa kuro bi mu, baako yɛ ɔdefoɔ, na baako yɛ ohiani.
Samuel 12
na ohiani no deɛ, ɔnni hwee sɛ odwammereɛ ketewa baako a ɔtɔɔ no. Na ɔyɛn no, na ɔne no ne ne mma boom nyiniiɛ. Ɔdii n’aduane bi, na ɔnom ne kuruwa ano. Na ɔda ne kokom, na ɔbɛyɛɛ sɛ ne babaa.
Afei ɔhɔhoɔ bi baa ɔdefoɔ no nkyɛn, nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔde ne nnwan ne n’anantwie no bi yɛ aduane ma ɔkwantuni a waba ne nkyɛn no, na ɔkɔfaa ohiani no dwammereɛ no siesie maa ɔbarima a ɔbaa ne nkyɛn no.”
Ɛnna Dawid bo fuu ɔbarima no dendeenden, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Natan sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, ɔbarima a ɔyɛɛ saa no fata owuo!
Sɛ wayɛ saa adeɛ yi na wanhunu mmɔbɔ nti, odwan no, ɔnhyɛ ananmu mprɛ nnan.”
Ɛnna Natan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Wo ara wone ɔbarima no! Deɛ Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn aka nie, ‘Me na mesraa woɔ de wo sii Israel so hene, na me na megyee wo firii Saul nsam.
Na mede wo wura fie maa wo, na mede wo wura yerenom nso guu wo kokom, na mede Israel ne Yuda fie maa wo. Na sɛ ɛsua a, anka mede nneɛma yi ne nneɛma foforɔ bɛka wo ho.
Adɛn nti na woabu Awurade asɛm animtia na woayɛ n’ani so bɔne yi? Wode nkrantɛ akum Hitini Uria, na woafa ne yere aware no; Ammonfoɔ nkrantɛ na wode kum no.
Na afei nkrantɛ remfiri wo fie da, ɛfiri sɛ woabu me animtia na woafa Hitini Uria yere aware no.’
Deɛ Awurade aka nie, ‘Hwɛ, mɛma mmusuo asɔre wo fie aba wo so, na magye wo yerenom w’anim de wɔn ama wo yɔnko, na ɔne wo yerenom adeda awia ketee.
Na wo deɛ, woyɛɛ no ahuntaeɛ mu, na me deɛ, mɛyɛ yei awia ketee wɔ Israel nyinaa anim.’”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Natan sɛ: “Mayɛ Awurade bɔne.” Na Natan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Awurade nso de wo bɔne akyɛ wo. Worenwu.
Nanso ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ yei de abu Awurade animtia nti, ɔba a wɔawo no ama wo seesei no, ɔbɛwu.”
Ɛnna Natan siim kɔɔ ne fie. Na Awurade bɔɔ abɔfra a Uria yere wo maa Dawid no maa no yareeɛ.
Na Dawid srɛɛ Nyankopɔn maa abɔfra no, na Dawid dii mmuada, na ɔkɔɔ dan mu kɔdaa fam anadwo no.
Na ne fie mpanimfoɔ kɔgyinaa ne nkyɛn sɛ wɔrema ne so afiri fam, nanso wampene, na ɔne wɔn annidi nso.

Ɛbaa sɛ da a ɛtɔ so nson no, abɔfra no wuiɛ. Nso na Dawid nkoa no suro sɛ wɔbɛka akyerɛ no sɛ abɔfra no awu, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Berɛ a abɔfra no te aseɛ no, yɛne no kasaeɛ nanso wantie yɛn. Ɛnneɛ yɛbɛyɛ dɛn aka akyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Abɔfra no awu’? Ɔbɛyɛ adebɔne bi atia ne ho.”
Berɛ a Dawid hunuu sɛ ne nkoa no reyɛ huhuhuhu no, Dawid hunuu sɛ abɔfra no awu. Enti Dawid bisaa ne nkoa no sɛ: “Abɔfra no awu anaa?” Na wɔbuaa sɛ: “Wawu.”
Ɛnna Dawid sɔre firii fam, na ɔdware de ngo sraeɛ, na ɔsesaa n’atadeɛ kɔɔ Awurade fie hɔ kɔkotoeɛ. Ɛno akyi no, ɔbaa ne fie, na ɔbisa maa wɔde aduane bɛsii n’anim ntɛm, na ɔdiiɛ.
Ɛnna ne nkoa no bisaa no sɛ: “Adeɛ a woayɛ yi kyerɛ sɛn? Abɔfra no te aseɛ no, ne nti, wodii mmuada na wosuiɛ. Nanso abɔfra no wuiɛ ara pɛ, woasɔre adidi.”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Abɔfra no te aseɛ no, medii mmuada, na mesuiɛ ɛfiri sɛ mekaa sɛ, ‘Hwan na ɔnim sɛ ebia Awurade bɛdom me na abɔfra no anya nkwa?’
Na seesei a wawuo yi, meredi mmuada ayɛ dɛn? Mɛtumi de no aba bio anaa? Mɛkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔno deɛ, ɔrensan mma me nkyɛn.”
Na Dawid kyekyeree ne yere Bat-Seba werɛ. Afei ɔkɔɔ ne nkyɛn ne no kɔdaeɛ, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima. Na ɔtoo ne din Solomon, na Awurade dɔɔ no.
Na ɔsomaa odiyifoɔ Natan maa no kɔtoo ne din Yedidia, ɛsiane Awurade nti.
Na Yoab ne Ammonfoɔ a wɔwɔ Raba koeɛ, na ɔgyee ahenkuro no.
Ɛnna Yoab somaa abɔfoɔ baa Dawid nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: “Me ne Raba ako, na magye nsuo kuro no.
Na afei boaboa ɔman no nkaeɛ ano bɛkyere kuro no ho nsraban, na gye, na me mmom mannye kuro no, na wɔamfa me din anto so.”
Na Dawid boaboaa ɔman no nyinaa ano na ɔne Raba kɔkoeɛ na ɔgyeeɛ.
Na ɔyii wɔn hene abotire firii ne ti; na emu duro yɛ sika dwetikɛseɛ baako, na aboɔden aboɔ nso wom, na wɔde hyɛɛ Dawid ti. Na ɔde kuro no mu asadeɛ bebree pa baeɛ.
Na ɔde emu nnipa nso baeɛ, na ɔmaa wɔde nnadeɛ a ano yɛ nnam ne akuma paee aboɔ, na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ birikisi; saa na ɔyɛɛ Ammonfoɔ nkuro nyinaa. Ɛnna Dawid ne dɔm no nyinaa san baa Yerusalem.
13: Na Dawid ba Absalom wɔ nuabaa hoɔfɛfoɔ bi a wɔfrɛ no Tamar. Nsɛm yi akyi no, ɛbaa sɛ na Dawid ba Amnon pɛ no.
Samuel 13
Na Amnon wɔ adamfoɔ bi a ne din de Yonadab a ɔyɛ Dawid nua Simea ba; na Yonadab yɛ onitefoɔ paa.
Enti ɔbisaa no sɛ: “O Adɛn nti na ɔhene ba paa, anɔpa biara na woabotoɔ yi? Worenka nkyerɛ me?” Ɛnna Amnon ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mepɛ me nua Absalom nuabaa Tamar.”

Ɛnna Yonadab kaa sɛ: “Kɔda wo mpa so na patu yare, na wo papa bɛba abɛhwɛ wo. Sɛ ɔba a, ka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wo, ma me nuabaa Tamar mmra, na me yareɛ no nti ɔmmɛma me aduane. Na ɔmmɛyɛ aduane no m’anim, na menhunu na menni no ne nsam.’”
Ɛnna Amnon kɔdaa hɔ na ɔpatu yareeɛ, na ɔhene bɛhwɛɛ no. Afei Amnon ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma me nuabaa Tamar mmra mmɛyɛ paanoo mmienu m’anim na me yareɛ no nti, menni no ne nsam.”
Ɛnna Dawid soma kɔɔ Tamar hɔ wɔ fie sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, kɔ wo nua Amnon fie na kɔyɛ paanoo ma no.”
Enti Tamar kɔɔ ne nua Amnon fie kɔtoo sɛ ɔda hɔ. Na ɔfaa esiam a wɔafete, na ɔbɔ de yɛɛ paanoo wɔ n’anim.
Na ɔwieeɛ no, ɔfaa kyɛnsee no na ɔyiyii no n’anim, nanso Amnon anni, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Momma obiara mfiri me nkyɛn mfiri adi!” Na obiara firii ne nkyɛn kɔeɛ.
Afei Amnon ka kyerɛɛ Tamar sɛ: “Fa paanoo no bra pia mu na me yareɛ no nti menni no wo nsam.” Enti Tamar de paanoo a wayɛ no kɔmaa ne nua Amnon wɔ pia mu.
Na berɛ a ɔkɔɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔrekɔma no aduane no, ɛhɔ ara na ɔyeree no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Me nuabaa, bra na me ne wo nna.”
Na ɔno nso ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Dabi me nuabarima! Mmrɛ me ase; na wɔnyɛ saa wɔ Israel. Nyɛ aniwudeɛ saa.
Na me deɛ, ɛhe na anka mede m’ahohora bɛfa? Na wo nso wobɛyɛ sɛ Israel mmarima agyimifoɔ a wɔnni adwene no bi. Enti mesrɛ wo, wo ne ɔhene nkasa, na ɔremfa me nkame wo.”
Nanso wantie no, na ɔde ahoɔden bunkam ne so brɛɛ no ase, na ɔne no daeɛ.
Ɛno akyi no, Amnon de ɔtan kɛseɛ tanee no, na ɔtan a ɔtanee no no yɛɛ kɛse senee ɔdɔ a ɔdɔɔ no no. Enti Amnon ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɔre, firi ha kɔ!”
Ɛnna ne nuabaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Dabi me nua; pamo a worepamo me yi yɛ bɔne sene deɛ wode ayɛ me no!” Nanso wantie no.
Ɛnna ɔfrɛɛ n’akoa a ɔsom no no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Pamo ɔbaa yi firi me so na ɔmfiri adi, na to pono akyi korɔkorɔ no mu n’akyi.”
Saa berɛ no, na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ nsensanmu yuu bi; saa ngugusoɔ no na na ɔhene mma mmaa, mmaabunu no, hyɛ. Enti ne somfoɔ no de no firii adi, na ɔtoo pono no mu n’akyi.
Ɛnna Tamar de nso guu ne tirim [n'atifi], na ɔsuanee atadeɛ nsensanmu a ɛhyɛ no no mu; afei ɔde ne nsa guu ne ti na ɔde susiim kɔeɛ.
Na ne nua Absalom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo nua Amnon ne wo ada anaa? Me nuabaa, wo deɛ, yɛ komm. Ɔyɛ wo nua. Mfa w’akoma nkɔ asɛm no so.” Na Tamar tenaa ne nua Absalom fie, na wamma nnipa mu.
Na ɔhene Dawid tee nsɛm yi nyinaa no, ne bo fuu pii.
Na Absalom anka asɛmmɔne anaa asɛmpa bi ankyerɛ Amnon, na Absalom tanee Amnon sɛ wabrɛ ne nuabaa Tamar aseɛ nti.
Na mfeɛ mmienu akyi no, Absalom maa nkurɔfoɔ kɔtwitwaa ne nnwan ho wɔ Baal-Hasor a ɛbɛn Efraim, na Absalom too nsa frɛɛ ɔhene mma no nyinaa.
Afei Absalom kɔɔ ɔhene anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, w’akoa ama nkurɔfoɔ retwitwa ne nnwan ho! Enti mesrɛ wo, ma ɔhene ne ne nkoa mmɛka w’akoa ho nkɔ.”
Nanso ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: “Dabi, me ba! Mesrɛ wo, mma yɛn nyinaa nnkɔ na yɛanyɛ adesoa amma wo.” Ɔsrɛɛ no ara, nanso wampene ne no ankɔ. Hyira na ɔhyiraa no.
Ɛnna Absalom kaa sɛ: “Sɛ wontumi nkɔ a, mesrɛ wo, ma me nua Amnon ne yɛn nkɔ.” Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wopɛ sɛ ɔne wo korɔ?”
Na Absalom srɛɛ no, enti ɔmaa Amnon ne ɔhene mma mmarima no nyinaa ne no kɔeɛ.

Afei Absalom hyɛɛ n’asomfoɔ no sɛ: “Sɛ mohunu sɛ Amnon anom nsa ama n’ani agye n’akomam aboro sei sram; na meka kyerɛ mo sɛ, ‘Monku Amnon!’ a, saa berɛ no na monku no, monnsuro. Ɛnyɛ me na mahyɛ mo saa anaa? Monyɛ den na monnya akokoɔduro.”
Na Absalom nkoa no yɛɛ Amnon sɛdeɛ Absalom hyɛɛ wɔn no, na ɔhene mma mmarima a wɔaka no nyinaa sɔresɔreeɛ, na obiara tenaa n’afunumupɔnkɔ so dwaneeɛ.
Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a wɔnam kwan so rekorɔ no, nkurɔfoɔ kɔbɔɔ Dawid amanneɛ sɛ: “Absalom akunkum ɔhene mma mmarima no nyinaa na wɔn mu baako mpo anka.”
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔreeɛ, na ɔsuanee n’atadeɛ mu de ne ho too fam; na ne nkoa nyinaa nso gyinagyina hɔ aasunsuane wɔn ntadeɛ mu.

Nanso Dawid nua Simea ba Yonadab kaa sɛ: “Mma me wura nnnwene sɛ ɔhene mma mmeranteɛ no nyinaa na wɔakunkum wɔn. Amnon nko ara na wawuo, ɛfiri sɛ Absalom na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnku no, na ɔbɔɔ pɔ yi firi da a ɔbrɛɛ ne nuabaa Tamar aseɛ no.
Enti mma me wura ɔhene mmfa n’akoma nnkɔ asɛm yi so sɛ, ‘Ɔhene mma mmarima no nyinaa awuwu,’ na Amnon nko ara na wawuo.”
Absalom deɛ, na wadwane. Akyire yi, aberanteɛ a ɔwɛn no maa n’ani so hwɛeɛ, na ɔnkɔhwɛ a, nnipa bebree na wɔfiri bepɔ so kwan a ɛda n’akyi no so reba yi.
Ɛnna Yonadab ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Hwɛ, ahenemma no reba. Sɛdeɛ w’akoa kaeɛ no, saa ara na ɛteɛ.”
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔkasa wieeɛ no, ahenemma no bɛduruiɛ, na wɔmemaa wɔn nne so suiɛ; ɔhene ne ne nkoa nyinaa nso suu esu kɛseɛ pa ara.
Na Absalom deɛ, na wadwane sɛ ɔrekɔ Gesur hene Amihud ba Talmai nkyɛn. Na Dawid suu ne ba no nna no nyinaa.
Enti Absalom dwane kɔɔ Gesur, na ɔtenaa hɔ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.
Na Dawid kra ani gyinaa sɛ ɔbɛhunu Absalom, ɛfiri sɛ na wakyekyere ne werɛ Amnon wuo no ho.
14: Na Seruia ba Yoab hunuu sɛ ɔhene akoma wɔ Absalom ho.
Samuel 14
Afei bra ɔhene anim bɛka nsɛm yi kyerɛ no.” Ɛnna Yoab de nsɛm no hyɛɛ n’anom.
Na Tekoani baa no baa ɔhene anim bɛkoto de n’anim butuu fam, na ɔkaa sɛ: “O ɔhene, gye me!”
Ɛnna ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Asɛm bɛn na ato woɔ?” Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “Me kunu awu, enti meyɛ ɔbaa kunafoɔ.
Na w’afenaa wɔ mma mmarima mmienu. Wɔn mmienu no dii aperepereɛ wɔ afuo mu berɛ a ɔgyefoɔ bi nni hɔ a ɔbɛpata wɔn. Na ɛbaa sɛ baako bɔɔ ne yɔnko hwee hɔ kum no.

Na hwɛ, abusuafoɔ no nyinaa asɔre atia w’afenaa, na deɛ wɔreka ara ne sɛ, ‘Fa deɛ ɔkum ne nua no ma yɛn na ne nua a waku no no kra nti, yɛnku no, na yɛmpepa deɛ ɔdi adeɛ no mfiri hɔ!’ Enti wɔrebɛhye m'ase de apepa me kunu din ne n’asefoɔ afiri asase so.”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no sɛ: “Kɔ wo fie, na mɛhyɛ ama wɔadi w’asɛm no ho dwuma.”
Afei Tekoani baa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “O me wura ɔhene, ma asodie no mmra me ne me papa fie so na ɔhene ne n’ahennwa nni bem.”
Na ɔhene san kaa sɛ: “Sɛ obi ka asɛm bi kyerɛ wo a, fa no brɛ me, na ɔrenyɛ wo bɔne bi bio.”

Nanso ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “Ɔhene, mesrɛ wo, kae Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, na mogya werɛtɔfoɔ no ankɔ so ansɛe adeɛ, na wɔanyi me ba no amfiri hɔ.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, wo ba no tiri nwi baako mpo rentɔ fam.”
Afei ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma w’afenaa nka asɛm bi nkyerɛ me wura ɔhene.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Kasa!”

Ɛnna ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woanya adwene a ɛntene saa Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ ho? Na sɛ ɔhene gu so reka saa asɛm yi a, na ɔte sɛ onipa a ɔdi fɔ no ara, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene mmaa ne ho nipa a watwa no asuo no nsan mmaeɛ.
Owuo deɛ, ɛtwa sɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛbɛwuo, na yɛte sɛ nsuo a wɔahwie agu fam a wɔntumi nsesa bio. Nanso Onyankopɔn renyi ɔkra bi mfiri hɔ, na wadwene deɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔde deɛ wɔatwa no asuo no bɛsan aba.
Na afei, deɛ enti a mebɛkaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ me wura ɔhene ne sɛ, ɔman no maa mesuroeɛ. Enti w’afenaa kaa sɛ, ‘Ma me ne ɔhene nkɔkasa ɛ. Ebia ɔhene bɛyɛ deɛ n’afenaa bɛka no.
Sɛ ɔhene bɛtie na wayi n’afenaa afiri onipa a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsɛe me ne me ba firi Onyankopɔn agyapadeɛ mu no nsam.’
Ɛno nti na w’afenaa kaa sɛ, ‘Me wura ɔhene anom asɛm bɛma me asomdwoeɛ.’ Ɛfiri sɛ me wura ɔhene te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, na ɔtumi hunu papa ne bɔne; Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyi.”
Ɛnna ɔhene buaa ɔbaa no sɛ: “Deɛ merebɛbisa woɔ yi, mfa biribiara nhunta me.” Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “Ma me wura ɔhene nkasa.”

Na ɔhene bisaa sɛ: “Yoab nsa wɔ yei nyinaa mu anaa?” Ɛnna ɔbaa no buaa sɛ: “O me wura ɔhene, sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, deɛ me wura ɔhene aka nyinaa, obiara ntumi nnane mfiri ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum; ɛyɛ w’akoa Yoab na ɔhyɛɛ me, na ɔno na ɔde nsɛm yi nyinaa hyɛɛ w’afenaa anom.
W’akoa Yoab yɛɛ saa na ama asɛm yi adane, nanso me wura nyansa te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ nyansa, na ɔnim asase so nsɛm nyinaa.”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Hwɛ, mɛyɛ saa. Enti kɔ na kɔfa aberanteɛ Absalom bra.”
Na Yoab koto de n’anim butuu fam, na ɔhyiraa ɔhene. Afei Yoab kaa sɛ: “O me wura ɔhene, ɛnnɛ na w’akoa ahunu sɛ manya w’anim adom, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene ayɛ deɛ n’akoa aka no.”
Ɛno nti Yoab kaa saa no, ɔsɔre siim kɔɔ Gesur kɔfaa Absalom baa Yerusalem.
Nanso ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Ma no mfa n’ani nkyerɛ ɔno ara ne fie, na mempɛ sɛ mɛhunu n’anim.” Enti Absalom de n’ani kyerɛɛ ɔno ara ne fie, na wankɔhunu ɔhene anim.
Israel nyinaa, na obiara nni hɔ a ne ho yɛ fɛ na wɔkamfo no pii sɛ Absalom. Ɛfiri ne nan ase kɔsi n’apampam, na dɛm biara nni ne ho.
Sɛ ɔyi ne tiri nwi na ɔkari a, emu duro yɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu, ahemfie nkariboɔ so—afe biara na ɔyi ne tiri nwi, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛyɛ no duru dodo.
Na wɔwoo mma mmarima mmiɛnsa ne ɔbabaa baako a wɔfrɛ no Tamar maa Absalom. Na ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ne ho yɛ fɛ yie.
Absalom kɔɔ so tenaa Yerusalem mfeɛ mmienu, na wanhunu ɔhene anim da.
Ɛnna Absalom somaa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ Yoab mmra na ɔnsoma no ɔhene nkyɛn, nanso wamma. Na ɔsan somaeɛ, ne mprenu soɔ, ɛno nso wamma.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: “Monhwɛ, Yoab asase da me deɛ ho, na ɔwɔ atokoɔ wɔ so. Monkɔ nkɔto mu gya.” Enti Absalom nkoa de egya kɔtoo asase no mu.
Ɛnna Yoab sɔre kɔɔ Absalom nkyɛn wɔ fie, na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wo nkoa de gya akɔto m’asase no mu?”

Ɛnna Absalom ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Hwɛ! mesoma baa wo hɔ sɛ, ‘Bra na mensoma wo ɔhene nkyɛn na kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na mefiri Gesur aba ha? Anka ɛyɛ ma me sɛ meda so te hɔ. Enti afei ma menhunu ɔhene anim, na sɛ bɔne bi wɔ me ho a, ma no nku me.”’”
Enti Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene anim kɔka kyerɛɛ no. Ɛnna ɔfrɛɛ Absalom, na ɔbaa ɔhene anim bɛkoto de n’anim butuu fam ɔhene anim, na ɔhene fee Absalom ano.
15: Nsɛm yi akyi no, Absalom maa wɔyɛɛ teaseɛnam maa no, na ɔnyaa apɔnkɔ ne mmarima aduonum a wɔtu mmirika di n’anim.
Samuel 15
afei Absalom ka kyerɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, w’asɛm yɛ dɛ na ɛtene, nanso obiara nni ɔhene nkyɛn a ɔbɛtie w’asɛm ama woɔ.”
Na Absalom ka bio sɛ: “O sɛ me na wɔayi me asase yi so ɔtemmufoɔ a, me nkyɛn na anka obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm a ɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi ma no bɛba na mabu atɛntenenee.”
Deɛ na ɔyɛ bio ne sɛ, obi kɔ ne nkyɛn na ɔbɔ ne mu ase a, ɔtene ne nsa sɔ ne mu na ɔfe n’ano.
Na saa na Absalom yɛɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔbaa ɔhene anim sɛ ɔmmu atɛn mma wɔn no nyinaa. Absalom de saa ara wiaa Israel mmarima akoma baa n'afa.
Ɛbaa sɛ mfeɛ nnan akyi no, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma menkɔ Hebron nkɔtua me bɔhyɛ adeɛ a mede hyɛɛ Awurade bɔ no.
Berɛ a w’akoa te Gesur wɔ Siria no, mehyɛɛ bɔ sɛ, ‘Sɛ Awurade san de me ba Yerusalem a, me nso mɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama Awurade.’”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ.” Enti ɔsɔre kɔɔ Hebron.
Afei Absalom somasomaa akwansrafoɔ kɔɔ Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu kodɛɛ sɛ: “Sɛ mote sɛ wɔahyɛne abɛn ara pɛ a, monka sɛ, ‘Absalom di hene wɔ Hebron!’”
Saa berɛ no, na wɔafrɛfrɛ mmarima ahanu afiri Yerusalem adi Absalom akyi kɔ, nanso na wɔnnim deɛ ɛrekɔ soɔ no ho hwee.

Afei nso, berɛ a Absalom bɔɔ afɔdeɛ no, ɔsoma kɔfrɛɛ Giloni Ahitofel, Dawid fotufoɔ no, firii ne kurom Gilo baeɛ. Na atirisopam no mu kɔɔ so yɛɛ den, na nnipa a wɔbɛkaa Absalom ho no kɔɔ so dɔɔso ara.
Akyire yi, obi bɛka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Israel mmarima akoma akɔdi Absalom akyi.”

Ntɛm ara na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa a wɔka ne ho wɔ Yerusalem no nyinaa sɛ: “Monsɔre mma yɛnnwane, anyɛ saa a, yɛrennya baabi mfa mfiri Absalom anim! Monka mo ho, na wanyɛ ntɛm ammɛto yɛn anyɛ yɛn bɔne bi, na wamfa nkrantɛ ammɔ kuro yi!”
Ɛnna ɔhene nkoa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ me wura ɔhene pɛ nyinaa, hwɛ, wo nkoa nie, bɛyɛ.”
Enti ɔhene kɔeɛ, na ne fiefoɔ nyinaa dii n’akyi. Na ɔhene gyaa mmaa du a wɔyɛ ne mpenafoɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie hɔ.
Ɛnna ɔhene siim kɔeɛ, na ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa dii n’akyi. Na wɔkɔgyinaa efie a ɛtwa toɔ ho wɔ kuro no akyi.
Na ne nkoa nyinaa bɛtwaam faa ne nkyɛn; Keretifoɔ no nyinaa ne Peletifoɔ no nyinaa ne Gatfoɔ no nyinaa, mmarima ahansia a wɔdii n’akyi firii Gat baeɛ no, bɛtwaam ɔhene anim.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Gitni Itai sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wo nso wo ne yɛn rekorɔ? San kɔ, na kɔtena ɔhene no nkyɛn, na woyɛ hɔhoɔ, na afei nso woatu afiri wo man mu.
Nnora nko ara na wobaeɛ, na adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnnɛ mema wo ne yɛn kɔkyinkyini baabiara a mɛkorɔ? San w’akyi kɔ, wo ne wo nuanom. Awurade ne wo nni no adɔeɛ ne nokorɛdie so!”
Nanso Itai buaa ɔhene sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade te aseɛ na me wura ɔhene nso te aseɛ yi, baabiara a me wura ɔhene bɛkorɔ no, owuo mu oo, nkwa mu oo, ɛhɔ ara na w’akoa nso bɛkorɔ!”
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Itai sɛ: “Twa kɔ.” Enti Gitni Itai twaeɛ, na ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa ne mmɔfra a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa dii n’akyi.
Na asase no sofoɔ nyinaa de nne kɛseɛ suiɛ, na nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa twaam kɔeɛ, na ɔhene twaa Kidron subɔn no, na nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa twa kɔfaa serɛ so kwan no so.
Na Sadok ne Lewifoɔ a wɔso Nyankopɔn apam adaka no nyinaa ka wɔn ho, na wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no sii hɔ, Abiatar nkyɛn, kɔsii sɛ nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa firii kuro no mu twaeɛ.
Nanso ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Sadok sɛ: “Fa Nyankopɔn adaka no san kɔ kuro no mu. Sɛ menya Awurade anim adom a, ɔbɛsan de me aba na mabɛhunu adaka no ne ne sibea.
Na sɛ ɔka sɛ, ‘M’ani nnye wo ho’ nso a, menie, deɛ ɛtene n’ani soɔ biara, ma no mfa nyɛ me.”
Na ɔhene san ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok sɛ: “Wonyɛ ɔdehwɛfoɔ anaa? San kɔ kuro no mu asomdwoeɛ mu, wo ne wo ba Ahimaas ne Abiatar ba Yonatan, mo ne mo mma mmienu no nyinaa nkɔ.
Me deɛ, mɛtwentwɛn me nan ase wɔ serɛ no so asutwareeɛ hɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛte asɛm bi afiri mo nkyɛn.”
Ɛnna Sadok ne Abiatar de Nyankopɔn adaka no san kɔɔ Yerusalem, na wɔtenaa hɔ twɛneeɛ.
Na Dawid foroo Ngo bepɔ no. Ɔreforo kɔ nyinaa na ɔde adeɛ akata ne ti resu; na ɔnhyɛ mpaboa, na nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa nso, obiara akata ne ti, na wɔreforo kɔ nyinaa na wɔresu.
Na wɔbɛbɔɔ Dawid amanneɛ sɛ: “Ahitofel nso ka wɔn a wɔne Absalom apam no ho.” Ɛnna Dawid kaa sɛ: “O Awurade, mesrɛ wo, ma Ahitofel agyinatuo nnane nkwaseasɛm!”
Na berɛ a Dawid duruu atifi hɔ, baabi a kane na wɔkoto Onyankopɔn no, hwɛ, Arkini Husai bɛhyiaa no wɔ hɔ a wasuane n’atadeɛ mu de dɔteɛ agu n’atifi.
Nanso Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ wo ne me twa kɔ a, wobɛyɛ adesoa ama me.
Na sɛ wosan kɔ kuro no mu na woka kyerɛ Absalom sɛ, ‘O ɔhene, meyɛ w’akoa; kane no, na meyɛ wo papa akoa, nanso seesei deɛ, meyɛ w’akoa’ a, wobɛtumi asɛe Ahitofel agyinatuo ama me.
Ɛnyɛ wo ne ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar na ɛwɔ hɔ anaa? Enti asɛm biara a wobɛte afiri ahemfie no, ka kyerɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar.
Hwɛ! Wɔn mma mmienu no ne wɔn wɔ hɔ, Sadok ba Ahimaas ne Abiatar ba Yonatan. Enti asɛm biara a mobɛteɛ no, momma wɔmmɛka nkyerɛ me.”
Ɛnna Dawid yɔnko Husai baa kuro no mu. Absalom nso baa Yerusalem.
16: Na berɛ a Dawid twaam firii atifi hɔ kɔɔ kakra no, Mefiboset somfoɔ Siba bɛhyiaa no, na ɔde mfunumu mmienu a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn a wɔsoso paanoo ahanu ne bobe taterɛ ɔha, ne ahuhuro berɛ mu aduaba a wɔabɔ no ntoantoa ɔha, ne bobesa ahina baako baeɛ.
Samuel 16
Ɛnna ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Na wo wura ba no wɔ he?” Na Siba ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Hwɛ, ɔte Yerusalem reka sɛ, ‘Ɛnnɛ Israel fie bɛsan adane m'agya ahennie ama me.’”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Siba sɛ: “Hwɛ! Deɛ Mefiboset wɔ biara yɛ wo dea.” Ɔkaa saa no, Siba kaa sɛ: “Mekoto wo. Ma mennya w’anim adom, me wura ɔhene.”
Na Ɔhene Dawid baeɛ ara bɛduruu Bahurim, na hwɛ! ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Saul abusua mu a wɔfrɛ no Simei, Gera ba no, firii adi firii hɔ baeɛ; ɔreba no nyinaa, na ɔredome no ba.
Na ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ paa Dawid ne Ɔhene Dawid nkoa nyinaa aboɔ; na nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa ne nnɔmmarima no nyinaa wɔ ne benkum ne ne nifa.
Nsɛm a Simei kaeɛ berɛ a ɔredome no ne sɛ: “Firi hɔ kɔ, firi hɔ kɔ, ɔbarima mogyapɛfoɔ, nipahunu a ɔte sɛ woɔ!
Awurade ama Saul a wobɛsii n’ananmu dii hene no fie mogya nyinaa abɛgu w’atifi, na Awurade agye ahennie no de ahyɛ wo ba Absalom nsa. Hwɛ, woyɛ ɔbarima mogyapɛfoɔ nti na mmusuo aba wo soɔ no!”
Ɛnna Seruia ba Abisai ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Adɛn nti na kraman funu yi redome me wura ɔhene? Mesrɛ wo, ma menkɔ nkɔte ne ti mfiri so.”
Nanso ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na me ne mo wɔ yɛ, Seruia mma? Momma no nnome me, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade na aka akyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Dome Dawid!’ Enti hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka sɛ, ‘Adɛn nti na woyɛɛ saa?’”
Na Dawid san ka kyerɛɛ Abisai ne ne nkoa nyinaa sɛ: “Hwɛ! Me ara me ba a ɔfiri m’asene mu mpo repɛ me kra, na Benyaminni na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn! Monnyaa no na ɔnnome me, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade na aka sɛ ɔnyɛ!
Ebia Awurade ani bɛhunu m'amanehunu, na Awurade de papa bɛhyɛ ne nnome no anan ama me nnɛ.”
Ɛnna Dawid ne ne mmarima no toaa wɔn akwantuo no soɔ; na Simei nso nam bepɔ no fanohoa, ne ntentensoɔ redome no, na ɔrekɔ nyinaa na ɔrepa no aboɔ, na ɔtoo mfuturo bebree peteeɛ.
Nkakrankakra ɔhene ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa kɔduruiɛ, na na wɔabrɛ. Enti wɔhomee hɔ.
Na Absalom deɛ, ɔne nnipa no nyinaa, Israel mmarima no, baa Yerusalem, na na Ahitofel ka ne ho.
Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a Dawid yɔnko Husai, Arkini no, duruu Absalom nkyɛn no, ɛhɔ ara na Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: “Ɔhene nnya nkwa! Ɔhene nnya nkwa!”
Ɛnna Absalom bisaa Husai sɛ: “Adɔeɛ a wopɛ sɛ woyɛ wo yɔnko nie? Adɛn nti na wo ne wo yɔnko no ankorɔ?”
Na Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: “Dabi, na deɛ Awurade ne nkurɔfoɔ yi ne Israel mmarima nyinaa ayi no no, ɔno na mewɔ n’afa, na ɔno na me ne no bɛtena.
Mereka ne mprenu soɔ sɛ, hwan na mɛsom no? Ɛnyɛ ne ba anim na mɛsom? Sɛdeɛ mesom wo papa anim no, saa ara na mɛsom w’anim.”
Akyire yi, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ Ahitofel sɛ: “Montu yɛn fo. Ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ?”
Ɛnna Ahitofel ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: “Wo ne wo papa mpenafoɔ a ɔgyaa wɔn akyire sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie hɔ no nna. Israel nyinaa bɛte sɛ wo ho abɔn wo papa, na wɔn a wɔwɔ w’afanyinaa bɛhyɛ wɔn nsam den.”
Enti wɔsii ntomadan wɔ dan atifi maa Absalom, na Absalom ne ne papa mpenafoɔ no daeɛ, Israel nyinaa anim.
Nna no mu no, na Ahitofel afotuo te sɛ deɛ obi akɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn akɔbisa biribi. Saa na na Ahitofel afotuo nyinaa teɛ ma Dawid ne Absalom nyinaa.
17: Ɛnna Ahitofel ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma menyi mmarima mpem dumienu na yɛnsɔre nkɔti Dawid anadwo yi.
Samuel 17
Na mede ɔman no nyinaa bɛsan abrɛ wo, sedeɛ wɔde ayeforɔ ba ne kunu nkyɛn no. Sɛ wo nsa ka onipa a worehwehwɛ no no a, woanya ɔman no nyinaa, na ɔman no nyinaa bɛnya asomdwoeɛ.”
Na asɛm no tɔɔ Absalom ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa aso mu.
Nanso Absalom kaa sɛ: “Momfrɛ Arkini Husai mmra na yɛntie deɛ ɔno nso wɔ ka.”
Enti Husai baa Absalom nkyɛn. Na Absalom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Asɛm a Ahitofel aka nie. Yɛnyɛ deɛ waka no anaa? Sɛ ɛnte saa a, wo nso ka bi.”
Ɛnna Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: “Ahitofel afotuo a ɔde ama saa berɛ yi deɛ, ɛnyɛ!”
Na Husai ka kaa ho sɛ: “Wo ara wonim wo papa ne ne mmarima no sɛ wɔyɛ ahoɔdenfoɔ, na wɔn ani abere sɛ sisire bereɛ a ne mma ayera wɔ wuram; wo papa nso yɛ ɔkofoɔ, enti ɔne ɔmanfoɔ no renna anadwo yi.
Hwɛ! Sɛsɛɛ wakɔhunta amena bi mu anaa baabi foforɔ, na sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔn mu bi di kan totɔ a, nkurɔfoɔ bɛte akɔka sɛ, ‘Nnipa a wɔdi Absalom akyi no adi nkoguo!’
Ɛba saa a, ɔbarima kokoɔdurofoɔ a n’akoma te sɛ gyata akoma mpo, ehu nti, ɔbɛyɛ mmerɛ; Israel nyinaa nim sɛ wo papa yɛ dɔmmarima, na saa na mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ a wɔka ne ho no nso teɛ.
Enti m’afotuo ne sɛ: Ma wɔmmoaboa Israel nyinaa ano, ɛfiri Dan kɔsi Beer-Seba, sɛ mpoano anwea dodoɔ, na wɔmmra wo nkyɛn, na wo ara kɔ ɛko no.
Ma yɛnkɔ ne so wɔ baabi a yɛbɛhu no, na yɛnto nhyɛ ne so sɛdeɛ bosuo tɔ gu fam no, na ɔne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no baako mpo renka.
Na sɛ ɔdwane kɔhyɛ kuro bi mu nso a, Israel nyinaa bɛfa nhoma akɔ kuro no mu, na yɛatwe akɔgu subɔn no mu akɔsi sɛ ɛboɔ baako mpo renka hɔ.”

Ɛnna Absalom ne Israel mmarima nyinaa kaa sɛ: “Arkini Husai afotuo no yɛ sene Ahitofel afotuo no!” Na Ahitofel afotuo no yɛ, nanso Awurade na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnsɛe afotuo no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Awurade de mmusuo bɛba Absalom soɔ.
Akyire yi, Husai kɔka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar sɛ: “Sei ne sei na Ahitofel tuu Absalom ne Israel mpanimfoɔ no foɔ, na sei ne sei na me nso metuu no foɔ.
Enti afei monsoma ntɛm nkɔka nkyerɛ Dawid sɛ, ‘Ntena serɛ pradaa no so anadwo yi, twa mmom na twa korɔ, anyɛ saa a wɔbɛmemene ɔhene ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa.’”

Na Yonatan ne Ahimaas deɛ, na wɔgyinagyina En-Rogel, na abaawa bi kɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ wɔn deɛ wɔnkɔka nkyerɛ Ɔhene Dawid. Ɛnna wɔn nso wɔsiim, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkɔka kyerɛ Ɔhene Dawid; na wɔrentumi nkɔ kuro no mu, ɛfiri sɛ nkurɔfoɔ bɛhu wɔn.
Nanso aberanteɛ bi hunuu wɔn, na ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Absalom. Enti wɔn mmienu de mmirika kɔɔ ɔbarima bi fie wɔ Bahurim; na ɔwɔ abura wɔ n’adihɔ, na wɔkɔhyɛɛ mu.
Ɛnna ɔbarima no yere faa nkatasoɔ de kataa abura no soɔ, na ɔde ayuo a wɔasie guguu so, na obiara anhunu ho hwee.

Na Absalom nkoa baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn wɔ fie hɔ, na wɔbisaa no sɛ: “Ɛhe na Ahimaas ne Yonatan wɔ?” Ɛnna ɔbaa no buaa sɛ: “Wɔatwam wɔ ha kɔ nsuo no ho.” Na wɔhwehwɛɛ wɔn ara, nanso wɔanhu wɔn, enti wɔsan kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a wɔfiri hɔ kɔeɛ no, wɔfirii abura no mu, na wɔsiim kɔka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Dawid. Wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: “Monsɔre, na monyɛ ntɛm nkɔtwa asuo no, na ɛfo a Ahitofel atu no mo ho nie.”
Ɛhɔ ara na Dawid sɔreeɛ, ɔne nnipa a wɔka ne ho nyinaa, na wɔkɔtwaa Yordan kɔsii sɛ animu tetee anɔpa, na wɔn mu baako mpo anka a wantwa Yordan.
Ahitofel deɛ, berɛ a ɔhunuu sɛ wɔamfa n’afotuo anyɛ adwuma no, ɔhyehyɛɛ afunumu, na ɔsɔre siim kɔɔ ne fie wɔ ne kurom. Ɛnna ɔhyɛɛ ne fie nsamanseɛ, na ɔsɛn ne ho wuiɛ. Na wɔsiee no n’agya asieeɛ.
Dawid kɔɔ Mahanaim, na Absalom nso kɔtwaa Yordan, ɔne Israel mmarima a wɔka ne ho nyinaa.
Amasa na Absalom de no sii Yoab anan yɛɛ no asraafoɔ so panin. Amasa yɛ Israelni barima bi a wɔfrɛ no Yitra ba. Yitra yi na ɔkɔɔ Nahas ba Abigail a ɔyɛ Yoab maame Seruia nuabaa ho no.
Na Israel ne Absalom kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Gilead asase so.
Berɛ a Dawid bɛduruu Mahanaim no, ɛhɔ ara na Nahas a ɔfiri Ammonfoɔ kuro Raba mu ba Sobi ne Amiel a ɔfiri Lo-Debar ba Makir ne Gileadni Basilai a ɔfiri Rogelim
de mpa ne asɛn ne nkukuo ne ayuo ne atokoɔ ne esiam ne nkyeweɛ ne apatram ne asedua ne aburoo a wɔakyeɛ,
ne ɛwoɔ ne bɔta ne nnwan ne nufosuo a ada brɛɛ Dawid ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no sɛ wɔnni, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛkɔm de nnipa no, na wɔabrɛbrɛ na sukɔm ade wɔn ɛserɛ yi so.”
18: Na Dawid kan nnipa a wɔka ne ho no, na ɔde mpem mpem so asafohene ne ɔha ha so asafohene sisii wɔn so.
Samuel 18

Nanso nnipa no kaa sɛ: “Mfiri adi nkɔ bi, na yɛn deɛ, sɛ ɛba sɛ yɛdwane a, ɛrenyɛ wɔn asɛm. Sɛ mpo yɛn mu fa wu a, ɛrenyɛ wɔn asɛm, na wo deɛ, wote sɛ yɛn mu mpem du, enti ɛyɛ mmom sɛ wobɛfiri kuro no mu adi aboa yɛn.”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Deɛ ɛtene mo ani soɔ biara, mɛyɛ.” Na ɔhene gyinaa kuro pono no nkyɛn maa nnipa no nyinaa firii adi, ɔha ha ne apem apem so, kɔeɛ.
Na ɔhene hyɛɛ Yoab ne Abisai ne Itai sɛ: “Mo ne aberanteɛ Absalom nni no brɛbrɛ mma me.” Berɛ a ɔhene de Absalom ho ahyɛdeɛ no rema asahene no, nnipa no nyinaa teeɛ.
Na nnipa no siim kɔɔ wuram kɔhyiaa Israel, na wɔkɔɔ ɛko no wɔ Efraim kwaeɛ mu.
Ɛkɔwiee sɛ Israel dɔm no dii nkoguo wɔ Dawid nkoa no anim, na nnipa a wɔtotɔɔ saa da no dɔɔso kɛse, mmarima mpem aduonu.
Na ɛko a wɔkoo hɔ no trɛ kɔɔ asase no ani baabiara. Bio nso, nnipa a kwaeɛ no kunkum wɔn saa da no dɔɔso senee nnipa a nkrantɛ kunkum wɔn.

Ɛduruu baabi no, Absalom kɔpuee Dawid nkoa no anim. Saa berɛ no, na Absalom te afunumupɔnkɔ bi so, na afunumupɔnkɔ no kɔfaa odum dua kɛseɛ bi mman kusuu ase, na ne tiri kɔsɔɔ dua kɛseɛ no mu maa no sensɛn soro a ne nan nka fam, na afunumupɔnkɔ a ɔwɔ n’ase no sene kɔeɛ.
Na ɔbarima bi kɔhunuiɛ, na ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Hwɛ! Makɔhunu Absalom sɛ ɔsɛn dua kɛseɛ bi soɔ.”
Ɛnna Yoab ka kyerɛɛ ɔbarima a ɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ no no sɛ: “Saa! Ah! sɛ wohunuu no a, adɛn nti na woammɔ no anhwe fam wɔ hɔ? Anka mede nnwetɛbena du ne abɔsoɔ bɛtua wo ka.”

Nanso ɔbarima no ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Sɛ wokari nnwetɛbena apem mpo gu me nsam a, merentene me nsa nka ɔhene ba no, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn asom na ɔhene hyɛɛ wo ne Abisai ne Itai sɛ, ‘Obiara nhwɛ yie na biribi anyɛ aberanteɛ Absalom.’
Anka me na mayɛ ne kra bɔne; nso anka asɛm no renhunta ɔhene, na wo nso anka wobɛtwe wo ho afiri me ho agyina nkyɛn.”
N’ano siiɛ no, Yoab kaa sɛ: “Merentwentwɛn me nan ase w’anim bio!” Ɛnna ɔfaa mpɛmɛ mmiɛnsa hyɛɛ ne nsam, na ɔkɔto wɔɔ Absalom akomam wɔ dua kɛseɛ no mu berɛ a nkwa da so wɔ ne mu no.
Na mmeranteɛ du a wɔkura Yoab akodeɛ twaa Absalom ho hyiae bɔɔ no kuu no.
Ɛnna Yoab hyɛnee abɛn, na nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa san firii Israel akyi; na Yoab asianka nnipa no.
Afei wɔyii Absalom de no kɔtoo amena kɛseɛ bi mu wɔ kwaeɛ mu hɔ, na wɔboaboaa aboɔ pii guu ne so. Na Israel nyinaa dwane maa obiara kɔɔ ne ntomadan mu.

Berɛ a Absalom te aseɛ no, ɔsii nkaeɛ dum bi de tim Ɔhene Bɔn mu, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Menni ɔbabarima biara a wɔde no bɛkae me din.” Enti ɔde ne din too edum no so, na wɔafrɛ no Absalom Nkaeɛdum de abɛsi nnɛ.
Na Sadok ba Ahimaas deɛ, ɔkaa sɛ: “Ma mentu mmirika nkɔbɔ ɔhene amanneɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade abu atɛn agye no afiri n’atamfo nsam.”
Nanso Yoab ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛkɔ akɔbɔ amanneɛ nnɛ, da foforɔ na wobɛkɔ akɔbɔ amanneɛ; ɛnnɛ deɛ, ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛkɔ akɔbɔ amanneɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene ba paa na awuo.”
Afei Yoab ka kyerɛɛ Kusni no sɛ: “Kɔ na kɔka deɛ woahunu kyerɛ ɔhene.” Ɛnna Kusni no bɔɔ ne mu ase maa Yoab, na ɔsɔɔ mmirika mu.

Afei Sadok ba Ahimaas san ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Ma deɛ ɛbɛba biara mmra, ma me nso mentu mmirika nni Kusni no akyi.” Nanso Yoab kaa sɛ: “Me ba, adɛn nti na wopɛ sɛ wotu mmirika kɔbɔ amanneɛ berɛ a biribiara mfiri mu mma woɔ?”
Ɔsan tii mu bio sɛ: “Ma deɛ ɛbɛba biara mmra, Ɛyɛ dɛn ara a, mɛtu mmirika.” Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Tu mmirika kɔ!” Na Ahimaas sɔɔ mmirika mu kɔfaa Ɔmantam kwan no so, na ɔkɔsianee Kusni no ho.
Na Dawid te kuro apono mmienu no ntam. Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no kɔ kuro pono no atifi dan mu, ɔfasuo no so. Akyire yi, ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛeɛ, na hwɛ! ɔbarima bi a ɔno nko ara nam de mmirika reba.
Enti ɔwɛmfoɔ no teaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene, na ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Sɛ ɔno nko ara na ɔnam a, ɛnneɛ asɛm wɔ n’ano.” Na ɔbaeɛ ara, na nkakrankakra, ɔbɛn hɔ.

Afei ɔwɛmfoɔ no hunuu ɔbarima foforɔ sɛ ɔde mmirika reba. Enti ɔwɛmfoɔ no teaam ka kyerɛɛ ɛpono ano hwɛfoɔ no sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ɔbarima foforɔ a ɔno nko ara nam de mmirika reba.” Ɛnna ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Ɔno nso so nkra.”
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Deɛ ɔdi kan no mmirikatuo no te sɛ Sadok ba Ahimaas mmirikatuo.” Ɛnna ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Ɔyɛ nipa pa enti ɛbɛyɛ sɛ asɛmpa na ɔde nam.”

Ɛnna Ahimaas teaam ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ mu!” Na ɔkotoo ɔhene de n’anim butuu fam. Na ɔtoaa so sɛ: “Nhyira nka Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ɛfiri sɛ nnipa a wɔmaa wɔn nsa so tiaa me wura ɔhene no, wayi wɔn ahyɛ wo nsa.”
Nanso ɔhene bisaa sɛ: “Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa?” Ɛnna Ahimaas kaa sɛ: “Berɛ a Yoab somaa ɔhene somfoɔ ne wo somfoɔ no, mehunuu kitikiti kɛseɛ bi, nanso na mennim asɛm korɔ.”
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sene kɔgyina nkyɛn ha.” Ɛnna ɔkɔgyinaa nkyɛn dinn.
Na hwɛ, Kusni no bɛduruiɛ, na Kusni no kaa sɛ: “Me wura ɔhene ntie amanneɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade abu atɛn ama wo nnɛ ayi wo afiri wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa woɔ no nyinaa nsam.”
Nanso ɔhene bisaa Kusni no sɛ: “Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa?” Na Kusni no kaa sɛ: “Ma me wura ɔhene atamfo a wɔsɔre tiaa woɔ a wɔpɛ wo bɔne nyinaa nyɛ sɛ aberanteɛ no.”

Na asɛm no haa ɔhene, na ɔforo kɔɔ kuro pono no atifi dan no mu, na ɔtuee su mu. Na ɔrekɔ nyinaa na ɔreka sɛ: “O me ba Absalom, me ba yi, me ba Absalom! Anka me mmom menwu, anka mensi w’ananmu, Absalom O, me ba yi, me ba yi!”
19: Akyire yi, wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ɔhene resu, na ɔredi Absalom ho awerɛhoɔ.”
Samuel 19
Na nnipa no wiawiaa wɔn ho baa kuro no mu saa da no, sɛdeɛ nnipa a wɔdwane ɛko mu de aniwuo wiawia wɔn ho korɔ no.
Na ɔhene deɛ, na wakata n’anim, na ɔhene kɔɔ so de nne kɛseɛ teaam sɛ: “O Me ba Absalom! Absalom O, me ba yi, me ba yi!”
Na Yoab baa ɔhene nkyɛn wɔ fie hɔ bɛkaa sɛ: “Wo nkoa a wɔagye wo kra ne wo mma mmarima ne wo mma mmaa kra ne wo yerenom kra ne mpenafoɔ kra no, ɛnnɛ woahyɛ wɔn nyinaa aniwuo,
ɛfiri sɛ woadɔ w’atamfo na woatan w’adɔfo. Ɛnnɛ woakyerɛ sɛ asahene ne nkoa nyɛ hwee mma wo; ɛnnɛ na mahunu sɛ, sɛ Absalom te nkwa mu na yɛn a yɛaka nyinaa awuwu nnɛ a, anka wopɛ.

Na afei sɔre firi adi, na kɔka asɛm bi kyerɛ wo nkoa fa dwodwo wɔn bo, ɛfiri sɛ medɔ Nyame sɛ, sɛ woamfiri adi a, obiara rentena wo ho anadwo yi, na anka ɛbɛkyɛn bɔne a aba wo soɔ firi wo mmeranteberɛ mu de abɛduru sɛsɛɛ no nyinaa.”
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔre bɛtenaa kuro pono no mu, na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa sɛ: “Ɔhene abɛtena kuro pono no mu.” Na nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa baa ɔhene anim. Na Israel deɛ, na wɔadwane ama obiara kɔ ne fie.

Na nnipa no nyinaa ne wɔn ho hamee Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔhene na ɔgyee yɛn firii yɛn atamfo nsam, na ɔno ara nso na ɔyii yɛn firii Filistifoɔ nsam; seesei Absalom nti wadwane afiri asase yi so.
Na Absalom nso a yɛsraa no sii yɛn soɔ no, wawu ɛko no mu. Enti afei adɛn nti na monkɔfaa ɔhene nsan mmaeɛ?”

Na Ɔhene Dawid soma kɔɔ ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar hɔ sɛ: “Monkɔka nkyerɛ Yuda mpanimfoɔ sɛ, ‘Adɛn nti na moretwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asan akɔ ne fie, berɛ a Israel nyinaa de nkra abrɛ ɔhene baabi a ɔwɔ?
Me nuanom ne mo; me nnompe ne me honam ne mo. Na adɛn nti na moretwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asan akorɔ?’
Na Amasa nso, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Ɛnyɛ me nnompe ne me honam ne wo? Sɛ woammɛyɛ ɔsahene ansi Yoab anan wɔ m’anim daa a, Onyankopɔn ntua me ka na ɔnsan mfa bi nka ho.’”
Na ɔmaa Yuda mmarima nyinaa akoma dane baa sɛ onipa baako, enti wɔsoma kɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Wo ne wo nkoa nyinaa, monsan mmra.”
Na ɔhene san baeɛ ara bɛduruu Yordan ho. Yuda nso kɔɔ Gilgal sɛ wɔrekɔhyia ɔhene na wɔde ɔhene atwa Yordan.
Ɛnna Benyaminni Gera ba Simei a ɔfiri Bahurim no yɛɛ ntɛm ne Yuda mmarima no kɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔhyia Ɔhene Dawid.
Ɔrekɔ no, Benyaminfoɔ mmarima apem kaa ne ho kɔeɛ. Na Saul fie akoa Siba ne ne mma dunum ne ne nkoa aduonu nso ka ne ho, na wɔkɔtwaa Yordan kɔeɛ ansa na ɔhene reba.
Na ɔtwaa asutwareeɛ no sɛ ɔrekɔfa ɔhene fiefoɔ de wɔn atwa nsuo no na wayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ. Na Gera ba Simei bɛkotoo ɔhene anim berɛ a ɔrebɛtwa Yordan no.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Mma me wura mmmu me fɔ, na nkae bɔne a w’akoa yɛɛ wo da a me wura ɔhene firii Yerusalem kɔeɛ no, na mma ɔhene mmfa nnhyɛ n’akomam.
Na w’akoa nim sɛ me na mayɛ bɔne, enti na ɛnnɛ madi Yosef fie nyinaa kan abɛhyia me wura ɔhene yi.”
Ɛhɔ ara na Seruia ba Abisai kaa sɛ: “Deɛ Simei yɛeɛ no, ɛnyɛ wuo na ɛfata no, sɛ wadome deɛ Awurade asra no yi?”
Nanso Dawid kaa sɛ: “Mo Seruia mma, ɛdeɛn na me ne mo wɔ yɛ a moasɔre atia me nnɛ yi? Ɛnnɛ yɛ da a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkum obi wɔ Israel anaa? Mennim sɛ ɛnnɛ da yi medi hene wɔ Israel anaa?”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: “Worenwu.” Na ɔhene kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no.
Na Saul banana Mefiboset bɛhyiaa ɔhene. Ɔno deɛ, ɛfiri da a ɔhene kɔeɛ bɛsi da a ɔbaa asomdwoeɛ mu no, na ɔnhohoroo ne nan ho mmubuu ne mmɔwerɛ, na ɔntwitwaa ne bɔdwesɛ na ɔnsii ne ntadeɛ.
Berɛ a ɔbaa Yerusalem bɛhyiaa ɔhene no, ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: “Mefiboset, adɛn nti na wo ne me ankorɔ?”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “O Me wura ɔhene, me somfoɔ no na ɔdaadaa me. W’akoa kaa sɛ, ‘Ma menhyehyɛ afunumu na mentena so ne ɔhene nkɔ,’ ɛfiri sɛ w’akoa yɛ bubuafoɔ.
Enti ɔbɛsɛee w’akoa din kyerɛɛ me wura. Nanso me wura ɔhene te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, enti yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ.
Anka me papa fie nyinaa nsɛ hwee sɛ owuo wɔ me wura ɔhene anim, nanso wode w’akoa aka wɔn a wɔdidi wo pono soɔ no ho. Enti hokwan bɛn na mewɔ bio mpo sɛ mɛsan asu akyerɛ ɔhene bio?”
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na woda so ara ka wo nsɛm yi? M’asɛm ne sɛ, wo ne Siba nkyɛ asase no mu.”
Na Mefiboset ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Seesei a me wura ɔhene asan aba ne fie asomdwoeɛ mu yi, ma no mfa ne nyinaa mpo.”
Na Gileadni Basilai siane firii Rogelim baa sɛ ɔrebɛsene ne ɔhene akɔ Yordan ho na wakɔgya no Yordan ho.
Na Basilai anyini yie, na wadi mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe; ɔno na ɔmaa ɔhene aduane berɛ a ɔte Mahanaim no; na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ paa.
Enti ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Basilai sɛ: “Wo ne me ntwa nkɔ, na mɛhwɛ wo ama wo aduane me nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem.”
Nanso Basilai ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Me nkwa nna a aka yɛ sɛn na me ne ɔhene akɔ Yerusalem?
Madi mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe nnɛ. Mɛhunu papa ne bɔne mu? W’akoa bɛte deɛ medie ne deɛ menom dɛ? Anaa mɛte mmarima ne mmaa nnwontofoɔ nne bio? Na adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ w’akoa bɛyɛ adesoa bio ma me wura ɔhene?
Ɛkwan kakra bi na w’akoa ne ɔhene atwa abɛduru Yordan ho, na adɛn nti na ɔhene de adeɛ a ɛte sei retua me ka?
Mesrɛ wo, ma w’akoa nsan na ma menwu me kurom, me papa ne me maame asieeɛ nkyɛn. Hwɛ, w’akoa Kimham nie. Ma no ne me wura ɔhene ntwa nkɔ, na yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ ma no.”
Ɛnna ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Kimham ne me bɛtwa akɔ, na mɛyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ ama no; deɛ wopɛ sɛ meyɛ biara mɛyɛ ama wo.”
Nnipa no nyinaa firii aseɛ twaa Yordan, na ɔhene nso twaeɛ; Basilai deɛ, ɔhene fee n’ano, na ɔhyiraa no maa no san n’akyi kɔɔ ne kurom.
Berɛ a ɔhene twa kɔɔ Gilgal no, Kimham ne no twaeɛ, na Yudafoɔ nyinaa ne Israelfoɔ fa nso de ɔhene twa kɔeɛ.
Hwɛ! Israel mmarima nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn, na wɔbisaa ɔhene sɛ: “Adɛn nti na yɛn nuanom Yuda mmarima no wiaa wo sɛ wɔde ɔhene ne ne fiefoɔ ne Dawid mmarima a wɔka ne ho nyinaa bɛtwa Yordan?”
Ɛnna Yuda mmarima nyinaa buaa Israel mmarima sɛ: “Ɛfiri sɛ yɛn na ɔhene bɛn yɛn paa, na adɛn nti na moama asɛm yi ahyɛ mo abufuo? Yɛadi ɔhene ho biribi, anaa wakyɛ yɛn biribi?”

Ɛnna Israel mmarima ka kyerɛɛ Yuda mmarima sɛ: “Yɛwɔ kyɛfa du ahennie no mu, enti yɛdɔɔso sene mo Dawid mu. Adɛn nti na moabu yɛn animtia, na adɛn nti na moamma yɛanni kan anka sɛ yɛrekɔfa yɛn hene asan aba?” Nanso Yuda mmarima ano yɛɛ den senee Israel mmarima.
20: Na ɔbarima huhuni bi wɔ hɔ a ne din de Seba a ɔyɛ Benyaminni Bikri ba. Na ɔhyɛnee abɛn kaa sɛ: “Yɛnni kyɛfa biara wɔ Dawid mu, na yɛnni agyapadeɛ biara wɔ Yese ba no mu. O Israelfoɔ, obiara nkɔ ne ntomadan mu!”
Samuel 20

Na Dawid bɛduruu ne fie wɔ Yerusalem. Afei ɔhene faa mmaa du no, ne mpenafoɔ a ɔgyaa wɔn akyire sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no, na ɔde wɔn guu fie bi mu sɛ wɔnhwɛ wɔn so, na ɔmaa wɔn aduane daa. Ɔne wɔn anna bio, na mmom ɔtoo wɔn mu kɔsii wɔn wuda, na wɔdii kuna te sɛ deɛ wɔyɛ kuna.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Amasa sɛ: “Kɔfrɛfrɛ Yuda mmarima ma wɔmmɛhyia me nkyɛn nnansa ntam, na wo nso bɛgyina ha.”
Enti Amasa kɔfrɛfrɛɛ Yudafoɔ bɛhyiaeɛ, nanso berɛ a ɔhyɛɛ no no twaam ansa na ɔreba.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai sɛ: “Deɛ Bikri ba Seba de bɛba yɛn soɔ bɛkyɛn Absalom deɛ no mpo. Wo deɛ, fa wo wura nkoa na ti no, na wannya nkuro bi a wɔabɔ ho ban, na wannwane amfiri yɛn ani so.”
Ɛnna Yoab mmarima no ne Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ ne nnɔmmarima no nyinaa dii n’akyi, na wɔfirii adi firii Yerusalem tu saa Bikri ba Seba.
