“Sɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn seɛ nie, ‘Kuro a ɛde apem firi adie no, ɛbɛka ɔha; na deɛ ɛde ɔha firi adie no, ɛbɛka du ama Israel fie.’
“Na sɛ Awurade ka kyerɛ Israel fie nie, ‘Monhwehwɛ m’akyiri kwan, na monnya nkwa.
Na monnhwehwɛ Betel akyiri kwan, na monnkɔ Gilgal, na monntwam nnkɔ Beer-Seba, ɛfiri sɛ Gilgal bɛkɔ nkoasom mu na Betel bɛdane huhuo.
Monhwehwɛ Awurade akyiri kwan na monnya nkwa, na wamma Yosef fie so sɛ egya, na Betel anhye a ɛnnya obi nnum no,
mo a modane atɛntenenee bɔnwono, na moto tenenee gu fam no.

Deɛ ɔyɛɛ Akokɔbaatan-ne-ne-mma nsorommakuo [Pleiades - Orion] nsorommakuo, na ɔma esum kabii dane adekyeeɛ, na ɔma awia duru sum sɛ anadwo, deɛ ɔfrɛ ɛpo mu nsuo hwie gu asase ani no, Awurade ne ne din.
Ɔno na ɔde ɔsɛeɛ ba ɔhoɔdenfoɔ so sɛ anyinam, na ɔsɛe abandenden.
“‘Deɛ ɔyi wɔn ntɛn wɔ kuro pono ano no, wɔtane no; na deɛ ɔka nokorɛ no, wɔkyiri no.
Enti ɛsiane sɛ motiatia mmɔborɔni soɔ na mogye ayuo sɛ toɔ firi ne hɔ nti, mode aboɔ a wɔapae asisi adan nanso morentena mu, moayeyɛ bobe nturo a ɛyɛ fɛ, nanso morennom mu nsa.
Na menim sɛdeɛ mo mmarato dɔɔso ne sɛdeɛ mo bɔne yɛ akɛseɛ fa, mo a mohiahia ɔteneneeni ho na mogyegye adanmudeɛ, na mokyea ahiafoɔ asɛm kuro pono mu.
Ne saa nti ɔba nimdefoɔ mua n’ano, ɛberɛ no mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ berɛ bɔne.
“‘Monhwehwɛ papa, na ɛnyɛ bɔne, na moanya nkwa, na Awurade, asafo Nyankopɔn, ne mo atena, sɛdeɛ moaka no.
Montane bɔne na monnɔ papa, na momma atɛntenenee ntena kuro pono ano. Na ebia Awurade, asafo Nyankopɔn, bɛhunu Yosef nkaefoɔ no mmɔbɔ.’

“Enti sɛ Awurade, asafo Nyankopɔn, Awurade no seɛ nie, ‘Wɔbɛsu yayaaya wɔ mmɔnten so, na nnipa bɛteam wɔ mmorɔno nyinaa so sɛ: “Buei! Buei!” Na wɔbɛfrɛ okuafoɔ ama no abɛsu, na wɔafrɛ wɔn a wɔtumi twa adwo ama wɔabɛtwa agyaadwoɔ.’
‘Na nnipa bɛtwa agyaadwoɔ wɔ bobe nturo nyinaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ mɛsene afa wo mu,’ Awurade na ɔseɛ.
“‘Wɔn a wɔn ani agyina Awurade da no nnue! Papa bɛn na Awurade da no bɛyɛ ama mo? Ɛyɛ sum berɛ na ɛnyɛ hann.
Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ obi a ɔdwane firi gyata anim, na sisire hyia no! Anaa ɔduru fie de ne nsa twere fasuo na ɔwɔ ka no.
Awurade da no yɛ sum, na ɛnyɛ hann; ɛyɛ kusuu na ɛnhyerɛn.
Metane mo afahyɛ ahodoɔ no na mepo koraa, na m’ani nnye mo afahyɛ nhyiamu kronkron no ho.
Na sɛ mobɔ mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne mo aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ ma me a, m’ani rensɔ, na sɛ mode nyɛmmoa a wɔadɔ sradeɛ bɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ma me a, merenhwɛ.
Monyi mo dwontoɔ gyegyeegye no mfiri me so, na merentie mo sankudwom no.
Na momma atɛntenenee nworo mmra sɛ nsuo, na tenenee ntene sɛ asubɔnten a ɛsene daa.
O Israel fie, mode afɔrebɔdeɛ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ me ɛserɛ no so mfirinhyia aduanan no anaa?
Nanso mosoaa mo hene Sikut ne mo ahoni Kiun, mo nsoromma nyame a moyɛeɛ no.
Ɛno nti mɛtu mo akɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Damasko akyi tɔnn,’ Awurade na ɔseɛ, asafo Nyankopɔn ne ne din.” Adwenharefoɔ ne ahantanfoɔ no asotwe
6: “Wɔnnue, wɔn a wɔte Sion dwoodwoo, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Samaria bepɔ soɔ no. Yeinom ne atitire a wɔfiri amanaman mu adikanfoɔ no mu, na wɔn nkyɛn na Israel fie kɔ.
Monkɔ Kalne nkɔhwɛ, na momfiri hɔ nkɔ Hamat kɛseɛ, na monsiane nkɔ Filistifoɔ kuro Gat mu. Moyɛ sene ahennie yi, anaasɛ wɔn asase so sene mo asase?
Monnue mo a motu dabɔne hyɛ akyirikyirie, na motwe awudie adwa bɛn.
Na modeda mpa a wɔde asommɛn ayɛ so, na modwodwo mo ho wɔ mo nnaeɛ so, na mowe mo nnwan mma a wɔfiri nnwankuo mu ne anantwie mma a wɔadɔ sradeɛ firi ɔyɛn dan mu;
na moto dwom de gyegye sankuo ho, na mo ara moyɛ asankuo sɛ Dawid;
na monom nsa wɔ nkoraa mu, na mosra ngohwam pa, nanso Yosef sɛeɛ deɛ, ɛnyɛ mo ya.
“Ɛno nti wɔbɛdi wɔn a wɔrekɔ nkoasom mu no kan akɔ nkoasom mu, afei sadwaasefoɔ gyegyeegye no to bɛtwa.
“‘Awurade Nyankopɔn aka ne ho ntam,’ Awurade, asafo Nyankopɔn, asɛm nie, ‘“Mekyiri Yakob ahantan, na metane n’aban akɛseɛ no, ɛno nti mɛyi kuro no ne ne mayɛ ama.
Na sɛ ɛka nnipa du wɔ fie baako mu a, wɔn nso bɛwuwu.

Na sɛ owufoɔ no busuani ne deɛ ɔrekɔhye awufoɔ no ba efie no mu sɛ wɔrebɛsesa wɔn akɔ na ɔbɛbisa obi a ɔwɔ pia no mu sɛ, ‘Obi foforɔ da so ne wo wɔ hɔ anaa?’ Na ɔbua sɛ, ‘Daabi a!’ Ɔno nso bɛka sɛ, ‘Yɛ komm! Na wɔmmɔ Awurade din.’”
“‘Na hwɛ, Awurade de ahyɛdeɛ ama, na ɔbɛbubu efi kɛseɛ no pasaa na wabubu efi ketewa no nso dukuduku.
“‘Apɔnkɔ tu mmirika wɔ ɔbotan so, anaa obi de anantwie bɛfuntum so? Nanso moadane atɛntenenee awuduro, na moadane tenenee aba nso bɔnwono,
mo a modi Lo-Debar ho ahurisie, na moka sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ yɛn ara yɛn ahoɔden na yɛde agye Karnaim afa yi anaa?”
Na hwɛ, mɛma ɔman bi asɔre atia mo, O Israel fie, Awurade, asafo Nyankopɔn, asɛm nie; na wɔbɛhyɛ mo so afiri Hamat hyeɛ so akɔsi Araba subɔn no ano.” Atemmuo ho anisoadehunu ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa no
7: Sei na Awurade Nyankopɔn maa mehunuiɛ: na hwɛ, na ɔrenwene ntutummɛ, ɛberɛ a akyire yi wura firi aseɛ fifire, na yei yɛ berɛ a wɔatwa ɔhene wura awie na wɔadua aba a ɛdi akyire no.
Na berɛ a wɔwee asase no so afifideɛ wieeɛ no, mekaa sɛ: “O Awurade Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo, fa firi. Yakob bɛyɛ dɛn agyina? Ɔsua!”
Afei Awurade sesaa n’adwene yei ho. “Ɛrenyɛ hɔ! Awurade na ɔseɛ.”
Yei na Awurade Nyankopɔn maa mehunuiɛ; na hwɛ, na Awurade Nyankopɔn refrɛ ogya abɛtwe aso; na ɛbɛhyee ebunu kɛseɛ no mu nsuo nyinaa, na ɛhyee asase no.
Na mekaa sɛ: “O Awurade Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo, gyae. Yakob bɛyɛ dɛn agyina? Ɛfiri sɛ ɔsua!”
Afei Awurade sesaa n’adwene yei ho. Yei nso renyɛ hɔ, Awurade Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.
Yei na ɔmaa mehunuu bio; hwɛ, na Awurade gyina fasuo a wɔde prumo homa [kyirebenn] ato asi hɔ so, na na prumo homa kura ne nsam.
Afei Awurade bisaa me sɛ: “Amos, ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi?” Ɛnna mebuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ prumo homa.” Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Hwɛ, mede prumo homa bɛsi me man Israel mfimfini. Na merenhu wɔn mmɔbɔ bio.
Na Isak sorɔnsorɔmmea nyinaa bɛdane amamfo na Israel kronkrommea no ayɛ agoago; na mɛtwe nkrantɛ wɔ Yeroboam fie so.”
Ɛnna Betel sɔfoɔ Amasia soma kɔɔ Israel hene Yeroboam nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Amos apam wo tiri so wɔ Israel fie mfimfini pɛɛ. Na asase no ntumi nkora ne nsɛm nyinaa so.
Na Amos se, ‘Yeroboam bɛwu nkrantɛ ano; na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ biara Israel bɛfiri n’asase so akɔ nkoasom mu.’”
Na Amasia ka kyerɛɛ Amos sɛ: “Ɔdehunufoɔ, dwane kɔ Yuda asase so kɔdidi wɔ hɔ na hyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔ.
Na Betel ha deɛ, nhyɛ nkɔm bio, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ ɔhene kronkronbea ne ahennie fie.”
Afei Amos ka kyerɛɛ Amasia sɛ: “Na menyɛ odiyifoɔ anaa odiyifoɔ ba; mmom na mehwɛ mmoa so na na mefitifiti sikamɔɔ nnuaba ho nso.
Ɛnna Awurade faa me firii nnwan no akyiridie, na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Kɔ na kɔhyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ me man Israel.’
Na afei tie Awurade asɛm, ‘Woreka sɛ: “Nhyɛ Israel ho nkɔm, na nka asɛm biara ntia Isak fie”.

Enti sɛ Awurade seɛ nie: “Wo yere bɛdane odwamanfoɔ wɔ kuro no mu. Na wo mma mmarima ne wo mma mmaa bɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano. Na wɔbɛtwe susuhoma ato w’asase so akyɛ afa. Na wo nso, wobɛwu asase a ɛho agu fi so, na Israel bɛfiri n’asase so akɔ nkoasom mu.”’”
8: Sei na Awurade Nyankopɔn maa mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ, kɛntɛn a ahuhuro berɛ mu nnuaba wom.
Ɛnna ɔbisaa me sɛ: “Amos, ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi?” Na mekaa sɛ: “Kɛntɛn a ahuhuro berɛ mu nnuaba wom.” Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Me man Israel awieeɛ aduru; na merenhu wɔn mmɔbɔ bio.
‘Saa da no, asɔrefie nnwom bɛdane adwotwa,’ Awurade Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. ‘Na afunu bɛbu so ama wɔatoto agu baabiara—ma ɛhɔ ntɛm dinn!’
“Montie, mo a momene ahiafoɔ na mosɛe asase so amanehunufoɔ,
na moka sɛ, ‘Da bɛn na bosome foforɔ bɛtwam na yɛatɔn aburoo, ne homeda, na yɛatɔn ayuo, na yɛayɛ efa susukoraa no ketewa na ne boɔ akɔ soro, na yɛakyea atorɔ nsania no,
na yɛde dwetɛ atɔ mmɔborɔfoɔ, na yɛde mpaboa boɔ atɔ ohiani, na yɛatɔn ayuo ase fo wurawura no?’
“Awurade aka Yakob ahokyerɛ ho ntam sɛ: ‘Me werɛ remfiri wɔn nneyɛɛ nyinaa da biara da!
Yei nti asase no renwoso na ɛsofoɔ nyinaa renni abooboo anaa? Na ɛbɛpu ayiri abu afa so sɛ Asubɔnten Nil, na ɛbɛhono na asane atwetwe sɛ Egypt asuo no.
“Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɛda no, Awurade Nyankopɔn asɛm nie: ‘Mɛma awia akɔtɔ awiaberɛ na mama sum aduru asase so awia ketee.
Na mɛma mo afahyɛ adane abooboo na mo nnwom adane kwadwom, na mɛma obiara de atweaatam asi n’asene, na etire biara ho apa; na mɛma no ayɛ sɛ deɛ wɔregyam ɔbakorɔ na n’awieeɛ ayɛ sɛ da a ɛyɛ nwono.
“Hwɛ, nna bi reba, Awurade Nyankopɔn asɛm nie: ‘Sɛ mɛma ɛkɔm aba asase no so; ɛnyɛ aduanekɔm anaa sukɔm, na mmom Awurade asɛm ho kɔm.
Na wɔde wɔn tiri bɛpempem afiri po ano akɔ po ano, firi atifi akɔ apueeɛ. Na wɔbɛkyinkyini ahwehwɛ Awurade asɛm, nanso wɔrenhunu.
Saa da no, sukɔm nti, mmaabunu a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ ne mmeranteɛ bɛtwitwa ahwe;
yeinom na wɔde Samaria bɔne ka ntam sɛ: “O Dan, sɛ wo nyame te aseɛ yi!” ne sɛ, “Sɛ Beer-Seba kwan te aseɛ yi!” Na wɔbɛhwehwe ase a wɔrensɔre bio.’”
9: Mehunuu Awurade sɛ ɔgyina afɔrebukyia no ho, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Bɔ adum no atifi ma apono no ase nwoso, na bubu ne nyinaa ti. Na mede nkrantɛ bɛkum wɔn a wɔbɛka no. Deɛ ɔredwane no rennya adwaneyɛ, na deɛ ɔrebɔ ne ho adwaa no rennya ne ho ntete.
Sɛ wɔtutu fam kɔhyɛ Asamando mu mpo a, me nsa bɛyi wɔn afiri hɔ aba; na sɛ wɔforo kɔ ɔsoro a, mɛtwe wɔn asiane aba fam.
Na sɛ wɔde wɔn ho kɔsie Karmel atifi a, mɛhwehwɛ wɔn akɔfa wɔn afiri hɔ. Na sɛ wɔfiri m’anim kɔhyɛ po ase a, ɛhɔ na mɛhyɛ ɔwɔ na wakeka wɔn.
Na sɛ wɔkɔ nkoasom mu wɔn atamfo anim a, mɛma nkrantɛ akɔkunkum wɔn wɔ hɔ. Na mede m’ani bɛsi wɔn so ama no awie wɔn bɔne, na ɛnyɛ papa.
Na asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn ne deɛ ɔka asase ma no nane; na ɛsofoɔ nyinaa di abooboo; na ɛyiri sɛ Nil na ɛtwetwe sɛ Egypt asuo Nil.
“‘Deɛ ɔsi ne nsamsoɔ wɔ ɔsoro na ɔto ne kuntunu fapem, asase so, na ɔfrɛ po mu nsuo hwie gu asase ani no, Awurade ne ne din.’
“‘O Israelfoɔ, monte sɛ Etiopiafoɔ wɔ m’ani so anaa?’ Awurade asɛm nie. ‘Ɛnyɛ Egypt asase so na meyii Israel firiiɛ, ne Filistifoɔ nso firii Kaftor, na Siriafoɔ nso firii Kir?
“‘Hwɛ, Awurade Nyankopɔn ani sa ahennie bɔne no so, na mɛsɛe no afiri asase so, nanso merensɛe Yakob fie korakora,’ Awurade asɛm nie.
‘Na hwɛ, mɛhyɛ na mɛhuhu Israel fie so wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu sɛdeɛ obi de huhuamoa huhu ayuo soɔ no, na ayufua bi rentɔ fam.
Me man mu abɔnefoɔ nyinaa bɛwuwu wɔ nkrantɛ ano, wɔn a wɔka sɛ: “Mmusuo biara rento yɛn, na ɛremmɛn yɛn” no.’
“‘Saa da no mɛma Dawid sese a ahwe aseɛ no so agyina hɔ na matuatua wɔn mu ntokuro. Mɛma n’amamfo so agyina hɔ na makyekyere no sɛ tete nna no.
Na wɔafa Edom nkaeɛ ne aman a me din da wɔn soɔ no nyinaa adi so,’ Awurade a ɔyɛ yeinom no asɛm nie.
“Hwɛ, nna bi reba, Awurade asɛm nie, sɛ deɛ ɔfɛntɛm bɛsiane deɛ ɔtwa ho, na deɛ ɔkyi bobe bɛsiane deɛ ɔgu aba ho; mmepɔ bɛsosɔ nsa dɔkɔdɔkɔ na nkokoɔ nyinaa ahono.
Na mɛma me man Israel nnommum no asane aba, na wɔabɛkyekyere nkuro a asɛe no atena mu, na wɔbɛyeyɛ bobe nturo anom mu nsa na wɔayɛ nnuaba turo adi mu aba.’
“‘Na mede wɔn bɛdua wɔn asase so, na wɔrentu wɔn mfiri asase a mede ama wɔn no so bio,’ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.”

1: Paulo a ɔnam Onyankopɔn pɛ so yɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, ne yɛn nua Timoteo
de kɔma ahotefoɔ ne agyidifoɔ a wɔwɔ Kristo mu wɔ Kolose: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Onyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo hɔ nka mo.
Berɛ biara a yɛbɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo no, yɛda Onyankopɔn a ɔne yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo Agya ase,
ɛfiri sɛ yɛate mo Kristo Yesu mu gyidie ne mo dɔ a mode dɔ ahotefoɔ nyinaa,
ɛsiane anidasoɔ a ɛda hɔ ma mo wɔ ɔsoro, asɛmpa no nokwasɛm a moateɛ no nti,
asɛmpa no na aduru mo nkyɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ wiase baabiara nso, na ɛreso aba na ɛrekɔ so nyini, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ mo mu nso firi da a moteeɛ na mohunuu Nyankopɔn adom wɔ nokorɛ mu no.
Ɛno na mosua firii yɛn awurakwaa dɔfo Epafra a ɔyɛ mo Kristo somfo nokwafoɔ,
deɛ wabɛyi mo honhom mu dɔ akyerɛ yɛn nso nkyɛn no. Wɔn honhom fam nkɔsoɔ ho adesrɛ
Yei nti na yɛn nso ɛfiri da a yɛtee ho asɛm no, yɛnnyaee sɛ yɛbɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo, ne nkotosrɛ, sɛ ne pɛ mu nimdeɛ nhyɛ mo ma, honhom nyansa ne nteaseɛ nyinaa mu,
na moanante sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ Awurade na ɛsɔ n’ani koraa, na moaso adwuma pa nyinaa mu aba, na moanyini akɔ Nyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ mu,
na ama wɔde tumi nyinaa ahyɛ mo den, sɛdeɛ n’animuonyam tumidie teɛ no, akɔ boasetɔ ne abodwokyɛre nyinaa mu wɔ anigyeɛ mu,
na yɛada Agya a wama yɛafata ahotefoɔ apɛgyadeɛ no fafafoɔ wɔ hann mu no ase.
Sɛ wayi yɛn afiri sum tumi ase de yɛn aba ne Dɔba ahennie mu,
ɔno mu na yɛanya ɔgyeɛ ne bɔne fafirie. Kristo yɛ Nyankopɔn suban ne abɔdeɛ nyinaa so wura
Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a wɔnhu no no suban, abɔdeɛ nyinaa mu abakan;

ɛfiri sɛ ne mu na wɔbɔɔ nneɛma nyinaa, deɛ ɛwɔ soro ne deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ, deɛ wɔhunu ne deɛ wɔnhunu, nhennwa oo, wuradie oo, mpaninnie oo, tumidie oo, nneɛma no nyinaa, wɔnam ne so na ɛbɔeɛ, na wɔbɔ maa no.
Na ɔno na ɔdi adeɛ nyinaa kan, na nneɛma nyinaa atim wɔ ne mu.
Na ɔno ne nipadua no, asafo no, ti. Ɔno ne mfitiaseɛ, awufoɔ sɔreɛ mu abakan, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛyɛ odikanfoɔ wɔ nneɛma nyinaa mu;
ɛfiri sɛ ɛsɔɔ Nyankopɔn ani sɛ ne mayɛ nyinaa bɛtena ne mu,

na ɔnam ne so apata ɔne ne nneɛma nyinaa ntam bio, kyerɛ sɛ, ɔnam n’asɛnnua ho mogya so ayɛ asomdwoeɛ nam ɔno ara so apata nneɛma nyinaa, asase so deɛ oo, ɔsoro deɛ oo, ne No ntam. Nkwagyeɛ a ɛnam Kristo so ba
Na mo a anka berɛ bi na moyɛ ahɔhoɔ ne atamfo, adwene fam ne nnwuma bɔne mu no,
afei ɔnam owuo so apata mo ne no ntam wɔ ne honam nipadua mu, sɛ ɔde mo bɛsi hɔ sɛ nnipa kronkron a wɔnni dɛm a asɛm bi nni wɔn ho wɔ n’anim,

nanso gye sɛ mokɔ so tena gyidie no mu, gyina fapem no so na motintim a momma wɔntwe mo mfiri asɛmpa a moteeɛ a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ase nyinaa mu ho anidasoɔ no ho. Saa asɛmpa yi na me Paulo, mabɛyɛ ho ɔsomfoɔ.
Afei m’ani gye amaneɛ a mehunu ma mo no mu, na mehyɛ Kristo amanehunu mu deɛ aka no ananmu, wɔ me honam mu ma ne nipadua a ɛyɛ asafo no,
a mebɛyɛɛ asafo yi somfoɔ sɛdeɛ efiehwɛ adwuma a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn hɔ no teɛ, deɛ mo nti wɔde maa me sɛ memfa nka Onyankopɔn asɛm no nkɔsi aseɛ no,
ahuntasɛm kronkron a wɔde huntaa mmeresanten ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a aba korɔ no. Nanso afei deɛ wɔayi no adi akyerɛ n’ahotefoɔ,
a Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɔma wɔhunu ahuntasɛm yi animuonyam ahonya wɔ amanaman mu, a ɛne Kristo a ɔwɔ mo mu, animuonyam anidasoɔ no.
Ɔno na yɛbɔ ne ho dawuro na yɛtu onipa biara fo na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ onipa biara wɔ nyansa nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a yɛde onipa biara bɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔdi mu wɔ Kristo mu.
Yei nti na meyɛ adwumaden yere me ho sɛdeɛ n’adwuma a ɔde tumi yɛ no me mu no teɛ.
2: Na mepɛ sɛ mohunu aperepereɛ kɛseɛ a meredi ma mo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne wɔn a wɔnhunuu m’anim ɔhonam mu no nyinaa,
sɛ wɔnnya deɛ ɛka wɔn akoma to wɔn yam, ɛne sɛ wɔnyɛ baako ɔdɔ mu, nnya nteaseɛ a wɔasi so dua ahonya nyinaa, na wɔahunu Nyankopɔn ahuntasɛm a ɛne Kristo no mu.
Ne mu na wɔde nyansa ne nimdeɛ ademudeɛ nyinaa akora.
Afei meka yei na obi amfa nnaadaasɛm anto mo bradɛ.
Na ɛwom sɛ menni hɔ honam mu deɛ, nanso me ne mo wɔ hɔ honhom mu, na m’ani gye sɛ mehunu mo kwan a mogyina soɔ ne mo gyidie a ɛkɔ Kristo mu tim a atim no. Wɔn honhom nkɔsoɔ ho nsiyɛ
Enti sɛdeɛ moagye Awurade Kristo Yesu no, monkɔ so nnante ne mu saa ara,
nnye nhini, na wɔnto mo nsi ne so na montintim wɔ gyidie no mu, sɛdeɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mo no, na mo gyidie aboro so aseda mu.
Monhwɛ yie na obi amfa nyansapɛ ne nnaadaa hunu a ɛnam nnipa atetesɛm ne wiase mfitiasesɛm soɔ na ɛnnam Kristo so, ammɛfa mo nnommum,
ɛfiri sɛ ne mu na nyamesu mayɛ nyinaa teɛ nipadua mu,
na moayɛ ma wɔ ne mu: Ɔno na ɔyɛ mpaninnie ne tumidie nyinaa ti.
Ɔno mu na wɔatwa mo twetia a wɔamfa nsa na ɛtwaeɛ, na mmom wɔyii honam nipadua no firii hɔ wɔ Kristo twetiatwa mu,
siee mo ne no wɔ asubɔ mu, ne mu nso na mo ne no anyane. Ɛnam gyidie a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no tumi adwuma so.
Na mo a anka moyɛ awufoɔ mfomsoɔ ne mo honam momonotoyɛ mu no, wama mo ne no anya nkwa bi, sɛ ɔnam adom so de mfomsoɔ nyinaa akyɛ mo,
na ɔpepaa nsa ano ntwerɛdeɛ a ahyɛdeɛ wom a na ɛtia yɛn no firii hɔ; na wayi afiri kwan mu de abɔ asɛnnua mu.
Na ɔtuu mpaninnie ne tumidie guiɛ yii wɔn adi kyerɛɛ pefee wɔ badwam de dii wɔn so nkonim wɔ mu. Ntamgyinafoɔ foforɔ biara nni hɔ
Enti mommma obi mmmu mo atɛn aduane anaa anonneɛ anaa afahyɛ anaa bosome foforɔ anaa home nna ho;
na saa nneɛma no yɛ deɛ ɛreba no sunsum, na deɛ ɛdi mu paa no yɛ Kristo dea.
Mommma obi mfa anisoɔ (kraman) ahobrɛaseɛ ne abɔfosom mmma nkonimboɔ no mmɔ mo, deɛ “ɔgyina” nneɛma a ɔhunu mu na ne honam nsusuiɛ ma no yɛ ahomasoɔ a adwene nnim
a ɔmmata tire no a nipadua no nyinaa firi mu nam akwaa ne ntini biara so nya aduane na wɔtoatoa mu nyini wɔ nyini a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn mu no. Mmara sodie nko ara nnɔɔso
Enti sɛ mo ne Kristo anya awu afiri wiase mfitiasesɛm ho a, adɛn nti na mode ahyɛdeɛ to mo ho soɔ sɛdeɛ moda so te wiase sɛ:
“Nsɔ mu, nka nhwɛ, mfa wo nsa nka,”
nso ne nyinaa yɛ nneɛma a wɔde yɛ ade na ɛsɛeɛ, sɛdeɛ nnipa ahyɛdeɛ ne wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ teɛ?

Saa nneɛma yi nyinaa yɛ wɔn ara wɔn som mu adeɛ a nnipa anim no, ayɛ sɛ deɛ nyansa wom nanso ɛyɛ kraman ahobrɛaseɛ a ɛma wɔn ara wɔn nipadua mpo, wɔdi no nya; nanso mfasoɔ biara nnim na mmom ne nyinaa yɛ deɛ ɛhyɛ honam akɔnnɔ ma.
3: Enti, sɛ wɔanyane mo ne Kristo a, monhwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ soro, baabi a Kristo teɛ wɔ Onyankopɔn nsa nifa soɔ no.
Momfa mo adwene nsi nneɛma a ɛwɔ soro so, na ɛnyɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ asase soɔ.
Na moawu, na wɔde mo nkwa aka Kristo ho ahunta Onyankopɔn mu.
Na da a Kristo a ɔne yɛn nkwa bɛyi ne ho adie no, mo nso wɔbɛyi mo adi aka ne ho animuonyam mu.
Enti, monkum mo nipadua akwaa a ɛwɔ asase soɔ no wɔ adwamammɔ, efideɛ, akɔnnɔ nhyɛsoɔ, akɔnnɔ bɔne, ne anibereɛ a ɛyɛ abosonsom ho.
Saa nneɛma yi nti na Onyankopɔn abufuo reba wɔ asoɔdenfoɔ mma so.
Mo nso berɛ bi a na mote saa nneɛma no mu no, monantee saa ara.
Nanso afei monyi ne nyinaa ngu, abufuo, koko bɔne, bɔnepɛ, abususɛm; na mommma kasafi mmfiri mo anom mmpue.
Monnnidi atorɔ nnkyerɛ mo ho. Monyi nipasu dada no ne ne nneyɛɛ ngu,
na monhyɛ nipasu foforɔ a wɔnam nimdeɛ mu ayɛ no foforɔ sɛdeɛ Onii a ɔbɔeɛ no suban teɛ,
baabi a Helani anaa Yudani nni hɔ, twetiatwa anaa momonotoyɛ nni hɔ, ɔpɔtɔni, Skiteni, akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ nni hɔ, na mmom Kristo ne adeɛ nyinaa wɔn nyinaa mu no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsua Kristo abrabɔ
Enti ɛnam sɛ moyɛ nnipa a Onyankopɔn ayi mo, ahotefoɔ ne adɔfo yi, monhyɛ timmɔborɔ, ayamyɛ, ahobrɛaseɛ adwene, ɔdwoɔ ne abodwokyɛre.
Na sɛ obi wɔ asɛm tia ne yɔnko a, monnya mo ho aboterɛ na momfa mfirifiri mo ho korakora. Sɛdeɛ Awurade de afiri mo no, mo nso monyɛ saa ara.
Na yeinom nyinaa akyi no, monhyɛ ɔdɔ ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ koroyɛ homa a ɛyɛ pɛ.
Bio nso, momma Kristo asomdwoeɛ nni hene wɔ mo akoma mu, na ɛno mu na wɔfrɛɛ mo baeɛ wɔ nipadua baako mu; na monna ase.
Momma Kristo asɛm no ntena mo mu mmoro so nyansa nyinaa mu. Na monkyerɛkyerɛ, ntutu mo ho fo, mfa sankuo so nnwom, ne ayeyie nnwom ne honhom mu nnwom nto dwom ɔdɛ so wɔ mo akoma mu mma Onyankopɔn.
Na biribiara a moyɛ no, kasa mu oo, nneyɛɛ mu oo, monyɛ ne nyinaa Awurade Yesu din mu mfa ne so nna Agya Nyankopɔn ase. Ɛyerenom, okununom, mma, awofoɔ, nkoa ne awuranom
Ɔyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo kununom, sɛdeɛ ɛfata Awurade mu.
Okununom, monnɔ mo yerenom, na monnhyɛ wɔn ahometeɛ.
Mma, montie mo awofoɔ asɛm nneɛma nyinaa mu, na yei na ɛsɔ Awurade ani.
Agyanom, monnhyɛ mo mma abufuo na wɔn abam ammu.
Nkoa, montie mo honam fam wuranom asɛm adeɛ nyinaa mu, ɛnyɛ nnipa ani so som, sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom akoma a emu teɛ mu, Awurade suro mu.
Na biribiara a moyɛ no, momfiri akoma mu nyɛ no sɛdeɛ moreyɛ ama Awurade na ɛnyɛ nnipa,
na monhunu sɛ Awurade nsam na mobɛnya akatua a ɛfata sɛ apɛgyadeɛ, na Awurade Kristo na mosom no.
Nanso deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no bɛnya adebɔne a ɔyɛeɛ no so akatua, na animhwɛ nnim.
4: Mo, awuranom, momfa deɛ ɛtene, na ɛyɛ pɛ mma mo nkoa, na monhunu sɛ mo nso mowɔ Owura wɔ ɔsoro.
Monkura mpaebɔ mu daa, na momfa aseda nwɛn wɔ mu,
na berɛ korɔ no ara nso mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn na Onyankopɔn mmue pono mma yɛnka Kristo ho ahuntasɛm kronkron a enti mewɔ afiase mpokyerɛ mu no;
na mayi no adi, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ me sɛ mekasa.
Monnante nyansam wɔn a wɔnka mo ho no mu, na monnsɛe mo berɛ kwa.
Momma mo kasa ho mmra nyam berɛ nyinaa na nkyene mmra mu, na moahunu sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mobua obiara.
Tihiko onua dɔfo ne ɔsomfoɔ nokwafoɔ ne me yɔnko akoa wɔ Awurade mu no bɛba abɛka me ho nsɛm nyinaa akyerɛ mo.
Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na moate yɛn ho asɛm na afei wama mo akoma atɔ mo yam nti, meresoma no aba mo nkyɛn,
ɔne Onesimo, onua dɔfo nokwafoɔ, a ɔfiri mo mu no. Wɔn na wɔbɛma moate ɛha nsɛm nyinaa.
Aristarko a ɔyɛ me yɔnko deduani no kyea mo, ne Barnaba wɔfase Marko a monyaa ne ho nkra no, sɛ ɔba mo nkyɛn a, monnye no fɛ so,
ɛne Yesu a wɔfrɛ no Yusto no; wɔn na wɔfiri wɔn a wɔatwa twetia mu. Yeinom nko ara ne me mfɛfoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ Onyankopɔn ahennie no fam, na wɔayɛ me awerɛkyekyerɛ.
Kristo Yesu akoa Epafra a ɔfiri mo mu no kyea mo; daa ɔdima ma mo dendeenden wɔ mpaebɔ mu, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mobɛgyina hɔ pintinn, na moayɛ ma Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ nyinaa mu.
Na medi ne ho adanseɛ sɛ ɔbɔ ne ho mmɔden pii ma mo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Hierapoli no.
Luka, oduyɛfoɔ dɔfo no, ne Dema kyea mo.
Monkyea anuanom a wɔwɔ Laodikea, na monkyea Nimfa ne asafo a ɛwɔ ne fie no.
Na sɛ mokenkan krataa yi wɔ mo hɔ wie a, momma wɔnkenkan no Laodikeafoɔ asafo no nso mu bi, na mo nso monkenkan deɛ ɛfiri Laodikea no.
Afei nso monka nkyerɛ Arkipo sɛ: “Hwɛ ɔsom adwuma a woanya no Awurade mu no so na woawie no pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
Me Paulo, me nkyea a mede me ara me nsa atwerɛ nie. Monkae me mpokyerɛ no. Adom nka mo nyinaa. Amen.

1: Yuda hene Yehoiakim ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, Babilon hene Nebukadnessar baa Yerusalem, na ɔbɛtwaa ho hyiaeɛ.
Na Awurade de Yuda hene Yehoiakim ne Nyankopɔn fie anwenneɛ no bi hyɛɛ ne nsa, na ɔde kɔɔ ne nyame fie wɔ Sinar asase so, na ɔde anwenneɛ no kɔguu ne nyame adekoradan mu.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ n’ahemfie panin Aspenas sɛ ɔmfa Israelfoɔ no bi ne ahemfo asefoɔ ne adehyeɛ no bi mmra,

mmerantewaa a wɔn ho nni dɛm biara na wɔn ho yɛ fɛ, na wɔn ani ateɛ, nyansa nyinaa mu, na wɔnim de na wɔwɔ nhunumu, na wɔbɛtumi asom wɔ ɔhene ahemfie, na ɔnkyerɛ wɔn mma wɔnsua Kaldeafoɔ nwoma ne wɔn kasa.
Afei nso ɔhene hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmma wɔn ɔhene nnuane ne ne nsa a ɔnom no bi da biara, sɛ wɔntete wɔn mfeɛ mmiɛnsa; na ɛno akyi wɔmmɛsom ɔhene.
Na wɔn mu bi a wɔfiri Yudafoɔ mu ne Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria.
Na ahemfie panin no totoo wɔn din. Ɔtoo Daniel din Beltesasar, ɔtoo Hanania din Sadrak, ɔtoo Misael din Mesak, na ɔtoo Asaria din Abed-Nego.
Na Daniel bɔɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔremfa ɔhene nnuane ne ne nsa a ɔnom no ngu ne ho fi, enti ɔsrɛɛ ahemfie panin no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔrengu ne ho fi.
Na Onyankopɔn maa Daniel nyaa ahemfie panin no anim adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu.

Na ahemfie panin no ka kyerɛɛ Daniel sɛ: “Mesuro me wura ɔhene a wayi aduane ne nsa ama mo no. Adɛn nti na mopɛ sɛ ɔhunu sɛ mo anim ayɛyɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ sene mo atipɛnfoɔ mmerantewaa no deɛ? Na moama me tiri ato, ɔhene anim.”
Ɛnna Daniel ka kyerɛɛ ɔpanin a ahemfie panin no de no asi Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria soɔ no sɛ:
“Yɛsrɛ wo, sɔ wo nkoa hwɛ dadu, na ma wɔmma yɛn afuomduane nni ne nsuo nnom,
na wode w’ani ahwɛ yɛn ne mmerantewaa a wɔdi ahennuane no anim, na sɛdeɛ wobɛhunu no, wo ne wo nkoa adi.
Ɛnna ɔpenee deɛ wɔkaeɛ no so, na ɔsɔɔ wɔn hwɛɛ dadu.
Na dadu no soeɛ no, wɔhunuu sɛ wɔn anim ayɛ fɛ na wɔayeyɛ akɛse sene mmerantewaa a wɔdii ahennuane no nyinaa.
Enti ɔpanin a ɔhwɛ wɔn no yii wɔn ahennuane ne nsa a wɔbɛnom no firii hɔ, na ɔmaa wɔn afuomduane daa.
Na mmerantewaa nnan yi, Onyankopɔn maa wɔn nwoma ne nyansa nyinaa mu nimdeɛ ne nhunumu, na Daniel nyaa anisoadehunu ne adaeɛ nyinaa mu nteaseɛ.
Nna a ɔhene hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn mmra no soeɛ no, ahemfie panin no de wɔn baa Nebukadnessar anim.
Na ɔhene ne wɔn kasaeɛ, na wɔn nyinaa mu no, wɔanhunu wɔn mu deɛ ɔte sɛ Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria; na wɔgyinaa ɔhene anim daa.
Nyansa ne nhunumu asɛm biara a ɔhene bisaa wɔn no, ɔhunuu sɛ n’ahennie nyinaa mu no, wɔkyɛn akɔmfoɔ ne nkonyaayifoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa mprɛ du.
Na Daniel tenaa hɔ kɔduruu ɔhene Cyrus afe a ɛdi kan mu. Nebukadnessar daeɛso ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ
2: Na Nebukadnessar ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu no, Nebukadnessar sosoo adaeɛ bi, na ne ho yeraa no, na ne nna tu yeraeɛ.
Enti ɔhene kaa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ akɔmfoɔ ne nkonyaayifoɔ ne asumanfoɔ ne Kaldeafoɔ no mmra na wɔmmɛka ɔhene adaeɛ no nkyerɛ no. Na wɔba bɛgyinagyinaa ɔhene anim.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Maso daeɛ bi ama me ho yera me, na mepɛ sɛ mehunu daeɛ no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ.”
Ɛnna Kaldeafoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene wɔ Aramaik kasa mu sɛ: “O ɔhene, nya nkwa daa. Ka daeɛ no kyerɛ wo nkoa, na yɛbɛkyerɛ aseɛ.”
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Kaldeafoɔ no sɛ: “Deɛ maka no ara na maka: Sɛ moanka daeɛ no ankyerɛ me na moankyerɛ aseɛ a, wɔbɛtwitwa mo mu asinasini na wɔadane mo afie sumina.
Na sɛ moka daeɛ no na mokyerɛ aseɛ a, mobɛnya me hɔ akyɛdeɛ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ ne anidie kɛseɛ. Enti monka daeɛ no nkyerɛ me na monkyerɛ aseɛ.”
Ɛnna wɔkaa no ne mprenu soɔ sɛ: “Ma ɔhene nka daeɛ no nkyerɛ ne nkoa ɛ, na yɛbɛkyerɛ aseɛ.”
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Menim ampa sɛ berɛ ara na morepɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moahunu sɛ deɛ maka no na maka.

Sɛ moanka daeɛ no ankyerɛ me a, asɛm baako pɛ yi na ɛda hɔ ma mo. Menim sɛ moasusu atorosɛm ne nnaadaasɛm sɛ morebɛka no m’anim de akɔsi sɛ berɛ no bɛsesa. Enti monka daeɛ no nkyerɛ me mma menhunu sɛ mobɛtumi akyerɛ aseɛ.”

Ɛnna Kaldeafoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Onipa bi nni asase so a ɔbɛtumi aka asɛm yi akyerɛ ɔhene, na ɔhenkɛseɛ anaa amrado biara mmisaa ɔkɔmfoɔ anaa nkonyaayifoɔ anaa Kaldeani biara hɔ asɛm a ɛte sei da.
Asɛm a ɔhene rebisa yi yɛ den dodo, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛtumi akyerɛ asɛm yi wɔ ɔhene anim, gye anyame a wɔn tenabea nni nnipa mu no.”
Ɛno nti ɔhene bo fuiɛ, na n’ani beree kɛse, na ɔkaa sɛ wɔnsɛe Babilon anyansafoɔ nyinaa.
Na wɔhyɛɛ mmara no, enti wɔkɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔkunkum anyansafoɔ no, na wɔhwehwɛɛ Daniel ne ne mfɛfoɔ no sɛ wɔbɛkum wɔn nso.
Saa berɛ no, Daniel de kasa pa ne nyansa ne ɔhene awɛmfoɔ so panin Ariok a ɔfirii adi sɛ ɔrekɔkunkum Babilon anyansafoɔ no kasaeɛ.
Na ɔbisaa ɔhene awɛmfoɔ so panin Ariok sɛ: “Adɛn nti na ɔhene ahyɛ mmara denden sei?” Ɛnna Ariok kaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ Daniel.
Na Daniel kɔ kɔsrɛɛ ɔhene sɛ ɔmma no berɛ na ɔmmɛkyerɛ aseɛ nkyerɛ ɔhene.
Ɛno akyi no, Daniel kɔɔ ne fie, na ɔkɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ ne mfɛfoɔ Hanania, Misael ne Asaria,
sɛ wɔnsrɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn hɔ mmɔborɔhunu, ahuntasɛm yi ho, na wɔansɛe Daniel ne ne mfɛfoɔ no anka Babilon anyansafoɔ a aka no ho.
Ɛnna wɔyii ahuntasɛm no adi kyerɛɛ Daniel anadwo anisoadehunu mu. Enti Daniel hyiraa ɔsoro Nyankopɔn.
Na Daniel kaa sɛ: “Nhyira nka Onyankopɔn din daa daa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na nyansa ne tumi wɔ no.
Ɔno na ɔsakra berɛ ne nna, na ɔtu ahemfo si ahemfo, na ɔma anyansafoɔ nyansa, na ɔma wɔn a wɔwɔ nhunumu nso nimdeɛ.
Ɔno na ɔyi deɛ emu dɔ ne ahuntasɛm adie. Ɔno na ɔnim deɛ ɛwɔ sum mu; ɔno na hann ne no teɛ.
O m’agyanom Nyankopɔn, wo na meyi wo ayɛ kamfo woɔ, sɛ woama me nyansa ne tumi. Na afei woayi deɛ yɛsrɛɛ woɔ no adi akyerɛ me, na ɔhene asɛm no, woama yɛahunu.”

Ɛno nti Daniel kɔɔ Ariok a ɔhene ayi no sɛ ɔnsɛe Babilon anyansafoɔ no nkyɛn. Ɔkɔeɛ no, asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no ne sɛ: “Babilon anyansafoɔ no, nsɛe obiara. Fa me kɔ ɔhene anim, na menkɔkyerɛ ɔhene daeɛ no ase.”
Ɛnna Ariok yɛɛ ntɛm de Daniel kɔɔ ɔhene anim, na deɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no nie: “Mahunu Yuda atukɔfoɔ no mu ɔbarima bi a ɔbɛtumi akyerɛ ɔhene daeɛ no ase.”
Na ɔhene bisaa Daniel a ne din de Beltesasar no sɛ: “Wogye di sɛ wobɛtumi aka daeɛ a mesoeɛ no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ akyerɛ me?”
Daniel buaa wɔ ɔhene anim sɛ: “Ahuntasɛm a ɔhene abisa no, anyansafoɔ, nkonyaayifoɔ, akɔmfoɔ, ne nsoromma mu ahwɛfoɔ rentumi nyi no adi nkyerɛ ɔhene.
Nanso Onyankopɔn bi wɔ ɔsoro a ɔyi ahuntasɛm adie, na wama Ɔhene Nebukadnessar ahunu deɛ ɛbɛba nna a ɛdi akyire no mu. Wo daeɛ ne anisoadehunu a woda wo mpa soɔ no wohunuiɛ no nie:
“Wo, ɔhene, wosusuu deɛ daakye ɛbɛba no ho wɔ wo mpa so, na Deɛ ɔyi ahuntasɛm adie no ama woahunu deɛ ɛbɛba.
Na me deɛ, ɛnyɛ nyansa a ɛwɔ me mu sene ateasefoɔ nyinaa nti na wɔayi ahuntasɛm yi akyerɛ me, na mmom deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ɔhene ahunu nkyerɛaseɛ no, na woahunu w’akoma mu nsusuiɛ ntira.
“Wo, O ɔhene, wohwɛeɛ, na hwɛ! ohoni kɛseɛ bi nie. Na ohoni no so, na ɛhyerɛn hyɛnn; na ɛgyina w’anim, na ɛyɛ hu.
Ohoni no, na ne tiri yɛ sika pa, ne koko ne n’abasa yɛ dwetɛ, ne yafunu ne n’asene yɛ kɔbere,
ne nan yɛ dadeɛ, na ne nan ase baabi yɛ dadeɛ, na ɛfabi nso yɛ dɔteɛ.
Wohwɛeɛ ara kɔsii sɛ ɛboɔ bi a nsa biara nkura mu te bɛbɔɔ ohoni no nan ase a ɛyɛ dadeɛ ne dɔteɛ no, na ɛbubuu no muhumuhu.

Ɛnna dadeɛ, dɔteɛ, kɔbere, dwetɛ ne sika no nyinaa bubuu muhumuhu prɛko pɛ, na ɛyɛɛ sɛ ahuhuro berɛ mu ayuporobea so ntɛtɛ, na mframa sesa kɔeɛ, na wɔanhunu ɛho biribiara bio. Na ɛboɔ a ɛbɔɔ ohoni no danee bepɔ kɛseɛ, na ɛyɛɛ asase nyinaa so ma.
“Daeɛ no nie, na yɛbɛka ne nkyerɛaseɛ nso akyerɛ ɔhene.
Wo, O ɔhene, woyɛ ahene mu hene a ɔsoro Nyankopɔn de ahennie, tumi, ahoɔden ne animuonyam ama woɔ,
na baabiara a nnipa mma ne wuram mmoa ne wiem nnomaa teɛ no, ɔde wɔn ahyɛ wo nsa, na ɔde wo asi wɔn nyinaa so. Wone sika tiri no.
“W’akyi no, ahennie foforɔ bɛsɔre a ɛnnuru wo deɛ no, na ahennie foforɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ kɔbere a ɛbɛdi asase nyinaa soɔ bɛsɔre.
“Na ahennie a ɛtɔ so nnan no deɛ, ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ dadeɛ. Na sɛdeɛ dadeɛ bubu na ɛyam adeɛ a ɛbɔ so nyinaa no, saa ara na ahennie a ɛtɔ so nnan no bɛbubu na ayam yeinom nyinaa sɛdeɛ dadeɛ yam adeɛ no.

“Na sɛdeɛ wohunuu nan ase ne nansoaa no sɛ ɛfabi yɛ ɔnwemfoɔ dɔteɛ na ɛfabi nso yɛ dadeɛ no, saa ara na ahennie no mu bɛpaepae, nanso sɛdeɛ wohunuu sɛ dɔteɛ frafra dadeɛ no mu no, dadeɛ denyɛ bɛda adi wom.
Na nansoaa a ne fabi yɛ dadeɛ na ne fabi nso yɛ dɔteɛ no, ahennie no fabi bɛyɛ den na ɛfabi nso ayɛ mmerɛ.
Na sɛdeɛ wohunuu sɛ dɔteɛ ne dadeɛ adi afra no, ɛne nnipa mma bɛdi afra, nanso ɛremfemfam ho, sɛdeɛ dadeɛ ne dɔteɛ ntumi mfra no.
“Na ahemfo no nna no mu no, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn bɛma ahennie bi so. Wɔrensɛe no da, na wɔrennya ahennie no mma ɔman foforɔ biara. Ɛbɛbubu ahennie ahodoɔ no nyinaa ama no asa, na ɛno deɛ, ɛbɛgyina daa.

Sɛdeɛ wohunuu sɛ ɛboɔ a nsa biara nkura mu te firii bepɔ ho, na ɛbɛbubuu dadeɛ, kɔbere, dɔteɛ, dwetɛ ne sika no, saa ara na ɛbɛyɛ. Onyankopɔn Kɛseɛ no na wakyerɛ ɔhene deɛ ɛbɛba daakye. Daeɛ no wom, na ne nkyerɛaseɛ nso yɛ nokorɛ.”
Ɛnna Ɔhene Nebukadnessar de n’anim butuu fam, na ɔde anidie maa Daniel, na ɔkaa sɛ wɔmma no akyɛdeɛ na wɔnhye aduhwam mma no.
Na Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Daniel sɛ: “Ampa ara, mo Nyankopɔn no yɛ anyame mu Nyame ne ahemfo Wura ne Deɛ ɔyi ahuntasɛm adie, sɛ woatumi ayi ahuntasɛm yi adie.”
Enti ɔhene yɛɛ Daniel onipa kɛseɛ, na ɔmaa no akyɛdeɛ akɛseɛ bebree, na ɔmaa no dii Babilon mantam no nyinaa so tumi, na ɔyɛɛ no Babilon anyansafoɔ nyinaa so panin.
Daniel nso srɛɛ ɔhene maa no de Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego sisii Babilon mantam no so sɛ ahwɛfoɔ, na Daniel deɛ, ɔtenaa ahemfie.
3: Ɔhene Nebukadnessar yɛɛ sika honi bi a ne tenten yɛ basafa aduosia, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa nsia, na ɔde sii Dura asasetamaa so wɔ Babilon mantam no mu.

Na Ɔhene Nebukadnessar somaa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ amantam asoafoɔ, atitire ne amradofoɔ, afotufoɔ, afotosanfoɔ, atemmufoɔ, polisifoɔ mpanimfoɔ, ne amantam no so ahwɛfoɔ nyinaa, sɛ wɔmmra adwabɔ a ɔhene Nebukadnessar de rehyira ne honi soɔ no ase.

Ɛnna wɔkɔfrɛfrɛɛ amantam asoafoɔ, atitire ne amradofoɔ, afotufoɔ, afotosanfoɔ, atemmufoɔ, polisifoɔ mpanimfoɔ, ne amantam no so ahwɛfoɔ nyinaa bɛhyiaa sɛ wɔrebɛhyira ohoni a ɔhene Nebukadnessar de asi hɔ no so, na wɔbɛgyinagyinaa ohoni a Nebukadnessar de asi hɔ no anim.
Na ɛsɛn bi teaam dendeenden sɛ: “O Mo, nkurɔfoɔ, aman ne kasa hodoɔ, wɔka kyerɛ mo sɛ,
sɛ mote abɛn, odurugya, sambuka sankuo, sankuwa, sankuo, atɛntɛbɛn ne nnwontoɔ nneɛma hodoɔ nyinaa nnyegyeeɛ a, mommutubutu fam nkoto nsɔre sika honi a Ɔhene Nebukadnessar de asi hɔ no.
Na obiara a ɔremmutu fam nkoto nsɔre no, dɔn no ara mu, wɔde no bɛto fononoo a egya refram mu no mu.”

Ɛno nti, berɛ a aman no nyinaa tee abɛn, odurugya, sambuka sankuo, sankuwa, sankuo, ne nnwontoɔ nneɛma hodoɔ nyinaa nnyegyeeɛ no ara pɛ, aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa hodoɔ no nyinaa butubutuu fam koto sɔree sika honi a Ɔhene Nebukadnessar de asi hɔ no. Mmarima baasa wɔ ogya fononoo mu
Saa berɛ no ara mu, Kaldeafoɔ bi baa ɔhene nkyɛn bɛbɔɔ Yudafoɔ no kwaadu.
Wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Nebukadnessar sɛ: “O ɔhene, nya nkwa daa.
Wo ɔhene, wo na woahyɛ mmara sɛ onipa biara a ɔbɛte abɛn, odurugya, sambuka sankuo, sankuwa, sankuo, atɛntɛbɛn ne nnwontoɔ nneɛma hodoɔ nyinaa nnyegyeeɛ no, ɔmmutu fam nkoto nsɔre sika honi no,
na deɛ wammutu fam ansɔre no, wɔde no bɛto fononoo a egya refram mu no mu.
Yudafoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wode wɔn asisi hɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ Babilon amantam soɔ, Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego; ɔhene, saa mmarima yi mmu wo koraa; wɔnsom w’anyame, na wɔnsɔre sika honi a wode asi hɔ no.”
Ɛnna Nebukadnessar de abufuo ne anibereɛ kaa sɛ wɔnkɔfa Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego mmra. Enti wɔkɔfaa mmarima yi baa ɔhene anim.
Na Nebukadnessar bisaa wɔn sɛ: “Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego, ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ mose morensom m’anyame, na sika honi a mede asi hɔ no nso, monkoto nsɔre no?

Afei deɛ, sɛ moasiesie mo ho sɛ berɛ a mobɛte abɛn, odurugya, sambuka sankuo, sankuwa, sankuo, atɛntɛbɛn ne nnwontoɔ nneɛma hodoɔ nyinaa nnyegyeeɛ no, mobɛbutu fam asɔre ohoni a mayɛ no a, ɛyɛ. Na sɛ moansɔre no a, dɔn no ara mu, wɔde mo bɛgu fononoo a egya refram mu no mu. Na onyame bɛn na ɔbɛtumi agye mo afiri me nsam?”
Ɛnna Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego buaa ɔhene sɛ: “O Nebukadnessar, ɛnhia sɛ yɛbɛbua wo yei ho asɛm bi.
Sɛ ɛba saa a, yɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛsom no no bɛtumi agye yɛn. Ɔbɛyi yɛn afiri fononoo a egya refram mu no mu, na ɔbɛgye yɛn afiri wo, ɔhene nsam.
Na sɛ amma saa mpo a, ɔhene, yɛpɛ sɛ wohunu sɛ ɛnyɛ w’anyame na yɛbɛsom wɔn, na sika honi a wode asi hɔ no nso, yɛrensɔre no.”
Ɛnna Nebukadnessar bo fuu Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego, na n’anim tebea sakraeɛ. Na ɔkaa sɛ wɔmma fononoo no nnɔ mprɛ nson nkyɛn sɛdeɛ daa ɛdɔ no.
Na ɔhyɛɛ mmarima ahoɔdenfoɔ bi a wɔka n’asraafoɔdɔm ho sɛ wɔnkyekyere Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego nkɔto wɔn ngu fononoo a egya refram mu no mu.
Ɛnna wɔkyekyeree mmarima yi, wɔn ntwontwo, wɔn ntadeɛ ne wɔn mmotire ne wɔn ntoma mu, na wɔtoo wɔn guu fononoo a egya refram mu no mu.
Ɛsiane sɛ na ɔhene asɛm no mu yɛ den, na fononoo no adɔ hyehyeehye aboro soɔ nti, mmarima a wɔde Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego kɔeɛ no, gyaframa no kunkum wɔn.
Na mmarima mmiɛnsa yi, Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego a wɔakyekyere wɔn no hwehwee fononoo a egya refram mu no mu. Ɔhene gye nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no to mu
Ɛnna ɔhene Nebukadnessar ho dwirii no, na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm sɔreeɛ. Na ɔbisaa n’agyinatufoɔ no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ mmarima mmiɛnsa na yɛkyekyeree wɔn too wɔn guu gya no mu?” Wɔbuaa ɔhene sɛ: “Ɛyɛ ampa, O ɔhene.”
Ɔno nso kaa sɛ: “Hwɛ! Mehunu mmarima nnan a wɔasane wɔn sɛ wɔnenam egya no mu, na wɔn ho ntɔɔ kyima, na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnan no tebea te sɛ Onyame ba bi.”

Ɛnna Nebukadnessar bɛn fononoo a egya refram mu no ano. Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Sadrak, Mesak, ne Abed-Nego, Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn no nkoa, momfiri adi mmra!” Na Sadrak, Mesak, ne Abed-Nego firii adi firii egya no mu baeɛ.

Na amantam asoafoɔ, atitire ne amradofoɔ ne ɔhene mpanimfoɔ a wɔahyia no hwɛɛ mmarima yi, na wɔhunuu sɛ egya no annya wɔn nipadua so tumi, na wɔn tiri so nwi ho anka, na wɔn ntwontwo mpo ansakra, na egya no hwa nso annye wɔn ho.

Nebukadnessar kaa sɛ: “Nhyira nka Sadrak, Mesak, ne Abed-Nego Nyankopɔn no; ɔno na wasoma ne bɔfoɔ ama no abɛyi ne nkoa a wɔde wɔn ho too ne soɔ na wɔsakraa ɔhene asɛm na wɔde wɔn nipadua maeɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔrenkoto nsɔre onyame biara sɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn no nko.

Ne saa nti, merehyɛ mmara sɛ aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa hodoɔ nyinaa mu no, obiara a ɔbɛka Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego Nyankopɔn ho abususɛm no, wɔbɛtwitwa ne mu asinasini, na wɔadane ne fie agyananbea, ɛfiri sɛ onyame bi nni hɔ a ɔbɛtumi agye onipa sɛ oyi.”
Ɛnna ɔhene maa no sii Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego yie wɔ Babilon mantam no mu. Nebukadnessar daeɛso a ɛtɔ so mmienu
4: “Ɔhene Nebukadnesar de yei kɔma aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa hodoɔ nyinaa a wɔte asase nyinaa soɔ: Mo asomdwoeɛ nnɔɔso.
Nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwanwadeɛ a Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama me no, ɛyɛ me fɛ sɛ mɛka ho asɛm.
Hwɛ sɛdeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne soso fa, na n’anwanwadeɛ yɛ akɛseɛ fa! N’ahennie yɛ daa ahennie, na ne tumi wɔ hɔ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
“Me, Nebukadnessar, na mete me fie dwoodwoo, na medi yie m’ahemfie.
Mesoo daeɛ bi a ɛmaa mebɔɔ hu, na me mpa so adwendwene ne m’anisoadehunu haa me.
Enti mehyɛɛ mmara sɛ wɔmfa Babilon anyansafoɔ nyinaa mmra m’anim na wɔmmɛkyerɛ me daeɛ no ase.
“Ɛnna akɔmfoɔ, nkonyaayifoɔ, Kaldeafoɔ ne nsoromma mu ahwɛfoɔ no baeɛ, na mekaa daeɛ no kyerɛɛ wɔn, nanso wɔantumi ankyerɛ me aseɛ.
Nanso akyire yi no, Daniel a wɔfrɛ no Beltesasar, sɛdeɛ me nyame no din teɛ, na Onyame kronkron no honhom wɔ ne mu no baa m’anim, a mekaa daeɛ no kyerɛɛ no sɛ:
“‘Nkonyaayifoɔ panin Beltesasar, menim sɛ Onyame kronkron no honhom wɔ wo mu, na ahuntasɛm biara nni hɔ a ɛkyere wo soɔ, enti ka me daeɛ mu adehunu a mehunuiɛ ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ kyerɛ me.
“‘Afei me daeɛ ne anisoadehunu a menyaa no me mpa soɔ mu no, mehunuiɛ na hwɛ! Na dua bi si asase mfimfini a ɛware tenteenten.
Dua no nyini bɛyɛɛ den, na ne tenten kɔduruu ɔsoro, na wɔhunuu no asase so baabiara.
Na n’ahahan yɛ fɛ, na n’aba dɔɔso, na aduane wɔ so ma obiara. Wuram mmoa gyee nwunu wɔ aseɛ, na ewiem nnomaa nso sisii ne mman so. Ɔhonam nyinaa nso didii so.
“‘Mekɔɔ so hwɛeɛ, me daeɛ ne anisoadehunu a menyaa no me mpa soɔ no mu, na hwɛ! ɔwɛmfoɔ, ɔkronkronni, bi na ɔfiri ɔsoro resiane ba yi.
Na ɔteaam dendeenden sɛ: “Montwa dua no na montwitwa ne mman. Momporo n’ahahan na mompansam n’aba. Na mmoa nnwane mfiri aseɛ, na nnomaa ntutu mfiri ne mman so.
Nanso monnya ne dunsini asase mu, na momfa dadeɛ ne kɔbere nkyekyere no petee so wura mu, na ɔsoro bosuo mfɔ no, na ɔne mmoa ntena wuram nni asase so ahahan.
Ma n’akoma nsesa na anyɛ ɔdasani deɛ bio, na wɔmma no aboa akoma na mmerɛ nson ntwa ne tiri so.

Awɛmfoɔ agyina so na asɛm yi gyina, na akronkronfoɔ asɛm so na atemmuo yi sie, na ama ateasefoɔ ahunu sɛ Ɔsorosoroni no na ɔdi adasamma ahennie so tumi, na ɔde ma obiara a ɔpɛ, na ɔde nnipa mu ahobrɛasefoɔ si soɔ.”

“‘Daeɛ yi na me, Ɔhene Nebukadnesar, mesoeɛ. Na afei wo, Beltesasar, kyerɛ aseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ m’ahennie mu anyansafoɔ nyinaa antumi ankyerɛ me aseɛ. Nanso wo deɛ, ɛsiane sɛ wowɔ Onyame kronkron no honhom nti, megye di sɛ wobɛtumi.’

“Ɛnna Daniel a ne din de Beltesasar no ho dwirii no kakra, na na n’adwene haa no. “Enti Ɔhene kaa sɛ, ‘Beltesasar, mma daeɛ no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ nnha wo.’ “Na Beltesasar buaa sɛ, ‘Me wura, anka ma daeɛ no mfa wɔn a wɔkyiri woɔ ho na ne nkyerɛaseɛ mfa w’atamfo ho.
“‘Dua a wohunuiɛ a ɛnyini bɛyɛɛ kɛseɛ na ɛyɛɛ den a ne tentene kɔpem ɔsoro a wɔhunuu no asase so baabiara,
na n’ahahan yɛ fɛ na n’aba dɔɔso na aduane wɔ soɔ ma obiara, na wuram mmoa tete aseɛ na ewiem nnomaa sisi ne mman soɔ no,
O ɔhene, ɛyɛ wo ara, ɛfiri sɛ woayɛ kɛseɛ na woayɛ den, na wo kɛseyɛ akɔ ara akɔduru ɔsoro, na wo tumidie akɔduru asase ano nohoa.

“‘Enti sɛ ɔhene hunuu ɔwɛmfoɔ, ɔkronkronni bi, sɛ ɔfiri ɔsoro reba na ɔkaa sɛ: “Montwa dua no nsɛe no, nanso monnya ne dunsini asase mu, na momfa dadeɛ ne kɔbere nkyekyere no wɔ petee so wura mu, na ɔsoro bosuo mfɔ no, na ɛne wuram mmoa ntena nnidi nkɔsi sɛ mmerɛ nson bɛtwa ne tiri soɔ” no,
Ɔhene, nkyerɛaseɛ no nie, na Ɔsorosoroni no ahyɛdeɛ a rebɛba mu, me wura ɔhene so ni.

Wɔbɛpamo wo afiri nnipa mu, na wo ne wuram mmoa atena, na wɔama woawe wura sɛ nantwie, na ɔsoro bosuo afɔ wo, na mmerɛ nson atwa wo tiri so, akɔsi sɛ wobɛhunu sɛ Ɔsorosoroni no na ɔdi adasamma ahennie so tumi, na ɔde ma obiara a ɔpɛ.
“‘Na sɛdeɛ wɔkaa sɛ wɔnnya dua no dunsini no, sɛ wonya hunu sɛ ɔsoro na ɛdi tumi no a, wɔbɛsane adane w’ahennie ama wo.
Enti ɔhene, ma m’afotuo nyɛ wo fɛ, na yɛ adetenenee fa pa wo bɔne gu, na hunu ahiafoɔ mmɔbɔ fa pepa w’amumuyɛ. Ebia ɛbɛma woadi yie akyɛ.’”
Yeinom nyinaa baa ɔhene Nebukadnessar so.
Abosome dumienu awieeɛ no, da bi na ɔnenam Babilon ahemfie no soro.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ Babilon Kɛseɛ a mede me tumi kɛseɛ akyekyere de ayɛ ahenkuro, na ama m’animuonyam agye din no nie anaa?”
Berɛ a ɔhene ano gu so reka asɛm no, ɛnne bi firi soro baa sɛ: “Wo ɔhene Nebukadnessar, wɔreka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Ahennie no afiri wo nsa.

Na wɔbɛpamo wo afiri nnipa mu, na wuram mmoa na wo ne wɔn bɛtena, na wura na wɔde bɛma wo awe sɛ nantwie, na mmerɛ nson atwa wo tiri so, akɔsi sɛ wobɛhunu sɛ Ɔsorosoroni no na ɔdi adasamma ahennie so tumi, na ɔde ma deɛ ɔpɛ no.’”

Dɔn no mu ara na asɛm no baa mu Nebukadnessar soɔ, na wɔpamoo no firii nnipa mu, na ɔwee wura sɛ nantwie, na ɔsoro bosuo fɔɔ ne honam, de kɔsii sɛ ne nwi fuu sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ ntakra, na ne mmɔwerɛ yɛɛ sɛ nnomaa deɛ. Nebukadnessar tontom AWURADE

“Na nna no baa awieeɛ no, me, Nebukadnessar, memaa m’ani so hwɛɛ ɔsoro, na m’adwene sane baeɛ, na mehyiraa Ɔsorosoroni no, na mekamfoo Deɛ ɔte ase daa daa no yii no ayɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ne tumi yɛ daa tumi na n’ahennie wɔ hɔ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Na asase sotefoɔ nyinaa wɔmmu wɔn hwee, na ɔyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ wɔ ɔsoro asafo ne asase sotefoɔ mu. Obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛtumi abɔ ne nsa atwene anaa ɔbɛtumi aka akyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi?’

“Ɛberɛ no mu no m’adwene sane baeɛ, na sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na masan anya m’ahennie animuonyam nti, me kɛseyɛ ne me hyerɛn sane baa me so, na m’agyinatufoɔ ne m’aberempɔn bɛhwehwɛɛ me, na wɔde me sii m’ahennie so bio, na menyaa tumi a ɛsene kane deɛ no kaa ho.
“Afei me, Nebukadnessar, meyi ɔsoro Hene no ayɛ na mema ne so hyɛ no animuonyam, ɛfiri sɛ ne nnwuma nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ, na n’akwan yɛ atɛntenenee, na wɔn a wɔnam ahantan soɔ no, ɔtumi brɛ wɔn ase.”
5: Ɔhene Belsasar too ponkɛseɛ maa n’aberempɔn a wɔyɛ nnipa apem, na wɔnomm nsa wɔ apem no anim.

Berɛ a nsa no boroo Belsasar no, ɔkaa sɛ wɔmfa sika ne dwetɛ anwenneɛ a ne papa Nebukadnessar kɔfa firii Yerusalem asɔrefie hɔ baeɛ no mmra, na ɔhene ne n’aberempɔn ne ne yerenom ne ne mpenafoɔ nnom mu.
Ɛnna wɔde sika anwenneɛ a wɔkɔfa firii Onyankopɔn asɔrefie a na ɛwɔ Yerusalem no baeɛ, na ɔhene ne n’aberempɔn, ne yerenom ne ne mpenafoɔ no nom mu.
Wɔnonomm nsa, na wɔkamfoo sika ne dwetɛ, kɔbere, dadeɛ, dua ne aboɔ anyame.
Dɔn no mu ara na onipa nsateaa ba bɛtwerɛɛ ahemfie no fasuo no ho, kaneadua no anim, na ɔhene hunuu nsa a ɛtwerɛeɛ no ano.
Ɛnna ɔhene anim tebea daneeɛ, na ne tirim nsusuiɛ maa no bɔɔ hu, na n’asene mu hodwoeɛ, na ne nkotodwe keka boom biribiri.

Ɔhene teaam dendeenden sɛ wɔnkɔfa nkonyaayifoɔ, Kaldeafoɔ ne nsoromma mu ahwɛfoɔ no mmra. Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Babilon anyansafoɔ no sɛ: “Obiara a ɔbɛkan ntwerɛdeɛ yi na wakyerɛ me aseɛ no, wɔbɛfira no tankɔkɔɔ de sika kɔnmuadeɛ agu ne kɔn mu, na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa adi tumi wɔ ahennie yi mu.”
Ɛnna ɔhene anyansafoɔ no nyinaa baeɛ, nanso wɔantumi ankan ntwerɛdeɛ no, na wɔantumi ankyerɛ ɔhene aseɛ.
Enti Ɔhene Belsasar ho yeraa no kɛse, na n’anim danee, na n’aberempɔn no tirim yɛɛ wɔn keserenee.
Ɔhene ne n’aberempɔn nsɛm no nti ɔhemmaa no baa apontoɔ dan no mu. Na ɔhemmaa kaa sɛ: “O ɔhene, nya nkwa daa! Mma w’adwene nnha wo na w’anim nnnane.

Ɔbarima bi wɔ w’ahennie mu a Onyame kronkron no honhom wɔ ne mu, na wo papa berɛ soɔ no, wɔhunuu no sɛ ɔwɔ nimdeɛ ne nhunumu ne nyansa sɛ anyame nyansa, wo papa, ɔhene Nebukadnessar, de no sii akɔmfoɔ, nkonyaayifoɔ, Kaldeafoɔ ne nsoromma mu ahwɛfoɔ so panin, wo papa ankasa.
Wɔhunuu honhom a ɛkyɛn soɔ ne nimdeɛ ne nhunumu a wɔde kyerɛ daeɛ ne aborɔme ase na wɔde sane apɔ wɔ Daniel a ɔhene too ne din Beltesasar no mu. Enti ma wɔnkɔfrɛ Daniel mmra na ɔmmɛkyerɛ aseɛ.”
Ɛnna wɔde Daniel baa ɔhene anim. Na ɔhene bisaa Daniel sɛ: “Wone Daniel a wofiri Yuda atukɔfoɔ a me papa ɔhene de wɔn firi Yuda baeɛ no mu no?
Mate wo nka nso sɛ wowɔ Onyankopɔn honhom, na wɔahunu sɛ wowɔ nimdeɛ ne nhunumu, na wowɔ nyansa a ɛkyɛn soɔ.
Na afei wɔde anyansafoɔ ne nkonyaayifoɔ no baa m’anim sɛ wɔmmɛkenkan ntwerɛdeɛ yi na wɔnkyerɛ me aseɛ, nanso wɔantumi ankyerɛ asɛm no ase.

Mate wo nka sɛ wotumi kyerɛ nsɛm ase na wosane apɔ. Enti sɛ wotumi kenkan ntwerɛdeɛ yi na wokyerɛ me aseɛ a, wɔbɛfira wo tankɔkɔɔ de sika kɔnmuadeɛ agu wo kɔn mu, na woayɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa adi ahennie yi mu tumi.”
Ɛnna Daniel kaa no ɔhene anim sɛ: “Ma w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ntena wo hɔ, na fa w’akyɛdeɛ ma onipa foforɔ. Nanso mɛkenkan ntwerɛdeɛ no akyerɛ ɔhene, na mama no ahunu ne nkyerɛaseɛ.
O ɔhene, Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn de ahennie ne kɛseyɛ ne anidie ne animuonyam maa w'agya Nebukadnessar.
Tumi a ɔde maa no nti, aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa hodoɔ nyinaa ho popoeɛ, na wɔsuroo n’anim. Deɛ ɔpɛ no, ɔkuu no, na deɛ ɔpɛ no, ɔmaa no tenaa ase; deɛ ɔpɛ no, ɔmaa ne so, na deɛ ɔpɛ no, ɔbrɛɛ no ase.
Nanso berɛ a n’akoma maa ne ho so na ne honhom yɛɛ den maa no yɛɛ ahantan no, wɔtuu no firii n’ahennwa so, na wɔgyee n’animuonyam firii ne nsam.

Enti wɔpamoo no firii adasamma mu, na wɔmaa n’akoma yɛɛ sɛ aboa deɛ, na ɔne ɛserɛ so mfunumu tenaeɛ. Wɔmaa no wee wura sɛ nantwie, na ɔsoro bosuo fɔɔ ne honam, kɔsii sɛ ɔhunuu sɛ Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn na ɔdi adasamma ahennie so tumi, na obiara a ɔpɛ no, ɔde no si so.
“Na wo, ne ba Belsasar, wonim yei nyinaa deɛ, nanso woammrɛ w’akoma ase.

Ɔsoro Wura no na woama wo ho so atia no, na wɔde ne fie anwenneɛ aba w’anim, na wo ne w’aberempɔn, wo yerenom ne wo mpenafoɔ anom mu nsa, na woakamfo dwetɛ ne sika, kɔbere, dadeɛ, dua ne aboɔ anyame a wɔnhunu adeɛ na wɔnte asɛm na wɔnnim hwee no, na Onyankopɔn a wo home wɔ ne nsam a w’akwan nyinaa wɔ no no deɛ, woanni no ni.
Enti ɔno na ɔsomaa nsa bi bɛtwerɛɛ ntwerɛdeɛ yi.
Na nsɛm a wɔkurukyireeɛ no nie: MENE, MENE, TEKEL ne PARSIN.
“Asɛm no nkyerɛaseɛ nie: MENE, Onyankopɔn akan w’ahennie nna, na ɔde aba awieeɛ.
“TEKEL, wɔakari wo nsania mu, na wɔahunu sɛ wotɔ sini.
“PERES, wɔakyɛ w’ahennie mu de ama Mediafoɔ ne Persiafoɔ.”
Ɛnna Belsasar ka maa wɔfiraa Daniel tankɔkɔɔ, na wɔde sika kɔnmuadeɛ guu ne kɔn mu, na wɔbɔ gyee ne so sɛ ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa adi ahennie no mu tumi.
Saa anadwo no ara, wɔkumm Kaldeafoɔ hene Belsasar,
na wɔde ahennie no maa Mediani Dario a saa berɛ no na wadi bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduosia mmienu no.
6: Ɛsɔɔ Dario ani sɛ ɔde amantam asoafoɔ ɔha aduonu bɛsisi ahennie no soɔ, sɛ wɔnni ahennie no nyinaa so,
na ɔde ahemfie mpanimfoɔ mmiɛnsa sisii wɔn so na amantam asoafoɔ no abu akonta akyerɛ wɔn, na ɔhene anhwere adeɛ; na Daniel yɛ mmiɛnsa no mu baako.
Na Daniel yi da nso ahemfie mpanimfoɔ ne amantam asoafoɔ no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na honhom a ɛkyɛn soɔ wɔ ne mu, na ɔhene yɛɛ n’adwene sɛ ɔbɛma ne so ahennie no nyinaa mu.
Ɛnna ahemfie mpanimfoɔ ne amantam asoafoɔ no hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya Daniel ho asɛm bi, ahennie no fam, nanso wɔannya asɛm anaa bɔne biara, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔdi nokorɛ na wɔnhunu ne ho mfomsoɔ anaa bɔne biara.
Enti mmarima no kaa sɛ: “Yɛrennya Daniel yi ho asɛm biara; yɛbɛnya no a, gye sɛ ne Nyankopɔn mmara ho.”
Ɛnna ahemfie mpanimfoɔ yi ne amantam asoafoɔ no boaboaa wɔn ano kɔtoaa ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔhene Dario, nya nkwa daa.

Na ahennie yi mu ahemfie mpanimfoɔ, atitire, amantam asoafoɔ, ɔhene agyinatufoɔ ne amradofoɔ nyinaa atu agyina sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmara ɔhene din mu na wɔaka no dendeenden sɛ obiara a ɔbɛbisa onyame bi anaa onipa bi hɔ adeɛ adaduasa yi, gye wo, ɔhene hɔ no, wɔbɛto no atwene agyata amena mu.
Enti O ɔhene, ma mmara no ntim, na fa wo nsa hyɛ deɛ wɔatwerɛ no ase na ansesa, sɛdeɛ Media ne Persia mmara a wɔnnane ani no teɛ.”
Yei nti ɔhene Dario de ne nsa hyɛɛ mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ no ase maa wɔkurukyiree.

Berɛ a Daniel tee sɛ wɔakurukyire atwerɛ no, ɔkɔɔ ne fie; nso na n’abansoro dan mu mpomma a ɛkyerɛ Yerusalem no abuebue, na ɔkotoo ne nkotodwe anim mprɛnsa da koro, na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ daa ase, ne Nyankopɔn anim sɛdeɛ na ɔyɛ kane no ara.
Na mmarima yi bɛtoaa Daniel na wɔhunuu no sɛ ɔrebisa adeɛ, na ɔrekoto srɛ ne Nyankopɔn anim.

Ɛnna wɔkɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Womfaa wo nsa nhyɛɛ mmara ase sɛ obiara a ɔbɛbisa onyame anaa onipa biara hɔ adeɛ bi adaduasa yi, gye wo, ɔhene hɔ no, wɔbɛto no atwene agyata amena mu anaa?” Ɔhene buaa sɛ: “Asɛm no atim sɛdeɛ Media ne Persia mmara a wɔnnane ani no teɛ.”
Ɛhɔ ara na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Daniel a ɔfiri Yuda atukɔfoɔ mu no mmu wo koraa, O ɔhene, ne mmara a wode wo nsa ahyɛ aseɛ no, na ɔbɔ mpaeɛ mprɛnsa da koro.”
Berɛ a ɔhene tee asɛm no, ɛyɛɛ no ya kɛse, na ɔbɔɔ ne tirim Daniel ho sɛ ɔbɛgye no; ɔbɔɔ mmɔden ara kɔsii awiatɔ berɛ sɛ ɔbɛgye no.

Afei mmarima no boaboaa wɔn ano bɛtoaa ɔhene, na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: “Ɔhene, hunu sɛ ɛyɛ Media ne Persia mmara sɛ mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ biara a ɔhene ahyɛ no, wɔntumi nsesa no.” Wɔde Daniel to gyata amena mu
Enti ɔhene hyɛ maa wɔkɔfaa Daniel baeɛ, na wɔtoo no twenee agyata amena mu. Nso ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Daniel sɛ: “Wo Nyankopɔn a wosom no daa no, ɔno na ɔbɛgye woɔ.”
Na wɔde boɔ bi ba bɛtoo amena no ano, na ɔhene de ne pɛtea, ne n’aberempɔn mpɛtea sɔɔ ano sɛdeɛ wɔrensesa Daniel ho asɛm biara.
Na ɔhene kɔɔ n’ahemfie, na ɔdii abuada anadwo no, na wamma wɔamfa nnwontoɔ nneɛma biara amma n’anim, na ne nna tetee n’ani so.
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔree ahemadakye, na animu reteteɛ no, ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ agyata amena no ano.

Berɛ a ɔbɛn amena no ano no, ɔde awerɛhoɔ nne teaam frɛɛ Daniel. Ɔhene teaam bisaa Daniel sɛ: “Daniel, Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no akoa, wo Nyankopɔn a wosom no daa no atumi agye wo afiri agyata no nsam anaa?”
Ntɛm ara Daniel ne ɔhene kasaa sɛ: “O Ɔhene, nya nkwa daa.
Me Nyankopɔn asoma ne bɔfoɔ ama wabɛmuamua agyata no ano, na wɔanyɛ me hwee, ɛfiri sɛ wahu me sɛ medi bem n’anim, na wo, O ɔhene anim nso, menyɛɛ bɔne biara.”
Ɛnna ɔhene ani gyee kɛse, na ɔkaa sɛ wɔnyi Daniel mfiri amena no mu. Berɛ a wɔyii Daniel firii amena no mu baeɛ no, wɔanhunu sɛ ne ho ati ketewa bi mpo ɛfiri sɛ ɔde ne ho too ne Nyankopɔn so.

Na ɔhene hyɛ maa wɔde mmarima a wɔtotoo Daniel ano no ba bɛtoo wɔn guu agyata amena no mu, wɔne wɔn mma ne wɔn yerenom. Wɔnnya nnuruu amena no ase no, agyata no faa wɔn so, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn nnompe nyinaa mu.
Ɛnna Dario twerɛ kɔmaa aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa hodoɔ a wɔtete asase nyinaa soɔ sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ nnɔɔso mma mo!

Mehyɛ mmara sɛ m’ahennie a medi so tumi nyinaa mu no, obiara ho mpopo na ɔnsuro Daniel Nyankopɔn anim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ne Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ a ɔwɔ hɔ daa, na n’ahennie yɛ deɛ ɛnsɛe da, na ne tumi bɛtena hɔ akɔsi daa.
Ɔno na ɔyie na ɔgyeɛ, na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwanwadeɛ ɔsoro ne asase soɔ; ɔno na ɔgyee Daniel firii agyata nsam.”
Na ɛsii Daniel yi yie wɔ Dario ahennie ase ne Persiani Cyrus ahennie ase.
7: Babilon hene Belsasar afe a ɛdi kan mu no, Daniel soo daeɛ, na ɔnyaa anisoadehunu wɔ ne mpa so. Ɛnna ɔtwerɛɛ daeɛ no kaa nsɛm no mu ade titire.
Daniel kaa sɛ: “Mehunuu m’anisoadehunu mu anadwo, na hwɛ! ɔsoro mframa nnan no bɛhwanyan ɛpo kɛseɛ no so.
Na mmoa akɛseɛ nnan pue firii ɛpo no mu baeɛ; ɛsono oyi, na ɛsono oyi.
“Deɛ ɔdi kan no te sɛ gyata, na ɔwɔ ɔkɔdeɛ ntaban. Mehwɛeɛ ara kɔsii sɛ wɔtutuu ne ntaban no, na wɔmaa no so firii fam, na wɔmaa no gyinaa nan mmienu so sɛ onipa, na wɔmaa no onipa akoma.
“Na hwɛ! aboa foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu a ɔte sɛ sisire nie. Ɔgyinaa hɔ tɔ kɔɔ ɛfa baako so, na mpadeɛ mmiɛnsa hyɛ n’anom wɔ ne se ntam, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Sɔre di nam bebree.’
“Yei akyi no, mehwɛeɛ ara, na hwɛ! aboa foforɔ nie. Ɔte sɛ sebɔ, na ɔwɔ anomaa ntaban nnan wɔ n’akyi. Na aboa no wɔ tiri nnan, na wɔmaa no tumi.

“Yei akyi no, mehwɛeɛ ara anadwo anisoadehunu no mu, na hwɛ! aboa a ɔtɔ so nnan nie. Na ne ho yɛ hu ne nwanwa na ɔwɔ ahoɔden boro so. Ɔwɔ dadeɛ se akɛseɛ. Ɔmemene keka nneɛma mu, de ne nan pɛkyɛɛ nkaeɛ. Ɛsono ɔno na ɛsono mmoa a wɔdii n’anim no nyinaa koraa, na ɔwɔ mmɛn du.
Meredwendwene mmɛn no ho no, hwɛ, abɛn ketewa foforɔ puee ɛnonom ntam, na kane mmɛn no mu mmiɛnsa ase tutuu wɔ n’anim. Na hwɛ, aniwa a ɛte sɛ onipa aniwa ne ano a ɛkeka nsɛnkɛseɛ wɔ abɛn no ho.

“Mehwɛeɛ ara kɔsii sɛ wɔsisii nhennwa, na deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mmerɛ santen bɛtenaa ase. N’atadeɛ yɛ fitaa sɛ sukyerɛmma, na ne tiri nwi hoa te sɛ odwanten nwi fitafita. N’adwa yɛ gyaframa ara nko, na ne ntwahonan yɛ egya a ɛrefram.
Egya te sɛ asubɔnten sene firi n’anim ba. Mpempem som no, na mpem du ahodoɔ mpem du buburugyaa gyinagyina n’anim. Wɔtenaa ase sɛ wɔrebu atɛn, na wɔbuebuee nwoma mu.
“Saa berɛ no, nsɛnkɛseɛ a abɛn no kekaeɛ nti, mehwɛeɛ ara. Mehwɛeɛ ara kɔsii sɛ wɔkum aboa no, na wɔsɛee ne honam, na wɔde maa egya a ɛrefram no.
Na mmoa a aka no nso, wɔgyee wɔn tumi, nanso wɔmaa wɔn berɛ ne dɔn a wɔn nkwa nna nkɔduro.
“Mehwɛeɛ ara, anadwo anisoadehunu no mu, na hwɛ, obi a ɔte sɛ onipa ba nam ɔsoro mununkum mu reba. Na ɔduruu deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mmerɛ santen no nkyɛn, na wɔmaa no bɛn n’anim.
Ɔno na wɔde tumi ne animuonyam ne ahennie maa no sɛ aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa hodoɔ nyinaa nsom no. Ne tumi yɛ daa tumi a ɛrentwam da, na n’ahennie yɛ deɛ wɔrensɛe no da. Anisoadehunu no nkyerɛaseɛ
“Me, Daniel, ɛno nti me honhom botoo me mu, na m'anisoadehunu no haa me.
Metwe bɛn wɔn a wɔgyina hɔ no baako, na mebisaa no yei nyinaa ase; na ɔka kyerɛɛ me, na ɔmaa mehunuu nneɛma no nkyerɛaseɛ sɛ:
“‘Mmoa akɛseɛ yi a wɔyɛ nnan yi yɛ ahemfo baanan a wɔbɛfiri asase soɔ asɔre agyina.
Nanso Ɔsorosoroni no ahotefoɔ bɛfa ahennie no, na wɔanya ahennie no daa daa mmerɛ santen.’

“Ɛnna mepɛɛ sɛ mehunu nokorɛ a ɛfa aboa a ɔtɔ so nnan a ɛsono ɔno wɔn nyinaa mu a ne ho yɛ hu boro soɔ a ne se yɛ dadeɛ na ne mmɔwerɛ yɛ kɔbere a ɔmemene keka nneɛma mu de ne nan pɛkyɛ nkaeɛ no soɔ ho asɛm no ase;
ne afei ne tiri so mmɛn du ne abɛn foforɔ a ɛpueeɛ a mmiɛnsa tutuu wɔ n’anim, abɛn a ɛwɔ aniwa ne ano a ɛkeka nsɛnkɛseɛ na wɔhwɛ a, ɔso sene ne mfɛfoɔ no deɛ.
“Mehwɛeɛ ara, na hwɛ, na saa abɛn no ne ahotefoɔ no redi ako, na ɛtumii wɔn,
kɔsii sɛ Deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ firi mmerɛ santen no baeɛ, na wɔbuu Ɔsorosoroni no ahotefoɔ no bem, na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛsɛ ahotefoɔ sɔ ahennie mu no durui.
“Ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Aboa a ɔtɔ so nnan no bɛyɛ ahennie a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛbɛsɔre asase soɔ, na ɛbɛsono ɛno ahennie a aka nyinaa mu, na ɛbɛmene asase nyinaa atiatia so abubu no asinasini.
Na mmɛn du no, ahennie no ara mu na ahemfo du bɛsɔreɛ, na wɔn akyi no ɔfoforɔ bi bɛsɔre, na ɛbɛsono ɔno ne wɔn a wɔdii kan no, na ɔbɛbrɛ ahemfo mmiɛnsa ase.
Na ɔbɛkeka nsɛm atia Ɔsorosoroni no, na ɔbɛha Ɔsorosoroni no akronkronfoɔ. Na ɔbɛbɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔbɛdane mmerɛ ne mmara, na wɔde akronkronfoɔ no bɛhyɛ ne nsa, ɛberɛ ne mmerɛ ne berɛ fa.
Nanso wɔbɛtena ase abu atɛn, na wɔagye ne nsam tumi, na wɔasɛe no ama wɔasɛe koraa.
“‘Na wɔde ɔsoro nyinaa ase ahemman ne tumi ne kɛseyɛ bɛma Ɔsorosoroni no akronkronfoɔ man no. N'ahennie yɛ daa ahennie, na tumi nyinaa bɛsom no na atie no.
“Ɛha na nsɛm no sie. Na me Daniel deɛ, m’adwene haa me pii, na m’anim sakraeɛ, nanso mede asɛm no siee m’akoma mu.” DANIEL ANISOADEHUNU: ODWENNINI NE ƆPAPO NO
8: Ɔhene Belsasar ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, me Daniel, menyaa anisoadehunu bi, kane deɛ a menyaeɛ no akyi.
Na mehunuu no anisoadehunu no mu sɛ, mewɔ Susan abankɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Elam mantam mu no mu; mehunuu no anisoadehunu no mu sɛ mewɔ Ulai asubɔnten no ho.
Berɛ a memaa m’ani so hwɛeɛ no, hwɛ, na odwennini bi gyina asubɔnten no ano; na ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu. Na mmɛn mmienu no woware, nanso na baako ware sene baako, na deɛ ɛware no na ɛdii akyire firiiɛ.
Mehunuu odwennini no sɛ ɔrepempem kɔ atɔeɛ ne atifi ne anafoɔ, na aboa biara ntumi nnyina n’anim, na obiara nso nni hɔ a ɔtumi gye obi firi ne nsam. Ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔdii akokurokosɛm.
Megu so redwendwene ho no, hwɛ, ɔpapo bi firi atɔeɛ fam baeɛ a ɔnam asase nyinaa ani a ne ho nka fam. Na ɔpapo no wɔ abɛn bi tua n’ani ntam.
Ɔbaeɛ ara bɛduruu odwennini a ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu a mehunuu no sɛ ɔgyina asubɔnten no ano no ho, na ɔde abufuo kɛseɛ tuu mmirika kɔɔ ne so.

Na mehunuu sɛ berɛ a ɔduruu odwennini no nkyɛn no, n’ani beree ne so na ɔpem odwennini no bubuu ne mmɛn mmienu no, na odwennini no annya ahoɔden a ɔde bɛgyina n’anim. Enti ɔtoo no twenee fam tiatiaa ne so, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye no afiri ne nsam.
Ɔpapo no dii akokurokosɛm boroo so. Nanso berɛ a ɔyɛɛ den no, abɛn kɛseɛ no buiɛ, na mmɛn nnan fifiri sii ɛno ananmu kyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔsoro mframa nnan no.
Na abɛn foforɔ firi baako mu baeɛ. Na ɛyɛ abɛn ketewa, na ɛyɛɛ kɛse boroo so, na ɛde n’ani kyerɛɛ anafoɔ ne apueeɛ ne Asase Fɛfɛ no.
Ɛyɛɛ kɛse ara kɔduruu ɔsoro asafo no nkyɛn, na ɛtotoo asafo no bi ne nsoromma no bi bɛguu fam, na ɛtiatiaa wɔn so.
Na ɛdii akokurokosɛm ara kɔduruu asafo no safohene so, na wɔyii daa afɔdeɛ no firii safohene no anim, na wɔtoo ne kronkronbea twenee fam.
Na mmarato nti, wɔde asafo no ne daa afɔdeɛ no hyɛɛ ne nsa, na ɔtoo nokorɛ twenee fam, na ɔyɛɛ adeɛ, na ɛsii no yie.

Na metee sɛ ɔkronkronni bi rekasa, na ɔkronkronni foforɔ bisaa baako a ɔrekasa no sɛ: “Da bɛn na daa afɔdeɛ ne mmarato a ɛma amamfoyɛ ba ne kronkronbea ne asafo no a wɔtiatia wɔn so ho anisoadehunu no bɛkɔ akɔsie?”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Ɛbɛkɔ akɔsi anwummerɛ ne anɔpa mpem mmienu ne ahasa (2,300), ansa na wɔayɛ kronkronbea hɔ yie asi ne dada mu.” Anisoadehunu no nkyerɛaseɛ
Na ɛbaa sɛ, me Daniel, megu so rehwɛ anisoadehunu no na merehwehwɛ sɛ mɛte aseɛ no, mehunui, na hwɛ, obi bɛgyinaa m’anim a wohwɛ no a, ɔte sɛ ɔbarima.
Na metee onipa bi nne firii Ulai asubɔnten no mu, na ɔteaam frɛɛ sɛ: “Gabriel, ma ɔbarima yi nte deɛ wahunu no ase.”
Enti ɔbaa deɛ megyina hɔ. Nanso berɛ a ɔbaeɛ no, mebɔɔ hu, na mede m’anim butuu fam. Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Onipa ba, te aseɛ sɛ anisoadehunu no fa awieeɛ berɛ no ho.”
Berɛ a ɔne me rekasa no, medaa hatee a m’anim butu fam. Enti ɔsɔɔ me mu de megyinaa me nan so bio.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, merema woahunu deɛ ɛbɛba abufuo berɛ no awieeɛ, na ɛfa awieeɛ berɛ a wɔahyɛ no ho.
“Odwennini a wohunuu no a ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu no gyina hɔ ma Media ne Persia ahemfo.
Ɔpapo a ne ho wɔ nwi bebree no nso gyina hɔ ma Greece hene, na abɛn kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ n’ani ntam no gyina hɔ ma ɔhene a ɔdi kan no.
Na deɛ ɛbuiɛ a nnan fifiri sii ananmu no nso, ahennie nnan bɛsɔre ne man mu, nanso wɔn ahoɔden rennuru ne deɛ no.
“Na ɛbɛba sɛ ɛrekɔ wɔn ahennie no awieeɛ a, berɛ a mmaratofoɔ nneyɛɛ aduru ne pɔmpɔn soɔ no, ɔhene tirimuɔdenfoɔ bi a ɔhunu ahuntasɛm mu bɛsɔre.
Ne tumi bɛyɛ den, nanso ɛrenyɛ ɔno ara n’ahoɔden so. Na ɔbɛsɛe adeɛ ama no ayɛ nwanwa, na deɛ ɔbɛyɛ nyinaa bɛsi no yie. Ɔbɛsɛe ahoɔdenfoɔ ne akronkronfoɔ man no nso.

Na n’aniteɛ nti, ɔbɛma nnaadaa akɔ so wɔ ne nsam. N’akoma mu nso, ɔbɛdi akokurokosɛm, na asomdwoeɛ berɛ mu, ɔbɛsɛe nnipa bebree. Na ɔbɛsɔre atia ahene mu hene no, nanso ɔbɛbubu a ɛnyɛ obi nsa na ɛbɛbu no.
“Anwummerɛ  ne anɔpa adehunu a wɔkaa ho asɛm yi yɛ nokorɛ. Na wo nso, sɔ anisoadehunu no ano, ɛfiri sɛ ɛfa daakye nna ho.”
Na me, Daniel, meyɛɛ kagyaa, na meyaree nna kakra. Afei mesɔre kɔyɛɛ ɔhene adwuma no. Nanso deɛ mehunuiɛ no nti, me ho dwirii me, na obiara ante nsɛm no ase.
9: Ahasweros ba Dario a n’ase firi Media a ɔdii Kaldeafoɔ ahemman so hene no afe a ɛdi kan mu no,
me Daniel, mehwehwɛɛ nwoma ahodoɔ no mu wɔ n’ahennie afe a ɛdi kan mu hunuu mfeɛ dodoɔ a Awurade asɛm a ɛbaa odiyifoɔ Yeremia nkyɛn no kyerɛɛ sɛ Yerusalem amamfoyɛ no bɛdie, kyerɛ sɛ mfeɛ aduɔson.
Na mede m’ani sii so sɛ mɛkɔ Awurade Nyankopɔn anim, na mabɔ no mpaeɛ de m’adesrɛ ato n’anim, na madi mmuada afira atweaatam atena nso mu.
Na mefirii aseɛ bɔɔ Awurade, me Nyankopɔn mpaeɛ, na mepaee mu kaa yɛn bɔne sɛ: “O, Awurade  Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ a ne ho yɛ hu a ɔkora apam ne adɔeɛ so ma wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wɔdi ne mmara nsɛm soɔ,
yɛayɛ bɔne na yɛafom, yɛadi amumuyɛsɛm na yɛate atua. Yɛadane afiri wo mmara nsɛm ne w’atemmusɛm ho.
Yɛantie wo nkoa adiyifoɔ a wɔkasaa wo din mu kyerɛɛ yɛn ahemfo, yɛn mmapɔmma ne yɛn agyanom ne asase no so nnipa nyinaa no.

O Awurade, wo na tenenee wɔ woɔ, na yɛn deɛ, animguaseɛ na ɛfata yɛn sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi; ɛfata Yudafoɔ ne Yerusalemfoɔ ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa, wɔn a wɔtete bɛn ha ne wɔn a nokorɛ a wɔanni woɔ nti woabɔ wɔn ahwete nsase nyinaa soɔ no.
“O Awurade, animguaseɛ na ɛfata yɛne yɛn ahemfo, yɛn mmapɔmma ne yɛn agyanom, ɛfiri sɛ yɛayɛ wo bɔne.
Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, wo na mmɔborɔhunu ne fafirie wɔ woɔ, na yɛn na yɛate wo so atua.
Na yɛantie Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn nne annante ne mmara a wonam ne nkoa adiyifoɔ no nsa so de maa yɛn no mu.
Israelfoɔ nyinaa abu wo mmara so; wɔamane, na wɔantie wo nne. Ɛno nti na nnome ne ntanka a wɔatwerɛ no Nyankopɔn akoa Mose mmara no mu no, woahwie agu yɛn soɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ yɛayɛ no bɔne.
Deɛ ɔkaa sɛ wode bɛyɛ yɛne yɛn atemmufoɔ a wɔbuu yɛn atɛn no, wayɛ, ne mmusuo kɛseɛ a ebi mmaa wiase nyinaa pɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛsii Yerusalem no.
Mmusuo yi nyinaa aba yɛn so, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara no mu no, nanso yɛnhwehwɛɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛ yɛbɛsane afiri yɛn amumuyɛ ho, na yɛatie wo nokorɛ.
“Enti na Awurade, de n’ani sii mmusuo no so, na wɔde baa yɛn soɔ no. Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛ tenenee, ne nneyɛɛ a ɔyɛ nyinaa mu, na yɛn deɛ, yɛantie ne nne.
“Na afei, Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, wo a wode nsa a ɛyɛ den yii wo man firii Egypt asase so de gyee din sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ da yi no, yɛayɛ bɔne, yɛadi amumuyɛsɛm.

O Awurade, sɛdeɛ wo tenenee nyinaa teɛ no, yɛsrɛ wo, ma w’abufuo ne w’anibereɛ nnane mfiri wo kuro Yerusalem, wo bepɔ kronkron no so, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn bɔne ne yɛn agyanom mfomsoɔ nti, Yerusalem ne wo man adane ahohoradeɛ ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia nyinaa.
Enti afei, yɛn Nyankopɔn, tie w’akoa mpaebɔ ne ne nkotɔsrɛ, na Awurade, wo nti, ma w’anim nhyerɛn wo kronkronbea a adane amamfo no so.
O me Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso tie. Bue w’ani na hwɛ yɛn amamfoyɛ ne kuro a wo din da soɔ no. Ɛnyɛ yɛn tenenee so nti na yɛde yɛn nkotɔsrɛ aba w’anim, na mmom wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe no ntira.
O Awurade, tie. O Awurade, fa firi yɛn. O Awurade, yɛ aso na keka wo ho. Me Nyankopɔn, wo din nti, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase, ɛfiri sɛ wo din na ɛda wo kuro ne wo man soɔ.” Gabriel kyerɛ nkɔmhyɛ no ase
Berɛ a megu so rekasa bɔ mpaeɛ na mereka me bɔne ne me man Israel bɔne na mede me Nyankopɔn bepɔ kronkron ho adesrɛ reto Awurade me Nyankopɔn anim no,
aane, berɛ a megu so rekasa bɔ mpaeɛ no, hwɛ, ɔbarima Gabriel a mehunuu no anisoadehunu a ɛdi kan no mu no, tuu ntɛmntɛm baa me nkyɛn anwummerɛ afɔrebɔ berɛ no mu.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na ɔne me kasaa sɛ: “O Daniel, mafiri aba sɛ merebɛma woanya nhunumu ne nteaseɛ.
Wo nkotɔsrɛ mfitiaseɛ no, menyaa nkra, na maba sɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo, ɛfiri sɛ wɔdɔ wo paa. Enti dwendwene asɛm no ho, na te deɛ woahunu no ase.

“Wɔahyɛ adapɛn aduɔson wɔ wo man ne wo kuro kronkron no ho sɛ mmarato to ntwa na bɔne mmra awieeɛ, na wɔmpata amumuyɛ, na wɔmfa daa tenenee mmra, na wɔmfa nsɔano ntim anisoadehunu ne adiyisɛm ano, na wɔnsra Kronkron mu Kronkronbea hɔ.

Na hunu na nya nhunumu sɛ ɛfiri asɛm a ɛse wɔnsane nkyekyere Yerusalem nsi n’ananmu no so kɔsi sɛ Mesia, Ɔberempɔn no, bɛba no bɛyɛ adapɛn nson ne adapɛn aduosia mmienu. Wɔbɛsane akyekyere, mmorɔno ne afasuo, nanso wɔbɛyɛ no ahohiahia berɛ mu.

“Adapɛn aduosia mmienu no akyi no, wɔbɛtwa Mesia no afiri hɔ, na ɛrenka no hwee. “Na ɔberempɔn a ɔbɛba no nkurɔfoɔ bɛsɛe kuro no ne kronkronbea no. N’awieeɛ bɛba sɛ nsuyire. Akodie bɛkɔ so akɔsi sɛ awieeɛ no bɛduro; deɛ wɔahyɛ ato hɔ ne amamfoyɛ.

“Na ɔne nnipa bebree bɛyɛ apam a emu yɛ den dapɛn baako, na ɛduru dapɛn no mfimfini a, ɔbɛma afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛdema agyae. “Akyiwadeɛ ntaban so na deɛ ɔde amamfoyɛ bɛba no bɛfa aba; deɛ wɔahyɛ ato hɔ no bɛhwie agu amamfo no so akɔsi sɛ ɔsɛeɛ pasaa no bɛba.”
10: Persia hene Cyrus afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, wɔyii asɛm bi adi kyerɛɛ Daniel a wɔtoo ne din Beltesasar no. Na asɛm no yɛ nokorɛ, na na ɛfa ɛko kɛseɛ bi ho. Ɔtee asɛm no ase, na ɔnyaa deɛ ɔhunuiɛ no mu nhunumu.
Saa nna no mu no, me, Daniel, me werɛ hoo nnawɔtwe mmiɛnsa.
Manni aduane dɛɛdɛ biara, na nam ne nsa anka m’ano, na mansra koraa kɔsii adapɛn mmiɛnsa no awieeɛ.
Na bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan no, na mewɔ asu kɛseɛ Hidekel a ɛne Tigris ano.
Memaa m’ani so hwɛeɛ, na mehunuu ɔbarima bi a ɔfira nwera a Ufas sika kɔkɔɔ bɔ n’asene.
Na ne nipadua te sɛ sikabereɛboɔ, na n’anim te sɛ anyinam, na n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa. Na n’abasa ne ne nan te sɛ kɔbere a wɔatwi ho kokwakokwa, na ne kasa nnyegyeeɛ te sɛ nnipadɔm nne.
Na me Daniel, me nko ara na mehunuu anisoadeɛ no. Na mmarima a wɔka me ho no deɛ, wɔanhunu adeɛ no. Nanso ehu kɛseɛ kaa wɔn maa wɔdwane kɔhuntaeɛ.
Me deɛ, ɛkaa me nko ara, na mehunuu anisoadeɛ kɛseɛ yi. Na ahoɔden biara anka me mu, na m’ahoɔfɛ dane yɛɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ, na mannya ahoɔden biara.
Nanso metee ne nsɛm nne no. Na metee ne nsɛm nne no, mehwee ase daa hatee a m’anim butu fam.
Na hwɛ! Obi de ne nsa kaa me, na ɔpusupusuu me maa mesɔre de me nkotodwe ne me nsa sisii fam.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “O Daniel, ɔbarima a wɔdɔ wo paa, te nsɛm a mereka kyerɛ woɔ no ase na sɔre gyina wo nan so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.” Berɛ a ɔkaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ me no, mede ahopopoɔ sɔre gyinaa hɔ.
Na ɔsane ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Nsuro, Daniel, ɛfiri sɛ ɛfiri da a wode w’akoma sii so sɛ wobɛte aseɛ, na wobrɛɛ wo ho ase wo Nyankopɔn anim no, wɔate wo nsɛm no, na wo nsɛm no nti na maba.
Nanso Persia ahemman no bapɔmma bɛgyinaa hɔ sii me kwan nnafua aduonu baako, na hwɛ! Mikael, asafohene atitire no baako bɛboaa me, na metenaa hɔ, Persia ahemfo no nkyɛn.
Na maba sɛ merebɛma woahunu deɛ ɛbɛto wo man wɔ nna a ɛdi akyire no mu, ɛfiri sɛ anisoadehunu no fa daakye nna ho.”
Berɛ a ɔne me reka nsɛm yi no, na mede m’anim asi fam, na na matɔre mum.
Na hwɛ! Ntɛm ara obi a ɔte sɛ onipa ba, bɛkaa m’anofafa, na mebuee m’ano kasaeɛ, na meka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔgyina m’anim no sɛ: “Me wura, anisoadehunu no ama masensene amono mu, na ahoɔden biara nni me mu.
Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na me wura akoa atumi ne me wura akasa? Na me deɛ, seesei ahoɔden biara nni me mu, na home biara nso nni me mu.”
Afei deɛ ɔte sɛ onipa ba no de ne nsa kaa me bio, na ɔhyɛɛ me den.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “O Ɔbarima a wɔdɔ wo paa, nsuro. Asomdwoeɛ nka wo. Yɛ den, aane, yɛ den.” Berɛ a ɔne me kasaeɛ no, ɛhɔ ara na menyaa ahoɔden na mekaa sɛ: “Me wura, kasa, ɛfiri sɛ woahyɛ me den.”
Enti ɔsane ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Wonim deɛ enti a maba wo nkyɛn no? Afei mɛsan ne Persia bapɔmma no akɔko. Sɛ merekɔ a, hwɛ! Greece bapɔmma no nso bɛba.
Nanso mɛka nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nokorɛ nwoma no mu akyerɛ wo, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔgyina m’akyi yei mu sɛ mo bapɔmma Mikael. Ɔbɔfoɔ no abakɔsɛm ho nkɔmhyɛ
11: “Me deɛ, Mediani Dario afe a ɛdi kan mu no, megyinaa sɛ meresɔ ne mu na mahyɛ no den.

Na afei mereka nokwasɛm akyerɛ wo: “Hwɛ! ahemfo mmiɛnsa foforɔ bɛsɔre agyina wɔ Persia, na deɛ ɔtɔ so nnan no bɛnya ahonyadeɛ pii asene wɔn a wɔaka nyinaa. Na sɛ ɔnya n’ahonyadeɛ no mu ahoɔden a, ɔbɛhwanyan biribiara atia Greece ahemman.
“Na ɔhenkɛseɛ bi bɛsɔre, na ɔbɛdi tumi akɔ akyiri na wayɛ deɛ ɔpɛ.

Sɛ ɔnya sɔre gyina a, n’ahennie no mu bɛbubu na wɔbɛkyekyɛ mu akɔ ɔsoro mframa nnan no fam, nanso ɛrenkɔdi n’asefoɔ nsam, na ɛrenyɛ sɛ tumi a ɔde dii adeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛtutu n’ahennie ase ama afoforɔ, na ɛnyɛ yeinom.
“Bio anafoɔ fam hene no bɛyɛ den, nanso ne mmapɔmma mu baako bɛyɛ den akyɛne no, na wanya tumi; na ne tumi bɛyɛ tumi kɛseɛ.

“Mfeɛ bi akyi no, wɔbɛfefa wɔn ho ayɔnkoɔ, na anafoɔ fam hene no babaa bɛba atifi fam hene no nkyɛn na wɔayɛ apam. Nanso ɔbaa no ntumi nkura ne basa ahoɔden no mu; na ɔhene no ne ne basa nso rennyina, na wɔbɛyi ɔbaa no ne wɔn a wɔde no baeɛ, ne deɛ ɔwoo no, ne deɛ ɔmaa no yɛɛ den saa mmerɛ no ama.
Nanso obi bɛsɔre afiri ɔbaa no nhini mu duforɔ mu abɛsi n’ananmu, na ɔde asraafoɔdɔm bɛba abɛto ahyɛ atifi fam hene no abankɛseɛ so, na ɔbɛsɔre atia wɔn adi wɔn so.
Afei nso ɔde wɔn anyame ahoni, wɔn dwetɛ ne sika nnwinneɛ afɛfɛ, ne nnommum bɛkɔ Egypt. Na ɔbɛtwe ne ho afiri atifi fam hene no ho mfeɛ dodoɔ bi.
“Na atifi fam hene no bɛba anafoɔ fam hene no ahennie mu deɛ, nanso ɔbɛsane akɔ n’asase so.
“Ne mma ani bɛbere na wɔaboaboa asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ paa ano. Na ɔbaako bɛba sɛ nsuo abɛyiri afa asase no so. Nanso ɔbɛsan akɔ, adi ako akɔduru n’abankɛseɛ ho.
“Na anafoɔ fam hene no ani bɛbere na wafiri adi ne no akɔko, kyerɛ sɛ, ɔne atifi fam hene no bɛko. Na ɔbɛma dɔm kɛseɛ asɔre, na wɔde dɔm kɛseɛ no bɛhyɛ baako no nsa, kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi nkoguo.
Sɛ wɔsoa asraafoɔdɔm no kɔ a, n’akoma bɛma ne ho so, na ɔbɛma mpem du du atotɔ; nanso ɔrenni nkonim.
“Na atifi fam hene no bɛsane aba, na ɔbɛboaboa dɔm kɛseɛ a ɛsene kane deɛ no ano; mmerɛ no awieeɛ, mfeɛ bi akyi no, ɔbɛba, na ɔde asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ ne nneɛma pii na ɛbɛba.
Saa mmerɛ no, nnipa bebree bɛsɔre atia anafoɔ fam hene no. “Wo man mu atuatefoɔ nso bɛdi akyire sɛ wɔbɛma anisoadehunu no aba mu, nanso wɔbɛhwehwe ase.
“Enti atifi fam hene no bɛba na wabɛhɔre dosie na wafa kuro a ɛyɛ den. Na anafoɔ fam abasa rentumi nnyina, n'asraafoɔdɔm a wayi wɔn no mpo rennya ahoɔden a wɔde bɛgyina.
Na deɛ ɔbɛba ne soɔ no bɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛtumi agyina n’anim. Ɔbɛgyina asase Fɛfɛ no so, na ɔde ɔsɛeɛ bɛhyɛ ne nsam aba.
Ɔde n’ani bɛsi so sɛ ɔde n’ahennie nyinaa mu ahoɔden bɛba, na ɔne no bɛyɛ apam, na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ biara. Na wɔde mmaa babaa bɛma no sɛ ɔnsɛe no. Nanso rennyina, na ɛrenyɛ no mfasoɔ biara.
Yei akyi no ɔbɛsane de n’ani akyerɛ mpoano nsase so na wafa pii. Nanso ɔhene bi bɛma no agyae ahohora no bɔ, na mpo wadane ahohora no agu ɔno ara ne so.
Afei ɔde n’ani bɛkyerɛ n’asase so, abankɛseɛ, na ɔbɛsunti ahwe ase, na wɔrenhu no.
“Na obi bɛsɔre asi n’ananmu a ɔbɛma togyeni abɛfa ahennie fɛfɛ no mu, na nna kakraa bi no, wɔbɛsɛe no, nanso ɛrenyɛ abufuo anaa akodie mu.
“Na ɔhohorani bi bɛsɔre asi n’ananmu a wɔbɛbu no animtia, na wɔremfa ahennie no mu animuonyam mma no; nanso ɔbɛba asomdwoeɛ berɛ mu, na ɔde adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm bɛgye ahennie no.
Na wɔde abasa a ɛte sɛ nsuyire bɛpia wɔn akɔ na wɔabubu wɔn ne apam berempɔn no nso wɔ n’anim.
Nanso ɔne no pam wie a, ɔbɛtwa no nkontompo, na ɔbɛsɔre aba, na ɔnam dɔm ketewa bi so abɛdi nim.

Asomdwoeɛ berɛ mu na ɔbɛkɔ ahemman no mu baabi a ɛyɛ, na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ n’agyanom ne ne nananom anyɛ bi da. Ɔbɛpete afomdeɛ ne asadeɛ ne ahodeɛ ama wɔn, na ɔbɛbɔ baabi a wɔabɔ ho ban ho pɔ bɔne, nanso ɛbɛkɔ akɔsi berɛ bi.

“Ɔde asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ bɛkanyan ne tumi ne n’akoma atia anafoɔ fam hene no; na anafoɔ fam hene no nso ani bɛbere, na ɔde asraafoɔdɔm kɛseɛ a wɔyɛ den boro soɔ bɛba abɛko. Nanso ɔrentumi nnyina, ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ne ho pɔ bɔne.
Aane, wɔn a wɔne no to nsa didie na wɔbɛsɛe no. “N’asraafoɔdɔm nso, wɔbɛpia wɔn akɔ, na nnipa pii bɛtotɔ.
“Na ahemfo mmienu yi akoma bɛdane akɔ bɔne ho na wɔatena ɛpono baako ho akeka atorosɛm. Nanso ne nyinaa bɛyɛ kwa, ɛfiri sɛ awieeɛ no bɛba berɛ a wɔahyɛ no.
“Na atifi hene no de ahodeɛ kɛseɛ bɛsane akɔ n’asase so, nanso n’ani bɛsa apam kronkron no ara, na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ na wasane akɔ n’asase so.
“Berɛ a wɔahyɛ no mu, ɔbɛsane aba anafoɔ fam, nanso akyire deɛ no renyɛ sɛ kane deɛ no.
Na Cyprus ahyɛn bɛba ne so, enti n’akoma bɛtu na wasane akɔ, na ne bo bɛfu atia apam kronkron no na wasɛe no. Ɔbɛsan akɔ, na ɔde n’ani bɛsi wɔn a wɔagya apam kronkron no so.
Na ɔde asraafoɔ bɛsisi hɔ; na wɔagu kronkronbea ne aban no ho fi, na wɔayi daa afɔdeɛ no afiri hɔ. “Na wɔde akyiwadeɛ a ɛbɔ man no asi hɔ.
“Na wɔn a wɔbɔ apam no ho mmusuo no, ɔde kasadɛ bɛtwetwe wɔn ama wɔawae. Na wɔn a wɔnim wɔn Nyankopɔn no bɛhyɛ wɔn ho den, na wɔayɛ adeɛ.
Na ɔman no mu wɔn a wɔnim de no bɛma nnipa bebree anya nhunumu, nanso wɔbɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano ne ogyaframa mu, nnommumfa ne ɛfomfa mu, nna bi.
Na sɛ wɔtotɔ saa a, wɔde mmoa ketewaa bi na ɛbɛboa wɔn, na nnipa bebree de adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm bɛbata wɔn ho.
Na mmadwemma no bi bɛtotɔ na wɔde ayi wɔn mu fi de ate wɔn ho ahoa wɔn ho fitaa akɔsi awieeɛ berɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛberɛ a wɔahyɛ no bɛba ara.

“Afei ɔhene no bɛyɛ deɛ ɔno ara pɛ, na ɔbɛma ne ho so ahyɛ ne ho animuonyam asene onyame biara; ɔbɛka nsɛm akɛseɛ atia anyame mu Nyankopɔn no. Na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ akɔsi sɛ abufuo no bɛba awieeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wɔahyɛ no bɛba mu.
Ɔremmu n’agyanom Nyankopɔn no; ɔremmu mmaa anigyedeɛ ne onyame foforɔ biara, na ɔbɛma ne ho so asene obiara.
Na ɔbɛdi abandenden nyame no ni asi wɔn ananmu; onyame a n’agyanom nnim no na ɔde sika ne dwetɛ ne aboɔden aboɔ ne afɛfɛdeɛ bɛdi no ni.
Na ɔbɛdi ananafoɔ nyame bi akyi ayɛ deɛ ɔpɛ atia abandenden mu abandenden no. Obiara a ɔbɛgye no atom no, ɔbɛhyɛ no animuonyam pii, na wama no adi nnipa pii so, na wakyɛ asase de ayɛ akatua.

“Awieeɛ berɛ no mu no, anafoɔ fam hene no ne no bɛdi apiapia, na atifi fam hene no de nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ ne po so ahyɛn bɛba ne so sɛ ahum; na ɔbɛba abɛsene afa nsase no so sɛ nsuo a ayiri asram soɔ.
Na ɔbɛkɔ asase Fɛfɛ no nso so, na aman bebree bɛtotɔ. Na yeinom deɛ, wɔbɛfiri ne nsam afi, Edom ne Moab ne Ammon mma mu atitire no.
Na ɔbɛtene ne nsa nsase no so, na Egypt asase deɛ, ɛremfiri mu mfi.
Ɔbɛdi sika ne dwetɛ akoradeɛ ne Egypt afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa so tumi. Na Libiafoɔ ne Etiopiafoɔ bɛdi n’anammɔn akyi.
“Nanso ɔbɛtete amanneɛbɔ bi afiri apueeɛ ne atifi fam, na ɛbɛha no, na ɔde abufuo kɛseɛ bɛkɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsɛe nnipa pii na watɔre wɔn ase.
Na ɔde n’ahemfie ntomadan bɛsi ɛpo kɛseɛ no ne asase Fɛfɛ no bepɔ kronkron no ntam, na ɔbɛba ara abɛduru n’awieeɛ, nanso ɔrennya ɔboafoɔ biara.
12: “Saa berɛ no, Mikael, ɔsafohene kɛseɛ a ɔgyina hɔ ma wo man mma no bɛsɔre agyina. Na ahohiahia a ɛfiri berɛ a ɔman baeɛ ebi mmaa da bɛba. Saa berɛ no, wo manfoɔ bɛnya wɔn tiri adidi mu, obiara a wɔatwerɛ ne din wɔ nwoma no mu no.
Na wɔn a wɔdeda fam dɔteɛ mu no bebree bɛnyane; ebinom bɛkɔ daa nkwa mu, na ebinom nso ayɛ ahohoradeɛ ne daa ahiyie mu.
“Na mmadwemma no bɛhyerɛn sɛdeɛ ewiem hyerɛn, na wɔn a wɔdane nnipa bebree kɔ tenenee mu no bɛyɛ sɛ nsoromma daa daa.
“Na wo Daniel, to nsɛm no mu na sɔ nwoma no ano kɔsi awieeɛ berɛ no. Nnipa bebree bɛdwane adi akɔneaba, na nimdeɛ adɔɔso.”
Na me, Daniel, mehwɛeɛ, na hwɛ, na mmarima foforɔ mmienu gyinagyina hɔ. Baako gyina asubɔnten no ano ha na baako nso gyina asubɔnten no ano ha.
Na baako bisaa ɔbarima a ɔfira nwera a ɔwɔ asubɔnten no atifi no sɛ: “Da bɛn na anwanwadeɛ no awieeɛ bɛkɔ akɔduro?”

Na metee ɔbarima a ɔfira nwera a ɔwɔ asubɔnten no nsuo soɔ no nne, na ɔmaa ne nsa nifa ne ne nsa benkum so kyerɛɛ ɔsoro, na ɔkaa deɛ ɔte ase daa daa no ntam sɛ: “Ɛbɛkɔ akɔduru berɛ, mmerɛ ne berɛ fa. Na sɛ wɔsɛe ɔman kronkron no ahoɔden wie ara pɛ a, yeinom nyinaa bɛba awieeɛ.”
Na meteeɛ, nanso mante aseɛ, enti mebisaa sɛ: “Me wura, nneɛma yi awieeɛ bɛyɛ sɛn?”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Daniel, wo deɛ, kɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔato nsɛm no mu asɔ ano de rekɔsi awieeɛ berɛ no.
Wɔbɛte nnipa bebree ho na wɔayɛ fitaa, na wɔayiyi wɔn mu fi. Na abɔnefoɔ bɛkɔ so ara adi asɛmmɔne, na abɔnefoɔ nyinaa rente aseɛ, na mmom mmadwemma na wɔbɛte aseɛ.
“Na ɛfiri berɛ a wɔbɛyi daa afɔdeɛ na wɔde akyiwadeɛ a ɛbɔ ɔman asi hɔ no yɛ nna apem ahanu aduɔkron (1,290).
“Nhyira ne deɛ ɔtwɛn kɔduru nna apem ahasa aduasa nnum no soɔ (1,335).
“Na wo deɛ, kɔ kɔduru awieeɛ; wobɛhome, na woasɔre abɛnya wo kyɛfa, nna a ɛdi akyire no mu.”

1: Yei ne nsɛm a Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa ɛserɛ no so wɔ Yordan mpɔtamu. Yei ne serɛ a ɛwɔ Suf anim, wɔ Paran, Tofel, Laban, Haserot ne Disahab ntam.
Ɛfiri Horeb kɔfa Bepɔ Seir ho kɔ Kades-Barnea no yɛ nna dubaako kwan.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so aduanan, bosome a ɛtɔ so dubaako no da a ɛdi kan no, Mose kaa deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no no nyinaa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no.
Kum a wɔkum Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔte Hesbon ne Basan hene Og a ɔte Astarot wɔ Edrei no akyi.
Mose firii aseɛ kyerɛkyerɛɛ mmara yi mu wɔ Yordan mpɔtamu wɔ Moab asase so sɛ:
“Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ yɛn Horeb sɛ, ‘Moatena bepɔ yi so akyɛ.
Monnane mo ho nkɔ Amorifoɔ bepɔ so ne mmeammea a ɛbembɛn Araba, mmepɔ so ne Sefela ne Negeb ne mpoano, Kanaanfoɔ asase so, ne Lebanon, nkɔsi Asubɔntene Eufrate ho.
Monhwɛ, asase a mede ama mo no da mo anim. Monkɔfa asase a Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔne wɔn asefoɔ a wɔbɛdi wɔn akyi aba no.’
“Na meka kyerɛɛ mo saa berɛ no sɛ, ‘Me nko ara mentumi nkura mo.
Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ama moadɔɔso, na nnɛ mo dodoɔ te sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.
Awurade mo agyanom Nyankopɔn no mma monnɔɔso mmɔho apem, na ɔnhyira mo sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ mo bɔ no.
Mɛyɛ dɛn na me nko ara masoa mo nnesoa duruduro ne mo ham yi?
Monyi mo mmusua mu mmarima anyansafoɔ a wɔn ani da hɔ na wɔwɔ suahunu, na memfa wɔn nsisi mo so.’
Ɛnna moka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Deɛ woaka sɛ yɛnyɛ no yɛ ne kwan so.’

Enti meyii wɔn a wɔdeda mo mmusua ano, mmarima anyansafoɔ a wɔwɔ suahunu, yɛɛ wɔn mpanimfoɔ de wɔn tuatuaa nnipa apem biara ano, ɔha biara ano, aduonum biara ano, ne du biara ano, na meyii mo mmusua so ahwɛfoɔ.
“Na meka kyerɛɛ mo atemmufoɔ no saa berɛ no sɛ, ‘Sɛ moredi mo nuanom ntam asɛm a, mommu atɛntenenee obi ne ne nua anaa ɔne ne hɔhoɔ ntam.
Monnhwɛ nnipa anim atemmuo mu. Montie deɛ ɔsua sɛdeɛ motie deɛ ɔso no ara. Monnsuro onipa anim, na Onyankopɔn na ɔbu atɛn. Na sɛ asɛm a emu yɛ duro bi sɔre a, momfa mmrɛ me na menni.’
Na saa berɛ no mekyɛɛ mo deɛ monyɛ nyinaa.
“Na yɛtu firii Horeb de yɛn ani kyerɛɛ serɛ kɛseɛ a ɛso yɛ hu a mohunuiɛ nyinaa so, na yɛfaa Amorifoɔ bepɔ kwan so, sɛdeɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ yɛn no, na yɛduruu Kades-Barnea.
Na meka kyerɛɛ mo sɛ, ‘Moaba Amorifoɔ bepɔ a Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de ama yɛn no ho.
Hwɛ, Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de asase no ama mo, enti monkɔfa sɛdeɛ Awurade mo agyanom Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ mo no. Monnsuro, na mommmɔ hu.’
“Na mo nyinaa mobaa me nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ, ‘Ma yɛnsoma mmarima nni yɛn kan nkɔhwɛ asase no na wɔmmɛkyerɛ yɛn kwan a yɛbɛfa soɔ ne nkuro a yɛbɛkɔ soɔ.’
Na mehunuu sɛ ɛyɛ asɛmpa, enti meyii mmarima dumienu, abusuakuo biara mu nipa baako.
Na wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛɛ bepɔ no so kɔduruu Eskol subɔn ho, na wɔhwɛɛ sɛdeɛ asase no teɛ.
Na wɔde asase no so aba no bi kura de siane brɛɛ yɛn. Na wɔbɔɔ yɛn amanneɛ sɛ, ‘Asase a Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de ama yɛn no yɛ.’
Nanso moampɛ sɛ mokɔ asase no soɔ, na motee atua tiaa Awurade mo Nyankopɔn anom asɛm.
Na monwiinwii mo ntomadan mu sɛ, ‘Awurade tane yɛn nti na wayi yɛn afiri Egypt asase so de yɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifoɔ nsa sɛ wɔntɔre yɛn ase no.
Ɛhe koraa na yɛrekorɔ? Yɛn nuanom abɛtu yɛn akoma sɛ: “Asase no sofoɔ soso woware sene yɛn, na wɔwɔ nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛho aban duru soro, na yɛhunuu Anakim mma no nso wɔ hɔ.”’
“Ɛnna meka kyerɛɛ mo sɛ, ‘Mommma mo akoma nntu, na monnsuro wɔn.
Na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn a ɔdi mo anim no, ɔbɛko ama mo sɛdeɛ mo ara mohunuu deɛ ɔyɛ maa mo Egypt no,
ne serɛ no so nso, berɛ a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de mo bɔɔ ne bo sɛdeɛ ɔbarima de ne ba bɔ ne bo, na ɔde mo twaa kwan baa ha no.’
Na deɛ mekaeɛ nyinaa akyi no, moannye Awurade mo Nyankopɔn anni.
Nanso ɔno na ɔdii mo anim kɔhwɛɛ baabi a mobɛtena. Sɛ ɛduru anadwo a ɔnam gya so kyerɛ mo kwan, na awia nso ɔnam mununkum so.
“Na Awurade tee deɛ mokaeɛ nyinaa. Enti ne bo fuiɛ na ɔkaa ntam sɛ,
‘Ampa ara, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bɔne yi mu barima baako mpo renhunu asase pa a mekaa mo agyanom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no,
gye Yefune ba Kaleb. Ɔno na ɔbɛhunu, na mede asase a ɔde ne nan sii soɔ no bɛma ɔne ne mma, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde n’akoma nyinaa adi Awurade akyi.
Mo nti, Awurade bo fuu me mpo, na ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Wo nso worenkɔ hɔ.
Nun ba Yosua a ɔgyina w’anim yi na ɔbɛkorɔ.’ Ɔno na hyɛ no den, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔbɛma Israelfoɔ afa asase no.
Na mo mma nketewa a ɛnnɛ wɔnnim papa ne bɔne a mokaa sɛ: “Asase no sofoɔ bɛfa wɔn!” no, wɔn na wɔbɛkɔ hɔ, na mede asase no bɛma wɔn sɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ.
Na mo deɛ, monnane mo ho nkɔfa Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho nkɔ serɛ no so.’
“Ɛnna moka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Yɛayɛ bɔne atia Awurade. Na yɛbɛkɔ akɔko sɛdeɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn ahyɛ yɛn no!’ Enti mo nyinaa mofaa mo akodeɛ hyɛɛ mo ho susuu sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ mobɛkɔ bepɔ no so.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monhwɛ na moamforo ankɔko na moanni nkoguo mo atamfo anim, ɛfiri sɛ menka mo ho.”’
Na me ne mo kasaeɛ, nanso moantie me na mode abufuo twi faa Awurade so sɛ morekɔ bepɔ no so.
Ɛnna Amorifoɔ a wɔte bepɔ no soɔ no baa mo soɔ na wɔtaa mo sɛ nwowa, na wɔbɔɔ mo hwete firii Seir kɔduruu Horma.
Na mosan mo akyi bɛsu guu Awurade so, nanso Awurade antie mo na wanyɛ aso amma mo.
Enti motenaa Kades dii nna pii, sedeɛ nna a mode tenaa hɔ teɛ no. Wɔne Edomfoɔ, Moabfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ nnko
2: “Ɛnna yɛdanee yɛn ho kɔfaa Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho kɔɔ serɛ so, sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me no, na yɛde nna pii kyinkyinii Bepɔ Seir ho.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ,
‘Moakyinkyini bepɔ yi ho akyɛ. Monnane mo ani nkyerɛ atifi fam.
Na ka kyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Morekɔfa mo nuanom Esau asefoɔ a wɔte Seir no hyeɛ so. Sɛ wɔhu mo a, ehu bɛka wɔn, enti monhwɛ mo ho yie paa.
Monhwɛ na mo ne wɔn anni aperepereɛ, na meremma mo wɔn asase no anammɔn baako mpo, ɛfiri sɛ mede Bepɔ Seir ama Esau sɛ ɔntena so.
Aduane a mobɛdie biara momfa sika ntɔ mfiri wɔn hɔ, na nsuo a mobɛnom nso momfa sika ntɔ mfiri wɔn hɔ.
Na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyira mo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa so. Ɔnim sɛdeɛ moanante serɛ kɛseɛ yi soɔ. Awurade mo Nyankopɔn adi mo akyi mfeɛ aduanan yi nyinaa, na hwee nhiaa mo.”’
Enti yɛtwaa yɛn nuanom Esau asefoɔ a wɔte Seir no ho, na yɛtwaa Araba ne Elat ne Esion-Geber danee yɛn ho de yɛn ani kyerɛɛ Moab serɛ so kwan so.
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Monteetee Moab na mo ne wɔn nnko, na meremma mo wɔn asase no bi ntena so, ɛfiri sɛ mede Ar ama Lot mma sɛ wɔntena so.
Berɛ bi na Emimfoɔ a wɔn ho yɛ den na wɔdɔɔso na wɔwoware te sɛ Anakimfoɔ no na na wɔte soɔ.
