Na Refaimfoɔ nso te sɛ Anakimfoɔ no, na na Moabfoɔ frɛ wɔn Emimfoɔ.
Na berɛ bi na Horifoɔ nso te Seir, na Esau mma no tuu wɔn tɔree wɔn ase, na wɔfaa wɔn asase no tenaa so, sɛdeɛ Israel nso bɛfaa asase a ɛyɛ wɔn wɔn agyapadeɛ a Awurade de maa wɔn no.
Afei monsɔre nkɔtwa Sered subɔn no.’ Enti yɛkɔtwaa Sered subɔn no.

Nna dodoɔ a yɛde nante firii Kades-Barnea kɔsii sɛ yɛtwaa Sered subɔn no si mfeɛ aduasa nwɔtwe, kɔsii sɛ saa berɛ no sofoɔ mmarima a wɔbɛtumi akɔ ko no nyinaa wiee sa firii nsraban no mu, sɛdeɛ Awurade kaa wɔn ntam no.
Na Awurade nsa da wɔn so na ɔmaa wɔn ho hiahiaa wɔn kɔsii sɛ saafoɔ no sa firii dɔm no mu.
“Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a mmarima a wɔbɛtumi akɔ ko no nyinaa wuwu maa wɔn ase tɔre firii ɔman no mu no,
Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ,
‘Ɛnnɛ worebɛtwam afa Moab hyeɛ Ar so.
Na sɛ mobɛn Ammonfoɔ a, nhiahia wɔn na mo ne wɔn nnni aperepereɛ, na meremma mo Ammonfoɔ asase no bi ntena so, ɛfiri sɛ mede ama Lot mma sɛ wɔntena so.
Na ɛyɛ Refaimfoɔ asase. Berɛ bi na Refaimfoɔ na wɔte soɔ, na na Ammonfoɔ frɛ wɔn Samsumim.
Wɔyɛ ɔman a na wɔn ho yɛ den na wɔdɔɔso na wɔwoware sɛ Anakimfoɔ. Na Awurade sɛee wɔn firii wɔn anim, enti wɔtuu wɔn faa wɔn asase no tenaa so.
Saa ara na ɔyɛ maa Esau asefoɔ a na wɔte Seir no. Ɔsɛee Horifoɔ firii wɔn anim na ɔmaa wɔtuu wɔn faa wɔn asase no tenaa so de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Awimfoɔ a na wɔte Gasa no deɛ, Kaftorimfoɔ a wɔfiri Kaftor no sɛee wɔn faa wɔn asase tenaa so. Wɔdi Amorifoɔ hene Sihon so
“‘Monsɔre nkɔtwa Arnon subɔn no. Hwɛ, mede Hesbon hene Sihon a ɔyɛ Amorini no ahyɛ mo nsa. Enti momfiri aseɛ mfa n’asase na mo ne no nko.
Ɛnnɛ da yi mɛma aman a wɔwɔ ɔsoro aseɛ a wɔbɛte mo nka nyinaa abɔ hu na wɔasuro mo. Na mo nti, wɔn ho bɛpopo na wɔn akoma atu mo anim.’
“Na metuu abɔfoɔ firii Kedemot serɛ so sɛ wɔnkɔka asomdwoeɛsɛm nkyerɛ Hesbon hene Sihon sɛ,
‘Ma mentwam mfa w’asase so. Kwan tempɔn no ara so na mɛfa, na meremmane nifa anaa benkum.
Aduane a wobɛtɔn ama me na mɛdie, na nsuo a wobɛtɔn ama me na mɛnom. Deɛ meresrɛ ara ne baabi a mede me nan bɛtia,
sɛdeɛ Esau asefoɔ a wɔte Seir ne Moabfoɔ a wɔte Ar yɛɛ me no, akɔsi sɛ mɛtwa Yordan akɔ asase a Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de ama yɛn no soɔ.’
Nanso Hesbon hene Sihon amma yɛamfa n’asase so, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn maa no senee ne kɔn na ɔpirim n’akoma, na ama no de no ahyɛ mo nsa sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ da yi.
“Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Hwɛ, mafiri aseɛ redane Sihon ne n’asase ama wo, enti kɔfa n’asase no.’
Ɛnna Sihon firi bɛhyiaa yɛn, ɔno ne ne man nyinaa, sɛ ɔne yɛn rebɛko wɔ Yahas.
Na Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de no hyɛɛ yɛn nsa, na yɛdii ɔne ne mma ne ne manfoɔ nyinaa so nkonim.
Na yɛko faa ne nkuro nyinaa sɛee no; na yɛkunkum emu mmarima ne mmaa ne mmɔfra nyinaa. Yɛannya onipa baako mpo.
Nyɛmmoa ne asadeɛ foforɔ a yɛnyaa no nkuro no mu na yɛfaeɛ.
Ɛfiri Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon subɔn no ho ne kuro a ɛwɔ bɔn mu no kɔsi Gilead no, na kuro biara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ den sene yɛn. Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de ne nyinaa hyɛɛ yɛn nsa.
Nanso Ammonfoɔ asase no, Yabok subɔn no ho nyinaa, ne bepɔ no so nkuro, ne baabiara a Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de ho mmara maeɛ deɛ, moammɛn hɔ koraa.
3: “Na yɛdanee yɛn ho foro faa Basan kwan so. Ɛnna Basan hene Og boaa ne dɔm ano bɛhyiaa yɛn wɔ Edrei sɛ ɔne yɛn rebɛko.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Nsuro no, na mede ɔne ne man nyinaa ne n’asase bɛhyɛ wo nsa na woayɛ no sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a na ɔte Hesbon no.’
Enti Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de Basan hene Og ne ne man nyinaa hyɛɛ yɛn nsa, na yɛkunkum wɔn nyinaa na anka onipa baako mpo.
Na yɛfaa ne nkuro nyinaa saa berɛ no. Kuro baako mpo nni hɔ a yɛannye no wɔn nsam. Yɛfaa nkuro aduosia, Argob asase nyinaa, Og ahemman a ɛwɔ Basan.
Na ɛyɛ nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ afasuo atenten ne apono akɛseɛ a dadeɛ deda akyire. Yeinom akyi no, na nkuro nketewa pii nso wɔ hɔ.
Nanso yɛsɛee ne nyinaa pasaa sɛdeɛ yɛyɛɛ Hesbon hene Sihon no, na yɛsɛee kuro biara, mmarima, mmaa ne mmɔfra.
Na wɔn mmoa ne nneɛma foforɔ a ɛwɔ kuro no mu deɛ, yɛfaa no sɛ asadeɛ.
“Saa berɛ no ara na yɛgyee asase no firii Amorifoɔ ahemfo mmienu a na wɔwɔ Yordan mantam mu no nsam, ɛfiri Arnon subɔn ho kɔsi Bepɔ Hermon ho.
Na Sidonfoɔ frɛ Hermon sɛ Sirion, na Amorifoɔ nso frɛ no Senir.
Na yɛfaa nkuro a ɛwowɔ asase tratra soɔ no ne Gilead ne Basan nyinaa kɔsii Saleka ne Edrei, nkuro a ɛwɔ Og ahemman mu wɔ Basan no.
Saa berɛ no na Basan hene Og nko na na waka wɔ abrane akɛseɛ no mu. Na na ne mpa yɛ dadeɛ mpa. Na mpa yi si Ammonfoɔ kurom wɔ Raba. Na ne tenten yɛ basafa nkron, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa nnan.
Saa berɛ no ara na yɛfaa asase no; ɛfiri Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon subɔn ho ne Gilead bepɔ no fa ne nkuro a ɛwowɔ hɔ no, mede maa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ.
Na mede Gilead asase a aka ne Og ahemman a ɛwɔ Basan nyinaa maa Manase abusuakuo no fa. Wɔfrɛ Argob anaa Basan mantam hɔ nyinaa Refaim asase anaa abrane akɛseɛ asase.
“Manase ba Yair faa Argob asase no nyinaa bɛsii Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ hyeɛ so. Na ɔde ne din too Basan nkuraa a ɛwowɔ hɔ no frɛɛ hɔ Hawot-Yair bɛsi nnɛ.
Na mede Gilead nso maa Makir.
Mede asase a ɛfiri Gilead kɔsi Arnon subɔn no mfimfini maa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ. Ɛba bɛsi Yabok subɔn ho wɔ Ammonfoɔ hyeɛ so,
ne Araba ne Yordan asase no ho kɔfa Kineret bɛsi po a ɛwɔ Araba anaa Nkyene Po no ho wɔ Pisga bepɔ no ase wɔ apueeɛ fam.
“Enti meka kyerɛɛ mo sɛ, ‘Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de asase yi ama mo sɛ momfa. Mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ nyinaa, mobɛfa mo akodeɛ adi mo nuanom Israelfoɔ anim akɔ asase no so.
Mo yerenom ne mo mma nkumaa ne mo mmoa, mmoa nso deɛ, menim sɛ mowɔ pii, yeinom nko ara na wɔbɛtena nkuro a mede ama mo no mu;
akɔsi sɛ Awurade bɛma mo ne mo nuanom ahome na wɔafa asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama wɔn Yordan agya no. Ɛno akyi no, mobɛtumi asane aba asase a mede ama mo no so.’
“Afei meka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ, ‘Wo ara woahunu deɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ayɛ ahemfo mmienu no nyinaa. Saa ara na Awurade bɛyɛ ahemman a morekɔ mu no nyinaa.
Monnsuro wɔn ɛfiri sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn bɛko ama mo.’
“Ɛnna mesrɛɛ Awurade saa berɛ no sɛ,
‘O Awurade Nyankopɔn, wo na woafiri aseɛ ama w’akoa ahunu wo kɛseyɛ ne wo basa denden no. Onyame bɛn na ɔwɔ soro anaa asase so a ɔbɛtumi ayɛ wo nnwuma ne w’ahoɔdenneɛ yi bie?
Mesrɛ wo ma mentwa nkɔhwɛ asase pa a ɛwɔ Yordan agya no, bepɔ so asase fɛfɛ no ne Lebanon.’
Na mo nti Awurade bo fuu me, na wantie me. Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Twa so! Mmɔ asɛm yi so nkyerɛ me bio.
Foro kɔgyina Pisga na ma w’ani so hwɛ atɔeɛ ne atifi ne anafoɔ ne apueeɛ, na Yordan deɛ, worentwa.
Fa Yosua yɛ ɔman no kannifoɔ na hyɛ no nkuran na hyɛ no den, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔbɛdi ɔman yi anim atwa Yordan, na ɔde asase a wobɛhunu no bɛma wɔn.’
Enti yɛtraa obon mu wɔ Bet-Peor anim.
4: “Na afei, O Israel, montie ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a merekyerɛkyerɛ mo yi na monni so na moanya nkwa, na moakɔfa asase a Awurade mo agyanom Nyankopɔn de ama mo no.
Mommfa biribiara nnka asɛm a merehyɛ mo yi ho, na monnyi bi nso mmfiri mu. Monhwɛ nni Awurade mo Nyankopɔn mmara a mede rema mo yi so.
“Mo ara mode mo ani hunuu deɛ Awurade yɛeɛ berɛ a ebinom kɔsom Baal-Peor no. Awurade mo Nyankopɔn sɛee obiara a ɔkɔdii Baal-Peor akyi firii mo mu.
Na mo a mode mo ho fam Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ho no nyinaa te ase nnɛ.
Hwɛ, mama moahunu ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm yi sɛdeɛ Awurade me Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ me no na moayɛ no saa ara wɔ asase a morekɔfa no so.
Enti monni so ɛfiri sɛ ɛno ne mo nyansa ne mo nhunumu wɔ aman a wɔbɛte ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa anim, na wɔbɛka sɛ, ‘Ɔman kɛseɛ yi nim nyansa na wɔwɔ nhunumu ampa.’
Na ɔman kɛseɛ bɛn na wɔwɔ onyame a wɔbɛn wɔn sɛdeɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛn yɛn, na abrɛ nyinaa mu yɛtumi frɛ no yi?
Na ɔman kɛseɛ bɛn na wɔwɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a ɛtene sɛ mmara a mede rema mo nnɛ yi?
“Ɛno ara ne sɛ monhwɛ mo ho yie na mo ani mmra mo kra so na mo werɛ amfiri deɛ moani ahunu no, na monkwa nna nyinaa mu amfiri moakoma mu; na momfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mo mma ne mo mma mma nhunu.

Momma wɔnhunu deɛ ɛsii da a mobɛgyinaa Awurade mo Nyankopɔn anim wɔ Horeb no. Saa da no Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Boaboa ɔman no ano m’anim na wɔntie me nsɛm na wɔnsua sɛ wɔbɛsuro me, nna dodoɔ a wɔbɛdi no asase soɔ nyinaa, na wɔmfa nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mma.’
“Enti mobɛgyinaa bepɔ no ase, na egya dɛree bepɔ no so kɔɔ soro, na esum ne mununkum kumɔnn baeɛ, na ewiem yɛɛ kusuu.
Na Awurade firi gya no mu kasa kyerɛɛ mo. Motee kasa bi, nanso moanhunu nipasu biara; ɛnne kɛkɛ na moteeɛ.
Na ɔkaa n’apam a ɔhyɛɛ mo sɛ monyɛ no kyerɛɛ mo, mmara nsɛm du no, na ɔtwerɛɛ wɔ aboɔpono mmienu so.
Na me na Awurade hyɛɛ me saa berɛ no sɛ menkyerɛ mo ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm no na moadi so asase a morekɔfa no so.
“Enti monhwɛ mo kra so yie, ɛfiri sɛ da a Awurade firi gya mu ne mo kasaa Horeb no, moanhunu nipasu biara.
Na moanni asɛmmɔne ankɔyɛ ohoni anaa adeɛ biara nsɛsoɔ, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa biara nsɛsoɔ,
asase so aboa anaa anomaa a ɔtu fa soro biara nsɛsoɔ,
adeɛ biara a ɛwea asase soɔ anaa apataa a ɔwɔ nsuo mu wɔ asase ase biara nsɛsoɔ.
Na woamma w’ani so ankyerɛ soro anhwɛ owia ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma, ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na antwe wo ankɔsɔre wɔn ansom wɔn, nneɛma a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyekyɛ ama wiase amanaman nyinaa no.
Nanso mo deɛ, Awurade ayi mo afiri Egypt dadeɛ fononoo mu de mo abɛyɛ ɔno ara n’agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
“Na mo nti Awurade bo fuu me, na ɔkaa ntam sɛ merentwa Yordan na merenkɔ asase pa a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama mo sɛ agyapadeɛ no so.
Me deɛ, merebɛwu wɔ asase yi so. Merentwa Yordan, na mo deɛ, mobɛtwa akɔfa asase pa no.
Monhwɛ yie na mo werɛ amfiri apam a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ne mo ayɛ no na moankɔyɛ ohoni biara anaa biribiara a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn abara mo no nsɛsoɔ.
Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn yɛ ogya a ɛhyeɛ, ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ.
“Na sɛ motena asase no so kyɛ na monya mma ne mma mma, na moyɛ asobrakyeɛ kɔyɛ ohoni anaa biribi nsɛsoɔ anaa abusudeɛ biara wɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ani so de hyɛ no abufuo a,
ɛnneɛ ɛnnɛ mefrɛ ɔsoro ne asase sɛ adansefoɔ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe mo ntɛm afiri asase a moretwa Yordan akɔfa no so. Na morentena so nkyɛ, na mmom sɛeɛ na wɔbɛsɛe pasapasa.
Na Awurade bɛbɔ mo ahwete amanaman mu, na aman a Awurade bɛpamo mo akɔ soɔ no, mo mu kakraa bi na ɛbɛka wɔ soɔ.
Ɛhɔ na mobɛsom anyame a onipa de ne nsa ayɛ, nnua ne aboɔ a ɛnhunu adeɛ na ɛnte asɛm na ɛntumi nnidie na ɛnte hwa biara.
“Na sɛ mode mo akoma ne mo kra nyinaa hwehwɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔ a, mobɛhu no.
Sɛ nsɛm yi nyinaa to mo daakye na mo ho kyere mo a, mobɛsan aba Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn abɛtie ne nne.
Na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunufoɔ, ɔrempa mo na ɔrensɛe mo, na ne werɛ remfiri mo agyanom apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn no.
“Na mommu nkɔmpɔ nhwɛ mo akyi, ɛfiri da a Onyankopɔn bɔɔ onipa too asase soɔ, na mommisa mfiri soro ano kɔpem ano, sɛ Obi ahunu adekɛseɛ a ɛte saa anaa wate ho asɛm pɛn?
Nnipa bi ate Onyankopɔn nne egya mu, sɛdeɛ woteeɛ no, a wɔda so te aseɛ anaa?

Anaasɛ onyame bi asɔ ahwɛ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔyi ɔman bi afiri ɔman bi mu, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, ne anwanwadeɛ, ne ɛko, ne nsa a ɛyɛ den, ne basa a wɔatene mu ne ahudeɛ so ayi ɔman bi afiri ɔman foforɔ mu de ne din ato wɔn so sɛdeɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn yɛ maa mo Egypt wɔ mo anim no anaa?
Nanso wo deɛ, wama woahunu sɛ ɔno ne Awurade Nyankopɔn no, na obiara nni hɔ sɛ ɔno.
Ɔmaa wotee ne nne firii soro na watenetene wo. Na asase so nso ɔmaa wohunuu ne gya kɛseɛ no, na wotee n’anom asɛm firii egya no mfimfini.
“Ɛsiane sɛ ɔdɔ mo agyanom nti, na ɔde ne tumi kɛseɛ yii wɔn asefoɔ, na ɔyii mo firii Egypt a n’ani di mo akyi;
sɛ ɔbɛpamo aman a ɛsoso na ɛyɛ den sene woɔ afiri w’anim, na ɔde wɔn nsase ama wo sɛ agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛte nnɛ da yi.
Enti hunu nnɛ, na fa sie w’akomam mu, sɛ Awurade ne Nyankopɔn, a wɔwɔ soro mu soro, ne asase a ɛwɔ fam yi so. Na obiara nni hɔ bio.
Enti di n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a mede rema wo nnɛ yi so na asi wo ne wo nkyirimma yie daa, na wo nna aware asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.” Mose yi dwanekɔbea nkuro mmiɛnsa
Saa berɛ no Mose yii nkuro mmiɛnsa wɔ Yordan agya apueeɛ fam
na ama obi a ne nsa bɛpa akum ne yɔnko a ɔntane no dada no adwane akɔ hɔ. Ɔnnwane nkɔ nkuro yi baako mu na wanya nkwa.
Ɔyii Beser a ɛwɔ serɛ soɔ ne asase tratra soɔ no maa Rubenfoɔ, na ɔde Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead no maa Gadfoɔ, na ɔde Golan a ɛwɔ Basan no maa Manasefoɔ.
Na yei ne mmara a Mose de too Israelfoɔ no anim.
Yei ne adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a Mose de ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ berɛ a wɔfirii Egypt no.
Saa berɛ no na wɔwɔ Yordan mpɔtamu wɔ bɔn no ho wɔ Bet-Peor anim. Na ɛhɔ yɛ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔte Hesbon no asase. Ɔno na Mose ne Israelfoɔ kuu no berɛ a wɔfiri Egypt reba no.
Na wɔfaa ɔne Basan hene Og nsase. Yeinom ne Amorifoɔ ahemfo mmienu a na wɔwɔ Yordan apueeɛ fam no.
Asase no firi Aroer a ɛda Arnon bɔn no ano kɔsi Sion Bepɔ a ɛne Hermon no ho,
ne Araba mpaperɛ a ɛda Yordan agya apueeɛ fam kɔsi po a ɛwɔ Araba no ano wɔ Pisga ase.
5: Na Mose frɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Israel, montie ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a mereka agu mo asom nnɛ yi. Monsua na monni ne nyinaa so.
Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn ne yɛn yɛɛ apam wɔ Horeb.
Ɛnyɛ yɛn nananom na Awurade ne wɔn yɛɛ apam yi, na mmom yɛn a yɛte ase nnɛ yi.
Awurade firi gya mu ne mo kasaa animu ne animu wɔ bepɔ no so.
Saa berɛ no me na na megyina Awurade ne mo ntam. Na mekaa Awurade anom asɛm kyerɛɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ na mosuro egya no na moankɔ bepɔ no so, na ɔkaa sɛ,
“‘Mene Awurade wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo firii Egypt nkoafie no.
Nnya anyame foforɔ biara nka me ho.
“‘Nyɛ ohoni biara anaa biribi a ɛwɔ soro anaa asase so anaa deɛ ɛwɔ nsuo mu wɔ asase ase nsɛsoɔ biara mfa.
Nkoto wɔn na nsom wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ me Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, meyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ. Na agyanom a wɔtan me deɛ, mede wɔn bɔne ho asotwe ba wɔn mma so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mmiɛnsa ne nnan mpo so;
na wɔn a wɔdɔ me na wɔdi me mmara soɔ deɛ, meyi m’adɔeɛ adi akyerɛ wɔn akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so mpempem so.
“‘Mmɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn din kwa, na Awurade remma deɛ ɔbɔ ne din kwa no mfa ne ho nni tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
“‘Di homeda na yɛ no kronkron sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ woɔ no.
Adwuma biara a wowɔ yɛ no, fa nnansia yɛ ne nyinaa.

Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ homeda ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Nyɛ adwuma biara; wo oo, wo babarima anaa wo babaa oo, w’akoa anaa w’afenaa oo, wo nantwie oo, w’afunumu oo, w’afieboa oo, ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo kurom oo, obiara nnyɛ adwuma. Ɛbɛma w’afenaa ne w’akoa ahome sɛ wo.
Na kae sɛ na woyɛ akoa wɔ Egypt asase so na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a watene mu yii wo firii hɔ. Ɛno nti na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo sɛ di homeda no.
“‘Di w'agya ne wo na ni, sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ woɔ no, na wo nna aware na asi wo yie, asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
“‘Nni awu.
“‘Na nsɛe awareɛ.
“‘Mmɔ korɔno.
“‘Nni wo yɔnko ho adansekunumu.

“‘Mma wo kɔn nnɔ wo yɔnko yere. Na mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko fie anaa n’asase anaa n’akoa anaa n’afenaa anaa ne nantwie anaa n’afunumu. Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko biribiara.’ Mose gye mmara no firi Onyankopɔn nsam
“Awurade firi gya ne mununkum kumɔnn ne sum mu de nne kɛseɛ kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ asafo no nyinaa wɔ bepɔ no so, na wamfa hwee anka ho. Akyire yi ɔtwerɛ guu aboɔpono mmienu so de maa me.
“Berɛ a bepɔ no redɛre na motee nne bi firii sum mu no, mobaa me nkyɛn, mo mmusua mu atitire ne mo mpanimfoɔ nyinaa.
Na mokaa sɛ: ‘Hwɛ, Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn ada n’animuonyam ne ne kɛseyɛ adi akyerɛ yɛn, na yɛate ne nne wɔ gya mu. Ɛnnɛ yɛahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛtumi ne onipa akasa ama no akɔ so atena nkwa mu.
Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛtena hɔ ma egya kɛseɛ yi bɛhye yɛn ma yɛwuwuo? Sɛ yɛte Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn nne bio a, yɛbɛwuwu.
Na honam nyinaa mu hwan na wate Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no nne wɔ gya mu sɛ yɛn na ɔda so te aseɛ?
Enti wo mmom bɛn hɔ kɔtie deɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka nyinaa, na deɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka akyerɛ woɔ biara, bɛbɔ yɛn amanneɛ, na yɛbɛtie na yɛadi so.’
“Na Awurade tee deɛ moka kyerɛɛ me no nyinaa. Enti Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Mate asɛm a ɔman yi aka akyerɛ woɔ no. Deɛ wɔaka nyinaa yɛ.
O, sɛ anka wɔbɛnya akoma a ɛte seyie na wɔde asuro me adi me mmara nsɛm so nna nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma yie daa ɛ!
Kɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkɔ mo ntomadan mu.”
Na wo deɛ, gyina me nkyɛn ha na menka nkyerɛ wo mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a wode bɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ama wɔadi soɔ asase a mede ama wɔn sɛ wɔmfa no so.’
Ɛno nti monhwɛ sɛ mobɛyɛ deɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo nyinaa. Mommmane nnkɔ benkum anaa nifa.
Ɛkwan a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ momfa soɔ no, monhwɛ sɛ mobɛfa soɔ. Moyɛ saa a, mobɛnya nkwa na asi mo yie na mo nkwa aware asase a morekɔfa no so.
6: “Na yei ne mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ mo na moadi so asase a morekɔfa no so.
Ɛbɛma woasuro Awurade wo Nyankopɔn adi n'ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware.
Enti O Israel, tie na hwɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ ne nyinaa na asi wo yie na mo ase atrɛ ayɛ pii asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so, sɛdeɛ Awurade w’agyanom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo bɔ no.
“O Israel, tie: Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ Awurade koro.
Na fa w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa ne w’ahoɔden nyinaa dɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn.
Na ma nsɛm a mereka akyerɛ wo nnɛ yi nna w’akoma so;
na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yie, na ka ho asɛm berɛ a wote wo fie, berɛ a wonam kwan soɔ, berɛ a woda hɔ, ne wosɔreɛ mu.
Fa yɛ sɛnkyerɛnne kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ wo moma so.
Na twerɛ gu wo fie apono ne w’aponkɛseɛ ho.
“Na sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’agyanom Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so, na ɔde nkuro akɛseɛ fɛfɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyereeɛ,
ne afie a nnepa ayɛ mu ma a ɛnyɛ wo na wode baeɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatuo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotuiɛ, ne bobe nturo ne ngo nnua a ɛnyɛ wo na woduaeɛ ma wo, na wodidi mee a,
hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri Awurade a ɔde wo firi Egypt nkoafie baeɛ no.
Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka.
Monnkɔdi anyame foforɔ a aman a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia no som wɔn no akyi,
ɛfiri sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ mo mfimfini no yɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ, na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn abufuo annɛre antia mo na wantɔre mo ase amfiri asase so.
“Monnsɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ sɛdeɛ mosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa no.
Monhwɛ sɛ ɛkwan biara so mobɛdi Awurade mo Nyankopɔn mmara ne n'adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a ɔde ama mo no nyinaa so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na monyɛ deɛ ɛtene ne deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ Awurade ani soɔ na asi mo yie na moakɔfa asase pa a Awurade kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom no.
Na moapamo mo atamfo nyinaa afiri mo anim sɛdeɛ Awurade ahyɛ bɔ no.
“Ebia daakye wo mma bɛbisa mo sɛ, ‘Na adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn de maa mo yi nso kyerɛ sɛn?’
Ɛnneɛ monka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Na yɛyɛ Farao nkoa wɔ Egypt, ɛnna Awurade de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn firii Egypt.
Na Awurade de nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu baa Egypt ne Farao ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa so yɛn anim.
Na ɔyii yɛn firii hɔ baa ha sɛ ɔde asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn agyanom no rebɛma yɛn.
Enti Awurade de mmara yi nyinaa maa sɛ yɛnni so na yɛnsuro Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn na asi yɛn yie daa na yɛatena nkwa mu sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so, Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn anim sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn ateneneefoɔ.’
7: “Na sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a worekɔfa no so, na ɔpamo aman akɛseɛ yi firi w’anim, Hitifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hiwifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ, aman nson a dɔɔso na wɔn ho yɛ den sene woɔ,
Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn hyɛ wo nsa na wodi wɔn so nkonim a, ɛnneɛ sɛe wɔn pasaa. Wo ne wɔn nnyɛ apam biara, na nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ.
Wo ne wɔn mu biara nnni ayewareɛ. Na mfa wo babaa mma ne babarima, na nnye ne babaa mma wo babarima.
Sɛ woyɛ saa a, ɔbɛma wo babarima afiri m’akyi akɔsom anyame foforɔ; na Awurade abufuo adɛre mo so na wasɛe mo prɛko pɛ.
“Na mmom deɛ monyɛ nie: Mommubu wɔn afɔrebukyia ne wɔn abosom adum no, na montwitwa wɔn abosonnua ngu, na momfa gya nhye wɔn ahoni.
Ɛfiri sɛ wo deɛ, woyɛ ɔman kronkron ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ayi wo afiri asase so aman nyinaa mu de wo ayɛ ne man, n’agyapadeɛ titire.
“Ɛnyɛ sɛ modɔɔso sene aman a aka nyinaa nti na Awurade pɛ mo asɛm na wahyɛ da ayi mo, ɛfiri sɛ mo mmom na mosua koraa wɔ aman nyinaa mu.
Na ɛsiane sɛ Awurade dɔ mo na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdi ntam a ɔkaa mo agyanom no soɔ nti na Awurade de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii mo firii nkoafie, na ɔgyee mo firii Egypt hene Farao nsam.
Enti hunu sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ a ɔdi n’apam soɔ, na wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wɔdi ne mmara soɔ no, ɔyi n’adɔeɛ adi kyerɛ wɔn kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem so.
Na deɛ ɔtan no deɛ, ɔde n’akatua bɛsi n’anim asɛe no ntɛm. Ɔrentwentwɛn ne nan ase wɔ ne ho; ɔbɛtua no ka ntɛm wɔ n’anim.
Ɛno nti ma mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a mede rema wo nnɛ yi nna w’akoma so na di so.
“Na sɛ motie atemmusɛm yi na modi so a, Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nso bɛdi apam ne adɔeɛ a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom no so.
Na ɔbɛdɔ wo ahyira wo na woadɔɔso. Ɔbɛhyira wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’ayuo ne wo nsa foforɔ ne wo ngo, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma wɔ asase a ɔkaa w’agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so.
Wɔbɛhyira wo asene aman nyinaa. Wo mmarima ne wo mmaa ne wo mmoa mu biara renyɛ obonini.
Na Awurade bɛyi yareɛ biara afiri wo so; na ɔremfa yare bɔne a wohunuu no Egypt no biara mma wo so, na ɔde bɛkɔ wɔn a wɔtan woɔ nyinaa so.
Bio nso, sɛe aman a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de bɛhyɛ wo nsa nyinaa; nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na nsom wɔn anyame ɛfiri sɛ ɛbɛyɛ fidie ama wo.
“Ebia wobɛka no w’akomam sɛ, ‘Aman yi dɔɔso dodo ma me. Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi apamo wɔn?’
Nanso nsuro wɔn, na kae deɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Farao ne Egypt nyinaa.
Kae sɔhwɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, anwanwadeɛ, nsa a ɛyɛ den, ne basa a wɔatene mu a wohunuu sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nam so yii woɔ no. Saa ara na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ aman a wosuro wɔn no nyinaa.
Nkotokurodu so na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛsoma ama wɔakɔ wɔn mu akɔsi sɛ wɔn a wɔaka a wɔahunta nyinaa bɛwuwuo.
Mma wɔnntu w’akoma, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ka wo ho. Ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ a ne ho yɛ hu.
“Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛpamo aman yi afiri w’anim nkakrankakra. Ɔremma wonsɛe wɔn nyinaa prɛko, anyɛ saa a wuram mmoa bɔne bɛbu so abɛha wo.
Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛhyɛ wo nsa na wama wɔabubu afa so akɔsi sɛ wɔn ase bɛtɔre.
Na ɔde wɔn ahemfo bɛhyɛ wo nsa na woasɛe wɔn din afiri ɔsoro ase. Obiara rentumi nnyina w’anim kɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛe wɔn.
Momfa gya nhye wɔn anyame ahoni no. Mma w’ani mmmere ɛho dwetɛ anaa sika, na mfa bi na ansum wo fidie, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.
Na mfa akyiwadeɛ biara mma wo fie na wɔansɛe wo anka abusudeɛ no ho. Ma no nyɛ wo tan na kyiri, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ abusudeɛ a wɔbɛsɛe no pasaa.
8: “Monhwɛ nni mmara nsɛm a mede rema mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so na moatena nkwa mu, na mo ase atrɛ, na moakɔfa asase a Awurade kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom no.
Na kae kwan a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn maa wonantee so mfirinhyia aduanan yi ɛserɛ soɔ no nyinaa, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo ase asɔ wo ahwɛ, na wahunu deɛ ɛwɔ w’akoma mu, sɛ wobɛdi ne mmara nsɛm so anaasɛ worenni so.

Enti ɔbrɛɛ wo ase maa ɛkɔm dee wo. Afei ɔmaa wo mana a wo ne w’agyanom biara nhunuu bi da diiɛ na woahunu sɛ ɛnyɛ paanoo nko ara so na onipa nam bɛtena aseɛ, na mmom asɛm biara a ɛfiri Awurade anom so.
Na mfeɛ aduanan yi nyinaa wo ntadeɛ antete na wo nan ase antaatae.
Na hunu no w’akomam mu sɛ, sɛdeɛ onipa tea ne ba no, saa ara na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn tea woɔ.
“Enti di Awurade wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so na fa n’akwan so, na suro no.
Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wo rekɔ asase pa a nsubɔnten wɔ soɔ so, asase a nsuwansuwa ne atadeɛ a ɛfiri abɔn ne mmepɔ mu sene wɔ soɔ.
Ɛyɛ asase a ayuo, atokoɔ, bobe, borɔdɔma, granate akutuo, ngodua, ne ɛwoɔ wɔ soɔ.
Worenni aduankɔm asase no so, na hwee renhia wo wɔ hɔ. Asase no so aboɔ yɛ dadeɛ, na wobɛtu kɔbere afiri ne mmepɔ mu.
“Na sɛ wodidi mee a, hyira Awurade wo Nyankopɔn sɛ wama wo asase pa.
Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na woannane w’akyi ankyerɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmusɛm ne ne mmara a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi.
Anyɛ saa na wodidi mee sisi adan pa tena mu,
na wonya anantwie ne nnwan ne dwetɛ ne sika ne agyapadeɛ pii a,
w’akoma amma ne ho so, na wo werɛ amfiri Awurade wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo firii Egypt nkoafie no.
Ɔno na ɔde wo faa serɛ a ɛso yɛ hu soɔ, ɛserɛ a awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ ne nyanyankyerɛ wɔ soɔ, asase kesee a nsuo nni soɔ; na ɔmaa nsuo firi abohemmaa botan mu ba maa wo.
Ɔno na ɔmaa wo mana a w’agyanom nhunuu bi da dii ɛserɛ soɔ sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo aseɛ na wasɔ wo ahwɛ, na awieeɛ no, wayɛ wo yie,
Hwɛ yie na woanka no w’akomam sɛ, ‘Me tumi ne m’ahoɔden na ama manya me ho.’
Na mmom kae Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔmaa wo tumi a wode anya wo ho no. Ɔyɛɛ yei ɛfiri sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdi apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’agyanom no so, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
“Na sɛ moma mo werɛ firi Awurade mo Nyankopɔn na mokɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi na mokoto sɔre wɔn a, ɛnneɛ medi mo adanseɛ nnɛ sɛ mobɛsɛe koraa.
Mobɛsɛe sɛ aman a Awurade sɛee wɔn firii mo anim no, ɛfiri sɛ moantie Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nne.
9: “O Israel, tie, ɛnnɛ woretwa Yordan akɔpamo aman akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ den sene woɔ akɔfa nkuro akɛseɛ a wɔato ho afasuo akɔduru soro,
ɔman kɛseɛ a wɔwoware. Yeinom ne Anakim mma no, na wonim wɔn na woate sɛ wɔka wɔn ho asɛm sɛ, ‘Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina Anak mma anim?’
Ɛnnɛ hunu sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn di w’anim retwa akɔ hɔ. Sɛ egya a ɛhye. Ɔno ara bɛsɛe wɔn na wabrɛ wɔn ase w’anim. Enti tu wɔn na sɛe wɔn ntɛm, sɛdeɛ Awurade aka akyerɛ woɔ no.
“Sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn pamo wɔn firi w’anim a, nka no w’akomam sɛ, ‘Me tenenee nti na Awurade de me aba sɛ memmɛfa asase yi.’ Kae sɛ aman yi abɔnefosɛm nti na Awurade repamo wɔn afiri w’anim.

Ɛnyɛ wo tenenee anaa w’akomam a ɛteɛ nti na worekɔfa wɔn asase no, na mmom aman no abɔnefosɛm nti na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn repamo wɔn afiri w’anim yi, na ama ntam a Awurade kaa w’agyanom Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob no aba mu.
Enti hunu sɛ ɛnyɛ wo tenenee nti na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de asase pa yi rema woɔ ama woafa, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ ɔman a wo kɔn asene.
“Kae: Mma wo werɛ mmfiri sɛdeɛ wohyɛɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn abufuo ɛserɛ no soɔ no. Ɛfiri da a mofirii Egypt bɛsi nnɛ a mowɔ ha yi, daa mote atua tia Awurade.
Na Horeb mpo mogyegyee Awurade maa n’ani bereeɛ, na Awurade bo fu maa anka ɔretɔre mo ase.
Berɛ a mekɔɔ bepɔ no so sɛ merekɔgye aboɔpono a mo ne Awurade ntam apam wɔ soɔ no, medii adaduanan awia ne anadwo wɔ bepɔ no so manni hwee na mannom nsuo nso.
Ɛnna Awurade maa me aboɔpono mmienu a Onyankopɔn de ne nsateaa atwerɛ nsɛm wɔ soɔ, nsɛm a Awurade firi gya mu ka kyerɛɛ mo bepɔ no soɔ nyinaa, da a asafo no bɔɔ dwa no.
Berɛ a adaduanan, awia ne anadwo, no durueɛ no, Awurade de aboɔpono mmienu a apam no ho mmara wɔ soɔ no maa me.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Sɔre firi ha kɔ ntɛm, ɛfiri sɛ wo nkurɔfoɔ a wokɔyii wɔn firii Egypt no adi asɛmmɔne. Wɔamane ntɛm afiri ahyɛdeɛ a mede ama wɔn no ho. Hwɛ, wɔayɛ dadeɛ honi afa.’
Na Awurade toaa so ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Hwɛ, mahunu sɛ ɔman yi yɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asene.
Gyaa me, ma mensɛe wɔn mpepa wɔn din mfiri ɔsoro ase na menyɛ wo ɔman kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ den nsene wɔn.’
“Enti medanee me ho si firii bepɔ no so, berɛ a na egya redɛre bepɔ no soɔ. Na aboɔpono mmienu a apam no ho mmara wɔ soɔ no wɔ me nsa mmienu mu.
Na mebɛhunuu sɛ ampa moayɛ bɔne atia Awurade mo Nyankopɔn! Na moayɛ nantwie ba honi. Momanee ntɛm firii kwan a Awurade hyɛɛ mo no so.
Mehunuu saa no, megyaa aboɔpono mmienu no mu hwee hɔ maa no bubuu mo anim.
Na mebutuu Awurade anim adaduanan awia ne anadwo sɛdeɛ meyɛɛ kane no. Manni hwee na mannom nsuo nso, mo bɔne a moyɛeɛ nyinaa nti, bɔne a moyɛɛ no Awurade ani soɔ sɛ mode bɛhyɛ no abufuo.
Mehwɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade bo afuo na n’ani abere mo soɔ no a, na mesuro sɛ ɔbɛtwa mo afiri hɔ. Na saa berɛ no nso Awurade tiee me.
“Na Awurade bo fuu Aaron nso dendeenden maa anka ɔretwa no afiri hɔ, nanso mepaa kyɛw maa Aaron nso saa berɛ no.
Na mede gya hyee nantwie ba honi a ɛyɛ mo bɔne no, na mebubuu mu yam no muhumuhu sɛ mfuturo, na meto guu nsuo a ɛfiri bepɔ mu sene no mu.
“Berɛ a mowɔ Tabera, Masa ne Kibrot-Hatawa no nso mohyɛɛ Awurade abufuo.
Na berɛ a Awurade somaa mo firi Kades-Barnea sɛ, ‘Monkɔfa asase a mede ama mo!’ no nso, motee Awurade mo Nyankopɔn so atua, na moannye no anni na moantie no.
Ɛfiri da a mehunuu mo yi, daa mote Awurade so atua.
“Enti mebutuu Awurade anim adaduanan awia ne anadwo, ɛfiri sɛ na Awurade aka sɛ ɔbɛtwa mo afiri hɔ.
Na mepaa Awurade kyɛw sɛ, ‘O Awurade Nyankopɔn, nsɛe wo man a wɔyɛ wo ara w’agyapadeɛ a wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne basa a ɛyɛ den yii wɔn firii Egypt no.
Kae wo nkoa Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob. Nnane w’ani nhwɛ ɔman yi asoɔden ne wɔn amumuyɛ ne wɔn bɔne,
anyɛ saa a ɔman a woyii wɔn firii hɔ no sofoɔ bɛka sɛ: “Awurade antumi amfa wɔn ankɔ asase a ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, na ɛsiane sɛ ɔtan wɔn nti na wɔyii wɔn kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔkunkum wɔn wɔ serɛ so.”
Na ɔman yi da so ara yɛ wo ara w’agyapadeɛ a wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo basa a woatene mu yii wɔn.’ Onyankopɔn tie mose mpaebɔ
10: “Saa berɛ no na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Sene aboɔpono mmienu te sɛ kane deɛ no na fa bra me nkyɛn wɔ bepɔ no so. Afei fa dua yɛ adaka.
Na mɛtwerɛ nsɛm a na ɛwɔ aboɔpono a ɛdi kan a wobubuu no no soɔ no agu foforɔ no so, na fa sie adaka no mu.’
Enti mede ɔkanto dua yɛɛ adaka na mesenee aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no. Na mede aboɔpono mmienu no kɔɔ bepɔ no so.
Na ɔtwerɛɛ Nsɛm Du no guu aboɔpono no so sɛdeɛ na ɛwɔ kane deɛ no soɔ no. Yei ne nsɛm a Awurade firi gya mu ka kyerɛɛ mo bepɔ no ho, da a asafo no bɔɔ dwa no. Na Awurade wieeɛ no, ɔde maa me.
Na mesiane firii bepɔ no so na mede aboɔpono no bɛsiee adaka a mayɛ no mu sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ sɛ menyɛ no.
“Na Israelfoɔ tu firii Beerot Bene-Yaakan kɔɔ Mosera. Ɛhɔ na Aaron wu maa wɔsiee no, na ne ba Eleasar sii n’ananmu dii ɔsɔfoɔ.
Na wɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Gudgoda, na wɔfiri Gudgoda kɔɔ Yotbata, asase a nsubɔnten sene soɔ no.
“Saa berɛ no Awurade yii Lewi abusuakuo no sɛ wɔnsoa Awurade apam adaka no na wɔnnyina Awurade anim nsom no na wɔmfa ne din nhyira de bɛsi nnɛ.
Yei nti na Lewi annya ne nuanom agyapadeɛ no bie no. Awurade ne n’agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no.
Na medii adaduanan wɔ bepɔ no so sɛ kane no, awia ne anadwo, na saa berɛ no nso Awurade tiee me. Na Awurade ampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe mo.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Sɔre di ɔman no anim ma wɔnkɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no.’

“Na afei Israel, ɛdeɛn na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn rehwehwɛ firi wo hɔ, sɛ wobɛsuro Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na woanante n’akwan nyinaa soɔ na woadɔ no, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa asom Awurade wo Nyankopɔn,
na woadi Awurade ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara a mede rema wo nnɛ yi soɔ, na asi wo yie?
Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro mpo, ne asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn dea.
W’agyanom nko ara na Awurade kaa wɔn bataa ne ho yii ne dɔ adi kyerɛɛ wɔn. Enti na wayi mo a moyɛ wɔn nkyirimma no afiri aman nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Enti montwatwa mo akoma twetia, na monnsene mo kɔn bio.
Na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn yɛ anyame mu Onyankopɔn ne awuranom mu Awurade, Onyankopɔn tumfoɔ pumpuni a ne ho yɛ hu. Ɔnyɛ animhwɛ na ɔnnye adanmudeɛ biara.
Ɔno na ɔbu atɛn ma nnyanka ne akunafoɔ, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔhoɔ ma no aduane ne nkataho.
Enti mo nso monnɔ ahɔhoɔ ɛfiri sɛ na moyɛ ahɔhoɔ Egypt asase so.
“Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na suro no. Ɔno na som no, ne ho na fa wo ho bata, na ne din na fa ka ntam.
Ɔno ne w’ayeyie, na ɔne wo Nyankopɔn a wayɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu a w’ani ahunu yi ama woɔ.
Akra aduɔson na w’agyanom de wɔn kɔɔ Egypt, nanso seesei Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ama woayɛ dɔm kɛseɛ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.
11: “Enti monnɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn na montie no, na monni n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmusɛm ne ne mmara so daa.
Na monhunu nnɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ mo mma na me ne wɔn rekasa. Wɔn deɛ, wɔnnim na wɔnhunui Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ntea, ne ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne ne basa a watene mu,
anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwanwadeɛ a ɔde baa Egypt hene Farao ne ne man nyinaa so wɔ Egypt no.
Ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Egypt asraafoɔ ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam a wɔde reti mo no, Awurade maa Po Kɔkɔɔ no bu faa wɔn so, na ɔsɛee wɔn koraa bɛsi nnɛ.
Monnim deɛ ɔyɛɛ mo serɛ no soɔ kɔsii sɛ mobɛduruu ha.
Na saa ara nso na wonnim sɛ ɔmaa asase mu bueeɛ na ɛmenee Ruben ba Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram ne wɔn fie ne wɔn ntomadan ne wɔn a wɔdii wɔdii wɔn akyi firii Israelfoɔ nyinaa mu no.
Nanso mo na mode mo ani hunuu anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a Awurade yɛeɛ no nyinaa.
“Enti monhwɛ nni mmara a mede rema mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so na ama mo ho ayɛ den, na moatwa akɔfa asase a morekɔ soɔ no.
Na mo nna aware wɔ asase a Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefoɔ no so, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no.
“Asase a morekɔ akɔfa no nte sɛ Egypt asase a mofiri so baeɛ no. Ɛhɔ deɛ, modua adeɛ a, na mode mo nan na ɛgugu so nsuo sɛ mfikyifuo no.
Nanso asase a worekɔfa yi yɛ mmepɔ ne mmɔnka asase a ɛnom nyankonsuo.
Ɛyɛ asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn hwɛ soɔ. Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ani wɔ so daa firi afe ahyɛase kɔsi afe awieeɛ.
“Na sɛ motie ahyɛdeɛ a mede rema mo nnɛ yi na modɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa som no a,
ɛnneɛ me nso mɛtɔ nsuo agu mo asase so wɔ ne berɛ mu, asusɔ ne adonsuo. Na mobɛboaboa mo nnɔbaeɛ ne mo nsa dɔkɔdɔkɔ ne mo ngo ano.
Na mɛma mo mmoa anya serɛ awe wɔ mo asase so na mo nso moadidi amee.
Monhwɛ yie na biribiara antwetwe mo akoma na moankɔsom anyame foforɔ ankoto wɔn.

Na sɛ moyɛ saa a, Awurade abufuo bɛdɛre atia mo, na ɔbɛto ɔsoro mu na nsuo rentɔ, na asase remmɔ aduane. Ɛba saa a, ɛrenni da bi na moawuwu afiri asase pa a Awurade de ama mo no so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsua Nyankopɔn nsɛm no yie
“Enti momfa me nsɛm yi nsie mo akoma ne mo kra mu, na momfa nyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne nkyekyere mo nsa, na ɛnyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ mo moma so.
Na momfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mo mma na monka ho asɛm berɛ a mote fie, berɛ a monam kwan soɔ, berɛ a moda hɔ, ne wo sɔreɛ mu.
Na montwerɛ ngu mo fie apono ne mo aponkɛseɛ ho,
na ama mo ne mo mma nna adɔɔso asase a Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, sɛdeɛ ɔsoro a ɛkata asase soɔ yi nna teɛ.
“Na sɛ motie mmara a mede rema mo yi nyinaa na modi so, na modɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nante n’akwan nyinaa so, na mode mo ho fam ne ho a,
ɛnneɛ Awurade nso bɛpamo aman yi nyinaa ama mo, na moafa aman akɛseɛ a wɔdɔɔso sene mo so.
Baabi a mo nan bɛtia biara bɛyɛ mo dea. Ɛfiri serɛ so kɔsi Lebanon, ɛfiri asubɔnten kɛseɛ no, asubɔnten Eufrate, ho kɔsi atɔeɛ fam po no ano nyinaa bɛyɛ mo asase.
Obiara rentumi nnyina mo anim. Awurade mo Nyankopɔn bɛma mo ho hu atɔ asase a mobɛfa soɔ no nyinaa so na wama wɔasuro mo, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ mo bɔ no.
“Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ mede nhyira ne nnome asi mo anim:
Sɛ motie Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ a mede rema mo nnɛ yi a, nhyira na mobɛnya.
Na sɛ moantie Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ na momane firi kwan a merekyerɛ mo nnɛ yi so kɔdi anyame foforɔ a monnim wɔn akyi a, ɛnneɛ nnome na ɛbɛba mo soɔ.
“Na sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de mo duru asase a morekɔfa no so a, monhyira wɔ Bepɔ Gerisim so na monnome wɔ Bepɔ Ebal so.
Ɛnni Yordan apueeɛ wɔ Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Araba no asase so. Ɛhɔ bɛn More nnua akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Gilgal anim no.
Na mobɛtwa Yordan akɔfa asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama mo no na moatena so.
Enti monhwɛ nni ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a mereka ho asɛm akyerɛ mo nnɛ no nyinaa so.
12: “Yeinom ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm a monhwɛ nyɛ no asase a Awurade mo agyanom Nyankopɔn de rema mo sɛ fa no soɔ, nna a mode te asase soɔ nyinaa.
Baabi a amanaman a morekɔpamo wɔn no som wɔn anyame nyinaa, monhwɛ sɛ mobɛsɛe hɔ pasaa, mmepɔ atenten so, nkokoɔ so, ne dua mono biara ase.
Mommubu wɔn afɔrebukyia ne wɔn abosom adum, na momfa gya nhye wɔn abosonnua, na montwitwa wɔn anyame ahoni ngu. Mompepa wɔn din mfiri hɔ koraa.
“Monnsom Awurade mo Nyankopɔn wɔ saa kwan no so,
na mmom baabi a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua mmusua yi nyinaa mu no, ɛhɔ na momfa mo ani nkyerɛ, na ɛhɔ na monkorɔ.

Ɛhɔ nso na momfa mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne mmoa a mobɛku wɔn abɔ afɔdeɛ foforɔ ne mo ntotosoɔ du du, ne mo mmasoɔ afɔdeɛ ne mo bɔhyɛ afɔdeɛ, ne afɔdeɛ a mofiri mo pɛ mu bɔ, ne mo anantwie ne mo nnwan mu mmakan nyinaa nkorɔ.
Na ɛhɔ na monnidi Awurade mo Nyankopɔn anim, na biribiara a mo ne mo fiefoɔ bɛyɛ biara, momma mo ani nnye, ade a mode mo nsa ka a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ahyira mo nyinaa mu.
“Monhwɛ na moanyɛ deɛ yɛreyɛ no ha nnɛ yi bi. Ɛha deɛ, obiara yɛ deɛ ɛtene n’ani soɔ,
ɛfiri sɛ monnya nnuruu tenabea ne asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama mo no so.
Na sɛ monya twa Yordan kɔtena asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo no so, na ɔma mo home firi mo atamfo a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia no nyinaa ho na motena ase dwoodwoo a,

ɛnneɛ baabi a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ayi sɛ ne din ntena no, ɛhɔ na momfa deɛ maka ho asɛm yi nyinaa nkorɔ: Mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne mmoa a mobɛku wɔn abɔ afɔdeɛ foforɔ ne mo ntotosoɔ du du, mo mmasoɔ afɔdeɛ, ne biribiara a moahyɛ bɔ sɛ mode bɛma Awurade no.
Afei momma mo ani nnye Awurade mo Nyankopɔn anim, mo ne mo mma mmarima ne mo mma mmaa ne mo nkoa ne mo mfenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ mo kuro apono mu, ɛfiri sɛ wannya mo agyapadeɛ no bi.
Hwɛ yie na woammɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ baabiara kɛkɛ a wobɛhunu.
Na baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi no mmusua yi baako mu no, ɛhɔ mmom na bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɛhɔ na yɛ deɛ maka akyerɛ woɔ yi nyinaa.

“Nanso berɛ biara a wo kra kɔn bɛdɔ nam no, kum na we sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira woɔ no, wo nkuro no nyinaa mu. Obi a ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nyinaa bɛtumi awe bi, te sɛ wansane ne ɔforoteɛ.
Nanso monhwɛ na moanni mogya. Monhwie ngu fam sɛ nsuo.

Yeinom ne deɛ wontumi nni bie wɔ wo kurom: W’ayuo anaa wo nsa foforɔ anaa wo ngo mu ntotosoɔ du du, anaa w’anantwie ne wo nnwan mu mmakan, anaa wo bɔhyɛ afɔdeɛ, anaa afɔdeɛ a wofiri wo pɛ mu bɔ, anaa wo mmasoɔ afɔdeɛ.

Na mmom di no Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim. Baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ no, ɛhɔ na wo ne wo mma mmarima ne wo mma mmaa ne wo nkoa ne wo mfenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu. Biribiara a wobɛyɛ biara, ma w’ani nnye Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim.
Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri Lewini, nna a wode te w’asase soɔ nyinaa.
“Sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn trɛ w’ahyeɛ mu sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ wo bɔ no a, ebia wo kra kɔn bɛdɔ nam na woaka sɛ, ‘mewe nam a.’ Ɛnneɛ, hunu sɛ berɛ biara a wo kra kɔn bɛdɔ nam no, wobɛtumi awe.

Na sɛ baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua no ware ma wo a, ɛnneɛ berɛ biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ nam no, wobɛtumi akum anantwie anaa nnwan a Awurade de ama woɔ no bi awe no wo kurom, sɛdeɛ meka kyerɛɛ woɔ no.
Sɛdeɛ wowe wansane ne ɔforoteɛ no, saa ara na we no: Obi a ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nyinaa bɛtumi awe bi.
Nanso si w’adwene pi sɛ worenni mogya, ɛfiri sɛ mogya ne ɔkra no, na nni ɔkra nka nam no ho.
Nni; hwie gu fam sɛ nsuo.
Nni, na woayɛ deɛ ɛsɔ Awurade ani na asi wo ne wo nkyirimma yie.
Na w’akronkronneɛ ne wo bɔhyɛ afɔdeɛ deɛ, ma so kɔ baabi a Awurade bɛkyerɛ no.
Na fa nam ne mogya no bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia so, na hwie mmoa no mogya gu Awurade wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no ho, na nam no deɛ we.
“Hwɛ di ahyɛdeɛ a mede rema woɔ yi nyinaa so, na sɛ woyɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛsɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ani a, ɛbɛsi wo ne wo nkyirimma yie daa.
“Na sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a worekɔ hɔ akɔtu wɔn no firi w’anim, na wotu wɔn tena wɔn asase so a,
hwɛ wo ho yie na sɛ wɔsɛe wɔn a biribiara ansum wo fidie amma woankɔdi wɔn akyi. Hwɛ na woankɔbisa sɛ, ‘Ɛkwan bɛn na aman yi faa so som wɔn anyame? Na me nso menyɛ saa.’

Nyɛ biribi a ɛte saa Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn kyire na ɛyɛ no tan nyinaa na wɔyɛ ma wɔn anyame. Wɔde wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa mpo bɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ gya mu ma wɔn anyame.
Monhwɛ nni asɛm biara a maka akyerɛ mo so. Mommfa bi nnka ho, na monnyi bi nso mmfiri mu. ADEBISA NE AHONISOM HO KƆKƆBƆ
13: “Sɛ odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ bi sɔre wo mu, na ɔma wo sɛnkyerɛnne anaa anwanwadeɛ bi,
na sɛnkyerɛnne anaa anwanwadeɛ a ɔkaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ woɔ no ba mu na ɔka kyerɛ mo sɛ, ‘Momma yɛnkɔdi anyame foforɔ a monnim wɔn akyi nkɔsom wɔn a,’
monntie saa odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no anom asɛm. Monhunu sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn na resɔ mo ahwɛ sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa dɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn anaa.
Awurade mo Nyankopɔn akyi na monnie, na ɔno na monsuro no, ne mmara so na monnie, n’asɛm na montie, ɔno na monsom no, na ne ho na momfa mo ho mfam.

Saa odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no deɛ, monku no, ɛfiri sɛ wakasa sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mobɛsɔre atia Awurade mo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii mo firii Egypt asase soɔ na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie no. Ɔpɛ sɛ momane firi kwan a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ momfa soɔ no so; enti monyi bɔne biara mfiri mo mu.
“Sɛ wo nuabarima, wo maame ba paa, anaa wo babarima anaa wo babaa anaa wo yere a ɔda wo kokom anaa wo yɔnko berɛboɔ bi daadaa wo kokoam sɛ, ‘Ma yɛnkɔsom anyame foforɔ’ a wo ne w’agyanom nnim wɔn,
anyame a aman a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia a wɔbɛn mo anaa wɔwɔ akyirikyiri, ɛfiri asase ano kɔsi asase ano, som wɔn no a,
mpene so na ntie no, na nhu no mmɔbɔ, na mma wo yam nnhyehye wo mmma no, na nkata ne so;
Ku no ntɛm. Ma wo nsa nni kan wɔ ne so, na ɔman no nyinaa nni akyire mma no nwu.
Si no aboɔ ma no nwu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdane wo firi Awurade wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo firii Egypt asase so nkoafie no ho.
Enti Israelfoɔ nyinaa bɛte na wɔasuro, na wɔrenyɛ bɔne a ɛte saa bio mo mu.
“Sɛ wonya kɔtena asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no so a, ebia wobɛte sɛ obi reka no nkuro no bi mu sɛ,
‘Nnipa hunu bi asɔre pɛ sɛ wɔsɛe kuro no mufoɔ adwene, na wɔka sɛ: “Momma yɛnkɔsom anyame foforɔ” a monnim wɔn.’
Ɛba saa a hwehwɛ asɛm no mu hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ anaa. Na wohunu sɛ wɔayɛ akyiwadeɛ a ɛte saa wɔ wo mu ampa a,
fa nkrantɛ kunkum nnipa a wɔwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa. Na fa nkrantɛ sɛe kuro no ne emu nneɛma ne emu nyɛmmoa nyinaa pasaa.
Afei boaboa asadeɛ a aka nyinaa ano gu kuro no mfimfini, na fa gya hye kuro no ne asadeɛ no nyinaa sɛ afɔdeɛ mu ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Kuro no bɛdane amamfo akɔsi daa, na wɔrenkyekyere bio.
Na mma abusudeɛ no bi nnka wo nsam na ama Awurade bo adwo na ne yam ahyehye no na wahu wo mmɔbɔ na wama w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛdeɛ ɔkaa w’agyanom ntam no.
Enti tie Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na di n’ahyɛdeɛ a mede rema wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so na woayɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ani so. Mmoa a monni ne deɛ monnni
14: “Awurade mo Nyankopɔn mma ne mo. Enti monhwɛ na awufoɔ nti moantwitwa mo ho akam na moanyi mo moma nwi.
Wo deɛ, woyɛ ɔman kronkron ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, na Awurade ayi wo afiri asase so aman nyinaa mu de wo ayɛ ne man, n’agyapadeɛ titire.
“Nni akyiwadeɛ biara.
Mmoa a mobɛtumi aweɛ nie: nantwie, odwan, ne abirekyie,
ɔforoteɛ, wansane, adowa, ɔkwaduo, ɔtwe, ɔdabɔ, ne eyuo.
Mobɛtumi awe aboa biara a ne nan mu apae ayɛ nta na ɔpu wesa.
Nanso mmoa a wɔpu wesa anaa wɔn nan mu apae koraa yi deɛ, monnwe: yoma ne adanko ne atwaboa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔpu wesa deɛ, nanso wɔn nan mu mpaeeɛ. Wɔn ho nte mma mo.
Bio nso monnwe prako, ɛfiri sɛ ne nan mu apae deɛ, nanso ɔmpu nwesa. Ne ho nte mma mo. Monnwe wɔn nam, na monnsɔ wɔn afunu mu.
“Nsuo mu nam a mobɛtumi aweɛ nie: Aboa biara a ntɛtɛ ne abena wɔ ne ho deɛ, mobɛtumi awe.
Aboa biara a ɔnni ntɛtɛ anaa abena deɛ, monnwe. Ne ho nte mma mo.
“Mobɛtumi awe anomaa biara a ne ho teɛ.
Nanso yeinom deɛ monnwe: ɔkɔdeɛ, ɔkɔrebia, ne pɛtɛ tuntum,
ne ɔkompɛtɛ ne ɔkom ne asansa, ne wɔn a wɔn su te saa;
ne kwaakwaadabi ahodoɔ nyinaa;
ne sohori, ɔpatuo, asomfenakatakyi, ne akorɔma, ne wɔn a wɔn su te saa;
ne ɔpatubiaa, patuo asotenten, ne suborɔkokɔ,
ne pokupoku, pɛtɛ, ne po so anene,
ne asukɔnkɔn ne asunoma ahodoɔ a wɔn su te saa, ne asɔkwaa ne apan.
Bio nso ntuboa manyamanya biara ho nte mma mo. Monnwe.
Nanso mobɛtumi awe ntuboa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa.

“Monnwe aboa funu biara. Fa ma ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔte wo kuro pono ano ma no nwe, anaa tɔn ma ɔmamfrani a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛ ɔman kronkron ma Awurade mo Nyankopɔn. “Nnoa abirekyie ba wɔ ne maame nufosuo mu.
“Afe biara kyɛ w’afuo mu nnɔbaeɛ nyinaa mu du na fa baako bra.

Afei fa w’ayuo ne wo nsa foforɔ ne wo ngo nkyɛmu du mu baako, ne w’anantwie ne wo nnwan mu mmakan bra baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua no. Fa bra bɛdi no n’anim na ama woasua sɛ wobɛsuro Awurade wo Nyankopɔn daa.
“Na sɛ baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua no ware dodo sɛ wobɛsoa nneɛma no akɔ hɔ na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo a,
ɛnneɛ dane no sika na kyekyere kura kɔ baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi asi hɔ no.

Na sɛ woduru hɔ a, fa sika no tɔ biribiara a wo kra kɔn dɔ: nantwie, odwan, abirekyie, bobesa anaa mmosa foforɔ biara. Biribiara a wo kra pɛ no, fa bra bɛdi no Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim, na wo ne wo fiefoɔ nyinaa ani nnye.
Na mmu w’ani ngu Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro pono ano no so, ɛfiri sɛ wannya w’agyapadeɛ no mu kyɛfa biara.
“Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa awieeɛ no, fa nnɔbaeɛ a wonyaa no saa afe no mu nkyɛmu du mu baako bra wo kuro apono mu.

Na ɛsiane sɛ Lewifoɔ annya w’agyapadeɛ no mu kyɛfa nti, wɔne ahɔhoɔ ne nnyanka ne akunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu bɛba abɛdi amee, na adwuma biara a wo nsa bɛsɔ mu no, Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira so. Afe a ɛtɔ so nson no ho mmara
15: “Mfeɛ nson biara awieeɛ no, fa ɛka biara kyɛ.
Ɛho akwankyerɛ nie: Obiara mfa ka a ne yɔnko de no no nkyɛ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔyere ne yɔnko anaa ne nua sɛ ɔntua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde ka no akyɛ wɔ Awurade anim.
Ɔhɔhoɔ deɛ, wobɛtumi ayere no ama no atua wo ka; nanso sɛ wo biribi kɔdi wo nua nkyɛn a, gya ma no.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛhia obi wɔ wo kurom, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛhyira wo asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo sɛ agyapadeɛ no so.
Deɛ ɛhia ara ne sɛ wobɛtie Awurade wo Nyankopɔn asɛm na woadi ahyɛdeɛ a mede rema wo nnɛ yi nyinaa soɔ.
Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ wo bɔ no, na wobɛnya wo ho de bi afɛm amanaman pii, na wo deɛ, worenkɔfɛm hwee; na wobɛdi amanaman pii so, na wo deɛ, wɔrenni wo so.
“Sɛ woduru asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no so na ɛhia wo nua bi wɔ wo kurom a, mma w’akoma anaa wo nsam nnyɛ den wo nua hiani no so.
Na mmom bue wo nsam ma no na fa deɛ ɔhia biara fɛm no.

Hwɛ yie na nsusuiɛ bɔne biara amma w’akomam sɛ, ‘Aka kakraa bi na afe a ɛtɔ so nson a wɔde ka kyɛ no abɛn.’ Sɛ wodwene saa a, wobɛkata w’ani abɔ wo nua hiani no atirimuɔden. Ɛba saa a, wo nti ɔbɛsu afrɛ Awurade na ɛbɛdane bɔne ama wo.
Enti pɛ biribi na yi yam ma no; na mma no nyɛ w'akoma ahi sɛ wobɛma no; na ama Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahwɛ so ahyira biribiara a woyɛ so, deɛ wo nsa bɛsɔ mu biara.
Na hunu sɛ ohiani rempa w’asase so. Yei nti na merehyɛ wo sɛ, ‘Bue wo nsam ma wo nua a ne ho akyere no anaa deɛ ahia no w’asase soɔ’ no.
“Sɛ wɔtɔn wo nua Hebrini barima anaa ɔbaa ma wo, na ɔsom wo mfeɛ nsia a, afe a ɛtɔ so nson no, gyaa no ma no nkɔ.
Na sɛ wogyaa no a, mma no mmfa nsapan nnkɔ.
Fa wo nnwan ne wo nnɔbaeɛ ne wo ngo ne wo nsa no bi gya no kwan. Hwɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira woɔ na wo nso pɛ biribi ma no.
Kae sɛ na woyɛ akoa wɔ Egypt asase so na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn gyee woɔ. Ɛno nti na mede mmara yi rema wo nnɛ no.
“Nanso sɛ ɔdɔ wo ne wo fiefoɔ, na ɔte nka sɛ wanya asetena pa wo nkyɛn a, ebia ɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Mempɛ sɛ mefiri wo nkyɛn!’
Ɛba saa a, fa no twere pono na fa fitiiɛ bɔ n’asom tokuro ma no nyɛ w’akoa afebɔɔ. Sɛ ɔyɛ afenaa nso a yɛ no saa ara.
Mma no nnyɛ wo den sɛ wobɛgyaa no ama no akorɔ, ɛfiri sɛ adwuma a ɔde mfeɛ nsia yɛeɛ no yɛ apaafoɔ mmienu adwuma, na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira deɛ woayɛ biara so.
“Hyira wo nnwan ne w’anantwie mmakan a wɔyɛ anini no so kronkron ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Mfa wo nantwie abakan nyɛ adwuma na ntwitwa wo dwan abakan ho nwi.
Wo ne wo fiefoɔ nwe no Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim afe biara wɔ baabi a Awurade bɛkyerɛ no.
Na sɛ aboa no atɔ apakye anaa n’ani abɔ anaa wadi dɛm foforɔ biara a, mfa no mmɔ afɔdeɛ mma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn.
We no wo kuro apono mu. Obiara a ne ho teɛ ne deɛ ne ho nteɛ nyinaa bɛtumi awe bi, te sɛ wansane ne ɔforoteɛ.
Nanso hwɛ na woanni ne mogya. Hwie gu fam sɛ nsuo.
16: “Kae bosome Abib [anaa Oforisuo] na di twam ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ bosome Abib mu na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn yii wo firii Egypt anadwo.
Ɛno nti fa odwan ne nantwie bɔ twam afɔdeɛ ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn wɔ baabi a Awurade de ne din bɛdua no.

Di no nnanson, na mfa biribiara a emu aka nka ho. Fa paanoo a mmɔreka nnim, anaa ahoyera paanoo, ka ho di, ɛfiri sɛ wode ahoperɛ na ɛfirii Egypt asase so baeɛ. Na wo nkwa nna nyinaa wobɛkae da a wofirii Egypt no.
Na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhunu mmɔreka obiara nkyɛn wɔ asase no nyinaa so nnanson. Afei sɛ wokum aboa no da a ɛdi kan anwummerɛ a, nnya bi mma adeɛ nnkye so.
Wontumi nkum twam aboa no wɔ nkuro a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no biara mu kɛkɛ.
Mmom gye baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua no, ɛhɔ na kum twam aboa no. Ku no anwummerɛ, berɛ a awia akɔtɔ, te sɛ berɛ a wofirii Egypt no.
Baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛyie no, ɛhɔ na siesie twam no na di no, na adeɛ kye anɔpa a woasan akɔ wo ntomadan mu.
Di paanoo a mmɔreka nnim nnansia, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no bɛyɛ nhyiamu titire ama Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Nyɛ adwuma biara.
“Na kan adapɛn nnanson. Kan firi da a ɛdi kan a wode wo kantankrankyi bɛto w’ayuo so sɛ woretwa no; kan adapɛn nson firi saa berɛ no.
Na di adapɛn afahyɛ ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Fa ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɛfiri wo pɛ mu bra sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira woɔ.

Na wo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ wo nkyɛn nyinaa ani nnye Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim. Wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa, w’akoa ne w’afenaa, Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro pono mu ne ɔhɔhoɔ, agyanka ne okunafoɔ nyinaa ani nnye baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua no.
Di ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa so na kae sɛ na woyɛ akoa wɔ Egypt.
“Di asese afahyɛ no nnanson. Ɛyɛ berɛ a woboaboa wo nnɔbaeɛ ne wo ngo ne wo nsa ano.
Ɛduru afahyɛ berɛ yi a ma w’ani nnye, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa, w’akoa ne w’afenaa, Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ, agyanka ne okunafoɔ a ɔwɔ wo kuro pono mu.

Di afahyɛ no nnanson fa hyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn animuonyam baabi a Awurade bɛkyerɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo nnɔbaeɛ ne wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa so. Enti deɛ wobɛyɛ ara ne sɛ wobɛma w’ani agyeɛ.

“Afe biara ɔbarima biara bɛba abɛgyina Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim mprɛnsa wɔ baabi a ɔbɛkyerɛ no: berɛ a woredi paanoo a mmɔreka nnim afahyɛ ne adapɛn afahyɛ ne asese afahyɛ no. Mma obiara mmfa nsapan mmma Awurade anim.
Obiara nhwɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira no ho mfa n’akyɛdeɛ mmra. Atemmufoɔ ne atemmuo ho asɛm
“Sisi atemmufoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ wɔ nkuro a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama abusuakuo biara no apono ano, na wɔmfa atɛntenenee mmu ɔman no atɛn.
Mmu atɛnkyea (Nnane atemmuo ani). Nhwɛ nnipa anim, na nnye adanmudeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ adanmudeɛ fira anyansafoɔ ani, na ɛtumi ma ateneneefoɔ sesa wɔn ano.
Asɛntenenee, na die na woanya nkwa na woakɔfa asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no.
“Nnua dua biara mfa nyɛ abosomnua wɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a wobɛsie no ho.
“Nyɛ abosom adum biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ adeɛ a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn kyiri koraa.
17: “Mfa nantwie anaa odwan a ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho anaa adebɔne biara mmɔ afɔdeɛ mma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.
“Sɛ wɔhunu wo mu, wo nkuro a ɔde rema woɔ no biara mu ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ani soɔ bu apam so,
na ɔkɔ kɔsom anyame foforɔ bi te sɛ awia anaa bosome anaa ɔsoro asafo a mabara no mu biara,
na wɔka ma wote na wohwehwɛ asɛm no mu yie hunu sɛ ampa wayɛ akyiwadeɛ a ɛte saa wɔ Israel a,
ɛnneɛ fa ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a ɔyɛɛ saa bɔne no bra kuro no pono ano, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa biara a ɔyɛɛ saa no, na si no aboɔ ma no nwu.
Adansefoɔ mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa anom asɛm so na wɔnnyina nku no. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔgyina danseni baako anom asɛm so ku no.
Adansefoɔ no nsa nni kan wɔ ne so, na ɔman no nyinaa nni akyire mma no nwu. Yɛ saa fa yi bɔne biara firi wo mu.

“Sɛ obi hwie mogya gu anaa ɔne ne yɔnko twe manso anaa ɔpira ne yɔnko na ɛyɛ asɛm a asɔre wo kuro pono ano, na asɛm no mu yɛ duru ma wo sɛ wobɛdie a, ɛnneɛ sɔre kɔ baabi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ayi asi hɔ no,
na kɔhunu Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no na fa asɛm no to wɔn anim na wɔnkyerɛ wo atɛn a buo.
Hwɛ di asɛm biara a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo baabi a Awurade ayi asi hɔ no so, na biribiara a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo sɛ yɛ no, yɛ no saa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mmara no mu asɛm biara a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ anaa atɛn biara a wɔbɛbuo no, di so. Mmane mfiri asɛm a wɔbɛka akyerɛ woɔ no ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum.
Sɛ obi yɛ ahantan na wantie ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔgyina Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim resom anaa ɔtemmufoɔ no a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔwuo, na yi bɔne biara firi Israel.
Ɛba saa a, ɔman no nyinaa bɛte na wɔasuro na wɔanni ahantansɛm bio.
“Sɛ woduru asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so na wofa tena so, na woka sɛ: Mɛsi me so hene sɛ amanaman a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no nyinaa a,
ɛnneɛ obi a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi no na ɛsɛ sɛ wode no si wo so hene. Ma wo nuanom bi nni wo so hene. Wontumi mma ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔnyɛ wo nua nni wo so.
Nanso ɔnhwɛ yie na n’ani ammere apɔnkɔ pii na ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔma nkurɔfoɔ no san kɔ Egypt kɔpɛ apɔnkɔ pii, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade aka akyerɛ mo sɛ, ‘Monnsane nnkɔfa kwan yi so bio.’
Afei ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔware mmaa bebree na n’akoma ammane, na saa ara na ɛnsɛ sɛ n’ani bere dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ pii.
Na sɛ ɔnya bɛtena n’ahennwa so a, ɔnhwɛ mmara a ɛwɔ Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no nkyɛn no so ntwerɛ bi wɔ nwoma mu mfa.
“Na ɔmfa nto ne ho na ɔnkenkan ne nkwa nna nyinaa na ama wasuro Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn, na wadi mmara yi mu nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa so.

Ɔnyɛ saa na n’akoma amma ne ho so ansene ne nuanom na wammane amfiri ahyɛdeɛ yi ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahennie mu wɔ Israel, ɔne ne mma nyinaa. Asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ agyapadeɛ ne AWURADE
18: “Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no, Lewi abusuakuo mu no nyinaa, rennya kyɛfa anaa agyapadeɛ biara wɔ Israel. Egya afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma Awurade no ne kyɛfa a wɔbɛdie.
Enti Lewini biara rennya agyapadeɛ wɔ ne nuanom mu. Awurade ne n’agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no no.
“Berɛ biara a ɔman no de aboa bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no, nantwie oo, odwan oo, asɔfoɔ no kyɛfa a wɔde bɛma wɔn nie: n’abasa ne n’apantan ne ne furu.
Afei fa w’ayuo a ɛdi kan ne wo nsa ne wo ngo foforɔ ne wo nnwan ho nwi a wobɛdi kan atwitwa ma no.
Ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ayi no afiri mmusua no nyinaa mu sɛ ɔne ne mma nsom Awurade din mu daa.
“Na sɛ Lewini bi te Israel nkuro no bi mu na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔba baabi a Awurade akyerɛ no a,
ɛnneɛ ɔno nso nsom wɔ Awurade ne Nyankopɔn din mu sɛdeɛ ne nuanom Lewifoɔ nyinaa gyina Awurade anim som no no.
Deɛ wɔbɛdie no, ɔno nso bɛnya saa ara bi adi de aka deɛ ɔbɛnya afiri n’agyanom nneɛma a ɔbɛtɔn mu no ho. Amanaman nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ
“Sɛ woduru asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no so a, nsua akyiwadeɛ a saa aman no yɛ no bi.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ obi a ɔyɛ abusudeɛ yi bi tena mo mu: obi a ɔma ne babarima anaa ne babaa fa gya mu, deɛ ɔhyɛ abosonkɔm, bayifoɔ anaa ɔyi nkonyaa, deɛ ɔhwehwɛ hyɛberɛ ho sɛnkyerɛnne anaa ɔdi asumansɛm,
ne nkaberɛkyerefoɔ anaa ɔkɔ abisa, ɔkɔmfoɔ anaa samanfrɛfoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kyiri obi a ɔyɛ yeinom, na akyiwadeɛ yi nti na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn repamo wɔn afiri w’anim yi.
Hwɛ na wo ho amma asɛm Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim.
“Na amanaman a worekɔtu wɔn no tie nkonyaayifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ abosonkɔm. Nanso wo deɛ, Awurade wo Nyankopɔn mmaa wo kwan sɛ yɛ saa. Wɔntie Onyankopɔn diyifoɔ no
Mmom Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi odiyifoɔ bi a ɔte sɛ me afiri wo nuanom mu ama wo; ɔno na montie no.
Sɛdeɛ wobisaa Awurade wo Nyankopɔn wɔ Horeb, da a asafo no bɔɔ dwa no. Saa da no na wokaa sɛ, ‘Mma mennte Awurade me Nyankopɔn nne bio, na mma mennhunu egya kɛseɛ yi bio na manwu.’
Enti Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Deɛ wɔaka no nyinaa yɛ.
Mɛyi odiyifoɔ bi te sɛ wo afiri wɔn nuanom mu ama wɔn, na mede me nsɛm bɛhyɛ n’anom, na deɛ mɛka akyerɛ no biara, ɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn.
Na ɛbɛba sɛ obiara a ɔrentie m’asɛm a ɔbɛka no me din mu no, mɛma no ayi n’ano.
“‘Nanso sɛ odiyifoɔ bi sɔre gyina de me din ka biribi a menhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnka anaa ɔde anyame foforɔ din ka biribi a, saa odiyifoɔ no bɛwu.
Na ebia wobɛka no w’akomam sɛ: “Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahunu asɛm a Awurade nkaeɛ?”
Sɛ odiyifoɔ bi kasa wɔ Awurade din mu, na asɛm korɔ no amma mu anaa ɛnyɛ nokorɛ a, na asɛm no mfiri Awurade; ahantan mu na odiyifoɔ no kasaeɛ, nsuro no.’
19: “Sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn sɛe aman a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn nsase rema woɔ no, na wokɔtena wɔn nkuro ne wɔn afie mu a,
yiyi nkuro mmiɛnsa si w'asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
Kyɛ asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no mu mmiɛnsa, na siesie akwan a ɛkɔ nkuro no mu na sɛ obi ka mogya gu a, wadwane akɔ hɔ.
“Na sɛ obi ka mogya gu a, deɛ ɛbɛma no adwane akɔ hɔ akɔnya ne tiri adidi mu nie: Sɛ wanhyɛ da na ɔkum ne yɔnko na ɔntane no dada,
anaa sɛ ɔne ne yɔnko kɔ anyina na ɔma akuma so sɛ ɔretwa gya na dadeɛ no hɔn firi dua no so bɛbɔ ne yɔnko no ma no wu a, ɔnnwane nkɔ nkuro yi baako mu na ɔnnya nkwa.
Anyɛ saa a, deɛ wawuo no busuani de abufuhyeɛ bɛtaa nipakumfoɔ no, na ɛsiane sɛ ɛkwan no wareɛ nti, ɔbɛto no aku no, nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔwuo ɛfiri sɛ na ɔntane no dada.
Ɛno nti na maka sɛ, ‘Yi nkuro mmiɛnsa si hɔ’ no.
“Na sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn trɛ w’ahyeɛ mu sɛdeɛ ɔkaa w’agyanom ntam no na ɔde asase a ɔhyɛɛ w’agyanom bɔ sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no nyinaa ma wo,
na sɛ wodi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so yɛ, na wodɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na wonante n’akwan so nna nyinaa a, ɛnneɛ yiyi nkuro mmiɛnsa bio ka mmiɛnsa no ho.
Yei bɛma woakwati sɛ wobɛhwie mogya a asɛm nni ho agu asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no so, na woanni mogya ho fɔ.
“Nanso sɛ ɛba sɛ obi tane ne yɔnko na ɔkɔtɛ no na ɔto hyɛ ne so de biribi bɔ no ma no wu, na ɔdwane kɔ nkuro yi bi mu a,
ɛnneɛ ne kurom mpanimfoɔ nsoma nkɔfa no mfiri hɔ, na wɔmfa no nhyɛ obusuani no nsa, na ɔnwu.
Nhu no mmɔbɔ, na yi mogya a ɛdi bem ho asodie firi Israel na asi wo yie.
“Sɛ wonya kɔtena asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no so na wo nsa ka w’agyapadeɛ a, mpia wo yɔnko hyeɛ a wo tetefoɔ ato dada wɔ asase no soɔ no.
“Onipa baako rentumi nsɔre nni adanseɛ ntia obi wɔ mfomsoɔ anaa bɔne bi ho, bɔne biara a wayɛ ho. Adansefoɔ mmienu anaa mmiɛnsa anom nsɛm so na asɛm no nnyina.
Sɛ obi a ɔwɔ adwemmɔne kɔdi ne yɔnko ho adansekunumu sɛ wato mmara a,
ɛnneɛ nnipa mmienu a asɛm no fa wɔn ho no mmɛgyina Awurade anim wɔ asɔfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no anim.
Na atemmufoɔ no nhwehwɛ asɛm no mu yie, na sɛ ɛbɛda adi sɛ ɔdanseni no redi adansekunumu na watwa asɛm no ato ne nua no so a,
ɛnneɛ deɛ ɔbɔɔ pɔ sɛ anka ɔbɛyɛ ne nua no, mo nso monyɛ no saa ara, na monyi adebɔne biara mfiri mo mu.
Ɛba saa a wɔn a wɔaka no bɛte na wɔasuro, na wɔrenyɛ bɔne a ɛte saa bio wɔ mo mu.
Nhu obiara mmɔbɔ: ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu, ani nsi ani ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu, nsa nsi nsa ananmu, na ɛnan nsi ɛnan ananmu.
20: “Sɛ wo ne w’atamfo rekɔko na wohunu sɛ wɔwɔ apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne dɔm a wɔdɔɔso sene woɔ a, nsuro wɔn ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo firii Egypt asase soɔ no ka wo ho.
Na sɛ morebɛn dɔm no a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mmɛkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no,
na ɔnka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Israel montie, ɛnnɛ morebɛn mo atamfo ne wɔn akɔko. Mommma mo akoma nntu, monnsuro wɔn na mo ho mmpopo, na mommma wɔn ho nnyɛ mo hu,
ɛfiri sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ka mo ho, na ɔne mo atamfo bɛko ama mo na wagye mo.’
“Na ahwɛfoɔ no nso mmɛkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ, ‘Hwan na wasi fie foforɔ a ɔmmuee ano? Ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie na wankɔwu akono amma obi foforɔ ammue ano.
Hwan na wayɛ bobeturo a ɔnnya ntee soɔ no? Ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie na wankɔwu akono amma obi foforɔ amfa.
Hwan na wagye ɔbaa bi awareɛ na ɔnnya nhyiaa no? Ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie na wankɔwu akono amma ɔbarima foforɔ ankɔfa no.’
Na ahwɛfoɔ no nsane nka nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ, ‘Hwan na ɔsuro na n’akoma atuo? Ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie na wantu ne nuanom akoma sɛdeɛ n’akoma atuo no.’
Na sɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne ɔman no kasa wie a, wɔnyiyi asafohene nsisi asraafoɔ no so na wɔnni ɔman no anim.
“Sɛ wobɛn kuro bi ne no rekɔko a, ka asomdwoeɛsɛm kyerɛ no.
Na sɛ kuro no de asomdwoeɛ hyia wo na ɔbue n’apono ma wo a, ɛnneɛ fa emu nnipa nyinaa yɛ nkoa na wɔnsom wo.
Na sɛ kuro no amfa asomdwoeɛ anhyia wo na ɔne wo ko a, ka no hyem,
na sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nso de kuro no hyɛ wo nsa a, fa nkrantɛ kunkum emu mmarima nyinaa.
Na fa kuro no mu mmaa ne mmɔfra nkumaa ne nyɛmmoa ne biribiara a ɛwɔ hɔ, na di w’atamfo a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn ama woɔ no asadeɛ.
“Saa na fa yɛ nkuro a ɛne wo ntam twe paa no nyinaa; a ɛnyɛ aman a ɛwɔ ha yi nkuro no bie no.
Na sɛ aman a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo sɛ agyapadeɛ yi deɛ, mma biribiara a ɛhome wɔ nkuro no mu nnnya nkwa.
Na sɛe wɔn pasaa: Hitifoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ ne Hiwifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ, sɛdeɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ woɔ no.
Na wɔankyerɛ mo akyiwadeɛ a wɔyɛ ma wɔn anyame no, na moanyɛ bɔne antia Awurade mo Nyankopɔn.
“Sɛ worekɔko afa kuro bi na woka no hyem nna pii a, mfa akuma nsɛe ɛhɔ nnua, ɛfiri sɛ ɛso aba no bi na wobɛdie. Enti ntwitwa ngu. Dua yɛ nipa na woaka no ahyem?
Nanso dua a wɔnni n’aba deɛ, twa twene. Sisi akoban twa kuro a ɛne wo reko no ho hyia kɔsi sɛ wobɛbrɛ no aseɛ. awudie, agyapadeɛ, aniɛden ne ɔsene ho mmara
21: “Sɛ wonya kɔtena asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so na da bi wohunu sɛ wɔakum obi ato wuram, na obiara nnim deɛ ɔdii awuo no a,
ɛnneɛ wo kurom mpanimfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ nkɔsusu mfiri faako a deɛ wawuo no da no nkɔ nkuro a ɛwowɔ mpɔtamu hɔ no,
na wɔnhwɛ kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wawuo no. Ɛba saa a kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa nantwie ba a ɔnyɛɛ adwuma da na wɔmfaa kɔnnua ntoo ne so da mmra.
Na kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa nantwie ba no nkɔ subɔnhwa a nsuo sene mu, baabi a wɔnnɔɔ da na wɔnnuaa hwee hɔ da. Afei wɔmmu nantwie ba no kɔn mu wɔ subɔnhwa no mu.

“Na Lewi mma asɔfoɔ no mmra hɔ ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ayi wɔn sɛ wɔnsom no na wɔmfa Awurade din nhyira, na sɛ obi pira ne yɔnko na asɛm sɔre a, wɔn anom asɛm so na wɔbɛgyina abua asɛm no.
Afei mpanimfoɔ a wɔwɔ kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wawuo no mu nyinaa mmra, na wɔnhohoro wɔn nsa ngu nantwie ba a wɔabu ne kɔn mu wɔ subɔn no mu no so.
Na wɔnka sɛ, ‘Ɛnyɛ yɛn nsa na ɛhwiee mogya yi guiɛ, na yɛn ani nso anhunu sɛ obi reyɛ saa.
Enti O Awurade, mmu wo man Israel a woagye wɔn no fɔ wɔ asɛm yi ho, na mfa mogya a ɛdi bem ho afɔbuo ngu wo man Israel so.’ Na fa mogya ho bɔne yi firi wɔn.
Na ɛbɛma woayɛ deɛ ɛtene Awurade ani soɔ na yi mogya a ɛdi bem ho afɔbuo firi wo mu.
“Sɛ wo ne w’atamfo kɔko na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn hyɛ wo nsa na wofa wɔn nnommum,
na wohunu ɔbaa bi wɔ nnommum no mu a ne ho yɛ fɛ, na wodɔ no na wopɛ sɛ woware no a,
ɛnneɛ fa no kɔ wo fie. Afei ɔnyi ne tiri nwi na ɔmmubu ne mmɔwerɛ.
Na ɔnyi n’atadeɛ berɛ a wɔde no baeɛ na ɛhyɛ no no na ɔntena wo fie nsu ne papa ne ne maame bosome baako. Sɛ ɔwie a, kɔ ne ho na ware no na ɔmmɛyɛ wo yere.
Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wompɛ no bio a, ma no mfa ne ho nkɔdi sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ, na tɔn deɛ, ntɔn no nnye sika, ɛne no nnni no sɛ afenaa, ɛfiri sɛ woahodwo no.
“Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ yerenom mmienu na ɔdɔ baako tane baako, na mmaa mmienu yi nyinaa wo mmarima ma no na deɛ ɔtane no no ba ne panin a,
ɛnneɛ da a ɔbɛkyɛ agyapadeɛ ama ne mma no, ɔrentumi nsian deɛ ɔtane no no ba a ɔyɛ panin no ho mfa abakan kyɛfa mma deɛ ɔdɔ no no ba no.
Na ɔmmu deɛ ɔtane no no ba no abakan; ɔbɛma no biribiara mu mmɔho mmienu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ne n’ahoɔden mfitiaseɛ. Abakan dibea yɛ ne dea.
“Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ ɔba tuatefoɔ a n’aso yɛ den, na ɔntie ne papa ne ne maame asɛm, na wɔtea no na ɔntie wɔn a,
ɛnneɛ ne papa ne ne maame mfa no mmra ne kurom mpanimfoɔ anim wɔ kuro no pono ano.
Na wɔnka nkyerɛ ne kurom mpanimfoɔ sɛ, ‘Yɛn ba yi yɛ otuatefoɔ a n’aso yɛ den; ɔntie yɛn asɛm; ɔyɛ odidifoɔ ne ɔsabofoɔ.’
Afei ne kurom mmarima nyinaa nsi no aboɔ mma no nwu. Yɛ saa fa yi adebɔne firi wo mfimfini na Israelfoɔ nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro.
“Sɛ ɔbarima bi yɛ bɔne a ɛsɛ owuo na wɔku no de no sɛn dua so a,
mma n’amu no nnsɛn dua so mmma adeɛ nnkye so. Hwɛ sie no da no ara ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn nnome wɔ deɛ wɔasɛn no no so, na mma efi nnka asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo sɛ agyapadeɛ no.
22: “Sɛ wohunu wo nua nantwie anaa ne dwan sɛ wayera a, ntwe wo ho mfiri ne ho. Fa no kɔma wo nua no.
Na sɛ wo nua no mmɛn wo anaa sɛ wonni no a, ɛnneɛ fa no bra wo nkyɛn wɔ wo fie kɔpem sɛ wo nua no bɛba abɛhwehwɛ no na wode no ama no.
Sɛ wo nua afunumu anaa n’atadeɛ anaa ne biribiara yera na wohunu a, saa ara na wobɛyɛ no; worentumi ntwe wo ho.
“Sɛ wohunu sɛ wo nua afunumu anaa ne nantwie ahwe ase da kwan mu a, nsian wɔn ho nkɔ. Boa no ma no mma wɔn so.
“Ɔbaa nnhyɛ ɔbarima atadeɛ, na ɔbarima nso nnhyɛ ɔbaa atadeɛ. Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn kyiri obi a ɔyɛ yeinom.
“Sɛ wonam na wohunu sɛ anomaa pirebuo sɛn dua so anaa ɛda fam, na anomaa mma anaa nkosua wom, na maame no butu ne mma anaa ne nkosua so a, hwɛ na woamfa maame no anka ne mma no ho.
Ma maame no nkɔ na fa ne mma no. Sɛ woyɛ saa a ɛbɛsi wo yie na wo nna aware.
“Sɛ wosi fie foforɔ a, gye ban wɔ dan no atifi na obi amfiri hɔ anhwe ase, na wo fie anni mogya ho fɔ.
“Nnua aba mmienu a ɛsono emu biara wɔ wo bobeturo mu, anyɛ saa a wobɛgye nnɔbaeɛ no ne bobeturo no mu aba nyinaa akɔ kronkronbea hɔ.
“Mfa nantwie ne afunumu mmɔ mu mfuntum asase.
“Nhyɛ atadeɛ a wɔde odwan nwi ne nwera abom anwene.
“Yɛ wo ntoma a wode kata wo ho no anoano nnan no nnwo.
“Sɛ ɔbarima ware na ɔkɔ ɔbaa no ho na afei na ɔmpɛ no bio a,
ebia ɔbɛbɔ no dimmɔne agu n’anim ase sɛ, ‘Mewaree ɔbaa yi, nanso mekɔɔ ne ho no, manhunu hwee a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu.’
Ɛba saa a, ababaa no papa ne ne maame mfa deɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ ababaa no yɛ ɔbaabunu mmɛkyerɛ kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ wɔ kuro no pono ano.
Afei ababaa no papa nka nkyerɛ mpanimfoɔ no sɛ, ‘Mede me babaa maa ɔbarima yi awareɛ, nanso ɔmpɛ no bio.

Na ɔbɔ no soboɔ sɛ wayɛ animguasedeɛ na ɔka sɛ: “Manhunu hwee a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo babaa no yɛ ɔbaabunu.” Nanso deɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ me babaa no yɛ ɔbaabunu nie.’ Afei wɔntrɛ nnasoɔ no mu wɔ kurom hɔ mpanimfoɔ anim.
Na kurom hɔ mpanimfoɔ ntwe ɔbarima no aso.
Na wɔnnye nnwetɛbena ɔha mfiri ɔbarima no nkyɛn mfa mma ababaa no papa, ɛfiri sɛ wabɔ Israelni baabunu dimmɔne. Ɔbɛkɔ so ne no atena sɛ ne yere; ɔrentumi nnyaa no ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
“Na sɛ ɛba sɛ asɛm no yɛ nokorɛ na wɔanhunu adanseɛ biara a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ababaa no yɛ ɔbaabunu a,
ɛnneɛ wɔmfa ababaa no mmɛgyina ne papa fie anim na ne kurom mmarima nsi no aboɔ mma no nwu, ɛfiri sɛ wayɛ aniwudeɛ wɔ Israel sɛ wabɔ adwaman wɔ ne papa fie. Yɛ saa fa yi adebɔne firi wo mfimfini.
“Sɛ wɔhunu sɛ ɔbarima bi ne obi yere ada a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn mmienu wuo, ɔbarima a ɔyɛɛ saa no ne ɔbaa no nyinaa. Yɛ saa fa yi adebɔne firi Israel.
“Sɛ ɔbarima bi nsa da ababaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu so na ɔbarima foforɔ hu no kurom na ɔne no da a,

momfa wɔn mmienu mmra kuro no pono ano na monsi wɔn aboɔ mma wɔnwu. Deɛ enti a ɛsɛ sɛ ababaa no wuo ne sɛ ɔwɔ kurom nso wanteateam, na ɔbarima no nso abrɛ ne yɔnko yere ase. Yɛ saa fa yi bɔne firi wo mfimfini.
“Nanso sɛ ɔbarima no kyee ababaa a obi nsa da ne soɔ no wɔ wuram na ɔne no daeɛ a, ɛnneɛ ɔbarima a ɔne no daeɛ no na ɔbɛwuo,
na ababaa no deɛ, nyɛ no hwee. Ababaa no nyɛɛ bɔne biara a ɛsɛ owuo, ɛfiri sɛ asɛm yi te sɛ deɛ ɔbarima bi ato ahyɛ ne yɔnko so aku no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ wuram na ɔhunuu no. Ababaa a obi nsa da ne soɔ no teateaam nanso na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
“Sɛ ɔbarima bi hunu ababaa bi a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu a obiara nsa nna ne soɔ na ɔkye no ne no da na wɔhu wɔn a,
ɛnneɛ ɔbarima a ɔne no daeɛ no ntua sika nnwetɛbena aduonum mma ɔbaa no papa na ɔnware no ɛfiri sɛ wabrɛ no ase. Ɔrentumi nnyaa no ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
“Ɔbarima biara mmfa ne papa yere na ɔnnyi ne papa adagya so. Deɛ ɔmfata sɛ ɔba AWURADE badwa mu
23: “Ɔbarima biara a ne hwewa mu aba apɛkyɛ anaa deɛ ne barima so atwa ntumi mma Awurade badwa mu.
“Obiara a ɔwoo no adwaman bɔ kwan soɔ ntumi mma Awurade asafo mu. N’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du a wɔbɛdi n’akyi aba mpo ntumi mma Awurade asafo mu.
“Ammonni anaa Moabni biara ntumi mma Awurade asafo mu. Wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du a wɔbɛdi wɔn akyi aba mpo ntumi mma Awurade asafo mu da,
ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a mofiri Egypt reba no wɔamfa aduane ne nsuo ammɛhyia mo kwan so. Afei wɔbɔɔ Beor ba Balaam a ɔfiri Petor a ɛwɔ Mesopotamia paa sɛ ɔnnome mo.
Nanso Awurade wo Nyankopɔn antie Balaam, na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn danee nnome no yɛɛ no nhyira maa wo, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn dɔ wo.
Wo nkwa nna nyinaa, nhwehwɛ wɔn asomdwoeɛ ne wɔn yiedie da.
“Nanso ntane Edomni biara ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo nua. “Na ntane Egyptni biara nso ɛfiri sɛ na woyɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ ne kurom.
Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a wɔbɛwo wɔn no bɛtumi aba Awurade badwa mu.
“Sɛ wokɔsoɛ baabi sɛ wo ne w’atamfo rebɛko a, twe wo ho firi bɔne biara ho.
Sɛ ɔbarima wɔ wo mu na ne ho gu fi anadwo a, ne ho nte, enti ɔnkɔ nsraban no akyi. Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔba nsraban no mu.
Na ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ a, ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na sɛ awia kɔtɔ a, afei ɔmmra nsraban no mu.
Na siesie baabi nsraban no akyi na woakɔyɛ wo ho yie wɔ hɔ.
Na nya sɔsɔ wɔ wo nneɛma mu na sɛ worekɔgya wo nan mfikyire hɔ a, wode atu amena, na wowie a wode akata wo tiafi so.
Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nam wo nsraban mu sɛ ɔbɛgye wo na ɔde w’atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa. Enti ma wo nsraban mu nyɛ kronkron na wammɛhunu atantanneɛ biara wo mfimfini na wantwe ne ho amfiri wo ho.
“Sɛ akoa dwane firi ne wura nkyɛn ba wo hɔ a, mfa no nsane nkɔma ne wura no.
Ma no ntena wo nkyɛn wo nkuro no mu baabiara a ɔpɛ. Na hwɛ na woanteetee no.
“Israelni baa biara nnnane odwamanfoɔ, na saa ara na Israelni barima biara nso nnnane odwamanfoɔ.
Mfa odwamanfoɔ akatua anaa kraman boɔ mma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn fie sɛ bɔhyɛ adeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ nneɛma mmienu yi nyinaa yɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ. Mfɛntomu, bɔhyɛ ne tɔsofa ho mmara
“Mma wo nua nntua biribiara ho nsiho, sika ho nsiho, aduane ho nsiho, anaa biribi foforɔ biara a wɔgye ɛho nsiho.
Wobɛtumi agye ɔhɔhoɔ nsiho, nanso wo nua deɛ, nnye no nsiho na ama Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira biribiara a wobɛyɛ no asase a worekɔtena soɔ no so.
“Sɛ wohyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɔ a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛtua, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɛhwehwɛ afiri wo hɔ, na ɛbɛdane bɔne ama wo.
Na sɛ woanhyɛ bɔ a, ɛnneɛ wonyɛɛ bɔne biara.
Hwɛ di asɛm biara a ɛbɛfiri w’anom aba so, na biribiara a wode bɛhyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn bɔ sɛ wofiri wo pɛ mu de bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama no no, yɛ deɛ wode w’ano aka no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
“Sɛ wokɔ wo yɔnko bobeturom a, di aba dodoɔ a ɛbɛmee woɔ, nanso mfa bi ngu w’adeɛ mu.
“Sɛ wokɔ wo yɔnko ayufuo mu a, fa wo nsa pempan mmɛtem no bi, nanso hwɛ na woantwe kantankrankyi anto wo yɔnko ayufuo so. Awareɛ ne awaregyaeɛ ho mmara
24: “Sɛ ɔbarima bi ware ɔbaa na ɔhunu sɛ ɔbaa no wɔ aniwudeɛ bi ma enti ɔmpɛ no bio a, ɛnneɛ ɔntwerɛ awaregyaeɛ krataa nhyɛ ɔbaa no nsam na ɔmma no mfiri ne fie nkɔ.
Na sɛ ɔfiri ne fie kɔ na ɔkɔware ɔbarima bi,
na ekunu foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no nso ani nnye ne ho na ɔtwerɛ awaregyaeɛ krataa de hyɛ ne nsam pamo no firi ne fie, anaa sɛ ɔbarima no wu a,

ɛnneɛ ne kunu a ɔdi kan a ɔpamoo no no ntumi nware no bio berɛ a ɔbaa no ho agu fi no, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade kyiri nneyɛɛ a ɛte saa. Enti hwɛ na woamma bɔne amma asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
“Sɛ ɔbarima bi ware yerɛ foforɔ a, ɔnnkɔ ɔsa, na ɔnnyɛ adwuma foforɔ biara nso. Ɔntena fie afe na ɔmma ne yere a wafa no no ani nnye.
“Obiara nnnye oyuyammoɔ anaa ɛboɔ a ɛda soɔ no awowa. Sɛ ɔyɛ saa a, ɛyɛ ɔkra na wagye no awowa no.
“Sɛ wɔhunu sɛ obi akye ne nuanom Israelfoɔ no bi asie na ɔne no di no atirimuɔden so anaasɛ ɔtɔn no a, ɛsɛ sɛ deɛ wakye ne nua asie no wuo. Yɛ saa fa yi adebɔne firi wo mfimfini.
“Hwɛ wo ho yie kwata yadeɛ ho, na hwɛ yɛ deɛ Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no bɛkyerɛ mo nyinaa. Monni deɛ maka akyerɛ wɔn no nyinaa so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kae deɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de yɛɛ Miriam ɛkwan soɔ, berɛ a mofiri Egypt reba no.
“Sɛ wobɔ wo yɔnko bosea a, nkɔ ne fie nkɔgye deɛ ɔde asi awowa no.
Gyina abɔnten ma deɛ woabɔ no bosea no nkɔfa deɛ ɔde asi awowa no mmrɛ wo abɔnten hɔ.
Nanso sɛ onii no yɛ ohiani a, hwɛ na woamfa deɛ ɔde asi awowa no anto wo ho amma adeɛ ankye so.
Awia kɔtɔ ara a, san fa deɛ ɔde sii awowa no kɔma no na ɔmfa ne ntoma nna na ɔnhyira wo. Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nso bɛbu no tenenee ama wo.
“Nhyɛ ɔpaani, mmɔborɔni ne ohiani a ɔfiri wo nuanom anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔwɔ w’asase soɔ, wo nkuro mu no so.
Tua no ka da no ara, na mma awia nnkɔtɔ so ɛfiri sɛ ahia no, na n’akatua no ara ne ne kra anidasoɔ. Woanyɛ saa na ɔsu frɛ Awurade a, ɛbɛdane bɔne ama wo.
“Sɛ mma yɛ biribi a, nku wɔn agyanom, na sɛ agyanom nso yɛ biribi a, nku wɔn mma. Obiara bɔne ho na wɔnku no.
“Sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ anaa agyanka de asɛm ba w’anim a, nnane atemmuo ani, na nnye kunafoɔ ntoma awowa.
Na kae sɛ na woyɛ akoa Egypt asase so na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn gyee wo firii hɔ. Ɛno nti na mede mmara yi rema woɔ na woadi so.
“Sɛ wotwa w’afuo mu nnɔbaeɛ na wo werɛ firi nnɔbaeɛ a wɔakyekyere no bi wɔ hɔ a, nsane nkɔfa. Gya ma ɔhɔhoɔ ne agyanka ne okunafoɔ na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa so.
“Sɛ woporo wo ngodua a, nsane nkɔfa so bio. Gya deɛ aka soɔ no ma ɔhɔhoɔ ne agyanka ne okunafoɔ.
“Sɛ wote wo bobeturom aba a, nsane w’akyi nkɔtete deɛ aka soɔ no. Gya ma ɔhɔhoɔ ne agyanka ne okunafoɔ.
Na kae sɛ na woyɛ akoa wɔ Egypt asase so. Ɛno nti na mede mmara yi rema woɔ na woadi so.
25: “Sɛ asɛm bi si mmarima mmienu ntam na wɔde ba atemmufoɔ anim a, wɔmmu wɔn atɛn; wɔmmu deɛ n’asɛm yɛ dɛ no bem na wɔmmu deɛ n’asɛm nyɛ dɛ no fɔ.
Na sɛ ɛfata sɛ wɔhwe deɛ ɔdi fɔ no a, ɔtemmufoɔ no mma no nna hɔ wɔ n’anim na ɔmmɔ no mmaa dodoɔ a ɛne ne bɔne no sɛ.
Mmaa aduanan na ɔmmɔ no; ɔmmma no mmmoro so. Anyɛ saa na ɔhwe no boro so a, wo nua anim bɛgu ase w’anim.
“Nkyekyere nantwie ano berɛ a ɔreporo ayuo.
“Sɛ anuanom bi wɔ hɔ na baako wu berɛ a ɔnni ba a, ɛnsɛ sɛ deɛ wawuo no yere kɔware abɔntensoni. Mmom ne kunu nua no nkɔ ne ho na ɔnware no na ɔnyɛ okunu nua asɛdeɛ mma no.
Na ɔmfa ne nua a wawuo no din nto abɔfra a ɔbaa no bɛdi kan awo no no so na ne nua no din anyera amfiri Israel.

“Na sɛ ɔbarima no mpɛ sɛ ɔware ne nua yere no a, ɛnneɛ okunafoɔ no nkɔ mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn kuro no pono ano na ɔnka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Me kunu nua no mpɛ sɛ ɔma ne nua din tena Israel. Ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔware me yɛ okunu nua asɛdeɛ.’
Afei ne kurom mpanimfoɔ no mfrɛ no nkasa nkyerɛ no, na sɛ ɔgyina hɔ ka sɛ, ‘Mempɛ sɛ meware no a,’
Ɛnneɛ ɛba saa a, ɔbaa no nyi ne kunu nua no nan ase mpaboa mpanimfoɔ no anim na ɔnte ntasuo ngu n’anim nka nkyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Saa na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ɔbarima a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔkyekyere ne nua fie.’
Afei edin a wɔde bɛfrɛ no wɔ Israel ne ‘Deɛ wɔayi ne nan ase mpaboa no fie.’
“Sɛ mmarima mmienu reko na baako yere ba sɛ ɔrebɛgye ne kunu afiri deɛ ɔreboro no no nsam, na ɔtene ne sɔ ne barima mu a,
ɛnneɛ twa ɔbaa no nsa firi hɔ. Nhu no mmɔbɔ.
“Mfa nkariboɔ ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, nhyɛ wo kotokuo mu.
Mfa efa susudeɛ ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, mma wo fie.
Fa nkariboɔ a ɛtene susu biribiara pɛpɛɛpɛ, na saa ara na nya efa susudeɛ a ɛtene na ɛyɛ pɛ, na wo nkwa nna aware asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
Na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ yeinom nyinaa, wɔn a wɔtwa nkontompo nyinaa.
“Kae deɛ Amalek de yɛɛ mo berɛ a mofiri Egypt reba no.
Kae sɛdeɛ wonam kwan so a woabrɛ na woahodwo no ɔbɛto hyɛɛ wɔn a wɔaka akyire no so twaa wɔn guiɛ no; na wansuro Onyankopɔn.

Enti sɛ woduru asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so na Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ma wode wo ho firi w’atamfo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no nsam a, pepa Amalek ho nkaeɛ biara firi ɔsoro ase. Mma wo werɛ mmfiri.
26: “Na sɛ wonya duru asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ agyapadeɛ no so na wofa tena so a,
fa asase a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so aba a ɛdi kan no biara bi gu kɛntɛn mu kɔ faako a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ne din bɛdua.
Na kɔ ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no nkyɛn na ka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Mepae mu ka kyerɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nnɛ sɛ mabɛduru asase a Awurade kaa yɛn agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma yɛn no so.’
“Afei ɔsɔfoɔ no nnye kɛntɛn no mfiri wo nsam na ɔmfa nsi Awurade wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no anim.

Na ka no Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim sɛ, ‘Na m'agya yɛ Aramni a anka ɔkyinkyini; na ɔde nnipa kakraa bi kɔtenaa Egypt sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, nanso akyire yi n’asefoɔ bɛdɔɔso yɛɛ ɔman kɛseɛ a wɔn ho yɛ den na wɔdɔreeɛ.
Nanso Egyptfoɔ no firii aseɛ tane yɛn ani, na wɔhyɛɛ yɛn so maa yɛyɛɛ nkoadwuma a ɛyɛ den.
Enti yɛsu frɛɛ Awurade yɛn agyanom Nyankopɔn, na Awurade tee yɛn nne na ɔhunuu yɛn amanehunu ne yɛn haw ne yɛn ahokyerɛ.
Afei Awurade nam nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a wɔatene mu ne ahudeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwanwadeɛ so yii yɛn firii Egypt.
Na ɔde yɛn aba ha sɛ yɛmfa asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ yi.
Na afei mede asase a O Awurade de ama me no so aba a ɛdi kan aba.’ “Na fa si Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim na koto sɔre Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim.
Na gye w’ani adepa a Awurade wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo ne wo fiefoɔ no nyinaa ho, wo ne Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo mu no.

“Sɛ wowie a afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no yɛ afe a wobɛkyɛ wo nnɔbaeɛ nyinaa mu du de baako aba. Enti ɛduru saa afe no a, kyɛ w’afuo mu nnɔbaeɛ a wonyaeɛ no mu du na fa emu baako ma Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne agyanka ne okunafoɔ, na wɔnni no wo kuro mu mmee.

Na kɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim na ka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Mayi ade kronkron afiri me fie de ama Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne agyanka ne okunafoɔ sɛdeɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wode ama me no nyinaa teɛ. Memmane mfirii w’ahyɛdeɛ ho na me werɛ mfiriiɛ nso.
Berɛ a meredi awerɛhoɔ no manni bi, na berɛ a na me ho nteɛ no manyi bi, na mamfa bi amma awufoɔ biara. Matie Awurade me Nyankopɔn asɛm, na mayɛ deɛ woahyɛ me no nyinaa.
Firi wo tenabea kronkron a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no hwɛ wo man Israel na hyira wɔn ne asase a wode ama yɛn a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no, sɛdeɛ wokaa yɛn agyanom ntam no.’
“Ɛnnɛ da yi Awurade wo Nyankopɔn rehyɛ wo nnɛ sɛ di ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmusɛm yi so. Enti fa w’akoma ne wo kra nyinaa di so na yɛ.
Ɛnnɛ woapae mu aka sɛ Awurade ne wo Nyankopɔn, na wobɛnante n’akwan so na woadi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmusɛm so na woatie ne nne.
Na Awurade nso aka no wo ho nnɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ ne man, n’agyapadeɛ titire, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ wo bɔ no, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm nyinaa so.
Na wama wo so akyɛne amanaman a ɔyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa, de wo ayɛ ayeyie ne din ne animuonyam, na woayɛ ɔman kronkron ama Awurade wo Nyankopɔn sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no.” Wɔntwerɛ mmara no ngu aboɔpono so
27: Na afei Mose ne Israel mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Monhwɛ sɛ mobɛdi mmara nsɛm a mede rema mo nnɛ yi nyinaa soɔ.
Na da a mobɛtwa Yordan akɔ asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo no soɔ no, monhyehyɛ aboɔ akɛseɛ nsisi hɔ na momfa akaadoo nka ho.
Sɛ motwa kɔduru hɔ a, montwerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ngu so na moakɔtena asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so, sɛdeɛ Awurade mo agyanom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ mo bɔ no.
Enti sɛdeɛ merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi no, sɛ motwa Yordan wie a, monhyehyɛ aboɔ yi nsi Bepɔ Ebal so, na momfa akaadoo nka ho.
Bio nso, fa aboɔ si afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn. Mfa dadeɛ biara nka.
Fa aboɔ amuamu si afɔrebukyia ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn, na bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn wɔ so.
Afei bɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ na di no wɔ hɔ, na gye w’ani wɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn anim.
Na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu aboɔ no so, na ma emu nna hɔ pefee.”
Afei Mose ne Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: “O Israelfoɔ, monyɛ aso na montie. Ɛnnɛ moabɛyɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn man.
Ɛno nti montie Awurade mo Nyankopɔn asɛm, na monni ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a mede rema mo nnɛ yi so.”
Na Mose hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara sɛ:
“Sɛ motwa Yordan wie a, yeinom na wɔbɛgyina Bepɔ Gerisim so ahyira ɔman no: Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Yosef, ne Benyamin.
Na yeinom nso na wɔbɛgyina Bepɔ Ebal so adome: Ruben, Gad, Aser, Sebulon, Dan, ne Naftali.
Na Lewifoɔ no mma wɔn nne so nka mma Israelni biara nte sɛ:
“‘Nnome nka onipa a ɔyɛ ohoni a wɔasene anaa deɛ wɔaguo, Awurade akyiwadeɛ, odwumfoɔ nsa ano adwuma, a ɔde bɛsi kokoam.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nnye so sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔbɛbu ne papa anaa ne maame animtia.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔpia ne yɔnko hyeɛ kɔ akyire.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔma onifirani fom kwan.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔbu ɔhɔhoɔ, agyanka ne okunafoɔ atɛnkyea.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔne ne papa yere bɛda, ɛfiri sɛ wayi ne papa nkataho.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔne aboa biara bɛda.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔne ne nuabaa, ne papa anaa ne maame ba, bɛda.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’asebaa bɛda.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔkɔtɛ baabi de adeɛ bɔ ne yɔnko ku no.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔgye adanmudeɛ kum ɔkra a ɔnni fɔ.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
“‘Nnome nka deɛ ɔremfa mmara yi mu nsɛm nyɛ adwuma.’ Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, ‘Amen!’
28: “Na sɛ woyɛ aso tie Awurade wo Nyankopɔn asɛm na wodi ne mmara nsɛm a mede rema wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so a, Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nso bɛma wo so asene asase so aman nyinaa.
Na nhyira yi nyinaa bɛba wo so na abɛto wo, ɛfiri sɛ wotie Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nne:
“Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kurom na nhyira aka wo wɔ afuo mu.
