14: Na berɛ a na Amrafel di Sinar soɔ, na Ariok di Elasar soɔ, na Kedorlaomer di Elam soɔ na Tidal di Goiim soɔ no,
wɔka boom ko tiaa Sodom hene Bera, Gomora hene Birsa, Adma hene Sinab, Seboiim hene Semeber, ne Bela (anaa Soar) hene.
Yeinom nyinaa bɛhyiaa Sidim Bɔn mu, Nkyene Po no ho.
Wɔsom Kedorlaomer mfeɛ dumienu, na afe a ɛtɔ so dumiɛnsa no wɔtee atua.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so dunan no, Kedolaomer, ne ahemfo a wɔka ne ho no kunkum Refaimfoɔ wɔ Asterot-Karnaim, Susimfoɔ wɔ Ham, Emimfoɔ wɔ Sawe-Kiriataim,
ne Horifoɔ wɔ wɔn bepɔ Seir so, kɔduruu El-Paran a ɛwɔ serɛ soɔ no.
Na wɔdanee wɔn ani baa En-Mispat a ɛne Kades, na wɔdii Amalekfoɔ asase nyinaa ne Amorifoɔ a wɔtete Hasason-Tamar so nkonim.
Saa berɛ yi Sodom hene, Gomora hene, Adma hene, Seboiim hene, ne Bela (anaa Soar) hene ka boom ne wɔn de sii ani wɔ Sidim Bɔn mu.
Wɔn a wɔne wɔn koeɛ no ne Elam hene Kedorlaomer, Goiim hene Tidal, Sinar hene Amrafel, ne Elasar hene Ariok. Ahemfo nnan yi ne nnum no na ɛkoeɛ.
Na Sidim bonhwa no mu yɛ ama amena ara nko; na Sodom hene ne Gomora hene dwane kɔhwee mu, na wɔn a wɔaka no dwane kɔɔ bepɔ so.
Na wɔfaa biribiara a ɛwɔ Sodom ne Gomora ne wɔn nnuane nyinaa kɔeɛ.
Na wɔfaa Abram nua ba Lot ne n’agyapadeɛ nso kɔeɛ. Saa berɛ no na ɔte Sodom.
Ɛnna wɔn a wɔdwaneeɛ no mu baako kɔbɔɔ Abram a ɔyɛ Hebrini no amanneɛ. Saa berɛ no na wasi ne ntomadan wɔ Amorini Mamre nnua akɛseɛ no mu. Na Mamre nuanom Eskol ne Aner ne Abram ayɛ apam.
Na Abram tee sɛ wɔafa ne nua no dommum no, ɔfaa mmarima ahasa dunwɔtwe a wɔatete wɔn akodie mu, nkoa a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ ne fie, na wɔtii wɔn kɔduruu Dan.
Anadwo no, ɔkyɛɛ ne nkoa no mu, na wɔto hyɛɛ wɔn so dii wɔn so nkonim, na wɔtii wɔn ara kɔduruu Hoba a ɛwɔ Damasko atifi.
Na ɔgyee nneɛma a wɔfaeɛ nyinaa ne mmaa ne nnipa a wɔka ho ne ne nua Lot ne n’agyapadeɛ nso.
Afei berɛ a wadi Kedorlaomer ne ahemfo a wɔka ne ho no so nkonim na ɔresan aba no, Sodom hene kɔhyiaa no wɔ Sawe bonhwa a ɛyɛ ɔhene bonhwa no mu.
Na Salem hene Melkisedek a na ɔyɛ Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn no sɔfoɔ no brɛɛ no paanoo ne bobesa.
Na ɔhyiraa no na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn, ɔsoro ne asase Wura no,
Na nhyira nka Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn A ɔde w’atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa no!” Na Abram kyɛɛ biribiara mu du du maa no baako.
Na Sodom hene ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: “Fa nnipa no ma me na fa nneɛma no.”
Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sodom hene sɛ: “Mema me nsa so ka Ɔsorosoroni Awurade Nyankopɔn, ɔsoro ne asase wura, no ntam
sɛ, ɛfiri asaawa so kɔsi mpaboa homa soɔ, meremfa me nsa nka biribiara a ɛyɛ wo de a, na woanka sɛ, ‘me na memaa Abram nyaa ne ho.’
Mempɛ hwee, gye deɛ mmeranteɛ no adie no nko. Na mmarima a wɔne me kɔeɛ, Aner ne Eskol ne Mamre nso, ma wɔmfa wɔn kyɛfa.” Onyankopɔn de ɔba hyɛ Abram bɔ
15: Nsɛm yi akyiri no Awurade baa Abram nkyɛn anisoadehunu mu sɛ: “Nsuro, Abram. Mene wo kyɛm; na w’akatua bɛdɔɔso pii.”
Na Abram kaa sɛ: “O Awurade Nyankopɔn, ɛdeɛn na wode bɛma me? Seesei menni ba na menam, na deɛ ɔbɛdi m'adeɛ ne Elieser a ɔyɛ Damaskoni.”
Na Abram de kaa ho sɛ: “Hwɛ, wommaa me asefoɔ, na me fie akoa na ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ.”
Na hwɛ, Awurade asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ saa ɔbarima no na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ, na mmom deɛ ɔbɛfiri wo yam na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ.”
Na ɔde no firii adi na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ma w’ani so ɛ, na hwɛ soro, na sɛ wobɛtumi akan nsoromma yi a, kan.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Saa ara na w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ.”
Na ɔgyee Awurade diiɛ, na ɔbuu yei sɛ tenenee maa no.
Na ɔka kaa ho sɛ: “Mene Awurade a ɔde wo firi Kaldeafoɔ kuro Ur mu baa sɛ bɛfa asase yi.”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “O Awurade Nyankopɔn, ɛdeɛn na mede bɛhunu sɛ ɛbɛyɛ me dea?”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa nantwie ba a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne abirekyie a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne odwennini a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne aburuburo ne aborɔnoma ba brɛ me.”
Na ɔde ne nyinaa baeɛ na ɔpaepaee wɔn mu mmienu mmienu, na ɔde afaafa no kyerɛkyerɛ animu totoo hɔ, nanso nnomaa no deɛ, wampaepae wɔn mu.
Na nnomaa a wɔdi nam bɛsisii nam no so, na Abram pamoo wɔn.
Akyire yi, ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ no, Abram daa hatee na esum kabii a ɛyɛ hu duruu no.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: “Hunu sɛ w’asefoɔ bɛkɔ akɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ obi man so na wɔasom wɔn, na nkurɔfoɔ no bɛdi wɔn ani mfeɛ ahanan.
Nanso mɛbu ɔman a wɔbɛsom wɔn no atɛn, na wɔde agyapadeɛ bebree bɛfiri hɔ akɔ.
Na wo deɛ, asomdwoeɛ mu na wobɛkɔ w’agyanom nkyɛn, na wobɛdi mfie pii ansa na wɔasie wo.
Na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so nnan mu no, wɔbɛsan aba ha, ɛfiri sɛ Amorifoɔ amumuyɛ nnya nnurui.”
Na awia tɔeɛ na esum duruiɛ, na hwɛ, fononoo bi a wisie firi mu ne gyaframa a ɛderɛ bɛfaa mmoa a wɔapaepae wɔn mu no ntam.
Saa da no ara na, Awurade ne Abram yɛɛ apam, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mede asase yi nyinaa bɛma w’asefoɔ, ɛfiri Misraim (Egypt) asubɔnten ho kɔsi asubɔnten kɛseɛ Eufrate ho:
Kenifoɔ, Kenisifoɔ, Kadmonifoɔ,
ne Hitifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Refaimfoɔ,
ne Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Girgasifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ.”
16: Na Abram yere Sarai nwoo ba biara mmaa no, nanso na ɔwɔ Egypt nii abaawa bi a wɔfrɛ no Hagar.
Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: “Hwɛ, Awurade asi m’awoɔ ho kwan. Enti mesrɛ wo, kɔ m’afenaa yi ho, na ebia ɔbɛwo ama me.” Na Abram tiee Sarai.
Na Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so mfirinhyia du no, Abram yere Sarai faa n'afenaa a ɔyɛ Misramni (Egyptian) no de no maa ne kunu Abram awareɛ.
Na ɔkɔɔ Hagar ho, na ɔnyinsɛneeɛ. Berɛ a ɔhunuu sɛ wanyinsɛn no, ɔbuu n'awuraa animtia.
Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: “Asɛmmɔne a wadi me da wo so. Me ara na mede m’abaawa too wo kokom, afei wahunu sɛ wanyinsɛn nti n’ani nsɔ me bio. Awurade mmu me ne wo ntam atɛn.”
Enti Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sarai sɛ: “Hwɛ! W’abaawa no wɔ wo nsam. Yɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ biara.” Na Sarai firii aseɛ teetee no maa ɔdwane firii ne nkyɛn.
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ hunuu no abura bi ho wɔ Sur kwan so wɔ serɛ so.
Ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Hagar, Sarai abaawa, ɛhe na wofire na ɛhe na worekorɔ?” Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: “Mefiri m'awuraa Sarai nkyɛn na meredwane.”
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: “San kɔ w'awuraa no nkyɛn na brɛ wo ho ase hyɛ n’ase.”
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso, na obiara rentumi nkan wɔn.”
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no toaa so sɛ: “Hwɛ, woafa afuro na wobɛwo ɔbabarima na woato ne din Ismael, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ate w’amanehunu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ onipa a ɔte sɛ ɛserɛ so afunumu. Na ɔbɛma ne nsa so atia obiara, na obiara bɛma ne nsa so atia no; ɔbɛtena ntomadan mu wɔ ne nuanom nyinaa anim.”
Na ɔfirii aseɛ bɔɔ Awurade a ɔne no kasaeɛ no din sɛ: “Woyɛ Onyankopɔn a wohunu adeɛ.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ampa deɛ ɔhu me no na me nso mahu no yi?”
Ɛno nti wɔfrɛɛ abura no Beer-Lahai-Roi, ɛwɔ Kades ne Bered ntam.
Na Hagar woo ɔbabarima maa Abram na Abram too abɔfra no din Ismael.
Berɛ a Hagar woo Ismael no na Abram adi mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe nsia.
17: Na Abram dii mfeɛ aduɔkron nkron no, Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no kaa sɛ: “Mene Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, nante m'anim, na yɛ pɛ,
Na mɛma m'apam ada me ne wo ntam, na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso papaapa.”
Na Abram de n’anim butuu fam, na Onyankopɔn toaa so ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ:
“Hwɛ, me ne wo ayɛ apam, na wobɛyɛ aman pii agya.
Na wɔremfrɛ wo Abram bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Abraham ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ wo aman pii agya.
Na mɛma w’ase atrɛ kɛse na woayɛ aman pii, na ahemfo bɛfiri wo mu aba.
“Na mɛma apam a me ne wo ne w’asefoɔ ayɛ no atena hɔ sɛ daa apam de akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛbɛba nyinaa so, na mayɛ Onyankopɔn ama wo ne w’asefoɔ.
Na mede asase a woabɛsoɛ soɔ yi, Kanaan asase nyinaa, bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ daa; na mɛyɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.”
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham bio sɛ: “Di m’apam so, wo ne w’asefoɔ ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔbɛdi w'akyi aba nyinaa.
Yei ne me ne w'asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w'akyire no ntam apam a monni soɔ: Mo mu ɔbarima biara ntwa twetia.
Na montwa twetia na ɛnyɛ apam a me ne mo ayɛ no ho sɛnkyerɛnne.
Na ɔbabarima biara a ɔwɔ wo fie a wadi nnawɔtwe ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔbɛdi akyire aba nyinaa ntwa twetia, obiara a wɔawo no wo fie ne obiara a wode sika atɔ no afiri ɔhɔhoɔ hɔ a ɔnyɛ w’aseni,
ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbarima biara a wɔawo no wo fie ne obiara a wode sika atɔ no no twa twetia; na m’apam ho sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ mo honam mu no bɛyɛ daa apam.
Na ɔbarima momonoto biara a wɔntwaa no twetia no, sɛ wantwa a, wɔbɛtwa saa onipa no afiri ne nkurɔfoɔ mu atwene. Wabu m’apam so.”
Na Onyankopɔn toaa so ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: “Wo yere Sarai nso, mfrɛ no Sarai bio, na mmom frɛ no Sara.
Na mɛhyira no, na mama no awo ɔbabarima ama wo; mɛhyira no ama no ayɛ aman pii; na n’asefoɔ bɛyɛ ahemfo.”
Na Abraham teeɛ no, ɔde n’anim butuu hɔ sereeɛ, na ɔkaa no n’akomam sɛ: “Ɔbarima a wadi mfeɛ ɔha bɛtumi awo ɔba, na Sara nso, ɔbaa a wadi mfeɛ aduɔkron no bɛwo anaa?”
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn sɛ: “O sɛ Ismael bɛnya w’anim adom a!”
Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: “Dabi, wo yere Sara bɛwo ama wo, na wobɛto ne din Isak. Me ne no bɛyɛ apam, na ɛbɛyɛ apam a ɛbɛgyina hɔ daa akɔsi n’asefoɔ nyinaa soɔ.
Na mate w’abisadeɛ a ɛfa Ismael ho no nso. Mɛhyira no ama no adɔre na n’asefoɔ ayɛ pii pa ara. Atitire dumienu na ɔbɛwoɔ, na mɛma no ayɛ ɔman kɛseɛ.
Na m’apam no deɛ, me ne Sara ba Isak a ɔbɛwo no afe sɛsɛɛ no na ɛbɛpam ama no agyina.”
Na Onyankopɔn ne Abraham kasa wieeɛ no ɔgyaa ne hɔ kɔɔ soro.
Na Abraham faa ne ba Ismael ne mmarima a wɔwoo wɔn ne fie nyinaa ne obiara a ɔde sika tɔɔ no, ɔbarima biara a ɔwɔ Abraham fie, na ɔtwaa wɔn twetia saa da no sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no.
Wɔtwaa Abraham twetia no na wadi mfeɛ aduɔkron nkron.
Na wɔtwaa ne ba Ismael nso twetia no na wadi mfeɛ dumiɛnsa.
Enti saa da no ara na wɔtwaa Abraham ne ne ba Ismael nyinaa twetia.
Ne fie mmarima nyinaa, obiara a wɔwoo no fie hɔ ne obiara a ɔde sika tɔɔ no firii ɔhɔhoɔ hɔ, wɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia.
18: Na Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no wɔ Mamre nnua akɛseɛ no mu, awia ketee a wiem ayɛ hyeɛ na ɔte ne ntomadan ano no.
Na ɔmaa n’ani soɔ no, ɔhunuu mmarima mmiɛnsa a wɔgyinagyina akyirikyiri wɔ n'anim. N’ani bɔɔ wɔn soɔ no ɔtuu mmirika firii ntomadan no ano kɔhyiaa wɔn, na ɔkotoo fam
kaa sɛ: “O Awurade, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, mesrɛ wo, ntwa w’akoa ho nkɔ.
Mesrɛ mo, momma wɔmfa nsuo kakra mmra mmɛhohoro mo nan ase, na monhome dua yi ase.
Na momma mempɛ paanoo sini bi mma mo na momfa nnwodwo mo akoma. Mowie a afei mobɛtumi akɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno nti na mobɛfaa mo akoa ha yi.” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛate. Yɛ sɛdeɛ woaka no.”
Na Abraham yɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ Sara nkyɛn ntomadan no mu, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛ ntɛm! Fa esiam susukoraa mmiɛnsa na fete fa yɛ paanoo.”
Na Abraham tuu mmirika kɔɔ ne mmoa mu kɔkyeree nantwie ba a ne ho yɛ mmerɛ na ɔyɛ de no maa abranteɛ bi, na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm siesieeɛ.
Na ɔfaa nufosuo ani sradeɛ, nufusuo ne nantwie ba a wasiesie no bɛsii wɔn anim. Na wɔredidie no nyinaa na ɔgyina wɔn nkyɛn wɔ dua no ase.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo yere Sara wɔ he?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɔwɔ ntomadan mu hɔ!”
Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Mɛsan aba wo nkyɛn saa berɛ yi afe sɛsɛɛ, na ɛbɛduru hɔ no na wo yere Sara awo ɔbabarima.” Na ɔrekasa nyinaa na Sara wɔ ntomadan no ano wɔ ɔbarima no akyi retie.
Na Abraham ne Sara nyinaa anyinyini na wɔn mfeɛ akɔ animu. Na Sara atwa bra.
Enti Sara firii aseɛ seree ne mu sɛ: “Seesei a mabɔ aberewa na me wura nso abɔ akɔkoraa yi, anigyeɛ bɛn na mɛnya?”
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: “Adɛn nti na Sara sere kaa sɛ, ‘mabɔ aberewa yi ɛbɛyɛ dɛn koraa na matumi awo ba?’
Biribi yɛ Awurade yɛna? Mɛsan aba wo nkyɛn saa berɛ yi afe sɛsɛɛ, na ɛbɛduru hɔ no na Sara anya ɔbabarima.”
Na Sara kaa sɛ: “Mansere,” ɛfiri sɛ na ɔsuro. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Dabi, wosereeɛ.”
Na mmarima no sɔre firii hɔ de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Sodom, na Abraham ne wɔn nante de gyaa wɔn kwan.
Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Mede biribi a mɛyɛ bɛhunta Abraham anaa?
Hwɛ, ɛkwan biara so Abraham bɛyɛ ɔman kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ den, na ne nti asase so aman nyinaa bɛnya nhyira.
Na mahu mayi no sɛ ɔnhyɛ ne mma ne ne fiefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n'akyire sɛ wɔnni Awurade Kwan so nyɛ tenenee ne atɛntenenee adeɛ, na Awurade ama deɛ waka afa Abraham ho nyinaa aba ne so.”
Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Esu ne nteateamu a Sodom ne Gomora ama no aba no ano yɛ den, na wɔn bɔne nso mu yɛ duru paa.
Mɛkɔ akɔhwɛ sɛ esu ne nteateamu a mateɛ no te saa ampa, na sɛ ɛnte saa a mɛhunu.”
Saa berɛ yi, mmarima no danee wɔn ho de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Sodom; nanso Abraham deɛ, na ɔda so gyina Awurade anim.
Na Abraham twe bɛn kaa sɛ: “O enti wobɛpra ateneneefoɔ aka abɔnefoɔ ho?
Fa no sɛ ateneneefoɔ aduonum te kuro no mu, enti wobɛpra wɔn agu? Ateneneefoɔ aduonum a wɔwɔ mu yi remma wonhu kuro no mmɔbɔ?
Yei mpare wo sɛ wobɛdi saa asɛm yi sɛ wobɛkum ɔteneneeni aka ɔbɔnefoɔ ho ama no awie ɔteneneeni sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ! Worentumi nyɛ saa da. Asase nyinaa temmufoɔ no renyɛ deɛ ɛtene anaa?”
Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Sɛ mehunu ateneneefoɔ aduonum wɔ Sodom kuro no mu a, wɔn nti mɛhu kuro no mmɔbɔ.”
Na Abraham buaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, menim sɛ meyɛ dɔteɛ ne nso, nanso mayɛ sɛ me ne Awurade bɛkasa.
Fa no sɛ aka nnipa nnum ansa na aduru ateneneefoɔ aduonum. Nnipa nnum a aka no nti wobɛsɛe kuro no nyinaa?” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ mehunu nnipa aduanan nnum wɔ hɔ a merensɛe hɔ.”
Na Abraham san ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa no sɛ aduanan na wɔwɔ hɔ.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Aduanan no nti merensɛe hɔ.”
Ɛnna ɔtoaa so sɛ: “Mesrɛ sɛ mma Awurade bo mmfu me na menkasa: Fa no sɛ nnipa aduasa na wɔwɔ hɔ.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ mehunu aduasa wɔ hɔ a merensɛe hɔ.”
Nanso ɔtoaa so sɛ: “Mesrɛ meka oo, mepɛ sɛ me ne Awurade kɔ so kasa: Fa no sɛ nnipa aduonu na wɔwɔ hɔ.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Aduonu no nti merensɛe hɔ.”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ sɛ mma Awurade bo mmfu me, na ma menka deɛ ɛtwa toɔ yi: Fa no sɛ nnipa du na wɔwɔ hɔ.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Edu no nti merensɛe hɔ.”
Na Awurade ne Abraham wiee kasa no ɔkɔeɛ, na Abraham nso san baa ne fie.
19: Na abɔfoɔ mmienu no kɔduruu Sodom anwummerɛ no, na Lot te Sodom kuro no pono ano. Lot ani bɔɔ wɔn soɔ no, ɔsɔre kɔhyiaa wɔn de n’anim butuu fam.

Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Me wuranom, mesrɛ mo mommane mmra mo akoa fie mmɛda ha anadwo yi, na monhohoro mo nan ho, na adeɛ kye a moasɔre ntɛm atoa mo akwantuo no so.” Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Dabi, abɔnten so na yɛbɛda anadwo yi.”
Nanso ɔsrɛɛ wɔn dendeenden, enti wɔne no kɔɔ fie. Afei ɔtoo wɔn pono, na ɔtoo paanoo a mmɔreka nnim maa wɔn, na wɔfirii aseɛ didiiɛ.
Na wɔnnya nkɔɔ kɛtɛ soɔ no, Sodomfoɔ, bɛtwaa fie no ho hyiaeɛ, ɛfiri mmarimaa so kɔsi nkɔkoraa so, nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa bɔɔ twi baeɛ.
Na wɔteateaa mu guu Lot so sɛ: “Mmarima a wɔbaa wo nkyɛn anadwo yi no wɔ he? Fa wɔn bra na yɛne wɔn nna.”
Na Lot pue kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn wɔ pono no ano, na ɔtoo pono no mu wɔ n’akyi.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Me nuanom, mesrɛ mo, monnyɛ bɔne saa.

Hwɛ, mewɔ mma mmaa mmienu a ɔbarima biara mfaa ne ho nkaa wɔn. Momma memfa wɔn mmrɛ mo na monyɛ wɔn deɛ mopɛ biara. Na mmarima yi deɛ, mommfa mo nsa nnka wɔn, na ɛno nti na wɔbaa me suhyɛ nwunu aseɛ yi.”

Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Twe wo ho firi hɔ!” Na wɔtoaa so sɛ: “Wobaa ha sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ ankonam na afei woadane ɔtemmufoɔ. Deɛ yɛde rebɛyɛ woɔ no bɛsene wɔn deɛ.” Na wɔtuu bum baa Lot so, na wɔpɛɛ sɛ wɔbubu pono no kɔ mu.
Na mmarima no sɔɔ Lot mu twee no baa fie no mu, na wɔtoo pono no mu.
Na wɔmaa mmarima a wɔgyinagyina ɛpono no ano no ani firafiraeɛ, ɛfiri kumaa so kɔsi kɛseɛ so, na wɔhwehwɛɛ fie no ano kwan brɛeɛ.
Na mmarima no bisaa Lot sɛ: “Wowɔ obi ka wo ho wɔ ha? W’ase anaa mmarima, wo mma mmarima ne wo mma mmaa anaa wo busuani biara a ɔwɔ kuro yi mu no, yi wɔn firi ha!
Na yɛrebɛsɛe ha, ɛfiri sɛ esu ne nteamu a wɔama no aba no ano ayɛ den Awurade anim, enti Awurade asoma yɛn sɛ yɛmmɛsɛe kuro no.”
Enti Lot firii adi ne ne nsenom a wɔrebɛware ne mma mmaa no kɔkasaa sɛ: “Monsɔre! Momfiri ha, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade rebɛsɛe kuro yi!” Nanso ɔyɛɛ ne nsenom ani so sɛ obi a ɔreyi nsɛnkwaa.
Na adeɛ reyɛ akye no, abɔfoɔ no ani beree Lot so sɛ: “Sɔre! Fa wo yere ne wo mma mmaa mmienu a wɔwɔ ha no, na wɔansɛe wo amfra kuro yi amumuyɔ!”
Berɛ a ɔretwentwɛn ne nan aseɛ no, Awurade mmɔborɔhunu nti, mmarima no sosɔɔ ɔne ne yere ne ne mma mmaa mmienu no nsa de wɔn pue kɔɔ kuro no akyi.
Berɛ a wɔde wɔn duruu kuro no akyi no, wɔn mu baako kaa sɛ: “Monnwane nnye mo kra nkwa! Monnhwɛ mo akyi na monnnyina Mantam yi mu baabiara! Monnwane nkɔ bepɔ so na wɔampra mo ankɔ!”
Ɛnna Lot ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “O me wura, nnyɛ saa!
Hwɛ, mahunu ampa sɛ w’akoa anya w’anim adom na woatrɛ w’adɔeɛ mu ama me nti na wopɛ sɛ wogye me kra nkwa, nanso merentumi nnwane nkɔ bepɔ so hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ anhwɛ a na asiane bi akɔsiane me ama mawu.
Kuro yi bɛn sɛ mɛtumi adwane akɔ hɔ, na ɛhɔ sua. Ma mennwane nkɔ hɔ ɛ! Anaa ɛnsua? Na me kra anya nkwa.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yei mu nso matie wo, na merensɛe kuro a woaka ho asɛm no.
Yɛ ntɛm! Dwane kɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, sɛ wonnuruu hɔ a merentumi nyɛ hwee!” Na ɛno nti ɔtoo kuro no din Soar.
Lot duruu Soar no, na awia apue asase so.
Na Awurade maa sɔfe ne egya tɔ firii soro, guu Sodom ne Gomora so.
Enti ɔsɛee nkuro yi ne Mantam no nyinaa ne nnipa a wɔwɔ nkuro no mu nyinaa ne biribiara a ɛfifi asase no soɔ.
Na Lot yere twaa n’ani hwɛɛ n’akyi, na ɔdanee nkyene sie.
Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutuutu kɔɔ baabi a ɔgyina ne Awurade kasaeɛ no.
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛɛ Sodom ne Gomora ne Mantam hɔ asase nyinaa na ɔhunuu sɛ biribi rekɔ so. Hwɛ, na ewiem ayɛ wisie kumɔɔ te sɛ fononoo mu wisie!
Nanso berɛ a Onyankopɔn resɛe nkuro a ɛwɔ Mantam no mu no, Onyankopɔn kaee Abraham na ɔmaa wɔyii Lot firii nkuro a ɔresɛe no no mu, baabi a na ɔteɛ no. Moabfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ahyɛaseɛ
Akyire yi Lot tu firii Soar na ɔne ne mma mmaa no kɔtenaa bepɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔsuro sɛ ɔbɛtena Soar. Enti ɔne ne mma mmaa no kɔtenaa ɔbodan bi mu.
Na ne babaa panin no ka kyerɛɛ kumaa no sɛ: “Yɛn papa abɔ akɔkoraa na ɔbarima biara nni asase yi so a ɔbɛba yɛn ho sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ no asase so baabiara no.
Bra na yɛmma yɛn papa nsa nnom na yɛne no nna na yɛnnya ne hɔ mma.”
Enti wɔmaa wɔn papa nsa nomee anadwo no; afei panin no ne no kɔdaeɛ, nanso papa no anhunu berɛ a ɔbɛdaa hɔ ne berɛ a ɔsɔreeɛ.
Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, panin no ka kyerɛɛ kumaa no sɛ: “Hwɛ, me ne me papa daa nnora anadwo no. Ma yɛmma no nsa nnom anadwo yi nso na wo ne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn papa hɔ mma.”
Enti wɔmaa wɔn papa nsa nomee saa anadwo no nso; afei kumaa no ne no kɔdaeɛ, nanso papa no anhunu berɛ a ɔbɛdaa hɔ ne berɛ a ɔsɔreeɛ.
Na Lot mma mmaa mmienu no ne wɔn papa nyinsɛneeɛ.
Na panin no woo ɔbabarima na ɔtoo ne din Moab. Ɔno ne Moabfoɔ agya de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na kumaa no nso woo ɔbabarima na ɔtoo ne din Ben-Ami. Ɔno ne Ammonfoɔ agya de bɛsi nnɛ.
20: Na Abraham tu kɔɔ Negeb asase so kɔtenaa Kades ne Sur ntam, na ɔbɛyɛɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ Gerar.
Na Abraham kaa ne yere Sara ho asɛm bio sɛ: “Ɔyɛ me nuabaa.” Enti Gerar hene Abimelek soma maa wɔkɔfaa Sara brɛɛ no.
Ɛnna Onyankopɔn baa Abimelek nkyɛn anadwo daeɛ mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔbaa a woakɔfa no yi nti, woawu awie. Hwɛ, ɔyɛ obi yere.”
Nso na Abimelek nkɔɔ ne ho. Enti ɔkaa sɛ: “O Awurade, wobɛkum ɔman tenenee?
Ɛnyɛ ɔno ara na ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me nuabaa’? Na ɔbaa no nso anka sɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me nuabarima’? M’akomam fitaa, na ɛnyɛ adwemmɔne na mede yɛɛ saa.”

Na Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no daeɛ no mu sɛ: “Me ara nso menim sɛ w’akomam fitaa na woyɛɛ saa, na me nso na mempɛ sɛ woyɛ bɔne tia me nti na mesii wo kwan no. Ne saa nti na mamma woamfa wo nsa anka no no.
Na afei fa ɔbaa no kɔma ne kunu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ, na ɔbɛsrɛ ama wo na woatena ase. Na sɛ woamfa no ankɔ a, kae hunu sɛ owuo na wobɛwuo, wo ne wo fiefoɔ nyinaa.”
Enti Abimelek sɔree anɔpatutuutu frɛfrɛɛ ne nkoa nyinaa kaa deɛ asie nyinaa kyerɛɛ wɔn. Na mmarima no suroo paa.
Na Abimelek frɛɛ Abraham na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na wode ayɛ yɛn yi, na bɔne bɛn koraa na mayɛ woɔ a wode bɔne kɛseɛ yi aba me ne m’ahennie soɔ yi? Deɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ na wode ayɛ me yi.”
Na Abimelek bisaa Abraham sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn koraa na ɛbaa wo tirim a ɛmaa woyɛɛ saa?”
Ɛnna Abraham kaa sɛ: “Mekaa no me tirim sɛ, ‘Onyankopɔn ho suro nni ha, anhwɛ a me yere nti wɔbɛku me.’
Na ɔyɛ me nuabaa nso ampa, me papa ba, na ɔnyɛ me maame ba; na ɔbɛyɛɛ me yere.
Berɛ a Onyankopɔn maa mefirii me papa fie dii atutena no, meka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Adɔeɛ a mepɛ sɛ woyɛ me nie: Baabiara a yɛbɛkorɔ no ka sɛ: “Ɔyɛ me nuabarima.”’
Ɛno akyi no Abimelek maa Abraham nnwan ne anantwie ne nkoa ne mfenaa, na afei ɔde ne yere Sara maa no.
Na Abimelek san kaa sɛ: “M’asase na ɛda w’anim yi, tena baabiara a wopɛ.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Sara nso sɛ: “Mama wo nuabarima no nnwetɛbena apem. Yei na mede rete w’anim wɔ wɔn a wɔka wo ho nyinaa ne obiara anim; wo ho nni asɛm biara.”
Na Abraham bɔɔ Nyankopɔn mpaeɛ; na Onyankopɔn saa Abimelek ne ne yere ne ne mfenaa yareɛ, na wɔfirii aseɛ wowoeɛ.
Deɛ ɛwɔ mu ne sɛ Abraham yere Sara nti, na Awurade ato Abimelek fie mmaa nyinaa yafunu mu.
21: Na Awurade danee n’ani baa Sara so sɛdeɛ na waka no, na Awurade yɛɛ Sara sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na Sara nyinsɛneeɛ na ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa Abraham ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu berɛ a Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no ara mu.
Enti Abraham too abɔfra a Sara woo no maa no no din Isak.
Berɛ a Isak nyaa nnawɔtwe no, Abraham twaa no twetia sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.
Wɔwoo Isak no na Abraham adi mfeɛ ɔha.
Ɛnna Sara kaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn ama masere. Na obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no bɛsere ama me.”
Ɔtoaa so sɛ: “Hwan na anka ɔbɛka akyerɛ Abraham sɛ, ‘Sara bɛma mma nufoɔ?’ Nanso hwɛ sɛ mawo ama no ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu.”
Na Isak nyiniiɛ no wɔtwaa no nufoɔ, na saa da no Abraham too pono kɛseɛ.
Afei Sara hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ a na abɔfra a Egyptni Hagar woo no maa Abraham no redi Isak ho fɛw.
Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: “Pamo afenaa yi ne ne ba no, na saa afenaa yi ba ntumi ne me ba Isak nni adeɛ!”
Nanso Abraham ba yi ho asɛm haa no yie.
Ɛnna Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: “Mma biribiara a Sara bɛka afa ɔbarimaa no ne w’afenaa ho no nnha wo. Tie no ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no w’aseni no nam Isak so na ɛbɛba.
Na mɛma afenaa no ba no nso ayɛ ɔman, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo ba.”
Enti Abraham sɔree anɔpahema faa paanoo ne nsuo kotokuo de maa Hagar, na ɔde sii ne kɔn ho, na ɔde ɔbarimaa no kaa ne ho gyaa no kwan. Na ɔkɔɔ Beer-Seba serɛ so, na ɔdii akyinkyinakyinkyini.
Na nsuo a ɛwɔ kotokuo no mu no sae, na ɔgyaa ɔbarimaa no too dɔtɔ bi ase.
Na ɔkɔpɛɛ baabi tenae, bɛyɛ sɛ deɛ wɔto agyan a ɛbɛtɔ, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mma mennhunu ɔbarimaa yi wuo.” Enti ɔkɔtenaa baabi maa ne nne so suiɛ.
Ɛnna Onyankopɔn tee ɔbarimaa no nne, na Onyankopɔn bɔfoɔ firi soro teaam frɛɛ Hagar sɛ: “Hagar, ɛdeɛn na ɛreyɛ woɔ? Nsuro na Onyankopɔn ate ɔbarimaa no nne wɔ baabi a ɔwɔ no.
Sɔre, ma ɔbarimaa no so na fa wo nsa sɔ ne mu, ɛfiri sɛ mɛma no ayɛ ɔman kɛseɛ.”
Na Onyankopɔn buee n’ani maa no hunuu asubura bi, na ɔkɔsaa nsuo guu kotokuo no mu maa ɔbarimaa no bi nomeeɛ.
Na Onyankopɔn dii ɔbarimaa no akyi, na ɔnyini tenaa ɛserɛ so, na ɔbɛyɛɛ agyantoni.
Na ɔtenaa Paran serɛ so, na ne maame kɔwaree ɔbaa firii Egypt asase so brɛɛ no.
Na berɛ no mu no, Abimelek ne ne sahene Pikol ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: “Onyankopɔn di w’akyi wɔ deɛ woyɛ nyinaa mu.
Enti ka Onyankopɔn ntam sɛ worentwa me ne me mma ne m’asefoɔ nkontompo; na sɛdeɛ me ne wo adi no adɔeɛ soɔ no, saa ara na wo ne me ne asase a woabɛsoɛ soɔ yi bɛdie.”
Na Abraham kaa sɛ: “Mɛka ntam.”
Na asubura bi a Abimelek nkoa nam aniɛden so gyeeɛ no nti Abraham kaa Abimelek anim,
Abimelek kaa sɛ: “Mennim wɔn a wɔdii saa dwuma yi, na wo ara nso wanka ho asɛm ankyerɛ me; ɛnyɛ nnɛ a, anka menteeɛ.”
Enti Abraham maa Abimelek nnwan ne anantwie na wɔn mmienu no yɛɛ apam.
Na Abraham yii nnwammaa abereɛ nson gyinaa nkyɛn,
enti Abimelek bisaa Abraham sɛ: “Nnwammaa abereɛ nson a woayi wɔn agyina nkyɛn yi kyerɛ sɛn?”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Gye nnwammaa abereɛ nson yi me nsam, na ɛnyɛ adanseɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ me na metuu saa abura yi.”
Ɛno nti na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Beer-Seba no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na wɔn mmienu nyinaa kaa ntam.
Enti wɔyɛɛ apam wɔ Beer-Seba, na wɔwieeɛ no Abimelek sɔreɛ ne ne sahene Pikol san kɔɔ Filistifoɔ asase so.
Ɛno akyiri no Abraham dua tamarisk dua wɔ Beer-Seba na ɔbɔɔ Awurade a ɔyɛ mmerɛsanten Nyankopɔn no din wɔ hɔ.
Na Abraham tenaa Filistifoɔ asase so sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ nna pii. Onyankopɔn hyɛ Abraham sɛ ɔmfa Isak mmɔ afɔreɛ
22: Na nsɛm yi kyiri no, Onyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛeɛ. Ɔfrɛɛ no sɛ: “Abraham!” Na ɔgyee so sɛ: “Menie!”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa wo ba korɔ a wodɔ no, Isak, kɔ Moria asase so kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ mmepɔ no baako a mɛkyerɛ woɔ so.”
Enti Abraham sɔree anɔpatutuutu hyehyɛɛ n’afunumu, na ɔfaa ne nkoa mmienu ne ne ba Isak kaa ne ho; na ɔtwaa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina na ɔsiim kɔɔ baabi a Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no.
Ɛda a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu beaeɛ hɔ wɔ akyirikyiri.
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa no sɛ: “Mo ne afunumu no ntwɛn wɔ ha, na me ne ɔbarimaa no rekɔ yɛn anim kakra akɔsom na yɛasan aba mo nkyɛn.”
Na Abraham de nnyina a ɔde bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no soaa ne ba Isak na ɔfaa egya ne sekan kuraeɛ, na wɔn mmienu siim kɔeɛ.
Na Isak frɛɛ ne papa Abraham sɛ: “Papa!” Na ɔgyee so sɛ: “Me ba, menie!” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, Egya ne nnyina nie, na odwan a yɛde bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no wɔ he?”
Ɛnna Abraham kaa sɛ: “Me ba, Onyankopɔn no ara bɛkyerɛ odwan a yɛde bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ no.” Na wɔtoaa so kɔeɛ.
Berɛ a wɔkɔduruu deɛ Nyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no, Abraham sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsiesiee nnyina no, na ɔkyekyeree ne ba Isak nsa ne ne nan na ɔde no too nnyina no so wɔ afɔrebukyia no so.
Afei Abraham tenee ne nsa twee sekan no sɛ ɔrebɛku ne ba no.
Ɛnna Awurade bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ no sɛ: “Abraham, Abraham!” Na ɔgyee so sɛ: “Menie!”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mfa wo nsa nka ɔbarimaa no, na nyɛ no hwee; afei na mahunu sɛ wosuro Onyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ woamfa wo ba korɔ no ankame me.”
Na Abraham maa n’ani so, na hwɛ ɔhunuu odwennini bi a ne mmɛn aka dɔtɔ mu. Enti Abraham kɔyii no de no sii ne ba no ananmu bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na Abraham frɛɛ hɔ Yahwe-Yir'en [ aseɛ ne sɛ "Awurade bɛkyerɛ"]. Yei nti na nnɛ wɔka sɛ: “Awurade bɛkyerɛ wɔ ne bepɔ so.”
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Abraham ne mprenu so
na ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, Awurade asɛm nie: ‘Ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ yei na woamfa wo ba korɔ no ankame me nti, maka me ho ntam sɛ,
ɛkwan biara so mɛhyira wo na mama w’asefoɔ adɔre ayɛ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea; na w’asefoɔ bɛfa wɔn atamfoɔ nkuro apono adi so,
na w’asefoɔ so na asase so aman nyinaa nam bɛnya nhyira, ɛfiri sɛ woayɛ aso ama me.’”
Ɛnna Abraham san baa ne nkoa no nkyɛn, na wɔsiim kɔɔ Beer-Seba; na Abraham kɔɔ so tenaa Beer-Seba.
Yeinom akyi no, wɔbɛbɔɔ Abraham amanneɛ sɛ: “Hwɛ, Milka nso awo mma ama wo nua Nahor:
Ne ba panin Us, ne ne nua Bus, ne Kemuel a ɔyɛ Aram agya,
ne Kesed, Haso, Pildas, Yidlaf, ne Betuel.”
Na Betuel woo Rebeka. Nnipa nwɔtwe yi na Milka woo wɔn maa Abraham nua Nahor.
Na ɔwɔ mpena bi a wɔfrɛ no Reuma. Ɔno nso woo Teba ne Gaham ne Tahas ne Maaka.
23: Mfeɛ a Sara diiɛ nyinaa yɛ ɔha aduonu nson (127). Yei ne Sara nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na Sara wuu wɔ Kiriat-Arba, anaa Hebron, wɔ Kanaan asase so, na Abraham baa ɛdan no mu bɛgyam Sara na ɔsuu no.
Na Abraham sɔre firii ne yere funu no ho kɔka kyerɛɛ Het mma no sɛ:
“Meyɛ hɔhoɔ ne otubrafoɔ a mabɛsoɛ mo. Momma me asieeɛ wɔ mo nkyɛn ha na mensie m’amu yi.”
Ɛnna Het mma no buaa Abraham sɛ:
“Me wura tie yɛn, woyɛ Onyankopɔn nipa titire a woabɛsoɛ yɛn. Sie w’amu no wɔ yɛn asieeɛ no fa biara a wopɛ. Yɛn mu biara rentumi mfa n’asieeɛ nkame wo sɛ nsie w’amu.”
Na Abraham sɔre bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ Het mma a wɔte asase no soɔ no anim,
na ɔne wɔn kasaa sɛ: “Sɛ ɛyɛ mo pɛ sɛ mesie m’amu yi ma no firi m'ani so a, montie me na monsrɛ Sohar ba Efron mma me,
sɛ ɔmfa ɔbodan a ɛwɔ Makpela a ɛda n’asase ano no mma me. Ɔnnye me boɔ biara a asase no som na ɔmfa mma me mo anim, na mennya baabi mfa nyɛ asieeɛ.”
Saa berɛ no na Efron te Het mma no mu. Enti Hitini Efron buaa Abraham maa Het mma no ne obiara a ɔwɔ ne kuro no pono ano tee sɛ:
“Dabi, me wura! Tie me. Mede asase no ne ɔbodan a ɛwɔ soɔ no nyinaa ama wo. Me manfoɔ nyinaa anim na mede ama woɔ. Sie w’amu.”
Ɛnna Abraham bɔɔ ne mu ase ɔmanfoɔ no anim,
na ɔka kyerɛɛ Efron maa ɔmanfoɔ no tee sɛ: “Sɛ wobɛtie me a—mesrɛ sɛ tie! Mede asase no ho sika bɛma wo. Gye, na matumi asie m’amu wɔ hɔ.”
Ɛnna Efron buaa Abraham sɛ:
“Me wura, tie. Asase a ne boɔ yɛ nnwetɛbena ahanan deɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ me ne wo ntam asɛm bɛn? Enti sie w’amu no.”
Enti Abraham tiee Efron na ɔkarii sika a Efron bɔɔ din wɔ Het mma anim no maa no, nnwetɛbena ahanan sɛdeɛ adwadifoɔ kari no.
Na Efron asase a ɛwɔ Makpela a ɛda Mamre anim ne ɛso ɔbodan ne nnua nyinaa, ɛfiri tire kɔsi tire,
bɛdii Abraham nsam, na ɛbɛyɛɛ n’agyapadeɛ wɔ Het mma ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ne kuro no apono ano nyinaa anim.
Ɛno akyiri no, Abraham siee ne yere Sara ɔbodan mu wɔ Makpela asase so wɔ Mamre anim; ɛne Hebron a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no.
Enti Het mma no danee asase no ne ɔbodan a ɛwɔ soɔ no maa Abraham sɛ asieeɛ.
24: Afei na Abraham mfeɛ akɔ animu na wabɔ akɔkoraa; na na Awurade ahyira Abraham wɔ biribiara mu.
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ n’akoa panin a ɔhwɛ ne fie nneɛma nyinaa soɔ sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, fa wo nsa hyɛ me srɛ ase,
na mepɛ sɛ woka Awurade, ɔsoro ne asase Nyankopɔn no, ntam sɛ Kanaanfoɔ a mete wɔn asase soɔ yi, worenware wɔn babaa biara mma me ba,
na mmom wobɛkɔ me kurom ne m’abusuafoɔ nkyɛn akɔware ɔbaa ama me ba Isak.”
Ɛnna akoa no bisaa no sɛ: “Na sɛ ɔbaa no mpɛ sɛ ɔne me ba ɛ? Mɛtumi de wo ba no akɔ asase a wofiri so baeɛ no so?”
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ yie na woamfa me ba no ankɔ hɔ.

Awurade, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn a ɔfaa me firii me papa fie ne m’abusuafoɔ nkyɛn no na ɔkaa me ntam sɛ, ‘W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi bɛma wɔn no;’ Hwɛ, ɔbɛma ne bɔfoɔ adi w’anim, na wobɛnya ɔbaa afiri hɔ abrɛ me ba no.
Na sɛ ɔbaa no mpɛ sɛ ɔne wo ba a, ɛnneɛ na woade wo ho afiri ntam a woaka me yi ho. Nanso hwɛ na woamfa me ba no ankɔ hɔ.”
Na akoa no de ne nsa hyɛɛ ne wura Abraham srɛ ase na ɔkaa ntam saa.
Enti akoa no yii ne wura yoma no mu du na ɔfaa nnepa a ne wura wɔ no biara bi. Na ɔsɔre de n’ani kyerɛɛ Mesopotamia sɛ ɔrekɔ Nahor kurom.
Ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ a mmaa taa kɔsa nsuo no, ɔmaa yoma no butubutuu abura bi ho wɔ kuro no akyi.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “O Awurade, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo yi w’adɔeɛ adi kyerɛ me wura Abraham wɔ m’anim nnɛ.
Hwɛ, megyina asubura yi ho, na kuro no mu mmabaa rebɛsa nsuo.

Ma no mmra sɛ ababaa a mɛka akyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wo soɛ w’ahina na ma me nsuo no bi nnom’ a ɔbɛka sɛ, ‘Nom bi, na mɛma wo yoma no nso bi anom’ no, ɔnyɛ ɔbaa a woayi no ama w’akoa Isak; na memfa yei so nhunu sɛ woayi adɔeɛ adi akyerɛ me wura.”
N’ano nnya nsiiɛ no, ɔhunuu sɛ Betuel ba Rebeka reba a ahina si ne kɔn ho. Betuel yɛ Abraham nua Nahor yere Milka ba.
Na ababaa no ho yɛ fɛ yie, ɔbaabunu a ɔbarima biara mfaa ne ho nkaa no da; na ɔkɔɔ asubura no ho kɔsaa nsuo guu n’ahina no mu baeɛ.
Ɛhɔ ara na akoa no kɔhyiaa no kaa sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo ma me w’ahina no mu nsuo kakra nnom.”
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Me wura nom bi.” Na ntɛm ara ɔsoɛɛ ahina no sii ne nsam maa no bi nomee.
Ɔmaa no bi nom wieeɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: “Mɛsa bi ama wo yoma no nso akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛnom amee.”
Na ntɛm ara ɔhwiee nsuo a ɛwɔ n’ahina no mu guu baabi a mmoa nom nsuo no, na ɔde mmirika dii akɔneaba wɔ abura no ho kɔsaa nsuo brɛɛ ne yoma no nyinaa.
Saa berɛ yi nyinaa na ɔbarima no rehwɛ no a, na ɔyɛɛ komm sɛ ɔbɛhunu sɛ Awurade ama no asi no yie n’akwantuo no mu anaa.
Na afei berɛ a yoma no nyinaa nom nsuo no wieeɛ no, ɔbarima no yii sika hwenem kawa a ano si dwetɛbena fa ne sika nkapo mmienu a ano si nnwetɛbena du a ɔde bɛhyɛ ne nsa,
na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Hwan ba ne wo? Mesrɛ wo ka kyerɛ me. Yɛbɛnya baabi wɔ wo papa fie ada anadwo yi?”
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Me papa ne Betuel a Milka woo no maa Nahor no.”
Na ɔtoaa so sɛ: “Yɛwɔ serɛ ne mmoa aduane pii, na baabi wɔ hɔ a mo nso mobɛda.”
Na ɔbarima no bɔɔ ne mu ase kotoo sɔree Awurade anim
na ɔkaa sɛ: “Nhyira nka Awurade, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, a wamfa n’adɔeɛ ankame me wura na wamma ne nsa ansi fam no. Na me nso, Awurade akyerɛ me kwan aba me wura nuanom fie.”
Na ababaa no tuu mmirika kɔbɔɔ ne maame fiefoɔ amanneɛ.
Na Rebeka wɔ nuabarima bi a ne din de Laban. Enti Laban tuu mmirika kɔɔ ɔbarima no nkyɛn wɔ asubura no ho.
Berɛ a ɔhunuu hwenem kawa ne nkapo a ɛgu ne nua Rebeka nsa na ɔtee asɛm a ɔkaeɛ sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ ɔbarima no kasa kyerɛɛ me nie” no, ɔbaa ɔbarima no nkyɛn, na ɔhunuu sɛ ɔgyina yoma no ho wɔ asubura no ho.
Ntɛm ara na ɔkaa sɛ: “Bra, wo a Awurade ahyira woɔ. Ɛdeɛn nti na woda so gyina afikyire? Masiesie fie hɔ ne faako a yoma no bɛda.”
Enti ɔbarima no kɔɔ fie hɔ, na ɔsanee yoma no maa wɔn aduane, na ɔmaa ɔbarima no ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho no nsuo de hohoroo wɔn nan ase.
Na wɔde aduane bɛsii n’anim, nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Merennidi, gye sɛ mabɔ m’amanneɛ awie ansa.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Bɔ ɛ!”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Meyɛ Abraham akoa.
Na Awurade ahyira me wura yie ama no ayɛ ɔkɛseɛ, na wama no nnwan ne anantwie ne dwetɛ ne sika ne nkoa ne mfenaa ne yoma ne mfunumu.
Na me wura yere Sara bɔɔ aberewa no ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa no; na me wura de deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa ama ne ba no.
Enti me wura maa mekaa ntam, na ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Kanaanfoɔ a mete wɔn asase soɔ yi, nware wɔn babaa biara mma me ba no.
Na mmom wobɛkɔ me papa fie ne m’abusua mu akɔware ɔbaa ama me ba no.
Na mebisaa me wura sɛ, ‘Na sɛ ɔbaa no mpɛ sɛ ɔne me ba nso ɛ?’
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘Me ne Awurade anante na menim sɛ ɔbɛma ne bɔfoɔ aka wo ho na asi wo yie w’akwantuo mu; enti ware ɔbaa firi m’abusua mu ne me papa fie brɛ me ba no.
Sɛ wonya kɔ m’abusua mu a, na ntam no ho asodie biara nna wo so, na sɛ wɔamfa ɔbaa no amma wo a, wobɛde wo ho afiri ntam yi ho.’
“Berɛ a meduruu asubura no ho nnɛ no, mekaa sɛ, ‘O Awurade, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, sɛ ampa ara sɛ wobɛma m’akwantuo yi asi me yie a,
hwɛ, ɛnneɛ megyina asubura yi ho. Ma no mmra sɛ ababaa a ɔbɛba abɛsa nsuo a mɛka akyerɛ no sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma mennom w’ahina yi mu nsuo no bi”
a ɔbɛka akyerɛ me sɛ: “Nom bi, na mɛma wo yoma no nso bi anom” no, nyɛ ɔbaa a Awurade ayi no ama me wura ba no.’
“Asɛm no da so wɔ m’akomam no, mehunuu sɛ Rebeka reba a ahina si ne kɔn ho; na ɔsiane kɔɔ asubura no ho kɔsaa nsuo. Ɛnna meka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wo, ma me nsuo no bi nnom.’
Na ntɛm ara na ɔsoɛɛ n’ahina no kaa sɛ, ‘Nom bi, na mɛma wo yoma no nso bi anom.’ Enti menomeeɛ, na ɔmaa yoma no nso bi nomeeɛ.
Na mebisaa no sɛ, ‘Hwan ba ne wo?’ na ɔkaa sɛ ‘Me papa ne Betuel a Milka woo no maa Nahor no.’ Enti mede hwenem kawa no hyɛɛ ne hwenem na mede nkapo no guu ne nsa.
Na mekotoo Awurade, na mehyiraa Awurade, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn a ɔkyerɛɛ me kwan sɛ memmɛfa me wura nua babaa mma ne ba no.
Na afei sɛ mo ne me wura bɛdi no adɔeɛ so adi no nokorɛ a, monka nkyerɛ me; na sɛ ɛnte saa nso a, monka nkyerɛ me, na sɛ mɛfa nifa oo, benkum oo, mafa.”
Ɛnna Laban ne Betuel ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Asɛm yi firi Awurade. Yɛn deɛ, yɛrentumi nka aane anaa dabi nkyerɛ wo.
Rebeka na ɔgyina w’anim no. Fa no kɔ na ɔnyɛ wo wura ba no yere sɛdeɛ Awurade aka no.”
Na Abraham akoa no tee wɔn nsɛm no ara pɛ na ɔbutuu fam wɔ Awurade anim.
Na akoa no yii dwetɛ agudeɛ ne sika agudeɛ ne ntadeɛ na ɔde maa Rebeka; na ɔmaa ne nuabarima ne ne maame nneɛma a ɛsom boɔ.
Na ɔne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no didiiɛ na wɔnomeeɛ, na wɔdaa hɔ anadwo no, na adeɛ kyeeɛ no wɔsɔreeɛ. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Monnya me kwan mma menkɔ me wura nkyɛn.”
Na ne nuabarima ne ne maame kaa sɛ: “Ma ababaa no ntena yɛn nkyɛn dadu bi ɛ. Ɛno akyi no ɔbɛtumi akɔ.”
Nanso ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnsi me kwan, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ama no asi me yie m’akwantuo mu. Monnya me kwan mma menkɔ me wura nkyɛn.”
Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: “Momma yɛmfrɛ ababaa no na yɛntie deɛ ɔbɛka.”
Na wɔfrɛɛ Rebeka bisaa no sɛ: “Wo ne ɔbarima yi bɛkɔ?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Mɛkɔ.”
Enti wɔgyaa wɔn nuabaa Rebeka ne ne abaawa no ne Abraham akoa no ne ne mmarima no kwan.
Na wɔhyiraa Rebeka ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “O yɛn nuabaa, mpempem ahodoɔ mfiri wo mu mmra, na w’asefoɔ mfa wɔn atamfo kuro pono nni so.”
Na Rebeka ne ne mmaawa sɔre tenatenaa yoma so dii ɔbarima no akyi; na akoa no faa Rebeka na ɔsii kwan so kɔeɛ.
Afei Isak firi Beer-Lahai-Roi kwan so baeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔte Negeb asase so.
Ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ no, Isak firii adi kɔɔ afikyire kɔdwendwenee ne nsɛm ho. Afei ɔbɛma n’ani so a, yoma na ɛreba yi!
Berɛ a Rebeka maa n’ani so a ɔhunuu Isak no, ɔhuri firii yoma no so sii fam.
Na ɔbisaa akoa no sɛ: “Ɔbarima bɛn na ɔnam hɔ rebɛhyia yɛn yi?” na akoa no buaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ me wura.” Na ɔyii ntoma de kataa n’anim.
Na akoa no kaa deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa kyerɛɛ Isak.
Na Isak de no baa ne maame Sara ntomadan mu. Enti ɔfaa Rebeka na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yere. Na Isak dɔ no, na ɛmaa no nyaa awerɛkyekyerɛ wɔ ne maame wuo akyi.
25: Abraham san waree ɔbaa bi a ne din de Ketura.
Akyire yi wɔwoo Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Yisbak ne Suha.
Yoksan woo Seba ne Dedan. Na Dedan woo Asurim ne Letusim ne Leumim.
Midian nso woo Hefa, Hefer, Hanok, Abida, ne Eldaa. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Ketura mma.
Akyire yi Abraham de deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa maa Isak,
na Abraham kyɛɛ ne mma afoforɔ no adeɛ. Na berɛ a ɔda so te aseɛ no, ɔmaa wɔfirii ne ba Isak nkyɛn de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ apueeɛ fam kɔɔ Apueeɛ asase so.
Na Abraham nna a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduɔson nnum (175).
Na Abraham gyaa ne honhom mu wuiɛ. Saa berɛ no na wanyini abɔ akora a ne nna amee no, na wɔsiee no kaa ne nkurɔfoɔ ho.
Na ne mma Isak ne Ismael siee no Makpela ɔbodan mu wɔ Hitini Sohar ba Efron asase a ɛda Mamre anim no so;
ɛno ne asase a Abraham tɔ firii Het mma hɔ no. Ɛhɔ na wɔsiee Abraham ne ne yere Sara nyinaa.
Na Abraham wuo akyi no, Onyankopɔn kɔɔ so hyiraa ne ba Isak, na Isak tenaa Beer-Lahai-Roi nkyɛn baabi.
Ismael a Egyptni Hagar, Sara afenaa no, woo no maa Abraham no ho nsɛm nie.
Afei Ismael mma ne wɔn mmusua din nie: Ismael ba panin ne Nebaiot, na wɔn a wɔdi hɔ ne Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam
ne Misma, Duma, Masa,
ne Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafis ne Kedema.
Yeinom ne Ismael mma ne wɔn din, sɛdeɛ wɔn nkuro ne wɔn nsraban teɛ: atitire dumienu ne wɔn mmusua.
Mfeɛ a Ismael diiɛ si ɔha aduasa nson. Afei ɔgyaa mu wuiɛ, na wɔsiee no kaa ne nkurɔfoɔ ho (137).
Na wɔtenaa Hawila a ɛbɛn Sur, a ɛwɔ Egypt anim, kɔpem Asiria. Na ɔtenaa ne nuanom nyinaa anim.
Abraham ba Isak ho nsɛm nie. Abraham woo Isak.
Isak dii mfeɛ aduanan no (40), ɔwaree Rebeka a ne papa ne Siriani Betuel a ɔfiri Padan-Aram; na ne nua ne Siriani Laban.
Isak srɛɛ Awurade maa ne yere, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔbonini; na Awurade tiee n’adesrɛ, na ne yere Rebeka nyinsɛneeɛ.
Na mmɔfra no dii aperepereɛ wɔ ne yam, enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ saa na ɛbɛkɔ so a, ɛnneɛ na mete nkwa mu reyɛ dɛn?” Enti ɔkɔbisaa Awurade asɛm no mu.
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Aman mmienu na ɛwɔ wo yam, na mmusuakuo mmienu a wɔyɛ soronko bɛfiri wo yam; na abusua baako bɛyɛ den asene baako, na panin no bɛsom kumaa no.”
Berɛ a n’awoɔ duruu soɔ no, na nta na ɛwɔ ne yam.
Deɛ ɔdi kan no baeɛ no, na ɔyɛ kɔkɔɔ na ne ho nyinaa yɛ nwi kuhaa te sɛ deɛ ɔhyɛ atadeɛ; enti wɔtoo ne din Esau.
Ɛno akyi no ne nua no baeɛ a na ɔkura Esau nantin; enti ɔtoo ne din Yakob. Rebeka woo wɔn no, na Isak adi mfeɛ aduosia (60).
Mmɔfra no nyiniiɛ; na Esau yɛ obi a ɔnim ahayɔ a ɔpɛ wuram korɔ, na Yakob deɛ, ɔyɛ obi a ne ho nni asɛm a ɔte ntomadan mu.
Na Isak pɛ Esau asɛm ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnya hanam we, na na Rebeka nso pɛ Yakob asɛm.
Berɛ bi na Yakob renoa abɔmuu, na Esau firi wuram baeɛ no, na wabrɛ.
Enti Esau ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo ma me abɔmuu kɔkɔɔ yi bi nni; yɛ no ntɛm na mabrɛ!” Ɛno nti na wɔtoo ne din Edom.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Tɔn wo panin ma me ansa!”
Esau buaa sɛ: “Owuo na merebɛwuo yi, na mpaninnie bɛyɛ me dɛn?”
Yakob ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ka me ntam ansa!” Na ɔkaa ntam tɔn ne panin maa Yakob.
Na Yakob maa no paanoo ne abɔmuu no bi, na ɔdidi nomeeɛ. Na ɔsɔre kɔeɛ. Enti Esau ammu ne panin no.
26: Na ɛkɔm baa asase no so, ɛsono ɛkɔm a ɛdii kan baa Abraham berɛ soɔ no, na Isak kɔɔ Filistifoɔ hene Abimelek nkyɛn wɔ Gerar.
Ɛnna Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nkɔ Egypt; Tena asase a mɛkyerɛ woɔ no so.
Tena asase yi so sɛ hɔhoɔ, na mɛka wo ho na mɛhyira wo, na mede nsase yi nyinaa bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ, na mɛma ntam a mekaa wo papa Abraham no aba mu,
‘Na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma na mede nsase yi nyinaa bɛma wɔn; na asase so aman nyinaa nam w’asefoɔ so bɛnya nhyira,’
ɛfiri sɛ Abraham tiee m’asɛm yɛɛ deɛ mehwehwɛ nyinaa, na ɔdii m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmusɛm ne me mmara so.”
Enti Isak kɔɔ so tenaa Gerar.

Afei na mmarima a wɔwɔ hɔ no taa bisa ne yere ase, na ɛyɛ a ɔka sɛ: “Ɔyɛ me nuabaa.” Na ɔsuro sɛ ɔbɛka sɛ “Ɔyɛ me yere,” ɛfiri sɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, “anhwɛ a Rebeka nti mmarima a wɔwɔ ha yi bɛku me,” ɛfiri sɛ na ne ho yɛ fɛ paa.
Ɔtenaa hɔ kyɛree kakra, na da bi Filistifoɔ hene Abimelek hwɛɛ ne mpomma mu hunuu sɛ Isak ne ne yere Rebeka redi ɔdɔ agorɔ.
Ntɛm ara na Abimelek frɛɛ Isak kaa sɛ: “Ɔbaa yi nyɛ obiara sɛ wo yere! Adɛn nti na wokaa sɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me nuabaa’?” Ɛnna Isak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mekaa saa ɛfiri sɛ na mesuro sɛ anhwɛ a ne nti wɔbɛku me.”
Nanso Abimelek toaa so sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi? Anka worebɛyɛ ama nnipa yi bi ne wo yere ada, na wode asodie abɛto yɛn so!”
Ɛnna Abimelek hyɛɛ mmara maa nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa sɛ: “Obiara a ɔde ne nsa bɛka ɔbarima yi ne ne yere no, wɔbɛku no!”
Na akyire yi Isak yɛɛ afuo wɔ asase no so, na saa afe no ɔnyaa nnɔbaeɛ mmɔho ɔha, ɛfiri sɛ na Awurade ahyira no.
Enti ɔbarima no bɛyɛɛ ɔkɛseɛ na ɔkɔɔ so ara nyaa ne ho kɔsii sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ.
Ɔbɛnyaa nnwan ne anantwie ne nkoa pii, na ɛmaa Filistifoɔ no ani beree no.
Na nsubura a ne papa Abraham nkoa tuiɛ berɛ a ɔte aseɛ no, Filistifoɔ no de dɔteɛ sii no.
Na Abimelek ka kyerɛɛ Isak sɛ: “Tu firi ha kɔ ɛfiri sɛ woabɛnya tumi asene yɛn koraa.”
Enti Isak tu firii hɔ kɔɔ Gerar Bɔn mu kɔtenaa hɔ.
Na Isak san tuu nsubura a ne papa Abraham nkoa tuiɛ berɛ a ɔte aseɛ no mu bio. Nsubura yi na Filistifoɔ no sii no Abraham wuo akyi no. Na edin a ne papa de totoo nsubura no ara na ɔsan de totoeɛ.
Isak nkoa no tuu abura wɔ bɔn no mu na wɔnyaa nsu pa wɔ hɔ.
Na aperepereɛ baa Gerar nnwanhwɛfoɔ ne Isak nnwanhwɛfoɔ ntam, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Nsuo no yɛ yɛn dea!” Enti ɔtoo abura no din Esek, ɛfiri sɛ wɔne no peree ho.
Afei wɔsan tuu abura foforɔ, na ɛno nso wɔne no peree ho. Enti ɔfrɛɛ no Sitna.
Akyire yi wɔfirii hɔ kɔtuu abura foforɔ, na ɛno deɛ wɔne no ampere ho. Enti ɔfrɛɛ no Rehobot kaa sɛ: “Afei deɛ, Awurade ama yɛn mu atrɛ, na yɛadɔre wɔ asase yi so.”
Wɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Beer-Seba.
Na Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no anadwo no, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mene w’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn. Nsuro, ɛfiri sɛ meka wo ho, na m’akoa Abraham nti mɛhyira wo ama w’ase atrɛ.”
Enti ɔsii afɔrebukyia na ɔbɔɔ Awurade din wɔ hɔ; afei Isak sii ne ntomadan wɔ hɔ na ne nkoa tuu abura wɔ hɔ. Abraham ne Abimelek yɛ apam
Akyire yi Abimelek ne n’adamfo fotufoɔ Ahusat ne ne sahene Pikol firi Gerar baa ne nkyɛn.
Ɛnna Isak bisaa wɔn sɛ: “Moaba me nkyɛn rebɛyɛ dɛn? Ɛnyɛ mo ara na ɔtan nti mopamoo me firii mo mpɔtamu hɔ no?”
Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛahunu ampa ara sɛ Awurade di w’akyi. Enti yɛdwenee ho sɛ, ‘Yɛne wo bɛkeka yɛn ho ntam, na yɛne wo ayɛ apam,
sɛ worenyɛ yɛn bɔne biara sɛdeɛ yɛmfaa yɛn nsa nkaa woɔ na yɛne wo adi no yie na yɛagya wo kwan asomdwoeɛ mu no. Afei wone deɛ Awurade ahyira no.’”
Na ɔtoo wɔn pono, na wɔdidi nomeeɛ.
Adeɛ kyeeɛ no wɔsɔree ntɛm, na wɔkekaa wɔn ho ntam. Ɛno akyi no, Isak gyaa wɔn kwan na wɔde asomdwoeɛ firii ne nkyɛn kɔeɛ.
Saa da no, Isak nkoa no bɛkaa abura a wɔtuiɛ no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛato nsuo!”
Enti ɔfrɛɛ no Siba. Ɛno nti na kuro no din de Beer-Seba bɛsi nnɛ no.
Na Esau dii mfeɛ aduanan no, ɔwaree Hitini Beeri ba Yudit ne Hitini Elon ba Basemat.
Na wɔmaa Isak ne Rebeka dii awerɛhoɔ, maa abrabɔ yɛɛ nwono maa wɔn.
27: Na berɛ a Isak abɔ akɔkoraa na n’ani so ayɛ kusuu a ɔnhunu adeɛ no, ɔfrɛɛ ne ba panin Esau sɛ: “Me ba, wowɔ he?” Ɛnna ɔse: “Menie!”
Ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, mabɔ akora. Mennim da a mɛwuo.
Enti mesrɛ wo, fa wo nneɛma a wode yɛ ha, w’agyan ne wo kotokuo, na kɔ wuram kɔpɛ hanam brɛ me,
wode ba a, fa yɛ akɔnnɔduane a mepɛ paa brɛ me ma menni na me kra nhyira wo ansa na mawu.”
Nso berɛ a Isak ne ne ba Esau rekasa no nyinaa na Rebeka retie. Na Esau kɔɔ wuram sɛ ɔrekɔpɛ hanam aba.
Ɛnna Rebeka ka kyerɛɛ ne ba Yakob sɛ: “Hwɛ, mate sɛ wo papa reka akyerɛ wo nua Esau sɛ,
‘Kɔ wuram kɔpɛ hanam bɛyɛ akɔnnɔduane ma menni na menhyira wo Awurade anim ansa na mawu.’
Na afei, me ba, tie me nne, sɛdeɛ merehyɛ woɔ yi:
Kɔ mmoakuo no mu kɔkyere mmirekyie nkumaa mmienu brɛ me, na memfa nyɛ akɔnnɔduane a wo papa pɛ paa mma no.
Mewie a, na wode akɔma wo papa ama no adi na wahyira wo ansa na wawu.”
Ɛnna Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne maame Rebeka sɛ: “Me nua Esau ho wɔ nwi na me deɛ, me ho yɛ tonomtonom.
Na sɛ me papa de ne nsa ka me ho ɛ? na mɛyɛ n’ani so sɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ, na ɛbɛdane nnome ama me, na ɛnyɛ nhyira.”
Na ne maame ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nnome biara a ɛbɛba wo soɔ no mmra me so. Wo deɛ, tie deɛ mereka no na kɔfa mmoa no brɛ me.”
Enti ɔkɔfaa wɔn brɛɛ ne maame na ɔde yɛɛ akɔnnɔduane a ne papa pɛ paa.
Na Rebeka de ne ba panin Esau ntadeɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie hɔ no hyɛɛ ne ba kumaa Yakob.
Ɛnna ɔde mmirekyie no nwoma duraa ne nsa ne ne kɔn ho baabi a nwi nnie no.
Na ɔde aduane ne paanoo a wasiesie no hyɛɛ ne ba Yakob nsa.
Enti ɔde kɔɔ ne papa hɔ, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Papa!” na ɔgyee so sɛ: “Menie! Ɛyɛ wo hwan, me ba?”
Ɛnna Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne papa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ wo ba panin Esau. Deɛ wokaeɛ no mayɛ awie. Mesrɛ wo, sɔre tena ase na di me hanam no bi na wo kra nhyira me.”
Ɛnna Isak ka kyerɛɛ ne ba no sɛ: “Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wonyaa no ntɛm saa?” Ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn na ɔmaa no bɛhyiaa me.”
Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, twe bɛn me na memfa me nsa nka wo nhwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ me ba Esau ampa a.”
Enti Yakob twe bɛn ne papa Isak, na ɔde ne nsa kekaa ne ho, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛnne no yɛ Yakob nne, nanso nsa no yɛ Esau nsa.”
Wanhu no, ɛfiri sɛ na ne nsa ho wɔ nwi te sɛ ne nua Esau nsa ho. Enti ɔhyiraa no.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: “Wone me ba Esau ampa?” Ɛnna ɔse: “Aane, mene no.”
Afei ɔkaa sɛ: “Fa brɛ me na menni me ba hanam no bi na me kra nhyira wo.” Enti ɔde bɛsii n’anim na ɔfirii aseɛ didiiɛ, na ɔde nsa brɛɛ no maa no nomee.
Ɛnna ne papa Isak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, twe bɛn me na bɛfe m’ano, me ba.”
Enti ɔbɛfee n’ano, na ɔtee n’atadeɛ mu hwa. Ɛnna ɔfirii aseɛ hyiraa no sɛ: “Hwɛ, me ba ho hwa te sɛ afuo a Awurade ahyira soɔ hwa.
Na Onyankopɔn mma wo ɔsoro bosuo ne asase pa ne nnɔbaeɛ, aburoo ne nsa pii.
Aman nsom wo, na amanaman nkoto wo. Di wo nuanom so na wo maame yam mma nkoto wo. Nnome nka obiara a ɔbɛdome woɔ, na nhyira nka obiara a ɔbɛhyira woɔ.”
Isak hyiraa Yakob wieeɛ a ɔfirii ne papa anim kɔeɛ ara pɛ na ne nua Esau firi ahayɔ baeɛ.
Ɔno nso yɛɛ akɔnnɔduane de brɛɛ ne papa kaa sɛ: “Papa, mesrɛ wo sɔre na di wo ba hanam na wo kra nhyira me.”
Ɛnna ne papa Isak bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛyɛ wo hwan?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ me, wo ba panin Esau.”
Na Isak ho wosoo biribiribiri na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛnneɛ hwan na ɔkɔyɛɛ ha de brɛɛ me maa medii ne nyinaa ansa na woreba yi? Mahyira no, na nhyira nso na ɔbɛnya!”
Esau tee ne papa asɛm no, ɔde yea suu dendeenden, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne papa sɛ: “Papa, mesrɛ wo, hyira me nso bi!”
Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: “Wo nua abɛdaadaa me agye wo nhyira no.”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ ɛno nti na ne din de Yakob no? Mprenu nie a watwintwane m’ananmu. Wagye me panin dada, na seesei nso wagye me nhyira!” Ɔtoaa so sɛ: “Enti woamfa nhyira bi ansie me?”
Nanso Isak buaa Esau sɛ: “Hwɛ, mayi no sɛ ɔnni wo so, na mede ne nuanom nyinaa ama no sɛ nkoa, na mede ayuo ne nsa nso ahyira no, na ɛdeɛn bio na ɛwɔ hɔ a mɛyɛ ama woɔ, me ba?”
Na Esau bisaa ne papa sɛ: “Papa, enti nhyira baako pɛ na wowɔ? Hyira me nso, O m'agya!” Na Esau maa ne nne so suu dendeenden.
Enti ne papa Isak buaa no sɛ: “Hwɛ, wo ne asase pa ntam kwan bɛware, na wobɛtena baabi a ɔsoro bosuo nnie.
Wo nkrantɛ ano na wode bɛtena aseɛ, na wobɛsom wo nua. Nanso sɛ wofiri aseɛ akentene wo ho a, wobɛyi ne kɔnnua afiri wo kɔn so.”
Ɛsiane sɛ Esau papa hyiraa Yakob nti, Esau bɛtanee ne nua no, na ɔkaa no n’akomam sɛ: “Berɛ a wɔde bɛgyam me papa abɛn. Ɛno akyi no mɛkum me nua Yakob.”
Berɛ a wɔbɛkaa asɛm a Rebeka ba panin Esau aka kyerɛɛ no no, ntɛm ara na Rebeka soma kɔfrɛɛ ne ba kumaa Yakob na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, wo nua Esau abɔ wo ato hɔ—ɔnya wo a, ɔbɛku wo.
Enti me ba, tie na sɔre dwane kɔ me nua Laban nkyɛn wɔ Haran.
Na tena ne nkyɛn nna kakra kɔsi sɛ wo nua abufuo ano bɛdwoɔ;

twɛn kɔsi sɛ wo nua abufuo bɛdane afiri wo soɔ na ne werɛ afiri deɛ woayɛ no no. Afei mɛsoma ama wɔabɛfa wo afiri hɔ. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwere mo mmienu nyinaa da koro?” Isak ma Yakob kɔ Laban nkyɛn

Akyire yi Rebeka ka kyerɛɛ Isak sɛ: “Het mma mmaa nti asetena afono me. Na sɛ Yakob nso kɔware Het mma mmaa te sɛ yeinom wɔ asase yi so a, ɛnneɛ na me mmerɛ ngui, na mete ase reyɛ dɛn?” Isak hyira Yakob, na ɔgya no kwan kɔ Mesopotamia
28: Enti Isak frɛɛ Yakob na ɔhyiraa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nware Kanaanfoɔ mmaa no mu biara.
Sɔre kɔ Padan-Aram, wo maame papa Betuel fie, na ware wo wɔfa Laban mma mmaa no baako.
Adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ Nyankopɔn nhyira wo, na ɔmma w’ase nnɔ nyɛ bebree, na woabɛyɛ aman asafodɔm.
Na ɔde Abraham nhyira bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ a wɔka wo ho, na wobɛfa asase a wobɛsoɛ so a Onyankopɔn de ama Abraham no.”
Enti Isak gyaa Yakob kwan na ɔsiim kɔɔ Siriani Betuel ba Laban nkyɛn wɔ Padan-Aram. Na ɔyɛ Yakob ne Esau maame Rebeka nuabarima.
Esau hunuu sɛ Isak ahyira Yakob agya no kwan kɔ Padan-Aram sɛ ɔnkɔware wɔ hɔ, na waka akyerɛ no nso sɛ: “Nware Kanaanfoɔ mmaa no mu biara.”
Afei ɔhunuu sɛ Yakob atie ne papa ne ne maame asi kwan so rekɔ Padan-Aram.
Na Esau hunuu sɛ ne papa Isak ani nnye Kanaanfoɔ mmaa no ho.
Enti Esau kɔɔ Abraham ba Ismael nkyɛn kɔwaree ne babaa Mahalat a ɔyɛ Nebaiot nuabaa kaa ne yerenom ho.
Yakob firii Beer-Seba de n’ani kyerɛɛ Haran.
Na ɔkɔduruu bea bi na ɔyɛɛ n’adwene sɛ ɔbɛda hɔ ɛfiri sɛ na enwunu adwo. Enti ɔfaa boɔ bi de yɛɛ sumiiɛ na ɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔsoo daeɛ, na ɔhunuu sɛ atwedeɛ bi si asase so na n’atifi kɔpem soro; na ɔhunuu sɛ Onyankopɔn abɔfoɔ redi aforosiane wɔ so.
Na hwɛ! na Awurade gyina atifi, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mene Awurade, w’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Isak Nyankopɔn. Mede asase a woda soɔ yi bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ.
W’asefoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ asase so anwea na w’ase bɛtrɛ akɔ baabiara, atɔeɛ ne apueeɛ, atifi ne anafoɔ; na asase so mmusua nyinaa nam wo ne w’asefoɔ so bɛnya nhyira.
Na hwɛ, mɛdi w’akyi na baabi a wobɛkorɔ biara mɛhwɛ wo so, na mɛsan de wo aba asase yi so, na merennya wo gye sɛ mayɛ deɛ maka akyerɛ woɔ yi nyinaa.”
Na Yakob nyaneeɛ na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ampa ara Awurade wɔ ha na mennim da.”
Ehu kaa no na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛha yɛ hu papaapa! Ɛha nyɛ baabiara sɛ Onyankopɔn fie, na ɛha ne ɔsoro pono ano.”
Enti Yakob sɔree anɔpatutuutu faa boɔ a ɔde yɛɛ sumiiɛ no de yɛɛ nkaeɛdum, na ɔhwiee ngo guu so.
Afei ɔtoo hɔ din Betel; nanso na kuro no din paa ne Lus.
Na Yakob hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: “Sɛ Onyankopɔn di m’akyi hwɛ me so m’akwantuo yi mu, na ɔma me aduane di ma me atadeɛ hyɛ
na mesan kɔ me papa fie asomdwoeɛ mu a, ɛnneɛ Awurade bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn.
Na ɛboɔ a mede ayɛ nkaeɛdum yi bɛyɛ Onyankopɔn fie, na biribiara a wode bɛma me no nso mɛkyɛ mu du ama wo baako.”
29: Na Yakob toaa n’akwantuo no so kɔɔ Apueeɛ Famfoɔ asase so.
Na ɔhunuu sɛ abura bi wɔ asase no so a nnwankuo mmiɛnsa butubutu ho, ɛfiri sɛ saa abura no mu nsuo na wɔsa ma mmoa no nom; na na ɛboɔ kɛseɛ bi da abura no ano.
Sɛ wɔboaboa nnwan no nyinaa ano wɔ hɔ a, wɔyi boɔ no firi abura no ano, na wɔma nnwan no nsuo, afei wɔsan de boɔ no to abura no ano.
Na Yakob bisaa wɔn sɛ: “Me nuanom, ɛhe na mofire?” na wɔbuaa sɛ: “Yɛfiri Haran.”
Afei ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: “Monim Nahor ba Laban anaa?” Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛni no.”
Ɛnna ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: “Ne ho yɛ anaa?” Na wɔbuaa sɛ: “Ne ho yɛ. Na ne babaa Rachel mpo na ɔde nnwan reba no!”
Ɔtoaa so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Hwɛ, adeɛ nnya nsae koraa, na ɛberɛ a wɔboaboa mmoakuo ano nnya nnurui. Momma nnwan no nsuo nnom, na monkɔ mma wɔnkɔdidi”
Ɛnna wɔbuaa sɛ: “Yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛyɛ saa gye sɛ nnwan no nyinaa ba ha na wɔyi boɔ no firi abura no ano. Ɛno ansa na yɛbɛtumi ama nnwan no nsuo.”
Berɛ a ɔgu so ne wɔn rekasa no, Rachel de ne papa nnwan baeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ.
Berɛ a Yakob hunuu ne wɔfa Laban ba Rachel ne Laban nnwan no, ntɛm ara na Yakob kɔpiaa boɔ no firii abura no ano, na ɔmaa ne wɔfa Laban nnwan no nsuo.
Na Yakob fee Rachel ano na ɔmaa ne nne so suiɛ.
Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Rachel sɛ ne maame ne Rebeka enti ne busuani ne Rachel papa. Na Rahel de mmirika kɔka kyerɛɛ ne papa.
Laban tee ne wɔfase Yakob ho asɛm ara pɛ na ɔtuu mmirika kɔhyiaa no. Ɛnna ɔbam no fee n’ano, na ɔde no baa ne fie. Na Yakob kaa deɛ asie nyinaa kyerɛɛ Laban.
Na Laban ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Woyɛ me dompe ne me honam.” Enti ɔne no tenaa bosome baako. Yakob som Laban de ware Lea ne Rahel
Na Laban ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “Ɛnam sɛ woyɛ me busuani nti, wobɛsom me kwa anaa? Ɛdeɛn na wobɛgyeɛ? Ka kyerɛ me na ɛnyɛ w'akatua.”
Na Laban wɔ mma mmaa mmienu. Panin no din de Lea na kumaa no de Rachel.
Nanso na Lea ani mma yɛ nketenkete, na Rahel deɛ, na ne ho yɛ fɛ firi soro bɛsi fam.
Na Yakob dɔ Rachel, enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Mepɛ sɛ mesom wo mfeɛ nson na wode wo babaa kumaa Rachel ma me.”
Ɛnna Laban kaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ sɛ mede no bɛma woɔ sene sɛ mede no bɛma ɔbarima foforɔ. Tena me nkyɛn.”
Na Yakob som mfeɛ nson sɛ ɔde bɛnya Rachel, nanso ɛyɛɛ n’ani so sɛ nna kakraa bi ɛfiri sɛ na ɔdɔ no.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Laban sɛ: “Me berɛ aduru, mesrɛ wo fa me yere ma me na menkɔ ne ho.”
Ɛnna Laban frɛfrɛɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa bɛhyiaeɛ na ɔtoo pono.
Nanso adeɛ saeɛ no, ɔde ne babaa Lea brɛɛ no na ɔkɔɔ ne ho.
Na Laban de n’afenaa Silpa maa ne babaa Lea sɛ n’abaawa.
Adeɛ kyeeɛ no ɔbɛhwɛ a, Lea nie! Enti ɔbisaa Laban sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ me yi? Ɛnyɛ Rahel nti na mesom woɔ? Adɛn nti na woadaadaa me?”
Ɛnna Laban buaa sɛ: “Ɛha deɛ, yɛnyɛ no saa o. Yɛn deɛ, yɛmfa kumaa no mma awareɛ ansa na panin no aware.
Wo ne ɔbaa yi ntena nnawɔtwe nwie. Ɛno akyi no mede ɔbaa baako no nso bɛma wo na woasom me mfeɛ nson aka ho.”
Enti Yakob penee so ne ɔbaa no tena maa nnawɔtwe no soeɛ, na ɛno akyi no ɔde Rachel maa no awareɛ.
Na Laban de n’afenaa Bilha maa Rahel sɛ n’abaawa.
Na ɔkɔɔ Rachel nso ho, na na ɔdɔ Rahel sene Lea, na ɔfirii aseɛ som Laban mfeɛ nson bio.
Na Awurade hunuu sɛ ɔnnɔ Lea no, ɔbuee ne yam, na Rachel deɛ, ɔbɛyɛɛ obonini.
Na Lea nyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima na ɔtoo ne din Ruben, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade abɛhwɛ m’amanehunu, na afei me kunu bɛdɔ me.”
Na ɔsan nyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade ate sɛ wɔnnɔ me, enti na wama me oyi nso.” Na ɔtoo ne din Simeon.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio woo ɔbabarima, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Afei deɛ, me kunu bɛka aba me ho, ɛfiri sɛ mawo mma mmarima mmiɛnsa ama no.” Enti ɔtoo ne din Lewi.
Na ɔsan nyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Afei deɛ, mɛkamfo Awurade.” Enti ɔtoo ne din Yuda. Afei n’awoɔ te kɔeɛ.
30: Rachel hunuu sɛ ɔnwo mmaa Yakob no, n’ani beree ne nua no na ɔka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “Ma me mma, anyɛ saa a mɛwu.”
Na Yakob bo fuu Rachel na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Mene Onyankopɔn a wasi wo yafunu ano a wontumi nwoɔ no anaa?”
Enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, m’abaawa Bilha nie. Kɔ ne ho, na ɔnwo nto me srɛ so na manya ne nkyɛn mma.”
Enti ɔde n’abaawa Bilha maa Yakob sɛ ne yere, na ɔkɔɔ ne ho.
Na Bilha nyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Rahel kaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn adi m’asɛm ama me, na watie me nso ama me ɔbabarima.” Enti ɔtoo ne din Dan.
Rachel abaawa Bilha san nyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Rahel kaa sɛ: “Me ne me nua adi asie a emu yɛ den, na madi nkonim!” Enti ɔtoo ne din Naftali.
Berɛ a Lea hunuu sɛ n’awoɔ ate kɔ no, ɔde n’abaawa Silpa maa Yakob sɛ ne yere.
Na Silpa woo ɔbabarima maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Lea kaa sɛ: “Aba yie!” Enti ɔtoo ne din Gad.
Ɛno akyi no Silpa woo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Lea kaa sɛ: “M’ani agye! Mmaa bɛfrɛ me nhyira.” Enti ɔtoo ne din Aser.
Na ayuo twa berɛ mu no, na Ruben nam na ɔkɔhunuu dudayim aduaba wɔ wuram. Enti ɔde brɛɛ ne maame Lea. Ɛnna Rahel ka kyerɛɛ Lea sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, ma me aduaba a wo ba no de baeɛ no bi.”

Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wogye di sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm ketewa sɛ wobɛgye me kunu na woasan abɛgye aduaba a me ba de aba yi?” Enti Rachel kaa sɛ: “Sɛ saa a, ma me wo ba no aduaba no bi na ɔne wo nkɔda anadwo yi.”
Anwummerɛ a Yakob firi afuo mu reba no Lea kɔhyiaa no kaa sɛ: “Wobɛba me ho anadwo yi, ɛfiri sɛ mabɔ wo paa na mede dudayim aduaba a me ba de baeɛ no atua ka.” Enti ɔkɔɔ ne ho anadwo no.
Na Onyankopɔn tiee Lea na ɔnyinsɛneeɛ, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so nnum maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Lea kaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn de m’akatua ama me, ɛfiri sɛ mede m’abaawa ama me kunu.” Enti ɔtoo ne din Isakar.
Na Lea san nyinsɛneeɛ na ɔwoo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so nsia maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Lea kaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn akyɛ me adepa. Afei deɛ me kunu bɛpɛ m’asɛm, ɛfiri sɛ mawo mma mmarima nsia ama no.” Enti ɔtoo ne din Sebulon.
Na ɛno akyi no ɔwoo ɔbabaa na ɔtoo ne din Dina.
Na Onyankopɔn kaee Rachel, na Onyankopɔn tiee no na ɔbuee ne yafunu mu.
Na ɔnyinsɛneeɛ na ɔwoo ɔbabarima. Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn ayi m’ahohora!”
Enti ɔtoo ne din Yosef, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade mma me ɔbabarima foforɔ nka ne ho.”
Berɛ a Rachel woo Yosef no, Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Laban sɛ: “Gya me kwan ma menkɔ me kurom ne m’asase so.
Fa me yerenom ne me mma a masom woɔ anya wɔn no ma me na menkɔ; na wo ara wonim som a masom woɔ.”
Ɛnna Laban ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ manya w’anim adom a, mesrɛ wo twɛn, na mahunu nsɛnkyerɛnne sɛ wo nti Awurade nam wo so ahyira me.”
Na ɔde kaa ho sɛ: “Kyerɛ akatua a memfa mma woɔ, na mede bɛma wo.”
Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo ara wonim sɛdeɛ masom woɔ ne sɛdeɛ wo mmoa ayɛ wɔ me nsam;
na wonim sɛ ansa na mereba no na wowɔ mmoa kakraa bi, nanso ɛfiri berɛ a mebaa ha yi, Awurade ahyira wo ama wɔadɔɔso ayɛ bebree. Enti berɛ bɛn na me nso mɛnya biribi ama me fie?”
Ɛnna ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na memfa mma woɔ?” Na Yakob kaa sɛ: “Mma me hwee! Sɛ wobɛyɛ yei ama me a, mɛkɔ so ahwɛ wo nnwan no. Mɛbɔ wɔn ho ban.
Mɛfa wo nnwan no nyinaa mu nnɛ. Ma nnwan a wɔn ho yɛ damedame nworonworan ne nnwammaa a wɔn ho yɛ tuntum ne mmirekyie a wɔn ho yɛ damedame nworonworan no nnyina faako. Ma ɛno nyɛ m’akatua.
Sɛ ɛba sɛ daakye wobɛhwɛ m’akatua no a, me nokorɛdie bɛdi me ho adanseɛ; na sɛ wohunu mmirekyie a wɔn ho nyɛ damedame nworonworan ne nnwammaa a wɔn ho nyɛ tuntum wɔ me nkyɛn a, na mawia.”
Ɛnna Laban kaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ paa! Ma yɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka no.”

Enti saa da no ɔmaa mpapo a wɔn ho wɔ nsensaneeɛ ne mmirekyibereɛ a wɔn ho yɛ damedame nworonworan, deɛ fitaa wɔ ne ho biara, ne nnwammaa a wɔyɛ tuntum nyinaa gyinaa faako, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ ne mma mmarima no nsa.
Na ɔde nnansa kwan too ɔne Yakob ntam, na Yakob hwɛɛ Laban nnwan a ɛkaeɛ no so.
Na Yakob twitwaa duafufuo ne ɔsonkoran ne kyɛnkyɛn nnua a ɛyɛ mono, na ɔwaewaee ho maa baabi a ɛyɛ fitaa no daa adi.
Na ɔde nnua a wawaewae ho no guu baabi a nnwan no nom nsuo, na sɛ wɔba hɔ bɛnom nsuo na wɔhunu a, wɔn berɛ aduru ama wɔaforo wɔn.
Enti sɛ nnwan no ba nnua no ho a wɔforo wɔn, na wɔwo mma a wɔn ho yɛ nsensaneeɛ ne damedame nworonworan.
Yakob yii nnwammaa no kɔɔ nkyɛn na ɔde nnwan no ani kyerɛɛ Laban nnwankuo no mu nnwan a wɔn ho yɛ nsensaneeɛ ne damedame no. Afei Yakob yii mmoa a wanya no kɔɔ nkyɛn na wamma wɔamfra Laban deɛ no mu.
Berɛ biara a ɛbɛduru sɛ wɔforo nnwan a wɔn ho yɛ den no, Yakob de nnua no kɔgu subɔnka no ho faako a nnwan no bɛhunu, na ama wɔaforo wɔn wɔ nnua no ho.
Nanso sɛ nnwan no yɛ nofonofo a, ɔmfa nnua no ngu hɔ. Enti na Laban nnwan no yɛ nofonofo, na Yakob deɛ no ho yɛ den.
Enti ɔbarima no nyaa ne ho paa, na ɔnyaa nnwan ne mfenaa ne nkoa ne yoma ne mfunumu pii. Yakob dwane firi Laban nkyɛn
31: Na Yakob tee sɛ Laban mma no rekeka sɛ: “Yakob afa yɛn papa nneɛma nyinaa; na yɛn papa agyapadeɛ na ɔde anya ne ho.”
Na Yakob hunuu sɛ Laban nte n’anim mma no sɛ kane no.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “San kɔ w’agyanom asase so ne w’abusuafoɔ nkyɛn, na mɛdi w’akyi.”
Ɛnna Yakob frɛɛ Rachel ne Lea baa baabi a ne nnwan didie no,
na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mahunu sɛ mo papa Laban nte n’anim mma me sɛ kane no; nanso mahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn a me papa som no no di m’akyi.
Mo ara monim sɛ mede m’ahoɔden nyinaa asom mo papa.
Na mo papa asisi me, na wasesa m’akatua mprɛ du, nanso Onyankopɔn amma kwan amma no anyɛ me bɔne.

Sɛ ɔka sɛ, ‘Mede mmoa a wɔn ho yɛ damedame no bɛtua wo ka’ a, mmoa no nyinaa wo wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ damedame; na sɛ ɔka sɛ, ‘Mede wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ nsensaneeɛ no bɛtua wo ka’ a, wɔn nyinaa wo wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ nsensaneeɛ.
Enti Onyankopɔn agye mo papa mmoa ama me.
Na ɛduruu berɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔforo mmoa no, mesoo daeɛ hunuu sɛ mpapo a wɔn ho yɛ nsensaneeɛ ne damedame ne nsisiinsisii no reforo abereɛ no.
Ɛnna Onyankopɔn bɔfoɔ frɛɛ me daeɛ mu sɛ, ‘Yakob!’ na megyee so sɛ, ‘Menie.’
Ɔtoaa so sɛ, ‘Ma w’ani so na hwɛ, mpapo a wɔn ho yɛ nsensaneeɛ ne damedame ne nsisiinsisii no reforo abereɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ mahunu deɛ Laban reyɛ woɔ no nyinaa.
Mene Onyankopɔn a ɔyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ wo wɔ Betel, baabi a wosraa nkaeɛdum bi na wohyɛɛ me bɔ no. Afei sɔre firi ha san kɔ asase a wɔwoo wo soɔ no so.’”
Na Rachel ne Lea buaa sɛ: “Agyapadeɛ bɛn bio na yɛwɔ no yɛn papa fie?
Ɔmmu yɛn sɛ ahɔhoɔ? Ɛfiri sɛ watɔn yɛn, na wadi yɛn tiri sika awie.
Agyapadeɛ a Onyankopɔn agye afiri yɛn papa hɔ nyinaa yɛ yɛne yɛn mma dea. Enti biribiara a Onyankopɔn aka akyerɛ woɔ no, yɛ.” Yakob dwane firi Laban anim
Na Yakob sɔre memaa ne mma ne ne yerenom so tenatenaa yoma so;
na ɔde ne mmoa ne agyapadeɛ a wabɛnya no Padan-Aram nyinaa siim sɛ ɔrekɔ ne papa Isak nkyɛn wɔ Kanaan asase so.
Saa berɛ yi na Laban rekɔtwitwa ne nnwan ho nwi. Na Rachel wiaa ne papa abusua honi.
Na Yakob wiaa ne ho dwaneeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wanka ne korɔ no ho asɛm ankyerɛ Siriani Laban.
Na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa dwane kɔtwaa asubɔnten kɛseɛ no. Akyire yi ɔde n’ani kyerɛɛ Gilead bepɔ so.
Nnansa akyi no, Laban tee sɛ Yakob adwane.
Ntɛm ara na ɔfaa ne nuanom kaa ne ho tii no nnanson, na wɔkɔtoo no Gilead bepɔ so.
Na Onyankopɔn yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Siriani Laban wɔ daeɛ mu na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ yie wɔ asɛm biara a wobɛka akyerɛ Yakob no ho.”
Enti Laban kɔtoo Yakob sɛ wasi ne ntomadan wɔ bepɔ so, na Laban ne ne nuanom nso sii wɔn deɛ wɔ Gilead bepɔ so.
Na Laban ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi? Woawia wo ho de me mma mmaa adwane sɛ nnipa a wɔde nkrantɛ afa wɔn nnommum!?
Adɛn nti na wowiaa wo ho dwaneeɛ a wanka ankyerɛ me amma mamfa osebɔ ne nnwom ne mpintin ne nsankuo annya wo kwan?
Woamma mamfe mmɔfra yi ne me mma mmaa no ano mpo. Woadi nkwaseasɛm paa.
Anka mɛtumi ayɛ mo bɔne biara a mepɛ, nanso Onyankopɔn a mo papa som no no ne me kasaa anadwo yi sɛ, ‘Hwɛ yie wɔ asɛm biara a wobɛka akyerɛ Yakob, papa anaa bɔne kwan so.’
Sɛ w’ani agyina wo papa fie na wopɛ sɛ wokɔ a, adɛn nti na woawia m’anyame?”
Ɛnna Yakob buaa Laban sɛ: “Na mesuro sɛ wobɛgye wo mma mmaa no afiri me nsam.
Obiara a wobɛhunu w’anyame no wɔ ne nkyɛn no, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔnya ne tiri didi mu. Yɛn nuanom na wɔwɔ ha yi; hwehwɛ biribiara mu na sɛ wohunu a, fa kɔ.” Nanso na Yakob nnim sɛ Rachel na wawia.
Enti Laban kɔɔ Yakob ne Lea ne mmaawa mmienu no nyinaa ntomadan mu, nanso wanhunu. Afei ɔfiri Lea hɔ kɔɔ Rahel ntomadan mu.
Na Rachel afa terafim honi no de ahyɛ mmaa kotokuo a wɔde to yoma soɔ no mu, na saa berɛ nso nyinaa na ɔte so. Enti Laban hwehwɛɛ ntomadan no mu baabiara nanso wanhunu.

Ɛnna Rachel ka kyerɛɛ ne papa sɛ: “Papa, mesrɛ wo mma wo bo mmfu me, merentumi nsɔre ɛfiri sɛ mmaa adeɛ no bi ayɛ me [mabu me nsa].” Enti ɔtoo ne bo ase hwehwɛɛ baabiara nanso wanhunu terafim honi no.
Yakob bo fuiɛ na ɔne Laban hamee, na ɔbisaa Laban sɛ: “Bɔne bɛn na mayɛ, na mmara bɛn na matoɔ a wodi m’akyi kirididi saa?
Wohwehwɛɛ me nneɛma mu yi, wo fie agyapadeɛ bɛn na woahunu? Sɛ woahunu biribi a fa bra me nuanom ne wo nuanom nyinaa anim na wɔmmu yɛn mmienu ntam atɛn.
Me ne wo atena mfeɛ aduonu. Wo nnwan anaa mmirekyie no biara ampɔn, na manwe mu biara nso.
Sɛ aboa bi ku wo mmoa no bi a, me ara metua ka; memfa no mmrɛ wo. Na sɛ obi wia bi anadwo oo, awia oo, wogye no me nsam.
Ahuhuro ba awia a, menam mu, awɔ ba anadwo nso a, menam mu, m’ani nkum na mada.
Mfeɛ aduonu nie a matena wo fie. Wo mma mmaa nti, masom wo mfeɛ dunan, na mede mfeɛ nsia nso ahwɛ wo mmoa, na woasesa m’akatua mprɛ du.
Sɛ enyɛ m’agya Nyankopɔn ne Abraham Nyankopɔn, deɛ Isak suro no no, nni m’akyi a, anka nsapan na wode bɛgya me kwan. Nanso Onyankopɔn ahunu m’ahohia ne me brɛ, enti na ɔkaa w’anim nnora anadwo no.”
Na Laban buaa Yakob sɛ: “Hwɛ, mmaa yi yɛ me mma mmaa, mmɔfra yi nso yɛ me dea, na mmoa yi nso wɔ me; biribiara a w’ani tua yi yɛ me dea. Bɔne bɛn na nnɛ mɛtumi ayɛ wɔn anaa mmɔfra a wɔawo wɔn yi?
Afei, bra na me ne wo nyɛ apam na ɛnyɛ adanseɛ me ne wo ntam.”
Enti Yakob faa ɛboɔ na ɔde yɛɛ nkaeɛdum.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: “Mommoaboa aboɔ ano!” Ɛnna wɔkɔtasee aboɔ baeɛ na wɔboaboaa ano yɛɛ no kuo. Na wɔdidii aboɔ kuo no so.
Laban frɛɛ hɔ Yega-Sahaduta, na Yakob deɛ ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Galeed.
Na Laban kaa sɛ: “Aboɔ kuo yi yɛ me ne wo ntam adanseɛ nnɛ.” Enti na ɔfrɛɛ no Galeed,
ne Mispa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ wokɔ na me nso mekɔ a, Awurade nhwɛ me ne wo ntam.
Sɛ woteetee me mma mmaa yi anaa wokɔfa mmaa foforɔ ka me mma yi ho a, onipa biara nni yɛn ntam. Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn na ɔyɛ me ne wo ntam danseni.”
Laban toaa so kaa sɛ: “Mahyehyɛ aboɔ kuo yi na mede nkaeɛdum yi asi me ne wo ntam.
Aboɔ kuo ne nkaeɛdum yi yɛ adanseɛ sɛ merentra aboɔ yi mma wo so na wo nso worentra aboɔ ne nkaeɛdum yi mma me so mmɛyɛ me bɔne.
Abraham nyame ne Nahor nyame, ne wɔn agya nyame, nni me ne wo ntam asɛm.” Nanso Yakob deɛ ɔkaa n'agya Isak ho suro ntam.
Ɛno akyi no, Yakob bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ bepɔ no so, na ɔfrɛɛ ne nuanom maa wɔbɛdidiiɛ. Enti wɔdidii na wɔdaa bepɔ no so anadwo no.
Na Laban sɔree anɔpahema na ɔfee mmɔfra no ne ne mma mmaa no ano na ɔhyiraa wɔn. Ɛnna Laban sii kwan so san kɔɔ ne kurom.
32: Na Yakob toaa n’akwantuo no so, na Onyankopɔn abɔfoɔ bɛhyiaa no.
Na Yakob hunuu wɔn no, ɔkaa sɛ: “Onyankopɔn asafo nie!” Enti ɔtoo hɔ din Mahanaim.
Na Yakob tuu abɔfoɔ dii n’anim kɔɔ ne nua Esau nkyɛn wɔ Seir asase so wɔ Edom mpɔtamu hɔ,
na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sɛ mokɔ a, monka nkyerɛ me wura Esau sɛ, ‘W’akoa Yakob se: “Makɔtena Laban nkyɛn berɛ tenten de abɛsi sɛsɛɛ.
Na manya anantwie ne mfunumu, ne nnwan, ne nkoa ne mfenaa, na masoma sɛ wɔmmɛka nkyerɛ me wura, sɛdeɛ mɛnya w’anim adom.
Akyire yi abɔfoɔ a Yakob somaa wɔn no san ba bɛkaa sɛ: “Yɛkɔtoo wo nua Esau, na ɔno nso ne mmarima ahanan rebɛhyia wo.”
Na Yakob bɔɔ hu paa na ne ho yeraa no. Enti ɔkyɛɛ nnipa a wɔka ne ho no ne nnwan ne anantwie ne yoma no mu yɛɛ wɔn akuo mmienu,
na ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ Esau bɛto hyɛ kuo baako so a, kuo a aka no bɛtumi adwane.”
Na Yakob kaa sɛ: “O m’agyanom Abraham ne Isak Nyankopɔn, Awurade a woka kyerɛɛ me sɛ, ‘San kɔ w’asase so, w’abusuafoɔ nkyɛn na mɛhwɛ wo soɔ’ no,
mahunu sɛ w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛdie a woayi adi akyerɛ me no mfata me, ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a meretwa Yordan no, poma nko ara na na ɛkura me, nanso seesei mabɛyɛ akuo mmienu.
Mesrɛ wo gye me firi me nua Esau nsam ɛfiri sɛ mesuro no sɛ ɔbɛto ahyɛ me ne mmaa ne mmɔfra yi so.
Wo na wokaa sɛ, ‘Ɛkwan biara so mɛdi w’akyi na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea a obiara ntumi nkan wɔn dodoɔ.’”
Na ɔdaa hɔ anadwo no. Na ɔyii n’agyapadeɛ no bi sɛ akyɛdeɛ a ɔde bɛma Esau:
mmirekyibereɛ ahanu ne mpapo aduonu, nnwammereɛ ahanu ne adwennini aduonu,
yoma a wɔma nufoɔ aduasa ne wɔn mma, anantwibereɛ aduanan ne anantwinini du, mfunumu abereɛ aduonu ne mfunumu anini du.
Na ɔkyekyɛɛ mmoa no mu akuakuo de hyɛɛ ne nkoa no nsa, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa no sɛ: “Monni m’anim nkɔ na momma kwan mmɛda kuo biara ne deɛ ɛdi hɔ ntam.”
Ɔka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔdi kan no sɛ: “Sɛ ɛba sɛ me nua Esau hyia wo na ɔbisa wo sɛ, ‘Hwan akoa ne wo, na ɛhe na worekorɔ, na deɛ ɛdi w’anim yi nso yɛ hwan dea?’ a,
ka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Ɛyɛ w’akoa Yakob dea. Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ a ɔde asoma sɛ yɛmfa mmrɛ me wura Esau, na ɔno nso ara wɔ akyire reba.’”
Na ɔhyɛɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu ne deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne wɔn a wɔdi mmoa no akyi nyinaa nso sɛ: “Sɛ mohyia Esau a, asɛm yi ara na monka nkyerɛ no.
Na momfa nka ho sɛ, ‘W’akoa Yakob wɔ yɛn akyi.’” Saa berɛ no na ɔreka no ne tirim sɛ: “Mede akyɛdeɛ yi di m’anim kɔ a, ansa na mɛduru n’anim no na ne bo adwo. Ebia ɔbɛte n’anim ama me.”
Enti ɔmaa akyɛdeɛ no dii n’anim kɔeɛ, nanso ɔno deɛ, anadwo no ɔdaa baabi a wɔsoɛeɛ no.
Na anadwo no ara ɔfaa ne yerenom mmienu no ne ne mmaawa mmienu no ne ne mma dubaako no kɔtwaa Yabok asutwareeɛ no.
Na ɔde wɔn twaa asubɔnten no, na ɔmaa deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa nso twaeɛ.
Afei na aka Yakob nko ara, na ɔbarima bi ne no bɛtentameeɛ kɔsii sɛ adeɛ kyeeɛ.
Berɛ a ɔbarima no hunuu sɛ ɔntumi no wɔ atentam no mu no, ɔde ne nsa kaa Yakob dwonku maa no hwaneeɛ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Adeɛ akye, ma menkɔ.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Woanhyira me a, meremma wonkɔ.”
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Wo din de sɛn?” na ɔkaa sɛ: “Yakob.”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Wɔremfrɛ wo Yakob bio, mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Israel, ɛfiri sɛ wo ne Onyankopɔn ne nnipa adi apereɛ nanso woatumi agyina mu.”
Yakob nso bisaa no sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo bɔ wo din kyerɛ me.” Ɛnna ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na worebisa me din?” Na ɔhyiraa no wɔ hɔ.
Enti Yakob frɛɛ hɔ Peniel, ɛfiri sɛ sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, “Mahunu Onyankopɔn animu ne animu, nanso manya me tiri adidi mu.”
Ɔfirii Penuel ara pɛ na awia pueeɛ, na na ɔtɔ gu ne nan so.
Yei nti na Israelfoɔ nwe srɛ mu ntini a ɛsɔ dwonkuo mu de bɛsi nnɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde ne nsa kaa Yakob dwonku, ne srɛ ntini no.
33: Na Yakob maa n’ani so na ɔhunuu sɛ Esau ne mmarima ahanan reba. Enti ɔkyɛɛ mmɔfra no mu maa Lea ne Rahel ne mmaawa mmienu no.
Na ɔde mmaawa no ne wɔn mma dii animu, Lea ne ne mma dii so, na Rahel ne Yosef dii wɔn akyi.
Na ɔsene kɔdii kan na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase mprɛ nson kɔsii sɛ ɔduruu ne nua no nkyɛn.
Ɛnna Esau de mmirika bɛhyiaa no, na ɔyɛɛ no atuu de ne tiri too ne kɔn ho fee n’ano, na wɔn mmienu suiɛ.
Berɛ a ɔmaa n’ani so hunuu mmaa ne mmɔfra no, ɔbisaa sɛ: “Yeinom nso firi he?” Ɛnna ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ mmɔfra a Onyankopɔn de adom w’akoa.”
Na mmaawa no ne wɔn mma no baa wɔn anim, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn mu ase;
Lea ne ne mma nso ba bɛbɔɔ wɔn mu ase, na Yosef ne Rahel dii so baeɛ, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn mu ase.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: “Na dɔm a mehyiaa wɔn yi nso kyerɛ sɛn?” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Meyɛɛ saa sedeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mɛnya me wura anim adom.”
Na Esau nso kaa sɛ: “O me nua, ɛyɛ; deɛ mewɔ dɔɔso. Ma wo nneɛma ntena wo nkyɛn.”
Nanso Yakob kaa sɛ: “Dabi, mesrɛ wo. Sɛ manya w’anim adom a, ɛnneɛ gye m’akyɛdeɛ yi, na w’anim a mahunu yi te sɛ deɛ mahunu Onyankopɔn anim, ɛfiri sɛ woate w’anim ama me.
Mesrɛ wo gye m’akyɛdeɛ yi, me nhyira a mede abrɛ woɔ yi, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn adom me na manya biribiara.” Ɔkɔɔ so ara srɛɛ no, enti ɔgyeeɛ.
Na Esau kaa sɛ: “Ma yɛnkɔ, na mɛdi w’anim.”
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Me wura nim sɛ mmɔfra no ho nyɛ den na me nnwan ne anantwie no bi ma nufoɔ, na sɛ yɛka wɔn ntɛmntɛm da koro a, wɔn nyinaa bɛwuwu.
Enti mesrɛ wo, di w’akoa anim kan na mento me bo ase nnante sɛdeɛ mmoa a wɔdi m’anim yi ne me mma no bɛtumi, kɔsi sɛ mɛduru me wura nkyɛn wɔ Seir.”
Ɛnna Esau kaa sɛ: “Ɛnneɛ ma memma wo nnipa a wɔka me ho yi bi na wɔmmoa wo.” Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “O adɛn, na wɔnyɛ dɛn? Ma mennya me wura anim adom.
Enti saa da no Esau sanee n’akyi kɔɔ Seir.
Na Yakob siim kɔɔ Sukot, na ɔsii fie wɔ hɔ na ɔbɔɔ asese maa ne mmoa no. Enti na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Sukot no.
Akyire yi Yakob firii Padan-Aram bɛduruu Sekem wɔ Kanaanfoɔ asase so dwoodwoo; na ɔsisii ntomadan wɔ kuro no anim.
Na ɔtɔɔ asase a ɔsii ntomadan wɔ soɔ no firii Sekem papa Hamor mma no nkyɛn, na ɔmaa wɔn nnwetɛbena ɔha.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ na ɔfrɛɛ no El-Elohe-Israel aseɛ ne sɛ "Awurade; Israel Nyankopɔn".
34: Na Lea babaa Dina a ɔwoo no maa Yakob no firii adi sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ kurom hɔfoɔ mma.
Na asase no so otitire Hamor a ɔyɛ Hiwini ba bi a wɔfrɛ no Sekem hunuu Dina, na ɔfaa no ne no da guu ne ho fi.
Na ne kra bɛfam Yakob ba Dina ho, na ɔdɔɔ ababaa no na ɔkorɔkorɔɔ no.
Ɛnna Sekem ka kyerɛɛ ne papa Hamor sɛ: “Kɔgye ababaa yi awareɛ ma me.”
Na Yakob tee sɛ aberanteɛ no agu ne ba Dina ho fi. Nanso saa berɛ no na ne mma mmarima no rehwɛ ne mmoa wɔ wuram, enti ɔmuaa n’ano twɛnee sɛ wɔbɛba.
Akyire yi Sekem papa Hamor baa Yakob nkyɛn ne no bɛkasaeɛ.
Na Yakob mma no tee asɛm no ara pɛ na wɔfirii wuram baeɛ; na asɛm no yɛɛ wɔn ya na wɔn bo fuu dendeenden, ɛfiri sɛ na wayɛ aniwudeɛ atia Israel sɛ ɔne Yakob babaa ada, biribi a ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ koraa.
Na Hamor ne wɔn kasaa sɛ: “Me ba Sekem kra fam mo babaa no ho. Enti mesrɛ mo momfa no mma no na ɔnware no.
Na mo ne yɛn nni ayewareɛ. Mode mo mma mmaa bɛma yɛn na moafa yɛn mma mmaa.
Mo ne yɛn ntena, na monyɛ deɛ mopɛ wɔ asase no so. Montena so na monni dwa, na monka so.”
Na Sekem ka kyerɛɛ Dina papa ne ne nuanom sɛ: “Mesrɛ mo, momma mennya mo anim adom, na biribiara a mobɛbisa no mede bɛma mo.
Mo deɛ, momma tiri adeɛ ne akyɛdeɛ biara a ɛsɛ sɛ mede ba no nyɛ kɛseɛ paa, na deɛ mobɛka biara mede bɛma mo; deɛ mehia ara ne sɛ mode ababaa no bɛma me awareɛ.”
Na Yakob mma mmarima no de aniteɛ buaa Sekem ne ne papa Hamor, ɛfiri sɛ na wagu wɔn nuabaa Dina ho fi.
Wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Yɛrentumi mfa yɛn nuabaa mma ɔbarima a ɔntwaa twetia, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ animguaseɛ ma yɛn. Dabi, yɛrentumi nyɛ saa.
Sɛ mopɛ sɛ yɛpene so ne mo yɛ nnipa baako a, ɛnneɛ mo mmarima nyinaa ntwa twetia.
Ɛba saa a, yɛde yɛn mma mmaa bɛma mo na yɛafa mo mma mmaa, na yɛne mo bɛtena ayɛ nnipa baako.
Na sɛ moantie antwa twetia a, ɛnneɛ yɛbɛfa yɛn babaa no akɔ.”
Na asɛm no yɛɛ Hamor ne ne ba Sekem dɛ,
na aberanteɛ no antwentwɛn ne nan ase koraa sɛ ɔbɛyɛ deɛ wɔaka no, ɛfiri sɛ na n’ani gye Yakob babaa no ho, na na aberanteɛ no wɔ animuonyam sene obiara wɔ ne papa fie.
Enti Hamor ne ne ba Sekem kɔɔ wɔn kuro pono ano na wɔka kyerɛɛ kurom hɔ mmeranteɛ sɛ:
“Mmarima yi ne yɛn te asomdwoeɛ mu. Enti momma wɔntena asase yi so na wɔnni dwa wɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ asase yi da wɔn anim kakraa. Yɛbɛtumi aware wɔn mma mmaa na yɛde yɛn mma mmaa ama wɔn.
Nanso sɛ wɔbɛpene so ne yɛn atena na wɔne yɛn ayɛ baako a, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn mmarima nyinaa twa twetia sɛdeɛ wɔatwa twetia no.
Wɔn agyapadeɛ ne ahodeɛ ne wɔn mmoa nyinaa, ɛnyɛ yɛn na yɛbɛfa? Mo deɛ, momma yɛmpene deɛ wɔaka no so kɛkɛ na wɔne yɛn ntena.”
Enti wɔn a wɔfa ne kuro pono ano firi adie nyinaa yɛɛ aso maa Hamor ne ne ba Sekem, na mmarima no nyinaa twaa twetia, wɔn a wɔfa ne kuro pono ano firi adie nyinaa.
Na ne nnansa soɔ a ɛyea no mu ayɛ den no, Yakob mma mmienu, Simeon ne Lewi a wɔyɛ Dina nuanom, faa nkrantɛ na wɔwiawiaa wɔn ho kɔɔ kuro no mu kɔkunkum mmarima no nyinaa.
Na wɔde nkrantɛ kum Hamor ne ne ba Sekem nso. Afei wɔfaa Dina firii Sekem fie hɔ kɔeɛ.
Yakob mma a wɔaka no nso baa mmarima a wɔapirapira no so, na wɔfaa kuro no mu nneɛma nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔagu wɔn nuabaa no ho fi.
Wɔfaa wɔn nnwan ne anantwie ne mfunumu ne deɛ ɛwɔ kuro no mu ne deɛ ɛwɔ wuram nyinaa.
Na wɔfaa wɔn ho nneɛma nyinaa ne wɔn mma ne wɔn yerenom nnommum kɔeɛ, enti biribiara a wɔn nsa kaa no wɔn afie mu no, wɔfaeɛ.
Ɛnna Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Simeon ne Lewi sɛ: “Moaha me ama me ho abɔn wɔn a wɔte asase yi soɔ, Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ. Me ho nnipa sua, na wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano abɛku me atɔre m’ase, me ne me fie.”
Ɛnna wɔbuaa sɛ: “Yɛntena hɔ mma obi nyɛ yɛn nuabaa sɛ odwamanfoɔ anaa?” Onyankopɔn hyira Yakob wɔ Betel
35: Na ɛno akyi no, Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: “Sɔre kɔ Betel kɔtena hɔ, na si afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ ma Onyankopɔn a ɔyii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ woɔ berɛ a woredwane afiri wo nua Esau nkyɛn no.”
Ɛnna Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne fiefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa sɛ: “Monto ananafoɔ anyame a ɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no nyinaa ngu, na monte mo ho na monsesa mo ntadeɛ.
Na momma yɛnkɔ Betel. Mɛsi afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ ama Onyankopɔn a ɔtiee me m’ahohia mu na ɔdii m’akyi m’akwantuo mu no.”
Enti wɔde ananafoɔ anyame a ɛwɔ wɔn nkyɛn nyinaa ne asomuadeɛ a ɛhyehyɛ wɔn no maa Yakob, na ɔde siee dua kɛseɛ bi ase wɔ Sekem kurotia.
Na ɔsiim kɔeɛ, na Onyankopɔn ho hu tɔɔ nkuro a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no so, enti wɔanti Yakob mma no.
Na Yakob ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa kɔduruu Lus, anaa Betel, a ɛwɔ Kanaanfoɔ asase soɔ no.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ El-Betel, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na Onyankopɔn yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ no berɛ a ɔredwane afiri ne nua no nkyɛn no.
Akyire yi Debora a na ɔhwɛ Rebeka no wuiɛ na wɔsiee no dua kɛseɛ bi ase wɔ Betel ase. Enti ɔtoo hɔ din Alon-Bakut.
Na Onyankopɔn san yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Yakob berɛ a ɔfirii Padan-Aram baeɛ no, na ɔhyiraa no.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo din de Yakob. Nanso wɔremfrɛ wo Yakob bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Israel.” Enti ɔtoo no din Israel.
Na Onyankopɔn san ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Mene Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn: Dɔre na yɛ bebree. W’asefoɔ bɛdane aman ne aman asafodɔm, na ahemfo bɛfiri w’asene mu aba.
Na asase a mede maa Abraham ne Isak no, mede bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ a wɔbɛdi w’akyi aba no.”
Ɛno akyi no, Onyankopɔn firii baabi a ɔne no kasaeɛ no kɔɔ soro.
Na Yakob de boɔ yɛɛ nkaeɛdum sii baabi a ɔne no kasaeɛ no, na ɔhwiee afɔrebɔ nsa ne ngo guu so.
Na Yakob frɛɛ baabi a Onyankopɔn ne no kasaeɛ no Betel.
Na wɔtu firii Betel, na berɛ a wɔkɔduruu baabi a ɛne Efrat ntam twe kakra no, awoɔ kaa Rachel, na awoɔ no mu yɛɛ den.
Nanso berɛ a n’awoɔ no mu yɛɛ den no, deɛ ɔregye no awoɔ no kaa sɛ: “Nsuro na wobɛsan anya ɔbabarima yi nso.”
Berɛ a ne kra refiri ne mu, kyerɛ sɛ ɔrewuo no, ɔtoo ne din Ben-Oni; nanso ne papa frɛɛ no Benyamin.
Enti Rachel wuiɛ na wɔsiee no Efrat, anaa Betlehem, kwan so.
Na Yakob yɛɛ nkaeɛdum sii ne nna so. Yei ne Rachel nna so nkaeɛdum de bɛsi nnɛ.
Ɛno akyi no, Israel firii hɔ kɔsii ne ntomadan wɔ Eder abantenten no akyi baabi.
Berɛ a Israel te asase no soɔ no, da bi Ruben ne ne papa abaawayerɛ Bilha kɔdaeɛ, na Israel teeɛ. Na Yakob mma mmarima no yɛ dumienu.
Lea mma ne Ruben, a ɔyɛ Yakob ba panin no, ne Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, ne Sebulon.
Rachel mma ne Yosef ne Benyamin.
Na Rachel abaawa Bilha mma ne Dan ne Naftali.
Na Lea abaawa Silpa mma ne Gad ne Aser. Yeinom ne mma mmarima a wɔwoo wɔn maa Yakob wɔ Padan-Aram.
Na Yakob kɔduruu ne papa Isak nkyɛn wɔ Mamre, wɔ Kiriat-Arba, kyerɛ sɛ Hebron, baabi a Abraham ne Isak kɔsoɛɛ sɛ ahɔhoɔ no.
Mfeɛ a Isak diiɛ nyinaa yɛ ɔha aduɔwɔtwe (180).
Na Isak gyaa ne honhom mu wuiɛ; saa berɛ no na wanyini abɔ akora na ne nna amee no, na ne mma Esau ne Yakob siee no kaa ne nkurɔfoɔ ho.
36: Esau, a na wɔfrɛ no Edom, ho nsɛm nie.
Esau waree Kanaanfoɔ mmaa: Hitini Elon babaa Ada, ne Hiwini Sibeon ba Ana babaa Oholibama,
ne Ismael babaa Basemat a ɔyɛ Nebaiot nuabaa.
Na Ada woo Elifas maa Esau, na Basemat nso woo Reuel,
na Oholibama woo Yeus ne Yalam ne Kora. Yeinom ne mma mmarima a wɔwoo wɔn maa Esau wɔ Kanaan asase so.
Na Esau faa ne yerenom ne ne mma mmarima ne ne mma mmaa ne nnipa a wɔwɔ ne fie nyinaa ne ne mmoa ne n’agyapadeɛ a ɔnyaa no Kanaan nyinaa, na ɔfirii Yakob nkyɛn kɔɔ asase foforɔ so,
ɛfiri sɛ na wɔn agyapadeɛ dɔɔso dodo sɛ wɔbɛtumi atena faako, na na asase a wɔte soɔ no sua ma wɔn mmoa.
Enti Esau kɔtenaa Seir bepɔ so. Esau din ne Edom.
Na yei ne Edomfoɔ agya Esau ho nsɛm wɔ Seir bepɔ so.
Yeinom ne Esau mma mmarima ne wɔn din: Esau yere Ada ba Elifas ne ne yere Basemat ba Reuel.
Na Elifas mma ne Teman, Omar, Sefo, Gatam ne Kenas.
Na Timna yɛ Esau ba Elifas mpena, na akyire yi ɔwoo Amalek maa Elifas. Yeinom ne Esau yere Ada mma.
Na Reuel mma nie: Nahat, Sera, Samma ne Misa. Yeinom ne Esau yere Basemat mma.
Na yeinom ne Esau yere Oholibama, Sibeon ba Ana babaa no mma: Ɔwoo Yeus ne Yalam ne Kora maa Esau.
Yeinom ne Esau asefoɔ a wɔbɛyɛɛ abusua mpanimfoɔ: Esau ba panin Elifas mma: Abusuapanin Teman, abusuapanin Omar, abusuapanin Sefo, abusuapanin Kenas,
abusuapanin Kora, abusuapanin Gatam ne abusuapanin Amalek. Yeinom ne Elifas mma a wɔbɛyɛɛ abusua mpanimfoɔ wɔ Edom asase soɔ. Yeinom ne Ada mma.

Yeinom ne Esau ba Reuel mma: Abusuapanin Nahat, abusuapanin Sera, abusuapanin Samma, abusuapanin Misa. Yeinom ne Reuel mma a wɔbɛyɛɛ abusua mpanimfoɔ wɔ Edom asase soɔ. Yeinom ne Esau yere Basemat mma.
Yeinom ne Esau yere Oholibama mma: Abusuapanin Yeus ne abusuapanin Yalam ne abusuapanin Kora. Yeinom ne Esau yere Oholibama a ɔyɛ Anah ba no mma a wɔbɛyɛɛ abusua mpanimfoɔ no.
Yeinom ne Esau mma ne abusua mpanimfoɔ. Ɔno ara ne Edom.
Yeinom ne Horini Seir mma a wɔyɛ asase no sofoɔ: Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibeon ne Anah,
ne Dison ne Eser ne Disan. Yeinom ne Horini Seir mma a wɔyɛ abusua mpanimfoɔ wɔ Edom.
Lotan mma ne Hori ne Hemam; na Lotan nuabaa ne Timna.
Na Sobal mma nie: Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo ne Onam.
Sibeon mma ne Aiya ne Anah. Anah yi na berɛ a ɔrehwɛ ne papa Sibeon mfunumu no, ɔhunuu nsutire a ɛpu nsuohyeɛ wɔ serɛ soɔ no.
Yeinom ne Anah mma: Dison ne Oholibama a ɔyɛ Anah babaa.
Dison nso mma nie: Hemdan, Esban, Yitran ne Keran.
Eser mma nie: Bilhan ne Saawan ne Akan.
Disan mma ne Us ne Aran.
Yeinom ne Horifoɔ abusua mpanimfoɔ: Abusuapanin Lotan, abusuapanin Sobal, abusuapanin Sibeon, abusuapanin Anah,
abusuapanin Dison, abusuapanin Eser ne abusuapanin Disan. Yeinom ne Horifoɔ abusua mpanimfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn din teɛ wɔ Seir asase so.
Yeinom ne ahemfo a wɔdii Edom asase soɔ ansa na Israel mma rebɛnya ɔhene bi adi wɔn soɔ.
Beor ba Bela bɛdii Edom so, na na ne kuro din de Dinhaba.
Bela wuiɛ, Sera a ɔfiri Bosra ba Yobab bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Berɛ a Yobab wuiɛ no, Husam a ɔfiri Temanfoɔ asase soɔ no bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Husam wuiɛ no, Bedad ba Hadad a ɔdii Midianfoɔ so wɔ Moab asase soɔ no bɛdii n’adeɛ, na ne kuro no din de Awit.
Hadad wuiɛ no, Samla a ɔfiri Masreka bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Berɛ a Samla wuiɛ no, Saul a ɔfiri Rehobot a ɛwɔ asubɔnten kɛseɛ no ho no bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Saul wuiɛ no, Akbor ba Baal-Hanan bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Berɛ a Akbor ba Baal-Hanan wuiɛ no, Hadar bɛdii n’adeɛ; na ne kuro no din de Pau, na ne yere de Mehetabel a ɔyɛ Mesahab ba Matred ba.
