Sɛ wopɛ a, tene wo nsa ka ne dompe ne ne honam, na hwɛ sɛ ɔrennyina w’anim nnome wo anaa.”
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: “Hwɛ, onie, ɔhyɛ wo nsa! Ne nkwa nko na kora!”
Ɛnna Satan firii Awurade anim kɔeɛ, na ɔde mpɔmpɔ bɔne kɔbobɔɔ Hiob firii ne nan ase kɔsii n’apampam.
Na ɔfaa kyɛmferɛ bi a ɔde bɛdwi ne ho; na ɔtenaa nso mu.
Na ne yere ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Woda so ara kura wo mudie mu? Dome Onyankopɔn na wu!”

Na ɔno nso buaa no sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ mmaa agyegyentwie no bi kasa no, saa na wo nso wokasa. Yɛnnye deɛ ɛyɛ adepa nko ara mfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na adebɔne deɛ yɛmpo?” Yei nyinaa mu no, Hiob amfa n’ano anyɛ bɔne.

Na Hiob nnamfo mmiɛnsa tee amanehunu a aba ne soɔ nyinaa, na wɔn mu biara firi deɛ ɔwɔ baeɛ, Elifas a ɔfiri Teman, Bildad a ɔfiri Suha, ne Sofar a ɔfiri Naama. Na wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ hyiaa mu sɛ wɔrebɛgyam no na wɔakyekyere ne werɛ.
Berɛ a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri a wɔmemaa wɔn ani so hunuu no no, wɔanhunu sɛ ɛyɛ ɔno a. Na wɔmemaa wɔn nne so suiɛ, na wɔsunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu, na wɔtoo mfuturo kɔɔ soro guu wɔn atifi.
Na wɔne no tenatenaa fam nnanson, adekyeeɛ ne adesaeɛ, na obiara ne no ankasa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu sɛ yea no mu yɛ den yie.
3: Ɛno akyi no, Hiob buee n’ano, na ɔdomee n’awoda.
Na Hiob kaa sɛ:
“ Ma ɛda a wɔwoo me mu no nyera,
Ɛda no nnuru sum, mma Onyankopɔn mmfiri soro mmmisa akyire kwan, na hann biara nnhyerɛn so.
Ma esum ne owuo sunsum nnye mfa. Ma deɛ ɛma adekyeeɛ duru sum nhunahuna no.
Saa anadwo no, ma esum kabii nkuta no; Mma no nnnya anigyeɛ biara wɔ afe nna no mu; Mma no mmma abosome dodoɔ no mu.
Hwɛ! Saa anadwo no—ma no nyɛ kwawee; Mma wɔnnto ahurisie dwom biara wɔ mu.
Ma wɔn a wɔdome ɛda mmɔ no dua, Wɔn a wɔtumi hwanyan dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn no.
Ma ahemadakye nsoromma nnuru sum; Ma no ntwɛn hann nanso ebi remma; Mma ɛrenhunu adekyeeɛ anisuatɛtɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ antoto me maame yafunu apono mu, na anyi ɔhaw anhunta m’ani.
Adɛn nti na manwu yafunu mu? Adɛn nti na mefiri yafunu mu reba no, mannyaa mu?
Adɛn nti na anankoroma sɔɔ me, na adɛn nti na metoo nufoɔ menumiiɛ?
Anka saa berɛ yi mada ama me ho adwo me komm; Anka mada; anka meregye m’ahome;
me ne ahemfo ne asase so afotufoɔ a wɔkyekyeree amamfo faeɛ no,
anaasɛ me ne mmapɔmma a wɔwɔ sika, wɔn a wɔde dwetɛ hyehyɛɛ wɔn afie amaama no;
Anaa anka mamma te sɛ ɔba a wɔapɔn no ahuntaeɛ mu, Te sɛ nkɔkoaa a wɔanhunu hann da.
Ɛhɔ na abɔnefoɔ nha obiara bio,
Ɛhɔ ara na nneduafoɔ te dwoodwoo; Wɔnte deɛ ɔpiapia wɔn kɔ adwuma no nne.
Ɛhɔ na nnipa akɛseɛ ne nketewa nyinaa wɔ, Na akoa ade ne ho afiri ne wura nsam.
Adɛn nti na ɔma mmɔborɔni hann, na ɔde nkwa ma wɔn a wɔn kra werɛ ahoɔ?
wɔn a wɔtwɛn owuo, nanso ɛmma, na wɔbɔre hwehwɛ no sene akoradeɛ a ahunta;
Wɔn a wɔn ani gye boro soɔ no, Wɔnya anigyeɛ kɛseɛ sɛ wɔnya damena?
Adɛn nti na wɔde hann ma ɔbarima a wɔde ne kwan ahunta, na Onyankopɔn de ban atwa ne ho ahyia?
Na m’apinisie abɛsi m’aduane ananmu,
Na deɛ mesuro no, ɛno ara na ɛto me, na deɛ m’akoma tutu ho no, na ɛba me so.
Mennya ahodwoɔ ne kommyɛ ne ɔhome,
4: Ɛnna Temanni Elifas bua see sɛ:
“Sɛ obi ka asɛm bi kyerɛ wo a, ɛbɛyɛ wo ahomete anaa? Nanso hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka ne kasa ahyɛ?
Hwɛ! woatenetene nnipa pii, Na nsa a emu agoɔ no, woahyɛ no den.
Deɛ ɔrehwe aseɛ no, wo nsɛm ama no asɔre agyina; Na nkotodwe a ahodwo no, woahyɛ no den.
Na afei ɛtoo woɔ yi deɛ, woagyigya; Ebi kaa woɔ yi deɛ, woaboto.
Ɛnyɛ wo Nyamesuro ne deɛ wode wo ho to soɔ? Na ɛnyɛ w’anidasoɔ ne w’akwan a ɛtene?
Kae yei: Hwan na ne ho nni asɛm a wɔasɛe no pɛn? Anaa ɛhe na wɔapepa ateneneefoɔ pɛn?
Deɛ mahunu ne sɛ wɔn a wɔfɛntɛm amumuyɛ, na wɔgu mmusuo no, ɛno ara na wɔtwa.
Onyankopɔn home sɛe wɔn, na wɔhye, n’abufuo mframa ano.
Gyata bobom, na wɔte gyata nne, Nanso gyataburuwa sebɔmmɔfoɔ tutu.
Hanam a ɛnni hɔ nti, gyata wu, Na gyatabereɛ mma bɔ pete.
Asɛm bi wiawiaa ne ho baa me nkyɛn, na m’aso tee ɛho asomusɛm bi.
Dadwene a ɛfiri anadwo anisoadehunu mu no mu, Berɛ a nnahɔɔ tɔ nnipa soɔ no.
Ehu ne ahopopoɔ kaa me, na ɛmaa me nnompe nyinaa wosoe.
Na honhom bi twaa mu faa m’ani so, me ho nwi nyinaa sɔre gyinagyinaeɛ.
Ɛbɛgyinaa hɔ dinn Ɛhɔ tɛm dinn, na afei metee ɛnne bi sɛ:
‘Onipa dasani bɛtumi atene asene Onyankopɔn anaa? Na onipa ho bɛtumi ate asene ne Yɛfoɔ?’
Hwɛ, ne nkoa mpo, ɔmfa ne ho nto wɔn so, na n’abɔfoɔ nso, ɔbu wɔn sɛ wɔtɔ mu;
Na wɔn a wɔtete dɔtedan mu na ɔbɛbu wɔn sɛn, Wɔn a wɔn nnyinasoɔ wɔ mfuturo mu no!
Ɛbɛfiri anɔpa akɔsi anwummerɛ no, na wɔaposa wɔn koraa; Wɔyera korakora a obiara nnwene ho.
Sɛ wɔtete wɔn ho ntomadan homa a, ɛnyɛ wuo na wɔwuo a wɔanhunu nyansa biara?
5: “Frɛ hwɛ ɛ! Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛgye wo so anaa? Na akronkronfoɔ no mu hwan na wobɛdane akɔ ne nkyɛn?
Na ahisɛm kum ogyimifoɔ, na ninkuntwe kum atetekwaa.
Me deɛ, mahunu ogyimifoɔ a ɔgyee nhini, nanso amonom hɔ ara na medomee ne tenabea.
Ne mma ne nkwagyeɛ ntam twe, wɔ kuro pono mu a ɔgyefoɔ nni hɔ.
Wɔn a wɔdi kɔm bɛdi ne nnɔbaeɛ, na nsɔeɛ mu mpo na wɔbɛfa, na adufudepɛfoɔ amene wɔn adedodoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ mmusuo mfifiri mfiri mfuturo mu, na ɔhaw nso mfu mfiri fam.
Nanso wɔwoo onipa maa ɔhaw Sɛdeɛ gyaframa tutu kɔ soro no.
Na me a, anka mɛhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn akyiri kwan, na mede m’asɛm mahyɛ Onyankopɔn nsa,
Deɛ ɔyɛ ade kɛseɛ a ɛnni nhwehwɛmu, anwanwadeɛ nso a wɔntumi nkan;
Deɛ ɔma nsuo tɔ asase soɔ,
Ɔde ahobrɛasefoɔ tena deɛ ɛkorɔn, na ɔma abooboodifoɔ so kɔ yiedie mu;
Ɔsɛe anitefoɔ atirimpɔ, na wɔn nsa antumi anyɛ adepa biara;
Ɔkyere anyansafoɔ wɔn aniteɛ mu, na ɔbutu akontonkyifoɔ agyina,
Wɔtɔ sum mu awia, na awia ketee wɔkeka sɛ anadwo;
Na ɔgye ohiani firi nkrantɛ a ɛfiri wɔn anomu no ano,
Na mmɔborɔni nya anidasoɔ,
Hwɛ, nhyira ne ɔdasani a Onyankopɔn ka n’anim, enti, mpo Otumfoɔ atenetene no!
Na ɔno na ɔpira, na ɔkyekyere soɔ,
Ɔbɛyi wo afiri ahohiahia nsia mu, na deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no mu, bɔne renka wo.
Ɛkɔm berɛ ɔbɛgye wo afiri owuo mu, na akodie mu nso wagye wo afiri nkrantɛ ano.
Ɔbɛkora wo afiri tɛkyerɛma mpire ano, na wɔrensuro sɛeɛ a ɛbɛba.
Wobɛsere sɛeɛ ne ɛkɔm, na asase so mmoadoma nso, worensuro wɔn.
Ɛfiri sɛ wo ne wiram aboɔ mpo bɛyɛ apam, na wiram mmoadoma bɛdwo ama wo.
Na wobɛhunu sɛ wo ntomadan si hɔ dwoodwoo, na wohwɛ wo tenabea a, worenhunu sɛ atɔ mu.
Wobɛhunu sɛ wo mma bɛdɔɔso pii, Na w’asefoɔ te sɛ asase so wura.
wode onyinkyerɛ na ɛbɛkɔ damena mu, sɛdeɛ wɔde ayuo afiafi ba mu ne berɛ mu no.
Hwɛ! Yei na yɛahwehwɛ ahunu. Saa na ɛteɛ.
6: Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
“O, sɛ anka wɔrekari m’awerɛhoɔ, na wɔde me yea nso agu nsania mu susu ɛ!
Ɛno deɛ anka ɛbɛsene mpoano anwea duru, enti na me nsɛm ayɛ hatuhatu yi.
Adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ agyan tuatua me mu, Na me honhom renom emu borɔ; Onyankopɔn ahudeɛ atwa me ho mpasua.
Sɛ serɛ so Ɔtorɔmo [afunumu] nya serɛ mono a, ɔteateam? Anaa nantwie su n’aduane ho?
Wɔdi aduane hunu a nkyene nni mu?
Adeɛ a me kra ampɛ sɛ ɛbɛka me no, ɛno ara na ayɛ me aduane a ɛyɛ me nwunu.
O, sɛ anka merenya m’abisadeɛ, Na Onyankopɔn ama m’anigyinadeɛ no aba mu ɛ!
Sɛ anka Onyankopɔn bɛpɛkyɛ me, Na wayi ne nsa atwa me afiri hɔ ɛ!
Ɛno mpo anka mɛnya awerɛkyekyerɛ ara, Na madi ahurisie me yea kɛseɛ yi mu, ɛfiri sɛ mensane Ɔkronkronni no nsɛm no ho.
M’ahoɔden ne deɛn, sɛ mede bɛtɔ me bo aseɛ atwɛn? Na ɛbɛwie me sɛn sɛ me kra bɛtena ase akyɛ?
M’ahoɔden te sɛ aboɔ ahoɔden anaa?
Ɛnyɛ mmoa bi na ɛnni me mu, na wɔatu ahoɔden afiri me ho?
Deɛ ɔde adɔeɛ kame ne yɔnko no, Ɔde adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no suro nso to nkyɛn.
Me nuanom twa nkontompo sɛ awɔ berɛ mu asuo a ɛsene, sɛ subonhwa a emu nsuwansuwa resene korɔ.
Nsukyeneeɛ ma ani yɛ tuntum, sukyerɛmma hyɛne mu hunta.
Sɛ hyehyeɛ ka no a, ɛtwitwa;
N’akwan kontonkonton fa baabi; ɛdane huruhuro kɔ soro na ɛyera.
Tema akwantemfoɔ asafo no hwɛe, Seba akwantufoɔ ani daa so.
Wɔn ani wuu sɛ wɔde wɔn ani too soɔ, wɔkɔduruu ho, na wɔn anim guu ase.
Saa ara na mo nso, monyɛ hwee; moahunu ahodwirideɛ, na afei mosuro.
Maka akyerɛ mo sɛ momma me biribi anaa? Anaa maka akyerɛ mo sɛ me nti momfa mo adeɛ bi nkyɛ?
Anaa maka akyerɛ mo sɛ monnye me mfiri ɔtamfo nsam? maka akyerɛ mo sɛ monnye me mfiri otirimuɔdenfoɔ nsam anaa?
Monkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mɛyɛ komm, na deɛ mafom wɔ mu no, momma menhunu.
Sɛdeɛ atɛntenenee si yɛ den fa! Na mo atɛnyie yi deɛ, animka bɛn na ɛwɔ mu?
Nsɛm ho animka na modwene, Berɛ a ɔwerɛhoni nsɛm te sɛ mframa?
Awisiaa so mpo moretwe ntonto, na mo yɔnko tiri nso moredi ano!
Na afei mompɛ ani pa nhwɛ me, na merenni atorɔ mo anim ha.
Mesrɛ mo, mompɛ mu bio ɛ, na mommmu ntɛnkyea; na monsane mpɛ mu, na me tenenee wom ara.
Deɛ ɛntene bi wɔ me tɛkyerɛma so, anaasɛ me dodom nhunu abusudeɛ?
7: “Ɛnyɛ akodie na ɛwɔ hɔ ma ɔdasani asase soɔ, na ne nna te sɛ ɔpaani nna?
Sɛ akoa pere hwehwɛ onwunu ho, ne sɛ ɔpaani hwɛ n’akatua kwan no.
Saa ara na wɔama madi abosome hunu, na wɔabu ɔhaw anadwo ama me.
Sɛ mekɔda a, meka sɛ, ‘Da bɛn na mɛsɔreɛ na anadwo atwam akorɔ?’ Na anadwo mu nyinaa yɛ me kɔdaanna kɔsi ahemadakye.
Me honam fira mmoaa ne dɔteɛ abon; Me honam atwintwam, na ɛrefiri nsuo.
Me nna yɛ hare sene ɔnwomfoɔ akurokurowa, na ɛrehi, na anidasoɔ biara nni hɔ.
Kae sɛ me nkwa yɛ mframa; Na m’ani rensane renhunu papa bio.
Deɛ n’ani hu me no, ɔrenhu me bio; w’ani tua me, nso na menni hɔ.
Sɛdeɛ mununkum sa na ɛkorɔ no, saa ara na deɛ ɔsiane kɔ Asamando no remforo mma bio.
Ɔrensan mma ne fie bio, Na ne tenabea renhu no bio.
Enti me nso merenka m’ano ntom. mɛkasa me honhom ahohiahia mu;
Meyɛ ɛpo anaa asuo mu bɔpɔn, na ɛma wode awɛmfoɔ sisi me ho?
Berɛ a mekaa sɛ, ‘Me mpa bɛkyekyere me werɛ, na me daberɛ bɛdwodwo m’apinisie no a,
Wode adaeɛso hunahunaa me, Na wode anisoadehunu maa mebɔɔ birim,
Na ɛma me kra nyi menebɔ ne owuo mmom
Afono me, merentena ase daa. Gyaa me, na me nna yɛ huruhuro.
Onipa dasani ne hwan a wobu no ɔkɛseɛ,
Na wohwɛ no daa anɔpa,
Worenyi w’ani mfiri me so de rekɔsi da bɛn? Wonnya me kwan na memmene me ntasuo mpo?
Sɛ mayɛ bɔne a, ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ, nnipa hwɛfoɔ, adɛn na wode me ayɛ w’adeɛ a wo ne no anya na madane adesoa ama me ho yi?
Na adɛn nti na womfa me mmarato mfiri me, na womma me mfomsoɔ nsene nkorɔ? Na wobɛhwehwɛ me, nanso na menni hɔ bio.” Bildad asɛnka a ɛdi kan. Ahonu de ahotɔ ba
8: Ɛnna Suhini Bildad gyee so sɛ:
“Ɛnkɔsi berɛ bɛn na wobɛka yeinom, na w’anomu nsɛm bɛyɛ sɛ mframa denden yi?
Onyankopɔn bɛkyea atemmuo, anaasɛ Otumfoɔ bɛkyea tenenee?
Sɛ wo mma ayɛ no bɔne a, wagyaa wɔn de wɔn ahyɛ wɔn mmarato nsam.
Sɛ wo ara wohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan,
sɛ wo ho te na wotene a, ampa ara ɔbɛkanyan ne ho ama wo, na wama wo tenenee tenabea no adi yie.
Na sɛ mpo wo mfitiaseɛ yɛ ketewa a,
Mesrɛ wo, bisa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ɛ, na ma w’akoma mmra deɛ wɔn agyanom ahwehwɛ ahunu no so.
Na yɛn deɛ, nnora nko ara na yɛfiri baeɛ, na yɛnnim hwee, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn nna te sɛ sunsum asase so.
Ɛnyɛ wɔn na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo na wɔaka akyerɛ woɔ anaa, na wɔayiyi nsɛm afiri wɔn akoma mu?
Nkyɛkyerɛ fifiri deɛ ɔwora nnie? Anaasɛ demmire bɛtumi anyini deɛ nsuo nnie?
Ɛda so wɔ ne frɔmfrɔmyɛ mu a wɔntwaeɛ no, ɛdi wura nyinaa anim kan kusa.
Saa ara na wɔn a wɔn werɛ firi Onyankopɔn nyinaa akwan teɛ, na ɔbɔnefoɔ anidasoɔ bɛyera;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔtwa n’ahotɔsoɔ firi hɔ, na n’anidasoɔ yɛ ananse ntentan.
Ɔbɛtwere ne dan, nanso ɛrennyina; ɔbɛkura mu, nso ɛrentena hɔ.
Ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm awia ano, na ne mman yiyi kata ne turo so.
Ne nhini mantammantam aboɔkuo ho,
Sɛ wɔsɛe no firi ne tenabea a, ɛpo no ka sɛ: Menhunuu wo da.’
Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ ne kwan ho ahosɛpɛ teɛ ne no, na mfuturo no mu na afoforɔ fifire.
Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn mpo deɛ ɔdi mu, Na adebɔneyɛfoɔ nso, ɔrensɔ wɔn nsa;
kɔsi sɛ ɔde sereɛ bɛhyɛ w’anomu ma, na wama ahurisie nne afa w’anofafa mu.
Aniwuo na wɔde bɛfira wɔn a wɔtane woɔ, Na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ntomadan bɛfiri hɔ.”
9: Ɛnna Hiob buaa gyee so sɛ:
“Ampa ara menim sɛ saa na ɛteɛ, na ɔdasani bɛtene Onyankopɔn anim sɛn?
Sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔne no yiyi ano a, ɔntumi mmua no apem mu baako mpo.
Akoma mu nyansafoɔ ne tumi mu hoɔdenfoɔ no, hwan na wasene ne kɔn wɔ ne soɔ na asi no yie?
Ɔtutu mmepɔ mpatuo mu,
Ɔwoso asase firi n’atenaeɛ,
Ɔhyɛ awia, na ɛmpue;
Ɔno nko na ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu, na ɔtiatia po asorɔkyeɛ soɔ.
Ɔno na wɔyɛɛ Arcturus nsorommakuo, Orion nsorommakuo, ne pleiades nsorommakuo ne Anafoɔ fam mpiakyire;
Wɔyɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ a ɛnni nhwehwɛmu, ne anwanwadeɛ a wɔntumi nkan.
Hwɛ! Ɔtwa me ho a menhu no, Na ɔsene a menhunu sɛ ɛyɛ ɔno a.
Hwɛ! Ɔhwim kɔ. Na hwan na ɔbɛtumi asi no kwan? Hwan na ɔbɛka akyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi?’
Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔrensianka n’abufuo; Rahab aboafoɔ brɛ wɔn ho ase wɔ n’ase.
Mene hwan a mɛbua no! anaasɛ mɛhwehwɛ me nsɛm mu, na me ne no ayiyie,
Na m’asɛm yɛ dɛ deɛ, nanso merenyi ano. nanso mɛkoto no sɛ me temmufoɔ.
Sɛ mefrɛ na ɔgye me so a, merennye nni sɛ wayɛ aso ama me nne;
Ɔno na ɔde ahum apirapira me Na wama m’akuro adɔɔso kwa.
Ɔmma mennya ahomegyeɛ, na ɔde awerɛhoɔ hyɛ me ma tɔ.
Sɛ wɔdi no ɔhoɔdenfoɔ tumi so a, anka: Ɔnnie! Na sɛ atemmuo nso a, anka: Hwan na ɔbɛsane no?
Sɛ metene mpo a, anka m’ano bɛbu me fɔ, na medi mu mpo a, ɔbɛma makyea.
Me deɛ, medi mu deɛ, nanso memmu me ho;
Ne nyinaa yɛ adeɛ baako; enti na mese: Deɛ ɔdi mu ne ɔbɔnefoɔ nyinaa na ɔsɛe wɔn.
Sɛ mpire kum obi mpofirim a, ɔseresere wɔn a wɔdi bem amaneɛ.
Wɔde asase ahyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ nsa; Sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a, ɛnneɛ na ɛyɛ hwan a?
Na me nna ho yɛ hare sene mmirikatuni; ɛdwane kɔ, ɛnhunu adepa biara
Ɛsene kɔ sɛ demmire nkyɛkyerɛ hyɛn, sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔtu si aduane soɔ.
Sɛ mese: Me werɛ bɛfiri m’apinisie, mɛgyae mosooyɛ na mate m’anim a,
Me yea nyinaa bɔ me hu;
Na sɛ wɔbɛbu me fɔ a,
Sɛ mede sukyerɛmma nsuo dware, Na mede samina hohoro me nsa mpo a,
ɛno nso wode me bɛto amena mu, na me ho ayɛ me ntadeɛ mpo nwunu.
Ɛfiri sɛ ɔnyɛ onipa te sɛ me na me ne no ayiyi nsɛm ano,
Nso ntamgyinafoɔ bi nni hɔ a ɔbɛdi yɛn ntam asɛm, na ɔde ne nsa agu yɛn mmienu soɔ.
Ma no nyi n’abaa mfiri me so, Na ne ho hu nso, mma ɛnnhunahuna me.
Ɛnna anka mɛkasa a merensuro no, Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ saa na meteɛ wɔ me mu.
10: Me nkwa yɛ me kra nwunu. mɛgyaa m’apinisie mu wɔ me mu; Mɛkasa me kra awerɛhoɔ mu!
Mɛse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Mmu me fɔ, ma menhunu adekodeɛ a enti wo ne me ham yi.
Ɛyɛ ma wo sɛ wohyɛ obi soɔ anaa, sɛ wopo wo nsa ano adwuma, Na wode wo hann to nnebɔneyɛfoɔ agyinatuo soɔ?
Wowɔ honam aniwa anaasɛ wohunu adeɛ sɛ ɔdasani hu no?
Wo nna te sɛ ɔdasani nna? Anaa wo mfeɛ te sɛ ɔbarima nna?
Sɛ wohwehwɛ me mfomsoɔ akyiri kwan
Nanso wonim sɛ menyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye wo nsam.
Wo nsa na ɛnwenee me na ɛyɛɛ me, me nipa mu nyinaa prɛko, ɛnna woamene me yi.
Mesrɛ wo, kae sɛ wonwenee me sɛ anwommoɔ, na wobɛma madane mfuturo bio anaa?
Anaa woanhwie me angu sɛ nufosuo na womaa mepii sɛ nufosuo a akyenkyen ɛtoa?
Wode wedeɛ ne honam duraa me ho, Na wode nnompe ne ntini nwenee me boom.
Womaa me nkwa, na woyɛɛ me adɔeɛ; na wo hwɛeɛ nso wɛn me honhom.
Nanso wode yeinom nyinaa siee w’akomam: Menim sɛ yeinom nyinaa wɔ wo tirim.
Sɛ meyɛ bɔne a, wobɛhwɛ me, na woremmu me bem me mfomsoɔ ho.
Sɛ medi abɔnefosɛm a, mennue, na sɛ metene nso a, meremma me tiri so; ɛfiri sɛ ahohora ahyɛ me ma,
Na sɛ mema me ho so a, wobɛti me sɛ gyata na woasane ne me adi anwanwasɛm.
Na wode w’adansefoɔ afoforɔ ara abɛgyina m’anim, na woama w’abufuo adɔɔso me so, na ɛdɔm a ɛto dɔm agu me so.
Ɛyɛɛ dɛn koraa na woyii me firii yafunu mu baeɛ? Anka menya megyaa mu na ani biara anhu me;
Anka menya meyɛɛ sɛ adeɛ a ɛnni hɔ koraa! Mefirii yafunu mu no, ɛnna anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkɔgya me ɛda mu.’
Me nna nyɛ kakraa bi? Ma no nnyaa me, Ma no nyi n’ani mfiri me so, na me ho nsane me kakra.
Ansa na makɔ a merensan mma bio— na makɔ sum ne sunsum asase so;
esum kabii a ɛte sɛ ɔdasuom tumm asase, sunsum ne sakasaka asase a ɛso hann te sɛ ɔdasuom tumm no”
11: Ɛnna Naamani Sofar gyee so sɛ:
“Wɔremmua nsɛm dodoɔ yi, anaasɛ wɔmma ɔbarima tɛkyerɛmafoɔ nni bem anaa?
Wo kasa worɔworɔ bɛma nnipa amua wɔn ano? Na sɛ wodi fɛw a, obi renhyɛ wo aniwuo anaa?
Na woaka sɛ: Me nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ gyenegyene, na me ho te wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.’
O, anka ma Onyankopɔn nkasa
Na ɔnka wo nyansa ahuntasɛm, sɛ ne nnwuma dɔɔso pii, na hunu sɛ Onyankopɔn yi n’ani firi w’amumuyɛ no bi so.
Wobɛhwehwɛ ahunu Onyankopɔn anaasɛ wobɛhunu akɔduru Otumfoɔ pɛyɛ mu anaa?
Ɛkorɔn sɛ ɔsoro, — ɛdeɛn na wobɛyɛ? Emu dɔ sɛ Asamando — Ɛdeɛn na wonim?
Ne nsusuiɛ ware sene asase,
Sɛ ɔtwam ba na ɔde nnipa gu nnua mu na ɔhyia asennie a, ɛnneɛ hwan na ɔbɛsianka no?
Na ɔno na ɔnim nnipa ahuhufoɔ, na ɔhunu abusudeɛ, nanso ɔmmu?
Sɛ onipa tibɔnkɔso nya nyansa akoma a, na ɛte sɛdeɛ wɔawo afunumu ba sɛ onipa.
Sɛ wo deɛ, wosiesie w’akoma, na wotrɛ wo nsam kyerɛ no a,
sɛ amumuyɛ wɔ wo nsam a, yi kɔ akyiri, na mma abusudeɛ nntena wo ntomadan mu.
Ɛno na wobɛma w’ani so a wonni dɛm, na wobɛtim pintinn a worensuro.
Na wo werɛ bɛfiri wo haw; wobɛkae no sɛ nsuo a asene.
Na wo nkwa nna bɛyɛ sɛ awia ketee,
Wobɛnya ahotɔsoɔ ɛfiri sɛ anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ; na wobɛhwɛ wo ho ahyia na woada dwoodwoo.
Wobɛda ahome, na obi renyi wo hu, na nnipa bebree bɛhwehwɛ wo hɔ adom.
Na abɔnefoɔ deɛ wɔn ani so bɛsi, na wɔn anidasoɔ bɛdane wɔn wuo.
12: Ɛnna Hiob buaa sɛ:
“Yoo! Ampa ara, sɛ mone ɔman;
Nanso me nso, mewɔ nteaseɛ sɛ mo ara, Na hwan na ɔnnim nneɛma a ɛte sɛɛ yi?
Deɛ ne yɔnko sere no ne me, deɛ ɔsu frɛɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔgyee no soɔ, wɔsere ɔteneneeni a ɔdi mu no.
Deɛ n’asom adwo no deɛ, ɔbu amanehunu animtia ne tirim;
Amimfoɔ ntomadan si hɔ dwoodwoo, Na wɔn a wɔhyɛ Onyankopɔn abufuo te hɔ komm, wɔn a wɔkura wɔn nyame wɔ wɔn nsam no.
Wo deɛ, bisa nwura mu mmoa ɛ, na wɔbɛkyerɛ wo; Ɛne wiem nnomaa, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo.
Anaasɛ dane w’ani hwɛ asase, na ɛbɛkyerɛ wo; Na ɛpo mu mpataa bɛka akyerɛ wo.
Wɔn mu hwan na ɔnnim Sɛ Awurade nsa na ayɛ yei,
Ne nsam na ɔteasefoɔ biara kra wɔ, ne adasamma nyinaa ahonhom.
Ɛnyɛ aso na ɛsɔ nsɛm hwɛ, na dodom nso ka aduane hwɛ?
Nkɔkoraa mu na nyansa wɔ,
Ɔno nkyɛn na nyansa ne mmaninneɛ wɔ, ɔno na afotuo ne nhunumu wɔ no.
Hwɛ! Ɔno na ɔbubu a obi ntumi nsie; ɔto onipa mu, na obi ntumi mmue.
Hwɛ, ɔsianka nsuo ma no we, nanso ɔgyaa mu ma no butu asase.
Ɔno nkyɛn na ahoɔden ne nyansa wɔ, deɛ wɔdaadaa no ne ɔdaadaafoɔ nyinaa yɛ ne dea.
Ɔpa afotufoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ, na ɔma atemmufoɔ dane nkwaseafoɔ.
Ɔsane ahemfo nkyehoma, Na ɔde nhoma kyekyere wɔn asene.
Ɔpa anyansafoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ, na ɔde wɔn a wɔatim no hwe fam.
Ɔma anotefoɔ gyae kasa,
Ɔde animtiabuo gu mmapɔmma so, na ɔhodwo nnɔmmarima abɔsoɔ mu.
Ɔyi adeɛ emu dɔ firi sum mu; na ɔde sum kabii firi ba hann mu.
Ɔma aman dɔɔso, na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔtrɛ amanaman mu, na ɔtu wɔn kɔ.
Ɔgye asase so aman mu atitire nimdeɛ, Na ɔma wɔkyinkyini deɛ hwee nnie, baabi a ɛkwan biara nnie.
Wɔde wɔn tiri pempem esum mu, baabi a hann nnie, Na ɔma wɔkyinkyini sɛ ɔsabofoɔ.
13: “Hwɛ, m’ani ahunu ne nyinaa, m’aso nso ate, na ate aseɛ.
Deɛ monim no, me nso menim;
Nanso me deɛ, mepɛ sɛ anka me ne  adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no mmom bɛkasa; na mehwehwɛ sɛ me ne Onyankopɔn bɛyiyi nsɛm ano.
Na mo deɛ, moyɛ atorofoɔ mapa, ayaresafoɔ ahuhufoɔ ne mo nyinaa.
Sɛ mobɛmua mo ano a,
Montie m'atɛnyie, na monyɛ aso mma m’anoyie.
Mobɛka deɛ ɛntene ama Onyankopɔn, na mode nnaadaa aka ama no anaa?
Mobɛgye ne ti adeɛ, anaasɛ mobɛham ama Onyankopɔn?
Sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mo mu a, ɛbɛsi mo yie nie? Anaasɛ mobɛdaadaa no sɛdeɛ wɔdaadaa onipa dasani?
Sɛ mohwɛ nnipa anim kokoa mu a,
Ne kɛseyɛ rentu mo akoma,
Mo nkaesɛm te sɛ mmebusɛm; mo anoyie yɛ dɔteɛ anoyie.
Mommua mo ano mfiri me so, na me ara menkasa,
Adɛn nti na memfa me honam nhyɛ me se mu, Na memfa me kra nto me nsam?
Sɛ ɔreku me mpo a, mehwɛ ɔno ara; m'akwan nko na mɛpere n'anim.
Yei ara nso na ɛbɛyɛ me nkwagyeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ remma n’anim.
Montie me nsɛm yi yie, na m’asɛm nkyerɛaseɛ nhyɛne mo aso mu.
Hwɛ, masiesie m’asɛm ato hɔ,
Hwan na ɔne me bɛdi asie? Ɛnneɛ anka mɛyɛ komm na mawu!
Nneɛma mmienu pɛ na yɛ ma me; Ɛno na meremfa me ho nhunta woɔ;
Yi wo nsa firi me so kɔ akyirikyiri, Na wo ho hu nso—mma no nnhunahuna me.
Ɛbɛyɛ a frɛ me na me nso mɛgye so, anaasɛ mɛkasa, na woabua me.
Mfomsoɔ bɛn na madie, na bɔne bɛn na mayɛ? Ma menhunu me mmarato ne me bɔne.
Adɛn nti na wode w’anim ahunta,
Wobɛbu ahahan a mframa hinhim no, na wobɛti nkraadua a adwan?
Wotwerɛtwerɛ me ho nsɛm yayaaya, na woma medi me mmeranteberɛ mu bɔne so adeɛ.
Wode me nan hyehyɛ ɛpa mu,
Nanso onipa deɛ, ɔporɔ sɛ dufɔkyeɛ, sɛ ntoma a nweweboaa redie. Hiob di onipa mmɔborɔyɛ ho abooboo
14: “Onipa a ɔbaa awo no, ne nna yɛ tiaa bi, na ɔhaw ma.
Ɔpue sɛ nhwiren, na wɔtwa; Ɔdwane sɛ sunsum, na ɔnnyina.
Na yei so na woabue w’ani, na wode me rekɔ atemmuo mu w’anim?
Hwan na ɔbɛnya ɔhoteni, afiri wɔn a wɔn ho akum no mu?
Sɛ wɔahyɛ ne nna ato hɔ, na n’abosome dodoɔ wɔ wo tirim, na woatwa hyeɛ a ɔrensiane ho ama no a,
ɛnneɛ yi w’ani firi ne so na ɔnhome nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwie ne da sɛ ɔpaani.
Na dua mpo, anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ ma no, sɛ wɔtwa a, ɛbɛfefɛ, na ne nnubaa remmɔ no.
Sɛ ne nhini kyenkyen wɔ fam, na ne dunsini wu dɔteɛ mu a,
nsuo hwa nti ɛfefɛ, na ɛyiyi mman sɛ dua a wɔatɛ.
Na ɔdasani deɛ, ɔwu, na ɔbea hɔ, na onipa gyaa mu a, na ɔwɔ he?
Nsuo firi po mu kɔ,
Saa ara na onipa kɔda hɔ, na ɔnsɔreɛ. Ɛnkɔsi sɛ ɔsoro bɛtwaa mu, wɔrennyane, Na ɔrensɔre mfiri ne nna mu nso.
O, sɛ wode me resie Asamando ɛ, sɛ wode me rehunta akɔsi sɛ w’abufuo bɛsane akorɔ ɛ, sɛ wohyɛ me da na wokae me ɛ!
Sɛ onipa wu a, ɔbɛtena ase bio? Anka m’akodie nna nyinaa mɛtwɛn
Wobɛfrɛ, na me nso magye wo so, anka w’ani bɛgyina wo nsa ano adwuma no.
Nanso afei deɛ, wokan m’anammɔn, na wonyi w’ani mfiri me bɔne so.
Wɔasɔ me mmarato ano de ahyɛ kotokuo mu, na woakyekyere me bɔne ano.
Ampa ara bepɔ mpo dwiri gu, na ɛfiri hɔ, Na ɔbotan nso tutu firi ne sibea.
Nsuo hohoro aboɔ kɔ; Ɛyiri na ɛhohoro asase so dɔteɛ kɔ. Saa na wosɛe ɔdasani anidasoɔ.
Wotintim ne so daa ma no twam kɔ; Wosakra n’anim, na wosum no kɔ.
Ne mma nya animuonyam mpo a, ɔnnim, wɔbrɛ wɔn ase nso a, ɔnhunu ho hwee.
Ɔno ara ne honam yea nko na ɔteɛ, na ne kra di ɔno ara ne ho abooboo.
15: Ɛnna Elifas a ɔfiri Teman no buaa sɛ:
“Onyansafoɔ de nimdeɛ huhu bɛbua nsɛm? Anaasɛ ɔde apueeɛ mframa bɛhyɛ n’afuru ma?
Ɔde nsɛm a ɛmfra bɛyi atɛn, ne nsɛnkeka a mfasoɔ nni mu anaa?
Nso woto nyamesuro twene, na wosi Nyankopɔn anim nsusuiɛ ho kwan.
Na w’ano nsɛm kyerɛ wo bɔne,
Wo ara w’ano na ɛbu wo fɔ, na ɛnyɛ me, na wo ara w’ano na ɛdi adanseɛ tia woɔ.
Wone onipa a wɔdii kan woo no? Anaasɛ wɔnyinsɛn wo ansa na wɔreyɛ nkokoɔ?
Wokɔtiee Nyankopɔn agyinatuo,
Ɛdeɛn koraa na wonim a yɛn nso yɛnnim? Na nteaseɛ bɛn na wowɔ a yɛnni bie?
Deɛ wafu dwono ne akɔkoraa wɔ yɛn mu, deɛ ɔsene w’agya panin mpo.
Nyankopɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ sua w’ani so, anaa asɛm a wɔne wo ka no brɛoo?
Adɛn na w’akoma twe wo korɔ, na adɛn na w’ani pa anyinam,
na wodane wo honhom tia Onyankopɔn na woma nsɛnkeka firi w’anomu?
Hwan ne ɔdasani a ne ho bɛteɛ, ne deɛ ɔbaa awo no a ɔtene?
Hwɛ! N’akronkronfoɔ mpo, ɔnni wɔn mu gyidie, Na ɔsoro nso, ɛho nte n’ani so.
Na nkantom deɛ ne ho yɛ nwunu na waporɔ, onipa a ɔnom amumuyɛ sɛ nsuo!
Mɛkyerɛ wo, na tie me; na deɛ mahunu yi, mɛka akyerɛ wo.
Deɛ anyansafoɔ aka akyerɛ na wɔamfa ansie, firii wɔn agyanom berɛ soɔ.
Wɔn nko ara na wɔde asase no maa wɔn, Na ɔhɔhoɔ biara antwam wɔn mu.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ ho yera no, ne nna nyinaa, na wɔde mfeɛ a wɔakan asie otirimuɔdenfoɔ.
Ɔte akomatusɛm n’asom; Asomdwoeɛ berɛ mu na ɔsɛefoɔ ba ne soɔ.
Ɔnnye nni sɛ ɔbɛfiri sum mu afiri,
Ɔkyinikyini hwehwɛ aduane, ka sɛ: Ɛhe na ɛwɔ?
Ahohiahia ne ahokyere yi no hu,; Ɛto hyɛ ne so sɛ ɔhene a wayɛ krado ama ɛko.
Ɛfiri sɛ watene ne nsa atia Onyankopɔn,
Ɔde kɔn a asene atu mmirika aba ne so, ne n’akyɛm akyi apɔapɔ a emu yɛ duro no;
ɛfiri sɛ wama ne sradeɛ akata n’anim, na wama ne mfe mu adɔre sradeɛ,
na wakɔtena nkuro a aguo so, afie a nnipa nte mu na wɔahyɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ nsefia mu.
Ɔrennya ne ho, na n’ahodeɛ rennɔɔso, Na ɔrentrɛ n’agyapadeɛ mu asase so.
Ɔremfiri sum mu mfi, ogyaframa bɛma ne nnuaban adwan, Na N’anom mframa bɛpra no akɔ.
Mma no mmfa ne ho nnto ahuhudeɛ so na annaadaa no, ɛfiri sɛ ahuhudeɛ ara na  ɛbɛyɛ n’akatua;
Ne da nnya nnuruiɛ no na akatua no bɛba, na ne duban renyɛ frɔmfrɔm;
Ɔbɛporo n’aba bunu agu sɛ bobe, Na watwa ne nhwiren agu sɛ ngodua.
Ɛfiri sɛ abɔnefoɔ fekuo bɛyɛ abonini, Na egya bɛhye adanmudeɛgyefoɔ ntomadan.
Wɔnyinsɛn ɔhaw, na wɔwo mmusuo, na wɔn yafunu siesie nnaadaa.”
16: Ɛnna Hiob kaa sɛ:
“Mate nsɛm a ɛtete sei bebree. Mo nyinaa moyɛ gyamserefoɔ!
Nsɛnhuhu nni awieeɛ anaa? Anaasɛ ɛdeɛn na ɛhwanyan mo ma mobua?
Sɛ mo wɔ me tebea mu a, anka mɛhɔre nsɛm agu mo so, na mawoso me ti magu mo so.
Anka mede m’anom nsɛm bɛhyɛ mo den mmom, Na anka m’anom duema bɛdwodwo mo yea.
Sɛ mekasa a, me yea no nnyae, Na sɛ megyae kasa nso a, ɛdeɛn na ɛbɛfiri me ho akorɔ?
Nanso seesei deɛ, Onyankopɔn ahodwo me; woama me ho nnipa nyinaa agu.
Woapompono me ama no adane adanseɛ, na me fɔn asɔre atia me, ɛdi adanseɛ wɔ m’anim.
Wasunsuane me n’abufuo mu, na ɔtaa me, M’ahohiahiafoɔ no pɔkyere n’ani hwɛ me.
Wɔabue wɔn anom hoo hwɛ me, Wɔde ahohorabɔ abɔ me sotorɔ, wɔn nyinaa boaboa wɔn ano tia me.
Onyankopɔn ayi me ahyɛ abusufoɔ nsa, na wasum me ato abɔnefoɔ nsam.
Na mete hɔ dwoodwoo, nanso ɔbubuu me; Ɔsɔɔ me kɔn akyi, na ɔbubuu me pasaa; na ɔde me sii hɔ yɛɛ ne botaeɛ.
N’agyan twa me ho hyia; ɔpaee me sawa mu, a ɔnhu me mmɔbɔ;
Ɔbubuu me mprɛ bebree sɛ fasuo a ɔde nkakrankakra tutu mu ntokuro; Ɔto ba me so sɛ dɔmmarima.
Mapam atweaatam akata me ho, Na mato m’ahoɔden ato mfuturo mu.
Esu nti m’ani abere kɔkɔkɔkɔ, na owuo sunsum da m’anisuatɛtɛ so.
Nanso amumuyɛ biara nni me nsam,
O asase, nkata me mogya so! na mma me sufrɛ nnnya homebea!
Seesei mpo, hwɛ, ɔsoro na me danseni wɔ, na me dimafoɔ wɔ deɛ ɛkorɔn.
Me nnamfo mpo di me ho fɛw, nanso Onyankopɔn na m’ani porepore nisuo ma no.
Sɛ ɔnni mma onipa, Onyankopɔn anim, sɛdeɛ onipa ba di ma ne yɔnko no.
Sɛ mfeɛ kakraa bi no duru a, makɔ kwan a merensan mma bio.
17: “Me honhom abubu, me nkwa nna ahi; damena na ɛwɔ hɔ retwɛn me.
Afɛdifoɔ na wɔatwa me ho ahyia, na m’ani tua wɔn ntɔkwapɛ.
Si awowa ɛ, di me agyinamu wo ara w’anim. Hwan na ɔbɛgyina m’akyire?
Na wode nimdeɛ ahunta wɔn akoma,
Deɛ ɔpa ne nnamfo de nya kyɛfa bie no, ne mma ani mpo bɛhwere saa kyɛfa no.
Ɔde me ayɛ aman akasabebuo, Na mayɛ onipa a wɔtete ntasuo gu n’anim.
M’awerɛhoɔ nti m’ani so ayɛ kusukusu, na me ho ade nyinaa ayɛ sɛ sunsum.
Teefoɔ ho dwiri wɔn yei ho, na deɛ ɔdi bem no bo huru ɔkɔnkɔnsani.
Nanso ɔteneneeni bɛkura ne kwan mu, na deɛ ne nsa ho teɛ no bɛkɔ so anya ahoɔden.
Na mo nyinaa, monsane mmra ɛ! Nanso merenhunu mo mu nyansafoɔ biara.
Me deɛ, me nna atwam kɔ, me nsusuiɛ agye agu,
Wɔde anadwo yɛ awia na wɔka sɛ:
Sɛ mede Asamando yɛ me fie,
na mese Amena sɛ: M’agya ne wo, ne mmoaa sɛ: Me na ne me nuabaa ne mo, a,
na afei, ɛhe na m’anidasoɔ wɔ? Na deɛ m’ani da soɔ no, hwan na ɔbɛhunu?
Ɛbɛsiane akɔ Adamena adaban mu, Berɛ a me ne m’anidasoɔ nyinaa bɛsiane akɔ mfuturo mu no.” Bildad kasa sɛ abɔnefoɔ bɛsɛe
18: Ɛnna Bildad a ɔfiri Suha no buaa sɛ:
“Mobɛkɔ nsɛnkeka so akɔsi da bɛn? Monnwene ho, na ɛno akyiri no, yɛakasa.
Adɛn na wɔbu yɛn sɛ mmoa, na yɛyɛ mo ani so sɛ tibɔnkɔso anaa?
Wo a wotete wo ho w’abufuo mu. na wɔatu ɔbotan afiri ne sibea anaa?
Nanso ɔbɔnefoɔ kanea bɛdum,
Hann bɛduru sum, ne ntomadan mu, na ne kanea adum wɔ ne so.
N’ahoɔden anammɔn ano bɛmoa, N’agyinatuo mpo bɛyi no ahwe hɔ.
Na ɔno ara ne nan bɛka no ato atena mu,
Fidie bɛsɔ ne nantin;
Wɔde kantankoraa bɛhunta fam ama no, na wɔasum no fidie kwan so.
Ehu bɛkuta no mmaa nyinaa ahyia,
Ɛkɔm bɛsɛe n’ahoɔden,
Ɛbɛdi ne honam akwaa, aane, owuo abakan bɛdi n’akwaa.
Wɔbɛtu n’anidasoɔ afiri ne ntomadan mu, na wɔde no akɔ ahudeɛ mu hene no nkyɛn.
Deɛ ɛnyɛ ne dea bɛtena ne ntomadan mu, wɔbɛbɔ sɔfe apete ne tenabea.
Ne nhini bɛwu wɔ fam, Na ne mman nso bɛdwan wɔ soro.
Ne nkaeɛ mpo, ɛbɛyera afiri asase so, Na wɔremmɔ ne din bio abɔnten so.
Wɔbɛsum no afiri hann mu akɔ sum mu,
Ɔrennya mma anaa mmanana ne man mu, na aseni biara renka n’atenaeɛ.
Ne da bɛyɛ nkyirimma ahodwiri, sɛdeɛ ehu kutaa wɔn a wɔdii kan no.
Ampa ara sɛdeɛ amumuyɛfoɔ tenabea teɛ ne no, ne deɛ ɔnnim Onyankopɔn no nso afa nie. Hiob nim sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛgye no
19: Ɛnna Hiob buaa gyee so sɛ:
“Mobɛteetee me kra akɔsi da bɛn, Na mode nsɛm bɛbubu me akɔsi da bɛn?
Mprɛ du nie a moasopa me, Ɛnyɛ mo aniwu sɛ mode mo ani asi me soɔ?
Sɛ madi mfomsoɔ mpo a,
Sɛ ampa sɛ moma mo ho so tia me, na moyi me m’ahohora ho atɛn a,
ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ Onyankopɔn na wakyea me kwan ama me, na ɔde n’asau atwa me ho ahyia.
Hwɛ! ayayadeɛ nti, meteam sɛ: ‘Asɛm ato me!’ nanso obiara nnye me so; Mesu frɛ mmoa, nanso wɔmmu atɛn mma me.
Ɔde fasuo asi me kwan, na mantumi antra;
Wayi m’animuonyam afiri me so, na wayi me tiri so abotire.
Wabubu me afa nyinaa a menni hɔ bio, na watu m’anidasoɔ ase sɛ dua.
Wama n’abufuo afram me so, na ɔbu me sɛ n’atamfo mu baako.
N’asafo ahodoɔ bɔɔ mu bae, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn akwan wɔ me so, na wɔkyeree nsraban twaa me ntomadan ho hyiae.
Wayi me ara me nuanom afiri me ho kɔ akyirikyiri, Na wɔn a wɔni me no, wɔatwe wɔn ho afiri me ho koraa.
M’abusuafoɔ atwe wɔn ho kɔ, na wɔn a menim wɔn werɛ afiri me.
Wɔn a wɔabɛtena me fie ne me mmaawa bu me sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, madane wɔn ani so ɔnanani.
Mefrɛ m’akoa, nanso ɔnnye me so. mede m’ano pa no kyɛw mpo sɛ ɔnhu me mmɔbɔ.
Me home mpo bɔn me yere, na me yafumma mpo mpɛ m’ahomeguo.
Ntɔtɔfefewa mpo bu me animtia, mese meresɔre a, wɔkasa tia me.
Me ho yɛ me nnamfo pa nyinaa nwunu, na m’adɔfo adane wɔn ani atia me.
Me nnompe femfam me wedeɛ ne me nam ho, na me se ho wedeɛ nko na mede afiri mu afire.
Monhu me mmɔbɔ, monhu me mmɔbɔ, O me nnamfonom, Na Onyankopɔn na ɔde ne nsa aka me.
Adɛn nti na moretan m’ani sɛ Onyankopɔn,
O sɛ anka wɔretwerɛ me nsɛm ato hɔ ɛ! O sɛ anka wɔretwerɛ ahyɛ nwoma mu ɛ!
Sɛ anka wɔde dadeɛ twerɛdua ne sumpii rekurukyire agu ɔbotan so ama no atena hɔ daa ɛ!
Na me deɛ, menim sɛ me gyefoɔ te ase, na awieeɛ no ɔbɛgyina asase so.
Sɛ wɔasɛe me wedeɛ wie a,—akyiri no! mɛfiri me honam mu afi ahunu Onyankopɔn.
Ɔno na me ara mɛhu no, M’ani na mede bɛhu no, na ɛnyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bi deɛ.
Sɛ mose: Sɛdeɛ yɛbɛsi atan no afa! Na, yɛahunu asɛm no ase wɔ ne hɔ, a,
Monsuro nkrantɛ, ɛfiri sɛ abufuhyeɛ de afena asotwe ba, na moahunu sɛ atemmuo wɔ hɔ.” Sofar kasa sɛ: Abɔnefoɔ yiedie nkyɛ
20: Ɛnna Sofar a ɔfiri Naama no buaa sɛ:
“Me ho a ɛpere me nti,
Mate atenetene a asopa me, nanso honhom firi me nhunumu mu bua me.
Wonnim yei firi tete, Firi berɛ a wɔde nnipa sii asase soɔ no,
sɛ abɔnefoɔ ahurisidie nkyɛ, na nyaatwomfoɔ anigyeɛ yɛ berɛ tiaa bi?
Sɛ ne kɛseyɛ korɔn kɔpem ɔsoro, na ne tiri kɔka mununkum a,
ɔbɛyera koraa sɛ ne sɛbeɛ; wɔn a wɔhu no no bɛbisa sɛ: Ɔwɔ he?
Ɔbɛtu akɔ sɛ daeɛ, na wɔrenhu no; na wɔbɛpamo no akɔ sɛ anadwo adehunu.
Aniwa a ɛhunuu no no renhu no bio, Na ne tenabea renhu no bio.
Ne mma bɛpata mmɔborɔfoɔ, na ne nsa adane n’ahodeɛ ama.
Ne mmeranteberɛ mu ahoɔden ahyɛ ne nnompe ma, na afei dɔteɛ mu na ɛne no bɛkɔ akɔda.
Sɛ adebɔne yɛ n’anomu fremfrem a, na ɔde siee ne kɛtrɛma ase,
Sɛ ɔma no yɛ no dɛ na wannyaa mu,
afei deɛ n’aduane asakra ne nsono mu; Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ prammire borɔ wɔ ne mu.
Wamemene ahodeɛ, nanso ɔbɛfe bio; Onyankopɔn bɛtu afiri ne yam aba.
Ɔprammire borɔ na ɔbɛfeɛ; Ahuritia kɛtrɛma na ɛbɛku no.
Ɔrenhunu asutene da, Ɛwoɔ ne nufosuo nsuwansuwa a ɛrebu fa soɔ ho.
Ɔbɛdane deɛ wabrɛ anya ama nkurɔfoɔ, na ɔremmene; n’adeɛ a wanya no, ɔrenni ho ahurisie, sɛdeɛ ne dodoɔ teɛ no.
Ɛfiri sɛ wayɛ nkurɔfoɔ pasaa, na wapo mmɔborɔfoɔ; na wafa efie a ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔsiiɛ.
Ne yam rennwo no da; Ɛnam sɛ ne yafunu ammee da nti, ɔrenkora deɛ n’ani gye ho no biara so.
Wannidi annya bi da, enti n’ahonyadeɛ rentena hɔ.
N’adedodoɔ mayɛ mu na ne ho bɛhiahia no, amanehunufoɔ nyinaa nsa bɛba ne so.
Ɔbɛma n’abufuhyeɛ aba ne so ama no de ahyɛ n’afuru ma, na ɔbɛma no atɔ agu ne so de ayɛ n’aduane.
Ɔdwane firi dadeɛ akodeɛ ano a, kɔbere agyan bɛwɔ no ahwire ne mu.
Pea bɛhwire ne mu, na agyan no firi ne bɔnwoma mu a, Nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu na ɛbɛdi n’akyi.
Wɔde sum nyinaa asie n’akoradeɛ; Egya a obiara mfite mu na ɛbɛhye no; ɛbɛhye deɛ aka ne ntomadan mu.
Ɔsoro bɛyi n’amumuyɛ adi,
Wɔbɛsoa ne fie ahonyadeɛ akɔ, wɔbɛtwe akɔ, n’abufuo da no.
Yei ne ɔdebɔneyɛfoɔ kyɛfa a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn nkyɛn, ne n’agyapadeɛ a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ato hɔ ama no no.”
21: Ɛnna Hiob buaa gyee so sɛ:
“Monyɛ aso ntie m’asɛm yi yie, na yei nyɛ mo awerɛkyekyerɛ.
Monnyaa me mma me nso menkasa, na mekasa wie a, afei moadi fɛw.
Me deɛ, onipa na medi abooboo kyerɛ no anaa? Na adɛn nti na me home rente me?
Monnane mo ani nhwɛ me, momfa ahodwirie nhwɛ me, Na momfa mo nsa nto mo ano.
Sɛ mekae a, mebɔ hu, na nketenkete kuta me honam.
Adɛn nti koraa na abɔnefoɔ kɔ so tena aseɛ, Wɔnyini kyɛ,  na wɔyɛ ahoɔdenfoɔ akɛseɛ nso?
Wɔn asefoɔ si wɔn anim pintinn ka wɔn ho, aane, mekyerɛ wɔn asefoɔ tim wɔn ani so.
Wɔn afie mu dwo, ehu biara nni mu, na Nyankopɔn abaa bi nni wɔn so.
Wɔn anantwinini wo, wɔn ho nsuo nsɛe kwa; Wɔn anantwibereɛ wo, na wɔmpɔn.
Wɔma wɔn ntɔtɔfefewa firi adi sɛ nnwankuo,
Wɔde mpintin ne asankuo bɔ dwom, na wɔn ani gye abɛnhyɛne ho.
Wɔgye wɔn ani wɔn nkwa nna mu; na wɔsiane kɔ Asamando ntɛm so.
Wɔka kyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ, ‘Firi yɛn nkyɛn kɔ! na yɛnhwehwɛ w’akwan ho nimdeɛ.
Adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no yɛ hwan a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsom no, na sɛ yɛbɔ no mpaeɛ a, mfasoɔ bɛn na yɛbɛnya?
Hwɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn ara wɔn nsam na wɔn nnepa wɔ, abɔnefoɔ agyinatuo mpare me!
Mprɛ sɛn na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kanea dum, na mprɛ sɛn na amanehunu to wɔn? na Onyankopɔn kyekyɛ awerɛhoɔ n’abufuo mu?
Wɔte sɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma, mframa ano, anaasɛ wɔte sɛ ntɛtɛ a osuframa soa korɔ?
Moka sɛ: Onyankopɔn kora n’amumuyɛ so ma ne mma; ma no ntua ɔno ara ne ka na ɔnhunu.
N’ani bɛhunu ne sɛeɛ, na ɔnnom adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no abufuhyeɛ.
Na efie a ɔgya no n’akyire no mfa ne ho hwee bio, berɛ a n’abosome dodoɔ to atwa no?
Obi bɛtumi akyerɛkyerɛ Onyankopɔn nhunumu? berɛ a Ɔno na ɔbu atitire atɛn no.
Obi wɔ ahoɔden pintinn nanso ɔwu, berɛ a ne ho tɔ no,
Nufosuo ahyɛ ne nhina amaama, na ne nnompe mu hon yɛ sɔkyee.
Na ɔfoforɔ nso de ne kra awerɛhoɔ wu
Wɔn nyinaa, dɔteɛ mu na wɔbɛkɔ akɔda, na mmoaa na ɛbɛkata wɔn soɔ.
Hwɛ! menim mo adwene nyinaa ne adwemmɔne a mowɔ no me ho no.
Ɛfiri sɛ sɛ moka sɛ: Ɛhe na bakoma no fie wɔ? Na ɛhe na ntomadan a abɔnefoɔ tenaa mu no wɔ?
Mommisaa wɔn a wɔfa ɔkwan no soɔ, na wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nso, monkarii?
Na wɔakora onipa bɔne so de sie kɔsi sɛeɛ da,
Hwan na ɔbɛka n’anim, n’abrabɔ ho? Na deɛ wayɛ no, hwan na ɔbɛtua no ɛso ka?
Ɔno deɛ, damena mu na wɔde no bɛkorɔ, na wɔwɛn ne damena so ara.
Subɔn dɔtetoa mu bɛyɛ no dɛ, na nnipa nyinaa twe wɔn ho di n’akyi, na n’anim nso wɔnnim wɔn dodoɔ.
Na adɛn na mokyekyere me werɛ kwa, na mo mmuaeɛ yɛ nkontompo ara yi?
22: Ɛnna Elifas a ɔfiri Teman no buaa sɛ:
“Ɔbarima so wɔ mfasoɔ ma Onyankopɔn? Anaa onimdefoɔ ho wɔ mfasoɔ ma ne ho?
Sɛ woyɛ ɔteneneeni a, ɛma adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no ani gye, anaasɛ ɔnya mfasoɔ sɛ w’akwan di mu?
Wo nyamesuro nti ɔbɛka w’anim, na ɔde wo akɔ atemmuo mu anaa?
Ɛnyɛ sɛ wo bɔne dɔɔso?
Sɛ woagye wo nuanom awowa ɔkwa, na woapa adagyafoɔ ho ntoma.
Woamma deɛ wabrɛ nsuo annom, Na deɛ ɛkɔm de no nso, woamma no aduane.
Na onipa a ne basa mu yɛ den no, ɔno na asase wɔ no, na deɛ ɔwɔ animuonyam no na ɔtena soɔ.
Woama mmaa akunafoɔ de nsapan kɔ, na nwisiaa abasa nso, wɔabubu.
Enti na afidie atwa wo ho ahyia, Na akomatusɛm a ɛba mpofirem hunahuna woɔ no;
Anaasɛ ɛno nti na esum ato woɔ na wonhunu adeɛ, Na nsuo pii abu afa wo soɔ no.
Ɛnyɛ ɔsoro korɔn mu na Onyankopɔn wɔ? Na hwɛ nsoromma a ɛwɔ sorosoro no sɛdeɛ ɛkorɔn fa!
Na woka sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na Onyankopɔn nim? Esum kabii akyiri nohoa na ɔbɛbu atɛn?
Mununkum akata ne so, na ɔnhunu adeɛ, na ɔsoro kɔntɔnkrɔn so na ɔnanteɛ.’
Wobɛfa tete tempɔn no a mma amumuyɔfoɔ nantee soɔ no so anaa?
Wɔn a wɔpraa wɔn kɔeɛ ansa na ɛberɛ reduro, na wɔn nnyinasoɔ sene kɔɔ sɛ asuo no.
Wɔn na wɔka kyerɛ Nyankopɔn sɛ: ‘Firi yɛn nkyɛn kɔ! Ɛdeɛn na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no bɛtumi ayɛ yɛn?’
Nanso ɔno na ɔde nneɛma pa hyehyɛɛ wɔn afie amaama: Na me ne abɔnefoɔ agyinatuo ntam kwan ware.
Ateneneefoɔ hunu, na wɔn ani gye; na deɛ ɔdi bem no di wɔn ho fɛw.
Ka sɛ ‘Ampa ara wɔapepa yɛn atamfo afiri hɔ; Na wɔn biribiara a ɛkaeɛ nso, egya ahye.’
Fa wo ho bɔ Nyankopɔn ho ɛ, na wo ho nnwo wo; yei mu na adepa bɛba ama woɔ.
Bɔ mmɔden gye n’anomu mmara, na fa ne nsɛm sie w’akomam.
Sɛ wosane kɔ adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no nkyɛn a, wɔde wo bɛsi hɔ; Sɛ wobɛyi amumuyɔ afiri wo ntomadan mu akɔ akyirikyiri a,
fa sika amapa gu mfuturo mu, na Ofir sika nso, fa gu asubɔnten mu mmoseaa mu.
Anka adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no nso bɛyɛ wo sika amapa bebree, ne dwetɛ a wɔahɔre ama woɔ.
Ɛno na wo ho bɛsɛpɛ wo Otumfoɔ ho, na woama w’ani so akyerɛ Onyankopɔn.
Anka wobɛbɔ no mpaeɛ, na ɔbɛtie wo, na wo bɔhyɛ adeɛ nso, woatua.
Wobɛbɔ wo tirim, na ɛbɛgyina ama wo, na hann bɛhyerɛn w’akwan so.
Sɛ wɔbrɛ wo ase a, ɛno deɛ, ahomasoɔ ntira; Na ɔhobrɛaseni deɛ, ɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Sɛ deɛ ɔnnii bem mpo, ɔbɛgye no a, ɛnneɛ wo nsam a ɛteɛ so na wɔbɛgye wo. Hiob srɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn mma no nnyina n’atemmuo adwa anim.
23: Ɛnna Hiob buaa gyee so sɛ:
“Ɛnnɛ na m’abooboodie mu ayɛ den, na me pira ayɛ den asene m’apinisie.
O sɛ anka menim baabi a mɛhu no ɛ!
Anka mede m’asɛm bɛto n’anim, Na mede nsɛm pii ayi me ho ano;
Anka mɛhunu nsɛm a ɔde bɛbua me, na mahunu deɛ ɔbɛka akyerɛ me no mu.
Anka ɔde n’ahoɔden dodoɔ no ne me bɛdi asie anaa? Dabida! aso nko na ɔbɛyɛ ama me.
Ɛhɔ na ɔteefoɔ ne no bɛyiyi no, na mafiri me temmufoɔ nsam korakora.
Hwɛ, mekɔ m’anim, nso ɔnni hɔ,
Mekɔ benkum, baabi a ɔyɛ adwuma, nanso m’ani nhu no; Ɔmane fa nifa, nanso menhu no.
Ɔno deɛ, ɔnim kwan a menam soɔ. Sɛ ɔsɔ me hwɛ wie a, me ho bɛfi sɛ sika.
N’anammɔn mu na me nan tintimiiɛ; ne kwan so na mefa, na mammane.
N’anomu mmara, mamfiri ho, makora n’anomu nsɛm sene aduane a ɛhia me.
Nso ɔno deɛ, ɔnsakra da, na hwan na ɔbɛsane no?
Ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wahyɛ ato hɔ ama me nyinaa ɔbɛyɛ, na adeɛ a ɛte seyie pii na ɛwɔ ne tirim.
Ɛno nti na ehu ka me n’anim; Medwendwene ho a, na mesuro no.
Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn ama m’akoma aboto, Na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no ayi me hu:
ɛfiri sɛ manyera esum no mu, na wankata esum kabii no so m’anim. Adɛn nti na Onyankopɔn ntea abɔnefoɔ ntɛm so
24: “Adɛn nti na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no nhyɛ atemmuo berɛ nsie, na wɔn a wɔni no no nhunu ne nna no?
Ebinom piapia ahyeɛ; wɔfom mmoakuo fa yɛne wɔn.
Wɔpamo nnyanka afunumu kɔ; wɔgye okunafoɔ nantwie awowa.
Wɔsum ahiafoɔ firi kwan so; asase so mmɔborɔfoɔ nso bom hunta.
Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛserɛ so mfunumu firi adie no, saa ara na wɔkɔ wɔn dwumadie so kɔpɛ aduane, ɛserɛ pradada so na wɔnya aduane ma wɔn mmɔfra.
Mfuo mu na ɔtwa mmoa aduane, na nnebɔneyɛfoɔ bobeturo mu na ɔfom nnɔbaeɛ ase.
Ɔde adagya na ɛda, ɔnni ntoma, na wɔnni nkataho wɔ awɔ mu.
Mmepɔ so sutorɔ fɔ wɔn, na ɛnam sɛ wɔnni dwanekɔbea nti,
Wɔte agyanka firi nufoɔ ano, na wɔgye mmɔborɔni hɔ awowa.
Wɔnenam adagya, wɔnni ntoma, na wɔde ɛkɔm soasoa ayuo afiafi.
Wɔkyi ngo wɔn afasuo mu, wɔtiatia nsa-kyi-amena so, nso wɔdi sukɔm.
Kuro no mu na wɔn a wɔrewuo no si apini ma wɔte no akyire hɔ, na wɔn a wɔapirapira wɔn nso akra team hwehwɛ mmoa; Nanso Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɛmfa ne ho: ɔmfa n’ani nkari amumuyɛsɛm no.
Ebinom ayɛ hann anim atuatefoɔ,
Owudini sɔre awiaberɛ, Na ɛduru anadwo a, ɔdane sɛ korɔmfoɔ.
Ɔwaresɛefoɔ ani deɛ, deɛ ɛtwɛn ara ne sɛ esum bɛduru anwummerɛ, Ɔka sɛ: ‘Ani biara renhu me!’ Na ɔde nkatanimu kata n’anim.
Esum mu na wɔhwirehwire adan mu;
Na wɔn nyinaa, esum kabii yɛ wɔn sɛ anɔpa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔne esum kabii mu ahuyideɛ yɛ nnamfo.
Ne ho yɛ hare wɔ nsuo ani; wɔadome ne kyɛfa asase so, ɔnnane n’ani nkɔ bobe nturo kwan so.
Ɛpɛ ne ahuhuro na ɛnane sukyerɛmma nsuo; saa ara nso na Asamando pra wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne kɔ.
Ɔyafunu a ɛwoo no no werɛ firi no, na mmoaa bɛtu agu ne so adi ne nam, na wɔbɛbubu amumuyɛ sɛ dua.
Obonini a ɔnwoɔ mpo, ɔyɛ no basabasa, Na okunafoɔ nso, ɔnyɛ no yie.
Nanso Onyankopɔn de ne tumi twe atumfoɔ nna mu; berɛ a wɔn ani nna nkwa soɔ no, wɔsɔre bio.
Ɔbɛma wɔanya ahotɔsoɔ na wɔahyɛ wɔn ho den;
Wɔduru deɛ ɛkorɔn, na ɛyɛ kakra pɛ, na wɔnni hɔ bio, Wɔbɛbrɛ wɔn ase; wɔgyaa mu na wɔboaboa wɔn ano sɛ nnipa nyinaa, Na wɔtwitwa wɔn gu sɛ ayuo mmɛtem.
Enti sɛ ɛnte saa a, hwan na ɔbɛyi me ɔtorofoɔ, na wakyerɛ sɛ m’asɛm no nni mu? Hwan ne onipa wɔ Nyankopɔn anim?
25: Ɛnna Bildad a ɔfiri Suha no buaa sɛ:
“Ɔno na tumidie wɔ no, na ne ho yɛ hu; ɔno na ɔma asomdwoeɛ ba wɔ ne sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ.
N’asafodɔm  ano wɔ abuyɛ? Na hwan na ne hann renhyerɛn ne soɔ?
Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na onipa dasani bɛtene Onyankopɔn anim? Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na onipa a ɔbaa awo no ho bɛteɛ?
Hwɛ! Bosome mpo, ɛmpae hyɛnn; na nsoromma nso, ɛho nte wɔ n’ani so.
Na nkantom ɔdasani, abubummabaa yi, na ɔbɛbu no sɛn, ne onipa ba a ɔyɛ sonsono kɛkɛ yi!” Hiob kyerɛ Nyankopɔn kɛseyɛ
26: Ɛnna Hiob buaa gyee so sɛ:
“Woaboa deɛ ɔnni tumi sɛn? Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ de agye basa a ɛnni ahoɔden?
Afotuo bɛn na woatu deɛ ɔnnim nyansa, na woaka nimdeɛsɛm pa a ɛdɔɔso anaa?
Hwan na woaka nsɛm akyerɛ no, na hwan ahome na afiri wo mu yi?
Nsamanfoɔ ho popo, nsuo ne wɔn a wɔte mu no ase.
Asamando da adagya n’anim, na nkatasoɔ biara nni hɔ mma Ɔsɛeɛ Amena.
Ɔno na ɔtrɛ atifi fam wɔ ahunumu, na ɔde asase sɛne deɛ hwee nnie;
Ɔkyekyere nsuo hyɛ mununkum mu, na mununkum no mpae wɔ aseɛ.
Ɔbram n’ahennwa anim de ne mununkum katakata ho.
Ɔtwa nsuo ani hyeɛ de kɔsi deɛ hann ne sum awieeɛ hyia hɔ.
Ɔsoro nnyinasoɔ hinhim, na wɔn ho dwiri wɔn, n’ateatea ano.
Ɔde ne tumi hwanyan ɛpo, na ɔde ne nhunumu brɛ Rahab ase.
Ne honhom ano na ɔsoro teɛ, ne nsa na ɛhwire ɔwɔ a ne ho yɛ hare no mu.
Hwɛ! Yeinom yɛ ne nnwuma mu ketewaa bi, na ne ho asɛm kakraa bi na atwa onipa asom! na ne mmaninyɛ prannaa a ɛbom no, hwan na ɔbɛhunu mu? Hiob kyerɛ ne bemdie ne abɔnefoɔ ahotɔ a ɛnkyɛ
27: Ɛnna Hiob san toaa n’akasabebuo no so sɛ:
“Sɛ Onyankopɔn a wagye me bemdie afiri me nsam no te aseɛ, na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ a wɔahyɛ me kra awerɛhoɔ no te aseɛ yi,
berɛ dodoɔ a m’ahome da so wɔ me mu, na Onyankopɔn honhom wɔ me hwene mu yi,
M’ano renka amumuyɔsɛm biara, Na me kɛtrɛma nso renka nnaadaasɛm biara!
Onyame mpa ngu sɛ mɛbu mo bem! Ɛnkɔsi sɛ mɛgyaa mu no, merennyaa me mudie mu da!
Mɛkura me tenenee mu dendeenden, na merennyaa mu; m’akoma remmu me fɔ, me nna biara ho.
Ma me tamfo nyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ, na deɛ ɔsɔre tia me no nyɛ sɛ omumuyɔfoɔ.
Na ɛdeɛn ne ɔbɔnefoɔ anidasoɔ berɛ a wɔtwa ne nkwa soɔ, berɛ a Onyankopɔn twe ne kra korɔ no?
Sɛ ahohiahia ba ne so a, Onyankopɔn bɛtie ne sufrɛ?
Anaasɛ ɔbɛnya anigyeɛ wɔ adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no ho? Ɔbɛfrɛ Onyankopɔn berɛ nyinaa mu anaa?
Menam Onyankopɔn nsa so bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo; meremfa deɛ ɛwɔ adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ hɔ no nsie mo.
Hwɛ, mo deɛ, mo nyinaa moahunu, na adɛn na moda so di ahuhusɛm yi?
Yei ne  otirimuɔdenfoɔ kyɛfa a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn hɔ; ne nhyɛsofoɔ agyapadeɛ a wɔnya firi adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no hɔ.
Sɛ ne mma dɔɔso mpo a, wɔdɔɔso ma nkrantɛ; na n’asefoɔ aduane remmee wɔn.
Ne ho nnipa a wɔbɛka no, owuyareɛ mu na wɔbɛsie wɔn,
Sɛ ɔboaboa dwetɛ ano sɛ mfuturo, na ɔsiesie ntadeɛ sɛ dɔteɛ mpo a,
Ɔbɛsiesie deɛ, nanso ɔteneneeni na ɔbɛhyɛ, Na dwetɛ no, deɛ ɔdi bem na ɔbɛkyɛ mu.
Ɔsi ne fie sɛ abubummabaa, na ɛte sɛ sese a ɔwɛmfoɔ yɛ.
Ɔrekɔda, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ, nso ɔrenna so nyɛ saa bio; ɔbɛbue n’ani na ɔnni hɔ bio.
Ahudeɛ bɛfa no sɛ nsuo;
Apueeɛ mframa soa no kɔ, na ɛhwim no firi ne tenabea.
Na Onyankɔpɔn bɛtɔ agu ne so, na ɛrenhu no mmɔbɔ, dwane ara na ɔbɛpɛ sɛ ɔdwane firi ne nsam.
Wɔbɛbobɔ wɔn nsam agu ne so na wɔabɔ ne so hwerɛma de no afiri ne tenabea akɔ. Ɛhe na nyansa firi? Mpeepee Nyankopɔn nyansa mu
28: “Aane dwetɛ wɔ ne nkommena, na afa wɔ hɔ ma sika a wɔhorɔ.
Dadeɛ nso wɔtu no fa mu,
Onipa ma esum to twa, na ɔhwehwɛ kɔduru akyirikyiri pɛ sum kabii ne sunsum mu aboɔ.
Wɔtu nkoron baabi a obiara nteɛ, anammɔn a ɛtwam werɛ firi no, ɔsensɛne hɔ, ɔdi ahim deɛ ɔdasani biara nnie hɔ.
Asase wɔ hɔ yi, emu na aduane firi ba; Nanso wɔdane ani butu sɛ egya.
N’aboɔ mu na hoaboɔ wɔ,
Ɔkɔdeɛ biara nnim saa kwan no, na akorɔma nso ani nhunuiɛ.
Wuram mmoa akɛseɛ nan nsii so;
Ɔtene ne nsa ka ɔbohemmaa,
Ɔtwitwa aka abotan mu, na n’ani hunu aboɔdenneɛ nyinaa.
Ɔsisi asuasu kwan na ansosɔ, na adeɛ a ahunta no, ɔyi ba hann mu.
Nanso nyansa deɛ, ɛhe na ɛwɔ? Na nhunumu nso, ɛhe na ne tenabea wɔ?
Ɔdasani nnim ne boɔ, na wɔnhu no ateasefoɔ asase so.
Subunu donkodonko ka sɛ, Ɛpo nso ka sɛ, ‘Ɛnni me hɔ!’
Wɔrentumi mfa sika amapa nsi ananmu nnye, na wɔrentumi nkari dwetɛ ntua ka.
Wɔrentumi mfa Ofir sika ntua ka, na wɔmfa apopobibireboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den ne hoaboɔ ntɔ.
Wɔrentumi mfa sika ne ahwehwɛ ntoto ho, na wɔrentumi mfa sika amapa anwenneɛ biara nsesa.
Wɔmmɔ nhwene panin ne aboɔ a ɛhyerɛn din, na nyansa boɔ sene nhwene pa deɛ.
Etiopia asase so akraateboɔ ne no nsɛ,; na sika amapa nso wɔrentumi mfa ntua ka.
Ɛnneɛ na ɛhe na nyansa firi ba? Na ɛhe na nhunumu tenabea wɔ?
Wɔde ahunta ateasefoɔ nyinaa aniwa, wɔakata so ewiem nnomaa anim.
Ɔsɛeɛ amena ne owuo ka sɛ, ‘Yɛde yɛn aso ate ho asɛm.’
Onyankopɔn na ɔte n’akwan ase, na ɔno na ɔnim ne tenabea,
Ɔno na ɔhunu asase ano nohoa;
Ɔhyɛɛ mframa duro too hɔ; na nsuo nso, ɔde adeɛ susuiɛ;
Berɛ a ɔhyɛɛ mmara maa osuo, na ɔtwaa kwan maa nsuframa ne aprannaa no,
Ɛhɔ na ɔhunuiɛ na ɔyii no adie, ɔsiesieeɛ, na ɔhwehwɛɛ mu nso.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ onipa sɛ, ‘Hwɛ! Awurade suro—ɛno ne nyansa, na bɔne ho fire ne nhunumu.’ ” Hiob kyerɛ n’ahotɔ a atwam
29: Ɛnna Hiob san toaa n’akasabebuo no so sɛ:
“O, sɛ anka mereyɛ sɛdeɛ na meteɛ akane abosome no, sɛ nna a Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ me soɔ no ɛ!
Berɛ a ne kanea hyerɛn me tiri soɔ, na mede ne hann nantee sum mu no;
Sɛdeɛ na meteɛ wɔ me twaberɛ nna mu, berɛ a Nyankopɔn ayɔnkofa wɔ me ntomadan soɔ no;
Berɛ a na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ ne me da so wɔ hɔ, na me mmɔfra nso atwa me ho ahyia!
Berɛ a nan ho fɔɔ nufosuo mu sradeɛ mu, na abotan maa ngo asubɔnten senee me hɔ no.
Berɛ a mekɔɔ kuro pono ho, na mede m’adwa sii abɔnten no!
Mmeranteɛ hunuu me, na wɔde wɔn ho huntaeɛ; and nkɔkoraa mpo sɔre gyinagyina hɔ.
Mmapɔmma nso gyaee kasa, na wɔde wɔn nsa too wɔn ano.
Mmakoma nne taa dinn, na wɔn kɛtrɛma fam wɔn dodom.
Na aso te a, ɛhyira me, na ani hu me a, ɛdi me adanseɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ na meyi ɔmanehunufoɔ a ɔsu frɛ ɔboafoɔ
Deɛ ɔreyɛ awuo no nhyira ba me so, na memaa okunafoɔ akoma ani gyeeɛ.
Mefiraa tenenee na ɛfiraa me, na m’atemmusɛm te sɛ atadeɛ yuu ne abotire.
Meyɛɛ aniwa maa onifirani, na meyɛɛ ɛnan nso maa apakye.
Meyɛɛ agya maa ahiafoɔ, na deɛ menni no no mpo asɛm, mehwehwɛɛ mu maa no.
Mebubuu ɔbɔnefoɔ apantan, na mehwim fomfa adeɛ firii ne se mu.
Na meka sɛ, ‘Me pirebuo mu na mɛgyaa mu, na mama me nna adɔɔso sɛ anwea.
Me nhini mu bɛbue ama nsuo, na bosuo nso atena me mman so anadwo.
M’animuonyam yɛ foforɔ ma me, na me tadua anya denyɛ foforɔ me nsam.
Me na wɔtiee me; wɔtwɛnee me, na wɔyɛɛ komm tie m’afotuo.
M’ano si a, wɔnkasa bio,
Na wɔtwɛn me sɛdeɛ wɔtwɛn osuo, na wɔtrɛ wɔn anomu sɛdeɛ wɔde regye bereamporɔsuo.
Mesere kyerɛɛ wɔn, na wɔannye anni, Na m’anim a ɛteɛ no, wɔammu no agu ase.
Meyii kwan maa wɔn, na metenaa ase sɛ otitire; metenaa ase sɛ ɔhene a ɔwɔ n’asraafoɔ mu, sɛ deɛ ɔkyekyere abooboodifoɔ werɛ. Hiob kyerɛ ne seesei asetena a ɛyɛ mmɔborɔ
30: “Na afei deɛ wɔn a mekyɛne wɔn panin koraa sere me, sɛ mede wɔn bɛhyɛ me nkraman a wɔhwɛ me nnwankuo so mu.
Wɔn nsam tumi nso bɛyɛ me dɛn,
Ohia ne ɛkɔm nti wɔatwintwam, deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ sakasaka, kusuu ne basabasa.
Wɔtete nkyenhahan wɔ nnuaa so, na ɛserɛ so nnuaa nhini ne wɔn aduane.
Wɔpampamoo wɔn firii nnipa mu;
Mmonhwa a ɛhɔ yɛ hu mu na wɔteteɛ, ɛfam ne abotan mu ntokuro mu.
Nnua ntam na wɔteateaa mu; nsansono ase na wɔboaboaa wɔn ho ano.
Agyegyentwie mma ne wɔn, wɔapam wɔn afiri asase so.
Na afei madane wɔn sankuo dwom,
Wɔkyiri me, wɔatwe wɔn ho afiri me ho kɔ akyirikyiri; na wɔamfa ntasuo nso ankame m’anim.
Na ɛnam sɛ Onyankopɔn asane me homa, wɔn nso ato ahohyɛsoɔ atwene wɔ m’anim.
Me nifa so na ahuhufoɔ no sɔreɛ, na wɔdane wɔn sɛeɛ akwan ba me so.
Wɔdwiri me kwan,
Wɔba sɛdeɛ wɔnam kwan a ɛtrɛ soɔ; wɔnam huuyɛ no mu munimuni ba me so.
Ahuyideɛ adane hwɛ me so, wɔpamo me bakomadie sɛ mframa, na me yiedie asene kɔ sɛ mununkum.
Seesei deɛ, me kra nane gu me mu, amanehunu nna asosɔ me mu.
Anadwo hodwo me nnompe wɔ me mu,
Emu den nko ara nti m’atadeɛ sakra;
Wato me atwene atɛkyɛ mu, me ho ayɛ sɛ dɔteɛ ne nso.
Mesu frɛ wo, na wonnye me so, megyina hɔ, na wohwɛ me haa.
Woadane ayɛ sɛ otirimuɔdenfoɔ ama me, wode wo nsa a ɛyɛ den ne me di asie.
Woma me so ma metena mframa so kɔ,
Na menim sɛ wode me bɛsane ama owuo ne efie a ateasefoɔ hyia mu no.
Nanso obi ntene ne nsa nhwehwɛ ɔgyeɛ nkunkumaboɔkuo mu, na sɛ obi reyera a, ɔnsu mfrɛ ɔboafoɔ anaa?
Mansu amma deɛ ɔwɔ amaneɛ mu, ohiani anyɛ me kra mmɔbɔ anaa?
Na metwɛnee adepa, nanso bɔne na ɛbaeɛ; m’ani daa hann so, nanso esum kabii na ɛbaeɛ.
Me nsono huruiɛ na anyɛ komm;
Awerɛhoɔ mu na menantee sum mu; mesɔre badwa mu na meteam.
Madane sakraman nua,
Me wedeɛ ayɛ tumm, na ɛwaewae firi me ho; na ahuhuro nti me nnompe ahye.
Na me sankuo adane abooboo, na me tɛntɛbɛn adane asufoɔ nne. Hiob kyerɛ sɛ n’abrabɔ tene
31: “Apam na me ne m’ani ayɛ. Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi de m’adwene akɔ ɔbaabunu so?
Anka kyɛfa bɛn na mɛnya afiri Onyankopɔn hɔ afiri soro? Na agyapadeɛ bɛn na anka mɛnya afiri adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no hɔ a ɛfiri sorɔnsorɔmmea?
Ɛnyɛ ɔsɛeɛ na ɛwɔ hɔ ma obusufoɔ? Na ɛnyɛ asɛm na ɛto amumuyɔfoɔ?
Ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔhunu m’akwan, na ɔkan m’anammɔn tutuo nyinaa?
Sɛ medii ahuhudeɛ akyi, na me nan pɛɛ nnaadaa ho ntɛm a,
Ɔnkari me nsania pa mu, na Onyankopɔn nhunu me mudie no.
Sɛ me nan mane firii kwan no so, na m’akoma dii m’aniwa akyi, na nkekaeɛ bi wɔ me nsam a,
ɛnneɛ wɔmma mennua na obi nni, na wɔntutu me nnɔbaeɛ ngu.
Sɛ m’akoma adaadaa me wɔ ɔbaa bi ho, anaasɛ na metɛ me yɔnko kwan ano a,
ɛnneɛ ma me yere nyam mma ɔbarima foforɔ,
Anka ɛno bɛyɛ ahohwibra, na anka ɛbɛyɛ amumuyɛ a ɛbɛkɔ asɛnnifoɔ anim.
Na ɛno ne ogya a ɛhye kɔ ɔyera amena mu, na anka ɛbɛtutu me nnɔbaeɛ nyinaa.
Sɛ mammu m’akoa anaa m’afenaa atemmuo hwee berɛ a wɔne me wɔ ɛham bi a,
Ɛnneɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn sɔre a, ɛdeɛn na mɛyɛ? Na sɛ ɔbisa me a, asɛm bɛn na mede bɛbua no?
Ɛnyɛ Deɛ ɔyɛɛ me ɔyafunu mu no ara na ɔyɛɛ no? Ɛnyɛ Ɔbaakofoɔ no ara na ɔsiesiee yɛn nyinaa wɔ awotwaa mu?
Sɛ mede deɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ pɛ kamee wɔn, na memaa okunafoɔ anidasoɔ yeraeɛ a,
Sɛ me nko ara na medii m’aduane, na mamma agyanka bi anni a,
Mmom mefiri me mmeranteberɛ mu na mahwɛ no sɛ agya, na mefiri me na yam na mayɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ;
Sɛ mahunu obi a atadeɛ a ɔnnie nti ɔrewuo, anaa ohiani a ɔnni deɛ ɔde kata ne ho;
Na sɛ n’asene anhyira me, na wamfa me nnwan nwi anhyɛ ne ho hye,
Na sɛ metenee me nsa wɔ agyanka so, ɛfiri sɛ mehunuu me boa kuro pono mu a,
ɛnneɛ ma me mmatiri nhwan mfiri ne dompe so, na m’abasa mmubu mfiri ne dompe so.
Ɛfiri sɛ mmusuo a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn yii me hu, na ne kɛseyɛ nti mantumi annyina n'anim.
Sɛ mede sika yɛɛ m’anidasoɔ, anaa meka kyerɛɛ sika amapa sɛ, ‘m’anidasoɔ ne no’
na sɛ m’ani gyee sɛ m’ahodeɛ dɔɔso, ne sɛ me nsa aka adeɛ bebree,
na sɛ mehunuu awia hann sɛ ɛhyerɛn, anaa bosome sɛ ɛnam ne haran mu,
Na m’akoma daadaa me wɔ kokoam,
ɛno nso ne otemmufoɔ anim amumuyɔ bi, na anka mapa Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ soro no  akyi.
Sɛ m’ani gyee me tamfo amanehunu ho, na me ho sanee me sɛ bɔne ato no,
nso mamma m’ano anyɛ bɔne, sɛ mede nnome bɛsrɛ ne wuo.
Ampa ara me ntomadan mufoɔ anka sɛ:
Ɔhɔhoɔ biara anna abɔnten anadwo; mebuee m’apono maa akwantufoɔ.
sɛ mekataa me mmarato so sɛ Adam, na mede m’amumuyɛ siee me kokom,
ɛfiri sɛ mesuroo nkurɔfoɔ dodoɔ na abusuafoɔ ahohorabɔ yii me hu, na ɛmaa meyɛɛ komm, mamfiri me pono ano amfiri adi.
O, sɛ anka merenya obi a ɔbɛtie me ɛ! Hwɛ, m’agyiraeɛ nie! Otumfoɔ mmua me! anaasɛ anka deɛ me ne no anya asɛm no atwerɛ nwoma ɛ!
Ampa ara, anka mede bɛto me mmatiri; mede bɛbɔ me ti sɛ abotire.
Anka mɛkyerɛ no m’anammɔntutuo dodoɔ,
Sɛ m’asase team tia me, na n’akofie de nne korɔ su,
Sɛ medii so aba a mantua sika biara, na memaa ɔdenadeɛ hweree ne kra, a,
Ɛnneɛ ma nkasɛɛ-nkasɛɛ nsi ayuo ananmu, Na ma nnɛnkyɛmse nsi atokoɔ ananmu.” Elihu asɛnka a ɛdi kan. Ɔkyerɛ deɛ enti a ɔkasa
32: Ɛnna mmarima mmiɛnsa yi gyaee sɛ wɔbɛma Hiob mmuaeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔtene ɔno ara n’ani so.
Na Busini Barakel a ɔfiri Ram abusua mu no ba Elihu bo fuu kɛse. Ne bo fuu Hiob sɛ ɔbu ne ho teneneeni sene Onyankopɔn.
Na ne bo fuu ne mfɛfoɔ mmiɛnsa no nso, sɛ wɔannya mmuaeɛ bi bio, na mmom wɔbuu Hiob fɔ.
Na Elihu twɛn maa Hiob kasae ansa, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔn nyinaa sene no panin.
Na Elihu hunuu sɛ mmuaeɛ biara nni mmarima mmiɛnsa no anom bio, ne bo fui.
Enti Busini Elihu a ɔyɛ Barakel ba buaa sɛ: Me deɛ, meyɛ abɔfra, na mo deɛ moyɛ nkɔkoraa, enti na metɔɔ me bo aseɛ, na mesuroo sɛ mɛka deɛ menim akyerɛ mo.
Mekaa sɛ: Wɔmma nna nkasa, na mfe dodoɔ nkyerɛ nyansa.
Ampa, honhom a ɛwɔ ɔdasani mu, ne adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no home, na ɛma no nhunumu.
Ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔanyini pii na wɔnim nyansa, na ɛnyɛ mpanin na wɔhunu atemmuo mu.
Ɛno nti mekaa sɛ, ‘Montie me. Na me nso mɛka deɛ menim akyerɛ mo.’
Hwɛ, matwɛn ama mo akasa awie, mayɛ aso mama mo nhunumusɛm, sɛ mobɛhwehwɛ anya nsɛm bi aka.
Meyɛɛ aso maa mo, nanso obiara nni hɔ a ɔyii Hiob ntɛn,
Enti monhwɛ na moanka sɛ, ‘Yɛahunu nyansa; Onyankopɔn na wabɔ n’asɛm aguo, na ɛnyɛ onipa.’
Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ me na ɔkaa ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ me, na me nso, meremfa mo nsɛm no memmua no.
Wɔn abam abu, wɔremmua bio, na wɔn anomu nsɛm nso asa.
Metwɛneeɛ, nanso wankasa bio; wɔgyinaa hɔ dinn, na wɔammua hwee bio.
Me nso mɛbua me fam deɛ;
Ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm ahyɛ me ma; na honhom a ɛwɔ me mu no hyɛ me.
Hwɛ, me yam te sɛ nsa a wɔntuu ano, ɛte sɛ nsa kotokuo foforɔ a ɛreyɛ apae.
Momma menkasa, na me ho ntɔ me.
Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛhwɛ onipa anim; na madɛfɛdɛfɛ m’ano mama onipa.
Mennim m’ano adɛfɛdɛfɛ, anka me Bɔfoɔ bɛyi me afiri hɔ ntɛm.
33: “Na afei, Hiob, tie me kasa ɛ, na yɛ aso ma me nsɛm nyinaa.
Hwɛ, mabue m’ano, me tɛkrɛma rekasa me dodom.
M’akomam teeyɛ ne me nsɛm, m’ano ka nimdeɛ kronkron frenkyemm.
Onyankopɔn honhom na ɛyɛɛ me, Na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no ahome na ɛmaa me nkwa.
Sɛ wobɛtumi a, yi ano kyerɛ me; Siesie wo ho m’anim, sɔre gyina.
Hwɛ! Sɛdeɛ woteɛ Nyankopɔn ani soɔ no, saa ara na meteɛ; Me nso, dɔteɛ na wɔde nwenee me.
Hwɛ! Me ho hu rentu w’akoma, Na me nhyɛsoɔ renyɛ wo so duru.
Woaka no m’asom,
‘Me deɛ, me ho te, mmarato nni me ho; me ho yɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, amumuyɛ biara nni me ho.
Hwɛ, ɔhunu ntɔkwa nsɛm wɔ me ho,
Ɔde me nan bɔ nnua mu, Na n’ani di m’akwan nyinaa akyi.’
Hwɛ! Yei mu deɛ, mereka akyerɛ wo, woanyɛ no yie; Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn sene onipa dasani koraa.
Adɛn nti na wo ne no reyiyi nsɛm ano? sɛ ɔmmua ne nsɛm nyinaa ho?
Nso Onyankopɔn kasa prɛko ne deɛ ɛtia mprenu, nanso onipa nnwene ho.
Daeɛ mu, anadwo adehunu mu, Berɛ a nnahɔɔ atɔ nnipa soɔ mu,
Emu na ɔbue nnipa aso,
sɛ ɔbɛsane onipa afiri ne nneyɛɛ ho, na wayi ahantan ahunta onipa,
na watwe ne kra afiri Amena mu, ne ne nkwa nso na antɔ afena ano.
Na wɔde yea twe n’aso ne mpa so ne ne nnompe mu daa aperedie.
N’asetena ma aduane yɛ no abofono,
Ne honam afɔn ma ɛyɛ huna, na ne nnompe a anka wonhu po ada adi.
Ne kra bɛn owuo amena, na ne nkwa nso bɛn awudifoɔ.
Sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ dimafoɔ wɔ hɔ ma no, sɛ ɔrekyerɛ onipa deɛ ɛtene ama no a,
ɛno na ɔhu no mmɔbɔ ka sɛ: Kɔgye no, na wankɔ ɔsɛeɛ Amena no mu,
ɛnneɛ ne honam nyɛ sɔɔsɔɔ sɛ mmɔfra deɛ, ɔsane kɔ ne mmeranteberɛ mu.
Ɔbɛbɔ Onyankopɔn mpaeɛ a, n’ani sɔ no, na ɔhunu n’anim anigyeɛ mu, na ɔdane ɔdasani tenenee ma no,
na ɔto dwom kyerɛ nnipa sɛ: Mayɛ bɔne, na makyea deɛ ɛtene no,
Wagye me kra na ankɔ amena mu; na me nkwa nso bɛhunu hann.’
Hwɛ, yeinom nyinaa na Onyankopɔn yɛ mprenu ne mprɛnsa wɔ onipa ho,
Sɛ ɔde bɛdane ne kra afiri amena ho, na ateasefoɔ hann ahyerɛn ne so.
Enti afei Hiob yɛ aso! Tie me! Yɛ komm, na mentoa so nkasa.
Sɛ nsɛm bi wɔ hɔ a, yi ano kyerɛ me, kasa, na wo bemdie bɛyɛ me fɛ.
Sɛ wonni hwee ka a, ɛnneɛ tie me ɛ; Yɛ komm na menkyerɛ wo nyansa.” Elihu kɔ so ara ka Hiob anim
34: Elihu toaa ne nsɛm no so sɛ:
“Montie me nsɛm, mo anyansafoɔ; Na monyɛ aso mma me, mo animdefoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ aso na ɛsɔ nsɛm hwɛ, Sɛdeɛ ano ka aduane hwɛ no.
Momma yɛnsɔ atemmuo nhwɛ; Na yɛnhunu deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ yɛn ntam.
Na Hiob aka sɛ: Metene, nanso Onyankopɔn afa me bem kɔ.
Me bem mu ara na wɔbu me torofoɔ, m’akuro bɔne ntumi nwu, nanso mmarato bi nni me mu.’
Ɔbarima bɛn na ɔte sɛ Hiob
na ɔhyɛne amumuyɛfoɔ ayɔnkofa mu, na ɔne nnipa abɔnefoɔ nanteɛ?
Na ɔka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ mma onipa
Enti mo a mowɔ tire, montie me, ɛmpare Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔbɛdi asɛmmɔne, na Otumfoɔ bɛdi amumuyɛsɛm.
Na mmom, onipa nneyɛɛ so ka na ɔtua no, na sɛdeɛ obi kwan teɛ no, saa na ɔma no to no.
Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔnyɛ bɔne, na adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no, ɔnkyea atemmuo.
Hwan na ɔde asase hyɛɛ ne nsa, na hwan na ɔsiesiee wiase nyinaa?
Sɛ ɔde n’ani si obi so, na ɔtwe onii no honhom ne ne home ba ne nkyɛn a,
anka honam nyinaa bɛgyaa mu prɛko, na onipa bɛsane akɔ dɔteɛ mu.
Na sɛ wowɔ nhunumu a, tie yei,
Deɛ ɔkyiri atɛntenenee bɛnya aman adi so anaa? Anaasɛ wobɛbu ɔteneneeni tumfoɔ no fɔ?
Obi bɛtumi aka akyerɛ ɔhene sɛ, ‘Woyɛ ohuhuni’?
Deɛ ɔnhwɛ atitire anim, na ɔmmu ɔdehyeɛ nsene mmɔborɔni; ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa ano adwuma ne wɔn nyinaa.
Mpofirim na wɔawuwu, anadwo dasuom; wɔwoso biribiri, na wɔtwam kɔ, na aberempɔn twam kɔ a onipa nsa biara nka wɔn.
Ɛfiri sɛ n’ani tua onipa akwan, na ɔhunu n’anammɔntutuo nyinaa.
Esum nni hɔ, na esum kabii nni hɔ, na amumuyɛfoɔ de wɔn ho ahunta hɔ.
Na ɛnhia sɛ ɔhwɛ onipa ma no kyɛ; ansa na wakɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, atemmuo mu.
Ɔbubu aberempɔn a ɔnhwehwɛ wɔn asɛm mu, na ɔde afoforɔ si wɔn ananmu.
Ne saa nti, ɔhwɛ wɔn nneyɛɛ, na ɔka wɔn gu anadwo ma wɔbubu.
Ɔbobɔ wɔn sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔagyae n’akyiridie, na wɔannwene n’akwan no biara ho,
sɛ wɔbɛma mmɔborɔni sufrɛ aduru ne nkyɛn, na wate amanehunufoɔ sufrɛ.
Sɛ ɔma kommyɛ ba a, hwan na ɔbɛtumi abu no fɔ? Na sɛ ɔde n’anim hunta a, hwan na ɔbɛtumi ahu no? Sɛ ɔde hunta ɔman oo, sɛ ɔde hunta onipa oo, ne nyinaa adekorɔ no ara.
Na onipa kɔnkɔnsani anni hene,
Na obi bɛka akyerɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: Mahunu amane, merenyɛ amumuyɛ bio;
Me deɛ, menhunu deɛ mayɛ, enti wo ara kyerɛ me;
Ɔnhyɛ ananmu sɛdeɛ wopɛ na worepo ne nneyeɛ yi? Ɛfiri sɛ wo na ɛsɛ sɛ woyie, na ɛnyɛ me; Sɛ wonim biribi a, kasa ɛ.
Nnipa a wɔwɔ tire bɛka akyerɛ me, na ɔbarima nyansafoɔ bɛtie ama me,
‘Hiob deɛ, ɛnyɛ nimdeɛ so na ɔkasa, na nhunumu nni nsɛm a ɔka mu.’
Sɛ anka wɔresɔ Hiob ahwɛ akɔsi awieeɛ ɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ne mmuaeɛ te sɛ amumuyɛfoɔ mmuaeɛ.
Na ɔde atuateɛ ka ne bɔne ho, na ɔma ne nsɛm a ɔne Onyankopɔn de di asie no dɔɔso.
35: Elihu toaa ne nsɛm no so sɛ:
“Yei na wobu no tenenee no? Woka sɛ, ‘Metene sene Onyankopɔn.’
Sɛ woka sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ me mfasoɔ bɛn? Na mfasoɔ bɛn na mɛnya asene sɛ anka meyɛɛ bɔne?
Mɛma wo mmuaeɛ, Wo ne wo nnamfo a wɔka wo ho no.
Ma w’ani so hwɛ soro, Hwɛ mununkum sɛ ɛkorɔn sene wo koraa.
Sɛ woyɛ bɔne a, ɛdeɛn na woyɛ tia no? Na sɛ w’atuateɛ dɔɔso a, ɛdeɛn na ɛyɛ no?
Sɛ woyɛ deɛ ɛtene a, ɛdeɛn na ɛde ma no, Na ɛdeɛn na ɔnya firi wo nsam?
Onipa te sɛ wo na w’amumuyɔ bɛtumi atia no, Na sɛ woyɛ adetenenee a, onipa dasani mmom na woyɛ ma no.
Nhyɛsoɔ bebrebe nti wɔteam hwehwɛ mmoa; Nnipa akɛseɛ basa nti wɔsu hwehwɛ mmoa.
Nanso wɔn mu biara nka sɛ, ‘Ɛhe na Onyankopɔn, me Bɔfo kɛseɛ no wɔ,
Ɔno na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ yɛn sene asase so mmoa, Na ɔma yɛhunu nyansa sene wiem nnomaa.
Wɔteam, nanso ɔmmua,
Ampa ara Onyankopɔn rentie ahuhusɛm,
Na nkantom sɛ wose: Wonhu no deɛ nanso asɛm no da n’anim, enti twɛn no ara.
Na afei ɛnam sɛ ɔmmɛtwee aso, n’abufuo mu, na ɔnni amumuyɛ akyiri pii nti,
Hiob bue n’ano kwa; na nimdeɛ a ɔnnie mu, ɔma nsɛm dɔɔso.”
36: Elihu toaa so bio sɛ:
“Nya aboterɛ kakra ma me, na mɛma woahunu sɛ mewɔ nsɛm bi ka ma Onyankopɔn.
Mɛfa me nimdeɛ afiri akyirikyiri, na mede me yɛfoɔ no bem ama no.
Na ampa, me nsɛm nyɛ atorɔ, deɛ ɔdi mu nimdeɛ mu na ɔne wo wɔ hɔ yi.
Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔkɛseɛ, na ɔmmu obi animtia, ɔyɛ ɔkɛseɛ, nteaseɛ tumi mu.
Ɔmma ɔbɔnefoɔ nnya nkwa, na ɔde amanehunufoɔ bem ma wɔn.
Ɔrenyi n’ani mfiri ɔteneneeni biara so; na ɔma wɔne ahemfo tena adwa so daa, na ɔma wɔn so.
Na sɛ wɔgu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn, na wɔde amaneɛ nhoma kye wɔn a,
ɛno na ɔbɛka wɔn nneyɛɛ akyerɛ wɔn, ɛne wɔn mmarato, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ ahomasoɔ.
Na ɔbue wɔn aso ma atenetene, na ɔka sɛ wɔnsane mfiri abusudeɛ ho.
Sɛ wɔtie na wɔsom no a, wɔbɛwie wɔn nna wɔ yiedie mu,
Na sɛ wɔantie deɛ a, wɔbɛtɔ  nkrantɛ ano, na nimdeɛ a wɔnnie mu na wɔbɛwuo.
Na akoma mu ansuronyamefoɔ kora abufuo, sɛ ɔkyekyere wɔn mpo a, wɔrenteam nhwehwɛ mmoa.
Wɔn kra wu mmeranteberɛ mu, na wɔn nkwa sɛe ka asɔrefie nnwamanfoɔ deɛ ho.
Ɔyi ɔmanehunufoɔ n’amaneɛ mu, na ɔbue wɔn aso ahodwan no mu.
Anka ɔbɛgye wo nso afiri ahohiahia mu akɔ deɛ ɛhɔ trɛ a ahokyere nnie hɔ, na sradeɛ ayɛ wo pono so aduane ma.
Nanso ɔbɔnefoɔ atemmuo ayɛ wo ma, atemmuo ne atɛntenenee asɔ wo mu.
Na mma abufuo nnnyegye wo nnkɔ ahiyie mu, na mma agyedeɛ no dodoɔ nnhima w’ani.
W’ahonyadeɛ anaa wo tumi ahoɔdenneɛ nyinaa de wo bɛsi deɛ ahohiahia nnie hɔ?
Mma wo ho mmpere wo anadwo ho, berɛ a ɛbɛpra aman firi wɔn afa.
Hwɛ yie na woannane ankɔ amumuyɛ ho, ɛfiri sɛ wopɛ ɛno mmom sene amanehunu.
Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn di ne tumi mu asɛnkɛseɛ, hwan ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ sɛ ɔno?
Hwan na ɔhyɛɛ no sɛdeɛ ɔnyɛ n’adeɛ mfa, na hwan na ɔbɛka sɛ: Woadi asɛmmɔne?
Kae na kamfo ne nnwuma
Adasamma nyinaa ahwɛ haa; Onipa dasani firi akyirikyiri hwɛ.
Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn so, na yɛnni no; ne mfeɛ dodoɔ nso mu nni hwehwɛbea.
Ɔno na ɔtwe nsuo ntoantoa a ɛsosɔ tɔ ne mununkum mu nsuo,
na ɛfiri mununkum mu tɔ gu fam,
Obi bɛtumi ate mununkum mu trɛ ne ne ntomadan mu kurududuyɛ no ase?
Hwɛ, ɔtrɛ ne hann mu wɔ ne so,
Na ɛno na ɔde di aman asɛm;
Ɔde anyinam katakata ne nsa ho, na ɔhyɛ ma no kɔsi botaeɛ bi mu.
Ne mmobɔmu ka ne ho asɛm, mmoakuo mpo ka asɛm fa ahum a ɛreba ho.
37: “Aane, yei ho na m’akoma tutuo,
Monyɛ aso ntie ne nne mmobɔmu, Ne kurududu a ɛpue firi n’anom no.
Ɔgyaa mu wɔ ɔsoro ase nyinaa, Na n’anyinam kɔduru asase ano nohoa.
Aprannaa bobom di akyire, ɔde ne kɛseyɛ nne no bobom. Sɛ wɔte ne nne a, ɔrensianka wɔn.
Onyankopɔn de ne nne prannaa bobom ma no yɛ nwanwa, ɔyɛ adeɛ akɛseɛ a yɛntumi nte aseɛ.
Na ɔka kyerɛ sukyerɛmma sɛ: Tɔ gu asase so! ne osukɛseɛ nso saa ara sɛ: Tue! ne n’ahoɔden suo akɛseɛ no.
Ɔsɔ nnipa nyinaa nsa ano, sɛ onipa dasani biara nhunu ne nsa ano adwuma.
Ɛnna mmoadoma kɔ wɔn atu mu, na wɔtenatena wɔn tenabea.
Ahum firi mpiakyire hɔ ba, na awɔ nso firi atifi fam.
Nyankopɔn home na ɛma nsukyeneeɛ, na ɛma nsuo a ɛtrɛ nso da.
Nsuo na ɔde soa mununkum, ɔtrɛ ne hann hwete mununkum,
Na ɔma no di kyinhyia sɛdeɛ n’akwankyerɛ teɛ, sɛ ɛnkɔyɛ deɛ ɔhyɛ no nyinaa, wiase nyinaa ne asase ani;
sɛ ɛyɛ atenetene nti oo, sɛ ɛyɛ n’asase nti oo, sɛ ɛyɛ n’adɔeɛ so oo, ɔma ɛdi dwuma.
O Hiob, yɛ aso tie yei; Gyina hɔ komm, na dwendwene Onyankopɔn anwanwadwuma ho.
Wonim berɛ a Onyankopɔn susuo ho, na ɔma ne mununkum mu hann hyerɛn?
Wonim mununkum nkariiɛ, nimdeɛ mu mudifoɔ no anwanwadeɛ no?
Wonim sɛdeɛ wo ntadeɛ mu yɛ hyeɛ, berɛ a anafoɔ mframa ma asase yɛ dinn no?
Wo ne no na ɛde ewiem tɔnn a ɛwɔ hɔ pintinn sɛ ahwehwɛ a wɔaguo no trɛɛ hɔ?
Ma yɛnhunu deɛ yɛnka nkyerɛ no; esum nti yɛrenhunu deɛ yɛnka.
Wɔbɛka akyerɛ no sɛ mewɔ asɛm bi ka anaa? Anaasɛ obi kasa a wɔbɛmene no?
Nnipa deɛ, wɔnhunu hann; berɛ a mframa atwam ama ewiem ateɛ no.
Atifi fam asase so na sika firi ba, Nyankopɔn ho na animuonyam a ɛyɛ hu wɔ.
Otumfoɔ deɛ, yɛnhu no; na ɔrenkyea atemmuo ne tenenee a ɛdɔɔso.
Enti nnipa monsuro no, ɔmmu akoma mu nyansafoɔ biara.
38: Ɛnna Awurade firi ahum mu buaa Hiob sɛ:
“Hwan ne oyi a ɔdane afotuo ani, na ɔka nsɛm a nimdeɛ nnim yi?
Bɔ w’asene sɛ ɔbarima ɛ; na memmisa wo na kyerɛ me.
Ɛhe na na wowɔ berɛ a metoo asase fapem? Sɛ wowɔ nhunumu a, ka kyerɛ me ɛ.
Hwan na ɔde ne nsusuiɛ too hɔ, wonim anaa? Anaasɛ hwan na ɔde susuhoma too soɔ?
Ɛdeɛn so na wɔde ne nnyinasoɔ sisiiɛ? Anaa hwan na ɔde ne tweatiboɔ toeɛ,
Berɛ a adekyeeɛ nsoromma boom too ahurisie dwom, na Onyankopɔn mma nyinaa bɔɔ ose no?
Hwan na ɔkaa po hyehyɛɛ apono mu, na ɛfirii adi te sɛ deɛ ɛfiri yafunu mu;
Berɛ a mede mununkum yɛɛ ne nkataho, na mede esum kabii yɛɛ n’abomu,
Berɛ  a metwaa ne so hyeɛ, na mesisii adaban ne apono maa no,
na mekaa sɛ, ‘Ɛha yi na bra bɛduro, na ntra; na ɛha ara na w’asorɔkye ahantan mmeso no?
Ɛfiri wo nna mfitiaseɛ no, woahyɛ berɛ ama anɔpa pɛn? woakyerɛ adekyeeɛ nso ne diberɛ,
Sɛ ɛnsosɔ asase ano, na wɔmporoporo abɔnefoɔ mfiri soɔ?
Sɛ ɛdanedane sɛ dɔteɛ wɔ nsɔano ase, na ɛnyɛ sɛ atadeɛ a wɔahyɛ no aduro,
na wɔde abɔnefoɔ hann akame wɔn, na nsa a wɔama soɔ no, wɔabu mu?
Woakɔ ɛpo aniwa ho, na wɔanante bunu donkodonko ase?
Wɔayi owuo aponkɛseɛ adi akyerɛ wo, anaasɛ woahunu esum kabii apono?
Woate asase tɛtrɛtɛ ase? Sɛ wonim ne nyinaa a, ka ɛ.
Ɛhe na hann tenabea kwan wɔ,
na wode akɔ ne hyeɛ so, na woahunu ne fie akwan no?
Wonim, aane ɛfiri sɛ saa berɛ no na wɔawo wo, na woadi nna bebree ntira?
Woakɔ sukyerɛmma korabea, anaa woahunu asukɔtweaa akoradeɛ no,
adeɛ a makora asie ahohiahia berɛ
Ɛhe na kwan a hann fa so hyerɛn no da, ne deɛ apueeɛ mframa fa so bɔ asase soɔ no nso wɔ?
Hwan na ɔyiyi aka ma nsuo ne kwan ma aprannaa asraman no,
sɛ ɔbɛma osuo atɔ asase a obi nni hɔ soɔ, ne anwea pradada a onipa bi nni soɔ so,
na wama amamfo ne asase hunu ameeɛ, na wama wira a ɛfuo no afefɛ?
Nsuo wɔ agya, anaasɛ hwan na ɔwo bosuo a ɛsosɔ?
Hwan yam na nsukyeneeɛ fire, na ɔsoro bosuo a akyenkyen no, hwan na ɔwoeɛ?
Nsuo kyenkyen sɛ boɔ, na ebunu donkodonko ani pam.
Wobɛtumi akyekyere Akokɔbaatan-ne-ne-mma nsorommakuo [Pleaides] abom? Anaasɛ wobɛtumi asane Kesil [Orion] nsorommakuo nhoma?
Wobɛtumi ama Owiakwanmu - Masarot nsorommakuo apue ne berɛ mu? Na Sisire - Ayis nsorommakuo ne ne mma nso, wobɛtumi akyerɛ wɔn kwan?
Wonim ɔsoro nhyehyɛɛ? Anaa wobɛtumi ahyehyɛ ne tumidie wɔ asase so?
Wobɛtumi ama wo nne so akyerɛ mununkum ama nsuo pii abɛkata wo so anaa?
Wobɛtumi asoma anyinam ama no akɔ, na aka akyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Yɛn nie!’ anaa?
Hwan na ɔde nyansa siee ayamdeɛ mu, anaasɛ hwan na ɔde nhunumu maa adwene?
Hwan na ɔbɛtumi de nyansa akan mununkum pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ɔbɛtumi adane ɔsoro nkotokuo no,
Berɛ a mfuturo pia kɔbɔ dosie,
Wobɛtumi ayɛ ha ama gyata? anaa wobɛtumi ama agyataburuwa amee,
ɛberɛ a wɔbutubutu wɔn atu mu,
Hwan na ɔsiesie aduane ma kwaakwaadabi, berɛ a ne mma su frɛ Onyankopɔn, wɔkyini na wɔnni aduane no? Mmoadoma di Nyankopɔn nyansa ho adanseɛ
39: “Wonim abotan so mmirekyie awoɔ berɛ? Na aforoteɛ awoko berɛ nso, wowɛn?
Wobɛtumi akan abosome dodoɔ a wɔn afuru de nyini? Anaasɛ wonim berɛ pɔtee a wɔde woɔ?
Wɔkoto wowo wɔn mma,
Wɔn mma ho kokwa, wɔnyini wuram; Wɔfiri adi kɔ, na wɔnsan mma wɔn nkyɛn bio.
Hwan na ɔgyaa ɛserɛ so afunumu sɛ ɔnne ne ho, na afunumu prakaateni nhoma, hwan na ɔsane?
Deɛ mede serɛ pradada so ama no sɛ ne fie, na mede nkyene asase ayɛ ne tenabea?
Ɔmmu kuro mu gyegyeegyeyɛ,
Deɛ ɔnya no mmepɔ soɔ no ne n’aduane, na ɔpɛ adeɛ biara a ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm.
Ɛkoɔ bɛpene so asom wo? Anaa ɔbɛda wo mmoa adididaka ho anadwo?
Wobɛtumi de homa akyekyere ɛkoɔ wɔ afuo mu? Anaa ɔbɛdi w’akyi afuntum asasetamaa?
N’ahoɔden dodoɔ nti, wode wo ho bɛto ne so anaa, na woagya w’adwuma ama no anaa?
Wobɛgye no adi sɛ ɔde w’aba bɛba, na waboa ano de aba w’asan so?
Sohori bɔ ne ntaban mu ahurisidie mu, ɛne asukɔnkɔn ntaban ne ne ntakra na ɛsɛ anaa?
Mmom ɔgya ne nkosua gu asase mu, na mfuturo mu na ɔma no nya ɔhyew,
Na ne werɛ firi sɛ obi nan bɛtumi apɛkyɛ no, anaasɛ wuram aboa bi bɛtumi atiatia so.
Ɔbɔ ne mma atirimuɔden; ɔyɛ wɔn sɛ deɛ wɔnyɛ ne mma,
Onyankopɔn ama nyansa abɔ no,
Na sɛ ɔyere ne ho tu a, ɔsere pɔnkɔ ne ne sotefoɔ.
Wo na wode ahoɔden ma pɔnkɔ? Wo na wode nnawa hyehyɛ ne kɔn mu?
Wo  na woma no hurihuri sɛ ntutummɛ? Ne home foofoo denyɛ, ɛyɛ hu.
Ɔde ne nan pempem bonhwa mu, na ɔdi n’ahoɔden ho ahurisie, ɔfiri kɔhyia akofoɔ a wɔamia.
Ɔhunu ahudeɛ a, ɔsere, na ne ho mpopo; na nkrantɛ nso, ɔnsan mfiri animu.
Agyan boha woso ne so, pea ne pɛmɛ a ɛtwa nyinamnyinam nso.
Ɔde anibereɛ ne abufuo werɛwerɛ asase, na totorobɛnto hyɛne a, ɔnnyina bio.
Ɔnya te abɛn pɛ a, ɔka sɛ, Ahaa! Ɔwɔ akyirikyiri mpo a, ɔte ɛko ho hwa, Ɔte asafohene gyegyeegye ne osebɔ no.
Wo nyansa nti na akorɔma tu kɔ sorosoro, na ɔtrɛ ne ntaban mu kyerɛ anafoɔ?
Anaa wo na wohyɛ ma ɔkɔdeɛ tu kɔ soro, kɔyɛ ne pirebuo wɔ sorosoro?
Ɔbotan mu na ɔteɛ na ɔda, baabi a ɔbotan ano hwirenhwiren a obiara ntumi nkɔ hɔ no?
Ɛhɔ na ɔfiri hwehwɛ aduane; n’ani hunu adeɛ akyirikyiri.
Na ne mma nso fefe mogya; na deɛ atɔfoɔ wɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɔwɔ.” Hiob brɛ ne ho ase, AWURADE asɛm a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Susono ne ɔdɛnkyɛmmirampɔn
40: Na Awurade buaa Hiob sɛ:
“Ɔtɛnyifoɔ bi ne Otumfoɔ no bɛham anaa? Ma deɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn gye akyinnyeɛ no, ɔmmua ɛ!
Ɛnna Hiob buaa Awurade sɛ:
“Ao! Mensɛ hwee: mesua, Ɛdeɛn na mede bɛyi wo ano?
Makasa prɛko, na merenkasa bio, ne mprenu, na merenkɔ so bio.”
Ɛnna Awurade firi ahum mu buaa Hiob sɛ:
“Bɔ w’asene sɛ ɔbarima ɛ; ma memmisa wo na kyerɛ me.
Wobɛdane m’atemmuo no ani? Wobɛbu me fɔ na woadi bem?
Wowɔ nsa sɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ, na wobɛtumi de nne a ɛte sɛ aprannaa abobom?
Fa kɛseyɛ ne tumidie hyehyɛ wo ho; na fa anidie, ɔhyerɛn ne animuonyam fira.
Hwie w’abufuo mmorosoɔ no gu, na hwɛ ɔhantanni biara na brɛ no ase.
Hwɛ ahantanfoɔ nyinaa na brɛ wɔn ase, na tiatia abɔnefoɔ so wɔ wɔn tenabea hɔ.
Fa wɔn nyinaa sie dɔteɛ mu, na kyekyere wɔn gu ahuntaeɛ mu,
Anka me na mɛkamfo woɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo nsa nifa bɛtumi agye wo.
Hwɛ susono a meyɛɛ no ne wo,
N’asene mu na ne tumi wɔ, na n’ahoɔden dodoɔ no wɔ ne yafunu ntini mu.
Ɔkoa ne dua sɛ tweneduro; ne srɛ mu ntini abebare ho.
Ne nnompe te sɛ kɔbere dorobɛn; ne nnompe mu den te sɛ dadeɛ.
Ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn akwan mfitiaseɛ; ne Yɛfoɔ nko na ɔbɛtumi de nkrantɛ abɛn no.
Mmepɔ na ɛfifiri aduane ma no, na ɛhɔ na wuram mmoa nyinaa di agorɔ.
Nkasɛɛnkasɛɛ nnua ase na ɔda, demmire ne ɔwora ahuntaeɛ mu.
Nkasɛɛnkasɛɛ nnua nwunu kata ne so; nsuo ano nnua twa ne ho hyia.
Hwɛ, asubɔnten ano yɛ den mpo a, ne ho mpopo. sɛ Yordan bu ba n’ano mpo a, ɔnsuro.
Obi bɛtumi agyina n’anim akye no animono, anaa, obi bɛtumi de fidie ahwire ne hwene mu?
41: “Wobɛtumi de daawa atwe dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn [Leviathan], anaasɛ wobɛtumi de homa akyekyere ne kɛtrɛma?
Wobɛtumi de kaa ahyɛ ne hwene mu, anaa wobɛtumi de kɔtɔkorɔ ahwire n’apantan mu?
Ɔbɛkoto asrɛ wo pii? Anaasɛ ɔne wo bɛkasa bɔkɔɔ?
Ɔne wo bɛyɛ apam
Wo ne no bɛdi agorɔ sɛ anomaa? Anaasɛ wobɛmantam no de agyegye wo mma mmaa ani?
Abatafoɔ de no bɛdi nsesadwa?
Wobɛtumi de mpea ahyehyɛ ne wedeɛ mu, anaa wobɛtumi de mpataa mpɛmɛ awowɔ ne tirim?
Fa wo nsa ka no hwɛ, kae ntɔkwa no, anka worenyɛ saa bio.
Hwɛ onipa anidasoɔ yɛ ohunu. Onipa ani bɔ ne so kɛkɛ a, ɔbɛtwa ahwe.
Obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛpɛ ne ho asɛm akɔgyegye no. Na hwan ne deɛ ɔbɛtumi agyina m’anim?
Hwan na wadi kan ama me biribie a ɛsɛ sɛ mehyɛ no ananmu? Deɛ ɛwɔ ɔsoro ase nyinaa, me na ɛwɔ me.
Merennyae ne honam adeɛ, ne ne mmaninyɛ ne n’aboaban fɛ a ɛyɛ no ho asɛnka.
Hwan na ɔbɛyi ne ho abon? Ne se kyerɛpɛn mmienu no, hwan na ɔbɛkɔ anim?
N’anim apono nso, hwan na ɔbɛtumi abue? Ne se a ayɛ n’anom ma ho no yɛ hu.
Abena a ɛwɔ ne ho ma no yɛ ahantan, akeka amiamia so te sɛ adeɛ a wɔasɔ ano dendeenden.
Ɛfemfam so papee,
Ɛtetare so dendeenden; Ɛdi nsosɔmu, na emu ntumi ntete.
Ne nwansi pa gya hyerɛn, na n’ani te sɛ adekyeeɛ hann.
N’anom pa gya yerɛwyerɛw,
Wisie firi ne hwene mu tokuro mu, te sɛ ɛsɛn a emu rehuro ne nkyɛkyerɛ a ɛrehyeɛ mu.
N’ahome sɔ nsramma, na ogyaframa firi n’anomu.
Ne kɔn mu na ahoɔden wɔ,
Ne honam abubu agu so; wɔguu wɔ ne ho, na ɛtim hɔ pintinn, na ɛntwe.
N’akoma yɛ den sɛ boɔ,
Sɛ ɔma ne ho so a, atumfoɔ ho popo, na ehu ma wɔn ani so yɛ wɔn krakra.
Wɔde nkrantɛ ka no a, ɛnka no, pea ne bɛmma ne agyan nso ntumi no.
Ɔbu dadeɛ sɛ ɛserɛ bi kɛkɛ, ne kɔbere sɛ duawuiɛ bi kɛkɛ.
Agyan ntumi mpamo no; ntɔmmoɔ mu aboɔ yɛ no sɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma.
Ɔbu akontimmaa sɛ nkyɛnkyɛmma,
Ne yam ase te sɛ abono hwetahweta; ɔfa atɛkyɛ mu a, ɛte sɛ ayuporeɛ adeɛ.
Ɔma ebunu mu huru sɛ kukuo; ɔma ɛpo yɛ sɛ sradehwam kukuo.
Ɔma kwan mu hyerɛn di n’akyi; ɔma nipa hunu subunu a ɛhuro no sɛ ɛdwono.
Ne nsɛsoɔ nni asase so;
Ɔhwɛ adeɛ a ɛkorɔn nyinaa; ɔne ahokyerɛ mma nyinaa hene.”
42: Ɛnna Hiob buaa Awurade sɛ:
“Menim sɛ wotumi adeɛ nyinaa yɛ,
‘Hwan ne oyi a ɔdane afotuo ani, a nimdeɛ nnim yi?’ Enti na mekaa deɛ mente aseɛ, anwanwadeɛ  a ɛsene me a na mennim.
‘Tie ɛ, na menkasa. Ma memmisa wo na kyerɛ me.’
Wo ho asɛm kɛkɛ na meteeɛ, nanso afei deɛ m’ani ahu wo.
Ɛno nti na matwe asan no, manu me ho, na afei me sakyera dɔteɛ ne nso mu.”
Ɛbaa sɛ, Awurade kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Hiob wieeɛ no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Temanni Elifas sɛ: “Me bo afu wo ne wo mfɛfoɔ mmienu no kɛse, ɛfiri sɛ moanka me ho nokwasɛm te sɛ m’akoa Hiob.

Enti momfa anantwinini nson ne adwennini nson, na monkɔ m’akoa Hiob nkyɛn, na mommɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma mo ho; na m’akoa Hiob na ɔbɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo. Ɔno nko ara na mɛhwɛ n’anim, na me ne mo anni no mo nkwaseasɛm nti, ɛfiri sɛ moanka me ho nokwasɛm te sɛ m’akoa Hiob.”
Ɛnna Elifas a ɔfiri Teman ne Bildad a ɔfiri Suha ne Sofar a ɔfiri Naama no sii mu kɔyɛɛ deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no pɛpɛɛpɛ; na Awurade tiee Hiob mpaebɔ.
Berɛ a Hiob bɔɔ mpaeɛ maa ne nnamfo no, Awurade nso maa Hiob amanehunu no baa awieeɛ, na Awurade de adeɛ a Hiob nyaeɛ no nyinaa mmɔho mmienu maa no.

Ɛnna ne nuanom mmarima nyinaa ne ne nuanom mmaa nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔni no dada nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔne no bɛdidii wɔ ne fie, na wɔgyam no, na wɔkyekyeree ne werɛ, amaneɛ a Awurade maa no baa ne soɔ nyinaa ho, na wɔn mu biara maa no sika dwetɛbena baako ne sika kaa baako.
Na Awurade hyiraa Hiob awieeɛ senee ne mfitiaseɛ, maa no nyaa nnwan mpem dunan (14,000) ne yoma mpemnsia (6,000) ne anantwie mpamho apem (1,000) ne mfunumu abereɛ apem (1,000).
Ɔnyaa mma mmarima nson ne mma mmaa mmiɛnsa nso.
Ɔfrɛɛ deɛ ɔdi kan no Yemaima, deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no, ɔfrɛɛ no Kesia, na ɔfrɛɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no nso Keren-Hapuk.
Na wɔanhunu mmaa a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ sɛ Hiob mma mmaa no wɔ asase no nyinaa so, na wɔn papa memaa wɔn agyapadeɛ wɔ wɔn nua mmarima mu.
Ɛno akyi no Hiob tenaa ase mfeɛ ɔha aduanan (140), na ɔhunuu ne mma ne ne       mmanana kɔsii awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so nnan so.
Na Hiob wuiɛ; na wabɔ akora, na wadi nna amee.

1: Awurade asɛm a ɛbaa Petuel ba Yoel nkyɛn nie:
“Montie yei, mo mpanimfoɔ, na asase sofoɔ nyinaa, monyɛ aso. Saa adeɛ yi bi asi pɛn wɔ mo berɛ so anaasɛ mo agyanom berɛ so anaa?
Monka ho asɛm nkyerɛ mo mma, na mo mma nka nkyerɛ wɔn mma, na wɔn mma nso nka nkyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdi soɔ no.
Deɛ aketekyire adi aka no, ntutummɛ adi; deɛ ntutummɛ di kaeɛ no, mfuntie adi; na deɛ mfuntie di kaeɛ no, mmɛbɛ adi.
“Mo nsabofoɔ, monnyane na monsu, na mo nsanomfoɔ nyinaa, montwa adwo, nsamono nti, ɛfiri sɛ wɔatwa afiri mo anomu.
Na ɔman bi aba m’asase so; wɔn ho yɛ den na wɔn dodoɔ nni ano. Wɔn se te sɛ gyata se, na wɔwɔ gyata apantan.
Wɔasɛe me bobe pasaa, na wɔapempane me borɔdɔma mman. Wɔawaewae ho hono ato agu. Na ne mman ho ayɛ fitafita.
Twa adwo sɛ ɔbaabunu a ɔfira atweaatam ma ne mmabaaberɛ mu kunu.
“Wɔatwa aduane afɔdeɛ ne afɔrebɔ nsa afiri Awurade fie; asɔfoɔ, Awurade asomfoɔ no, di awerɛhoɔ.
Mfuo asɛe, asase di abooboo; na aduane asɛe, nsamono awe, ngo ase atu.
Akuafoɔ, mo ani nwu; ayuo ne atokoɔ nti bobe nturo mu adwumayɛfoɔ, montwa adwo, ɛfiri sɛ afuo mu nnɔbaeɛ asɛe.
Bobe adwan, na borɔdɔma nso akusa. Granate akutuo ne abɛ ne aprɛ dua, ne wuram nnua nyinaa awuwu; ampa ahurisie atu afiri adasamma mu.
“Asɔfoɔ, mommɔ abɔsoɔ na mommɔ bena. Afɔrebukyia asomfoɔ, montwa adwo. Me Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ, mommra mmɛda atweaatam mu anadwo nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ aduane afɔdeɛ ne afɔrebɔ nsa agyae mo Nyankopɔn fie ba.
Monyɛ abuadadie kronkron. Monyɛ afahyɛ nhyiamu titire. Mommoaboa mpanimfoɔ no ne asase no sofoɔ nyinaa ano mmra Awurade mo Nyankopɔn fie, na monsu mfrɛ Awurade.
“O, ɛda no; Awurade da no abɛn, na ɛbɛba sɛ ɔsɛeɛ a ɛfiri adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no nkyɛn!
Wɔntwaa aduane mfirii yɛn anim, na wɔntwaa anigyeɛ ne ahosɛpɛ mfirii yɛn Nyankopɔn fie anaa?
Aba a wɔadua aporɔ ne nkofie mu, aduanekora adan ada mpan, asan nso, abubu, ɛfiri sɛ ayuo asɛe.
Hwɛ sɛdeɛ mmoadoma penepene! Hwɛ sɛdeɛ anantwie kuo si brɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni adidibea. Na wɔde asodie nso to nnwankuo no so.
“O Awurade, wo na mesu frɛ woɔ, ɛfiri sɛ egya ahye ɛserɛ so adidibea, na gyaframa ahye wuram nnua nyinaa.
Wuram mmoa nso su frɛ wo, ɛfiri sɛ nsuwansuwa awewe, na egya ahye ɛserɛ so adidibea.”
2: “Monhyɛne totorobɛnto wɔ Sion, na mommɔ ose me bepɔ kronkron so. Ma asase sofoɔ nyinaa ho mpopo, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade da no reba, na abɛn!

Ɛyɛ esum ne kusuuyɛ da, mununkum ne kusukuukuu da; ɛte sɛ adekyeeɛ hann a ɛkata mmepɔ soɔ. “Ɔman bi wɔ hɔ a wɔdɔɔso na wɔn ho yɛ den; ɛso bi mmaa da firi teteete, na wɔn akyi nso, ebi remma bio, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ akyi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mfeɛ mu.
Egya hye di wɔn anim, na ogyaframa tafere di wɔn akyi. Asase a ɛda wɔn anim no te sɛ Eden turo, na wɔn akyi deɛ, ɛyɛ ɛserɛ pradada, ampa ara, biribiara remfiri wɔn anim redwane.
“Wɔn ho te sɛ apɔnkɔ ho, na wɔtu mmirika sɛ apɔnkɔ.
Wɔhurihuri sɛdeɛ nteaseɛnam yɛ kitikiti wɔ mmepɔ so, ne sɛdeɛ gyaframa hye nkyɛnkyɛmma turituri no. Wɔte sɛ ɔman a ɛyɛ den a wɔasiesie wɔn ama ɔko.
Wɔn nti, aman ho dwiri wɔn, nnipa nyinaa anim sinsiam.
“Wɔtu mmirika sɛ nnɔmmarima. Wɔforo fasuo sɛ akofoɔ. Obiara nam ne kwan so na wɔmmane mfiri wɔn kwan so.
Obi nsum ne yɔnko. Wɔnam wɔn kwan so tee. Sɛ wɔn mu bi tɔ akodeɛ ano mpo a, wɔmpira.
“Wɔbɔ kirididi di kuro mu akɔneaba. Wɔtu mmirika fa ɔfasuo so. Wɔforo ba afie mu. Na wɔfa mpomma mu ba sɛ owifoɔ.
Asase woso wɔn anim, na ɔsoro hinhim. Awia ne bosome dane sum, na nsoromma gyae hyerɛn.
Awurade na ɔma ne nne so n’asraafoɔdɔm no anim, ɛfiri sɛ ne dɔm no dɔɔso paa. Na deɛ ɔdi n’asɛm soɔ no ho yɛ den; Awurade da no so na ɛyɛ hu sɛ. Hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ano?”
“Na afei,” Awurade asɛm nie, “momfiri mo akoma nyinaa mu mfa mmuadadie ne esu ne agyaadwoɔtwa nsane mmra me nkyɛn.
Monsunsuane mo akoma mu mmom, na ɛnyɛ mo ntadeɛ mu, na monsane mmra Awurade mo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔyɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ, ne bo kyɛre fu na n’adɔeɛ dɔɔso, na ɔnu ne ho adebɔne ho.
Hwan na ɔnim sɛ ebia ɔbɛsane na wanu ne ho, na wagya n’akyiri nhyira, -- aduane afɔdeɛ ne afɔrebɔ nsa a wɔde bɛma Awurade mo Nyankopɔn.
“Monhyɛne totorobɛnto wɔ Sion. Monhyɛ berɛ mma mmuada kronkron. Monyɛ afahyɛ nhyiamu titire.
Mommoaboa ɔman no ano. Monte asafo no ho. Mommoaboa mpanimfoɔ no ano, na mommoaboa mmɔfra ne wɔn a wɔnom nufoɔ ano. Momma ayeforɔkunu mpue mfiri ne pia mu na ayeforɔ mpue mfiri n’ayeforɔ dan mu.

“Momma asɔfoɔ no, Awurade asomfoɔ no nsu wɔ ntwonoo no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam sɛ, ‘O Awurade, hu wo man mmɔbɔ, na mfa w’agyapadeɛ mma ahohora, na mma amanaman nnni wɔn so. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔka no aman mu sɛ: “Wɔn Nyankopɔn no wɔ he?”’
Na afei Awurade bɛtwe n’asase ho ninkunu na wahu ne man mmɔbɔ.
Na Awurade bɛbua ne man aka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Hwɛ, mede aduane ne nsamono ne ngo rebrɛ mo, na ɛbɛmee mo; na meremma monyɛ ahohoradeɛ bio amanaman mu.

Nanso atifi fam dɔm no mɛyi wɔn afiri mo so akɔ akyirikyiri; na mapamo wɔn akɔ asase pradada ne amamfo so, na mede wɔn ani bɛkyerɛ apueeɛ fam po na mede wɔn akyi akyerɛ atɔeɛ fam po. Na wɔn ho kankan bɛsɔre, na ɔsoro ara na wɔn ho nka bɛkorɔ; ɛfiri sɛ wɔadi bɔne kɛseɛ.’
“O asase, nsuro. Ma w’ani nnye na di ahurisie, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ayɛ adeɛ kɛseɛ.
Wuram mmoa, monnsuro, ɛfiri sɛ ɛserɛ so wura mono refefɛ. Na nnua reso n’aba, borɔdɔma dua ne bobe reso bebree.
Sion mma, momma mo ani nnye, na monni Awurade mo Nyankopɔn mu ahurisie, na ɔbɛma mo asusɔ sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ, na ɔbɛma nsuo atɔ ama mo na moanya asusɔ ne adonsuo sɛ kane no.
Ayuo a wɔaporo bɛyɛ ayuporobea amaama, na bobesa foforɔ bɛbu so wɔ nsa-kyi-amena mu.
Na mfirinhyia a ntutummɛ, mfuntie, mmɛbɛ ne nketekyire, me dɔm kɛseɛ a mesomaa wɔn baa mo mu no diiɛ no, mɛhyɛ no ananmu.
Na mobɛdidi; mobɛdidi na moamee, na moayi Awurade mo Nyankopɔn din ayɛ, deɛ wayɛ anwanwadeɛ yi ama mo no; na me man ani renwu da biara da.
Na mobɛhunu sɛ mewɔ Israel mu, na mene Awurade mo Nyankopɔn, na obi nni hɔ bio. Na me man ani renwu da biara da.
“Na yei akyiri no, ɛbɛba sɛ mɛhwie me honhom agu honam nyinaa so, na mo mma mmarima ne mo mma mmaa bɛhyehyɛ nkɔm. Mo mpanimfoɔ nso bɛsoso adaeɛ. Na mo mmeranteɛ ahunu anisoadeɛ.
Mɛhwie me honhom agu nkoa ne mfenaa mpo so, saa nna no mu.
“Na mɛma anwanwadeɛ aba ɔsoro ne asase so: mogya ne egya ne wisie kumɔnn.
Owia bɛduru sum, na ɔsrane adane mogya ansa na Awurade da kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu no aba.

Na ɛbɛba sɛ obiara a ɔbɛbɔ Awurade din afrɛ no no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa. Na sɛdeɛ Awurade aka no, wɔn a wɔbɛdwane no, Bepɔ Sion so ne Yerusalem ne wɔn a wɔafiri mu afi a Awurade afrɛ wɔn no mu na wɔbɛtena.”
3: “Hwɛ! nna no mu, berɛ a mede Yuda ne Yerusalem atukɔfoɔ bɛsane aba no,
mɛboaboa amanaman nyinaa nso ano de wɔn asiane aba Yehosafat bɔnhwa no mu, na me ne wɔn adi asɛm wɔ hɔ, me man ne m’agyapadeɛ Israel a wɔabɔ wɔn apete amanaman mu, na wɔakyɛ m’asase no mu nti.
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔtwee me man so ntonto, na wɔde abarimaa gyee odwamamfoɔ, na wɔtɔn abaayewa gyee nsa nomeeɛ.

“Na mo, O Tiro ne Sidon ne Filistia nkuro nyinaa nso, ɛdeɛn na me ne mo wɔ yɛ? Deɛ mayɛ bi na mode retua me ka? Sɛ mo se moretua me ka a, ɛnneɛ deɛ moreyɛ no, mede ahoɔherɛ bɛyɛ ntɛm adane agu mo atifi.
Ɛsiane sɛ mofaa me dwetɛ ne me sika kɔkɔɔ, na mode m’afɛfɛdeɛ pa kɔguu mo asɔredan mu;
