Enti Yesu firii adi baeɛ a nkasɛɛ abotire bɔ no na atadeɛ ngugusoɔ kɔkɔɔ nso hyɛ no. Ɛnna Pilato ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Hwɛ! Onipa no nie!”

Nanso berɛ a asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne asomfoɔ no hunuu no no, wɔteatea mu kaa sɛ: “Bɔ no asɛnnua mu! Bɔ no asɛnnua mu!” Pilato ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mo ara momfa no nkɔbɔ no asɛnnua mu, na me deɛ, menhunu mfomsoɔ biara wɔ ne ho.”
Yudafoɔ no buaa no sɛ: “Yɛwɔ mmara, na sɛdeɛ mmara no kyerɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔwuo, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛɛ ne ho Onyankopɔn ba.”
Afei berɛ a Pilato tee saa asɛm no, ɔsuroo paa;
na ɔkɔɔ amrado aban mu hɔ bio, na ɔbisaa Yesu sɛ: “Wofiri he?” Nanso Yesu amma no mmuaeɛ biara.
Ɛnna Pilato bisaa no sɛ: “Wommua me? Wonnim sɛ mewɔ tumi sɛ megyaa woɔ anaa mewɔ tumi nso sɛ mebɔ wo asɛnnua mu?”
Yesu buaa no sɛ: “Sɛ wɔamfa amma wo amfiri soro a, anka worennya me so tumi biara. Ɛno nti deɛ ɔyii me maa woɔ no na ne bɔne so.”
Enti Pilato kɔɔ so hwehwɛɛ kwan a ɔbɛfa so agyaa no. Nanso Yudafoɔ no wɔteatea mu kaa sɛ: “Sɛ wogyaa onipa yi a, na wonyɛ Kaesare adamfo. Ɛfiri sɛ onipa biara a ɔyɛ ne ho ɔhene no kasa tia Kaesare.”
Enti Pilato tee saa asɛm no, ɔde Yesu firii adi, na ɔtenaa atemmuo adwa so wɔ baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Aboɔ-Nsɛeɛ, deɛ Hebri mu wɔfrɛ no Gabata no.
Saa berɛ no na wɔreboaboa wɔn ho ama twam no; na ɛbɛyɛ dɔn a ɛtɔ so nsia. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Yudafoɔ no sɛ: “Hwɛ! Mo hene nie!”
Nanso wɔteateaam sɛ: “Fa no kɔ! Fa no kɔ! Bɔ no asɛnnua mu!” Pilato ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Memmɔ mo hene asɛnnua mu?” Asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no buaa sɛ: “Yɛnni ɔhene biara sɛ Kaesare.”
Afei ɔde no maa wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no asɛnnua mu.
Na berɛ a ɔno ara so asɛnnua no, ɔfirii adi kɔɔ baabi a wɔato din Tikwankoraa a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgota wɔ Hebri mu no;
ɛhɔ na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu kaa nnipa mmienu ho, baako wɔ fa ha na baako nso wɔ fa ha, na Yesu wɔ mfimfini.
Na Pilato twerɛɛ asɛm bi nso fam asɛnnua no atifi. Ɔtwerɛɛ sɛ: “YESU NASARENI, YUDAFOƆ HENE NO.”
Enti Yudafoɔ no bebree kenkanee asɛm yi, ɛfiri sɛ na baabi a wɔbɔɔ Yesu asɛnnua mu no bɛn kuro no, na wɔtwerɛɛ no Hebri, Latin, ne Hela kasa mu.
Nanso Yudafoɔ asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Pilato sɛ: “Ntwerɛ sɛ ‘Yudafoɔ Hene,’ na mmom twerɛ sɛ ɔno na ɔkaa sɛ, ‘Mene Yudafoɔ Hene.’”
Pilato buaa sɛ: “Deɛ matwerɛ no, na matwerɛ.”

Afei berɛ a asraafoɔ no bɔɔ Yesu asɛnnua mu no, wɔfaa n’atadeɛ ngugusoɔ kyɛɛ mu nnan, na ɔsraani biara faa baako, ɛne n’atadeɛ nhyɛaseɛ no. Nanso na atadeɛ nhyɛaseɛ no nni mpameeɛ, na na wɔanwene firi soro abɛsi fam.

Enti wɔkeka kyerɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ: “Mommma yɛnnsunsuane mu, mmom momma yɛntwe so ntonto nhwɛ deɛ ɛbɛyɛ ne dea.” Yei baa saa na ama twerɛsɛm no aba mu sɛ: “Wɔkyekyɛɛ me ngugusoɔ mu faeɛ, na m’atadeɛ nso, wɔtwee so ntonto.” Enti asraafoɔ no na ɛyɛɛ yeinom.
Na ne maame ne ne maame nua, afei Klopa yere Maria, ne Maria Magdalene gyina asɛnnua no ho.
Na berɛ a Yesu hunuu ne maame, na ɔhunuu osuani a ɔdɔ no no sɛ wɔgyina hɔ no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne maame sɛ: “Ɔbaa, hwɛ! Wo ba!”
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ osuani no nso sɛ: “Hwɛ! Wo maame! Na ɛfiri saa berɛ no, osuani no de no kɔɔ ɔno ara ne fie.
Yei akyi, berɛ a Yesu hunuu sɛ biribiara aba awieeɛ no, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na twerɛsɛm no aba mu no ɔkaa sɛ: “Sukɔm de me.”
Na adeɛ bi si hɔ a nsa kekakeka ayɛ no ma. Ɛnna wɔde nsa no bi hyɛɛ sapɔ ma, na wɔde tuaa sommɛ ano de kaa n’ano.
Afei berɛ a wɔde nsa kekakeka no kaa Yesu ano no, ɔkaa sɛ: “Wɔawie!” Na ɔsii ne tiri ase gyaa ne honhom mu.

Na ɛyɛ Ahoboaboa berɛ, na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Homeda no bɛduru na amu no nsɛn asɛnnua no soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na saa Homeda no yɛ homeda kɛseɛ nti, Yudafoɔ no srɛɛ Pilato sɛ ɔmma wɔmmubu wɔn nan mu na wɔnyi amu no mfiri hɔ.
Enti asraafoɔ no ba bɛbubuu deɛ na ɔdi kan no nan mu ne deɛ ɔka ho a wɔbɔɔ ɔne no asɛnnua mu no nso deɛ mu.
Na wɔduruu Yesu nkyɛn a wɔhunuu sɛ wawu dada no, wɔammubu ne nan mu.
Nanso asraafoɔ no baako de pea wɔɔ ne mfe na ntɛm ara mogya ne nsuo firi baeɛ.
Deɛ ɔde n’ani hunuiɛ na adi adanseɛ yi, na n’adanseɛ no yɛ nokorɛ, na saa onipa no nim sɛ ɔka nokorɛ na ama mo nso moagye adi.
Na yeinom siiɛ na twerɛsɛm no aba mu sɛ: “Wɔremmu ne dompe baako mpo mu.”
Afei nso twerɛsɛm foforɔ ka sɛ: “Wɔbɛhwɛ Deɛ wɔde pea wɔɔ no no.”

Afei, yeinom akyi no, Yosef a ɔfiri Arimatea, a na ɔyɛ Yesu suani nanso Yudafoɔ no ho suro nti ɔyɛɛ no kokoam no, bɛsrɛɛ Pilato sɛ ɔmma no mfa Yesu amu nkɔ; na Pilato maa no kwan. Ɛnna ɔbɛfaa amu no kɔeɛ.
Nikodemo a berɛ a ɛdi kan no ɔbaa Yesu nkyɛn anadwo no nso de kurobo ne pɛprɛ mfrafraeɛ bɛyɛ nkariboɔ ɔha baeɛ.
Enti wɔfaa Yesu amu no de nwera a aduhwam no wom kyekyeree no sɛdeɛ Yudafoɔ amusie ho amanneɛ teɛ no.
Na turo bi wɔ baabi a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no, na na ɛda foforɔ a wɔmfaa obiara ntoo mu da wɔ turo no mu.
Ɛhɔ na Yudafoɔ no ahoboaboa nti, wɔde Yesu kɔtoeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛda no bɛn.
20: Nnawɔtwe no da a ɛdi kan no, Maria Magdalene kɔɔ ɛda no so anɔpatutuutu berɛ a esum da so wom, na ɔhunuu sɛ wɔayi boɔ no afiri ɛda no ano dada.
Ɛnna ɔde mmirika kɔɔ Simon Petro ne osuani foforɔ a Yesu dɔ no no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Wɔayi Awurade afiri ɛda no mu, na yɛnnim baabi a wɔde no akɔtoɔ.”
Afei Petro ne osuani foforɔ no firii adi de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ ɛda no so.
Enti wɔn mmienu no sɔɔ mmirika mu; nanso osuani baako no de mmirika a emu yɛ den dii Petro anim, na ɔduruu ɛda no ho kane.
Na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase hwɛɛ mu no, ɔhunuu nwera no sɛ ɛgu hɔ, nanso wankɔ mu.
Simon Petro nso dii n’akyi baeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ ɛda no mu. Na ɔhunuu nwera no sɛ ɛgu hɔ,
ne duku a wɔde bɔɔ ne ti no sɛ wɔabobɔ agu nkyɛn baabi a ɛnka nwera no ho.
Afei osuani a ɔduruu ɛda no ho kane no nso kɔɔ mu, na ɔhunuiɛ na ɔgye diiɛ.
Saa berɛ no na wɔntee twerɛsɛm no ase sɛ ɛtwa sɛ ɔnyane firi awufoɔ mu.
Enti asuafoɔ no sane kɔɔ wɔn afie.
Nanso Maria deɛ, na ɔda so ara gyina ɛda no nkyɛn baabi a ɔresu. Afei berɛ a ɔresu no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase hwɛɛ ɛda no mu,
na ɔhunuu abɔfoɔ mmienu a wɔhyehyɛ ntade fitaa sɛ baako te baabi a na Yesu amu no da no atifi na baako nso te anafoɔ.
Ɛnna wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔbaa, adɛn na woresu?” Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Wɔafa m'Awurade kɔ, na mennim baabi a wɔde no akɔtoɔ.” Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ Maria
Afei ɔkaa saa no, ɔdanee ne ho hwɛɛ n’akyi, na ɔhunuu sɛ Yesu gyina hɔ, nanso na ɔnnim sɛ ɛyɛ Yesu.

Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔbaa, adɛn na woresu? Hwan na worehwehwɛ no?” Ɔno deɛ, na ɔsusu sɛ ɛyɛ turom hɔ hwɛfoɔ, enti ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Owura, sɛ wo na woafa no afiri ha a, kyerɛ me baabi a wode no akɔtoɔ na menkɔfa no nkɔ.”
Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Maria!” Na ɔdanee ne ho ka kyerɛɛ no Hebri kasa mu sɛ: “Raboni!” (a aseɛ ne “Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ!”)
Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mfa wo nsa nka me, na mennya nkɔɔ Agya no nkyɛn. Mmom si kwan so kɔ me nuanom nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Merekɔ m’Agya ne mo Agya ne me Nyankopɔn ne mo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.’”
Maria Magdalene bɛkaa deɛ asie kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no sɛ: “Mahunu Awurade!” Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ waka yeinom nyinaa akyerɛ no. Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ n’asuafoɔ

Afei ɛduruu saa da no anwummerɛ, a ɛyɛ nnawɔtwe no da a ɛdi kan no, ɛwom sɛ na Yudafoɔ no ho suro nti wɔatoto apono mu wɔ baabi a na asuafoɔ no wɔ deɛ, nanso Yesu ba bɛgyinaa wɔn mfimfini ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ nka mo.”
Na ɔkaa saa no, ɔde ne nsam ne ne mfem kyerɛɛ wɔn. Afei asuafoɔ no dii ahurisie sɛ wɔahunu Awurade.
Ɛnna Yesu sane ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ nka mo. Sɛdeɛ Agya no asoma me no, me nso meresoma mo.”
Ɔkaa saa no, ɔhuu mframa guu wɔn so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnye honhom kronkron.
Wɔn a mode wɔn bɔne bɛkyɛ wɔn no, wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔn; na wɔn a mobɛma wɔn bɔne atena hɔ no, wɔbɛma atena hɔ.”
Nanso berɛ a Yesu baeɛ no, na Toma, dumienu no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Ata no, nka wɔn ho.

Enti asuafoɔ nkaeɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛahunu Awurade!” Nanso ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sɛ manhunu nnadewa no ananmu wɔ ne nsam, na mamfa me nsateaa anka nnadewa no ananmu na mamfa me nsa anka ne mfem a, merennye nni da.”
Ne nnawɔtwe akyi no, na n'asuafoɔ no wɔ dan mu bio, na na Toma ka wɔn ho. Ɛwom sɛ na wɔatoto apono no mu deɛ, nanso Yesu baa mu bɛgyinaa wɔn mfimfini kaa sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ nka mo.”
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ Toma sɛ: “Fa wo nsateaa ka ha, na hwɛ me nsam na fa wo nsa ka me mfem, na gyae akyinnyegyeɛ na gye di.”
Toma bua see no sɛ: “M’Awurade ne me Nyankopɔn!”
Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Toma, sɛ woahu me nti na afei woagye adie? Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔnhunuiɛ nanso wɔgye die.”
Nokwasɛm nie, Yesu yɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne foforɔ bebree wɔ asuafoɔ no anim a wɔantwerɛ no nwoma yi mu.
Nanso wɔatwerɛ yeinom ato hɔ na moagye adi sɛ Yesu ne Kristo no, Onyankopɔn Ba no, na mogye di a moanya nkwa wɔ ne din mu. Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ Asuafoɔ baason
21: Yeinom akyi no, Yesu yii ne ho adi bio kyerɛɛ n'asuafoɔ no wɔ Tiberia po ho; na ɔyii ne ho adi saa kwan yi so.
Na wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ ne Simon Petro ne Toma a wɔfrɛ no Ata no, ne Natanael a ɔfiri Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea no, ne Sebedeo mma no, ne n’asuafoɔ foforɔ mmienu.
Simon Petro ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Merekɔ po so akɔyi nam.” Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛn nso yɛne wo bɛkɔ.” Enti wɔfirii adi kɔtenaa kodoɔ mu, nanso wɔanyi hwee anadwo no.
Na adeɛ reyɛ akye no, Yesu bɛgyinaa po no ano, nanso asuafoɔ no anhunu sɛ ɛyɛ Yesu.
Afei Yesu bisaa wɔn sɛ: “Mma nkumaa, moanya nam anaa?” Wɔbuaa no sɛ “Dabi!”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mongu asau no wɔ kodoɔ no nifa na mobɛnya bi.” Ɛnna wɔguiɛ, na mpataa no dodoɔ nti na wɔntumi ntwe bio.
Enti osuani a na Yesu dɔ no no ka kyerɛɛ Petro sɛ: “Ɛyɛ Awurade!” Afei berɛ a Simon Petro tee sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade no, ɔde n'atadeɛ soro hyɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnhyɛ hwee, na ɔtoo ne ho too po no mu.
Nanso asuafoɔ a aka no de kodoɔ ketewa no baeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔne asase ntam kwan nware, bɛyɛ anammɔn ahanu, na wɔtwee asau a mpataa wom no baeɛ. Wɔne Kristo di paanoo ne mpataa
Afei wɔfiri kodoɔ no mu sii fam no, wɔhunuu gyabidie a wɔasɔ a mpataa gu soɔ ne paanoo.
Yesu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Momfa mpataa a moyii no seesei yi ara no bi mmra.”
Ɛnna Simon Petro foro kɔtwee asau a mpataa akɛseɛ ɔha aduonum mmiɛnsa (153) ahyɛ no ma no baa asase soɔ. Na ɛdɔɔso paa deɛ, nanso asau no antete.
Yesu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mommra mmɛdidi.” Nanso asuafoɔ no baako mpo annya akokoɔduro ammisa no sɛ: “Woyɛ hwan?” Ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnim sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade.
Yesu bɛfaa paanoo no de maa wɔn, na ɔde apataa no nso maa wɔn saa ara.
Yei ne ne mprɛnsa soɔ a na Yesu ayi ne ho adi akyerɛ n'asuafoɔ no firi berɛ a wɔnyane firii awufoɔ mu no.
Afei berɛ a wɔdidi wieeɛ no, Yesu bisaa Simon Petro sɛ: “Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me sene yeinom anaa?” Ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Aane, Awurade, wonim sɛ medɔ wo.” Ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛn me nnwammaa no.”
Ɔbisaa no ne mprenu soɔ sɛ: “Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me?” Ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Aane, Awurade, wonim sɛ medɔ wo.” Ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ me nnwan no.”

Ɔbisaa no ne mprɛnsa soɔ sɛ: “Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me?” Petro werɛ hoo sɛ ɔbisaa no ne mprɛnsa soɔ sɛ: “Wodɔ me?” Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Awurade wonim nneɛma nyinaa; wonim sɛ medɔ wo.” Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛn me nnwan no.
Nokorɛ, nokorɛ, mese wo sɛ, woyɛ aberanteɛ no, wobɔɔ abɔsoɔ nante kɔ baabi a wopɛ. Nanso sɛ wobɔ akora a, wobɛtene wo nsa na obi abɔ wo abɔsoɔ, na ɔde wo akɔ baabi a wompɛ.”
Ɔkaa yei de kyerɛɛ owuo ko a ɔde bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam. Enti ɔkaa yei no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Di m’akyi!.” Yesu ne Osuani a ɔdɔ no no
Petro danee ne ho no, ɔhunuu osuani a Yesu dɔ no no sɛ ɔdi n’akyi, deɛ anwummeduane no ase no na ɔtwere ne kokom a ɔbisaa sɛ: “Awurade, hwan na ɔbɛyi wo ama?” no.
Enti berɛ a Petro hunuu no no, ɔbisaa Yesu sɛ: “Awurade, oyi nso ɛ?”
Yesu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ mepɛ sɛ ɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba a, ɛfa wo ho bɛn? Wo deɛ, kɔ so di m’akyi.”
Afei asɛm no trɛɛ anuanom no mu sɛ saa osuani no renwu. Nanso Yesu anka ankyerɛ no sɛ ɔrenwu, na mmom ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɛ mepɛ sɛ ɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba a, ɛfa wo ho bɛn?”
Oyi ne osuani a ɔdi nneɛma yi ho adanseɛ na ɔtwerɛɛ yeinom, na yɛnim sɛ n'adanseɛ a ɔdie no yɛ nokorɛ.
Na nneɛma foforɔ pii wɔ hɔ a Yesu yɛeɛ a, sɛ wɔtwerɛɛ ne nyinaa a, anka mesusu sɛ nwoma a wɔbɛtwerɛ no renkɔ wiase mpo.

1: Na Awurade asɛm baa Amitai ba Yona nkyɛn sɛ:
“Sɔre kɔ Niniwe kuro kɛseɛ no mu, na ka kyerɛ kurom hɔfoɔ sɛ wɔn bɔne aforo aba m’anim.”
Nanso Yona sɔree sɛ ɔredwane akɔ Tarsis afiri Awurade anim, na ɔsiane kɔɔ Yopa kɔhunuu hyɛn bi a ɛrekɔ Tarsis. Enti ɔtuaa ka foro kɔtenaa mu sɛ ɔredwane afiri Awurade anim ne wɔn akɔ Tarsis.
Na Awurade maa mframa a ano yɛ den bɔ faa po no so, na ahum kɛseɛ bi tuiɛ wɔ ɛpo no so, na hyɛn no yɛɛ sɛ deɛ ɛrebɛbɔ.

Afei na hyɛn no mu adwumayɛfoɔ no suro, enti obiara su frɛɛ ne nyame. Na wɔfirii aseɛ yiyii nneɛma a ɛwɔ hyɛn no mu to guu po no mu sɛdeɛ emu bɛyɛ hare. Nanso saa berɛ yi na Yona akɔhyɛ hyɛn no ase baabi ada hatee.
Afei hyɛn no mu panin kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Nna wura, ɛdeɛn na ayɛ woɔ nti a wada hatee seyie? Sɔre frɛ wo Nyankopɔn ɛ! Ebia wo Nyankopɔn bɛhu yɛn mmɔbɔ na yɛanwuwu.”
Enti wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: “Mommra mma yɛntwe ntonto mfa nhunu deɛ ne nti saa amaneɛ yi aba yɛn soɔ yi. Na wɔtwee ntonto no, ntonto no bɔɔ Yona.
Enti wɔsee no sɛ: “Yɛsrɛ wo, ka kyerɛ yɛn: Hwan na ama mmusuo yi aba yɛn soɔ? Adwuma bɛn na woyɛ, na ɛhe na wofire? Ɔman bɛn so na wofire, na wo kurom ne he?”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Meyɛ Hebrini na mesom ɔsoro Nyankopɔn Awurade, deɛ ɔbɔɔ ɛpo ne asase pɛsɛɛ no.”
Afei na nnipa no suro, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi?” Na nkurɔfoɔ no nim sɛ ɔredwane Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ na waka akyerɛ wɔn.
Afei wɔsane bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ woɔ na po no ano adwo ama yɛn?” Saa berɛ no na po no gu so ara rehuru dendeenden.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Momma me so nto me ntwene ɛpo no mu na ano bɛdwo, ɛfiri sɛ menim sɛ me nti na ahum kɛseɛ yi aba mo soɔ.”
Nanso mmarima no bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde hyɛn no bɛfa ahum no mu aba asase pɛsɛɛ so, nso wɔantumi ɛfiri sɛ na ɛpo no gu so rehuru hyia wɔn dendeenden.
Afei wɔfirii aseɛ su frɛɛ Awurade sɛ: “O Awurade, yɛsrɛ wo mma yɛnnwuwu ɛsiane ɔbarima yi kra nti! Na mfa mogya a yɛdi ho bem ngu yɛn so, na wo O Awurade, deɛ ɛsɔ w’ani na woayɛ yi!”
Enti wɔmaa Yona so too no twenee ɛpo no mu, na ɛpo no gyaee ne bagyabagyayɛ no.
Afei nnipa no firii aseɛ suroo Awurade papaapa, enti wɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Awurade, na wɔhyehyɛɛ bɔ.
Nso na Awurade asiesie apataa kɛseɛ bi sɛ ɔmenee Yona, na Yona dii apataa no yam nnansa, awia ne anadwo. Yona mpaebɔ ne ne nkwagyeɛ
2: Afei Yona bɔɔ Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn mpaeɛ wɔ apataa no yam,
na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mefiri m’ahohia mu na mesu frɛɛ Awurade, na ɔgyee me so. Asamando yafunu mu na mesu hwehwɛɛ mmoa. Na wotiee me nne.
Na wotoo me twenee ebunu mu, ɛpo akoma mu tɔnn, na ɔhweamo [Nsuo] twaa me ho hyiae; w’asorɔkyeɛ ne w’aworɔ nyinaa bu faa me so.
Ɛnna mekaa sɛ, ‘Wɔapamo me afiri w’anim! Nanso mede m’ani bɛhwɛ w’asɔrefie kronkron no bio.
Nsuo twaa me ho hyiae bɛduruu me kra ho; ebunu twaa me ho buka sii.
Mesiane kɔɔ mmepɔ ase tɔnn. Na asase akyiri adaban kaa me hyɛɛ mu daa. Nanso woyii me nkwa firii amena mu, O Awurade me Nyankopɔn.
Me kra tɔɔ me mu piti no, mekaee Awurade. Na me mpaebɔ duruu w’anim, w’asɔrefie kronkron hɔ.
Wɔn a wɔn ani sɔ atorɔ ahoni no, wɔpo wɔn ara wɔn adom.
Nanso me deɛ, mede aseda nne bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama wo. Ɛbɔ a mahyɛ biara mɛtua. Na nkwagyeɛ wɔ Awurade.”
Ɛnna Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ apataa no na ɔkɔfee Yona too asase pɛsɛɛ so.
3: Na Awurade asɛm sane baa Yona ne mprenu soɔ sɛ:
“Sɔre kɔ Niniwe kuro kɛseɛ no mu na pae mu ka asɛm a mereka akyerɛ woɔ yi kyerɛ wɔn.”
Enti Yona sɔre kɔɔ Niniwe sɛdeɛ Awurade kaeɛ no. Nso na Ninewe yɛ kuro kɛseɛ a nnansa na wɔde twa ho hyia.
Afei Yona de n’ani kyerɛɛ kuro no mu twaa da koro kwan, na ɔpaee mu kaa sɛ: “Aka adaduanan na wɔadane Niniwe kuro yi abutu.”
Ɛnna Niniwefoɔ no gyee Onyankopɔn diiɛ, na ɛfiri kumaa so kɔsi ɔpanin so, wɔn nyinaa dii mmuada firafiraa atweaatam.
Berɛ a asɛm no duruu Niniwe hene asom no, ɔsɔre firii n’adwa so yii n’ahentadeɛ guu hɔ firaa atweaatam, na ɔtenaa nso mu.

Afei ɔmaa wɔbɔɔ dawuro wɔ Niniwe, na wɔde mmara a ɔhene ne ne mpanimfoɔ ahyɛ too dwa sɛ: “Ɛnsɛ sɛ onipa anaa aboa biara, nantwie oo, odwan oo, de biribi ka n’ano. Obiara nnnidi, na nsuo mpo wɔnnnom bi.
Na onipa ne aboa biara mfira atweaatam, na wɔnsu dendeenden mfrɛ Onyankopɔn, na obiara nsane mfiri ne kwammɔne ne n’amumuyɛsɛm biara a ɛwɔ ne nsam no ho.
Hwan na ɔnim, sɛ ebia Onyankopɔn bɛsesa n’adwene wɔ adeɛ a wɔrebɛyɛ no ho, na wadane afiri n’abufuhyeɛ no ho, na wansɛe yɛn.
Afei Onyankopɔn hunuu wɔn nneyɛɛ, sɛ wɔasane afiri wɔn akwammɔne so, enti Onyankopɔn sesaa n’adwene wɔ bɔne a ɔkaa sɛ ɔde bɛba wɔn soɔ no ho, na wanyɛ wɔn hwee. Yona abufuo ne n’atenetene
4: Nanso Yona ani annye asɛm no ho koraa, na ne bo fuiɛ.

Enti ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ ka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ: “Ah, Awurade, ɛnyɛ asɛm a mewɔ m’asase soɔ mekaeɛ no ara na ɛda hɔ yi? Ɛno nti na medwanee sɛ merekɔ Tarsis no, ɛfiri sɛ menim sɛ woyɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ, wo bo kyɛre fu, w’adɔeɛ dɔɔso, deɛ wɔsesa n’adwene wɔ mmusuo a wode reba ho.
Na afei Awurade, gye me kra firi me nsam, na ɛyɛ sɛ mɛwuo sene sɛ mɛtena aseɛ.”
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wosusu sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ wo bo fuo?”
Na Yona firii kuro no mu kɔɔ apueeɛ fam baabi kɔtenaa hɔ, na ɔbɔɔ sese bi sɛ ɔretena ne nwunu ase atwɛn ahwɛ deɛ ɛbɛto kuro no.
Ɛnna Awurade Nyankopɔn maa adedenkruma [kɔntoa dua] bi fifii sɛ ɛnkata Yona so, na ɔnyaa nwunu a ɛbɛgye no afiri n’ahoyera mu. Na kɔntoa dua yi nti Yona ani gyee papaapa.
Nanso adeɛ kyeeɛ a animu rebaebae no, Onyankopɔn maa ɔsa bɛwee kɔntoa dua no, na ɛwuiɛ.
Berɛ a awia pueeɛ no, Onyankopɔn maa apueeɛ mframa a emu yɛ hyeɛ nso bɔeɛ, na awia no hyee Yona apampam maa ɔyɛɛ mmerɛ. Afei ɔsrɛɛ sɛ anka ɔnwu, na ɔsii so kaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ sɛ mɛwuo sene sɛ mɛtena aseɛ.”
Afei Onyankopɔn bisaa Yona sɛ: “Wosusu sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ kɔntoa dua yi nti wo bo fuo anaa?” Ɛnna ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ sɛ me bo fuo, na menyaeɛ mpo a anka owuo de me kɔ.”
Na Awurade kaa sɛ: “Wo deɛ, kɔntoa dua yi mpo asɛm no yɛ wo ya. Nso wonyɛɛ ɛho adwuma biara, na ɛnyɛ wo na womaa no nyiniiɛ; ɛfifii anadwo koro na ɛwuu anadwo koro.
Na me deɛ, Niniwe kuro kɛseɛ a emufoɔ boro mpem ɔha aduonu (120,000) a wɔnnim wɔn nifa nnim wɔn benkum ne nyɛmmoa bebrebe yi asɛm nha me anaa?”

1: Na Awurade akoa Mose wuo akyiri no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Nun ba Yosua a na ɔyɛ Mose somfoɔ no sɛ:
“M’akoa Mose awu; afei sɔre na wo ne ɔman yi nyinaa ntwa Yordan yi nkɔ asase a mede rema Israelfoɔ no so.
Baabiara a mo nan bɛtia no, mede bɛma mo sɛdeɛ meka kyerɛɛ Mose no.
Ɛfiri serɛ so hɔ ne Lebanon yi kɔsi Asubɔntene kɛseɛ Eufrate ho, kyerɛ sɛ Hitifoɔ asase nyinaa, de kɔfa Po kɛseɛ no atɔeɛ fam; deɛ awia kɔtɔ no nyinaa bɛyɛ mo asase.
Na wo nkwa nna nyinaa, obiara rentumi nnyina w’anim. Sɛdeɛ medii Mose akyi no, saa ara na mɛdi w’akyire. Merempa wo na merennya wo.
Ma wo bo nyɛ duru na wo ho nyɛ den, ɛfiri sɛ wo na wode ɔman yi bɛkɔ ama wɔakɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no so.
“Deɛ ɛhia ara ne sɛ wobɛma wo bo ayɛ duro na wo ho ayɛ den paa, na hwɛ di mmara a m’akoa Mose de maa woɔ no nyinaa soɔ. Mmane mfiri ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum na baabi a wobɛkorɔ nyinaa woadi yie.
Mma mmara nwoma yi mmfiri w’anom, na mmom kenkan na dwendwene ho awia ne anadwo na woadi deɛ wɔatwerɛ no mu nyinaa so. Woyɛ saa a, ɛno na wo kwan bɛyɛ dwoodwoo, na ɛno na ɛbɛsi wo yie.
Menhyɛɛ wo sɛ ma wo bo nyɛ duru na wo ho nyɛ den? Nsuro na mmɔ hu, ɛfiri sɛ baabi a wobɛkorɔ biara no, Awurade wo Nyankopɔn ka wo ho.”
Ɛnna Yosua hyɛɛ ɔman no mu ahwɛfoɔ no sɛ:
“Monkɔ nsraban no mu na monka nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ, ‘Nnansa akyi mobɛtwa Yordan asubɔnten yi akɔfa asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama mo no. Enti, monsiesie aduane a mobɛdi no kwan soɔ.’”
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo no fa no sɛ:
“Monkae asɛm a Awurade akoa Mose ka kyerɛɛ mo no sɛ, ‘Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ama moanya ahome, na ɔde asase yi ama mo.
Mo yerenom ne mo mma nkumaa ne mo mmoa bɛka asase a Mose de ama mo Yordan agya ha no so; na mo, nnɔmmarima nyinaa deɛ, momfa mo akodeɛ na monni mo nuanom anim nkɔboa wɔn;

Nkɔsi sɛ Awurade bɛma mo nuanom ahome sɛ mo na wɔfa asase a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama wɔn no, afei mobɛtumi asane aba abɛfa asase a wɔde ama mo no, deɛ Awurade akoa Mose de ama mo Yordan agya wɔ apueeɛ fam no.’”
Ɛnna wɔbuaa Yosua sɛ: “Deɛ woahyɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛbɛyɛ, na baabiara a wobɛsoma yɛn no yɛbɛkɔ.
Sɛdeɛ yɛtiee Mose biribiara mu no, saa ara na yɛbɛtie woɔ. Deɛ yɛresrɛ ara ne sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyi sɛdeɛ ɔdii Mose akyi no.
Na obiara a ɔbɛsɔre atia w’ahyɛdeɛ na wantie asɛm biara a wobɛka akyerɛ no no, wɔnku no. Enti ma wo bo nyɛ duru na wo ho nyɛ den.”
2: Afei Nun ba Yosua somaa mmarima mmienu kodɛɛ firii Sitim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkɔhwɛ sɛdeɛ asase no ne Yeriko kuro no teɛ.” Enti wɔsiim kɔeɛ, na wɔkɔduruu ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ bi a ne din de Rahab fie, na wɔdaa hɔ.
Na asɛm no kɔduruu Yeriko hene asom sɛ: “Hwɛ! Israelfoɔ mmarima bi aba ha anadwo yi rebɛhwɛ sɛdeɛ yɛn asase yi teɛ.”
Ɛnna Yeriko hene soma kɔɔ Rahab nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yi mmarima a wɔaba wo nkyɛn wɔ wo fie no bra, na wɔaba ha sɛ wɔrebɛhwɛ sɛdeɛ yɛn asase no nyinaa teɛ.”
Nanso saa berɛ yi nyinaa na ɔbaa no de mmarima mmienu no asie. Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ampa, mmarima no baa me nkyɛn, nanso mennim baabi a wɔfire.
Na esum duruiɛ a wɔrebɛto kuro pono no mu no, na mmarima no firii adie, nanso mennim baabi a wɔfaeɛ. Monyɛ ntɛm nti wɔn na mobɛto wɔn.”
Nso na ɔde wɔn kɔ ɛdan no atifi de wɔn akɔsie asaawa nnua bi a wɔahyehyɛ no atifi hɔ mu.
Enti ɔhene no nkurɔfoɔ no de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Yordan asutwareeɛ tii wɔn. Na berɛ a wɔfirii adie ara pɛ, na wɔtoo kuro no pono mu.
Ansa na mmarima a wɔwɔ dan no atifi bɛda no, ɔbaa no kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn,
na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Menim sɛ ɛkwan biara so Awurade de asase yi ama mo, na mo ho hu mpo atɔ yɛn so dada. Na moama asase yi sofoɔ nyinaa akoma aboto.
Yɛate sɛdeɛ mofiri Egypt reba no Awurade maa Po Kɔkɔɔ no wee wɔ mo anim, ne deɛ mode yɛɛ Amorifoɔ ahemfo mmienu, Sihon ne Og, a wɔwɔ Yordan agya no, sɛdeɛ mosɛee wɔn pasapasa no.
Na berɛ a yɛteeɛ no, yɛn akoma tuiɛ, na mo nti obiara honhom adwane bɛsi nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔsoro a ɛwɔ soro ne asase a ɛwɔ fam yi Nyankopɔn.
Ɛsiane sɛ mayɛ mo adɔeɛ nti, monka ntam Awurade din mu sɛ mo nso mobɛyɛ m'agya fiefoɔ adɔeɛ. Enti momma me sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛyɛ nokorɛ,
mesrɛ mo monnye me papa ne me maame ne me nua mmarima ne me nua mmaa ne wɔn fiefoɔ nyinaa. Na monyi yɛn kra mfiri owuo mu.”
Ɛnna mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ mobɛwuo deɛ, anka yɛde yɛn kra bɛtwa so! Na sɛ moammɔ asɛm yi so na Awurade de asase yi ma yɛn a, yɛn nso yɛbɛyɛ mo adɔeɛ na yɛadi mo nokorɛ.”
Afei ɔbaa maa wɔn ahoma maa wɔde faa mpomma mu sii fam, ɛfiri sɛ na ne dan si kuro no fasuo so, na ɔfasuo so na na ɔteɛ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkɔ bepɔ so na wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ mo no anhu mo; afei momfa mo ho nsie nnansa nkɔsi sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ mo no bɛsane aba ansa na moakɔ mo kwan.”
Na mmarima no nso ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛrenni fɔ wɔ ntam a woama yɛaka yi ho.
Hwɛ! Yɛreba asase yi so. Enti fa ahoma kɔkɔɔ yi sɛn mpomma a womaa yɛfaa mu yi ho, na ma wo papa ne wo maame ne wo nuanom ne wo papa fiefoɔ nyinaa mmɛka wo ho wɔ fie ha.
Na obiara a ɔbɛfiri fie yi mu akɔ abɔnten no, ne mogya bɛgu ne tiri so, na yɛrenni fɔ. Na obiara a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ fie ha deɛ, sɛ obi de ne nsa ka no a, ne mogya bɛba yɛn tiri so.
Na sɛ wobɔ asɛm yi so a, ɛnneɛ yɛrenni fɔ wɔ ntam a woama yɛaka yi ho.”
Ɛnna ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: “Deɛ moaka yi mmra mu saa.” Afei ɔgyaa wɔn kwan maa wɔkɔeɛ. Na ɔde ahoma kɔkɔɔ no sɛnee mpomma no ho.
Enti wɔkɔɔ bepɔ so na wɔtenaa hɔ nnansa kɔsii sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn no sane baeɛ. Na wɔhwehwɛɛ akwan no nyinaa so nanso wɔanhu wɔn.
Afei mmarima mmienu no siane firii bepɔ no so, na wɔtwaa nsuo no baa Nun ba Yosua nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkaa deɛ wɔfaa mu nyinaa kyerɛɛ no.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Awurade de asase no nyinaa ahyɛ yɛn nsa. Na yɛn nti, asase no sofoɔ nyinaa akoma aboto.”
3: Na Yosua sɔree anɔpahema; ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa tu firii Sitim kɔɔ Yordan ho; na wɔdaa hɔ maa adeɛ kyeeɛ ansa na wɔretwa.
Nnansa akyi no ahwɛfoɔ no faa nsraban no mu,
na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Sɛ mohunu sɛ Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no so Awurade mo Nyankopɔn apam adaka no a, momfiri mo atenaeɛ na monni akyire.
Nanso momma kwan bɛyɛ basafa mpem mmienu nna mo ne ne ntam; mommmɛn ho. Ɛno bɛma moahunu kwan a mobɛfa soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ momfaa kwan no so da.”
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Monyɛ mo ho kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkyena Awurade bɛyɛ anwanwadeɛ mo mu.”
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ asɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Momfa apam adaka no na monni ɔman no anim.” Enti wɔfaa apam adaka no dii ɔman no anim.
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Ɛfiri nnɛ rekorɔ mɛma wo so Israelfoɔ nyinaa anim, na wɔahunu sɛ sɛdeɛ medii Mose akyi no saa ara na mɛdi w’akyire.
Na ka kyerɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso apam adaka no sɛ, ‘Sɛ moduru Yordan nsuo no ano pɛ a, monnyina Yordan mu.’”
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: “Mommra mmɛtie Awurade mo Nyankopɔn asɛm.”
Ɛnna Yosua kaa sɛ: “Afei mobɛhunu sɛ Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no wɔ mo mu, na ɔbɛpamo Kanaanfoɔ ne Hitifoɔ ne Hiwifoɔ ne Perisifoɔ ne Girgasifoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ afiri mo anim.
Hwɛ, asase nyinaa Wura no apam adaka di mo anim rekɔ Yordan mu.
Enti monyi mmarima dumienu mfiri Israel mmusuakuo no mu, abusuakuo biara mu barima baako.
Na sɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso asase nyinaa Wura Awurade adaka no de wɔn nan si Yordan nsuo no mu pɛ a, nsuo a ɛfiri atifi no bɛtwa na agyina faako na ayɛ tadeɛ kɛseɛ.”
Na berɛ a ɔman no tu firii wɔn ntomadan mu a wɔrekɔtwa Yordan no, na asɔfoɔ no so apam adaka no di ɔman no anim.
Na ɛduru ayuo twa berɛ a na Yordan yiri fa ne kɔn so nyinaa. Na berɛ a wɔn a wɔso adaka no duruu Yordan nsuo no ano na asɔfoɔ a wɔso adaka no de wɔn nan sii nsuo no mu pɛ,

ɛnna nsuo a ɛfiri atifi reba no nyinaa bɔɔ kuo bɛgyinaa faako. Ɛyɛɛ tadeɛ kɛseɛ wɔ akyirikyiri, wɔ Adam, kuro bi a ɛbɛn Saretan. Enti nsuo a ɛsene kɔ po a ɛwɔ Araba anaa Nkyene Po no mu no twaa koraa maa ɔman no tumi twa kɔɔ Yeriko ntentensoɔ.
Na asɔfoɔ a wɔso Awurade apam adaka no gyinaa asase pɛsɛɛ so pintinn wɔ Yordan mfimfini kɔsii sɛ Israel man no nyinaa faa asase pɛsɛɛ no so twaa Yordan wieeɛ.
4: Afei berɛ a ɔman no nyinaa twaa Yordan wieeɛ no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ:
“Yi mmarima dumienu firi ɔman no mu, abusuakuo biara mu barima baako,
na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Momfa aboɔ dumienu mfiri Yordan mfimfini, baabi a na asɔfoɔ no nan sisie no, na momfa nkɔgu baabi a mobɛsoɛ anadwo yi.’”
Enti Yosua frɛɛ mmarima dumienu a ɔyii wɔn firii Israelfoɔ mu no, abusuakuo biara mu ɔbarima baako;
na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monsene nkɔdi Awurade mo Nyankopɔn apam adaka no anim nkɔ Yordan mfimfini, na obiara mfa boɔ baako nto n’abati, sɛdeɛ Israel mmusua dodoɔ teɛ,
na yei nyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne mma mo. Na sɛ da bi mo mma bisa mo sɛ, ‘Mode aboɔ yi reyɛ dɛn?’ a,
monka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Berɛ a wɔde Awurade apam adaka no kɔfaa Yordan nsuo no mu no, nsuo no twaeɛ, adaka no anim, na aboɔ yi bɛyɛ nkaeɛ ama Israelfoɔ daa.’”

Enti Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ deɛ Yosua kaeɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ, na wɔtasee aboɔ dumienu firii Yordan mfimfini, sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua no. Aboɔ no dodoɔ ne Israel mmusua no dodoɔ yɛ pɛ, na wɔde kaa wɔn ho kɔguu wɔn asoɛeɛ.
Na Yosua de aboɔ dumienu no guu Yordan mfimfini, baabi a na asɔfoɔ a wɔso apam adaka no nan sisie no, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na asɔfoɔ a wɔso adaka no kɔɔ so gyinaa Yordan mfimfini kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ ɔman no nyinaa, sɛdeɛ Mose ka kyerɛɛ Yosua no. Na ɔman no yɛɛ ntɛm twaeɛ.
Na berɛ a ɔman no nyinaa twaeɛ no, Awurade adaka no ne asɔfoɔ no twaeɛ, ɔman no anim.
Na Ruben asefoɔ ne Gad asefoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no de wɔn akodeɛ twaeɛ, Israelfoɔ no anim, sɛdeɛ Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no.
Na asraafoɔ a wɔasiesie wɔn ho ama ɛko no bɛyɛ mpem aduanan na wɔtwa faa Awurade anim kɔɔ Yeriko mpaperɛ soɔ.
Saa da no ara Awurade maa Yosua so wɔ Israelfoɔ nyinaa anim, na wɔfirii aseɛ suroo no sɛdeɛ na wɔsuro Mose no, ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ:
“Ka kyerɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso adanseɛ adaka no sɛ wɔmfiri Yordan mu.”
Enti Yosua ka kyerɛɛ asɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Momfiri Yordan mu.”
Afei berɛ a asɔfoɔ a wɔso Awurade apam adaka no firii Yordan mu baeɛ a wɔn nan kaa asase pɛsɛɛ no soɔ ara pɛ na Yordan nsuo no san baeɛ, na ɛyiri faa ne kɔn so nyinaa sɛdeɛ na ɛteɛ kane no.
Na bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so du na ɔman no firii Yordan mu, na wɔbɛsoɛɛ Gilgal wɔ Yeriko hyeɛ so wɔ apueeɛ fam.
Enti Yosua de aboɔ dumienu a wɔfa firii Yordan mu no bɛsisii Gilgal.
Na ɔtoaa so ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: “Sɛ da bi mo mma bisa wɔn papanom sɛ, ‘Aboɔ yi nso kyerɛ sɛn?’ a,
monka nkyerɛ mo mma no sɛ, ‘Israelfoɔ faa asase pɛsɛɛ so na wɔtwaa Yordan yi.
Awurade mo Nyankopɔn maa Yordan nsuo no we kɔsii sɛ wɔn nyinaa twa kɔɔ n’agya, sɛdeɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn maa Po Kɔkɔɔ no wee wɔ yɛn anim kɔsii sɛ yɛtwaeɛ no.
Na ama asase so aman nyinaa ahunu sɛ Awurade nsa yɛ den, na mo nso moasuro Awurade mo Nyankopɔn daa.’”
5: Afei berɛ a Amorifoɔ ahemfo a wɔwɔ Yordan agya wɔ atɔeɛ fam, ne Kanaanfoɔ ahemfo a wɔtete po ho no nyinaa tee sɛ Awurade maa Yordan nsuo no wee wɔ Israelfoɔ no anim kɔsii sɛ wɔn nyinaa twaeɛ no, wɔn akoma tuiɛ, na Israelfoɔ no nti wɔn ho mmoa nyinaa dwaneeɛ. Ɔman no twetiatwa ne Twam afahyɛ
Saa berɛ no ara Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Fa aboɔ a ano yɛ nnam yɛ asekan na twitwa Israelfoɔ no twetia, deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu.”
Enti Yosua de aboɔ yɛɛ asekan twitwaa Israelfoɔ no twetia wɔ Gibeat-Haaralot kokoɔ so.
Deɛ enti a Yosua twitwaa wɔn twetia ne sɛ: Mmarima a wɔfiri Egypt baeɛ a na wɔbɛtumi akɔ ko no nyinaa wuwuu kwan mu wɔ serɛ no so berɛ a wɔfiri Egypt reba no.
Wɔn a wɔfiri Egypt baeɛ no nyinaa deɛ, na wɔatwa wɔn twetia dada, nanso wɔn a wɔfiri Egypt reba a wɔwoo wɔn kwan so wɔ serɛ soɔ no nyinaa deɛ, na wɔntwaa wɔn twetia.

Israelfoɔ no nantee serɛ no so mfeɛ aduanan kɔsii sɛ ɔman no mu mmarima a wɔbɛtumi akɔ ko a wɔfiri Egypt baeɛ a wɔantie Awurade no nyinaa ase hyeeɛ. Wɔn na Awurade kaa wɔn ntam sɛ ɔremma wɔnhunu asase a Awurade kaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma yɛn no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no.
Enti ɔmaa wɔn mma bɛsii wɔn anan. Yeinom na Yosua twaa wɔn twetia, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantwa wɔn twetia wɔ kwan so.
Na berɛ a wɔtwaa ɔman no nyinaa twetia wieeɛ no, wɔtenaa wɔn asoɛeɛ hɔ kɔsii sɛ wɔn ho tɔɔ wɔn.
Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Ɛnnɛ mapia Egypt animguaseɛ nyinaa afiri mo so.” Enti wɔtoo hɔ din Gilgal, na wɔfrɛ hɔ saa de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Israelfoɔ no kɔɔ so tenaa Gilgal, na bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunan anwummerɛ no, wɔdii twam no wɔ Yeriko mpaperɛ no so.
Na berɛ a wɔdii twam no akyi na adeɛ kyeeɛ, saa da no wɔfirii aseɛ dii asase no so nnɔbaeɛ, paanoo a mmɔreka nnim ne nkyeweɛ.
Na ɛfiri da a wɔdii asase no so nnɔbaeɛ no bie no, mana no to twaeɛ, na Israelfoɔ annya mana bio. Saa afe no, wɔfirii aseɛ dii Kanaan asase no so nnɔbaeɛ no bi.
Na berɛ bi na Yosua wɔ Yeriko mpɔtamu hɔ baabi, afei ɔbɛma n’ani so a, ɔbarima bi na watwe nkrantɛ gyina n’anim yi! Ɛnna Yosua twe bɛn no bisaa no sɛ: “Hwan afa na wowɔ, yɛn anaa yɛn atamfo?”
Na ɔbarima no buaa sɛ: “Ɛnte saa, mmom maba sɛ Awurade dɔm so safohene.” Ɛnna Yosua de n’anim butuu fam bisaa no sɛ: “Asɛm bɛn na me wura wɔ ma n’akoa?”
Na Awurade safohene no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Yi wo nan ase mpaboa, ɛfiri sɛ baabi a wogyina no yɛ kronkron.” Ntɛm ara na Yosua yɛɛ saa.
6: Na Yeriko deɛ, Israelfoɔ no nti, na wɔato kuro no mu abram ano; obi nkɔ, ɛnna obi mma mu.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Hwɛ, mede Yeriko ne ne hene ne ne nnɔmmarima ahyɛ wo nsa.
Enti mmarima akofoɔ no nyinaa mmɔ nsra; ntwa kuro no ho nyinaa nhyia prɛko. Monyɛ saa nnansia.
Enti ma asɔfoɔ nson mfa nnwan mmɛn nson nni Adaka no anim. Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no mommɔ nsra ntwa kuro no ho nyinaa nhyia mprɛ nson, na asɔfoɔ no nhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no.
Na sɛ wɔhyɛne osebɔ abɛn no na mote abɛn no nnyegyeeɛ a, ɔman no nyinaa nteam dendeenden; na kuro no fasuo nyinaa bɛdwiri agu. Ɛba saa a, obiara nkɔ n’anim tee.”
Enti Nun ba Yosua frɛɛ asɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Momfa apam adaka no, na asɔfoɔ nson mfa nnwan mmɛn nson nni Awurade adaka no anim.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Monsene nkɔbɔ nsra ntwa kuro no ho nhyia, na asraafoɔ no nni Awurade adaka no anim.”
Enti ɔman no yɛɛ deɛ Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no pɛpɛɛpɛ; na asɔfoɔ nson a wɔkurakura nnwan mmɛn nson wɔ Awurade anim no bɛdii animu hyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no, na Awurade apam adaka no dii wɔn akyi.
Na asraafoɔ no di asɔfoɔ a wɔrehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no anim, na wɔn a wɔbɔ kyidɔm no nso dii Adaka no akyi berɛ a asɔfoɔ no gu so rehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no.
Na Yosua aka akyerɛ ɔman no dada sɛ: “Monnteam na mommma obi nnte mo nne, na mommmue mo ano nnka biribiara kɔsi sɛ mɛka akyerɛ mo sɛ, ‘Monteam!’ ansa na mode osebɔ ateam.”
Na ɔmaa wɔde Awurade adaka no twaa kuro no ho hyiaa prɛko, na wɔsane kɔɔ wɔn asoɛeɛ kɔda maa adeɛ kyeeɛ.
Afei Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na asɔfoɔ no soaa Awurade adaka no.

Ɛnna asɔfoɔ nson a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto nson no hyɛnee mmɛn no dii Awurade adaka no anim, na asraafoɔ no nso dii wɔn anim. Afei wɔn a wɔbɔ kyidɔm no nso dii Awurade adaka no akyi berɛ a asɔfoɔ no gu so rehyɛne ntotorobɛnto no.
Na da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no nso wɔbɔɔ nsra twa kuro no ho nyinaa hyiaa prɛko, na wɔsane kɔɔ wɔn asoɛeɛ. Wɔyɛɛ saa ara nnansia.
Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, anɔpahema a animu rebaebae no ara na wɔsɔreeɛ, na wɔkɔfaa kuro no ho saa ara mprɛ nson. Saa da no nko ara na wɔbɔɔ nsra twa kuro no ho nyinaa hyiaa mprɛ nson.
Na ɛduruu deɛ ɛtɔ so nson soɔ no, asɔfoɔ no hyɛnee mmɛn no na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Monteam; mmɔ ose, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade de kuro no ama mo.
Na kuro no nyɛ abusudeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ mosɛe no; ɛno ne biribiara a ɛwɔ mu yɛ Awurade dea. Odwamanfoɔ Rahab ne obiara a ɔka ne ho wɔ ne fie nko ara na wɔbɛka, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde nnipa a yɛsomaa wɔn no sieeɛ.
Mo nso, montwe mo ho mfiri abusudeɛ biara ho, na mo kɔn annɔ, na moamfa abusudeɛ no bi, na Israel nsraban no annane abusudeɛ na ankɔfa ɔhaw biara amma so.
Na dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ ne nneɛma a wɔde kɔbere ne dadeɛ ayɛ nyinaa yɛ Awurade akronkronneɛ. Ɛsɛ sɛ ne nyinaa kɔ Awurade adekorabea.”
Enti wɔhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no, na ɔman no de ose teaam. Berɛ a ɔman no tee abɛn no a wɔteaam dendeenden no, ɔfasuo no dwiri guu fam. Afei obiara de n’ani kyerɛɛ kuro no mu na wɔfaa kuro no.
Na wɔde nkrantɛ faa kuro no mu sɛee biribiara a ɛwɔ hɔ, mmarima ne mmaa, mmɔfra ne mpanin, anantwie ne nnwan ne mfunumu.
Ɛnna Yosua ka kyerɛɛ mmarima mmienu a wɔkɔhwɛɛ asase no sɛ: “Monkɔ ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ no fie nkɔfa ɔne wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa mmra, sɛdeɛ mokaa no ntam no.”
Enti mmarima a wɔkɔhwɛɛ kuro no kɔfaa Rahab ne ne papa ne ne maame ne ne nua mmarima ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinaa, n’abusuafoɔ nyinaa, baeɛ. Na wɔmaa wɔkɔtenaa Israelfoɔ nsraban no akyi.
Nanso wɔde gya hyee kuro no ne emu nneɛma nyinaa. Dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ ne nneɛma a wɔde kɔbere ne dadeɛ ayɛ nko ara na wɔde kɔɔ Awurade fie adekorabea.
Na Yosua koraa odwamanfoɔ Rahab ne ne papa fiefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinaa so, na ɔtenaa Israelfoɔ mu bɛsi nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde nnipa a Yosua somaa wɔn maa wɔkɔhwɛɛ Yeriko no sieeɛ.

Ɛnna Yosua kaa ntam saa berɛ no sɛ: “Nnome nka obiara a ɔbɛkyekyere Yeriko kuro yi wɔ Awurade anim. Sɛ ɔto kuro no fapem a, ɔde ne ba panin nkwa bɛtwa so, na ɔsisi n’apono a, ɔde ne ba kumaa nkwa bɛtwa so.”
Enti Awurade gyinaa Yosua akyi, na ne din trɛɛ asase no nyinaa so. Wɔkum Israelfoɔ wɔ Ai. Wɔkum Akan
7: Na berɛ a wɔkaa sɛ Israelfoɔ nsɛe abusudeɛ biara no, wɔanni nokorɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Sera a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu no ba Sabdi ba Karmi ba Akan faa nneɛma a wɔkaa sɛ wɔnsɛe no no bi. Na Awurade bo fuu Israelfoɔ no dendeenden.
Afei Yosua somaa mmarima firii Yeriko sɛ wɔnkɔ Ai a ɛbɛn Bet-Awen wɔ Betel apueeɛ fam, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monwia mo ho nkɔhwɛ sɛdeɛ asase no teɛ.” Enti mmarima no kɔhwɛɛ sɛdeɛ Ai teɛ.
Na wɔbaeɛ no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Ɛnhia sɛ woma ɔman yi nyinaa foro kɔ hɔ. Ma mmarima bɛyɛ mpem mmienu anaa mpem mmiɛnsa pɛ nkɔ Ai so. Nha ɔman no nyinaa sɛ wɔnkɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔsua.”
Enti mmarima bɛyɛ mpem mmiɛnsa (3,000) kɔɔ hɔ, nanso wɔdwane firii Ai mmarima no anim.
Na Ai mmarima no kunkum wɔn mu bɛyɛ aduasa nsia, na wɔtaa wɔn so firii kuro no ano kɔsii Sebarim, na berɛ a wɔresiane nyinaa na wɔrekunkum wɔn. Yei maa nnipa no akoma naneeɛ na ɛyɛɛ sɛ nsuo.
Enti Yosua hunuu deɛ asie no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu na ɔde n’anim butuu fam wɔ Awurade adaka no anim kɔsii anwummerɛ, ɔne Israel mpanimfoɔ no, na wɔde dɔteɛ guu wɔn tirim.
Na Yosua kaa sɛ: “Ao Awurade Nyankopɔn, adɛn nti na wode ɔman yi atwa Yordan aba ha sɛ wode yɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifoɔ nsa na wɔasɛe yɛn? Yei deɛ, sɛ yɛtenaa yɛn baabi wɔ Yordan agya nohoa a, anka ɛyɛ.
Ao Awurade, Israel na adane n’akyi akyerɛ n’atamfo yi, ɛdeɛn bio na mɛtumi aka?
Kanaanfoɔ ne asase no so nnipa nyinaa bɛte, na wɔbɛba abɛtwa yɛn ho ahyia, na wɔatwa yɛn din afiri asase so. Ɛdeɛn na wobɛyɛ de agye wo din kɛseɛ yi?”
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Sɔre! Adɛn nti na wode w’anim abutu fam?
Israel ayɛ bɔne, na wɔabu m’apam a mehyɛɛ maa wɔn no so. Na wɔafa abusudeɛ a mekaa sɛ wɔnsɛe no no bi, wɔawia bi, akata so, na wɔde akɔka wɔn nneɛma ho.
Ɛnno nti Israelfoɔ rentumi nnyina wɔn atamfo anim. Wɔn akyi na wɔbɛdane akyerɛ wɔn atamfo, ɛfiri sɛ wɔadane abusudeɛ. Enti sɛ moanyi abusudeɛ yi amfiri mo mfimfini ansɛe no a, merenni mo akyi.

Sɔre! Te ɔman no ho na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Monte mo ho ɔkyena, na sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade seɛ nie: “O Israel, abusudeɛ bi wɔ wo mfimfini. Sɛ moanyi abusudeɛ yi amfiri mo mu a, morentumi nnyina mo atamfo anim.

Na ɔkyena anɔpa mmusuakuo mmusuakuo a ɛwɔ Israel nyinaa mmra mmaako mmaako, na abusuakuo a Awurade bɛyie no, emu mmusua nso mmra mmaako mmaako. Afei abusua a Awurade bɛyie no mu afie mmra mmaako mmaako. Na efie a Awurade bɛyie no mu mmarima nso mmra mmaako mmaako.
Na deɛ ɔbɛyi no sɛ ɔno na abusudeɛ no wɔ ne nkyɛn no, wɔmfa gya nhye ɔne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ wabu Awurade apam so ayɛ aniwudeɛ wɔ Israel.”’”
Enti Yosua sɔree anɔpahema frɛɛ mmusuakuo a ɛwɔ Israel nyinaa baa mmaako mmaako, na wɔyii Yuda abusuakuo no.
Afei ɔmaa Yuda abusuakuo no mu mmusua nyinaa baa mmaako mmaako, na wɔyii Sera abusua no. Na ɔmaa Sera abusua no mu mmarima baa mmaako mmaako, na wɔyii Sabdi.
Awieeɛ koraa no ɔmaa ne fie mmarima baa mmaako mmaako, na Sera a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu no ba Sabdi ba Karmi ba Akan na wɔyii no.
Afei Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Akan sɛ: “Me ba, hyɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade animuonyam na ka wo bɔne kyerɛ me. Ɛdeɛn na woyɛeɛ? Ka kyerɛ me, mfa hwee nsie me.”
Ɛnna Akan buaa Yosua sɛ: “Nokwasɛm nie, mayɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade bɔne, na deɛ meyɛeɛ nie:

Mehunuu atadeɛ fɛfɛ bi a ɛfiri Sinar ne dwetɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu ne sika kɔkɔɔ a emu duro yɛ nnwetɛbena aduonum wɔ asadeɛ no mu, na na m’ani gye ho enti mefaeɛ. Na mede asie fam me ntomadan mu, na sika no hyɛ aseɛ.”
Ɛnna Yosua somaa nnipa ntɛm kɔɔ ntomadan no mu, na ampa ara na ɔde sika no ahyɛ nneɛma no ase de asie ne ntomadan mu.
Enti wɔyi firii ntomadan no mu de brɛɛ Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no nyinaa, na wɔde bɛguu Awurade anim.

Afei Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa de Sera ba Akan ne dwetɛ ne atadeɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ no ne ne mma mmarima ne ne mma mmaa ne n’anantwie ne ne mfunumu ne ne nnwan ne ne ntomadan ne biribiara a ɔwɔ baa Akor bɔn mu.
Na Yosua kaa sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wode mmusuo aba yɛn soɔ yi? Awurade nso de mmusuo bɛba wo so nnɛ.” Ɔkaa saa no, Israelfoɔ nyinaa sii no aboɔ, na akyire yi wɔde gya hyee wɔn. Enti wɔsii wɔn aboɔ.
Na wɔsoaa aboɔ guu ne so maa no bɛyɛɛ esie kɛseɛ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ. Afei Awurade bo dwoeɛ. Enti wɔtoo hɔ din Akor Bɔn, na wɔfrɛ hɔ saa de bɛsi nnɛ.
8: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Nsuro na mmɔ hu. Fa asraafoɔ no nyinaa ka wo ho na monkɔ Ai, na mede Ai hene ne ne man ne ne kuro ne n’asase ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na yɛ Ai ne ne hene sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Yeriko ne ne hene no. Nanso kuro yi mu mmoa ne asadeɛ a aka deɛ, momfa. Ma nnipa bi nkɔtɛ kuro no akyi baabi.”
Enti Yosua ne asraafoɔ no nyinaa sɔre de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Ai, na Yosua yii mmarima akokoɔdurofoɔ mpem aduasa, na ɔgyaa wɔn kwan anadwo no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monkɔtɛ kuro no akyi. Monhwɛ na mo ne kuro no ntam antwe pii, na obiara nyɛ krado.
Me nso me ne nnipa a aka no nyinaa bɛtwe abɛn kuro no. Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔpue bɛhyia yɛn sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ kane no a, yɛbɛdwane afiri wɔn anim.
Ɛba saa a wɔbɛfiri adi ati yɛn akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwe wɔn afiri kuro no mu, na wɔbɛka sɛ, ‘Wɔredwane sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ kane no.’ Na yɛn nso yɛbɛdwane afiri wɔn anim.
Afei mobɛfiri faako a mokɔtɛeɛ no abɔ awura kuro no mu; na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de bɛhyɛ mo nsa.
Na sɛ mofa kuro no a, momfa gya ntom, na monyɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade aka no ara. Yei ne akwankyerɛ a mepɛ sɛ modi soɔ.”
Ɛnna Yosua gyaa wɔn kwan maa wɔkɔtɛɛ Betel ne Ai ntam wɔ Ai atɔeɛ fam. Na Yosua daa nnipa a aka no nkyɛn anadwo no.
Na Yosua sɔree anɔpahema boaboaa ɔman no ano, na ɔne Israel mpanimfoɔ dii wɔn anim foro kɔɔ Ai.
Afei asraafoɔ a wɔka ne ho no foro kɔɔ kuro no anim kɔsoɛɛ Ai atifi fam, na na bɔn da wɔne Ai ntam.
Enti Yosua yii mmarima bɛyɛ mpemnum sɛ wɔnkɔtɛ Betel ne Ai ntam, wɔ kuro no atɔeɛ fam.
Na asraafoɔ no mu fa kɛseɛ kɔsoɛɛ kuro no atifi fam, na ebinom nso kɔtɛɛ atɔeɛ fam, na Yosua kɔɔ bɔn no mu anadwo no.
Na berɛ a Ai hene hunuu saa no, ɔne ne man nyinaa, kuro no mu mmarima, sɔree ntɛm sɛ wɔne Israelfoɔ no rekɔko wɔ serɛ no so wɔ mpaperɛ a wɔahyɛ mu. Nanso na ɔnnim sɛ ebinom akɔtɛ kuro no akyi.
Na Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no nyinaa yɛɛ wɔn ho sɛ deɛ wɔadi nkoguo, na wɔdwane de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ serɛ no so.
Ɛnna wɔteaa mu frɛɛ nnipa a Ai wɔwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa maa wɔtii wɔn; enti wɔfirii kuro no mu bɛtii Yosua.
Na ɔbarima biara anka Ai ne Betel a wankɔdi Israelfoɔ no akyire. Enti wɔgyaa kuro no ano too hɔ hahraa kɔtii Israelfoɔ no.
Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Tene pea a wokura no kyerɛ Ai so, ɛfiri sɛ mede bɛhyɛ wo nsa.” Enti Yosua tenee pea a ɔkura no kyerɛɛ kuro no so.
Na berɛ a ɔtenee ne nsa no ara na wɔn a wɔakɔtɛ kuro no akyi no de mmirika bɔ wuraa kuro no mu. Na ntɛm ara na wɔde gya too kuro no mu.

Na berɛ a Ai mmarima no danee wɔn ani hwɛɛ wɔn akyi no, wɔhunuu sɛ wisie firi kuro no mu ayɛ wiem kumɔnn, na na wɔntumi nnwane nkɔ benkum anaa nifa. Afei wɔn a wɔredwane kɔ serɛ soɔ no dane baa wɔn ataafoɔ no so.
Enti berɛ a Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no nyinaa hunuu sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔtɛeɛ no akɔfa kuro no na kuro no mu wisie ayɛ wiem kumɔnn no, wɔsanee wɔn akyi bɛto hyɛɛ Ai mmarima no so kunkum wɔn.
Na wɔn a wɔwɔ kuro no mu no nso bɛhyiaa wɔn. Enti na Israelfoɔ no fa wɔ wɔn anim ne wɔn akyi, na wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ mfimfini kunkum wɔn nyinaa. Onipa baako mpo anka, na obiara nso antumi annwane.
Nanso Ai hene deɛ, wɔkyeree no animono brɛɛ Yosua.
Na berɛ a Israelfoɔ kunkum Aifoɔ a wɔdii wɔn akyi kɔɔ serɛ soɔ na wɔn nyinaa totɔɔ nkrantɛ ano maa wɔsaeɛ no, Israelfoɔ nyinaa sane kɔɔ Ai twee nkrantɛ too kuro no so kumkum wɔn.
Na da no, mmarima ne mmaa a wɔwuwuiɛ nyinaa yɛ mpem dumienu (12,000), Aifoɔ nyinaa.
Na Yosua amfa ne nsa a ɔde tenee pea no anto hɔ kɔsii sɛ ɔsɛee Aifoɔ nyinaa pasapasa.
Kuro no mu mmoa ne asadeɛ foforɔ a aka na Israelfoɔ faeɛ, sɛdeɛ ahyɛdeɛ a Awurade de maa Yosua no teɛ.
Enti Yosua hyee Ai dwerɛbee maa no danee daa amamfo sie de bɛsi nnɛ.

Na ɔsɛnee Ai hene no wɔ dua so kɔsii anwummerɛ, na berɛ a awia kɔtɔeɛ no, Yosua maa wɔyii ne funu firii dua no so kɔtoo kuro no pono ano, na wɔsoaa aboɔ pii guu ne so maa no yɛɛ esie kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ. Yosua si afɔrebukyia, na ɔtwerɛ mmara no gu aboɔ so
Na Yosua sii afɔrebukyia wɔ Bepɔ Ebal so maa Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn,

sɛdeɛ Awurade akoa Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔatwerɛ ho asɛm wɔ Mose mmara nwoma mu no sɛ: “Aboɔ amuamu a dadeɛ nkaeɛ na momfa nsi afɔrebukyia no.” Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ so maa Awurade.
Na ɔtwerɛɛ mmara a Mose twerɛɛ no Israelfoɔ anim no ntimu guu aboɔ no so.

Afei Israelfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no mu mpanimfoɔ ne atitire ne atemmufoɔ, ahɔhoɔ ne kuromma nyinaa bɛgyinagyinaa Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ a wɔso Awurade apam adaka no anim, wɔ Adaka no benkum ne nifa so. Na nnipa no fa gyinaa Bepɔ Gerisim anim na ɛfa nso gyinaa Bepɔ Ebal anim maa wɔdii kan hyiraa Israelfoɔ, sɛdeɛ Awurade akoa Mose hyɛɛ wɔn no.
Ɛno akyi no, ɔkenkanee mmara no mu nsɛm nyinaa, nhyira ne nnome, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara nwoma no mu no.
Deɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu asɛm biara nni hɔ a Yosua ankenkan ankyerɛ Israel asafo no nyinaa ne mmaa ne mmɔfra nkumaa ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔwɔ wɔn mu nyinaa anim. Gibeonfoɔ ne Yosua yɛ apam
9: Ɛbae sɛ berɛ a ahemfo a wɔwɔ Yordan agya wɔ bepɔ so ne Sefela ne Po Kɛseɛ no ano wɔ Lebanon anim, Hitifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hiwifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ tee deɛ asie no,
wɔka boom yɛɛ nokorɔ sɛ wɔne Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no rebɛko.
Na Gibeonfoɔ nso tee deɛ Yosua de yɛɛ Yeriko ne Ai no,
wɔn deɛ, wɔyɛɛ wɔn adeɛ nyansam mu. Na wɔfaa akwansoduane ne nkotokuo dada ne nsa kotokuo a ateteɛ a wɔapempam guu wɔn mfunumu so.
Afei wɔhyehyɛɛ mpaboa a ahi a wɔapempam ne ntadeɛ agoago, na paanoo a wɔfaeɛ nyinaa akyenkyene na ɛfurofuro.
Na wɔkɔɔ Yosua nkyɛn asoɛeɛ hɔ wɔ Gilgal, na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔne Israel mmarima no sɛ: “Yɛfiri akyirikyiri asase so na yɛreba. Enti mo ne yɛn nyɛ apam.”
Ɛnna Israel mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ Hiwifoɔ no sɛ: “Ebia yɛn mpɔtamu ha yi ara na moteɛ. Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛne mo ayɛ apam?”
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Yɛyɛ wo nkoa.” Ɛnna Yosua bisaa wɔn sɛ: “Moyɛ nnipa bɛn, na mofiri he?”
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo nkoa firi akyirikyiri paa na yɛaba, Awurade mo Nyankopɔn din nti; yɛate ne nka ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ no Egypt nyinaa,
ne deɛ ɔde yɛɛ Amorifoɔ ahemfo a na wɔtete Yordan agya nohoa no, Hesbon hene Sihon ne Basan hene Og a na ɔte Astarot no.
Enti yɛn mpanimfoɔ ne ɔmanfoɔ no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ, ‘Momfa akwansoduane na monkɔhyia wɔn nka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ: “Yɛyɛ mo nkoa. Enti mo ne yɛn nyɛ apam.’”
Monhwɛ yɛn paanoo yi; da a yɛresim aba mo nkyɛn a yɛfa firii yɛn afie sɛ akwansoduane no, na ɛyɛ hye, nanso seesei akyenkyene na ɛfurofuro.
Na nsa nkotokuo yi nso, na ɛyɛ foforɔ koraa, nanso monhwɛ sɛ ateteɛ. Na kwan no tenten nti, yɛn ntadeɛ ne yɛn mpaboa nso atete.”
Ɛnna Israel mmarima no faa akwansoduane no bi ka hwɛeɛ, na Awurade anom asɛm deɛ wɔammisa.
Enti Yosua ne wɔn dii no asomdwoeɛ so na ɔne wɔn yɛɛ apam sɛdeɛ wɔbɛnya wɔn tiri adidi mu. Enti asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ no kekaa wɔn ntam.
Na wɔne wɔn yɛɛ apam no wieeɛ no, nnansa akyi na wɔtee sɛ nkurɔfoɔ no te bɛn wɔn na wɔte wɔn mpɔtamu hɔ ara.
Afei Israelfoɔ no tuiɛ, na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wɔkɔduruu wɔn nkuro mu. Nkuro no ne Gibeon, Kefira, Beerot ne Kiriat-Yearim.
Na Israelfoɔ no amfa wɔn nsa anka wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ na asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ de Israel Awurade Nyankopɔn din aka wɔn ntam. Afei asafo no nyinaa firii aseɛ nwiinwii tiaa mpanimfoɔ no.
Na mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ asafo no sɛ: “Yɛde Israel Awurade Nyankopɔn din aka wɔn ntam, enti yɛrentumi mfa yɛn nsa nka wɔn.
Yei na yɛbɛyɛ wɔn na yɛama wɔatena ase na ntam a yɛaka wɔn no ho nnome biara amma yɛn so.”

Enti mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnyaa wɔn mma wɔntena ase na wɔnkɔ anyina ne nsuo mma asafo no nyinaa [kyerɛ sɛ: wɔn na wɔbɛkɔ akɔ bubu gya abrɛ yɛn na nsu kɔ nso wɔn na wɔbɛkorɔ], sɛdeɛ mpanimfoɔ ahyɛ wɔn bɔ no.”
Ɛnna Yosua frɛɛ wɔn ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Adɛn nti na modaadaa yɛn kaa sɛ, ‘Yɛne mo ntam kwan ware yie,’ berɛ a mote yɛn mpɔtamu ha yi ara?
Enti afei wɔadome mo, na mo nkwa nna nyinaa mobɛyɛ nkoa wɔ me Nyankopɔn fie, na morennyae anyina ne nsukorɔ da.”

Ɛnna wɔbuaa Yosua sɛ: “Asɛm no ne sɛ wo nkoa tee sɛ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn aka akyerɛ n’akoa Mose sɛ ɔmfa asase yi nyinaa mma mo na monsɛe asase no sofoɔ nyinaa mfiri mo anim, na mo nti, na yɛsuro paa ma yɛn kra. Ɛno nti na yɛyɛɛ saa no.
Na afei yɛnie, yɛwɔ mo nsam. Deɛ ɛyɛ na ɛtene mo ani soɔ biara momfa nyɛ yɛn.”
Na Yosua yɛɛ wɔn saa gyee wɔn firii Israelfoɔ no nsam, na wɔanku wɔn.
Enti da no Yosua yɛɛ wɔn anyina ne nsuo kɔfoɔ maa asafo no ne Awurade afɔrebukyia no, baabi a ɔbɛkyerɛ biara, de bɛsi nnɛ.
10: Afei berɛ a Yerusalem hene Adoni-Sedek tee sɛ Yosua ako afa Ai, na wasɛe Ai ne ne hene sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ Yeriko ne ne hene, na Gibeonfoɔ ne Israel akɔyɛ asomdwoeɛ apam na wɔne wɔn teɛ no,
ehu kaa no paa ɛfiri sɛ na Gibeon yɛ kuro kɛseɛ te sɛ nhenkuro no bi. Bio nso na ɛso sene Ai koraa, na emu mmarima ho yɛ den.
Enti Yerusalem hene Adoni-Sedek soma kɔɔ Hebron hene Hoham ne Yamut hene Piram ne Lakis hene Yafia ne Eglon hene Debir nkyɛn sɛ,
“Mommɛboa me mma yɛnsɛe Gibeon ɛfiri sɛ wɔne Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no akɔyɛ asomdwoeɛ apam.”
Enti Amorifoɔ ahemfo nnum no kaa wɔn ho boom, Yerusalem hene ne Hebron hene ne Yarmut hene ne Lakis hene ne Eglon hene ne wɔn dɔm nyinaa, na wɔboaa wɔn ano sɛ wɔbɛkɔ Gibeon so ne wɔn akɔko.
Ɛnna Gibeonfoɔ soma kɔka kyerɛɛ Yosua wɔ Gilgal sɛ: “Yɛ ntɛm bɛboa wo nkoa na gye yɛn. Mma wo nsa nnyɛ tia, ɛfiri sɛ Amorifoɔ ahemfo a wɔte mmepɔ soɔ no aboaboa wɔn ano ne yɛn rebɛko.”
Enti Yosua ne asraafoɔ ne nnɔmmarima a wɔka ne ho nyinaa firi Gilgal kɔeɛ.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Nsuro wɔn na mede wɔn ahyɛ wo nsa. Wɔn mu biara rentumi nnyina w’anim.”
Afei Yosua baa wɔn so mpofirem. Ɔde anadwo mu no nyinaa na ɛfiri Gilgal baeɛ.
Na Awurade maa wɔn ani tanee wɔ Israelfoɔ no anim, na wɔde nkrantɛ kunkum dɔm kɛseɛ wɔ Gibeon. Na wɔtii wɔn faa Bet-Horon aforoeɛ, na wɔkunkum wɔn bɛduruu Aseka ne Makeda.

Na berɛ a wɔredwane afiri Israelfoɔ anim, na wɔresiane Bet-Horon no, Awurade maa aboɔ akɛseɛ firii soro bɛkunkum wɔn kɔduruu Aseka. Na wɔn a asukɔtweaa no kunkum wɔn no dɔɔso sene wɔn a Israelfoɔ de nkrantɛ kunkum wɔn no. Owia ne ɔsrane di Yosua asɛm so
Da a Awurade de Amorifoɔ hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ nsa no, Yosua ne Awurade kasaeɛ, na ɔkaa no Israelfoɔ nyinaa anim sɛ: Na bosome, gyina wɔ Aiyalon bonhwa mu.”
Enti awia gyinaeɛ, na bosome nso gyinaeɛ kɔsii sɛ ɔman no tuaa n’atamfo ka. Wɔntwerɛɛ yei ho asɛm wɔ Yasar nwoma mu anaa? Awia gyinaa wiem, na ampere ne ho ankɔtɔ bɛyɛ da mu nyinaa.
Da yi nsɛsoɔ mmaa da n’anim oo, n’akyi oo, ebi nsii da, sɛ Awurade atie onipa nne wɔ saa kwan yi soɔ. Saa da no, na Awurade no ara reko ama Israel.
Afei Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa sane baa wɔn asoɛeɛ wɔ Gilgal.
Na saa berɛ yi na ahemfo nnum no adwane akɔhyɛ ɔbodan mu wɔ Makeda.
Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ bɛka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Wɔahunu sɛ ahemfo nnum no adwane akɔhyɛ ɔbodan mu wɔ Makeda.”
Na Yosua kaa sɛ: “Mompia aboɔ akɛseɛ nkata ɔbodan no ano na momma mmarima nwɛn wɔn.
Na mo nso monnnyina faako. Monti mo atamfo no nkunkum wɔn. Mommma wɔnnkɔ wɔn kurom, na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de wɔn ahyɛ mo nsa.”
Afei berɛ a Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no kunkum nkurɔfoɔ no maa wɔn nyinaa saeɛ, na wɔn a wɔnyaa wɔn tiri didii mu no dwane kɔɔ nkuro a wɔatoto ho afasuo mu no,
ɔman no nyinaa sane baa Yosua nkyɛn asomdwoeɛ mu wɔ Makeda, wɔn asoɛeɛ hɔ. Na obiara antwe ne kɛtrɛma mpo antia Israelfoɔ no [Kyerɛ sɛ: obiara ankasa antia Israelfoɔ no].
Ɛnna Yosua kaa sɛ: “Mommue ɔbodan no ano na monyi ahemfo nnum a wɔhyɛhyɛ hɔ no mmrɛ me.”
Na wɔyɛɛ deɛ ɔkaeɛ no, na wɔyii ahemfo nnum yi firii ɔbodan no mu brɛɛ no: Yerusalem hene, Hebron hene, Yarmut hene, Lakis hene, ne Eglon hene.

Berɛ a wɔde ahemfo yi brɛɛ Yosua no, ɔfrɛɛ Israel mmarima nyinaa na ɔka kyerɛɛ asraafoɔ mpanimfoɔ a wɔne no kɔeɛ no sɛ: “Mommra. Momfa mo nan nsisi ahemfo yi kɔn so.” Na wɔbaeɛ de wɔn nan bɛsisii wɔn kɔn so.
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monnsuro na mommmɔ hu. Momma mo bo nyɛ duru na mo ho nyɛ den, na sei na Awurade bɛyɛ mo atamfo a mo ne wɔn redi ako no nyinaa.”
Ɛno akyi no Yosua kunkum wɔn, na ɔde wɔn sensɛnee nnua nnum so kɔsii anwummerɛ.
Na berɛ a awia kɔtɔeɛ no, Yosua maa wɔyii wɔn firii nnua no so, na wɔkɔtoo wɔn guu ɔbodan a wɔkɔhyɛɛ mu no mu. Na wɔde aboɔ akɛseɛ guu ɔbodan no ano de bɛsi nnɛ.

Na saa da no, Yosua faa Makeda, na ɔtwee nkrantɛ too kuro no so, na ɔkum ɔhene no ne nnipa a wɔwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa. Wannya obiara wɔ hɔ. Na sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ Yeriko hene no, saa ara na ɔyɛɛ Makeda hene nso.
Afei Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa firii Makeda kɔɔ Libna ne Libnafoɔ kɔkoeɛ.
Na Awurade de kuro no ne emu hene hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wɔtwee nkrantɛ wɔ kuro no so kunkum akra a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa. Wɔannya obiara. Na sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ Yeriko hene no, saa ara na wɔyɛɛ kurom hɔ hene no nso.
Ɛno akyi no, Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa firii Libna kɔɔ Lakis, na wɔboaa wɔn ho ano ne wɔn kɔkoeɛ.
Na Awurade de Lakis hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, wɔfaa kuro no. Afei wɔtwee nkrantɛ wɔ kuro no so kunkum nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ Libna no.
Na Geser hene Horam hunuu saa no, ɔkɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔboa Lakis. Enti Yosua kuu ɔne ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, na wannya obiara.
Ɛnna Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa firii Lakis kɔɔ Eglon, na wɔboaa wɔn ho ano ne wɔn kɔkoeɛ.
Na wɔfaa kuro no saa da no. Na wɔtwee nkrantɛ too so kunkum nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa saa da no, sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ Lakis no.
Enti Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa firii Eglon kɔɔ Hebron ne wɔn kɔkoeɛ.
Na wɔfaa kuro no ne ne nkuraa nyinaa, na wɔtwee nkrantɛ wɔ so. Na wɔkum ɔhene no ne nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa. Wannya obiara, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ Eglon no. Enti ɔsɛee kuro no ne nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa.
Akyire yi Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa sane baa Debir ne wɔn bɛkoeɛ.

Na ɔfaa kuro no ne ɛhɔ hene ne nkuraa a ɛwowɔ hɔ nyinaa. Na wɔtwee nkrantɛ wɔ so kunkum nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa. Wannya obiara. Na sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ Hebron ne Libna ne ne hene no, saa ara na ɔyɛɛ Debir ne ne hene.
Enti Yosua sɛee nsase a ɛwɔ mmepɔ so ne Negeb ne Sefela ne nkokoɔ ase no nyinaa, na ɔkunkum wɔn ahemfo nyinaa. Wannya obiara. Ɔsɛee biribiara a ɛhome sɛdeɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade hyɛeɛ no.
Na Yosua de nkrantɛ faa asase no nyinaa so firii Kades-Barnea kɔsii Gasa, ne Gosen asase nyinaa de kɔpem Gibeon.
Na Yosua faa ahemfo yi nyinaa ne wɔn nsase prɛko, ɛfiri sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade ko maa Israel.
Afei Yosua ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa sane kɔɔ wɔn asoɛeɛ wɔ Gilgal.
11: Na berɛ a Hasor hene Yabin tee deɛ asie no, ɔsoma kɔɔ Madon hene Yobab, ne Simron hene, ne Aksaf hene,
na ɔde nkra kɔmaa ahemfo a wɔwɔ atifi fam mmepɔ soɔ, ne ɛserɛ so wɔ Kinerot anafoɔ fam, ne Sefela, ne Dor bepɔ so wɔ atɔeɛ fam,
ne Kanaanfoɔ a wɔwɔ apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ, ne Amorifoɔ, ne Hitifoɔ, ne Perisifoɔ, ne Yebusifoɔ a wɔwɔ mmepɔ soɔ, ne Hiwifoɔ a wɔwɔ Hermon ase wɔ Mispa asase soɔ no nkyɛn.
Enti wɔne wɔn dɔm huhaa te sɛ mpoano anwea ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam bebree pa firi baeɛ.
Na berɛ a wɔhyɛeɛ no duruiɛ no, ahemfo no nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano wɔ Merom asuo ho sɛ wɔne Israel rebɛko.
Nanso Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Nsuro wɔn, na ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ mɛma wɔn nyinaa atotɔ Israelfoɔ nsa ano. Twitwa wɔn apɔnkɔ nantin na fa gya hye wɔn nteaseɛnam.”
Na Yosua ne asraafoɔ no nyinaa faa Merom asuo ho bɛto hyɛɛ wɔn so prɛko pɛ.
Enti Awurade de wɔn hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no nsa, na wɔtii wɔn kɔkunkum wɔn kɔduruu Sidon kɛseɛ ne Misrefot-Maim ne Mispa asasetamaa so wɔ atɔeɛ fam. Wɔkunkum wɔn nyinaa, na baako mpo anka.
Na deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua no, saa pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɔde yɛɛ wɔn: Ɔtwitwaa wɔn apɔnkɔ no nantin, na ɔde gya hyee wɔn nteaseɛnam.
Afei Yosua danee ne ho saa berɛ no bɛfaa Hasor, na ɔde nkrantɛ kum ɛhɔ hene, ɛfiri sɛ na Hasor ne ahemman yi nyinaa ti.
Na wɔde nkrantɛ kunkum nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinaa tɔree wɔn ase. Wɔannya biribiara a ɛhome wɔ hɔ, na ɔde gya hyee Hasor.
Na Yosua faa nhenkuro a ɛwowɔ hɔ ne emu ahemfo nyinaa, na ɔde nkrantɛ kunkum wɔn. Ɔsɛee wɔn pasaa, sɛdeɛ Awurade akoa Mose kaeɛ no.
Nanso nkuro a ɛgugu nkokoɔ soɔ no deɛ, Israel anhye, gye Hasor na Yosua hyeeɛ.
Na Israelfoɔ no faa nkuro no mu afieboa ne asadeɛ a aka nyinaa. Nnipa no deɛ, wɔde nkrantɛ kunkum wɔn nyinaa tɔree wɔn ase. Obiara a ɔhome biara nni hɔ a wɔmaa no kaeɛ.
Na sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ n’akoa Mose no, saa ara na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Yosua, na saa ara nso na Yosua yɛeɛ. Wanyi asɛm baako mpo amfiri deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose no mu.
Enti Yosua faa asase yi nyinaa, mmepɔ no ne Negeb ne Gosen asase nyinaa, ne Sefela ne Araba ne Israel mmepɔ ne ɛhɔ asase tratra,
ɛfiri Bepɔ Halak a animu kyerɛ Seir kɔsi Baal-Gad a ɛwɔ Lebanon asasetamaa so wɔ Bepɔ Hermon ase, na ɔkyeree wɔn ahemfo nyinaa kunkum wɔn.
Yosua ne ahemfo yi nyinaa koo nna pii.
Kuro biara nni hɔ a wɔne Israelfoɔ yɛɛ asomdwoeɛ apam, gye Hiwifoɔ a wɔte Gibeon no. Wɔn a aka no deɛ, ɛko mu na wɔfaa wɔn.
Awurade na ɔmaa wɔpirim wɔn akoma sɛ wɔne Israelfoɔ bɛko na wasɛe wɔn a ahummɔborɔ biara nnim, na watɔre wɔn ase sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose no.
Saa berɛ no nso, Yosua kɔkunkum Anakimfoɔ a wɔwɔ mmepɔ soɔ, Hebron ne Debir ne Anab ne Yuda ne Israel mmepɔ so nyinaa. Yosua sɛee wɔne wɔn nkuro no nyinaa.
Wannya Anakimni biara wɔ Israelfoɔ asase so, gye Gasa ne Gat ne Asdod na ebi kaeɛ.

Enti Yosua faa nsase no nyinaa sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ Mose bɔ no, na Yosua kyɛ maa Israelfoɔ no sɛ wɔn kyɛfa, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Ɛfiri saa berɛ no, ɛko anha asase no bio. Nsase a Mose faeɛ no so ahemfo baanu ho asɛm
12: Na yeinom ne asase no so ahemfo a Israelfoɔ no dii wɔn so nkunim faa wɔn nsase wɔ Yordan agya apueeɛ fam, ɛfiri Arnon subɔn no ho kɔsi Bepɔ Hermon ne Araba nyinaa wɔ apueeɛ fam no:
Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a na ɔte Hesbon no. Ɔdii hene faa Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon subɔn ho ne subɔn no mfimfini ne Gilead asase no fa kɔsii Yabok subɔn ho wɔ Ammonfoɔ hyeɛ so,
ne Araba kɔsii Kinerot mpoano wɔ apueeɛ fam, ne po a ɛwɔ Araba anaa Nkyene Po no ano wɔ apueeɛ, Bet-Yesimot kwan so, de kɔɔ anafoɔ wɔ Pisga bepɔ ase;
ne Basan hene Og. Ɔno ne Refaimni na ɔfiri abrane akɛseɛ no mu a waka, na ɔtenaa Astarot ne Edrei.
Na ɔdii hene wɔ Bepɔ Hermon so ne Saleka ne Basan nyinaa kɔsii Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ hyeɛ so ne Gilead asase no fa kɔpem Hesbon hene Sihon asase so.
Awurade akoa Mose ne Israelfoɔ no dii wɔn so, na ɛno akyi no Awurade akoa Mose de asase no maa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo no fa no.

Ahemfo yi nso na Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no dii wɔn so nkunim wɔ Yordan atɔeɛ fam, firi Baal-Gad a ɛwɔ Lebanon asasetamaa no mu kɔsi Bepɔ Halak a animu kyerɛ Seir no ho. Ɛno akyi na Yosua kyɛɛ asase no maa Israelfoɔ mmusua no sɛ wɔn kyɛfa,
mmepɔ so nsase ne Sefela ne Araba ne mmepɔ ase ne serɛ so ne Negeb. Ɛha na na Hitifoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ ne Hiwifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ no teɛ. Ahemfo yi nie:
Yeriko hene ne Ai a ɛbɛn Betel no hene;
Yerusalem hene ne Hebron hene;
Yamut hene ne Lakis hene;
Eglon hene ne Geser hene;
Debir hene ne Geder hene;
Horma hene ne Arad hene;
Libna hene ne Adulam hene;
Makeda hene ne Betel hene;
Tapua hene ne Hefer hene;
Afek hene ne Lasaron hene;
Madon hene ne Hasor hene;
Simron-Meron hene ne Aksaf hene;
Taanak hene ne Megido hene;
Kedes hene ne Yokneam a ɛwɔ Karmel no hene;
Dor a ɛwɔ Dor bepɔ soɔ no hene, ne Goiim a ɛwɔ Gilgal no hene;
ne Tirsa hene. Ahemfo no nyinaa yɛ aduasa baako. Onyankopɔn hyɛ Yosua sɛ ɔnkyekyɛ asase no mu
13: Saa berɛ yi na Yosua mfeɛ akɔ animu na wabɔ akora. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo mfeɛ akɔ animu na woabɔ akora, nanso asase a aka a ɛsɛ sɛ wofa no dɔɔso bebree.
Asase a aka nie: Filistifoɔ ne Gesurfoɔ mpɔtamu hɔ nyinaa,
wɔbu Sihor fa a ɛda Egypt anim kɔsi Ekron hyeɛ so wɔ atifi fam no sɛ Kanaanfoɔ asase; Filistifoɔ ahemfo nnum dii nkuro yi so, Gasa, Asdod, Askelon, Gat, Ekron, ne Awim.
Anafoɔ fam nso, wobɛfa Kanaanfoɔ asase nyinaa; ne Meara a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ asase akɔsi Afek, na ɛbɛkɔ akɔpem Amorifoɔ hyeɛ so;
ne Gebalfoɔ asase ne Lebanon nyinaa wɔ apueeɛ, firi Baal-Gad wɔ Bepɔ Hermon ase de akɔsi Hamat;

wɔn a wɔtete mmepɔ no soɔ nyinaa, ɛfiri Lebanon kɔ Misrefot-Maim, kyerɛ sɛ Sidonfoɔ nyinaa. Na me ara mɛtu wɔn afiri wɔn asase so ama Israelfoɔ. Nanso hwɛ sɛ wode bɛka Israel agyapadeɛ ho, sɛdeɛ maka akyerɛ woɔ no.
Na afei kyɛ asase no ma mmusua nkron no ne Manase abusuakuo fa no.”
Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne abusuakuo no fa a aka no kɔfaa asase a Mose de maa wɔn Yordan agya wɔ apueeɛ fam no, sɛdeɛ na Awurade akoa Mose atwa ama wɔn dada no,
ɛfiri Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon Bɔn ano ne kuro a ɛwɔ bɔn no mfimfini ne Medeba asase tratra no so de kɔsi Dibon;
ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdii adeɛ wɔ Hesbon no nkuro nyinaa, kɔsi Ammonfoɔ hyeɛ so;
ne Gilead, ne Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ nsase nyinaa, ne Bepɔ Hermon ne Basan nyinaa de kɔsi Saleka;
ne Og a ɔdii adeɛ wɔ Astarot ne Edrei no ahemman a ɛwɔ Basan nyinaa. Og na na waka wɔ Refaimfoɔ (abrane akɛseɛ) no mu. Na Mose kunkum wɔn faa wɔn asase.
Nanso Israelfoɔ amfa Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ nsase; mmom Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ te Israelfoɔ mu de bɛsi nnɛ.
Lewi abusuakuo no nko ara na wamma wɔn agyapadeɛ. Egya afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade no ne wɔn agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ wɔn bɔ no. Yordan apueeɛ fam asase yɛ mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no dea
Na Mose maa Ruben asefoɔ nyaa wɔn asase, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Na wɔn asase no firi Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon Bɔn ano ne kuro a ɛwɔ Bɔn no mfimfini ne Medeba asase tratra no so nyinaa;
ne Hesbon ne ɛho nkuro a ɛwɔ asase tratra no soɔ nyinaa, Dibon ne Bamot-Baal ne Bet-Baal-Meon,
ne Yahas ne Kedemot ne Mefaat,
ne Kiriataim ne Sibma ne Seret-Saha wɔ asasetamaa no bepɔ so,
ne Bet-Peor ne Pisga bepɔ ase ne Bet-Yesimot,

ne nkuro a na ɛwɔ asase tratra no soɔ ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdii adeɛ wɔ Hesbon no ahemman nyinaa. Mose kum ɔne Midian atitire yi nyinaa: Ewi ne Rekem ne Sur ne Hur ne Reba. Yeinom ne Sihon aberempɔn a na wɔwɔ asase no soɔ.
Na Israelfoɔ de nkrantɛ kum Beor ba Balaam, nkɔmhyɛfoɔ no, kaa wɔn a wɔkunkum wɔn no ho.
Na Ruben asefoɔ hyeɛ bɛsi Yordan ho; na asase yi nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Ruben asefoɔ mmusua no dea, nkuro no ne nkuraa a ɛwowɔ ho nyinaa.
Na Mose maa Gad asefoɔ nyaa wɔn asase, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Na wɔn hyeɛ firi Yaser ne Gilead nyinaa ne Ammonfoɔ asase no fa kɔsi Aroer a ɛda Raba anim.
Na ɛfiri Hesbon kɔka Ramat-Mispe ne Betonim, na ɛkɔfa Mahanaim kɔ Debir hyeɛ so.
Na asasetamaa no fam nso, ɛfa Bet-Haram ne Bet-Nimra ne Sukot ne Safon, Hesbon hene Sihon ahemman a aka no, na ɛfa Yordan ho kɔpem Kineret po no ano nohoa wɔ Yordan apueeɛ fam.
Yei ne Gad asefoɔ mmusua no asase, nkuro no ne nkuraa a ɛwowɔ ho no nyinaa.
Na Mose maa Manase abusuakuo fa no nyaa wɔn asase, na ɛbɛyɛɛ Manase abusuakuo fa no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Na wɔn hyeɛ firi Mahanaim ne Basan nyinaa, ne Basan hene Og ahemman nyinaa, ne Yair nkuraa-nkuraa a ɛwowɔ Basan nyinaa; nkuro no yɛ aduosia.
Na Gilead asase no fa ne Astarot ne Edrei nkuro a ɛwɔ Basan hene Og ahemman mu no kɔdii Manase ba Makir mma nsam, na ɛbɛyɛɛ Makir mma no mu fa dea, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Yei ne asase a Mose de maa wɔn Moab serɛ so wɔ Yordan apueeɛ, Yeriko nkyɛn no.
Nanso Lewi abusuakuo no deɛ, Mose amma wɔn agyapadeɛ no bi. Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade ne wɔn agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn no. Wɔnam ntontotwe so ma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no agyapadeɛ
14: Yei na Israelfoɔ nyaa no sɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ wɔ Kanaan asase soɔ. Asase yi na ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ne Nun ba Yosua ne Israel agyanom mmusua mu atitire kyɛ maa wɔn.
Wɔtwee ntonto de kyɛɛ asase no maa mmusua nkron ne fa no, sɛdeɛ na Awurade nam Mose so aka no.
Saa berɛ no na Mose de mmusua mmienu ne fa no agyapadeɛ ama wɔn dada wɔ Yordan agya nohoa. Lewifoɔ deɛ, wamma wɔn agyapadeɛ no bi wɔn mu.
Nanso na Yosef mma Manase ne Efraim abɛyɛ mmusua mmienu; na wɔantwa asase no bi amma Lewifoɔ no, gye nkuro a wɔbɛtena mu ne mfikyisase a wɔn mmoa bɛdidi soɔ na wɔakora agyapadeɛ ahodoɔ wɔ soɔ.
Sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose no, saa ara na Israelfoɔ no yɛeɛ, na wɔkyekyɛɛ asase no mu.
Afei Yuda asefoɔ baa Yosua nkyɛn wɔ Gilgal, na Kenisini Yefune ba Kaleb ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wo ara wonim deɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa Mose wɔ Kades-Barnea faa me ne wo ho.
Na berɛ a Awurade akoa Mose somaa me firii Kades-Barnea sɛ menkɔhwɛ asase no, na madi mfeɛ aduanan, na mede asɛm a ɛwom biara bɛtoo n’anim, deɛ ɛwɔ m’akomam biara.
Me nuanom a me ne wɔn kɔeɛ no maa nnipa no akoma tuiɛ; nanso me deɛ, mede m’akoma nyinaa dii Awurade me Nyankopɔn akyi.
Enti saa da no, Mose kaa ntam sɛ: ‘Asase a wode wo nan sii soɔ no bɛyɛ wo ne wo mma agyapadeɛ daa, ɛfiri sɛ wode w’akoma nyinaa adi Awurade me Nyankopɔn akyi.’
Na Awurade adaworoma meda so te ase sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛɛ Mose bɔ mfeɛ aduanan nnum nie, berɛ a Israelfoɔ nam serɛ soɔ no, na ɛnnɛ, madi mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe nnum.
Nanso ɛnnɛ mpo me ho da so ara yɛ den sɛ da a Mose somaa me no. Ahoɔden a na mewɔ saa berɛ no, ebi na mewɔ nnɛ a mɛtumi akɔ akono asane aba.

Enti mesrɛ wo, fa asase a ɛwɔ bepɔ soɔ a Awurade hyɛɛ ho bɔ saa da no ma me, ɛfiri sɛ da no wotee sɛ Anakimfoɔ wɔ hɔ na wɔabɔ wɔn nkuro ho ban. Menim sɛ Awurade bɛka me ho, na mɛpamo asase no sofoɔ sɛdeɛ Awurade aka no.”
Na Yosua hyiraa Yefune ba Kaleb, na ɔde Hebron maa no sɛ n’agyapadeɛ.
Ɛno nti na ɛde bɛsi nnɛ, Hebron yɛ Kenisini Yefune ba Kaleb agyapadeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔde n’akoma nyinaa dii Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade akyi.
Kane no na Hebron de Kiriat-Arba ɛfiri sɛ na Arba yɛ Anakimfoɔ mu katakyie. Ɛfiri saa berɛ no asase no so dwo firii ɛko mu.
15: Berɛ a wɔbɔɔ ntonto kyɛɛ asase no, Yuda asefoɔ ne wɔn mmusua no hyeɛ kɔfaa Edom, Sin serɛ so, kɔsii Negeb anafoɔ.
Na wɔn hyeɛ a ɛda anafoɔ fam no firi Nkyene Po no ano, dɔnnɔn a ani kyerɛ anafoɔ fam no ano.
Ɛkɔfa anafoɔ fam kɔ Akrabim kokoɔ so kɔsi Sin, na ɛfiri anafoɔ kɔfa Kades-Barnea twam kɔ Hesron, na ɛkɔfa Adar kontono kɔ Karka.
Afei ɛtwam kɔ Asmon kɔfa Egypt subɔn no ho, na ɛhyeɛ no ano kɔpem mpoano. Yei ne mo hyeɛ a ɛda anafoɔ fam no.
Wɔn hyeɛ a ɛda apueeɛ no nam Nkyene Po no ano de kɔsi Yordan agya. Na atifi fam hyeɛ no firi po no ho dɔnnɔn a ɛwɔ Yordan agya no ho.
Na ɛhyeɛ no sane kɔfa Bet-Hogla twam kɔ Bet-Araba atifi, na ɛforo kɔ Ruben ba Bohan boɔ no ho.
Na ɛsan kɔfa Debir wɔ Akor bɔn no mu, na ɛdane kɔ atifi kɔduru Gilgal a ɛda Adumim kokoɔ anim wɔ subɔn no anafoɔ. Na ɛhyeɛ no twam kɔfa En-Semes nsuo no ho kɔpem En-Rogel.
Na ɛhyeɛ no toa so kɔfa Hinom ba bɔn no ano kɔsi Yebusi kokoɔ so wɔ anafoɔ, kyerɛ sɛ Yerusalem. Na ɛforo kɔ bepɔ a ani kyerɛ Hinom Bɔn no atɔeɛ fam wɔ Refaim bɔn no atifi fam.
Na ɛhyeɛ no firi mmepɔ so kɔ Neftoa asutire ho, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔfa nkuro a ɛwɔ Bepɔ Efron soɔ no ho; na ɛtoa so kɔ Baala a wɔfrɛ no Kiriat-Yearim no.
Na ɛhyeɛ no firi Baala wɔ atɔeɛ kɔfa Bepɔ Seir ho, na ɛkɔ atifi fam kɔfa Bepɔ Yearim ho, kyerɛ sɛ Kesalon; na ɛsiane kɔfa Bet-Semes kɔ Timna.
Na ɛhyeɛ no kɔfa Ekron kokoɔ so wɔ atifi fam, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Sikeron twam kɔ Bepɔ Baala no ho, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Yabneel; na ɛhyeɛ no kɔpem po no ano.
Na atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ no nso nam Po Kɛseɛ no ano. Yei ne Yuda asefoɔ mmusua no asase no hyeɛ ano nyinaa.
Afei Yefune ba Kaleb deɛ, ɔmaa no asase wɔ Yudafoɔ mu sɛdeɛ Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua no; ɛno ne Kiriat-Arba ɛfiri sɛ na Arba yɛ Anak agya. Saa kuro yi ara ne Hebron.
Na Kaleb tuu Anak mma mmiɛnsa no firii hɔ. Anak mma yi ne Sesai, Ahiman, ne Talmai.
Na ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Debirfoɔ so. Nso kane no na wɔfrɛ Debir sɛ Kiriat-Sefer.
Na Kaleb kaa sɛ: “Deɛ ɔbɛtumi ako afa Kiriat-Sefer no, mede me babaa Aksa bɛma no aware.”
Ɛnna Kaleb nua Kenas ba Otniel kɔko faeɛ, enti ɔde ne babaa Aksa maa no wareeɛ.
Na ɔbaa no kɔɔ Otniel fie no, ɔsii so ka kyerɛɛ ne kunu Otniel sɛ ɔmmisa asase mfiri ne papa nkyɛn. Afei berɛ a Aksa si firii n'afunumu soɔ no, Kaleb bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na wopɛ?”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ma me nhyira. Ɛsiane asase a ɛda anafoɔ na wode maa me, enti ma me mmasuo nso.” Na ɔde atifi mmasuo ne anafoɔ mmasuo maa no.
Yei ne agyapadeɛ a wɔde maa Yuda asefoɔ ne wɔn mmusua.
Na Yuda abusuakuo no nkuro a ɛgu anafoɔ fam a ɛbɛn Edom hyeɛ pɛɛ no ne Kabseel, Eder, Yagur,
ne Kina, Dimona, Adada,
ne Kedes, Hasor, Yitnan,
ne Sif, Telem, Bealot,
ne Hasor-Hadata, Keriot-Hesron, anaa Hasor,
ne Amam, Sema, Molada,
ne Hasar-Gada, Hesmon, Bet-Pelet,
ne Hasar-Sual, Beer-Seba, Bisiotia,
ne Baala, Yim, Esem,
ne Eltolad, Kesil, Horma,
ne Siklag, Madmana, Sansana,
ne Lebaot, Silhim, Ain, ne Rimon; nkuro aduonu nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Sefela nso, nkuro a ɛwɔ hɔ ne Estaol, Sora, Asnah,
ne Sanoa, En-Ganim, Tapua, Enam,
ne Yamut, Adulam, Soko, Aseka,
ne Saaraim, Aditaim, Gedera, ne Gederotaim; nkuro dunan ne ɛho nkuraa.
Senan, Hadasa, Migdal-Gad,
ne Dilean, Mispe, Yokteel,
ne Lakis, Boskat, Eglon,
ne Kabon, Lamam, Kitlis,
ne Gederot, Bet-Dagon, Naama, ne Makeda; nkuro dunsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Libna, Eter, Asan,
ne Yifta, Asnah, Nesib,
ne Keila, Aksib, ne Maresa; nkuro nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ekron ne ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa.
Ɛfiri Ekron kɔ atɔeɛ fam nsase a ɛwɔ Asdod ne ɛho nkuraa nyinaa.
Asdod ne ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa; Gasa ne ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa, kɔsi Egypt subɔn no ne Po Kɛseɛ no ho ne mantam no nyinaa.
Na mmepɔ so nkuro ne Samir, Yatir, Soko,
ne Dana, Kiriat-Sanna, anaa Debir,
ne Anab, Estemo, Anim,
ne Gosen, Holon, ne Gilo; nkuro dubaako ne ɛho nkuraa.
Arab, Duma, Esan,
ne Yanim, Bet-Tapua, Afeka,
ne Humta, Kiriat-Arba, anaa Hebron, ne Sior; nkuro nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Maon, Karmel, Sif, Yuta,
ne Yesreel, Yokdeam, Sanoa,
ne Kain, Gibea, ne Timna; nkuro du ne ɛho nkuraa.
Halhul, Bet-Sur, Gedor,
ne Maarat, Bet-Anot, ne Eltekon; nkuro nsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Kiriat-Baal, anaa Kiriat-Yearim, ne Raba; nkuro mmienu ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ɛserɛ so nkuro nso ne Bet-Araba, Midin, Sekaka,
ne Nibsan, ne Nkyene Kuro, ne En-Gedi; nkuro nsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Nanso Yebusifoɔ a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no deɛ, Yudafoɔ no antumi ampamo wɔn amfiri hɔ; na Yebusifoɔ ne Yudafoɔ tenaa Yerusalem de bɛsi nnɛ. Yosef ne Efraim asase no ahyeɛ
16: Na berɛ a wɔbɔɔ ntonto kyɛɛ asase no, na Yosef asefoɔ no hyeɛ firi Yordan agya a ɛbɛn Yeriko kɔsi Yeriko nsuo ho wɔ apueeɛ, ɛserɛ a ɛfiri Yeriko foro kɔ Betel mmepɔ soɔ no.
Na asase no sane kɔfa Betel a ɛwɔ Lus, na ɛtwam kɔ Arkifoɔ hyeɛ so wɔ Atarot,
na ɛsiane kɔ atɔeɛ kɔfa Yafletfoɔ hyeɛ so de kɔsi Anafoɔ Bet-Horon hyeɛ so, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Geser kɔpem po no ano.
Na Yosef mma Manase ne Efraim nyaa wɔn asase.
Na asase a Efraim asefoɔ mmusua no nyaeɛ no hyeɛ a ɛwɔ apueeɛ no firi Atarot-Adar de kɔsi Atifi wɔ Bet-Horon;
na ɛhyeɛ no kɔfa po no ano wɔ Mikmetat atifi fam, na ɛhyeɛ no kontono fa apueeɛ kɔ Taanat-Shilo, na ɛtwam kɔ apueeɛ kɔduru Yanoa.
Na ɛsiane firi Yanoa kɔ Atarot ne Naara, na ɛkɔfa Yeriko kɔ Yordan.
Ɛhyeɛ no firi Tapua toa so kɔ atɔeɛ kɔduru Kana subɔn ho, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ po no ano. Yei ne Efraim asefoɔ ne wɔn mmusua no asase.
Afei Efraimfoɔ nyaa nkuro wɔ Manasefoɔ asase so, nkuro ne ɛho nkuraa nyinaa.
Nanso wɔampamo Kanaanfoɔ a na wɔwɔ Geser no, enti Kanaanfoɔ kɔɔ so tenaa Efraimfoɔ mu de bɛsi nnɛ, na wɔde wɔn yɛɛ nkoadwuma.
17: Na wɔbɔɔ ntonto maa Manase abusuakuo no nyaa asase, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ne Yosef ba panin, na ɛbɛdii Manase ba panin Makir, Gilead papa, nsam, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔsabarima; na wɔde Gilead ne Basan maa no.

Na wɔbɔɔ ntonto maa Manase mma a aka no mmusua nso nyaa asase. Enti wɔkyɛ maa Abiesar asefoɔ ne Helek asefoɔ ne Asriel asefoɔ ne Sekem asefoɔ ne Hefer asefoɔ ne Semida asefoɔ. Yeinom ne Yosef ba Manase mma mmarima mmusua.
Na Manase ba ne Makir, na Makir ba ne Gilead. Na Gilead ba Hefer nso ba ne Selofehad. Na Selofehad nni ɔbabarima biara; na ne mma nyinaa yɛ mmaa na wɔn din ne Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka, ne Tirsa.

Na mmaa yi baa ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ne Nun ba Yosua ne mpanimfoɔ no nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: “Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ ɔmma yɛn agyapadeɛ wɔ yɛn nua mmarimanom mu.” Enti ɔmaa wɔn agyapadeɛ wɔn papa nuanom mu sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no.
Manase nyaa nsase du; ɛsono Gilead ne Basan asase a ɛwɔ Yordan agya no;
ɛfiri sɛ Manase mma mmaa no nyaa agyapadeɛ wɔ ne mma mmarima mu; na Gilead asase no bɛyɛɛ Manase mma nkaeɛ no agyapadeɛ.
Na Manase hyeɛ no firi Aser kɔ Mikmetat, wɔ Sekem anim. Ɛhyeɛ no firi hɔ fa nifa so kɔ En-Tapuafoɔ asase so.
Tapua asase no bɛdii Manasefoɔ nsam, nanso Tapua kuro a ɛwɔ Manase hyeɛ soɔ no yɛ Efraimfoɔ dea.
Na ɛhyeɛ no fa Kana subɔn ho kɔ anafoɔ de kɔfa Efraim nkuro a ɛwɔ subɔn ho no mu, wɔ Manase nkuro no mfimfini. Na Manase hyeɛ no wɔ subɔn no atifi, na ano kɔpem po no ho.
Enti na Efraim wɔ anafoɔ na Manase nso wɔ atifi; ne hyeɛ kɔpem po no ano. Wɔne Aser bɔ hyeɛ wɔ atifi na wɔne Isakar nso bɔ hyeɛ wɔ apueeɛ.
Afei Manase bɛnyaa nkuro a ɛdidi soɔ yi ne ɛho nkuraa ne emu nnipa wɔ Isakar ne Aser nsase so: Bet-Sean ne Yibleam ne Dor ne En-Dor ne Taanak ne Megido, ne nkuro mmiɛnsa a ɛgu nkokoɔ soɔ.
Nanso Manasefoɔ antumi anko amfa nkuro yi, enti Kanaanfoɔ kɔɔ so tenaa asase no so.
Afei berɛ a Israelfoɔ ho yɛɛ den no, wɔmaa Kanaanfoɔ no yɛɛ nkoadwuma, nanso wɔantu wɔn amfiri hɔ koraa.
Na Yosef mma no kɔbisaa Yosua sɛ: “Berɛ a Awurade ahyira me abɛduru sɛsɛɛ ama mayɛ ɔman kɛseɛ yi, adɛn nti na woatwa asase baako pɛ na ama me sɛ m’agyapadeɛ?”
Ɛnna Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sɛ woyɛ ɔman kɛseɛ a, ɛnneɛ kɔbu kwaeɛ a ɛwɔ Perisifoɔ ne Abranefoɔ asase soɔ no fa, ɛfiri sɛ bepɔ so asase a ɛwɔ Efraim no sua ma wo.”
Na Yosef mma no kaa sɛ: “Bepɔ no sua ma yɛn, na Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte asasetamaa no soɔ nyinaa, wɔn a wɔte Bet-Sean ne ɛho nkuro mu ne Yesreel Bɔn mu no, wɔ nteaseɛnam a wɔde nnadeɛ ayɛ.”
Enti Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Yosef fie, Efraim ne Manase, sɛ: “Woyɛ ɔman kɛseɛ na wo ho yɛ den yie. Ɛnyɛ asase baako na ɛsɛ sɛ wonya,

na mmom bepɔ no so bɛyɛ wo dea. Ɛyɛ kwaeɛ, enti bu fa, na ɛhɔ na w’asase no ano bɛpem. Kanaanfoɔ no ho yɛ den na wɔwɔ nnadeɛ nteaseɛnam deɛ, nanso wobɛtumi apamo wɔn firi hɔ.” Wɔkyekyɛ asase a aka no mu
18: Afei Israel asafo no nyinaa kɔhyiaa Shilo, na wɔsii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ afei deɛ, na asase no abɛdi wɔn nsam.
Nanso na aka Israelfoɔ mmusua nson a wɔntwitwaa wɔn agyapadeɛ mmaa wɔn.
Enti Yosua bisaa Israelfoɔ no sɛ: “Mobɛtwentwɛn mo nan ase akɔsi da bɛn na moakɔfa asase a Awurade mo agyanom Nyankopɔn de ama mo no?
Monyi mmarima mmiɛnsa mfiri abusuakuo biara mu na memma wɔnkɔfa asase no so; wɔnsusu na wɔntwerɛ ho nsɛm sɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ, na wɔmmra me nkyɛn.
Na wɔnkyɛ asase no mu nson mfa. Yuda nnyina n’asase so wɔ anafoɔ na Yosef fie nso nnyina wɔn asase so wɔ atifi fam.
Monkyekyɛ asase no mu nson, na montwerɛ ho nsɛm mmrɛ me, na mentwe ntonto Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn anim mma mo.

Na Lewifoɔ no deɛ, wɔrennya mo asase no bi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ ne Awurade asɔfodie. Gad ne Ruben ne Manase abusuakuo fa no nso anya wɔn agyapadeɛ a Awurade akoa Mose de maa wɔn Yordan agya wɔ apueeɛ no.”
Enti mmarima no sɔree sɛ wɔrekɔ, na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔrekɔyɛ asase no ho krataa no sɛ: “Monkɔfa asase no so ntwitwa nto hɔ na monsane mmra, na mentwe ntonto Awurade anim wɔ Shilo mma mo.”
Na mmarima no siim kɔfaa asase no so kyekyɛɛ mu nson, emu biara ne ne nkuro, na wɔtwerɛɛ no nwoma mu. Afei wɔsane baa Yosua nkyɛn wɔ Shilo asoɛeɛ hɔ.
Na Yosua twee ntonto maa wɔn wɔ Shilo, Awurade anim. Enti Yosua kyɛɛ asase no maa Israelfoɔ no maa obiara nyaa ne kyɛfa.
Wɔtwee ntonto maa Benyamin asefoɔ mmusua no nyaa wɔn asase. Na wɔn asase no da Yuda ne Yosef mma no ntam.
Na wɔn hyeɛ no kɔpem Yordan atifi, na ɛforo kɔfa Yeriko nkokoɔ so wɔ atifi, na ɛtwam fa bepɔ so wɔ atɔeɛ kɔpem Bet-Awen serɛ so.
Na ɛhyeɛ no firi hɔ kɔfa Lus, wɔ Lus anaa Betel nkokoɔ a ɛwɔ anafoɔ no ho; na ɛsiane kɔfa Atarot-Adar, bepɔ a ɛwɔ Anafoɔ Bet-Horon anafoɔ no so.
Na ɛhyeɛ no firi bepɔ a ɛwɔ Bet-Horon anim wɔ anafoɔ no so kontono fa atɔeɛ fam kɔ anafoɔ; na ɛkɔpem Kiriat-Baal anaa Kiriat-Yearim, Yudafoɔ kuro bi. Yei ne atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ no.
Na anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no firi Kiriat-Yearim ano nohoa kɔ atɔeɛ kɔfa Neftoa asutire ho.

Na ɛsiane kɔfa bepɔ a ɛne Hinom ba bɔn di nhwɛanimu no akyi pɛɛ. Saa bepɔ yi kɔ ara kɔduru Refaim Bɔn no atifi fam. Na ɛhyeɛ no siane kɔfa Hinom Bɔn mu kɔ Yebusifoɔ kokoɔ so wɔ anafoɔ fam, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ En-Rogel.
Na ɛkɔ atifi kɔfa En-Semes kɔ Gelilot wɔ Adumim kokoɔ no anim, na ɛsiane kɔ Ruben ba Bohan boɔ no ho.
Na ɛforo kɔ atifi fam kɔfa Bet-Araba kokoɔ no anim siane kɔ Araba.
Na ɛhyeɛ no twam kɔ Bet-Hogla kokoɔ so wɔ atifi fam. Na ano kɔpem Nkyene Po no dɔnnɔn a ɛwɔ atifi fam no ho wɔ Yordan anafoɔ. Yei ne anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no.
Na Yordan ne n'apueeɛ fam hyeɛ. Yei ne asase a wɔde maa Benyamin asefoɔ mmusua no; n’ahyeɛ nyinaa nie.
Nkuro a ɛbɛdii Benyamin asefoɔ ne wɔn mmusua nsam ne Yeriko, Bet-Hogla, Emek-Kesis,
ne Bet-Araba, Semaraim, Betel,
ne Awim, Para, Ofra,
ne Kefa-Amoni, Ofni, Geba; nkuro dumienu ne ɛho nkuraa.
Gibeon, Rama, Beerot,
ne Mispe, Kefira, Mosa,
ne Rekem, Yirpeel, Tarala,
ne Sela, Ha-Elef, ne Yebusifoɔ kuro Yerusalem, ne Gibea ne Kiriat; nkuro dunan ne ɛho nkuraa. Yei ne Benyamin mma mmusua no agyapadeɛ.
19: Afei ntonto a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bɔɔ Simeon abusuakuo no, Simeon mma mmusua no. Na wɔn agyapadeɛ no wɔ Yuda abusuakuo no asase so.
Na berɛ a wɔmaa wɔn agyapadeɛ no, nkuro a wɔnyaeɛ no bi ne Beer-Seba, Sheba, Molada,
ne Hasar-Sual, Bala, Esem,
ne Eltolad, Betul, Horma,
ne Siklag, Bet-Makabot, Hasar-Susa,
ne Bet-Lebaot ne Saruhen; nkuro dumiɛnsa ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ain, Rimon, Eter, ne Asan; nkuro nnan ne ɛho nkuraa,
ne nkuraa a atwa nkuro yi nyinaa ho ahyia de kɔsi Baalat-Beer ne Rama wɔ anafoɔ. Yei ne Simeon mma mmusua no agyapadeɛ.
Yuda abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ no bi na wɔde maa Simeon abusuakuo no, ɛfiri sɛ na Yudafoɔ agyapadeɛ no so dodo ma wɔn. Enti na Simeon abusuakuo no nkuro wɔ Yudafoɔ asase so.
Ntonto a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no bɔɔ Sebulon mma mmusua no. Na wɔn agyapadeɛ no hyeɛ kɔsi Sarid.
Na ɛhyeɛ no toa so fa atɔeɛ fam kɔ Mareal de kɔsi Dabeset, na ɛkɔ ara kɔfa subɔn a ɛne Yokneam di nhwɛanimu no ho.
Na ɛfiri Sarid sane kɔfa apueeɛ kɔ Kislot-Tabor hyeɛ so, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔfa Daberat foro kɔ Yafia.
Afei na ɛtwam fa apueeɛ kɔ Gat-Hefer ne Et-Kasin. Ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Rimon, na ɛtoa so kɔ Nea.
Na ɛhyeɛ no kontono fa atifi kɔ Hanaton, na ano kɔpem Yifta-El Bɔn mu.
Ne Katat, Nahalal, Simron, Yidala, ne Betlehem; nkuro dumienu ne ɛho nkuraa.
Yei ne Sebulon mma mmusua no agyapadeɛ; nkuro ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ntonto a ɛtɔ so nnan no bɔɔ Isakar mma mmusua no.
Na wɔn asase no hyeɛ kɔfa Yesreel, Kesulot, Sunem,
ne Hafraim, Sihon, Anaharat,
ne Rabit, Kision, Ebes,
ne Remet, En-Ganim, En-Hada, ne Bet-Pases.
Na ɛhyeɛ no sane kɔfa Tabor, Sahasuma, ne Bet-Semes, na ano kɔpem Yordan; nkuro dunsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Yei ne Isakar mma mmusua no agyapadeɛ; nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ntonto a ɛtɔ so nnum no bɔɔ Aser mma mmusua no.
Na wɔn hyeɛ ne Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf,
ne Alamelek, Amad, ne Misal. Ɛkɔ atɔeɛ kɔfa Karmel ne Sihor-Libnat,
na ɛsane kɔfa apueeɛ kɔ Bet-Dagon kɔsi Sebulon ne Yifta-El Bɔn mu wɔ atifi; ɛkɔ Bet-Emek ne Neiel, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Kabul wɔ benkum so,
na ɛkɔfa Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, ne Kana, na ɛkɔduru Sidon kɛseɛ.
Na ɛhyeɛ no dane kɔfa Rama kɔ ara kɔduru Tiro (Tyre) kuro a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu. Afei na ɛkɔfa Hosa de kɔsi po no ho wɔ Aksib mpɔtamu,
ne Uma, Afek, ne Rehob; nkuro aduonu mmienu ne ɛho nkuraa.
Yei ne Aser asefoɔ mmusua no agyapadeɛ; nkuro ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ntonto a ɛtɔ so nsia no bɔɔ Naftali abusuakuo no, Naftali mma sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Na wɔn hyeɛ no firi Helef kɔfa Saananim dua kɛseɛ no ho kɔ Adami-Nekeb ne Yabneel kɔsi Lakum; na ano kɔpem Yordan.
Na ɛkɔfa atɔeɛ kɔ Asnot-Tabor, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Hukok kɔsi Sebulon wɔ anafoɔ, Aser wɔ atɔeɛ, Yuda wɔ Yordan apueeɛ fam.
Na nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban no ne Sidim, Ser, Hammat, Rakat, Kineret,
ne Adama, Rama, Hasor,
ne Kedes, Edrei, En-Hasor,
ne Yiron, Migdal-El, Horem, Bet-Anat, ne Bet-Semes; nkuro dunkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Yei ne Naftali mma mmusua no agyapadeɛ; nkuro ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ntonto a ɛtɔ so nson no bɔɔ Dan mma mmusua no.
Na wɔn agyapadeɛ no hyeɛ fa Sora, Estaol, Ir-Semes,
ne Saalabin, Ayalon, Yitla,
ne Elon, Timna, Ekron,
ne Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat,
ne Yehud, Bene-Berak, Gat-Rimon,
ne Me-Yarkon ne Rakon, na ɛhyeɛ no kɔfa Yopa anim.

Nanso na Dan mma no asase sua ma wɔn. Enti Dan mma no de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ atifi ne Lesemfoɔ kɔkoeɛ, na wɔtwee nkrantɛ too kuro no so, na wɔfa tenaa so. Afei wɔde wɔn agya Dan din too Lesem so, enti wɔfrɛɛ kuro no Dan.
Yei ne Dan mma mmusua no agyapadeɛ; nkuro ne ɛho nkuraa.
Afei wɔwiee asase no kyekyɛ. Na Israelfoɔ maa Nun ba Yosua agyapadeɛ wɔ wɔn mfimfini.
Wɔde kuro a ɔbisaeɛ no maa no sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no. Kuro no ne Timnat-Sera a ɛwɔ Efraim bepɔ soɔ no; na ɔkyekyeree kuro no tenaa mu.

Yeinom ne agyapadeɛ a ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ne Nun ba Yosua ne Israel agyanom mmusua mu atitire bɔɔ ntonto wɔ Shilo kyɛ maa wɔn. Wɔyɛɛ saa Awurade anim wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. Afei wɔwiee asase no kyekyɛ.
20: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ:
“Ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ, ‘Monyi dwankɔbea nkuro a menam Mose so kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ mo no,
na sɛ obi anhyɛ da na ne nsa pa kum onipa bi a, wadwane akɔ hɔ. Ɛbɛyɛ mo dwankɔbea na deɛ ne nsa apa no atumi akɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ na owufoɔ no busuani anku no antua ka.
Ɔnnwane nkɔ nkuro yi baako mu na ɔnkɔgyina kuro no pono ano. Afei ɔmfa n’asɛm nto ɛhɔ mpanimfoɔ anim, na wɔmfa no nkɔ kuro no mu nkɔma no baabi ntena wɔ wɔn nkyɛn.
Na sɛ obusuani no ti no kɔ hɔ a, wɔnhwɛ na wɔamfa deɛ wakum nipa no amma no, ɛfiri sɛ wanhyɛ da na ɔkum no; ɔnni ne ho adwemmɔne biara.

Na ɔntena kurom hɔ nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛba abɛgyina asafo no anim na wɔabu no atɛn, na ɔbɛtena hɔ akɔsi sɛ ɔsɔfo panin a ɔwɔ so saa berɛ no bɛwuo. Ɛno akyi no, deɛ ne nsa apa no bɛtumi asane akɔ ne fie ne kuro a ɔdwane firii mu no mu.’”
Enti wɔyiyii nkuro yi sii hɔ: Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea wɔ Naftali mmepɔ soɔ; Sekem a ɛwɔ Efraim mmepɔ soɔ; ne Kiriat-Arba anaa Hebron a ɛwɔ Yuda mmepɔ soɔ.
Afei Yordan mpɔtamu wɔ Yeriko apueeɛ nso, wɔyii Beser a ɛwɔ serɛ soɔ firii Ruben abusuakuo mu; Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead firii Gad abusuakuo mu; ne Golan a ɛwɔ Basan firii Manase abusuakuo mu.
Yeinom ne nkuro a wɔyiyi maa Israelfoɔ ne ahɔhoɔ a wɔte wɔn mu no na sɛ obi nsa pa kum onipa bi a, wadwane akɔ hɔ, na deɛ wawuo no busuani anku no ansa na wabɛgyina asafo no anim ama wɔadi n’asɛm.
