21: Afei Lewi abusuakuo no mpanimfoɔ baa ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ne Nun ba Yosua ne Israel agyanom mmusua mu atitire nkyɛn
wɔ Shilo, Kanaan asase so, bɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Awurade nam Mose so kaa sɛ momma yɛn nkuro a yɛbɛtena mu ne mfikyisase a yɛn mmoa bɛdidi soɔ.”
Enti Israelfoɔ maa Lewifoɔ no nkuro ne mfikyisase; wɔyi firii wɔn agyapadeɛ mu, sɛdeɛ Awurade kaeɛ no.
Afei wɔbɔɔ ntonto maa Kohatfoɔ mmusua nyaa wɔn deɛ, na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ a wɔfiri Lewi abusuakuo mu no nyaa nkuro dumiɛnsa firii Yuda ne Simeon ne Benyamin mmusua no mu.
Na wɔbɔɔ ntonto maa Kohat mma a aka no nso nyaa nkuro du firii Efraim ne Dan mmusua ne Manase abusuakuo fa no hɔ.
Na wɔbɔɔ ntonto maa Gerson mma no nyaa nkuro dumiɛnsa firii Isakar abusuakuo ne Aser abusuakuo ne Naftali abusuakuo ne Manase abusuakuo fa a ɛwɔ Basan no mu.
Na Merari mma mmusua nso nyaa nkuro dumienu firii Ruben abusuakuo ne Gad abusuakuo ne Sebulon abusuakuo no mu.
Enti Israelfoɔ bɔɔ ntonto de nkuro yi ne ɛho mfikyisase a mmoa bɛdidi soɔ maa Lewifoɔ no, sɛdeɛ Awurade nam Mose so kaeɛ no.
Na Yuda mma abusuakuo ne Simeon mma abusuakuo no de nkuro a wɔabobɔ din yi maeɛ,
na ɛbɛdii Aaron mma a wɔyɛ Kohat asefoɔ a wɔfiri Lewi abusuakuo mu no nsam, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔnyaa ntonto a ɛdi kan no.
Enti wɔde Kiriat-Arba ɛfiri sɛ na Arba yɛ Anak agya, anaa Hebron, a ɛwɔ Yuda bepɔ soɔ no ne ɛho mfikyisase nyinaa maa wɔn.
Na wɔde kuro no ho asase ne ne nkuraa nyinaa maa Yefune ba Kaleb sɛ n’agyapadeɛ.
Afei wɔde nkuro yi nso maa Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no: Hebron a sɛ obi kum nipa a ɔbɛdwane akɔ hɔ ne ɛho mfikyisase, Libna ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Yatir ne ɛho mfikyisase, Estemoa ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Holon ne ɛho mfikyisase, Debir ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Ain ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Yuta ne Bet-Semes ne ɛho mfikyisase. Wɔnyaa nkuro nkron firii mmusua mmienu yi mu.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Benyamin abusuakuo no hɔ nie: Gibeon ne ɛho mfikyisase, Geba ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Anatot ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Almon ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Enti nkuro a Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no nyaeɛ nyinaa yɛ nkuro dumiɛnsa ne ɛho mfikyisase.
Na wɔbɔɔ ntonto no, Kohat mma mmusua a aka a wɔn nyinaa yɛ Lewifoɔ no nso nyaa nkuro firii Efraim abusuakuo no nkyɛn.
Enti nkuro a wɔde maa wɔn nie: Sekem a sɛ obi kum nipa a ɔbɛdwane akɔ hɔ ne ɛho mfikyisase a ɛwɔ Efraim mmepɔ soɔ, ne Geser ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Kibsaim ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Bet-Horon ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Dan abusuakuo no mu nie: Elteke ne ɛho mfikyisase, Gibeton ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Ayalon ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Gat-Rimon ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Manase abusuakuo fa no mu nie: Taanak ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Gat-Rimon ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro mmienu.
Nkuro a Kohat mma mmusua a aka no nyaeɛ nyinaa yɛ nkuro du ne ɛho mfikyisase.

Na Gerson mma a wɔyɛ Lewifoɔ no nso nyaa nkuro. Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Manase abusuakuo fa no asase soɔ nie: Golan a sɛ obi kum nipa a ɔbɛdwane akɔ hɔ ne ɛho mfikyisase wɔ Basan, ne Beestera ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro mmienu.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Isakar abusuakuo no mu nie: Kision ne ɛho mfikyisase, Daberat ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Yarmut ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne En-Ganim ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Aser abusuakuo no mu nie: Misal ne ɛho mfikyisase, Abdon ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Helkat ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Rehob ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Naftali abusuakuo no mu nie: Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea a sɛ obi kum nipa a ɔbɛdwane akɔ hɔ ne ɛho mfikyisase, Hamot-Dor ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Kartan ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro mmiɛnsa.
Enti nkuro a Gerson mma mmusua no nyaeɛ nyinaa yɛ nkuro dumiɛnsa ne ɛho mfikyisase.
Lewifoɔ a na wɔaka ne Merari mma mmusua no, nkuro a wɔnyaa no Sebulon abusuakuo no mu nie: Yokneam ne ɛho mfikyisase, Karta ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Dimna ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Nahalal ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Ruben abusuakuo no mu nie: Beser ne ɛho mfikyisase, Yahas ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Kedemot ne ɛho mfikyisase, ne Mefaat ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro nnan.
Nkuro a wɔnyaa no Gad abusuakuo no mu nie: Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead a sɛ obi kum nipa a ɔbɛdwane akɔ hɔ ne ɛho mfikyisase, Mahanaim ne ɛho mfikyisase,
Hesbon ne ɛho mfikyisase, Yaser ne ɛho mfikyisase; nkuro no nyinaa yɛ nnan.
Enti wɔbɔɔ ntonto no, nkuro a Lewifoɔ a na wɔaka a wɔyɛ Merari mma mmusua no nyaeɛ nyinaa yɛ dumienu.
Nkuro a Lewifoɔ no nyaa no Israelfoɔ asase soɔ nyinaa yɛ nkuro aduanan nwɔtwe ne ɛho mfikyisase.
Na mfikyisase atwa nkuro yi nyinaa ho ahyia; saa na na nkuro no nyinaa teɛ.
Enti Awurade de asase a ɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn agyanom no nyinaa maa Israelfoɔ tenaa so.
Na baabi a wɔwɔ biara no, Awurade maa wɔhomee sɛdeɛ ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn agyanom no, na wɔn atamfo no biara antumi annyina wɔn anim. Awurade de wɔn atamfo nyinaa hyɛɛ wɔn nsa.
Asɛm pa a Awurade de hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ bɔ no baako mpo antɔ fam; ne nyinaa baa mu.
22: Ɛnna Yosua frɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no,
na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Moadi deɛ Awurade akoa Mose ka kyerɛɛ mo no nyinaa so, na me nso moayɛ aso ama me wɔ biribiara mu.
Saa nna dodoɔ yi nyinaa moannya mo nuanom de bɛsi nnɛ, na moadi Awurade mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so.
Na afei Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ama mo nuanom ahome, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ wɔn bɔ no. Enti monsane nkɔ mo ntomadan mu, asase a Awurade akoa Mose de maa mo wɔ Yordan agya no so.

Na monhwɛ nni ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara a Awurade akoa Mose de maa mo no so; monnɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn, na momfa n’akwan so nni n’ahyɛdeɛ so, na momfa mo ho mfam ne ho, na momfa mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa nsom no.”
Enti Yosua hyiraa wɔn na ɔgyaa wɔn kwan maa wɔkɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.

Na Mose de Basan maa Manase abusuakuo fa no, na Yosua nso maa abusuakuo no fa a aka no ne wɔn nuanom nyinaa agyapadeɛ wɔ Yordan atɔeɛ fam. Berɛ a Yosua regya wɔn kwan akɔ wɔn ntomadan mu no, ɔhyiraa wɔn nso.
Na ɔtoaa so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Momfa ahonyadeɛ ne nyɛmmoa bebree pa ne dwetɛ ne sika ne kɔbere ne nnadeɛ ne ntadeɛ a ɛdɔɔso pii paa nkɔ. Na mo ne mo nuanom nkyɛ asadeɛ a monya firii mo atamfo hɔ no.”

Enti Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no ne Israelfoɔ a aka no dii mpaepaemu, na wɔfirii Shilo a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Gilead asase so, agyapadeɛ a Awurade nam Mose so de maa wɔn sɛ wɔntena soɔ no.
Na berɛ a wɔduruu Yordan mantam mu wɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no, Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no sii afɔrebukyia wɔ Yordan ho. Na ɛyɛ afɔrebukyia kɛseɛ soronko bi.
Akyire yi, Israelfoɔ a aka no tee sɛ wɔrekeka sɛ: “Hwɛ, Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no asi afɔrebukyia wɔ Yordan mpɔtamu, Kanaan hyeɛ so, Israelfoɔ no afa hɔ.”
Na berɛ a Israelfoɔ no teeɛ no, Israel asafo no nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano wɔ Shilo sɛ wɔne wɔn rekɔko.
Na Israelfoɔ somaa ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ba Finehas kɔɔ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no nkyɛn wɔ Gilead asase so,
na wɔde mpanimfoɔ du kaa ne ho. Wɔyii ɔpanin baako firii Israel agyanom abusuakuo biara mu. Yeinom na wɔdeda wɔn agyanom fie ano, Israel mpempem mu.
Na berɛ a wɔduruu Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no nkyɛn wɔ Gilead asase soɔ no, wɔde too wɔn anim sɛ:
“Awurade asafo no nyinaa se yɛmmisa mo sɛ, ‘Adɛn nti na moayɛ adebɔne yi atia Israel Nyankopɔn, na moadane afiri Awurade akyi akɔsi afɔrebukyia? Ɛnyɛ atua na moate atia Awurade nnɛ yi?
Bɔne a yɛyɛɛ no Peor a ɛkɔfaa ɔhaw baa Awurade asafo so a ɛde bɛsi nnɛ yɛntumi nnwiraa yɛn ho yi nnɔɔso mma yɛn?
Ɛnnɛ nso moasi mo bo sɛ mobɛdane afiri Awurade akyi. Monhunu sɛ sɛ mote atua tia Awurade nnɛ a, ɔkyena Israel asafo no nyinaa na ɛbɛsoa n’abufuo.

Nanso sɛ asase a wɔde ama mo no ho agu fi a, ɛnneɛ mommra mmɛtena yɛn nkyɛn wɔ Awurade asase no so, baabi a Awurade ntomadan sie no. Sɛ mosi afɔrebukyia foforɔ ka Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no ho a, na morete atua atia Awurade, ne yɛn nso.
Ɛnyɛ Sera ba Akan na ɔfaa nneɛma a wɔkaa sɛ wɔnsɛe no no? Nso ɛnyɛ Israel asafo no nyinaa na wɔsoaa ɛho abufuo? Ɔno nko ara anwu ne bɔne no mu.’”
Ɛnna Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no ka kyerɛɛ Israel mpempem so mpanimfoɔ no sɛ:
“Onyankopɔn, Tweaduampɔn Awurade, Onyankopɔn, Tweaduampɔn Awurade, ɔno na ɔnim, na Israel nso nhunu, yɛyɛɛ no atuateɛ mu anaa Awurade fom mu na yɛyɛeɛ a, nnye yɛn nkwa nnɛ!
Sɛ yɛsii afɔrebukyia no sɛ yɛde redane afiri Awurade akyi, anaasɛ yɛsii sɛ yɛbɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa aduane afɔdeɛ anaa asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ so a, ɛnneɛ Awurade no ara mmɛbisa ho asɛm.
Ɛnyɛ biribi a yɛsuro nti na yɛyɛɛ yei? Yɛkaa no yɛn tirim sɛ, ‘Daakye bi mo mma bɛbisa yɛn mma sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na mo ne Awurade Israel Nyankopɔn no wɔ yɛ?
Na Awurade de Yordan ayɛ hyeɛ ato yɛne mo Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ntam. Monni kyɛfa biara wɔ Awurade mu.” Ɛba saa a, mo mma bɛma yɛn mma agyae Awurade suro.’
“Enti yɛkaa sɛ: ‘Momma yɛnyɛ ho biribi; momma yɛnsi afɔrebukyia. Yɛremmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa afɔdeɛ foforɔ biara wɔ so,

na mmom ɛbɛyɛ adanseɛ wɔ yɛne mo ne yɛn nkyirimma ntam sɛ yɛde yɛn hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne yɛn asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ne afɔdeɛ foforɔ a aka bɛba Awurade anim abɛsom no, na ɔkyena bi mo mma anka ankyerɛ yɛn mma sɛ: “Monni kyɛfa biara wɔ Awurade mu.”’

Enti yɛkaa sɛ, ‘Sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔkyena bi wɔka saa kyerɛ yɛne yɛn nkyirimma a, yɛbɛka sɛ: “Monhwɛ Awurade afɔrebukyia nsɛsoɔ a yɛn agyanom yɛeɛ. Ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa afɔdeɛ foforɔ biara nti na wɔyɛeɛ, na mmom wɔyɛɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ adanseɛ wɔ yɛne mo ntam.”’

Ɛmpare yɛn sɛ yɛbɛhyɛ da ate atua atia Awurade na yɛadane yɛn ho afiri Awurade akyi akɔsi afɔrebukyia foforɔ aka Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a ɛsi ne ntomadan anim no ho, na yɛabɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ anaa afɔdeɛ foforɔ biara wɔ soɔ!”
Na berɛ a ɔsɔfoɔ Finehas ne asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔdeda Israel mpempem ano a wɔka ne ho no tee asɛm a Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ kaeɛ no, wɔhunuu sɛ ɛtɔ asomu.

Enti ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ba Finehas ka kyerɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ no sɛ: “Ɛnnɛ yɛahunu sɛ Awurade wɔ yɛn ntam, ɛfiri sɛ moanyɛ yei sɛ mode resɔre atia Awurade. Na moagye Israelfoɔ afiri Awurade nsam.”
Afei ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasar ba Finehas ne mpanimfoɔ no ne Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no dii mpaepaemu wɔ Gilead asase so, na wɔsane baa Israelfoɔ a aka no nkyɛn wɔ Kanaan asase so bɛbɔɔ wɔn amanneɛ.
Na Israelfoɔ no hunuu sɛ asɛm no tɔ asomu; enti Israelfoɔ no hyiraa Onyankopɔn, na wɔanka bio sɛ wɔne Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ bɛkɔ akɔko asɛe asase a wɔte soɔ no.
Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no too afɔrebukyia no din sɛ "adanseɛ", ɛfiri sɛ “ɛyɛ adanseɛ wɔ yɛn ntam sɛ Awurade ne Onyankopɔn.”
23: Berɛ a Awurade maa Israelfoɔ no home firii wɔn atamfo a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia nyinaa nsam akyi nna pii a Yosua mfeɛ akɔ animu na wabɔ akora no,
Yosua frɛɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa, mpanimfoɔ ne ahwɛfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ ne atitire, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Me deɛ, me mfeɛ akɔ animu na mabɔ akora.
Na moahunu deɛ mo nti Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de yɛɛ aman yi nyinaa; Awurade mo Nyankopɔn na ɔko maa mo.
Monhwɛ, mebɔɔ ntonto kyɛɛ aman a aka yi ne wɔn a metuu wɔn ase no nyinaa nsase ama mo mmusua no sɛ agyapadeɛ, ɛfiri Yordan de kɔsi Po Kɛseɛ no ho wɔ atɔeɛ fam.
Na Awurade mo Nyankopɔn na ɔbɛpamo wɔn afiri mo anim, na ɔbɛgye wɔn nsase ama mo atena so, sɛdeɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ mo bɔ no.
“Enti momma mo bo nyɛ duru paa na monhwɛ sɛ mobɛdi deɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara nwoma no mu nyinaa soɔ, na moammane ankɔ nifa anaa benkum.
Na mommfa mo ho mmmɔ aman a aka wɔ mo nkyɛn yi ho. Mommmɔ wɔn anyame din, mommfa wɔn din nnka ntam, monnsom wɔn na monnkoto wɔn.
Na mmom Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ho na momfa mo ho mfam, sɛdeɛ moayɛ de abɛsi nnɛ yi.
Na Awurade nso apamo aman akɛseɛ a wɔn ho yɛ den afiri mo anim. Mo deɛ, ɛde bɛsi nnɛ, obiara ntumi nnyinaa mo anim.
Mo mu baako pɛ bɛpamo nnipa apem, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn na ɔko ma mo sɛdeɛ wahyɛ mo bɔ no.
Enti monhwɛ mo ho yie paa na monnɔ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn.
“Na sɛ mosane mo akyi de mo ho kɔfam aman a aka a mo ne wɔn teɛ yi ho, na mo ne wɔn di ayewareɛ anaa mo ne wɔn di hwebom "mokɔ wɔn mu na wɔba mo mu a",

ɛnneɛ monhyɛ no nso sɛ Awurade mo Nyankopɔn renkɔ so mpamo aman yi mfiri mo anim. Na mmom wɔbɛdane fidie ama mo na wɔabɛyɛ mpire wɔ mo akyi ne nkasɛɛ wɔ mo aniwa mu akɔsi sɛ mo ase bɛtɔre afiri asase pa a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama mo yi soɔ.
“Ɛnnɛ merekɔ asase sofoɔ nyinaa kwan, na monim mo akoma nyinaa mu ne mo kra nyinaa mu sɛ nsɛmpa a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn kaa no wɔ mo ho no nyinaa aba mu, emu baako mpo ntɔɔ fam.

Na monhunu sɛ sɛdeɛ asɛmpa a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ mo no nyinaa aba mu no, saa ara na Awurade de nnome no nyinaa bɛba mo soɔ akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛtɔre mo ase afiri asase pa a Awurade mo Nyankopɔn de ama mo yi soɔ,

sɛ mofom Awurade mo Nyankopɔn apam a ɔde ama mo no so, na mokɔsom anyame foforɔ na mo kɔkoto sɔre wɔn a ɛnneɛ Awurade abufuo bɛdɛre atia mo, na ɛrenni da bi na mo ase ahye koraa afiri asase pa a ɔde ama mo yi so.”
24: Afei Yosua maa Israel mmusua no nyinaa bɛhyiaa Sekem, na ɔfrɛɛ Israel mpanimfoɔ ne ahwɛfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ ne atitire nyinaa bɛgyinaa Onyankopɔn anim.

Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: “Sɛ Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade seɛ nie, ‘Tete no na mo agyanom te asubɔnten kɛseɛ no agya nohoa; ɛhɔ na na Abraham ne Nahor agya Tera teɛ, na saa berɛ no, na wɔsom anyame foforɔ.
“‘Akyire yi mefaa mo nana Abraham firii asubɔnten kɛseɛ no agya, na memaa no kyinii Kanaan asase nyinaa so, na memaa n’asefoɔ dɔreeɛ. Na mede Isak maa no.
Na memaa Isak nso nyaa Yakob ne Esau. Akyire yi mede Bepɔ Seir maa Esau tenaa so; na Yakob ne ne mma nso kɔɔ Egypt.
Afei mesomaa Mose ne Aaron, na mede ɔhaw baa Egypt so; na ɛno akyi no meyii mo firii hɔ.
Na berɛ a meyii mo agyanom firii Egypt bɛduruu po no ho no, Egyptfoɔ de nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ tii mo agyanom baa Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho.
Na wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, enti ɔmaa esum kabii bɛdaa mo ne Egyptfoɔ no ntam, na ɔmaa po no bu faa wɔn so kataa wɔn so. Mode mo ani hunuu deɛ meyɛɛ no Egypt no, na motenaa ɛserɛ so nna pii.
“‘Nkakrankakra mede mo bɛduruu Amorifoɔ a wɔte Yordan agya no asase so, na wɔne mo koeɛ. Na mede wɔn hyɛɛ mo nsa sɛ momfa wɔn asase ntena so, na mesɛee wɔn mo anim.
Afei Sipor ba Balak a ɔyɛ Moab hene no sɔre baa Israelfoɔ so ne wɔn bɛkoeɛ. Na ɔsoma kɔfrɛɛ Beor ba Balaam sɛ ɔmmɛdome mo.
Nanso mampɛ sɛ mɛtie Balaam. Na nhyira ara na ɔhyiraa mo. Enti megyee mo firii ne nsam.
“‘Ɛnna motwaa Yordan bɛduruu Yeriko, na Yerikofoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ne Perisifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ ne Hitifoɔ ne Girgasifoɔ ne Hiwifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ firii aseɛ ne mo koeɛ; nanso mede wɔn hyɛɛ mo nsa.
Na mesomaa nkotokurodu dii mo anim, na wɔpamoo Amorifoɔ ahemfo mmienu no, ɛnyɛ mo nkrantɛ so na ɛnyɛ mo tadua soɔ.
Na memaa mo asase a moammrɛ ho, na monyaa nkuro a ɛnyɛ mo na mokyekyereeɛ tenaa mu. Bobenturo ne ngo nnua a modidi soɔ yi nso, ɛnyɛ mo na moduaeɛ.’
“Na afei monsuro Awurade na monsom no mudie ne nokorɛ mu. Na monto anyame a mo agyanom som wɔn asubɔnten kɛseɛ no agya ne Egypt no ngu, na monsom Awurade.

Na sɛ ɛyɛ bɔne wɔ mo ani so sɛ mobɛsom Awurade a, ɛnneɛ ɛnnɛ monyi deɛ mobɛsom no, sɛ anyame a mo agyanom a na wɔwɔ asubɔnten kɛseɛ no agya no som wɔn no oo, sɛ Amorifoɔ a mote wɔn asase soɔ no anyame oo, monyi deɛ mobɛsom no. Na me ne me fie deɛ, yɛbɛsom Awurade.”
Ɛnna ɔman no buaa sɛ: “Ɛmpare yɛn sɛ yɛbɛgya Awurade hɔ akɔsom anyame foforɔ.

Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn na ɔyii yɛne yɛn agyanom firii Egypt nkoafie, ɔno na ɔyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ yi wɔ yɛn ani soɔ, ɔno na ɔbɔɔ yɛn ho ban yɛn akwantuo mu, na ɔno na ɔhwɛɛ yɛn so faa aman ahodoɔ no nyinaa mu.
Na Awurade pamoo aman no nyinaa firii yɛn anim, Amorifoɔ a wɔte asase no soɔ no. Enti yɛn nso yɛbɛsom Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ne yɛn Nyankopɔn.”
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Morentumi nsom Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn kronkron. Na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔne obi bɛkyɛ ne som. Sɛ mote atua yɛ bɔne a, ɔremfa nkyɛ mo.
Na sɛ mogya Awurade hɔ kɔsom ananafoɔ anyame a, ɔno nso bɛdane ne ho ne mo adi no nwononwono na watɔre mo ase, berɛ a wayɛ mo papa akyi no.”
Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Dabi, Awurade ara na yɛbɛsom no!”
Afei Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Mo ara mo anom na moayi Awurade sɛ mobɛsom no; mo ara moyɛ adansefoɔ.” Na wɔbuaa sɛ: “Yɛyɛ adansefoɔ.”
“Ɛnneɛ monto ananafoɔ anyame a ɛwɔ mo nkyɛn no ngu, na monnane mo akoma mmra Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade nkyɛn.”
Na ɔman no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: “Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛbɛsom no, na ɔno na yɛbɛtie no!”
Saa da no Yosua ne ɔman no yɛɛ apam, na ɔmaa wɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ wɔ Sekem.
Afei Yosua twerɛɛ nsɛm yi wɔ Onyankopɔn mmara nwoma no mu, na ɔde boɔ kɛseɛ bi sii hɔ wɔ dupɔn a ɛsi Awurade kronkronbea no ho ase.
Na Yosua toaa so ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: “Monhwɛ, ɛboɔ yi bɛyɛ yɛn danseni, ɛfiri sɛ ate deɛ Awurade aka akyerɛ yɛn nyinaa. Enti ɛboɔ yi bɛyɛ danseni na moampa mo Nyankopɔn akyi.”
Enti Yosua gyaa ɔman no kwan maa obiara kɔɔ n’agyapadeɛ so.
Nsɛm yi nyinaa akyi no, Awurade akoa Yosua, Nun ba no, wuiɛ berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ ɔha ne du (110).
Na wɔsiee no n’asase so wɔ Timnat-Sera a ɛwɔ Efraim bepɔ so wɔ Bepɔ Gaash atifi fam.
Na Israelfoɔ kɔɔ so som Awurade wɔ Yosua ne mpanimfoɔ a wɔtenaa ase wɔ Yosua akyi nyinaa berɛ so, mpanimfoɔ a wɔhunuu nnwuma a Awurade yɛ maa Israel no nyinaa.
Afei wɔsiee Yosef nnompe a Israelfoɔ de firi Egypt baeɛ no wɔ Sekem, asase a Yakob tɔ firii Sekem papa Hamor mma nkyɛn nnwetɛbena ɔha no so, na ɛbɛyɛɛ Yosef mma agyapadeɛ.
Na Aaron ba Eleasar nso wuiɛ, na wɔsiee no wɔ ne ba Finehas Kokoɔ so, asase a ɔde maa no wɔ Efraim bepɔ soɔ no so.

1: Yuda, Yesu Kristo akoa, ne Yakobo nua, de kɔma wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn a Agya Nyankopɔn dɔ wɔn na wɔakora wɔn ama Yesu Kristo no:
Mmɔborɔhunu, asomdwoeɛ ne ɔdɔ nnɔɔso mma mo.
Adɔfo, ɛnam sɛ na merebɔ mmɔden biara atwerɛ nkwagyeɛ a ɛyɛ yɛn nyinaa dea no ho asɛm abrɛ mo nti, ɛho hiaa me sɛ metwerɛ brɛ mo, na mede bɛtu mo fo sɛ mompere gyidie a wɔde ama ahotefoɔ prɛko no ho.

Deɛ enti a ɛte saa ne sɛ nnipa bi awiawia wɔn ho aba mo mu a ɛfiri tete no wɔnam Twerɛnsɛm no so aka ato hɔ sɛ wɔbɛnya saa atemmuo yi, amumuyɛfoɔ a wɔdane yɛn Nyankopɔn adom ahohwie, na wɔpo Otumfoɔ koro a ɔne yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo no. Asoɔden so akatua ho nhwɛsoɔ
Na mepɛ sɛ mekae mo a moahunu yei prɛko dada sɛ, Awurade gyee ɔman no firii Egypt asase soɔ no, akyire yi no, ɔsɛee wɔn a wɔannye annie no.
Na abɔfoɔ a wɔankora wɔn paninnie, na mmom wɔgyaa wɔn ara wɔn tenaberɛ no, ɔde daa ahoma akyekyere wɔn, akora wɔn esum kabii mu, ama da kɛseɛ no atemmuo.
Saa ara na Sodom ne Gomora ne nkuro a atwa ho ahyia nso yɛɛ sɛ yeinom, de wɔn ho maa adwamammɔ na wɔkɔdii ɔhonam foforɔ akyi no, wɔde wɔn asi hɔ sɛ asɛnnahɔ ama daa ogya asotwe.
Saa ara na nnipa yi nso yɛ adaeɛsofoɔ a wɔgu honam ho fi, wɔmmu tumidie na wɔkasa tia animuonyamfoɔ.
Nanso berɛ a ɔbɔfo panin Mikael ne ɔbonsam redi aperepereɛ kasakasaa Mose amu ho no, wansi ne bo anka asɛmmɔne bi ammu no atɛn, na mmom ɔkaa sɛ: “Awurade nka w’anim.”
Nanso saa nnipa yi ka deɛ wɔnnim nyinaa ho asɛmmɔne; na nneɛma a wɔfiri wɔn awosuo mu nim nyinaa te sɛ mmoa a wɔnni adwene no, ɛno mu na wɔsɛe wɔn ho.
Wɔnnue, ɛfiri sɛ wɔafa Kain kwan so, na mfasoɔ nti, wɔde ahoperɛ akɔfa Balaam kwammɔne no so, na wɔayera Kora atuateɛ mu.

Yeinom yɛ mo dɔ adidie mu nkekaeɛ, wɔne mo redidi a wɔnsuro adeɛ,  nnwanhwɛfoɔ a wɔyɛne wɔn ho; wɔyɛ mununkum a nsuo nni mu a mframa twetwe kyinkyini; nnua a twaberɛ aduro nanso ɛnso aba, na awu mprenu a ne nhini atutuo,
ɛpo asorɔkye a ɛhuru kutukutu pu wɔn ara aniwudeɛ guo; nsoromma a ɛkyinkyini kɛkɛ, a wɔakora esum kabii ama wɔn daa.
Yeinom ho na Henok a ɔtɔ Adam so nson wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu nso hyɛɛ nkɔm de too hɔ sɛ: “Hwɛ! Awurade ne n’ahotefoɔ mpempem reba,
abɛbu wɔn nyinaa atɛn, na wabu wɔn mu amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa atɛn, wɔn amumuyɛdeɛ a wɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne wɔn atirimuɔdensɛm a nnebɔneyɛfoɔ amumuyɛfoɔ no ka de tiaa no nyinaa ho.
Saa nnipa yi yɛ anwiinwiifoɔ, awɛnafoɔ a wɔdi wɔn ara wɔn akɔnnɔ akyi, na wɔn ano ka akonkosɛm, na mfasoɔ nti wɔdɛfɛdɛfɛ nnipa.
Na mo, adɔfo, monkae nsɛm a yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo asomafoɔ no ka too hɔ no,
sɛdeɛ wɔka kyerɛɛ mo sɛ: “Berɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu no, fɛdifoɔ bɛba a wɔbɛdi wɔn ara wɔn amumuyɛ akɔnnɔ akyire.”
Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔde mpaepaemu ba, honam akyiridifoɔ a wɔnni Honhom no.
Na mo, adɔfo deɛ, momfa mo ho nsi mo gyidie kronkron no so mmɔ mpaeɛ Honhom Kronkron tumi mu;
momfa mo ho nsie Onyankopɔn dɔ mu, na montwɛn yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo mmɔborɔhunu a ɛkɔ daa nkwa mu no.
Afei nso, monhu akyinnyegyefoɔ mmɔbɔ,
ebinom nso monhwim wɔn mfiri gya mu nnye wɔn nkwa, na ebinom nso momfa suro nhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na montane atadeɛ a honam nkekaeɛ akeka mu nso.
Afei deɛ ɔbɛtumi asɔ mo mu na moansunti, na ɔde mo asi n’animuonyam anim, sɛ nnipa a wɔnni dɛm wɔ ahosan mu no,
Onyankopɔn koro a ɔnam yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo so yɛ yɛn Agyenkwa no, ɔno na animuonyam ne kɛseyɛ ne ahoɔden ne tumi nka no mmerɛ santen, seesei ne daa nyinaa. Amen.
Na Yosua wuo akyi no, Israelfoɔ bisaa Awurade sɛ: “Yɛn mu hwan na ɔbɛdi kan ne Kanaanfoɔ akɔko?”
Ɛnna Awurade kaa sɛ: “Yuda na ɔbɛkorɔ. Hwɛ, mede asase no ahyɛ ne nsa.”
Na Yuda ka kyerɛɛ ne nua Simeon sɛ: “Wo ne me nkɔ asase a me nsa kaeɛ no so na yɛne Kanaanfoɔ nkɔko, na me nso me ne wo bɛkɔ w’asase so.” Enti Simeon ne no kɔeɛ.
Na Yudafoɔ no kɔeɛ, na Awurade de Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ hyɛɛ wɔn nsa, na wɔkum nnipa mpem du (10,000) wɔ Besek.
Na berɛ a wɔhunuu Adoni-Besek wɔ Besek no, wɔne no koeɛ, na wɔdii Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ no so nkonim.
Afei Adoni-Besek dwaneeɛ, na wɔtii no kɔkyee no twitwaa ne nsa kokuromoti ne ne nan kokuromoti.

Ɛnna Adoni-Besek kaa sɛ: “Metwitwaa ahemfo aduɔson nsa kokuromoti ne wɔn nan kokuromoti, na wɔtasetasee me pono ase aduane. Deɛ meyɛɛ wɔn no, Onyankopɔn ayɛ me bi atua ka.” Ɛno akyi no, wɔde no baa Yerusalem, na ɔwuu wɔ hɔ.
Afei Yudafoɔ ne Yerusalem kɔkoeɛ, na kuro no bɛdii wɔn nsam. Na wɔde nkrantɛ kunkum ɛhɔfoɔ de gya hyee kuro no.
Ɛno akyi no, Yudafoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte bepɔ soɔ ne Negeb ne Sefela kɔkoeɛ.
Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no kɔɔ Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Hebron no so. Berɛ bi na wɔfrɛ Hebron sɛ Kiriat-Arba. Na wɔkum Sesai ne Ahiman ne Talmai.
Na wɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Debirfoɔ so. Berɛ bi na wɔfrɛ Debir sɛ Kiriat-Sefer.
Na Kaleb kaa sɛ: “Deɛ ɔbɛtumi ako afa Kiriat-Sefer no, mede me babaa Aksa bɛma no aware.”
Ɛnna Kaleb nua kumaa Kenas ba Otniel kɔko faeɛ, enti ɔde ne babaa Aksa maa no wareeɛ.
Na ɔbaa no rekɔ fie no, ɔsii so ka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ ɔmmisa asase mfiri ne papa nkyɛn. Afei berɛ a Aksa te n'afunumu soɔ no, ɔbɔɔ ne nsam frɛɛ ne papa. Ɛnna Kaleb bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na wopɛ?”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ma me nhyira bi ɛ. Asase a ɛda anafoɔ na wode maa me, enti ma me mmasuo nso.” Na Kaleb maa no atifi mmasuo ne anafoɔ mmasuo.
Na Mose asebarima a ɔyɛ Kenini no mma ne Yudafoɔ firi mmɛ kuro no mu baa Yuda serɛ a ɛwɔ Arad anafoɔ no so. Na wɔne ɛhɔfoɔ kɔtenaeɛ.
Afei Yuda ne ne nua Simeon kɔto hyɛɛ Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Sefat no so, na wɔsɛee kuro no pasaa. Enti wɔtoo kuro no din Horma.
Akyire yi, Yuda ko faa Gasa ne ɛho nsase, Askelon ne ɛho nsase, ne Ekron ne ɛho nsase.
Na Awurade kɔɔ so dii Yuda akyi, na ɔfaa nsase a ɛwɔ bepɔ soɔ no, nanso wantumi ampamo wɔn a wɔtete asasetamaa no soɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔwɔ nteaseɛnam a wɔde nnadeɛ ayɛ.
Na wɔde Hebron maa Kaleb sɛdeɛ Mose kaeɛ no, na ɔpamoo Anak mma mmiɛnsa no firii hɔ.
Na Benyaminfoɔ no ampamo Yebusifoɔ a wɔte Yerusalem no, na Yebusifoɔ no kɔɔ so ne Benyaminfoɔ tenaa Yerusalem de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Yosef fiefoɔ nso kɔɔ Betel so, na Awurade dii wɔn akyi.
Na Yosef fiefoɔ no wiaa wɔn ho kɔhwɛɛ Betel. Kane no na wɔfrɛ kuro no Lus.
Na wɔn a wɔsomaa wɔn sɛ wɔn kɔhwɛ asase no hunuu ɔbarima bi sɛ ɔfiri kuro no mu reba. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛsrɛ wo, kyerɛ yɛn kwan a yɛbɛfa so akɔ kuro no mu, na yɛne wo bɛdi no adɔeɛ so.”
Na ɔbarima no kyerɛɛ wɔn kwan a wɔbɛfa so akɔ kuro no mu. Na wɔde nkrantɛ kɔkunkum kurom hɔfoɔ, na wɔgyaa ɔbarima no ne n’abusuafoɔ nyinaa.
Afei ɔbarima no kɔɔ Hitifoɔ asase so kɔkyekyeree kuro bi too hɔ din Lus. Saa na wɔfrɛ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Manase amfa Bet-Sean ne Taanak ne ɛho nkuro, ne Dorfoɔ ne Yibleamfoɔ ne Megidofoɔ ne nkuro a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no. Na Kanaanfoɔ no kɔɔ so tenaa asase yi so.
Afei Israelfoɔ no ho bɛyɛɛ den, na wɔmaa Kanaanfoɔ no yɛɛ nkoadwuma, na wɔantu wɔn amfiri hɔ koraa.
Na Efraim nso ampamo Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Geser no amfiri hɔ, na mmom Kanaanfoɔ no kɔɔ so ne wɔn tenaa Geser.
Na Sebulon ampamo Kitronfoɔ ne Nahalolfoɔ no, na mmom Kanaanfoɔ yi kɔɔ so ne wɔn tenaeɛ, na wɔmaa wɔyɛɛ nkoadwuma.
Aser ampamo nnipa a wɔte Ako ne Sidon ne Ahlab ne Aksib ne Helba ne Afik ne Rehob no.
Enti Aserfoɔ no kɔɔ so ne Kanaanfoɔ a wɔwɔ asase no soɔ no tenaeɛ, na wɔampamo wɔn.
Naftali nso ampamo nnipa a wɔte Bet-Semes ne Bet-Anat no, na wɔkɔɔ so ne Kanaanfoɔ a wɔwɔ asase no soɔ no tenaeɛ, na wɔde nnipa a wɔte Bet-Semes ne Bet-Anat no yɛɛ nkoadwuma.
Na Amorifoɔ no kaa Danfoɔ no hyɛɛ bepɔ no so, na wɔamma wɔansiane amma asasetamaa no so.
Enti Amorifoɔ no kɔɔ so tenaa Bepɔ Heres so ne Ayalon ne Saalbim. Nanso Yosef fiefoɔ nsa yɛɛ den wɔn so, na wɔde wɔn yɛɛ nkoadwuma.
Na Amorifoɔ hyeɛ no firi Akrabim kokoɔ so, na ɛfiri Sela foro kɔ atifi fam. Ɔman no asoɔden ne Nyankopɔn abufuo
2: Ɛnna Awurade bɔfoɔ firi Gilgal baa Bokim, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Meyii mo firii Egypt baa asase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo agyanom no so. Na mekaa sɛ, ‘Meremmu m’apam a me ne mo yɛeɛ no so da.
Na mo nso, mo ne asase yi sofoɔ nnyɛ apam biara. Mommubu wɔn afɔrebukyia.’ Nanso moantie m’asɛm. Ɛdeɛn na moayɛ yi?
Enti deɛ mereka nie, ‘Merempamo wɔn mfiri mo anim, na wɔbɛdane nkasɛɛ ama mo, na wɔn anyame adane mo fidie.’”
Na berɛ a Awurade bɔfoɔ no de asɛm yi too Israelfoɔ no anim ara pɛ na wɔmaa wɔn nne so suiɛ.
Enti wɔtoo hɔ din Bokim. Na wɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ maa Awurade.
Ɛnna Yosua gyaa Israelfoɔ no kwan, na obiara kɔɔ n’agyapadeɛ so kɔtenaa asase no so.
Enti ɔman no kɔɔ so som Awurade, Yosua ne mpanimfoɔ a wɔtenaa ase wɔ n’akyi no nna nyinaa, mpanimfoɔ a wɔhunuu nnwuma akɛseɛ a Awurade yɛ maa Israel no.
Afei Awurade akoa Yosua, Nun ba no, wuiɛ berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ ɔha ne du.
Na wɔsiee no n’asase so wɔ Timnat-Heres a ɛwɔ Efraim bepɔ so wɔ Bepɔ Gaash atifi fam.
Na ɛbaa sɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ no nyinaa wuwu maa wɔsiee wɔn kɔkaa wɔn agyanom ho. Na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ dii wɔn akyi baeɛ a na wɔnnim Awurade anaa nnwuma a ɔyɛ maa Israelfoɔ no.
Na Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, na wɔsom Baal ahoni.
Na wɔgyaa Awurade wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn a ɔde wɔn firi Egypt asase so baeɛ no kɔdii aman a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no anyame akyi, na wɔkotoo wɔn de hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo.
Enti wɔgyaa Awurade kɔsom Baal ne Astarot ahoni.
Afei Awurade abufuo dɛre tiaa Israel, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ wɔn atamfo nsa maa wɔfom wɔn nneɛma. Na ɔtɔn wɔn maa wɔn atamfo a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia no, na wɔantumi annyina wɔn atamfo anim bio.
Baabi a wɔkɔeɛ biara, Awurade de amanehunu baa wɔn so, sɛdeɛ na Awurade aka no, ɛfiri sɛ na Awurade aka wɔn ntam dada sɛ ɔbɛyɛ saa, na wɔn ho hiahiaa wɔn papaapa.
Enti Awurade maa wɔn atemmufoɔ sɛ wɔnnye wɔn mfiri wɔn a wɔfom wɔn nneɛma no nsam.

Nanso wɔn atemmufoɔ no mpo, wɔantie wɔn, na mmom wɔne anyame foforɔ bɔɔ adwaman, na wɔkotoo wɔn. Wɔantwentwɛn wɔn nan ase koraa na wɔmane firii kwan a wɔn agyanom faa soɔ no so. Wɔn agyanom dii Awurade ahyɛdeɛ so, nanso wɔn deɛ, wɔanyɛ saa.

Na sɛ Awurade ma wɔn atemmufoɔ a, na Awurade di ɔtemmufoɔ biara akyi. Na ɔtemmufoɔ no nna nyinaa, ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn atamfo nsam, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛha Awurade sɛ ɔbɛhunu sɛ wɔn atamfo ne asɔretiafoɔ nti wɔresi apini.

Nanso sɛ ɔtemmufoɔ no wu pɛ a, wɔdane wɔn ho kɔyɛ akyiwadeɛ a ɛsene deɛ wɔn agyanom ayɛ pɛn, na wɔkɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi som wɔn koto wɔn. Wɔansesa wɔn akwan na wɔannane amfiri wɔn nneyɛɛ bɔne no ho.
Afei Awurade abufuo dɛre tiaa Israel, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛsiane sɛ ɔman yi amane afiri m'apam a me ne wɔn agyanom yɛeɛ no ho na wɔantie me nti,
me nso, merempamo aman a Yosua wu gyaa wɔn yi baako mpo mfiri wɔn anim.
Na menam wɔn so bɛsɔ Israel ahwɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa Awurade kwan so sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom yɛeɛ no anaa wɔremfa so.”
Enti Awurade gyaa amanaman no komm, na wampamo wɔn ntɛm ara, na wamfa wɔn anhyɛ Yosua nsa.
3: Na yeinom ne amanaman a Awurade gyaa wɔn wɔ asase no so sɛ ɔde wɔn bɛsɔ Israel ahwɛ no, wɔn a wɔanhunu ɛko a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Kanaan no nyinaa,
sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Israel awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔnhunuu biribi a ɛte saa da no bɛsua akodie na wɔanya ɛko mu suahunu.
Yeinom ne Filistifoɔ ahemfo nnum no ne Kanaanfoɔ nyinaa, ne Sidonfoɔ ne Hiwifoɔ a wɔte Bepɔ Lebanon soɔ, ɛfiri Bepɔ Baal-Hermon ho kɔsi Hamat no.
Na wɔde wɔn sɔɔ Israelfoɔ hwɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi mmara a Awurade nam Mose so de maa wɔn agyanom no so anaa.
Enti Israelfoɔ tenaa Kanaanfoɔ, Hitifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hiwifoɔ, ne Yebusifoɔ no mu.
Na wɔfaa wɔn mma mmaa wareeɛ, na wɔde wɔn mma mmaa nso maa wɔn mma mmarima, na wɔsom wɔn anyame.
Enti Israelfoɔ yɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, na wɔn werɛ firii Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn na wɔkɔsom Baal ahoni ne abosonnua.
Na Awurade abufuo dɛre tiaa Israelfoɔ na ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Mesopotamia hene Kusan-Risataim nsa; na Israelfoɔ som Kusan-Risataim mfeɛ nwɔtwe.
Ɛnna Israelfoɔ su frɛɛ Awurade, enti Awurade maa Israelfoɔ no ɔgyefoɔ bi a ɔbɛgye wɔn. Ɔno ne Kaleb nua kumaa Kenas ba Otniel.
Na Awurade honhom baa ne so na ɔbɛyɛɛ Israel temmufoɔ. Na berɛ a ɔfirii adi kɔkoeɛ no, Awurade de Mesopotamia hene Kusan-Risataim hyɛɛ ne nsa na ɔdii Kusan-Risataim so nkonim.
Afei asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduanan. Akyire yi, Kenas ba Otniel wuiɛ.
Na ntɛm ara na Israelfoɔ kɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so bio. Na Awurade maa Moab hene Eglon ho yɛɛ den boroo Israel so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so.
Na ɔboaboaa Ammonfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ ano kaa ne ho baa wɔn so, na wɔkunkum Israelfoɔ na wɔfaa mmɛ kuro no.
Na Israelfoɔ som Moab hene Eglon mfeɛ dunwɔtwe.
Afei Israelfoɔ firii aseɛ su frɛɛ Awurade, enti Awurade maa wɔn ɔgyefoɔ bi. Oyi ne Gera ba Ehud, Benyaminni a ɔyɛ abenkumma no. Na Israelfoɔ faa ne so de ayɛyɛdeɛ kɔmaa Moab hene Eglon.
Na Ehud yɛɛ nkrantɛ anofanu a ne tenten yɛ basafa baako. Ɔde bɔɔ n’asene wɔ n’atadeɛ ase, ne dwonku nifa so.
Enti ɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ no kɔmaa Moab hene Eglon. Na Eglon yɛ ɔbarima a ɔso yie.
Na berɛ a ɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ no maa no wieeɛ ara pɛ na ɔgyaa wɔn a wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ no baeɛ no kwan.

Na ɔno ara deɛ, ɔdanee ne ho firii ahoni a ɛwɔ Gilgal no, ɔsane n’akyi bɛka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ: “O ɔhene, mepɛ sɛ me ne wo ka asomsɛm bi.” Enti ɔkaa sɛ: “Twɛn, mo nyɛ komm!” Afei wɔn a wɔgyina ne nkyɛn nyinaa firii adi.
Na Ehud baa ne nkyɛn berɛ a ɔno nko ara te n’abansoro pia mu, baabi a ɛhɔ dwoɔ no. Na Ehud ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mewɔ asɛm bi firi Onyankopɔn hɔ ma wo.” Ɔtee saa no, ɔsɔre firii n’adwa so.
Ɛnna Ehud de ne nsa benkum twee nkrantɛ no firii n’ataaso wɔ ne nifa, na ɔde wɔɔ ne yam.
Wantwe nkrantɛ no amfiri ne yam, enti dadeɛ no ne dua no nyinaa wuraa ne yam maa sradeɛ yɛɛ ho, na tiafi dii so baeɛ.
Na Ehud totoo abansoro dan no apono mu wɔ n’akyi, na ɔfaa tokuro mu pueeɛ.
Na ɔfirii adi kɔeɛ. Na ne nkoa bɛhwɛeɛ, na wɔhunuu sɛ wɔatoto abansoro apono no mu. Enti wɔkaa sɛ: “Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔregya ne nan wɔ pia mu hɔ nono.”
Na wɔgyinaa hɔ kyɛreeɛ. Afei na asɛm no ha wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ obiara ammue pia no apono no. Enti wɔfaa safoa bueeɛ, na wɔnkɔhwɛ a, wɔn hene na ɔda fam tim a wawuo yi!
Berɛ a wɔda so gyinagyina hɔ twentwɛn wɔn nan ase no, na Ehud adwane kɔ dadaada. Ɔdwane twam kɔfaa ahoni no mu kɔɔ Seira.
Na ɔduruu hɔ no, ɔfirii aseɛ hyɛnee abɛn wɔ Efraim bepɔ no so, na ɔdii Israelfoɔ no anim ne wɔn siane firii bepɔ no so.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monni m’akyi ɛfiri sɛ Awurade de mo atamfo Moabfoɔ no ahyɛ mo nsa.” Enti wɔdii n’akyi, na wɔko faa Yordan asutwareeɛ no sii Moabfoɔ no kwan, na wɔamma obiara antwam amfa hɔ.
Na saa berɛ no wɔkunkum Moab mmarima akantinka ahoɔdenfoɔ bɛyɛ mpem du (10,000); baako mpo antumi annwane.
Enti Israel dii Moab so nkonim, na asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe.
N’akyi no, Anat ba Samgar nso gyee Israelfoɔ firii Filistifoɔ nsam, na ɔde poma a wɔde ka nantwie kɔkunkum mmarima ahansia.
4: Ehud wuo akyi no, Israelfoɔ firii aseɛ yɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so bio.
Enti Awurade tɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Kanaan hene Yabin a na ɔdi hene wɔ Hasor no nsa. Na ne sahene ne Sisera, na na ɔte Haroset-Hagoyim.
Na Israelfoɔ firii aseɛ su frɛɛ Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ dadeɛ nteaseɛnam ahankron na ɔhyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no so dendeenden mfeɛ aduonu.
Saa berɛ no na Lapidot yere Debora a ɔyɛ odiyifoɔbaa no na ɔbu atɛn wɔ Israel.
Na ɔte Debora abedua ase wɔ Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so, na na Israelfoɔ no kɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.

Na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ Kedes-Naftali kɔfrɛɛ Abinoam ba Barak baeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade nhyɛɛ wo anaa? ‘Fa mmarima mpem du firi Naftali ne Sebulon mmusua mu ka wo ho kɔ Bepɔ Tabor so.
Na mɛtwetwe Yabin sahene Sisera ne ne nteaseɛnam ne ne dɔm aba wo nkyɛn wɔ Kison subɔn no ho, na mede no bɛhyɛ wo nsa.’”
Ɛnna Barak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ wo ne me bɛkɔ a, ɛnneɛ mɛkɔ, na sɛ wo ne me ankɔ a, ɛnneɛ me nso merenkɔ.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ den, me ne wo bɛkɔ. Nanso animuonyam a ɛbɛfiri akwantuo no mu aba no renyɛ wo dea, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbaa na Awurade de Sisera bɛhyɛ ne nsa.” Afei Debora sɔre ne Barak kɔɔ Kedes.
Na Barak boaboaa Sebulon ne Naftali ano baa Kedes, na mmarima mpem du dii n’akyi kɔeɛ (10,000); na Debora nso kaa ne ho kɔeɛ.
Saa berɛ no na Kenini barima bi a ɔde Heber ate ne ho afiri Kenifoɔ a wɔyɛ Mose ase Hobab mma no ho, na ɔkɔsii ne ntomadan dupɔn bi ho wɔ Saananim wɔ Kedes.
Ɛnna wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Sisera sɛ Abinoam ba Barak aforo kɔ Bepɔ Tabor so.
Ntɛm ara na Sisera boaboaa ne nteaseɛnam nyinaa, dadeɛ nteaseɛnam ahankron no, ano, na ɔboaboaa nnipa a wɔka ne ho nyinaa ano firii Haroset-Hagoyim baa Kison subɔn no ho.
Ɛnna Debora ka kyerɛɛ Barak sɛ: “Sɔre! Ɛnnɛ na Awurade de Sisera bɛhyɛ wo nsa. Wonnim sɛ Awurade adi w’anim dada?” Ɛnna Barak de mmarima mpem du dii n’akyi siane firii Bepɔ Tabor soɔ.
Na Awurade maa Sisera ne ne nteaseɛnam ne n’asraafoɔ nyinaa de wɔn ti pempemeeɛ, na wɔtotɔɔ nkrantɛ ano wɔ Barak anim. Afei Sisera si firii ne teaseɛnam mu dwaneeɛ.
Na Barak tii nteaseɛnam ne asraafoɔ no kɔduruu Haroset-Hagoyim, na Sisera asraafoɔ no nyinaa totɔɔ nkrantɛ ano. Baako mpo anka.
Nanso Sisera deɛ, ɔdwane kɔɔ Kenini Heber yere Yael ntomadan mu, ɛfiri sɛ na asomdwoeɛ wɔ Hasor hene Yabin ne Kenini Heber fiefoɔ ntam.
Na Yael firii adi kɔhyiaa Sisera, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Me wura, mane fa ha bra me nkyɛn; nsuro.” Enti ɔmane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ ntomadan no mu, na ɔde kuntu kataa ne so.
Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no sɛ: “Sukɔm de me; mesrɛ wo, ma me nsuo kakra nnom.” Ɛnna ɔbaa no buee nufosuo kotokuo ano hwiee bi maa no nomeeɛ, na ɔsane kataa ne so.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no bio sɛ: “Kɔgyina ntomadan no ano, na ebia obi bɛba abɛbisa wo sɛ, ‘Ɔbarima bi aba ha?’ Ɔbisa saa a, ka sɛ ‘Dabi!’”

Afei Heber yere Yael kɔfaa ntomadan pɛɛwa ne asaeɛ. Na berɛ a Sisera abrɛ na wada hatee no, ɔbaa no wiawiaa ne ho kɔɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔde asaeɛ no bɔɔ pɛɛwa no so wuraa n’asontorɔm maa no sii fam. Enti ɔwuiɛ.

Saa berɛ no nyinaa na Barak reti Sisera. Na Yael bɛhyiaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Bra na menkyerɛ wo ɔbarima a worehwehwɛ no no.” Enti ɔkɔɔ ɔbaa no nkyɛn, na ɔnkɔhwɛ a, Sisera na awu da hɔ a pɛɛwa tua n’asontorɔm yi!
Enti saa da no, Onyankopɔn brɛɛ Kanaan hene Yabin ase maa Israelfoɔ no.
Na Israelfoɔ maa wɔn nsa yɛɛ duru wɔ Kanaan hene Yabin so kɔsii sɛ wɔkum Kanaan hene Yabin.
5: Ɛnna Debora ne Abinoam ba Barak too dwom sɛ:
“Sɛ Israel mu atitire dii wɔn anim, na ɔman no nso yii wɔn yam baeɛ nti; Monhyira Awurade.
O Ahemfo, montie; O aberempɔn, monyɛ aso: Mɛto sankuo dwom ama Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn.
Awurade, berɛ a wofiri Seir, Berɛ a wofiri Edom asase so baeɛ no, Asase wosoeɛ, ɔsoro asusɔ tueeɛ,
Mmepɔ popoo firii Awurade anim, Sinai firii Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade anim.
Anat ba Samgar berɛ so, Yael berɛ so, akwan dedaa mpan, Akwantufoɔ a wɔfa atempɔn soɔ nwonwan kɔfaa anammɔnkwan so.
Nnipa tu firii nkuraaseɛ, wɔtu firii Israel nkuraaseɛ Kɔsii sɛ me Debora, mesɔreeɛ, Kɔsii sɛ mesɔree sɛ ɔbaatan wɔ Israel.
Sɛ wɔyiyi anyame foforɔ a, afei dɔm bɛto hyɛ wɔn so wɔ kuro apono ano. Wɔhunuu kyɛm anaa pea Israel mu nnipa mpem aduanan mu?
M’akoma da Israel asahene so, Wɔn a wɔyii wɔn yam baeɛ no so.
Mo a motete mfunumu abereɛ afufuo soɔ, Mo a motete kuntu fɛfɛ soɔ,

Wɔtee nsusafoɔ nne nsubura ho, Na ɛhɔ na wɔfirii aseɛ kaa Awurade adetenenee ho asɛm, Ɛhɔ na wɔkaa ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔtete Israel nkuraaseɛ no adetenenee ho asɛm. Afei Awurade man siane kɔɔ kuro apono ano.
Kanyan wo ho, Debora, kanyan wo ho; Kanyan wo ho, kanyan wo ho, to dwom! Sɔre ɛ, O Abinoam ba Barak, sɔre di wo nnommum anim kɔ!
Saa berɛ no na wɔn a wɔkaeɛ no baa atumfoɔ no nkyɛn; Awurade man bɛgyinaa m’afa ko tiaa nnɔmmarima maa me.
Wɔfirii Efraimfoɔ a wɔn nhini muni dii  Amalek soɔ, w’akyiri na Benyamin baa wo man mma no mu. Makir mu na asahene firi baeɛ, Na Sebulon mu na wɔn a wɔkura ɔsafohene poma.
Na Isakar akunini kaa Debora ho, Na sɛdeɛ Isakar teɛ no, saa ara na Barak teɛ. Ɔnante kɔɔ asasetamaa no so. Ruben mmusua no mu na akoma mu pɔbɔ a ɛsoso wɔ.
Ɛdeɛn nti na na wote nnwanmuo mmienu ntam retie mmɛn a nnwanhwɛfoɔ rehyɛne? Ruben asuwa no ano na akoma mu mpeepeemu akɛseɛ wɔ.
Gilead tenaa ne fie wɔ Yordan agya nohoa; Na Dan nso, adɛn nti na ɔtenaa nsuhyɛn mu? Aser yii n’ani tenaa mpoano, Ɔtenaa hyɛn gyinabea hɔ ara.
Sebulon yɛ ɔman a ɔde ne kra sɔɔ owuo hwɛeɛ; Naftali nso yɛɛ saa ara wɔ nkokoɔ so.
Ahemfo bɛkoeɛ; Wɔ Taanak, Megido asuo ho.
Nsoromma firi soro bɛkoeɛ, Wɔfiri wɔn akwan so ne Sisera bɛkoeɛ.
Kison asubɔnten, tete asubɔnten, Kison asubɔnten hohoroo wɔn kɔeɛ. O Me kra, tiatia ahoɔden so.
Saa berɛ no, apɔnkɔ tuu mmirika kiridikiridi, Na wɔn nan pempem fam kimkim.
Awurade bɔfoɔ kaa sɛ, ‘Monnome Meros,’ Ɛfiri sɛ wɔammɛboa Awurade, Wɔamɛboa Awurade antia dɔmmanin no.’
Wɔbɛhyira Kenini Heber yere Yael wɔ mmaa mu, Wɔbɛhyira no mmaa mu wɔ ntomadan mu.
Ɔbisaa nsuo, na ɔde nufosuo maa no; Ɔde nufosuo guu atumfoɔ sɛn mu baeɛ.
Ɔtenee ne nsa faa ntomadan pɛɛwa, Na ɔde adwumayɛfoɔ saeɛ hyɛɛ ne nsa nifa mu. Ɔbɔɔ so wuraa Sisera tirim pɛkyɛɛ ne ti,
Ɔhwee ne nan ntam daa hɔ; Baabi a ɔhweeɛ no, ɛhɔ ara na n’ahoɔden kɔsoe wuiɛ.
Ɔbaa bi de n’ani hwɛɛ mpomma mu sɛ ɔbɛhu no anaa, Sisera maame de n’ani hwɛɛ ntokuwa mu "aniahunuankansa", ‘Adɛn nti na ne teaseɛnam akyɛ saa? Adɛn nti na ɛbɛsi sɛsɛɛ mentee n’apɔnkɔ nan aseɛ?’
Ne mmaa mu atitire a wɔyɛ anyansafoɔ bua no, Ɔno ara de ne nsɛm bɛbua ne ho,

‘Ɛnyɛ asadeɛ na wɔrehwehwɛ? Ɔsraani biara nya ababaa baako anaa mmienu, Na Sisera nso nya ntoma a wɔahyɛ no aduro, Atadeɛ a wɔanwene mu, ntoma a wɔahyɛ no aduro, ne ntadeɛ mmienu a wɔanwene mu, Asadeɛ a mmarima de bɛgu wɔn kɔn mu.’
O Awurade, ma w’atamfo nyinaa nsɛe saa ara, Na ma w’adɔfo nyɛ sɛ awia a ɛgyina so dendeenden.” Afei asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduanan.
6: Na Israelfoɔ firii aseɛ yɛɛ Awurade ani so bɔne, enti Awurade de wɔn hyɛɛ Midian nsa mfeɛ nson.
Na Midian dii Israel so nkonim. Midian nti Israelfoɔ yɛɛ amena wɔ mmepɔ mu, abodan ne huntabea fae.
Na sɛ Israelfoɔ yɛ afuo a, na Midianfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ ne Apueeɛfoɔ abɛto ahyɛ wɔn so.
Wɔboaboa wɔn ano ne wɔn ko, na wɔsɛe wɔn asase no so nnɔbaeɛ nyinaa kɔsi Gasa, na wɔnnya aduane anaa odwan anaa nantwie anaa afunumu biara wɔ Israel.
Na wɔde wɔn mmoa ne wɔn ntomadan nyinaa ba. Na wɔba yuu sɛ ntutummɛ; wɔne wɔn yoma nni ano, na wɔba asase no so bɛsɛe no.
Midianfoɔ yi nti, ohia fitaa kaa Israelfoɔ no. Afei Israelfoɔ su frɛɛ Awurade.
Na berɛ a Midianfoɔ haa Israelfoɔ maa wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade no,
Awurade somaa odiyifoɔ bi baa Israelfoɔ nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie, ‘Me na meyii mo firii Egypt de mo firii nkoafie baeɛ.
Na megyee mo firii Egypt ne wɔn a wɔhaa mo nyinaa nsam, na mepamoo wɔn firii mo anim, na mede wɔn asase maa mo.
Bio nso meka kyerɛɛ mo sɛ: “Mene Awurade mo Nyankopɔn. Monnsuro Amorifoɔ a mote wɔn asase soɔ no anyame.” Nanso moantie me.’”
Akyire yi Awurade bɔfoɔ bɛtenaa dupɔn a ɛsi Ofra no ase, Abiesarni Yoas dupɔn no. Saa berɛ no na ne ba Gideon reporo ayuo wɔ nsa-kyi-amena mu, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a Midianfoɔ no renhunu.
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɔkatakyie kokoɔdurofoɔ, Awurade ka wo ho.”

Ɛnna Gideon ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “O Me wura, mesrɛ wo, sɛ Awurade ka yɛn ho ampa a, adɛn nti na awie yɛn sei? N’anwanwadeɛ a yɛn agyanom kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ yɛn no wɔ he? Wɔkaa sɛ, ‘Ɛnyɛ Egypt na Awurade yii yɛn firiiɛ?’ Na afei deɛ Awurade apo yɛn, na ɔde yɛn ahyɛ Midianfoɔ nsa.”
Na Awurade danee n’ani kyerɛɛ no kaa sɛ: “Fa ahoɔden a wowɔ yi ara kɔ, na wobɛgye Israelfoɔ afiri Midianfoɔ nsam. Ɛnyɛ me na meresoma woɔ?”
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “O Awurade. Ɛdeɛn na mede bɛgye Israel? Hwɛ, Manase abusuakuo mu nyinaa, m’asafo na yɛnni ahoɔden koraa, na mene kumaa wɔ m’agya fie.”
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mɛdi w’akyi, na wobɛsɛe Midianfoɔ sɛ onipa baako bi.”
Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: “Sɛ manya w’anim adom a, ɛnneɛ yɛ sɛnkyerɛnne bi ma menhunu sɛ wo na wo ne me rekasa.
Mesrɛ wo mfiri ha nkɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba wo nkyɛn de m’ayɛyɛdeɛ abɛsi w’anim.” Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mɛtena ha atwɛn akɔsi sɛ wobɛba.”
Na Gideon kɔpɛɛ abirekyie ba bi noaeɛ, na ɔde esiam efa baako yɛɛ paanoo a mmɔreka nnim. Afei ɔde nam no guu kɛntɛn mu de ɛho nsuo no nso guu kukuo mu, na ɔde brɛɛ no dupɔn no ase.
Na Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa nam ne paanoo a mmɔreka nnim no kɔsi ɔbotan kɛseɛ no so, na hwie ɛho nsuo no gu so.” Na ɔyɛɛ saa.
Ɛnna Awurade bɔfoɔ no de poma a ɔkura no ano kaa nam ne paanoo no, na egya firi ɔbotan no mu bɛhyee nam ne paanoo no. Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no yera firii n’anim.
Afei Gideon hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade bɔfoɔ. Enti Gideon kaa sɛ: “Ei, O Awurade Nyankopɔn! Awurade bɔfoɔ na mahunu n’anim yi!”
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Asomdwoeɛ nka wo, nsuro. Worenwu.”
Enti Gideon sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ maa Awurade, na wɔfrɛ no Yahwe-Shalom [aseɛ ne sɛ: Awurade ne asomdwoeɛ] bɛsi nnɛ. Ɛwɔ Abiesarfoɔ kuro Ofra mu.
Na saa anadwo no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Fa wo papa nantwinini a ɔtɔ so mmienu a wadi mfeɛ nson no, na bubu Baal afɔrebukyia a wo papa siiɛ no, na twa bosom dua a ɛwɔ ho no.
Na hyehyɛ aboɔ fa yɛ afɔrebukyia ma Awurade wo Nyankopɔn wɔ aban yi atifi, na twitwa bosom dua a wobɛtwa no mu asinasini na fa nantwinini a ɔtɔ so mmienu yi bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ so.”
Enti Gideon yii ne nkoa no mu mmarima du sɛ wɔrekɔyɛ deɛ Awurade aka akyerɛ no no. Nanso na ɔsuro ne papa fiefoɔ ne kurom hɔfoɔ, enti wanyɛ adwuma no awia; na mmom ɔyɛɛ no anadwo.

Na anɔpahema a kurom hɔfoɔ sɔreeɛ no, wɔnkɔhwɛ a, Baal afɔrebukyia na wɔabubu no yi, na bosom dua a ɛwɔ ho no nso na wɔatwa yi! Na wɔde nantwinini a ɔtɔ so mmienu no nso abɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia a wɔasie no so.
Na wɔbisabisaa wɔn ho sɛ: “Hwan na ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ yi?” Ɛnna wɔfirii aseɛ hwehwɛɛ mu. Akyire yi wɔkaa sɛ: “Yoas ba Gideon na ɔdii saa dwuma yi.”
Enti kurom hɔfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ Yoas sɛ: “Fa wo ba no bra ma yɛnku no, ɛfiri sɛ wabubu Baal afɔrebukyia na watwa bosom dua a ɛwɔ ho no nso atwene.”

Ɛnna Yoas ka kyerɛɛ nnipa a wɔsɔre tiaa no no nyinaa sɛ: “Mo na mobɛdi Baal asɛm ama no, anaa mo na mobɛgye no? Deɛ ɔbɛko ama no no, wɔnku no anɔpa yi ara. Sɛ ɔyɛ onyame na obi abubu n’afɔrebukyia a, momma ɔno ara nko mma ne ho.”
Enti da no ara, ɔtoo ne din Yerubaal, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Obi abubu Baal afɔrebukyia a, momma ɔno ara nko mma ne ho.”
Na Midianfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ ne Apueeɛfoɔ nyinaa boaa wɔn ano na wɔtwa baa Yesreel bɔn mu.
Na Awurade honhom bɛsii Gideon so, na ɔhyɛnee totorobɛnto frɛɛ Abiesarfoɔ bɛdii n’akyi.
Bio nso, ɔtuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Manase asase nyinaa so, na wɔn nso bɛdii n’akyi. Na ɔtuu abɔfoɔ foforɔ kɔɔ Aser ne Sebulon ne Naftali nsase so, na wɔbɛhyiaa no.
Na Gideon ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn sɛ: “Sɛ wonam me so bɛgye Israel, sɛdeɛ woaka no a,
ɛnneɛ mede odwan nwi rekɔhata ayuporobea. Sɛ bosuo fɔ odwan nwi no nko ara, na fam hɔ nyinaa wo a, mɛhunu ampa sɛ wonam me so bɛgye Israel, sɛdeɛ woaka no.”
Na saa ara na ɛbaeɛ. Berɛ a ɔsɔree anɔpa a ɔkyii bosuo no firii odwan nwi no mu no, nsuo a ɛfiri mu baeɛ no yɛɛ koraa kɛseɛ ma.

Ɛnna Gideon ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, mma wo bo mmfu me; ma menka asɛm baako pɛ. Ma memfa odwan nwi yi nsɔ adeɛ baako pɛ nhwɛ. Mesrɛ wo ma nwi no nko ara nwo, na bosuo ntɔ ngu fam hɔ nyinaa.”
Na anadwo no, Onyankopɔn yɛɛ saa. Nwi no nko ara woeɛ, na bosuo tɔ guu fam hɔ nyinaa.
7: Ɛnna Yerubaal a wɔsane frɛ no Gideon ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa sɔree ntɛm, na wɔkɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Harod abura ho. Saa berɛ yi na Midianfoɔ dɔm nso wɔ n’atifi fam wɔ More kokoɔ ho, asasetamaa no so.
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: “Nnipa a wɔka wo ho no dɔɔso dodo sɛ mede Midian bɛhyɛ wɔn nsa. Anhwɛ a Israel bɛhoahoa ne ho aka akyerɛ me sɛ ‘Me ara me nsa na ɛgyee me.’

Afei frɛ nnipa no na pae no ɔman no asomu sɛ, ‘Hwan na ɔsuro na n’akoma atuo? Ɔnsane n'akyi, na ɔnnane n'ani mfiri Gilead bepɔ ho nkɔ.’” Enti Gideon sɔɔ wɔn hwɛeɛ. Ɛbaa saa no, nnipa mpem aduonu mmienu (22,000) sanee wɔn akyi maa no kaa nnipa mpem du (10,000).

Nanso Awurade sane ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: “Nnipa a wɔaka yi mpo dɔɔso. Ma wɔnkɔ asuo no ho na mensɔ wɔn nhwɛ wɔ hɔ mma wo. Afei sɛ meka kyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Oyi ne wo bɛkɔ’ a, ɔno na ɔne wo bɛkɔ. Na sɛ meka kyerɛ wo sɛ ‘Oyi ne wo renkɔ’ a, ɔrenkɔ.”

Ɛnna ɔde nnipa no kɔɔ asuo no ho. Afei Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: “Obiara a ɔbɛtafere nsuo sɛdeɛ kraman tafere nsuo no, ma no nnyina nkyɛn. Na obiara a ɔbɛbu nkotodwe anom nsuo no nso, yɛ no saa ara.”
Na mmarima a wɔtaferee nsuo wɔ wɔn nsam no ano si ahasa. Na wɔn a wɔaka nyinaa buu nkotodwe nom nsuo no.
Ɛnna Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: “Mmarima ahasa a wɔnom nsuo wɔ wɔn nsam yi so na menam bɛgye mo, na mede Midian bɛhyɛ mo nsa. Ma nnipa a wɔaka no nyinaa nsane nkɔ wɔn afie.”

Enti wɔgyee nnipa no nsam akwansoduane ne wɔn ntotorobɛnto, na ɔmaa Israel mmarima no nyinaa kɔɔ wɔn afie. Na mmarima ahasa no deɛ, ɔmaa wɔkaeɛ. Saa berɛ yi na Midianfoɔ gu aseɛ hɔ wɔ asasetamaa no so.
Na anadwo no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɔre siane kɔ asraafoɔ asoɛeɛ hɔ na mede ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na sɛ wosuro sɛ wobɛkɔ a, fa wo somfoɔ Pura ka wo ho kɔ asoɛeɛ hɔ.
Na tie asɛm a wɔbɛka no, na akyire yi wo nsa bɛyɛ den na woakɔ wɔn so wɔ nsraban no mu.” Enti ɔne ne somfoɔ Pura siane kɔɔ nsraban no nkyɛn baabi, baabi a asraafoɔ a wɔrewɛn asoɛeɛ hɔ no wɔ no.
Saa berɛ yi na Midianfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ ne Apueeɛfoɔ nyinaa abɛsum asasetamaa no so sɛ ntutummɛ. Wɔn yoma nni ano; wɔdɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea.

Na berɛ a Gideon duruu hɔ no, ɔtee sɛ ɔbarima bi reka ne daeɛ akyerɛ ne yɔnko. Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mesoo daeɛ bi. Na mehunuu sɛ atokoɔ paanoo kurukuruwa bi redanedane ba Midian asoɛeɛ hɔ. Berɛ a ɛbɛduruu ntomadan ho no baabi no, ɛdanee no butuiɛ, na ntomadan no tutu guu hɔ.”
Ɛnna ne yɔnko no kaa sɛ: “Yei deɛ, ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ Yoas ba Gideon, Israelni no, nkrantɛ. Onyankopɔn de Midian ne ne dɔm no nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa.”
Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ a Gideon tee daeɛ no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase koto sɔreeɛ. Afei ɔsane baa Israelfoɔ asoɛeɛ hɔ, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monsɔre, na Awurade de Midian asraafoɔ asoɛeɛ hɔ ahyɛ mo nsa.”
Ɛnna ɔkyɛɛ mmarima ahasa no mu yɛɛ wɔn akuo mmiɛnsa. Na ɔde ntotorobɛnto ne nkuruwa hunu hyehyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa nsam. Na gyatɛnee hyehyɛ nkuruwa no mu.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monhwɛ deɛ mɛyɛ biara na monyɛ bi. Sɛ meduru asoɛeɛ no ano a, biribiara a mɛyɛ no, mo nso monyɛ saa ara.
Na sɛ me ne wɔn a wɔka me ho no hyɛne totorobɛnto no a, mo nso monhyɛne ntotorobɛnto ntwa asoɛeɛ no ho nhyia, na monka sɛ, ‘Awurade nkrantɛ ne Gideon deɛ nie!’”

Enti dasuom no, Gideon ne mmarima ɔha a wɔka ne ho no baa asoɛeɛ no ano. Saa berɛ yi ara na wɔde awɛmfoɔ akɔgyinagyina wɔn awɛneeɛ. Na wɔfirii aseɛ hyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no, na wɔbobɔɔ nkuruwa a wɔkurakura no.

Na akuo mmiɛnsa no hyenhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto no na wɔbobɔɔ nkuruwa no. Wɔde gyatɛnee no hyɛɛ wɔn nsa benkum mu, na wɔde ntotorobɛnto no hyɛɛ wɔn nsa nifa mu hyɛneeɛ, na wɔteateaam sɛ: “Awurade nkrantɛ ne Gideon deɛ!”
Saa berɛ yi nyinaa na obiara gyina n’afa atwa asoɛeɛ no ho ahyia. Na dɔm no nyinaa sɔɔ mmirika mu de nteateamu dwaneeɛ.

Berɛ a ahasa no kɔɔ so hyɛnee wɔn ntotorobɛnto no. Awurade maa obiara a ɔwɔ asoɛeɛ hɔ de ne nkrantɛ kɔɔ ne yɔnko so, na dɔm no dwane kɔduruu Bet-Sita wɔ Serera, na wɔkɔeɛ ara kɔduruu Abel-Mehola wɔ Tabat ho.
Na wɔfrɛfrɛɛ Israel mmarima firii Naftali ne Aser ne Manase, na wɔtii Midianfoɔ no.

Na Gideon tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Efraim bepɔ nyinaa so, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Monkɔdi Midianfoɔ anim nsisi asuo no ano akwan nkɔsi Bet-Bara ne Yordan.” Enti wɔfrɛɛ Efraim mmarima nyinaa hyiaeɛ, na wɔkɔsisii asuo no ano akwan kɔsii Bet-Bara ne Yordan.

Afei wɔkyeree Midian asafohene mmienu a wɔn din de Oreb ne Seeb, na wɔkum Oreb wɔ Oreb botan so, na wɔkum Seeb wɔ Seeb nsa-kyi-amena ho. Na wɔkɔɔ so ara tii Midianfoɔ no, na wɔde Oreb ne Seeb tiri kɔmaa Gideon wɔ Yordan mpɔtamu hɔ. Midianfoɔ so nkonimdie awieeɛ
8: Na Efraimfoɔ bisaa no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi? Adɛn nti na wo ne Midianfoɔ rekɔko no woamfrɛ yɛn?” Enti wɔne no ham dendeenden paa.
Ɛnna ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na mayɛ a ɛsene mo deɛ? Bobe ase nkaeɛ a Efraim sesaeɛ no nyɛ nkyɛn bobe a Abiesar atwa aboaboa ano?
Mo nsam na Onyankopɔn de Midianfoɔ akunini Oreb ne Seeb ahyɛ. Ɛdeɛn na mayɛ a ɛbɛto deɛ moayɛ yi?” Ɔkaa saa no wɔn bo dwoeɛ.
Afei Gideon ne mmarima ahasa a wɔka ne ho no bɛduruu Yordan ho na wɔtwaeɛ. Na wɔabrɛ deɛ, nanso wɔkɔɔ so ara tii wɔn.
Na akyire yi ɔka kyerɛɛ Sukotfoɔ sɛ: “Mesrɛ mo, momma mmarima a wɔdi m’akyi yi paanoo nni, ɛfiri sɛ wɔabrɛ, na mereti Midian ahemfo Sebah ne Salmuna.”
Nanso Sukot atitire no kaa sɛ: “Wo nsa aka Sebah ne Salmuna awie na yɛmma wo dɔm paanoo yi?”
Na Gideon buaa sɛ: “Yei nti sɛ Awurade nya de Sebah ne Salmuna hyɛ me nsa a, mede serɛ so nkasɛɛ ne hwerɛmo bɛtete mo nam.”
Na ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Penuel de asɛnkorɔ no ara kɔtoo wɔn anim, nanso deɛ Sukotfoɔ kaeɛ no ara na Penuelfoɔ nso ka kyerɛɛ no.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ Penuelfoɔ nso sɛ: “Sɛ mesane ba asomdwoeɛ mu a, mɛdwiri abantenten yi agu fam.”
Saa berɛ no na Sebah ne Salmuna ne wɔn dɔm wɔ Karkor. Na Apueeɛfoɔ dɔm a aka no nyinaa yɛ mpem dunum (15,000), ɛfiri sɛ na asraafoɔ mpem ɔha aduonu (120,000) a wɔtwe nkrantɛ atotɔ akono.
Na Gideon toaa so kɔfaa wɔn a wɔte ntomadan mu no kwan so wɔ Noba ne Yogbeha apueeɛ, na ɔto hyɛɛ asraafoɔ no so berɛ a wɔn ani nni wɔn ho soɔ.
Na Midian ahemfo mmienu no, Sebah ne Salmuna, dwaneeɛ na ɔtii wɔn ntɛm ara kɔkyee wɔn. Na ɔbɔɔ asraafoɔ no nyinaa guiɛ.
Afei Yoas ba Gideon firi akono kɔfaa kwan a ɛforo kɔ Heres no so sane baeɛ.
Na berɛ a ɔnam kwan so reba no, ɔkyee aberanteɛ bi a ɔfiri Sukot bisabisaa no nsɛm. Na ɔtwerɛɛ Sukot atitire ne wɔn mpanimfoɔ din maa no. Na wɔyɛ mmarima aduɔson nson.
Afei ɔfirii hɔ no, ɔkɔɔ Sukotfoɔ no so kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sebah ne Salmuna nie. Wɔn nti na motwaa me mpoa sɛ, ‘Wo nsa aka Sebah ne Salmuna awie na yɛmma wo mmarima a wɔabrɛ no paanoo yi?’”
Ɛnna ɔkyee kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ, na ɔde serɛ so nkasɛɛ ne hwerɛmo kyerɛɛ Sukot mmarima no nyansa.
Na ɔdwirii Penuel abantenten no guiɛ, na ɔkunkum kurom hɔ mmarima.
Afei ɔbisaa Sebah ne Salmuna sɛ: “Mmarima a mokum wɔn Tabor no te sɛn?” Na wɔbuaa sɛ: “Wɔte sɛ wo ara; wɔn nyinaa te sɛ ahenemma.”
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: “Wɔyɛ me nuanom, me maame mma. Na sɛ Awurade te aseɛ yi, sɛ moanku wɔn a, anka me nso merenku mo.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne ba panin Yeter sɛ: “Sɔre ku wɔn.” Nanso aberanteɛ no antumi antwe ne nkrantɛ wɔn so; na ɔyɛ aberantewaa, enti na ɔsuro.

Ɛnna Sebah ne Salmuna kaa sɛ: “Wo ara sɔre na ku yɛn, na sɛdeɛ ɔbarima teɛ no, saa ara na ne mmaninyɛ teɛ.” Enti Gideon sɔre kum Sebah ne Salmuna na ɔfaa nnwinneɛ a ɛte sɛ bosome a ɛdeda wɔn yoma kɔn mu no.
Akyire yi Israelfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: “Wo ne wo mma ne wo ba ba nyinaa nni yɛn so, ɛfiri sɛ woagye yɛn afiri Midianfoɔ nsam.”
Na Gideon ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Me deɛ, merenni mo so, na me ba nso renni mo so. Awurade na ɔbɛdi mo soɔ.”
Na Gideon toaa so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mepɛ sɛ moyɛ biribi ma me: Obiara mfa asom kawa a ɔnyaa no sɛ asadeɛ no mma me.” Ɛnam sɛ wɔyɛ Ismaelfoɔ enti no na wɔwɔ sika asum nkawa.
Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛde bɛma mo.” Enti wɔde ntoma sɛɛ fam, na obiara de asom kawa a ɔnyaeɛ no guu so.

Na sika asom nkawa a ɔgyeeɛ no ano si sika nnwetɛbena apem ahanson (1,700). Yei nka nnwinneɛ a ɛte sɛ bosome ne asomuadeɛ ne ntade kɔkɔɔ a na ɛhyehyɛ Midian ahemfo no, ne kɔnmuadeɛ a ɛdeda yoma kɔn mu no ho.
Na Gideon de yɛɛ asɔfotadeɛ na ɔde kɔsii ne kuro Ofra mu. Nanso Israelfoɔ danee no honi na wɔne no bɔɔ adwaman, na ɛbɛyɛɛ fidie maa Gideon ne ne fiefoɔ.
Na Israelfoɔ dii Midianfoɔ so nkonim, na wɔantumi amma wɔn tiri so bio, na asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduanan wɔ Gideon berɛ so.
Na Yoas ba Yerubaal sane kɔtenaa ne fie.
Gideon nyaa mma mmarima aduɔson a wɔfiri ɔno ara n’asene mu, ɛfiri sɛ na ne yerenom dɔɔso pii.
Na ɔwɔ mpena bi wɔ Sekem, na ɔno nso woo ɔbabarima maa no. Na ɔtoo ne din Abimelek.
Akyire yi, Yoas ba Gideon wuiɛ a na ne nna amee no, na wɔsiee no ne papa Yoas asieeɛ wɔ Abiesarfoɔ kuro Ofra mu.
Na berɛ a Gideon wuiɛ ara pɛ na Israelfoɔ no sane ne Baal kɔbɔɔ adwaman, na wɔde Baal-Berit yɛɛ wɔn nyame.
Na Israelfoɔ ankae Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn atamfo a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia nyinaa nsam no.
Na nnepa a Yerubaal anaa Gideon yɛɛ no Israel nyinaa akyi no, Israelfoɔ anyɛ ne fiefoɔ adɔeɛ antua ka. Abimelek nnebɔne ne ne sɛeɛ
9: Akyire yi Yerubaal ba Abimelek kɔɔ ne maame nuanom nkyɛn wɔ Sekem, na ɔne wɔn ne ne maame papa fiefoɔ nyinaa kɔkasaa sɛ:
“Monka mma Sekem mmarima nyinaa nte sɛ, ‘Ɛyɛ ma mo sɛ Yerubaal mma aduɔson no nyinaa bɛdi mo soɔ, anaa onipa baako? Monkae sɛ meyɛ mo dompe ne mo honam nso.’”
Enti ne maame nuanom kaa ne ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Sekem mmarima nyinaa maa wɔn akoma dane kɔɔ Abimelek so, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Ɔyɛ yɛn nua.”
Na wɔyii nnwetɛbena aduɔson firii Baal-Berit abosomfie de maa no, na Abimelek de bɔɔ ahuhufoɔ akwasampafoɔ bi paa sɛ wɔnni n’akyi.
Afei ɔkɔɔ ne papa fie wɔ Ofra kɔkunkum ne nuanom, Yerubaal mma mmarima aduɔson no, wɔ boɔ baako so. Ɛkaa Yerubaal ba kumaa Yotam nko ara, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkɔhuntaeɛ.
Enti Sekem mmarima ne Milofoɔ nyinaa hyiaeɛ, na wɔsii Abimelek hene wɔ dupɔn no ho, edum a ɛsi Sekem no ho.
Berɛ a wɔbɔɔ Yotam amanneɛ no, ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kɔgyinaa Bepɔ Gerisim atifi, na ɔmaa ne nne so teaam ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sekem mmarima, montie me, na Onyankopɔn nso ntie mo:
“Berɛ bi nnua nyinaa kɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔsra obi asi wɔn so hene. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ngodua sɛ, ‘Di yɛn so hene.’
Na ngodua bisaa wɔn sɛ, ‘Mopɛ sɛ megya me sradeɛ a wɔde hyɛ Onyankopɔn ne nnipa animuonyam no hɔ kɔhim me ho wɔ nnua foforɔ so anaa?’
Na nnua no ka kyerɛɛ borɔdɔma nso sɛ, ‘Bra bɛdi yɛn so hene.’
Na borɔdɔma bisaa wɔn sɛ, ‘Mopɛ sɛ megya me dɛ ne m’aba pa hɔ kɔhim me ho wɔ nnua foforɔ so anaa?’
Afei nnua no kɔka kyerɛɛ bobe sɛ, ‘Bra bɛdi yɛn so hene.’
Ɛnna bobe ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ‘Mopɛ sɛ megya me nsa foforɔ a ɛma Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ani gyeɛ no hɔ kɔhim me ho wɔ nnua foforɔ so anaa?’
Awieeɛ koraa no, nnua no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ nnɛnkyɛmse sɛ, ‘Wo deɛ, bra bɛdi yɛn so hene.’
Ɛnna nnɛnkyɛmse ka kyerɛɛ nnua no sɛ, ‘Sɛ ɛyɛ ampa sɛ mopɛ sɛ mosra me si mo so hene a, mommra me nwunu ase mmɛhome. Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, ɛnneɛ egya mfiri nnɛnkyɛmse mu mmɛhye Lebanon ntweneduro no.’
“Enti sɛ mofiri mo akomam ampa na mosii Abimelek hene na ɛtene sɛ moyɛɛ saa, na sɛ mo ne Yerubaal ne ne fie adi no yie, na deɛ ɔyɛeɛ so akatua nie,
na sɛ me papa ko maa mo na ɔde ne kra too ne nsam gyee mo firii Midian nsam,
na sɛ nnɛ moatu mo ani asi me papa fie so akunkum ne mma, mmarima aduɔson wɔ boɔ baako so, na sɛ mode n’afenaa ba Abimelek asi Sekem mmarima so hene, sɛ ɔyɛ mo nua nti,
na sɛ mo ne Yerubaal ne ne fie adi no nokorɛ ne tenenee mu ampa a, ɛnneɛ monni ahurisie Abimelek ho na ɔno nso nni ahurisie mo ho.
Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, ɛnneɛ egya mfiri Abimelek mu mmɛhye Sekem mmarima ne Milofoɔ, na egya mfiri Sekem mmarima mu ne Milofoɔ mmɛhye Abimelek.”
Afei Yotam de mmirika dwane kɔɔ Beer kɔtenaa hɔ, ne nua Abimelek ho suro nti.
Na Abimelek dii Israel so hene mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.
Ɛnna Onyankopɔn maa ntoto baa Abimelek ne Sekem mmarima ntam, na Sekem mmarima firii aseɛ twitwaa Abimelek nkontompo,

na ama amumuyɔsɛm a Abimelek de dii Yerubaal mma aduɔson no adane aba ne so na wɔn mogya abɛgu ne tiri so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na ɔkum wɔn. Na ɛbɛgu Sekem mmarima nso tiri so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔhyɛɛ ne nsam den maa no kum ne nuanom.
Enti Sekem mmarima maa nkurɔfoɔ kɔtɛɛ Abimelek wɔ mmepɔ atifi, na wɔgyee obiara a ɔbɛtwam wɔn nkyɛn no ho nneɛma wɔ kwan no so. Na wɔkɔbɔɔ Abimelek amanneɛ.
Na Ebed ba Gaal ne ne nuanom bɛtwaam kɔɔ Sekem, na Sekem mmarima de wɔn ho too ne so.
Na sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ daa no, wɔkɔɔ wɔn mfuo mu kɔtetee wɔn bobe nturo mu aba, na wɔkyi yɛɛ nsa, na wɔbɔɔ ose. Afei wɔkɔɔ wɔn nyame fie kɔdidi nomeeɛ na wɔdomee Abimelek.

Na Ebed ba Gaal kaa sɛ: “Hwan ne Abimelek, na hwan ne Sekem? Adɛn nti na yɛnsom no? Ɔnyɛ Yerubaal ba, na Sebul nyɛ ne nanmusini anaa? Sɛ mobɛsom Sekem agya Hamor asefoɔ a, monsom wɔn, na ɛdeɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn nso yɛsom no?
Sɛ ɔman yi hyɛ me nsa a, anka matu Abimelek adeɛ so dadaada.” Na ɔtoaa so ka kyerɛɛ Abimelek sɛ: “Ma wo dɔm nnɔɔso na firi bra.”
Na berɛ a Sebul a ɔyɛ amrado wɔ kurom hɔ tee Ebed ba Gaal nsɛm no, ne bo fuiɛ.
Na ɔfaa akyire somaa nnipa kɔɔ Abimelek nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ! Ebed ba Gaal ne ne nuanom aba Sekem, na wɔama kuro muno nyinaa asɔre atia wo.
Enti sɔre anadwo na wo ne nnipa a wɔka wo ho no nkɔtɛ wuram.
Na anɔpa a awia repue no, sɔre ntɛm kɔto hyɛ kuro no so; na sɛ ɔne ne dɔm ba wo so a, yɛ no deɛ wobɛtumi biara.”
Enti Abimelek ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa sɔree anadwo, na wɔkyɛɛ wɔn mu akuo nnan kɔtɛ hwɛɛ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛto ahyɛ Sekem kuro no soɔ.
Akyire yi Ebed ba Gaal firii adi kɔgyinaa kuro no pono ano. Afei Abimelek ne ne nkurɔfoɔ no pue firii baabi a wɔkɔtɛeɛ no.
Na berɛ a Gaal hunuu nnipa no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Sebul sɛ: “Hwɛ! Nnipa bi firi mmepɔ no atifi resiane.” Nanso Sebul ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛyɛ mmepɔ no sunsum na wohunu no sɛ nnipa no.”
Akyire yi Gaal sane kaa sɛ: “Hwɛ, nnipa bi firi asase no so reba, na kuo baako nam Meonenim dupɔn no kwan so reba!”
Ɛnna Sebul ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Afei w’ano a wode kaa sɛ, ‘Hwan ne Abimelek a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsom no’ no wɔ he? Ɛnyɛ nnipa yi na wobuu wɔn akumaa no? Afei kɔ na wo ne wɔn nkɔko ɛ.”
Enti Gaal dii Sekem mmarima anim ne Abimelek kɔkoeɛ.
Na Abimelek pamoo no, na ɔdwaneeɛ; na nnipa pii wuwu sam hɔ de kɔsii kuro no pono ano.
Afei Abimelek tenaa Aruma, na Sebul pamoo Gaal ne ne nuanom firii Sekem.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, nnipa no firii adi kɔɔ wuram. Enti wɔkɔbɔɔ Abimelek amanneɛ.
Na ɔkyɛɛ nnipa no mu akuo mmiɛnsa, na wɔkɔtɛɛ wuram. Na berɛ a ɔhunuu sɛ nnipa no apue afiri kurom hɔ reba no, ɔto hyɛɛ wɔn so kunkum wɔn.
Na Abimelek ne kuo a wɔka ne ho no bɔɔ twi kɔgyinaa kuro no pono ano, na akuo mmienu no nso kɔto hyɛɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ wuram no so kunkum wɔn.
Na Abimelek to hyɛɛ kuro no so ne emufoɔ koo da muno nyinaa, na ɔdii so nkonim. Afei ɔkunkum nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ no, na ɔsɛee kuro no de nkyene petee hɔ nyinaa.
Na berɛ a mmarima a wɔtete Sekem abankɛseɛ mu teeɛ no, wɔkɔhyɛɛ onyame El-Berit fie aban mu.
Afei wɔkɔbɔɔ Abimelek amanneɛ sɛ mmarima a wɔtete Sekem abankɛseɛ mu no nyinaa aboa wɔn ano.

Ɛnna Abimelek ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa kɔɔ Bepɔ Salmon so. Na Abimelek de akuma twaa duban bi de too ne kɔn ho, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔka ne ho no sɛ: “Deɛ mayɛ a mo ani tua yi, monyɛ bi ntɛm, sɛdeɛ mayɛ no!”
Enti nnipa no nyinaa twitwaa nnua mman de dii Abimelek akyi. Na wɔde bɛguu aban no ase wɔ dan no ho de gya toom. Enti Sekem abankɛseɛ no mu nnipa nyinaa wuwuiɛ, mmarima ne mmaa bɛyɛ apem (1,000).
Afei Abimelek kɔto hyɛɛ Tebes so, na ɔfaa kuro no.
Na saa berɛ no, na abandenden bi wɔ kuro no mu, enti mmarima ne mmaa ne kurom hɔfoɔ nyinaa dwane kɔhyɛɛ hɔ, na wɔtoo mu foro kɔɔ aban no atifi.
Na Abimelek kɔduruu aban no ho, na ɔto hyɛɛ so, na ɔbɛn aban no ano pɛɛ sɛ ɔde gya rekɔto mu.
Ɛnna ɔbaa bi gyaa oyuyammoɔ mu bɛhwee Abimelek tirim maa ne tikwankoraa pɛkyɛɛeɛ.
Ntɛm ara na ɔfrɛɛ n’akoa a ɔkura n’akodeɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Twe wo nkrantɛ ku me, na nkurɔfoɔ anka sɛ, ‘Ɔbaa na ɔkuu no.’” Ntɛm ara, n’akoa no de ne nkrantɛ wɔɔ no maa no wuiɛ.
Na berɛ a Israelfoɔ hunuu sɛ Abimelek awuo no, obiara sane kɔɔ ne fie.
Enti Onyankopɔn maa bɔne a Abimelek yɛɛ ne papa sɛ ɔkunkum ne nuanom aduɔson no baa ne so.
Na Onyankopɔn maa Sekemfoɔ bɔne nyinaa baa wɔn ara tiri so, na Yerubaal ba Yotam nnome no baa wɔn so.
10: Abimelek akyi no, Dodo ba Pua ba Tola na ɔsɔre gyinaa sɛ ɔbɛgye Israel. Na ɔfiri Isakar abusuakuo mu na ɔtenaa Samir wɔ Efraim bepɔ so.
Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa, na ɛno akyi no ɔwu maa wɔsiee no Samir.
N’akyi no Gileadni Yair nso baeɛ, na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ aduonu mmienu.
Na ɔwɔ mma mmarima aduasa a wɔtenatenaa mfunumu aduasa soɔ. Na wɔwɔ nkuro aduasa wɔ Gilead asase so a wɔfrɛ hɔ Hawot-Yair de bɛsi nnɛ.
Akyire yi Yair wu maa wɔsiee no Kamon. Israelfoɔ hyɛ wɔn atamfoɔ ase bio

Na Israelfoɔ no firii aseɛ yɛɛ bɔne bio Awurade ani so, na wɔsom Baal ne Astarot ahoni ne Siria anyame ne Sidon anyame ne Moab anyame ne Ammonfoɔ anyame ne Filistifoɔ anyame. Enti wɔpoo Awurade na wɔansom no.
Enti Awurade bo fuu Israel dendeenden na ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Filistifoɔ ne Ammonfoɔ nsa.
Na wɔdii Israelfoɔ ani, na wɔhyɛɛ wɔn so saa afe no, na wɔyɛɛ saa mfeɛ dunwɔtwe de teetee Israelfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yordan agya wɔ Amorifoɔ asase so wɔ Gilead no nyinaa.
Saa berɛ no Ammonfoɔ twaa Yordan asubɔnten no ne Yuda ne Benyamin ne Efraim fie kɔkoeɛ maa Israel ho hiahiaa no paa.
Ɛnna Israelfoɔ su frɛɛ Awurade, na wɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛayɛ bɔne atia wo, ɛfiri sɛ yɛagya yɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ akɔsom Baal ahoni.”
Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: “Berɛ a Egyptfoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ne Ammonfoɔ ne Filistifoɔ
ne Sidonfoɔ ne Amalekfoɔ ne Midianfoɔ hyɛɛ mo soɔ na mosu frɛɛ me no, mannye mo amfiri wɔn nsam?
Nanso mopoo me kɔsom anyame foforɔ. Enti merennye mo bio.
Monkɔ nkɔsu mfrɛ anyame a moayi wɔn no, na wɔmmɛboa mo. Sɛ mo ho akyere mo a, momma wɔmmɛgye mo.”
Ɛnna Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ: “Yɛayɛ bɔne, enti yɛ yɛn deɛ ɛfata w’ani soɔ biara. Deɛ yɛresrɛ ara ne sɛ gye yɛn nnɛ da yi.”
Na wɔfirii aseɛ yiyii ananafoɔ anyame firii wɔn nkyɛn, na wɔsom Awurade. Afei na ne kra ntumi nhwɛ Israelfoɔ ahoyera ne ahometeɛ no bio.
Berɛ bi akyi no, Ammonfoɔ boaa wɔn dɔm ano wɔ Gilead, na Israelfoɔ nso boaa wɔn dɔm ano wɔ Mispa.
Na Gileadfoɔ ne wɔn atitire bisaa wɔn ho sɛ: “Ɔbarima bɛn na ɔbɛdi animu ne Ammonfoɔ akɔko? Ɔno na ɔbɛdi Gileadfoɔ nyinaa soɔ.” Yefta, ne nkonimdie ne ne bɔhyɛ
11: Saa berɛ yi, na Gileadni bi a ɔde Yefta a ne maame yɛ ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ abɛyɛ ɔbarima katakyie kokoɔdurofoɔ. Na Gilead na ɔwoo Yefta.
Na Gilead yere woo mma mmarima maa no. Afei berɛ a ne yere no mma nyinyiniiɛ no, wɔpamoo Yefta ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Wonni agyapadeɛ biara wɔ yɛn papa fie, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbaa foforɔ bi ba ne wo.”
Enti Yefta firii ne nuanom nkyɛn kɔtenaa Tob asase so, na akobɔfoɔ bi boaa wɔn ho ano bɛkaa Yefta ho, na ɔpue a, wɔne wɔn na ɛkorɔ.
Akyire yi Ammonfoɔ ne Israelfoɔ bɛkoeɛ.
Na berɛ a Ammonfoɔ ne Israelfoɔ bɛkoeɛ no, Gilead mpanimfoɔ yɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ Tob asase so kɔfaa Yefta baeɛ.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: “Bra bɛyɛ yɛn safohene na yɛne Ammonfoɔ nkɔko.”
Ɛnna Yefta bisaa Gilead mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: “Ɛnyɛ mo na ɔtane nti mopamoo me firii me papa fie no? Afei sɛ mo ho akyere mo a, moaba sɛ menyɛ mo dɛn?”
Na Gilead mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: “Ɛno nti na yɛasane aba wo nkyɛn yi. Enti ma yɛnkɔ na yɛne Ammonfoɔ nkɔko, na yɛbɛma woadi Gileadfoɔ nyinaa so.”
Ɛnna Yefta ka kyerɛɛ Gilead mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: “Sɛ mode me sane kɔ sɛ me ne Ammonfoɔ nkɔko, na Awurade de wɔn hyɛ me nsa a, ɛnneɛ mɛyɛ mo tiri anaa?”
Na Gilead mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: “Awurade ate, enti sɛ yɛanyɛ deɛ woaka yi a, ɔno ne yɛn ntam danseni.”
Ɛnna Yefta ne Gilead mpanimfoɔ no kɔeɛ, na ɔman no de no yɛɛ wɔn tiri ne wɔn safohene. Na Yefta de n’asɛm nyinaa too Awurade anim wɔ Mispa.
Afei Yefta tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Ammonfoɔ hene nkyɛn kɔbisaa no sɛ: “Asɛm bɛn na me ne wo wɔ a enti woaba m’asase so sɛ wo ne me rebɛko yi?”
Na Ammonfoɔ hene ka kyerɛɛ Yefta abɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Asɛm no ara ne sɛ, berɛ a Israelfoɔ firi Egypt reba no, wɔfaa m’asase de firi Arnon kɔ Yabok kɔsi Yordan ano. Enti dane ma me komm.”
Nanso Yefta sane tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Ammon hene nkyɛn
kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yefta se yɛnka nkyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Israel amfa Moab ne Ammonfoɔ asase biara.
Na mmom berɛ a Israelfoɔ firi Egypt reba no, wɔfaa serɛ so bɛduruu Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho, na wɔfiri hɔ baa Kades.
Ɛnna Israel tuu abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Edom hene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo ma memfa w’asase so,” nanso Edom hene ampene. Na wɔsoma kɔɔ Moab hene nso nkyɛn, na ɔno nso ampene. Enti Israelfoɔ tenaa Kades.
Na berɛ a wɔnam serɛ soɔ no, wɔtwa faa Edom ne Moab asase ho kɔpuee Moab asase no apueeɛ, na wɔkɔsoɛɛ Arnon mpɔtamu. Na wɔantra amma Moab asase so, ɛfiri sɛ na Arnon da Moab hyeɛ so.
“‘Akyire yi Israel somaa nnipa kɔɔ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔdi adeɛ wɔ Hesbon no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛsrɛ wo ma yɛmfa w’asase so nkɔ m’asase so.”
Nanso na Sihon tirim ntene no sɛ ɔbɛma Israelfoɔ afa n’asase soɔ, na ɔboaboaa ne dɔm nyinaa ano wɔ Yahas ne Israelfoɔ koeɛ.
Na Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade de Sihon ne ne dɔm nyinaa hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ nsa, na wɔkunkum Amorifoɔ faa asase a wɔte soɔ no nyinaa.
Na wɔfaa Amorifoɔ asase nyinaa firi Arnon kɔsi Yabok, firi serɛ so kɔsi Yordan ano.
“‘Enti Israel Nyankopɔn Awurade na ɔtuu Amorifoɔ firii ne man Israel anim, na wo nso wopɛ sɛ wotu ɔman yi anaa?
Ɛnyɛ asase a wo nyame Kemos de maa wo sɛ di soɔ na wobɛfa adi soɔ anaa? Enti yɛn nso, asase a yɛn Nyankopɔn Awurade agye de ama yɛn sɛ yɛnni soɔ no, ɛno na yɛbɛfa adi soɔ.
Na afei wosusu sɛ wokyɛn Sipor ba Balak, Moab hene no, anaa? Ɔne Israel dii asie, anaa ɔne wɔn koo pɛn?
Berɛ a Israel te Hesbon ne ɛho nkuro ne Aroer ne ɛho nkuro ne nkuro a ɛgu Arnon nsuano nyinaa mu mfeɛ ahasa no, adɛn nti na woannye amfiri wɔn nsam saa berɛ no?
Me deɛ, menyɛɛ wo bɔne biara, na wo mmom na woayɛ bɔne sɛ wode ntɔkwa bɛtoa me. Ɔtemmufoɔ Awurade no ara mmu Israelfoɔ ne Ammonfoɔ ntam atɛn nnɛ.’”
Nanso Ammonfoɔ hene no antie asɛm a Yefta soma maa wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ no no.
Na Awurade honhom baa Yefta so na ɔkɔfaa Gilead ne Manase kɔɔ Gilead-Mispa, na ɔfiri Gilead-Mispa kɔɔ Ammonfoɔ so.
Na Yefta hyɛɛ Awurade bɔ sɛ: “Sɛ wode Ammonfoɔ hyɛ me nsa,
na mefiri Ammonfoɔ so ba asomdwoeɛ mu a, deɛ ɛbɛfiri me fie abɛhyia me no bɛyɛ Awurade dea, na mede no bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.”
Enti Yefta kɔɔ Ammonfoɔ so ne wɔn kɔkoeɛ, na Awurade de wɔn hyɛɛ ne nsa.
Na ɔkunkum wɔn firii Aroer ara kɔduruu Minit, nkuro aduonu, ɛde kɔsi Abel-Keramim. Enti wɔbrɛɛ Ammonfoɔ ase maa Israelfoɔ.
Afei Yefta baa Mispa, na ɔrekɔ ne fie no, hwɛ, ne babaa de mpintin ne asa bɛhyiaa no! Na ɔdi no bakorɔ; ɔnni ɔbabarima anaa ɔbabaa biara ka ne ho.

Berɛ a n’ani bɔɔ ne soɔ ara pɛ na ɔsunsuanee n’atadeɛ mu, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Ao me ba! Woama mahodwo papaapa, sɛɛ na wo na merebɛtwa wo asuo. Nanso manya abue m’ano ahyɛ Awurade bɔ, enti mentumi nsane m’akyi.”
Ɛnna ne babaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Papa, sɛ woabue w’ano ahyɛ Awurade bɔ a, ɛnneɛ deɛ afiri w’anom no, yɛ me saa ara, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade atua w’atamfo Ammonfoɔ so ka ama wo.”
Na ɔtoaa so ka kyerɛɛ ne papa sɛ: “Deɛ meresrɛ woɔ nie: Gya me kwan na menkɔ mmepɔ so abosome mmienu, na me ne me nnamfonom nkɔsu me baabunuyɛ.”
Ɛnna ne papa kaa sɛ: “Kɔ!” Enti ɔgyaa no kwan maa no kɔɔ abosome mmienu. Na ɔne ne nnamfonom kɔsuu ne baabunuyɛ wɔ mmepɔ so.
Na abosome mmienu no baa awieeɛ no, ɔbaa ne papa nkyɛn, na ɔyɛɛ no sɛdeɛ wahyɛ bɔ no. Na ababaa no ne ɔbarima biara anna da. Afei ɛbɛyɛɛ amanneɛ wɔ Israel sɛ:
Afe biara Israel mmabaa kɔkamfo Gileadni Yefta babaa no nnanan.
12: Na Efraim mmarima boaa wɔn ho ano kɔɔ atifi fam (Safon) kɔka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: “Adɛn nti na wo ne Ammonfoɔ rekɔko no woamfrɛ yɛn amma yɛne wo ankorɔ? Yɛde gya bɛhye wo fie agu wo so.”
Na Yefta ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Manso kɛseɛ bi bɛtɔɔ me ne me man ne Ammonfoɔ ntam. Na mebɛfrɛɛ mo sɛ mommɛboa me, nanso moammɛgye me amfiri wɔn nsam.
Na berɛ a mehunuu sɛ moremma mmɛgye me no, meyɛɛ m’adwene sɛ mede me kra bɛto me nsam ne Ammonfoɔ akɔko. Na Awurade nso de wɔn hyɛɛ me nsa. Afei adɛn nti na moaba me so nnɛ sɛ mo ne me rebɛko yi?”
Ɛhɔ ara na Yefta boaboaa Gilead mmarima nyinaa ano ne Efraimfoɔ koeɛ; na Gilead mmarima no kunkum Efraimfoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkaa sɛ: “Mo Gileadfoɔ, moyɛ Efraim adwanefoɔ a mowɔ Efraim ne Manase mu.”

Na Gileadfoɔ dii Efraimfoɔ anim kɔsii Yordan asutwareeɛ no kwan. Afei sɛ Efraimfoɔ a wɔredwane no bi duru hɔ na ɔka sɛ: “Momma mentwa nkɔ” a, Gileadfoɔ no bisa no sɛ: “Woyɛ Efraimni anaa?” Na sɛ ɔka sɛ: “Dabi” a,

na wɔaka akyerɛ no sɛ: “Ka sɛ Shibbolet.” Nanso ɛyɛ a ɔntumi nka no yie, enti ɔka sɛ “Sibbolet.” Ɛba saa a na wɔakye no aku no wɔ Yordan asutwareeɛ hɔ. Saa berɛ no, Efraimfoɔ mpem aduanan mmienu (42,000) na wɔhweree wɔn nkwa.
Na Gileadni Yefta buu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nsia, na ɛno akyi no ɔwuiɛ, na wɔsiee no ne kurom wɔ Gilead. Ibsan, Elon ne Abdon ho asɛm
N’akyi no, Ibsan a ɔfiri Betlehem bɛbuu Israel atɛn.
Na ɔwoo mma mmarima aduasa ne mma mmaa aduasa. Ɔde ne mma mmaa aduasa maa awareɛ mmeammea, na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔfaa mmaa aduasa nso firii mmeammea brɛɛ ne mma mmarima no. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nson.
Akyire yi Ibsan wuiɛ, na wɔsiee no Betlehem.
N’akyi no, Sebulonni Elon bɛbuu Israel atɛn. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ du.
Na Sebulonni Elon wuiɛ, na wɔsiee no Ayalon wɔ Sebulon asase so.
N’akyi no Piratonni Hilel ba Abdon buu Israel atɛn.
Na ɔwɔ mma mmarima aduanan ne mmanana aduasa a wɔtenatenaa mfunumu aduɔson soɔ. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nwɔtwe.
Akyire yi Piratonni Hilel ba Abdon wuiɛ, na wɔsiee no Piraton wɔ Efraimfoɔ asase so wɔ Amalek bepɔ so.
13: Na Israelfoɔ firii aseɛ yɛɛ bɔne bio wɔ Awurade ani so, enti Awurade de wɔn hyɛɛ Filistifoɔ nsa mfeɛ aduanan.
Saa berɛ no na ɔbarima bi wɔ Sora a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu a ne din de Manoa. Na ne yere yɛ obonini a ɔnni ba.
Da bi Awurade bɔfoɔ baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, woyɛ obonini a wonwoɔ, nanso wobɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima.
Hwɛ na woannom bobesa anaa mmosa biara, na nni biribi a ɛho nteɛ.
Hwɛ, wobɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima, na ɛnsɛ sɛ yiwan ka ne ti, ɛfiri sɛ sɛ abɔfra no nya firi yafunu mu pɛ a, ɔbɛyɛ Nasirini ama Onyankopɔn. Na ɔno na ɔbɛdi animu agye Israel afiri Filistifoɔ nsam.”
Ɛnna ɔbaa no kɔbɔɔ ne kunu amanneɛ sɛ: “Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn nipa bi baa me nkyɛn. Na ne su te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, na ne ho yɛ hu paa. Nanso mammisa no baabi a ɔfire, na wammɔ ne din nso ankyerɛ me.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: ‘Wobɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima. Na hwɛ na woannom bobesa anaa mmosa biara, na nni biribiara a ɛho nteɛ, ɛfiri sɛ sɛ abɔfra no nya firi yafunu mu pɛ a, ɔbɛyɛ Nasirini ama Onyankopɔn akɔsi da a wɔbɛwuo.’”
Ɛnna Manoa bɔɔ Awurade mpaeɛ sɛ: “O Awurade, mesrɛ wo, ma Nyankopɔn nipa a wosomaa no no nsane mmra, na ɔmmɛkyerɛ yɛn deɛ yɛnyɛ abɔfra a yɛbɛwo no no.”
Na Nyankopɔn tiee Manoa, na berɛ a ɔbaa no wɔ wuram no, Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ no sane baa ne nkyɛn bio. Saa berɛ no na ne kunu Manoa nni ne nkyɛn.
Na ntɛm ara na ɔbaa no tuu mmirika kɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: “Hwɛ, ɔbarima a ɔbaa me nkyɛn nnaano no asane abɛyi ne ho adi akyerɛ me!”
Na Manoa tee saa no, ɔsɔre dii ne yere no akyi baa ɔbarima no nkyɛn, na ɔbisaa no sɛ: “Wone ɔbarima a wo ne ɔbaa yi kasaeɛ no?” Na ɔbuaa sɛ: “Ɛyɛ me a.”
Ɛnna Manoa kaa sɛ: “Wo nsɛm no ba mu a, abɔfra no asetena bɛyɛ sɛn, na ɛdeɛn na ɔbɛyɛ?”
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Manoa sɛ: “Biribiara a maka akyerɛ ɔbaa no, ɔnhwɛ nni so.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔde biribiara a ɛfiri bobe mu ka n’ano. Ɔnnnom bobesa anaa mmosa biara, na ɔnnni biribiara a ɛho nteɛ. Deɛ maka akyerɛ no nyinaa, ma ɔnhwɛ nni so.”
Afei Manoa ka kyerɛɛ Awurade bɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Yɛsrɛ wo, twɛn ma yɛmpɛ abirekyie kumaa bi nyɛ aduane mma wo.”

Nanso Awurade bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Manoa sɛ: “Sɛ wogye me ka ha mpo a, meremfa w’aduane no bi nka m’ano; nanso sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma Awurade a, wobɛtumi abɔ.” Saa berɛ yi nyinaa na Manoa nnim sɛ ɔyɛ Awurade bɔfoɔ.
Ɛnna Manoa ka kyerɛɛ Awurade bɔfoɔ no sɛ: “Wo din de sɛn, na sɛ deɛ woaka yi nyinaa ba mu a, yɛahyɛ wo animuonyam.”
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Adɛn nti na worebisa me din, Me din yɛ nwanwa?”
Enti Manoa faa abirekyie kumaa ne aduane kɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ ɔbotan no so maa Awurade, na ɔyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ maa Manoa ne ne yere de wɔn ani hunuiɛ.
Afei berɛ a ogyaframa firi afɔrebukyia no so rekɔ soro no, Awurade bɔfoɔ no faa gyaframa no mu foro kɔɔ soro. Na Manoa ne ne yere hwɛɛ deɛ ɛrekɔ soɔ no, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam.
Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no ansane amma Manoa ne ne yere nkyɛn bio. Afei Manoa hunuu sɛ ɔyɛ Awurade bɔfoɔ.
Na Manoa ka kyerɛɛ ne yere sɛ: “Ɛkwan biara so yɛbɛwu, ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ani ahunu Onyankopɔn.”
Ɛnna ne yere ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ Awurade pɛ sɛ ɔku yɛn a, anka ɔrennye yɛn nsam ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ no, na anka ɔremma yɛnhunu yeinom nyinaa, na anka ɔremma yɛnte biribi a ɛte sei nso.”
Akyire yi ɔbaa no woo ɔbabarima na ɔtoo ne din Samson. Abɔfra no nyiniiɛ, na Awurade hyiraa no.
Na Awurade honhom baa ne so wɔ Mahane-Dan wɔ Sora ne Estaol ntam. Samson awadeɛ ne n’aborɔme no
14: Na Samson siane kɔɔ Timna, na ɔkɔhunuu ɔbaa bi wɔ Timna a ɔyɛ Filistifoɔ mma mmaa no baako.
Enti ɔforo ba bɛka kyerɛɛ ne papa ne ne maame sɛ: “Mahunu Filistini ababaa bi wɔ Timna, na mepɛ sɛ mokɔgye no awareɛ ma me.”

Na ne papa ne ne maame bisaa no sɛ: “Woanhunu ɔbaa biara wɔ wo nuanom ne me nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa mu a enti wopɛ sɛ wokɔware ɔbaa firi Filistifoɔ momonotofoɔ yi mu?” Nanso Samson ka kyerɛɛ ne papa sɛ: “Ɔno ara na m’ani gye ne ho, enti kɔgye no ma me.”
Na ne papa ne ne maame nnim sɛ yei firi Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔrehwehwɛ kwan a ɔbɛfa so anya Filistifoɔ no. Saa berɛ no na Filistifoɔ di Israel so.
Enti Samson ne ne papa ne ne maame siim kɔɔ Timna. Na berɛ a ɔduruu Timna bobe nturo mu no, ɔbɛhwɛ a, gyata bi na ɔrebobom ba ne soɔ yi!
Ɛnna Awurade honhom baa ne soɔ, na ɔtetee aboa no mu  sɛdeɛ obi tete ɔpapo kumaa mu, nanso na ɔnkura biribiara wɔ ne nsam. Na wammɔ deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no so ankyerɛ ne papa anaa ne maame.
Na ɔtoaa so kɔɔ n’anim ne ɔbaa no kɔkasaeɛ, na Samson hunuu sɛ ɔbaa no da so ara sɔ n’ani.
Na nna bi akyi no, ɔkɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔfa ɔbaa no aba fie. Na ɔmane kɔhwɛɛ gyata funu no, na ɔhunuu sɛ nwowa ne ɛwoɔ ahyɛ mu ma.
Enti ɔyii bi kuraa ne nsam, na ɔrekɔ nyinaa na ɔredi. Berɛ a ɔkɔtoo ne papa ne ne maame no, ɔmaa wɔn bi diiɛ. Nanso wanka ankyerɛ wɔn sɛ gyata no funu mu na ɔyii ɛwoɔ no.
Na ne papa toaa so kɔɔ ɔbaa no nkyɛn, na Samson too pono wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ saa na na mmeranteɛ no taa yɛ.
Berɛ a wɔhunuu no no, wɔde mmarima aduasa brɛɛ no sɛ ayeforɔkunu nnamfo a wɔbɛtena ne ho.
Afei Samson ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Mewɔ abebuo bi a mepɛ sɛ mokyerɛ me aseɛ. Sɛ motumi kyerɛ aseɛ ansa na apontoɔ yi aba awieeɛ nnanson akyi a, mɛma mo ntadeɛ nhyɛaseɛ aduasa ne ngugusoɔ nso aduasa.
Na sɛ moantumi ankyerɛ me aseɛ a, ɛnneɛ mobɛma me ntadeɛ nhyɛaseɛ aduasa ne ngugusoɔ nso aduasa.” Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “To wobe no na yɛntie.”
Enti ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Odidifoɔ mu na aduane firi baeɛ, Na ɔhoɔdenfoɔ mu na ade fremfrem firi baeɛ.” Na wɔtenaa ho nnansa a wɔantumi ankyerɛ aseɛ.

Afei da a ɛtɔ so nson no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Samson yere sɛ: “Daadaa wo kunu na ɔnkyerɛ yɛn abebuo no ase. Anyɛ saa a, yɛbɛhye wo ne wo papa fie nyinaa. Adɛn, mode yɛn baa ha sɛ morebɛpra yɛn ho nneɛma anaa?”

Enti Samson yere su guu ne so sɛ: “Mahunu sɛ ɔtan na wotan me, na wonnɔ me koraa. Woato me nkurɔfoɔ abebuo, nanso wonka nkyerɛɛ me.” Ɛnna Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Hwɛ, me papa ne me maame mpo menka nkyerɛɛ wɔn, na wo na menka nkyerɛ woɔ anaa?”
Na ɔsu guu ne so nnanson a apontoɔ no gu soɔ no nyinaa. Afei da a ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no ɛfiri sɛ na ɔreteetee no dodo. Na ɔbaa no nso ka kyerɛɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ.

Enti da a ɛtɔ so nson no, ansa na awia rekɔtɔ no, kurom hɔ mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Ɛdeɛn na ɛyɛ fremfrem sene ɛwoɔ? Na ɛdeɛn na ɛwɔ ahoɔden sene gyata?” “Sɛ moamfa me nantwie amfuntum a, Anka montumi nkyerɛ m’abebuo yi ase.”
Na Awurade honhom baa ne so, na ɔkɔɔ Askelon kɔkunkum wɔn mmarima aduasa, na ɔyii wɔn ntadeɛ maa wɔn a wɔkyerɛɛ abebuo no ase no. Na ɔde abufuo kɔɔ ne papa fie.
Na wɔde Samson yere no maa ne yɔnko bi a na ɔka ne ho sɛ ayeforɔkunu adamfo. Samson ne nsakraman ahasa no
15: Na berɛ bi akyi, ayutwa berɛ mu no, Samson faa abirekyie ba bi siim kɔɔ ne yere nkyɛn. Na ɔkaa sɛ: “Mɛkɔ me yere nkyɛn wɔ pia mu.” Nanso ɔbaa no papa amma no kwan ankɔ mu.
Na ne papa kaa sɛ: “Mesusuu me tirim sɛ wotan no na wompɛ no bio. Enti mede no ama wo yɔnko no. Ne nuabaa kumaa no ho nyɛ fɛ nsene no anaa? Fa no si baako no ananmu.”
Ɛnna Samson kaa sɛ: “Afei sɛ me ne Filistifoɔ di no bɔne a, asodie biara nna me so.”
Enti Samson kɔ kɔkyee nsakraman ahasa na ɔfaa agyatɛnee, na sɛ ɔkyekyere mmienu biara dua bom a, na ɔde gyatɛnee baako ahyɛ ntamu.
Afei ɔsosɔɔ agyatɛnee no ano gya na ɔpamoo mmoa no kɔɔ Filistifoɔ no ayufuo mu. Na ɛhyee biribiara, ayuo a wɔatwa aboa ano ne deɛ wɔntwaeɛ, bobe nturo ne ngodua nturo nyinaa.

Ɛnna Filistifoɔ no bɛbisaa sɛ: “Hwan na ɔdii saa dwuma yi?” Na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Ɛyɛ Timnani no ase Samson, ɛfiri sɛ wagye ne yere afiri ne nsam de no ama n’adamfo.” Enti Filistifoɔ no tee saa no, wɔde gya kɔhyee ɔbaa no ne ne papa.
Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Deɛ moayɛ yi, gye sɛ metua mo so ka ansa na magyae.”
Na ɔkunkum wɔn dwerɛbee—srɛ da ha na nan nso da so—na ɛno akyi no ɔkɔtenaa ɔbotan bi tokuro mu wɔ Etam.
Na Filistifoɔ bɛkyeree nsraban wɔ Yuda, na wɔtee wɔn ho guu Lehi nyinaa.
Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no bisaa sɛ: “Adɛn nti na moreba yɛn soɔ yi?” Na wɔkaa sɛ: “Yɛaba sɛ yɛrebɛkyekyere Samson, na yɛayɛ no sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ yɛn no.”

Enti Yudafoɔ mmarima mpem mmiɛnsa (3,000) siim kɔɔ Etam botan tokuro no mu, na wɔkɔbisaa Samson sɛ: “Wonnim sɛ Filistifoɔ na wɔdi yɛn soɔ? Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi?” Na ɔno nso ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Sɛdeɛ wɔyɛɛ me no, saa ara na mayɛ wɔn.”
Ɛnna wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Yɛaba sɛ yɛrebɛkyekyere wo akɔma Filistifoɔ no.” Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Monka me ntam sɛ mo ara moremfa mo nsa nka me.”
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Dabi, yɛrebɛkyekyere wo akɔma wɔn kɛkɛ; yɛrenku wo.” Enti wɔde ntampehoma foforɔ mmienu kyekyeree no na wɔyii no firii ɔbotan no mu pueeɛ.
Na berɛ a ɔduruu Lehi no, Filistifoɔ de osebɔ hyiaa no. Na Awurade honhom baa ne so, na ntampehoma a wɔde akyekyere n’abasa no yɛɛ sɛ asaawa a wɔde gya aka ho, enti nhoma no tete firii ne nsa ho.
Afei ɔhunuu afunumu apantan foforɔ bi, na ɔtenee ne nsa fa de kunkum mmarima apem (1,000).
Ɛnna Samson kaa sɛ: “Afunumu apantan—kuo baako, akuo mmienu! Mede afunumu apantan akunkum mmarima apem.”
Na berɛ a ɔkasa wieeɛ no, ɔtoo afunumu apantan no twenee ntɛm ara, na ɔtoo hɔ din Ramat-Lehi.
Afei sukɔm dee no paa, na ɔsu frɛɛ Awurade sɛ: “Ɛyɛ wo na wonam w’akoa so ama ɔgyeɛ kɛseɛ yi nyinaa aba, na afei sukɔm nku me na mentɔ momonotofoɔ yi nsam?”
Enti Onyankopɔn maa tokuro bi a ɛwɔ Lehi mu paeeɛ, na nsuo firi mu baeɛ, na ɔnomeeɛ. Afei ne honhom sane baeɛ na ɔnyaa ahoɔden. Ɛno nti ɔtoo hɔ din En-Hakore, na ɛwɔ Lehi de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na ɔbuu Israelfoɔ atɛn mfeɛ aduonu wɔ Filistifoɔ berɛ so.
16: Da bi Samson kɔɔ Gasa kɔhunuu ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ bi wɔ hɔ, na ɔkɔɔ ne nkyɛn.
Afei wɔbɔɔ Gasafoɔ amanneɛ sɛ: “Samson aba ha.” Enti wɔtwaa ne ho hyiaeɛ, na wɔtɛɛ no anadwo munyinaa wɔ kuro no pono ano. Na wɔyɛɛ komm anadwo no kaa sɛ: “Sɛ animu tete ara pɛ a, yɛbɛku no.”
Nanso Samson daa hɔ kɔsii dasuom, na ɔsɔre kɔtuu kuro no pono ne n’adum mmienu no ne n’adaban nyinaa, na ɔde too ne mmatiri foro kɔɔ bepɔ a ɛwɔ Hebron anim no so.
Ɛno akyi no, n’ani bɛgyee ɔbaa bi a wɔfrɛ no Delila ho wɔ Sorek bɔn mu.

Afei Filistifoɔ asafohene no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Daadaa no na hunu adekodeɛ a n’ahoɔden kɛseɛ no firi mu, ne deɛ yɛde bɛnya no ne deɛ yɛde bɛkyekyere no adi ne soɔ. Na yɛn mu biara bɛma wo nnwetɛbena apem ne ɔha (1,100).”
Berɛ bi akyi no, Delila bisaa Samson sɛ: “Mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me ɛ, adekodeɛ a w’ahoɔden kɛseɛ no firi mu, na ɛdeɛn na sɛ obi de kyekyere wo a, ɔbɛtumi adi wo soɔ?”
Ɛnna Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ wɔde nhoma mono nson a ɛnwoeɛ kyekyere me a, mɛhodwo na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.”
Enti Filistifoɔ asafohene no de nhoma mono a ɛnwoeɛ nson brɛɛ no, na ɔde kyekyeree no.

Saa berɛ yi na mmarima bi tetɛ ɔbaa no dan mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Samson, Filistifoɔ no reba wo so!” Na ɔtee nhoma no mu mmienu te sɛ asaawa a egya aka no ama emu ate mmienu. Enti wɔanhunu deɛ n’ahoɔden no fire.
Ɛnna Delila ka kyerɛɛ Samson sɛ: “Hwɛ, woredi me ho fɛw, na wompɛ sɛ woka nokorɛ kyerɛ me. Mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me adekodeɛ a wɔbɛtumi de akyekyere woɔ ɛ.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ wɔde ntampehoma foforɔ a wɔmfa nyɛɛ hwee da kyekyere me a, mɛhodwo na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.”
Enti Delila faa ntampehoma de kyekyeree no, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Samson, Filistifoɔ no reba wo so!” Saa berɛ yi nyinaa na mmarima no tetɛ dan no mu. Na Samson tee mu mmienu te sɛ asaawa bi.

Afei Delila ka kyerɛɛ Samson sɛ: “Woda so ara redi me ho fɛw, na wompɛ sɛ woka nokorɛ kyerɛ me. Kyerɛ me adeɛ a wɔbɛtumi de akyekyere woɔ.” Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Sɛ wode me tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntomaban nwono bom a.”
Enti ɔde akoroteaa bɔɔ mu na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Samson, Filistifoɔ no reba wo so!” Na ɔnyaneeɛ, na ɔyii akoroteaa ne ahoma no.
