Wobɛhwɛ asase gugu so nsuo, woama ɛso aduane bu so bebree. Nyankopɔn asubɔnten no, nsuo ayɛ mu ma, wo na woma wɔn aburoo gyina,
Wogugu n’akofie so nsuo de honoo emu apɔapɔ, wode bosuo pii fɔ no; wohyira n’afifideɛ so.
Wobɔ w’ayamyɛ afirinhyia abotire, na sradeɛ sosɔ w’akwan so.
Ɛsosɔ serɛ so adidibea so, na nkokoɔ de abotɔyam hyehyɛ wɔn ho.
Nnwankuo ahyɛ adidibea no ma, aburoo nso akata abɔn no mu, anigyeɛ dwom nko ara na wɔtoɔ.
66: Asase nyinaa, monni ahurisie mmɔ ose mma Onyankopɔn,
Monto dwom nhyɛ ne din animuonyam; monhyɛ no animuonyam nyi no ayɛ.
Monse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Wo nnwuma yɛ hu ampa. Wo tumi kɛseɛ nti w’atamfo bɛkoto wo.
Asase nyinaa bɛsɔre wo na wɔato wo dwom, wɔbɛto dwom ama wo din.” Sela.
Mommra mmɛhwɛ Onyankopɔn nnwuma; sɛdeɛ ɔne nnipa mma die no yɛ hu.
Ɔmaa ɛpo danee asase pɛsɛɛ, wɔde anammɔn twaa asubɔnten kɛseɛ, ɛno nti yɛn ani gye ne ho.
Deɛ ɔde ne tumi di hene daa no, n’ani tua amanaman nyinaa; Mma atuatefoɔ mmma wɔn ho so. Sela.
Amanaman, monhyira yɛn Nyankopɔn, na momma wɔnte n’ayeyie yie.
Ɔde yɛn kra asi nkwa mu, na wamma yɛn nan anwatiri.
Na wo, O Onyankopɔn, na woakari yɛn ahwɛ, woanane yɛn ahwɛ sɛ wɔnane dwetɛ hwɛ mu.
Wode yɛn ahyɛ asau mu, wode adesoa dompee asoa yɛn.
Woama ɔdasani atwi afa yɛn tiri so; nanso woayi yɛn aba deɛ nnepa abu soɔ hɔ.
Mede ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ bɛkɔ wo fie,
deɛ mede mebuee m’ano, ne deɛ m’ano kaa m’ahohia mu no.
Mede mmoa a wɔadɔ sradeɛ bɛbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ama wo, ne adwennini a ɛyɛ hwam bɛbɔ wo ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, mede anantwie ne mpapo bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ. Sela.
Mo a mosuro Nyankopɔn nyinaa, mommra mmɛtie, na mɛka deɛ wayɛ ama me kra akyerɛ mo.
Mede m’ano mesu mefrɛɛ no, na mede me kɛtrɛma meyii no ayɛ.
Sɛ medi ahuhudeɛ akyiri m’akomam a,
Ampaneampa, Onyankopɔn atie me,
Nhyira nka Onyankopɔn a wanyi n’aso amfiri me mpaebɔ ho, na wanyi n’adɔeɛ nso amfiri me soɔ no.
67: Onyankopɔn, nnom yɛn, na nhyira yɛn, ɔnte n'anim nkyerɛ yɛn.  Sela.
Na wɔnhunu w’akwan wɔ asase so, ne wo nkwagyeɛ, amanaman nyinaa mu.
O Onyankopɔn, ma aman nyi wo ayɛ,
Ma amanaman nni ahurisie na wɔmmɔ ose, Ɛfiri sɛ teeyɛ mu na wobɛbu aman atɛn; na woakyerɛkyerɛ asase so aman kwan.  Sela.
O Onyankopɔn, ma aman nyi wo ayɛ,
Asase bɛma ne nnɔbaeɛ; Onyankopɔn, yɛn Nyankopɔn, bɛhyira yɛn.
Onyankopɔn bɛhyira yɛn, na wɔn a wɔte asase ano nyinaa asuro no. Nyankopɔn nkonimdifoɔ no ho ayeyie dwom
68: Ma Onyankopɔn nsɔre ɛ na n’atamfo nhwete, na ma wɔn a wɔkyiri no nnwane n’anim.
Sɛdeɛ wisie tu korɔ no, pamo wɔn saa ara; sɛ abɔnefoɔ bɛsɛe Nyankopɔn anim ne no.
Na teneneefoɔ deɛ, wɔn ani bɛgye, wɔbɛdi Nyankopɔn anim ahurisie na wɔn ho asane wɔn, anigyeɛ mu.
Monto Nyankopɔn dwom, monto dwom mma ne din; monto dwom mma Deɛ ɔnam mununkum mu, a ne din de Yah no; na monni ahurisie, n’anim;
Nwisiaa se ne akunafoɔ sɛnnifoɔ ne Onyankopɔn a ɔte ne kronkronbea no.
Onyankopɔn ma ankonam nya mpɔn-ne-mma, ɔtu nneduafoɔ ma wɔbɛdi yie, na atuatefoɔ deɛ, wɔte nkyɛkyerɛ so.
O Onyankopɔn, wofirii adi dii wo man anim, wode wɔn faa ɛserɛ paradada soɔ no,—Sela—
asase wosoe, ɔsoro nso sosɔɔ nsuo Sinai yi ara wosoe Onyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn, anim.
O Onyankopɔn, wotɔɔ adɔeɛ nsuo guu w’agyapadeɛ so, na ɛtɔ piti a, wo na woma no yɛ yie.
W’asafo tenaa so; O Onyankopɔn, w’ayamyɛ mu wosiesie maa mmɔborɔfoɔ.
Awurade kaa n’asɛm; mmaa a wɔkaa nkonim asɛmpa no yɛ asafodɔm kɛseɛ.
Asafodɔm so ahemfo deɛ, dwane na wɔdwane, na ɔbaa a ɔte fie no akyekyɛ asadeɛ mu.
Ɛwom sɛ moda nnwammuo ntam deɛ, nanso mobɛyɛ sɛ aburuburo ntaban a wɔde dwetɛ agu ho, ne ne ntakra a sika fɛfɛ hran ho.
Berɛ a adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ bɔɔ asase no so ahemfo hweteeɛ no, ɛhoa sɛ nsukyerɛmma wɔ Salmon.
Basan mmepɔ yɛ Onyankopɔn mmepɔ; Basan mmepɔ yɛ mmepɔ atenten.
Adɛn na mo mmepɔ atentene mode ani bɔne hwɛ bepɔ a Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ ɔtena soɔ no? Ampa, Awurade bɛtena so daa.
Onyankopɔn akodie nteaseɛnam yɛ ɔpedu ne mpempem huhaa. Awurade wɔ wɔn mu te sɛ Sinai kronkronbea no mu.
Woaforo kɔ soro, woagye nnipa mu ayɛyɛdeɛ, atuatefoɔ mu mpo, na Awurade Nyankopɔn atena hɔ.
Nhyira nka Awurade a ɔsoa yɛn adesoa ma yɛn daa daa, Ɔno ne yɛn nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn. Sela.
Yɛn Nyankopɔn no ne yɛn nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn, na Awurade Nyankopɔn nsam na ɛkwan a wɔde firi owuo mu wɔ.
Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn bɛpiepie n’atamfo ti, na ɔkyea n’afodie mu no ti.
Awurade aka sɛ: “Basan na mede wɔn bɛfiri aba, mede wɔn bɛfiri ɛpo bunu mu aba,
na wode wo nan akeka mogya mu, na wo nkraman kɛtrɛma nso atafere atamfo mogya.”
O Onyankopɔn, wɔhunu w’adi a worebɛfire, me Nyankopɔn ne me hene adi a ɔrebɛfiri, kronkronbea hɔ.
Nnwontofoɔ di kan, asankubɔfoɔ di akyire, wɔn ntam na mmaayewa a wɔbɔ mpintin no die.
Monhyira Onyankopɔn, mo asafo ahyiaeɛ mu, mo a mofiri Israel abura mu, monhyira Awurade.
Benyamin akumaa, wɔn sodifoɔ, wɔ hɔ, Yuda atitire, wɔn asafohene ahodoɔ, Sebulon atitire ne Naftali atitire wɔ hɔ.
Wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ ahoɔden mmra wo so. O Onyankopɔn hyɛ deɛ woayɛ ama yɛn yi mu den.
W’asɔrefie a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no nti, ahemfo de ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ wo.
Ka mmɛwa mu aboa ne anantwininikuo ne anantwie mma a ɛyɛ aman no anim, Pansam aman a wɔpɛ akodie mu.
Akunini bɛfiri Egypt aba; Kus—Etiopia bɛtene ne nsa ntɛm ama Onyankopɔn.
Asase so ahennie, monto dwom mma Onyankopɔn, O, monto dwom mma Awurade—Sela—
Monto mma Deɛ ɔte soro mu soro firi teteete no. Hwɛ! Ɔbobom, ɔma wɔte ne nne a ɛyɛ tumi nne.
Momfa tumi mma Onyankopɔn, n’animuonyam kata Israel so, na ne tumi wɔ wiem tɔnn.
O Onyankopɔn, wo ho yɛ hu, wo tenabea kronkron mu, Ɔno ne Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔde tumi ne ahoɔden ma ne man. AWURADE akoa a ɔwɔ amanehunu mu
69: O Onyankopɔn, gye me, na nsuo reyɛ afa me kra.
Matɔ amena kuronkuron atɛkyɛ
Me sufrɛ ama mabrɛ,
Wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso sene me tiri so nwi, m’asɛefoɔ a wɔyɛ m’atamfoɔ atorofoɔ dɔɔso, Deɛ menwiaeɛ no, wɔse menhyɛ ananmu.
O Onyankopɔn, wo na wonim me nkwaseasɛm,
O Awurade, asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, mma wɔn a wɔtwɛn woɔ ani nnwu me ho, mma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ woɔ no anim nngu ase me nti,
Na wo nti na magye ahohora, na aniwuo ahyɛ m’ani so ma.
Madane me nuanom mu ɔhɔhoɔ, mayɛ me maame mma mu ɔnanani.
Wo fie no ho mmɔdemmɔ na wɔn a wɔbɔ wo ahohora no ahohorabɔ aba me so.
Me kra suu mmuada mu,
Berɛ a mede atweaatam yɛɛ m’atadeɛ no,
Wɔn a wɔtete kuro pono mu ka me ho asɛm, na nsanomfoɔ de me to dwom.
Nanso me deɛ, wo Awurade, na mebɔ wo mpaeɛ adom berɛ mu, O Onyankopɔn, fa wo nkwagyeɛ nokorɛ gye me so.
Yi me firi atɛkyɛ mu na mammem, ma wɔnyi me mfiri wɔn a wɔkyiri me nsam
Mma nsuo a ayire no mmfa me, na mma amena nnka me nnhyɛ mu mmmua ano me so.
O Awurade, gye me so, na w’adɔeɛ yɛ; sɛdeɛ wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe no teɛ.
Na nyi w’ani nhunta w’akoa, na mewɔ ahokyerɛ mu, enti yɛ ntɛm gye me so.
Twe bɛn me kra, na bɛgye no,
Wo na wonim m’ahohora ne m’aniwuo ne m’animguaseɛ, w’ani tua m’ahohiahiafoɔ nyinaa.
Ahohora apɛkyɛ m’akoma, na abɔ me yareɛ, na m’ani da so sɛ obi bɛnya ayamhyehyeɛ ama me, nanso na obiara nni hɔ; Mehwehwɛɛ awerɛkyekyefoɔ, nanso mannya bi.
Wɔde bɔnwoma yɛɛ m’aduane, na me sukɔm mu wɔmaa me nsa kekakeka sɛ mennom.
Ma wɔn pono a ɛsi wɔn anim nnane sɛ apa, na wɔdi yie a, ma no nyɛ afidie mma wɔn.
Ma wɔn ani so nyɛ wɔn kusuu,
Hwie w’abufuo gu wɔn so, na ma w’abufuhyeɛ nka wɔn.
Ma wɔn tenabea nnane amamfo, na mma obiara nntena wɔn ntomadan mu.
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔtaa deɛ wo ara woabɔ no no, na wɔka wɔn a woapira wɔn no yea kyerɛ.
Ma amumuyɛ mmɔ wɔn amumuyɛ so, na mma wɔmmma wo tenenee mu.
Ma wɔmpepa wɔn din mfiri ateasefoɔ nwoma mu, na mma wɔnntwerɛ wɔne ateneneefoɔ din mmmom.
Seesei meyɛ ɔmanehunufoɔ ne ɔwerɛhoni, O Onyankopɔn, ma wo nkwagyeɛ mma me so.
Mede nnwontoɔ bɛyi Onyankopɔn din ayɛ,
Yei bɛsɔ Awurade ani yie asene nantwinini a ɔwɔ mmɛn na ne tɔte mu apaeɛ.
Ahobrɛasefoɔ bɛhunu; na wɔn ani bɛgye, Mo a mohwehwɛ Onyankopɔn akyiri kwan, mo akoma nnya nkwa.
Na Awurade tie ahiafoɔ, na ɔnto ne nkurɔfoɔ nneduafoɔ ho mpe.
Momma ɔsoro ne asase nyi no ayɛ, Ɛpo ne deɛ ɛkeka ne ho wɔ mu nyinaa.
Na Onyankopɔn na ɔbɛgye Sion na wɔatena mu, na ayɛ wɔn dea.
Ne nkoa asefoɔ na wɔbɛnya adie, na wɔn a wɔdɔ ne din na wɔbɛtena mu.
70: O Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛgye me, O Awurade, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.
Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra ani nwu ma wɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔne nsane wɔn akyi
Ma wɔn a wɔka sɛ: “Ahaa, ahaa!” no, ma wɔnsane wɔn akyi,
Ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ woɔ nyinaa ani nnye na wɔnni ahurisie wo mu, na ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagyeɛ no nka daa sɛ: Ma wɔnkamfo Awurade kɛseyɛ.
Na me deɛ, meyɛ mmɔborɔni ne ohiani. O Onyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm ma me. Wone me boafoɔ ne me Gyefoɔ. O Awurade, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase.
71: O Awurade, wo na madwane abɛtoa woɔ.
Fa wo tenenee yi me, na gye me, yɛ aso ma me na gye me nkwa.
Yɛ m’abandenden a mekɔ mu daa. Ɛfiri sɛ wone me botan ne me ho fasuo.
O me Nyankopɔn, gye me firi ɔbɔnefoɔ nsam, gye me omumuyɛfoɔ ne otirimuɔdenfoɔ nsam.
O Awurade Nyankopɔn, wone m’anidasoɔ, wo na mefiri me mmɔfraase de me ho too wo soɔ.
Wo na mefiri yafunum mede m’akyiri metweree woɔ, wo na woyii me firii me maame yam.
Mayɛ nnipa bebree ani so anwanwadeɛ, nanso wone me dwankɔbea a ɛyɛ den.
W’ayeyie ne w’anidie bɛhyɛ m’anomu ma da mu nyinaa.
Nto me ntwene me nkɔkoraaberɛ mu; na sɛ m’ahoɔden sa a, nnya me.
Na m’atamfoɔ ka me ho asɛm, na wɔn a wɔtɛ me kra bom tu agyina,
Na wɔka sɛ: “Onyankopɔn apa no. na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
O Onyankopɔn, mma wo ne me ntam nnware. O me Nyankopɔn, yɛ ntɛm bɛboa me.
Me kra ho asɛmpɛfoɔ ani bɛwu na wɔayera, ma wɔn a wɔpɛ me sɛeɛ no mfira ahohorabɔ ne animguaseɛ.
Na me deɛ, mɛtwɛn daa; na mede bi bɛka w’ayeyie nyinaa ho.
M’ano bɛka wo tenenee, ɛbɛka wo nkwagyeɛ da mu nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ mennim ne dodoɔ ano.
Mede Awurade Nyankopɔn ahoɔdenneɛ bɛba abɛka wo tenenee
O Onyankopɔn, wo na wofiri me mmɔfraase kyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na maka w’anwanwadeɛ no mabɛduru sɛsɛɛ.
O Onyankopɔn, sɛ mebɔ akɔkoraa na mefu dwono mpo a, nnya me, kɔsi sɛ mɛka wo tumi ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirimma, na maka wo mmaninyɛ akyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛba nyinaa.
O Onyankopɔn, wo tenenee kɔduru sorosoro; O Onyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ?
Woama m'ahunu amaneɛ bebree a ɛyɛ ya, na woatwe me afiri asase akunu mu asane aba.
Wobɛma me kɛseyɛ adɔ, na woadane w’ani akyekyere me werɛ.
Me nso mede bɛnta bɛyi wo ayɛ, wo nokorɛdie ho, O me Nyankopɔn. O Israel Kronkronni, mede sankuten bɛto dwom ama wo.
Sɛ meto ayeyie dwom ma wo a, a woagye no no ho bɛsane no.
Mede me kɛtrɛma nso bɛka wo tenenee ho asɛm daa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔne no ani awu, Asomdwoeɛ hene ne n’ahennie
72: O Onyankopɔn, fa w’atemmuo ma ɔhene, na fa wo tenenee ma ɔhene ba.
Ma no mfa tenenee nni wo nkurɔfoɔ asɛm mma wɔn, na ɔmfa atɛntenenee nni mma wo mmɔborɔni.
Mmepɔ bɛso asomdwoeɛ ama ɔman, na nkokoɔ nso de tenenee aba.
Ma no nni ɔman no mu mmɔborɔfoɔ asɛm mma wɔn, na wagye ahiafoɔ mma nkwa, na wabubu nhyɛsofoɔ mu pasapasa.
Awia ne bosome da so wɔ hɔ yi, wɔbɛsuro wo, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Ɔbɛba sɛ nsuo a ɛtɔ gu serɛ a wɔahu soɔ so,
Ne berɛ so, ɔteneneeni bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm, na asomdwoeɛ pii bɛba akɔduru sɛ bosome nni hɔ bio.
Ɔbɛdi hene afiri po so akɔsi po so, de afiri asubɔnten no so akɔsi asase ano.
Wɔn a wɔte serɛ so bɛkoto n’anim, na n’atamfo atafere mfuturo.
Tarsis ne nsupɔ so ahemfo,
Na ahemfo nyinaa bɛkoto asɔre no,
Na ɔbɛgye hiani a ɔsu frɛ no, ne mmɔborɔni ne deɛ ɔnni boafoɔ nso.
Ɔbɛkora ɔbrɛfoɔ ne ohiani so, na wagye ahiafoɔ kra nkwa.
Ɔbɛgye wɔn kra afiri nhyɛsoɔ ne atirimuɔdensɛm mu, na wɔn mogya boɔ bɛyɛ den n’ani so.
Na ɔbɛnya nkwa, na ɔde Seba sika no bi bɛma no, na ɔno nso ɔbɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama no daa,
Asase no so aburoofuo bɛdɔɔso; ɛbɛbu so akɔduru mmepɔ atifi, ɛso aba bɛwoso sɛ Lebanon, na kuro no mufoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmm sɛ asase so afifideɛ.
Ne din bɛtena hɔ daa, na awia wɔ hɔ yi ne din asi so, na nnipa de no ahyira wɔn ho, na amanaman nyinaa afrɛ no nhyira.
Nhyira nka Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn; a ɔno nko yɛ anwanwadeɛ no.
Na nhyira nka n’animuonyam din no daa daa; na n’animuonyam nhyɛ asase nyinaa so ma.
Yese ba Dawid mpaebɔ no aba awieeɛ.
73: Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn yɛ ma Israel, ɔyɛ ma wɔn a wɔn akomam teɛ.
Na me deɛ, anka me nan reyɛ amane, na ɛkaa kakraa bi sɛ m’anammɔn rewatiri.
Na metwee ahokyerɛfoɔ ho ninkunu, ɛfiri sɛ mehunuu abɔnefoɔ yie a wɔdie no.
Wɔnhunu owuo mu aninyanneɛ,
Adasamma haw deɛ, ebi mpo nka wɔn, na deɛ ɛto nnipa nyinaa no, ebi nto wɔn.
Ɛno nti wɔde ahantan ayɛ kɔnmuadeɛ [barehyia]; awudisɛm afira wɔn sɛ ntoma.
Sradeɛ ama wɔn ani apupu; wɔanya aboro deɛ wɔsusu no wɔn akomam.
Wɔsi atwetwe na wɔde adwemmɔne ka amimdie asɛm,
Wɔma wɔn ano so tia ɔsoro, na wɔn kɛtrɛma nenam asase so.
Enti wɔn nkurɔfoɔ twe bɛdane wɔn, na wɔnya nsuo kuruwa ma nom.
Na wɔse: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Onyankopɔn bɛhunu, nimdeɛ wɔ ɔsorosoroni no tirim anaa?
Hwɛ! Saa na abɔnefoɔ a wɔte hɔ dwoodwoo daa no teɛ.
Ampa ara mate m’akomam kwa, na mahohoro me nsa bemdie mu kwa.
Nanso wɔaha me da mu nyinaa na wɔatwe m’aso anɔpa biara.
Sɛ mekaa sɛ: “Mɛka asɛm a ɛte saa” a, anka hwɛ! matwa wo mmasantene nkontompo.
Na mesusuu ho sɛ mɛhunu adeɛ yi,
kɔsii sɛ mekɔɔ Nyankopɔn kronkron mu hɔ na mekɔhunuu deɛ akyire ɛbɛwie wɔn daakye.
Ampa ara, wode wɔn gyina deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ torɔ, wode wɔn hwe fam bubu wɔn pasaa.
O hwɛ sɛdeɛ wɔadane sɛ amamfo seesei ara,
Sɛdeɛ obi so daeɛ na n’ani teɛ no, saa na O Awurade, sɛ wokanyane wo ho a, wobɛbu wɔn nipaban sɛ adehunu bi kɛkɛ.
M’akoma dii awerɛhoɔ,
Meyɛɛ ɔkwasea a na mennim de,
Na me deɛ, mɛtena wo nkyɛn daa,
Wonam w’afotuo so bɛkyerɛ me kwan, na awieeɛ koraa wode me bɛkɔ animuonyam mu.
Hwan bio na mewɔ no wɔ soro? W’akyi no, menhwehwɛ hwee asase so.
Ma me honam ne m’akoma nwie sa, Onyankopɔn ne m’akoma botan ne me kyɛfa daa.
Na hwɛ, wɔn a wɔfiri wo nkyɛn kɔ akyiri no bɛyera, wobɛsɛe wɔn a wɔfiri wo nkyɛn kɔbɔ adwaman no nyinaa.
Na me deɛ, Nyankopɔn nkyɛn tena yɛ ma me, mede Awurade Nyankopɔn ayɛ me dwankɔbea, Asafo no amanehunu mu sufrɛ
74: O Onyankopɔn, adɛn nti na woato yɛn atwene koraa yi, na w’abufuo rehye w’adidibea nnwan?
Kae w’asafo a wotɔɔ wɔn teteete, abusua a wogyee wɔn sɛ w’agyapadeɛ no, Sion bepɔ a wobɛtenaa soɔ no.
Ma wo nan so bɛhwɛ daa amamfo no, ɔtamfoɔ asɛe kronkronbea hɔ ade nyinaa.
W’atamfo teateam w’ahyiaeɛ mu, wɔasi wɔn frankaa de ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne.
Wɔyɛɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔma mmonnua so kɔ soro
Na afei ɛho nnwinneɛ nyinaa, wɔde akuma ne asaeɛ abubu.
Wɔde gya ato wo kronkronbea hɔ, wɔagu deɛ wo din tenaeɛ no ho fi.
Wɔkae wɔn akoma mu sɛ: Momma yɛmmia wɔn nkɔ fam prɛko. Wɔahyehye Nyankopɔn ahyiaeɛ nyinaa wɔ asase no so.
Yɛnhunu yɛn nsɛnkyerɛnne; odiyifoɔ biara nni hɔ bio, na yɛn mu biara nnim da ko a ɛbɛkɔ akɔsie.
O Onyankopɔn, da bɛn na atamfo mmɔ wo ahohora nkɔsie? Ɔtamfoɔ ngu wo din ho fi daa anaa?
Adɛn nti na wotwe wo nsa, wo nsa nifa? Yi firi wo kokom, na sɛe wɔn.
Nanso Onyankopɔn ne me Hene firi teteete, ɔyɛ nkwagyeɛ adwuma asase so.
Wo na wode w’ahoɔden paee po mu; wobobɔɔ nsuo atweaseɛ ti wɔ nsuo mu.
Wopɛkyɛɛ dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn-[Leviathan] ti, wode no yɛɛ ɛserɛ sofoɔ aduane.
Wo na wopaee asutire ne asutene mu; na womaa asubɔnten a ɛsene daa weeɛ.
Wo na adekyeeɛ yɛ wo dea, na anadwo nso wɔ woɔ, wo na wosiesiee nkanea, ne awia.
Ɛyɛ wo na wotwitwaa asase ahyeɛ nyinaa; na wo na woyɛɛ ahuhuro ne awɔ berɛ.
O Awurade, kae yei sɛ atamfoɔ bɔɔ wo ahohora, na ɔman agyegyentwie guu wo din ho fi.
Mfa w’aborɔnoma kra nhyɛ wuram mmoa nsa. Mma wo werɛ mmfiri wo mmɔborɔni kra daa.
Ma w’ani mmra apam no so, na atirimuɔdensɛm tenabea ayeyɛ asase so nkokoam ma.
O mma deɛ wɔhyɛ no soɔ mmfa animguaseɛ nsane mmma. Ma mmɔborɔni ne ohiani nyi wo din ayɛ.
O Onyankopɔn, sɔre, bɛdi wo ara w’asɛm, kae sɛdeɛ ɔkwasea bɔ wo ahohora da mu nyinaa no.
Mma wo werɛ mmfiri w’atamfo nne, wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ no nnyegyeeɛ kɔ soro daa. Onyankopɔn yɛ wiase temmufoɔ tenenee
75: O Onyankopɔn, yɛda wo ase da wo ase, w’anwanwadwuma kyerɛ sɛ wo din bɛn.
“Mɛba berɛ a ɛsɛ mu, na me ara mabɛbu atɛntenenee.
Asase ne wɔn a wɔte soɔ nyinaa mu hodwo a, me na mede mu afadum sisi hɔ.” Sela.
Meka kyerɛɛ ahokyerɛfoɔ sɛ: “Monnyɛ ahokyerɛ,” ne abɔnefoɔ sɛ: “Mommma abɛn no so.
Mommma mo abɛn so nnkɔ soro.
Na ɛmfiri apueeɛ, na ɛmfiri atɔeɛ, nanso ɛmfiri mmepɔ serɛ so,
Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn ne ɔtemmufoɔ. Ɔbrɛ oyi ase, na ɔma oyi so.
Na kuruwa bi wɔ Awurade nsam; emu nsa repu ahuro, mfrasa ayɛ mu ma aseɛ puo mpo, asase so abɔnefoɔ nyinaa bɛfefe anom”
Me deɛ, mɛka ho asɛm daa daa; Mɛto ayeyie dwom ama Yakob Nyankopɔn.
“Na abɔnefoɔ mmɛn nyinaa, mɛbubu agu.” Na ateneneefoɔ mmɛn deɛ, wɔbɛma so. Nkonimdie ne Nyankopɔn ayeyie dwom
76: Yuda mu na wɔahunu Onyankopɔn, ne din yɛ kɛse wɔ Israel mu.
Ɛhɔ na ɔbubuu tadua mu mmɛmma, ne ɛkyɛm ne nkrantɛ ne ɔsa. Sela.
W’anim yɛ nyam, wokorɔn sene ahayɔ mmepɔ.
Wɔasɛe abrane akokoɔdurufoɔ no, na akokoɔdurofoɔ no mu biara annya nsa amfa anko.
O Yakob Nyankopɔn, w’ateatea nti, nteaseɛnam kafoɔ ne apɔnkɔ adeda hatee.
Wo deɛ, wo ho yɛ hu, hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina w’anim?
Womaa wɔtee w’atemmuo firii soro; asase suroeɛ na ɛyɛɛ dinn,
berɛ a Onyankopɔn sɔre bɛbuu atɛn, sɛ ɔbɛgye wɔn a wɔdwoɔ asase soɔ nyinaa no. Sela.
Na nnipa abufuhyeɛ dane wo ayeyie, wode abufuhyeɛ a ɛboro soɔ bɔ abɔsoɔ.
Monhyɛ Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn, bɔ, na momfa mma no. Ma wɔn a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia nyinaa mfa ayɛyɛdeɛ mmrɛ deɛ ne ho yɛ hu no.
Ɔbɛhu atumfoɔ home agu, ne ho yɛ asase so ahemfo hu.
77: Mɛma me nne so akyerɛ Onyankopɔn, mɛma me nne so akyerɛ Onyankopɔn,
M’ahohia da mu na mehwehwɛɛ Awurade, metenee me nsam anadwo, na ampa aba,
Mekae Onyankopɔn a, mesi apini, medwene a, me honhom tɔ piti. Sela.
Wokura m’anisuatɛtɛ mu, ɛpempem me, na mentumi nkasa.
Medwene tete nna no,
Mekae m’anadwo dwom, medwene m’akomam, na me honhom hwehwɛm pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Awurade bɛto yɛn atwene daa,
N’adɔeɛ atwam kɔ koraa anaa? N’asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no asa ama awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa anaa?
Enti Onyankopɔn werɛ afiri adom, anaasɛ n’abufuo nti watwa ne mmɔborɔhunu mu? Sela.
Ɛnna mese: Me dadwene a ɛda me soɔ ne sɛ, mɛkae Ɔsorosoroni no nsa nifa mfeɛ”?
Mɛkae Awurade nneyɛɛ; ampa ara, mɛkae anwanwadeɛ a woyɛɛ no tete no.
Na masusu wo nnwuma nyinaa ho, na madwene wo nneyɛɛ nso ho.
O Onyankopɔn, w’akwan wɔ kronkronbea hɔ. Onyame bɛn na ɔyɛ kɛseɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn?
Wone Onyankopɔn a woyɛ anwanwadeɛ. woama wɔahunu wo tumi, aman mu.
Wo basa na wode agye wo man, Yakob ne Yosef mma no. Sela.
O Onyankopɔn, nsuo nyinaa ahu wo, nsuo nyinaa ahu wo; na wɔbɔɔ birim,
Mununkum tɔɔ nsuo bitibiti; w’agyan nso pepaa anyinam.
W’aprannaa boboom, ahum a ɛdi kyinhyia mu.
Wo kwan faa ɛpo mu, na w’anammɔn kwan da nsuo pii mu;
Wonam Mose ne Aaron nsa so dii  wo man anim sɛ nnwankuo.
78: O me man, monyɛ aso mma me mmara; Monwɛn mo aso mma m’anom nsɛm.
Mɛbue m’ano mmebuo mu, mɛyi atetesɛm adi sɛ akasabebuo.
Deɛ yɛateɛ na yɛnim ne deɛ yɛn agyanom aka akyerɛ yɛn no;
Yɛremfa nhunta wɔn mma, Na yɛbɛka Awurade ayeyie akyerɛ ne ne tumidie, ne n’anwanwadeɛ a
Ɔde adanseɛ tintim Yakob mu, Na ɔhyɛɛ mmara wɔ Israel mu, Ɛno ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɔde maa yɛn
Ɛno na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛbɛba, mma a wɔbɛwo wɔn no, bɛhunu, na wɔsi so a, wɔaka
Ɛno bɛma wɔde wɔn ho ato Na wɔn werɛ amfiri Onyankopɔn
Na wɔanyɛ sɛ wɔn agyanom, mma asoɔdenfoɔ ne atuatefoɔ, Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔansiesie Na wɔn honhom anni Onyankopɔn
Efraim mma a wɔnim agyan toɔ no mpo,
Wɔanni Onyankopɔn apam so, Na ne mmara nso, wɔannante mu.
Wɔn werɛ firii ne nneyɛɛ
Ɔyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ wɔ wɔn agyanom anim, Egypt asase so, Soan petee mu.
Ɔpaee ɛpo mu de wɔn twaa mu, na ɔmaa nsuo no gyinaa sɛ ekuo.
Ɔde mununkum dii wɔn anim Na anadwo munyinaa nso, ɔde egya a ɛhyerɛn dii wɔn anim.
Ɔpaee abotan mu wɔ serɛ so, Na ɛmaa wɔnyaa nsuo pii nomeeɛ
Ɔmaa nsubɔntene firii ɔbotan mu baeɛ, na ɔmaa nsuo senee sɛ asutene.
Nanso wɔkɔɔ so ara yɛɛ no bɔne, tee Ɔsorosoroni no anim atua, anwea pradada so.
Na wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛeɛ bisaa no aduane a wɔn kra kɔn dɔeɛ,
Aane, wɔkasa tiaa Onyankopɔn bɛtumi ato pono
Hwɛ! ɔbɔɔ ɔbotan maa nsuo baeɛ na asubɔnten senee; “Ɔbɛtumi ama yɛn paanoo anaa? Na ɔbɛtumi asiesie nam ama ne man?”
Ɛno na Awurade teeɛ na ne bo na abufuo nso sɔre tiaa Israel,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔannye Onyankopɔn
Nanso ɔhyɛɛ ɔsoro mununkum,
Ɔtɔɔ mana guu wɔn so sɛ Ɔsoro aduane na ɔde maa wɔn.
Nnipa dii abɔfoɔ aduane;
Ɔmaa apueeɛ mframa bɔ firii na ɔde ne tumi twee anafoɔ
Ɔtɔɔ nam guu wɔn so sɛ mfuturo, Ne ntakraboa sɛ mpoano anwea.
Ɔmaa wɔtotɔɔ wɔn nsraban mu, de twaa wɔn tenabea ho hyiae.
Enti wɔdidi mee paa. ɛfiri sɛ ɔmaa wɔn wɔn akɔnnɔdeɛ.
Berɛ a wɔn akɔnnɔ to ntwaeɛ, na wɔn aduane no da so wɔ wɔn anom no,
Onyankopɔn hwiee n’abufuo guu wɔn so. na ɔkunkumm wɔn mu abrane no mu bi, na ɔde Israel mmeranteɛ hwehwee fam.
Yei nyinaa akyi no, wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne, na wɔannye n’anwanwadeɛ no anni.
Enti ɔtwaa wɔn nkwa nna so te sɛ mframa ara kwa, Ne wɔn mfeɛ so, akomatusɛm mu.
Berɛ biara nso a ɔbɛkunkum wɔn no, wɔhwehwɛ n’akyiri kwan, Na wɔsan wɔn akyi kɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.
Na wɔkaee sɛ Onyankopɔn ne wɔn Botan, Na Ɔsorosoroni no ne wɔn Gyefoɔ.
Nanso wɔde wɔn ano dɛfɛdɛfɛɛ no; Wɔde wɔn kɛtrɛma twaa no nkontompo.
Na wɔn akoma nni mu wɔ ne ho; na wɔanni n’apam no mu nokorɛ.
Ne nyinaa akyi no, ɔhuu wɔn mmɔbɔ; ɔde wɔn bɔne kyɛɛ wɔn, na wansɛe wɔn. Mprɛ pii na ɔsiankaa n’abufuo, Na wanhwanyan n’abufuo nyinaa.
Berɛ nyinaa ɔkaee sɛ wɔyɛ honam, mframa a ɛkorɔ na ɛnsane n’akyiri  mma bio.
Mprɛ ahe ara na wɔante n’anim atua ɛserɛ no soɔ, na wɔanho ne werɛ anwea pradada no soɔ!
Wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ mprɛ pii, na wɔyii Israel Kronkronni no ahi.
Wɔankae ne tumi, da a ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn atamfo nsam no,
na ɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ wɔ Egypt ne n’anwanwadeɛ, Soan petee mu no.
Sɛdeɛ ɔdanee wɔn nsubɔntene mogya, na wɔantumi annom wɔn nsuwansuwa.
Ɔsomaa ahuriiɛ bɛguu wɔn so maa wɔbɛwee wɔn, ne mponkyerɛne maa wɔbɛsɛee wɔn.
Ɔde wɔn nnɔbaeɛ maa mmɛbɛ, Na ɔde wɔn nsa ano adwuma maa ntutummɛ.
Ɔde asukɔtweaa sɛee wɔn bobe, na ɔde nsukyenkyeneeɛ bɔɔ wɔn akyee nnua,
Ɔde wɔn nyɛmmoa maa asukɔtweaa, ne wɔn mmoakuo maa asraman.
Ɔsomaa n’abufuhyeɛ baa wɔn so, Anibereɛ ne ahi ne ahohia; Ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ asafodɔm nso sɛ wɔmfa ɔhaw mmra wɔn so.
Ɔbɔɔ kwan maa n’abufuo. wamfa owuo ankame wɔn kra; na ɔyii wɔn nkwa maa owuyareɛ.
Ɔbobɔɔ Egypt mmakan nyinaa kunkum wɔn, wɔn ahoɔden mfitiaseɛ no, Ham ntomadan mu.
Na ɔgyaa ne man sɛ nnwan, Na ɔkaa wɔn sɛ mmoakuo wɔ serɛ no so.
Ɔdii wɔn anim dwoodwoo kɔe na wɔansuro, wɔn atamfo deɛ, ɛpo no kataa wɔn so.
Na ɔde wɔn baa ne kronkronbea hyeɛ so, bepɔ a ne nsa nifa gyeeɛ no so.
Wɔn nti, ɔpampamm amanaman, wɔn anim, na ɔtwee wɔn awunnyadeɛ so ntonto kyɛɛ no homa so, na ɔmaa Israel mmusuakuo tenatenaa wɔn ntomadan mu.
Nanso wɔsɔɔ Ɔsorosoroni Nyankopɔn hwɛeɛ tee ne so atua, na n’adansesɛm no, wɔanni so.
Wɔsanee wɔn akyi, na wɔtwaa nkontompo sɛ wɔn agyanom; wɔmanee sɛ tadua daadaafoɔ.
Wɔde wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea no hyɛɛ no abufuo, na wɔde wɔn ahoni maa no twee ninkunu.
Enti Onyankopɔn teeɛ, no ne bo fuu kɛse, na Israel ho yɛɛ no nwunu koraa.
Na ɔgyaa Silo tenabea no, ntomadan a ɔsii no nnipa mu no.
Ɔde n’ahoɔden hyɛɛ nnommumfa mu, na ɔde n’animuonyam hyɛɛ ɔtamfoɔ nsa.
Ɔgyaa ne man maa nkrantɛ,
Egya hyee wɔn mmeranteɛ, na wɔn mmabaa nso, wɔanto wɔn ayeforɔ dwom.
Wɔn asɔfoɔ totɔɔ nkrantɛ ano,
Na Awurade nyanee sɛ obi a ɔfiri nna mu, sɛ ɔkatakyie a nsa ma no teateam.
Na ɔbobɔɔ n’atamfo maa wɔsanee wɔn akyi,
Nso ɔpoo Yosef ntomadan no; Na wanyi Efraim abusuakuo no.
Na mmom Yuda abusuakuo na ɔyiiɛ,
Na ɔsii ne kronkronbea sɛ ɔsorosoro, Te sɛ asase a ɔde atim hɔ afebɔɔ no.
Ɛnna ɔyii n’akoa Dawid, Na ɔfaa no firii nnwammuo mu.
Ɔmaa no firii nnwammereɛ a wɔma nufoɔ akyiridie bae,
Ɔde akoma a ɛdi mu yɛnee wɔn, Na ɔde ne nsa dii wɔn anim ahokokwa so.
79: O Onyankopɔn, amanaman aba w’agyapadeɛ mu; Wɔagu w’asɔrefie kronkron no ho fi; wɔama Yerusalem ayɛ agoago.
Wɔde wo nkoa afunu ama wiem nnomaa sɛ aduane, wɔde w’ahotefoɔ nam ama asase so mmoa.
Wɔahwie wɔn mogya agu sɛ nsuo de atwa Yerusalem ho nyinaa ahyia, na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛsie wɔn.
Yɛayɛ ahohora ama wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho, fɛdie ne ahiyie ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia.
O Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wo bo bɛfuo? Ɛnkɔsi daa anaa? na wo ninkuntwe adɛre sɛ ogya?
Hwie w’abufuo gu amanaman a wɔnnim woɔ, Ne ahennie a wɔmmɔ wo din no so.
Wɔamene Yakob, Na wɔama ne tenabea adane amamfo.
O Nkae akanefoɔ amumuyɛ mfa ngu yɛn so, yɛ ntɛm ma w’ayamhyehyeɛ mmɛhyia yɛn,
Di boa yɛn, O yɛn nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn, Gye yɛn nkwa, na wo din nti kata yɛn bɔne so.
Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ amanaman no ka sɛ: “Ɛhefa na wɔn Nyankopɔn no wɔ?” Ma wɔnhunu amanaman mu, yɛn anim, sɛ wotɔ wo nkoa mogya a wɔka guiɛ no so were.
Ma deduani apinisie nnuru w’anim. sɛ wo nsa kɛseyɛ teɛ no, na gye wɔn a wɔayi wɔn ama owuo no.
Na ahohora a wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho de abɔ wo, Awurade, no, dane no mprɛ nson gu wɔn kokom.
Na yɛn a yɛyɛ wo man ne w’adidibea nnwan no, yɛbɛka w’ayeyie akyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa.
80: O Israel dwanhwɛfoɔ, yɛ aso, Wo a woka Yosef sɛ nnwankuo no. Wo a wote kerubim soɔ, pue na hyerɛn ɛ.
Efraim ne Benyamin ne Manase anim
O Onyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra, na ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
O asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, wo man mpaebɔ bɛyɛ wo abufuo akɔsi da bɛn?
Wode nisuo yɛɛ aduane maa wɔdii, na wode nisuo maa wɔnomee.
Wode yɛn yɛɛ ntɔkwa maa wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho, na yɛn atamfoɔ sereseree wɔ wɔn mu.
O asafo Nyankopɔn, san fa yɛn bra; na ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
Wotuu bobe firii Egypt bae. wotutuu amanaman no na woduaeɛ.
Ne nwunu kataa mmepɔ so, Na ne mman kataa Onyankopɔn ntweneduro so.
Ne mman nyini kɔduruu po ho, Na ne duban nso kɔduruu asubɔnten no ho.
Adɛn nti na woabubu ne ban, ma wɔn a wɔnam kwan soɔ nyinaa tete n’aba bie?
O asafo Nyankopɔn, yɛsrɛ wo, san w’akyi bra; Brɛ w’ani ase firi soro na bɛhwɛ bobe yi,
Ne dua a wo nsa nifa atɛ, ne mman a woafa no ayɛ wo deɛ no pintinn.
Wɔde gya ahye, wɔatwa atwene. w’anim ateatea nti wɔyera.
Ma wo nsa mmra onipa a ɔwɔ wo nifa so, Ne onipa ba a woama no ayɛ den no so.
Ɛnneɛ, na yɛrensan mfiri w’akyi. Ma yɛnnya nkwa, na yɛmmɔ wo din.
O asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, san fa yɛn bra; ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
81: Monto ahurisi dwom mma Onyankopɔn yɛn ahoɔden; Mommɔ ose mma Yakob Nyankopɔn.
Mommɔ dwom na monwoso mpintin, Na mommɔ sankuo ne sankuten dɛdɛ.
Monhyɛne abɛn, bosome foforɔ so; ɔsrane korokumatwa mu, mma yɛn afahyɛ da.
Na ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ma Israel, Ɛyɛ Yakob Nyankopɔn mmara.
Ɔde yɛɛ adanseɛ maa Yosef, Berɛ a ɔfirii adi faa Egypt asase soɔ no. Ɛhɔ na metee kasa a na mennim.
“Meyii ne mmatiri firii adesoa ase, ne ne nsa firii kɛntɛn ho.
Wofrɛɛ ahohia mu, na megyee wo; Mefiri aprannaa ahuntaeɛ mu gyee wo so. Mesɔɔ wo hwɛɛ wɔ Meriba nsuo no ho. Sela.
O Me man, tie, na menni wo adanseɛ, Sɛ anka wobɛtie me a, O Israel.
Anka onyame foforɔ biara remma wo mu, Na worenkoto ananafoɔ nyame bi.
Mene Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, a ɔyii wo firii Egypt asase soɔ no. Bue w’anom tɛtrɛɛ, na menhyɛ no ma.
Nanso me man antie me nne; Israel ampɛ sɛ ɔbɛbrɛ ne ho ase ama me.
Enti megyaa wɔn sɛ wɔnni wɔn akomaden no akyi; na wɔnante wɔn ara wɔn agyinatuo mu.
O sɛ anka me man retie me ɛ, Sɛ anka Israel bɛnante m’akwan so ɛ!
Anka mɛbrɛ wɔn atamfo ase ntɛm, na madane me nsa atia wɔn ahohiahiafoɔ.
Anka Awurade atamfoɔ bɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase ama no, na wɔn berɛ akyɛre akɔsi daa.
Na ɔde ayuo mu ayuo pa ama wɔn adi, na mede abotan mu woɔ bɛma woamee.
82: “Mobɛbu ntɛnkyea akɔsi da bɛn? Na mobɛyɛ animhwɛ adi ama abɔnefoɔ akɔsi da bɛn? Sela.
Monni ɔbrɛfoɔ ne agyanka asɛm mma wɔn. Mommu mmɔborɔni ne ohiani atɛn tenenee mu.
Montwitwa nnye ɔbrɛfoɔ ne ohiani; monhwim wɔn mfiri abɔnefoɔ nsam.
Wɔnnim, na wɔnte aseɛ nso; asase nnyinasoɔ nyinaa rewoso.
“Mese, ‘Moyɛ anyame, Na mo nyinaa yɛ Ɔsorosoroni no mma.
Nanso mobɛwuwu sɛdeɛ nnipa wuo; na moatotɔ sɛ ahemfo mu biara.
Sɔre ɛ, O Onyankopɔn, na bu asase atɛn; na wo na wobɛdi adeɛ, amanaman nyinaa mu.
83: O Onyankopɔn, nyɛ komm; Nka w’ano ntom, na nhome, O Onyankopɔn.
Na hwɛ! w’atamfo yɛ gyegyeegye; Na wɔn a wɔkyiri wo kɔkɔkɔkɔ no ama wɔn tiri so.
Wo man tiri so na wɔrepam anyansapam, na wɔkɔ wɔn a wɔahunta no tiri so agyina.
Deɛ wɔka ne sɛ: “Mommra mma yɛntɔre wɔn ase mfiri ɔman no mu, Na wɔankae Israel din bio.”
Na wɔde akoma korɔ tu agyina,
Wɔn a wɔtete Edom ntomadan mu ne Ismaelfoɔ ne Moab ne Hagrifoɔ,
Gebal ne Ammon ne Amalek, Filistia ne wɔn a wɔtete Tiro.
Asiria nso de ne ho akɔbata wɔn ho,
Yɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Midian ne Sisera, Ne Yabin wɔ Kison subɔn ho no.
Wɔn ase tɔree wɔ En-Dor; na wɔbɛyɛɛ asase so nwira.
Yɛ wɔn ne wɔn adehyeɛ sɛ Oreb ne Seeb, na yɛ wɔn ahemfo nyinaa sɛ Sebah ne Salmuna,
wɔn na wɔka sɛ: “Momma yɛnnye Onyankopɔn afie mfa.”
O Me Nyankopɔn, yɛ wɔn sɛ ahum a ɛdi kyinhyia,
Sɛdeɛ egya hye kwaeɛ Na ogyaframa hyehye mmepɔ soɔ no,
Saa ara na fa w’ahum taa wɔn, na fa wo mframa denden no hunahuna wɔn.
O Awurade, ma wɔn ani nwu, na wɔmmisa wo din akyiri kwan.
Ma wɔn ani nwu, na wɔn ho nyera wɔn daa; Ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔnyera,
Na wɔnhunu sɛ wo a wo din de Awurade no, Wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni, asase nyinaa so.
84: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wo tenabea hɔnom si yɛ fɛ,
Me kra ani gyina, ɛtɔ piti mpo, M’akoma ne me honam to ahurisi dwom ma Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no.
Nso apatuprɛ mpo anya ɛdan, na asomfena anya ne pirebuo wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛto ne mma agu mu, ɛne w’afɔrebukyia no, O asafo Awurade, me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn.
Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔte wo fie,
Nhyira ne onipa a n’ahoɔden wɔ wo mu, na Sion atempɔn no wɔ n’akomam.
Sɛ wɔnam baka bɔn no mu a, bereamporɔsuo nso de nhyira pii kata so.
Wɔnante firi ahoɔden mu kɔ ahoɔden mu; wɔn mu biara bɛpue Onyankopɔn anim wɔ Sion.
O asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ; Yɛ aso ɛ, Yakob Nyankopɔn. Sela.
O Onyankopɔn, yɛn kyɛm, hwɛ ɛ, na hwɛ deɛ woasra no no anim.
Ɛfiri sɛ wo fie dakorodie yɛ Mɛgyina me Nyankopɔn fie kwan ano mmom sene sɛ mɛtena abɔnefoɔ ntomadan mu.
Awurade Nyankopɔn yɛ awia ne kyɛm; Awurade ma adom ne animuonyam, Ɔremfa adepa biara nkame wɔn a wɔnante teeyɛ mu no.
O asafo Awurade, nhyira ne onipa
85: O Awurade, woadom w’asase, woasan de Yakob nnommum no aba.
Wode wo man mfomsoɔ akyɛ wɔn; Woakata wɔn bɔne nyinaa so. Sela.
Woatwe w’anibereɛ nyinaa, woadane afiri w’abufuhyeɛ ho.
O yɛn nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra, na yi yɛn ho abufuo firi wo mu.
Wobɛkɔ so ama w’ani abere yɛn so afebɔɔ anaa? Wobɛtwe w’abufuo mu akɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ mu?
Worensane mma yɛn nkwa, na wo man adi ahurisie wo mu anaa?
O Awurade, yi w’adɔeɛ adi kyerɛ yɛn,
Mɛtie deɛ Onyankopɔn Awurade bɛka. asɛm akyerɛ ne man ne n’ahotefoɔ, nanso mma wɔnnsane nnkɔ nkwaseadeɛ mu.
Ampa ara, ne nkwagyeɛ bɛn wɔn a wɔsuro no, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na animuonyam atena yɛn asase soɔ.
Adom ne nokorɛ ahyia; Tenenee ne asomdwoeɛ nso, wɔadi mfeano.
Nokorɛ bɛfifiri asase so, na tenenee afiri soro ahwɛ.
Awurade nso, adepa na ɔde bɛma, na yɛn asase bɛma ne nnɔbae.
Tenenee bɛdi n’anim, Na n’anammɔn bɛyi kwan ama yɛn.
86: O Awurade, brɛ w’aso ase tie me; Na meyɛ mmɔborɔni ne ohiani.
Hwɛ me kra so, na meyɛ ɔhotefoɔ; wo, ne me Nyankopɔn; Gye w’akoa a ɔde ne ho ato wo soɔ no.
Hu me mmɔbɔ, O Awurade, Na wo na mesu mefrɛ wo da mu nyinaa.
Ma w’akoa kra ani nnye, Na wo, O Awurade, na mema me kra so ma woɔ.
O Awurade, woyɛ, na wowɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wode bɔne bɛfirie; na w’adɔeɛ dɔɔso ma wɔn a wɔfrɛ woɔ nyinaa.
O Awurade, yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ;
Obiara nte sɛ wo, anyame mu, O Awurade, na biribiara nte sɛ wo nnwuma.
Amanaman a woyɛeɛ nyinaa bɛba abɛkoto w’anim, O Awurade, na wɔabɛhyɛ wo din animuonyam.
Na woyɛ kɛseɛ, na woyɛ anwanwadeɛ,
O Awurade, kyerɛkyerɛ me wo kwan; ka m’akoma bom ma no nsuro wo din.
O Awurade me Nyankopɔn, mede m’akoma nyinaa bɛda wo ase, Na mahyɛ wo din animuonyam akɔsi daa,
Ɛfiri sɛ w’adɔeɛ dɔɔso ma me, na woayi me kra afiri Asamando bunu mu.
O Onyankopɔn, ahantanfoɔ asɔre atia me; na atirimuɔdenfoɔ asafo rehwehwɛ me kra, na wɔmfaa wo nsii wɔn ani so.
O Awurade, woyɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunufoɔ, Ɔdomfoɔ a wo bo kyɛre fuo na w’adɔeɛ ne wokorɛdie dɔɔso.
Dane w’ani kyerɛ me, na dom me.
Yɛ me ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ma no nsi me yie, na m’atamfoɔ nhunu, na wɔn ani nwu, sɛ wo, Awurade, woaboa me akyekyere me werɛ.
87: Ne fapem wɔ mmepɔ kronkron no mu.
Mɛbɔ Rahab ne Babilon din akyerɛ wɔn a wɔnim me; Hwɛ, O Filistia ne Tiro ne Kus [Ethiopia], “Emu na wɔwoo wɔn mu biara.”
Na Sion ho deɛ, wɔbɛka sɛ: Wɔwoo wɔn nyinaa mmaako mmaako wɔ ne mu, Na Ɔsorosoroni no bɛma no atim pintinn.
Sɛ Awurade retwerɛtwerɛ amanaman no din a, ɔbɛka sɛ: “Emu na wɔwoo wɔn mu biara.” Sela.
Na nnwontofoɔ ne asafoɔ bɛka sɛ: Me mmasuo nyinaa wɔ wo mu.
88: O Awurade, me nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn, mesu mefrɛ, w’anim, awia ne anadwo.
Ma me mpaebɔ nnuru w’anim, na brɛ w’aso ase ma me sufrɛ.
Wɔakan me afra wɔn a wɔrekɔ amena mu; Mayɛ sɛ ɔbarima a ɔnni ahoɔden,
Wɔato me atwene awufoɔ mu sɛ atɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn agu ɛda mu na wɔatwa wɔn afiri wo nsam.
Wode me ato Amena donkodonko mu,
W’abufuo ato ahyɛ me so, Na woama w’asorɔkye nyinaa abu afa me so. Sela.
Woama m’amannifoɔ afiri me nkyɛn kɔ akyirikyiri; wode me ayɛ wɔn akyiwadeɛ, wɔato me mu a meremfiri adie.
Amanehunu nti, m’ani so ayɛ wisiwisi. mefrɛ wo, Awurade, da mu nyinaa,
Wobɛyɛ anwanwadeɛ akyerɛ awufoɔ, anaasɛ nsamanfoɔ bɛsɔre ayi wo ayɛ? Sela.
Ɛda mu na wɔbɛka w’adɔeɛ ho asɛm, Anaasɛ wɔbɛka wo nokorɛdie ho asɛm wɔ ɔsɛeɛ amena mu?
Wɔbɛhunu w’anwanwadeɛ, wɔ esum mu, ne wo tenenee awerɛfire asase so?
O Awurade, wo na mesu mefrɛ woɔ, Na anɔpa biara, me mpaebɔ pue w’anim.
O Awurade, adɛn na woto me kra twene, adɛn nti na wode w’anim hunta me?
Meyɛ mmɔborɔni, na mereyɛ mawu firi me mmɔfraase, wo ho hu akuta me, na metɔ ntintan.
atwa me ho ahyia te sɛ nsuo da mu nyinaa,
Woayi ɔdɔfo ne adamfo afiri me nkyɛn kɔ akyirikyiri,
89: Mɛto Awurade adɔeɛ ho dwom daa, Mede m’ano bɛka wo nokorɛdie ho asɛm awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Na maka sɛ: “Adɔeɛ bɛsi hɔ daa, ɔsoro hɔ na wode nokorɛdie atintim.
“Me ne deɛ mayi no no apam apam bi, Maka ntam akyerɛ m’akoa Dawid sɛ,
‘Mɛma w’aseni atim afebɔɔ, akɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ so. ” Sela.
O Awurade, ɔsoro yi wo anwanwadeɛ ayɛ, ne wo nokorɛ nso wɔ akronkronfoɔ asafo mu.
Na hwan na wɔbɛtumi de no atoto Awurade ho wɔ soro, hwan na ɔsɛ Awurade, anyame mma mu?
Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsuro Nyankopɔn wɔ akronkronfoɔ asafo mu; Ɔyɛ kɛseɛ na ne ho yɛ hu sene wɔn a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia nyinaa.
O asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ, Otumfoɔ O Awurade? Wo nokorɛdie atwa wo ho nyinaa ahyia.
Wo na wodi ɛpo mfumpaabuo soɔ, Sɛ ɛmema n’asorɔkye so a, wo na woma no yɛ dinn.
Wo na woabubu Rahab pasaa sɛ ɔtɔfoɔ, wode wo tumi nsa abɔ w’atamfo apansam.
Ɔsoro yɛ wo dea, asase nso yɛ wo dea; wiase ne ne mayɛ, wo na wohyɛɛ aseɛ.
Atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam, wo ara na wobɔeɛ, Tabor ne Hermon di wo din mu ahurisie.
Tumi basa ne mmarimayɛ wɔ wo, wo nsa yɛ den, wɔama wo nifa so.
Tenenee ne atemmuo yɛ w’ahennwa nnyinasoɔ; Adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ gyina w’anim.
Nhyira ne ɔman a wɔnim osebɔ na wɔnante wo, Awurade, anim hann mu.
Wo din mu na wɔn ho bɛsɛpɛ wɔn daa nyinaa, Na wo tenenee mu na wɔama wɔn soɔ.
Wone wɔn ahoɔden animuonyam; na w’adom mu na wɔama yɛn abɛn soɔ.
Na Awurade na yɛn kyɛm wɔ no, na Israel Kronkronni no na yɛn hene wɔ no.
Da bi wokasaa anisoadehunu mu Mama obi a mayi no afiri ɔman no mu so.
Mahunu m’akoa Dawid; Mede me ngo kronkron asra no;
Ɔno na me nsa bɛma no atim, na me basa nso ahyɛ no den.
Ɔtamfo biara rensisi no, Na obusuyɛfoɔ asefoɔ biara renhyɛ ne so.
N’anim na mebubuu n’atamfo pasapasa, Na wɔn a wɔkyiri no kɔkɔkɔkɔ no, mebobɔɔ wɔn.
Na me nokorɛdie ne m’adɔeɛ ne no bɛtena, na me din mu na wɔbɛma n’abɛn soɔ.
Na mede ne nsa bɛsi po mu, na mede ne nsa nifa nso asi nsubɔntene so.
Ɔno deɛ, ɔbɛfrɛ me sɛ: Wone m’agya, me Nyankopɔn ne me nkwagyeɛ Botan!
Na me nso mede no bɛyɛ m’abakan, Na ɔbɛyɛ asase so ahemfo mu pumpuni.
Mɛkora m’adɔeɛ so mama no daa,
Mɛma n’asefoɔ atena hɔ daa, Na n’ahennwa bɛyɛ sɛ ɔsoro nna.
Sɛ ne mma gya me mmara Na wɔannante m’atemmusɛm mu,
na sɛ wɔgu m’ahyɛdeɛ ho fi Na wɔanni me mmara nsɛm so a,
ɛno deɛ mede abaa bɛba abɛtwe wɔn aso, wɔn mmarato ho, na mede ɔhaw ahodoɔ mabɛtwe wɔn aso, wɔn amumuyɛ ho.
Nanso m’adɔeɛ deɛ, merenyi mfiri ne so, na merenyɛ me nokorɛdie no ho nsakyirinsayam.
Merengu m’apam ho fi, Na m’anom asɛm nso, merensesa.
Maka me kronkronyɛ mu ntam prɛko,
N’asefoɔ bɛtena hɔ daa, Na n’ahennwa bɛyɛ sɛ awia wɔ m’anim.
Ɛbɛtim afebɔɔ sɛ bosome, sɛ ɔdanseni nokwafoɔ a ɔwɔ wiem.” Sela.
Na wo ara deɛ, woato atwene na ayɛ wo nwunu, na woafa deɛ woasra no no ho abufuo.
Woapo w’akoa apam, woagu n’abotire ho fi de ato fam.
Woadwiri ne ban nyinaa agu, woama n’aban akɛseɛ ayɛ agoago.
Wɔn a wɔtwam ɔkwan no soɔ nyinaa fom no fa, wayɛ ahohora ama wɔn a wɔtete ne ho.
Woama n’ahohiahiafoɔ nsa nifa so; woama n’atamfo nyinaa ani agye.
Woadane ne nkrantɛ ano nso, na woamma no annyina ɔsa mu.
Woama n’animuonyam abɔ no, Na woato n’ahennwa atwene fam.
Woatwa ne mmeranteberɛ nna so; Wode animguaseɛ afira no. Sela.
Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn, Awurade, na wode wo ho bɛhunta daa ama w’abufuo adɛre sɛ ogya?
Kae me nna tiaa a ɛyɛ: Ade hunu yi ara nti na wobɔɔ nnipa mma nyinaa?
Ɔdasani bɛn na ɔte ase a ɔrenhunu owuo, na ɔbɛyi ne kra afiri Asamando nsam? Sela.
O Awurade, ɛhe na wo kane adɔeɛ no wɔ, Deɛ wokaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid, wo nokorɛdie mu no?
O Awurade, kae wo nkoa ahohora a ɛfiri aman dodoɔ no nyinaa mu a ɛda me koko soɔ no.
O Awurade, w’atamfo bɔ ahohora, wɔbɔ deɛ woasra no no anammɔn ahohora!
Nhyira nka Awurade daa daa. Amen ne Amen. Daa Nyankopɔn ne yɛn dwanekɔbea
90: Awurade, wo na woayɛ yɛn dwanekɔbea, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Wo deɛ, wonnya mmɔɔ mmepɔ na wonnya nyii asase ne wiase adie no, na wofiri tete akyirikyiri kɔsi daakye akyirikyiri yɛ Onyankopɔn.
Woma ɔdasani dane mfuturo, na wose: “Nnipa mma, monsan nkɔ dɔteɛ mu.”
Na mfirinhyia apem yɛ w’ani so
Woma wɔsene kɔ sɛ susuansuo, wɔte sɛ nna, anɔpa wɔfefɛ sɛ wira,
anɔpa ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm, na ɛfefɛ, anwummerɛ wɔtwa, na ɛtwintwam.
Yɛn awieeɛ aba, w’abufuo nti, na yɛahye w’abufuhyeɛ no ano.
Wode yɛn amumuyɛ asi w’anim, wode yɛn kokoam bɔne aba w’anim hann no mu.
Na yɛn nna nyinaa atwam kɔ w’abufuo mu, yɛahwere yɛn mfeɛ sɛ asomusɛm bi.
Yɛn mfeɛ nna deɛ, ɛyɛ aduɔson (70); Na sɛ yɛwɔ ahoɔden paa na sɛ ɛboro so a, na ɛduru aduɔwɔtwe, Nanso emu ahohoahoadeɛ yɛ ɔbrɛ ne ahuhudeɛ, na ɛtwa mu ntɛmso, na yɛtu kɔ.
Hwan na ɔnim sɛdeɛ w’abufuo mu yɛ den fa, sɛdeɛ wo ho suro teɛ no, saa ara na w’abufuhyeɛ teɛ.
Ma yɛnhunu yɛn nna kan sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ,
O Awurade, san bra! Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn? Na ma wo nkoa asɛm nyɛ wo mmɔbɔ.
Ma w’adɔeɛ mmee yɛn anɔpa, na yɛadi ahurisie, na yɛn ani agye yɛn nna nyinaa mu.
Ma yɛn ho nsane yɛn, sɛ nna a wobrɛɛ yɛn ase wɔ mu ne mfeɛ a yɛhunuu mu bɔne no.
Ma w’adwuma nna adi mma wo nkoa, na w’animuonyam nna adi, wɔn mma so.
Ma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn animteɛ mmra yɛn so, na yɛn nsa ano adwuma no, ma no nyɛ yie mma yɛn, aane, yɛn nsa ano adwuma no, ma no nyɛ yie.
91: Deɛ ɔte Ɔsorosoroni no huntabea tena Tweaduampɔn nwunu ase.
Mese Awurade sɛ: “Me dwanekɔbea ne m’abankɛseɛ, me Nyankopɔn a mede me ho meto wo soɔ.”
Na ɔno na ɔbɛgye wo afiri ofirisumfoɔ fidie mu
Ɔde ne ntakra bɛkata wo so, na ne ntaban ase na wobɛkɔ akɔhyɛ, ɔkyɛm ne nkataboɔ ne ne nokorɛ.
ɔyaredɔm a ɛnenam sum mu, nsane yareɛ a ɛsɛe ade awia ketee.
W’ani nko na wode bɛhwɛ, na woahunu abɔnefoɔ akatua.
Na wo, Awurade, ne me dwanekɔbea, ɔsorosoroni no na wode no ayɛ wo tenabea.
Bɔne renka wo, na ɔhaw remmɛn wo ntomadan.
Na wahyɛ n’abɔfoɔ ama wo, sɛ wɔnhwɛ wo so, w’akwan nyinaa mu.
Wobɛnante gyata ne ahuritia so, wobɛtiatia gyataburuwa ne ɔtweaseɛ so.
Na sɛ ɔfam me ho yi, mɛgye no, mɛma no so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim me din.
Ɔsu frɛ me, na mɛgye ne so, me ne no bɛtena ahohia mu, mɛyi no na mahyɛ no animuonyam.
Mɛma no adi nkwa tentene amee, na mama no ahunu me nkwagyeɛ. Nyankopɔn tenenee nnisoɔ ho ayeyie
92: Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔda Awurade ase Na yɛto dwom ma wo din, O Ɔsorosoroni;
Sankuo a ɛso nhoma yɛ du ne bɛnta so, Ne dwom dɛdɛ wɔ sankuten so.
Na wo, Awurade, woma m’ani gye wo nneyɛɛ ho, wo nsa ano nnwuma ho na mɛdi ahurisie.
O Awurade, hwɛ sɛdeɛ wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ fa!
Ogyimifoɔ nnim, Na ɔkwasea ntumi nte aseɛ.
Sɛ abɔnefoɔ fifiri sɛ ɛfan, Na amumuyɔfoɔ nyinaa pae sɛ nhwiren a, ɛne sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wɔn korakora.
Nanso wo Awurade deɛ, wowɔ sorosoro kɔsi daa.
Na hwɛ, w’atamfo no, O Awurade, na wɔbɛhwete amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa mu.
Nanso woama m’abɛn so sɛ ɛkoɔ deɛ; wode ngo foforɔ agu me so.
M’ani ahunu deɛ mepɛ m’atamfo ho; na m’aso ate deɛ ɛyɛ me dɛ, abɔnefoɔ a wɔsɔre tia me no ho.
Ɔteneneeni bɛfefɛ ayɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ abɛ, ɔbɛnyini sɛ Lebanon so tweneduro.
Wɔn a wɔdua wɔn Awurade fie no, bɛfefɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn abannwa so.
Sɛ wɔfu dwono mpo a, wɔbɛso aba, Na wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ akɛseɛ ne frɔmfrɔm ara,
Na wɔaka sɛ Awurade tene. Ɔno ne me Botan, na deɛ ɛntene biara nni ne mu.
93: Awurade di hene! Ɔde animuonyam ahyehyɛ ne ho; Awurade ahyehyɛ ne ho, ɔde ahoɔden akyekyere ne ho, na wiase tim hɔ pintinn a ɛrenhinhim.
Deɛ ɔsene nsukɛseɛ nne, nsuo a ɛwɔ tumi, ɔne ɔsoro hɔ tumfoɔ Awurade.
W’adansesɛm yɛ nokorɛ pii; kronkronyɛ na ɛfata wo fie, O Awurade, nnasanten nyinaa.
94: O aweretɔ Nyankopɔn Awurade, O aweretɔ Nyankopɔn, pue hyerɛn!
O asase Temmufoɔ, ma wo ho so,
O Awurade, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na abɔnefoɔ bɛkɔ soɔ, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na abɔnefoɔ nni ahurisie?
Wɔka asɛmdenden, amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa di ahantansɛm.
O Awurade, wo man na wɔbobɔ wɔn pasaa, Na w’agyapadeɛ no na wɔhiahia wɔn ho.
Wɔkum okunafoɔ ne ɔhɔhoɔ,
Na wɔka sɛ: “Awurade nhunu; na Yakob Nyankopɔn nnim deɛ ɛrekɔ soɔ.”
Ɔman mu agyimifoɔ, monte aseɛ, na mo, nkwaseafoɔ nso, da bɛn na mo bɛhunu nyansa?
Deɛ ɔyɛɛ aso no, ɔrente asɛm anaa? Na deɛ ɔnwonoo ani no, ɔrenhunu adeɛ?
Deɛ ɔtwe amanaman aso no, ɔrentenetene, na deɛ ɔkyerɛ nnipa nimdeɛ no, ɔno ɛ?
Awurade hunu nnipa adwene sɛ ɛyɛ ahuhudeɛ.
Nhyira ne onipa a wo, Awurade, wotwe n’aso, na wofiri wo mmara no mu kyerɛkyerɛ no,
sɛ wobɛma no nna bɔne ho abodamu akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛtu amena ama ɔbɔnefoɔ.
Na Awurade  rento ne man ntwene,
na atemmuo bɛsane akɔ tenenee mu, na akomam teefoɔ nyinaa bɛdi akyire.
Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ adi asie ama me? Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre agyina ne amumuyɛfoɔ adi asie ama me?
Sɛ ɛnyɛ Awurade na ɔyɛ me boafoɔ a, anka aka kakra bi na me kra akɔtena kommyɛ mu.
Sɛ mese me nan rewatiri a, wo Awurade, w’adɔeɛ na ɛwowa me.
Me mu dadwene dɔɔso a, w’awerɛkyekyerɛ gye me kra ani.
Amammɔeɛ adwa a ɛnam mmara so bɔ mmusuo no
Wɔbɔ ɔteneneeni kra so kyenku, na wɔbu mogya a ɛdi bem fɔ.
Nanso Awurade ayɛ me abankɛseɛ, na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ me dwanekɔbea botan.
Na ɔde wɔn mmusuo abua wɔn atifi, na wɔn bɔne nti ɔbɛyi wɔn afiri hɔ. Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛyi wɔn afiri hɔ.
95: O Mommra mma yɛnto anigyeɛ dwom mma Awurade, momma yɛmmɔ ose mma yɛn nkwagyeɛ botan no.
Momma yɛmfa aseda mmra n’anim; na yɛmfa nnwom nni ahurisie mma no.
Na Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ ne Ɔhenkɛseɛ, anyame nyinaa so;
Ne nsam na asase mu ahuntadeɛ wɔ, na mmepɔ so srɔnsrɔn nso wɔ no.
Ɔno na ɛpo wɔ no, na ɔno na ɔyɛeɛ, na asase pɛsɛɛ nso, ne nsa na ɛnwonoeɛ.
Na ɔno ne yɛn Nyankopɔn, na yɛn deɛ, yɛyɛ n’adidibea nkurɔfoɔ ne ne nsam nnwan.
Mommpirim mo akoma sɛdeɛ ɛsii wɔ Meriba,
Berɛ a mo agyanom gyegyee me no; na wɔsɔɔ me hwɛeɛ, nanso na wɔahunu me nnwuma.
Mfeɛ aduanan na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ no ho yɛɛ me ahi, “Ɔman a wɔfom akoma mu ne wɔn. Na wɔn deɛ, wɔnhunuu m’akwan”;
Wɔn na mekaa wɔn ho ntam m’abufuo mu sɛ: Asase nyinaa so wura no ayeyie
96: Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade! Asase nyinaa, monto dwom mma Awurade.
Monto dwom mma Awurade, monhyira ne din. Monka ne nkwagyeɛ ho asɛmpa da biara.
Monka n’animuonyam ho asɛm amanaman mu, n’anwanwadeɛ ho asɛm aman nyinaa mu.
Awurade yɛ kɛseɛ na ɔfata ayeyie pii. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsuro no sene anyame nyinaa.
Na amanaman no anyame nyinaa yɛ abosonhuhuo, Na Awurade mmom na ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro.
Anidie ne animuonyam wɔ n’anim; tumi ne ahoɔfɛ wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ.
Aman mmusuakuo, momfa mma Awurade, Momfa animuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.
Momfa Awurade din animuonyam mma no; monsoa ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra n’abannwa so.
Monsɔre Awurade, ahokeka kronkron mu, asase nyinaa, mo ho mpopo n’anim.
Monka no amanaman mu sɛ: “Awurade di hene. na wiase tim hɔ a ɛrenhinhim, na ɔbɛdi aman so, tenenee mu.
Ma ɔsoro nni ahurisie, na asase ani nnye. Ma ɛpo nworo, ɛne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa.
Ma petee mu ne deɛ ɛwom nyinaa nni ahurisie, ɛno na kwaeɛ mu nnua nyinaa bɛto anigyeɛ nnwom,
Awurade anim. Na ɔreba, na ɔreba abɛbu asase atɛn. Ɔrebɛbu wiase atɛn tenenee mu, ne amanaman wɔ ne nokorɛ mu. Nyankopɔn ahennie wɔ awieeɛ berɛ no mu
97: Awurade di hene, ma asase ho nsane no, na nsupɔ bebree no nso ani nnye.
Mununkum ne sum atwa ne ho ahyia; Tenenee ne atemmuo ne n’ahennwa nnyinasoɔ.
Mmepɔ nane sɛ akraa Awurade anim, Asase nyinaa Wura no anim.
Ɔsoro ka ne tenenee kyerɛ, na aman nyinaa hunu n’animuonyam.
Ma ahonisomfoɔ nyinaa ani nwu, Mo anyame nyinaa, monkoto no.
Ɛfiri sɛ wo, Awurade, wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni, asase nyinaa so; woama wo ho so koraa wɔ anyame nyinaa so.
O mo a modɔ Awurade nyinaa, monkyiri bɔne. Ɔgye wɔn firi abɔnefoɔ nsam.
Hann ahyerɛn ama ɔteneneeni, ne anigyeɛ ama akomam teefoɔ.
Ateneneefoɔ, monni Awurade mu ahurisie, na monyi ne din kronkron no ayɛ.
98: O Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade, Ne nsa nifa, ne ne basa kronkron no, adi nkonim ama no.
Awurade ama wɔahunu ne nkwagyeɛ; Wayi ne tenenee adi amanaman anim.
Wakae n’adɔeɛ ne ne nokorɛdie ama Israel fie. Asase ano nyinaa ahunu yɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagyeɛ.
Asase so aman nyinaa, mommɔ ose mma Awurade. Momma mo ani nnye na monto ahurisie ne ayeyi dwom.
Momfa sankuten nto dwom mma Awurade, Momfa sankuten ne ɛnne nto dwom.
Momfa ntotorobɛnto ne abɛn; Mmɔ ose Ɔhene Awurade anim.
Ma ɛpo nworo, ɛne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, wiase ne wɔn a wɔte mu nyinaa.
Awurade anim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔrebɛbu asase atɛn. Ɔbɛbu asase atɛn tenenee mu, Ne amanaman wɔ atɛntenenee mu. Onyankopɔn kronkron ho ayeyie
99: Awurade di hene; ma amanaman no ho mpopo. Ɔte kerubim so; ma asase nhinhim.
Awurade yɛ kɛseɛ wɔ Sion, na wɔama no so aman nyinaa so.
Ma wɔ nyi wo din kɛse a ɛyɛ hu no ayɛ,
Ɔhene tumfoɔ a wodɔ atemmuo, wo na woama atɛntenenee atim. Yakob mu atemmuo ne tenenee,
Momma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn so, na monkoto nsɔre ne nan ase adwa anim.
Na Mose ne Aaron wɔ n’asɔfoɔ mu, na Samuel nso ka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ ne din no ho. Wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, na ɔno nso gyee wɔn so.
Ɔkasa kyerɛɛ wɔn mununkum dum mu, wɔdii n’adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɔde maa wɔn no so.
O Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, wo na wogyee wɔn soɔ, woyɛɛ fafirie Nyankopɔn a ɔde kyɛ maa wɔn, ne wɔn nneyɛɛ so weretɔfoɔ.
Momma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn so, na monkoto nsɔre wɔ ne bepɔ kronkron so, na Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ kronkron.
100: Asase so aman nyinaa, mommɔ ose mma Awurade.
Momfa anigyeɛ nsom Awurade; Na momfa ahurisi dwom mmra n’anim.
Monhunu sɛ Awurade ne Onyankopɔn. ɔno na ɔyɛɛ yɛn, ɔno na yɛwɔ no, yɛyɛ ne man ne n’adidibea nnwan.
Momfa aseda nhyɛne n’aponkɛseɛ mu, na momfa ayeyie mmra n’abannwa so. Monna no ase, na monhyira ne din.
Na Awurade yɛ, na ne nokorɛdie kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
101: Mɛto adɔeɛ ne atemmuo ho dwom, O Awurade, wo na mɛto dwom ama woɔ.
Mede nimdeɛ bɛfa pɛyɛ kwan so. O Da bɛn na wobɛba me nkyɛn? M’akoma mudie mu na mɛnante me fie.
Obiara a ɔsɛe ne yɔnko din kokoam no, Obiara a ɔwɔ ahantan ani ne
Asase so anokwafoɔ na m’ani wɔ wɔn soɔ, deɛ ɔnam pɛyɛ kwan soɔ no,
Ɔdaadaafoɔ biara rentena me fie. Obiara a ɔtwa nkontompo no, rennyina m’anim.
Anɔpa biara mɛsɛe asase so abɔnefoɔ nyinaa, Na matwa amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa afiri Awurade kuro no mu.
102: O Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ ɛ; na ma me sufrɛ nnuru w’anim.
Nyi w’anim nhunta me m’ahohia da, da a mesu mefrɛ no, yɛ ntɛm gye me so.
Na me nna ahi sɛ wisie, Na me nnompe adɔ kɔɔ sɛ bukyia.
M’akoma aboto na akusa sɛ ɛfan, na me werɛ afiri mpo sɛ mɛdidie.
M’apinisie nne nti me nnompe afemfam me wedeɛm.
Mayɛ sɛ ɛserɛ so anomaa pokupoku,
Mesiri pɛ, mete sɛ apatuprɛ
Da mu nyinaa m’atamfoɔ bɔ me ahohora, wɔn a wɔbɔ me so dam no de me din mpo ka ntam.
Na madi nso sɛ paanoo; na me nisuo afra m’anonneɛ mu.
Ɛnam w’abufuo ne w’anibereɛ nti, woama me so, na woato me atwene.
Me nna te sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam, na me deɛ, mekusa sɛ ɛfan.
Na wo Awurade deɛ, wowɔ hɔ daa daa, na wo nkaeɛ kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
Wobɛsɔre, abɛhunu Sion mmɔbɔ, na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wodom no ni, aane, berɛ a wɔahyɛ no aduru.
Wo nkoa nya n’aboɔ ho anigyeɛ, na wɔn yam hyehye wɔn wɔ ne mfuturo ho.
Enti amanaman bɛsuro Awurade din, na asase so ahemfo nyinaa asuro w’animuonyam.
Sɛ Awurade kyekyere Sion a; ɔbɛyi ne ho adi n’animuonyam mu.
Ɔbɛdane n’ani akyerɛ onnibie mpaebɔ,
Wɔbɛtwerɛ yei ama nkyirimma, na ɔman a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn no bɛyi Awurade ayɛ.
Ɔbrɛ n’ani ase hwɛ fam firi ne soro kronkronbea hɔ, Awuarde firi sorosoro hɔ hwɛ asase so,
Sɛ ɔbɛtie deduani apinisie, na wasane wɔn a wɔayi wɔn ama owuo no;
na wɔabɔ Awurade din wɔ Sion, na wɔaka n’ayeyie wɔ Yerusalem,
da a aman bɛbom aboaboa wɔn ho ano ne ahennie, sɛ wɔbɛsom Awurade no.
Wago me tumi mu ɛkwan mu,
Mekaa sɛ: “O me Nyankopɔn, wo mfeɛ kyɛre kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
Teteete na wotoo asase fapem, na ɔsoro yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.
Ɛno deɛ, ɛbɛsɛe, na wo deɛ, wotim hɔ daa. wobɛsakra wɔn sɛ atadeɛ, na wɔasakra.
Nanso wo deɛ, wonsesa da,
Wo nkoa mma bɛtena ase, na wɔn asefoɔ bɛtim w’anim.”
103: O me kra, hyira Awurade, na me mu adeɛ nyinaa nhyira ne din kronkron no.
O me kra, hyira Awurade, na mma wo werɛ mmfiri ne nneyɛɛ pa nyinaa.
Ɔno na ɔde wo mfomsoɔ nyinaa kyɛ woɔ,
Ɔno na ɔgye wo nkwa firi amena mu, na ɔde adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu bɔ wo abotire.
Ɔno na ɔde adepa hyɛ  w’afono ma, na wo mmeranteberɛ yɛ foforɔ sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ.
Awurade di asɛntenenee, na ɔbu atɛn gye wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn soɔ nyinaa.
Ɔde n’akwan kyerɛɛ Mose, ɔmaa Israel mma hunuu ne nneyɛɛ.
Awurade yɛ mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ, ne bo kyɛre fu na n’adɔeɛ dɔɔso.
Ɔrenham nkɔsi daapem, na ɔrennya yɛn menasepɔ nkɔsi daa.
Ɔnsusu yɛn bɔne so ne yɛn nni, na ɔnhwɛ yɛn mfomsoɔ so ntua yɛn ka.
Na sɛdeɛ ɔsoro ware sene asase no, saa na n’adɔeɛ so ma wɔn a wɔsuro no.
Sɛdeɛ apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ ntam ware no, saa na wama yɛne yɛn mmarato ntam aware.
Sɛ agya yam hyehye no ne mma ho no, saa na Awurade nso yam hyehye no ma wɔn a wɔsuro no.
Na ɔnim yɛn nipaban;
Onipa dasani deɛ, ne nna te sɛ ɛserɛ, ɔyɛ frɔmm sɛ wuram nhwiren.
Sɛ mframa bɔ fa ne so a, na ɔnni hɔ,
Nanso Awurade adɔeɛ deɛ, ɛwɔ hɔ firi mmerɛsanten kɔsi mmerɛsanten Na ne tenenee nso wɔ hɔ ma wɔn mma mma,
ma wɔn a wɔdi n’apam soɔ, na wɔkae n’ahyɛdeɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ.
Awurade de n’adwa asi soro, na n’ahennie di ade nyinaa so.
O Awurade, abɔfoɔ, monhyira no, mo ahoɔden mu akatakyie a modi n’asɛm soɔ
Awurade asafodɔm nyinaa, monhyira no, n’asomfo a moyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani no.
Awurade nnwuma nyinaa, monhyira no, mmeammea a ɔdi tumi nyinaa.
104: O me kra, hyira Awurade. O Awurade me Nyankopɔn, woso kɛse, woahyɛ ɔhran ne animuonyam.
Ɔfira hann sɛ ntoma, ɔtrɛ ɔsoro mu sɛ ntomadan tam,
ɔde ne mpia sam nsuo so, ɔde mununkum yɛ ne teaseɛnam,
Ɔde mframa yɛ n’abɔfoɔ, ɔde ogya a ɛderɛ yɛ n’asomfo.
Ɔde asase atim ne nnyinasoɔ so,
Wode ebunu kataa so sɛ ntoma,
W’animka nti ɛdwanedwanee, W’aprannaa mmobɔmu nti, ɛde ahopopoɔ dwaneeɛ;
mmepɔ memaa wɔn ho so, ɛsene kɔɔ abɔn mu,
Woatwa hyeɛ sɛ ɛnntra, na ansane ammɛkata asase so.
Ɔyi nsuo aniwa, abɔn mu,
Ɛma wuram mmoa nyinaa nom bi, atorɔmo [mfunumu] de kum wɔn sukɔm.
Ɛso na ewiem nnomaa teteɛ, nnua mman mu na wɔfiri ma wɔn nne soɔ to dwom.
Ɔfiri ne soro mpia mu gu mmepɔ so nsuo, wo nnwuma so aba mee asase.
Ɔma wura fifiri ma afieboa, ne afuomduane a onipa yɛ ho adwuma, sɛ ɔbɛma aduane afiri asase mu.
Na nsa ama ɔdasani akoma atɔ ne yam, na wama ngo ayɛ onipa anim dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ, na aduane awowa ɔdasani akoma.
Wɔma Awurade nnua nso mee, Lebanon ntweneduro a ɔduaeɛ no.
Ɛhɔ na nnomaa yɛ wɔn mpirebuo; Asukɔnkɔn nso, pepeaa nnua so na ne fie wɔ.
Mmepɔ atenten yɛ abotan so mmirekyie tenabea;
Ɔhyɛ ɔsrane sɛ ɛnkyerɛ berɛ mu nsakraeɛ;
Woma sum duru, na adeɛ sa, ɛno mu na kwaeɛ mu mmoa nyinaa keka wɔn ho.
Gyataburuwa bobom pɛ hanam, Na wɔkɔpɛ wɔn aduane, Onyankopɔn nsam.
Sɛ awia pue a, wɔtwe wɔn ho, Na wɔkɔbutubutu wɔn atu mu.
Onipa firi adi kɔ n’adwuma ne ne dwumadie so kɔsi anwummerɛ.
O Awurade, hwɛ sɛdeɛ wo nnwuma si dɔɔso fa! nyansa mu na woyɛɛ ne nyinaa, w’abɔdeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma.
Ɛpo kɛseɛ a ɛtrɛ kakraa yi, ɛhɔ na mmoa manyamanya a ɛnni ano nenam,
Ɛso na ahyɛn korɔ; ɛhɔ na dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn [Leviathan] a woyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnni agorɔ wɔ mu no wɔ.
Wɔn nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan sɛ ma wɔn wɔn aduane, ne berɛ mu.
Deɛ wode ma wɔn na wɔtaseɛ. Wobue wo nsam, na wɔnya nnepa di mee.
Sɛ wode w’anim hunta a, wɔyɛ basaa; woyi wɔn ahome, na wɔgyaa mu,
Sɛ wosoma wo honhom kɔ a, wode bɔ wɔn, na woma asase ani yɛ foforɔ.
Ma Awurade animuonyam ntena hɔ daa, ma Awurade ani nnye ne nnwuma mu.
Ɔno na ɔhwɛ asase na ɛwosoɔ,
Mete aseɛ yi, mɛto dwom ama Awurade, meda so te aseɛ yi, mɛto ayeyie dwom ama me Nyankopɔn.
Ɔmma m'adwendwene yi nyɛ no fɛ, na me nso m’ani bɛgye Awurade ho.
Ma nnebɔneyɛfoɔ nsa asase so, na mma abɔnefoɔ nntena hɔ bio. O me kra, hyira Awurade. Yi Awurade ayɛ!
105: O Monna Awurade ase, mommɔ ne din, momma wɔnhunu ne nneyɛɛ, aman mu.
Monto dwom mma no, monto ayeyi dwom mma no, monnwennwene n’anwanwadeɛ nyinaa ho nka.
Momfa ne din kronkron no nhoahoa mo ho. ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no akoma nni ahurisie.
Mompɛ Awurade  ne ne tumi akyiri kwan,
Monkae n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ, n’ahodwirideɛ ne n’anom atemmusɛm no,
O n’akoa Abraham asefoɔ,
Ɔno ne Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn; n’atemmuo wɔ asase nyinaa so.
Ɔkae n’apam no de kɔsi daa, asɛm a ɔhyɛ maa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem no,
apam a ɔne Abraham pameeɛ no, ne ne ntam a ɔkaa Isak no,
na ɔde sii hɔ maa Yakob sɛ ahyɛdeɛ, na ɔde maa Israel sɛ daa apam no,
sɛ: Wo na mede Kanaan asase bɛma wo sɛ mo apɛgyadeɛ a wɔkyɛ no homa soɔ.
Saa berɛ no na wɔnnɔɔso, na wɔyɛ kakraa bi; na wɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔnenam firi ɔman mu kɔ ɔman mu, wɔfiri ahennie bi mu kɔ ɔman foforɔ bi mu no,
Wamma onipa biara ansisi wɔn, aane, wɔn nti ɔkaa ahemfo anim,
sɛ: “Mommfa mo nsa nnka me nkurɔfoɔ a masra wɔn no, na m’adiyifoɔ nso, monnyɛ wɔn bɔne.”
Na ɔmaa ɛkɔm baa asase no so; ɔbubuu aduane poma nyinaa mu;
Ɔsomaa ɔbarima bi dii wɔn anim, Yosef a wɔtɔn no kɔɔ nkoasom mu no.
Wɔde mpokyerɛ miaa ne nan, de no too dadeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu.
kɔsii berɛ a n’asɛm baa mu, Awurade asɛm sɔɔ no hwɛeɛ.
Ɔhene no soma maa wɔkɔyii no, deɛ ɔdi aman soɔ no maa wɔkɔsanee no.
Ɔde no sii ne fie so panin, na ɔmaa no dii n’agyapadeɛ nyinaa so sodifoɔ;
Sɛ ɔnkyekyere ɔhene asafohene sɛdeɛ ne kra pɛ, na ɔnkyerɛ ne mpanimfoɔ nso nyansa.
Ɛnna Israel nso baa Egypt, na Yakob bɛsoɛɛ Ham asase so sɛ hɔhoɔ.
Na ɔmaa ne man ase trɛɛ pii, na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ den senee wɔn atamfo.
Ɔdanee wɔn akoma maa wɔtan ne man, na wɔmfa aniteɛ nhyɛ ne nkoa so.
Ɔsomaa n’akoa Mose; ne Aaron
Wɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne wɔn mu, ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham asase so.
Ɔsomaa esum maa no duruu sum,
Ɔdanee wɔn nsuo mogya,
Wɔn asase dɔɔ mponkyerɛne manyamanya, ma wɔbaa wɔn ahemfo mpo mpia mu.
Ɔkasae, na anwansena borebore bae, ntontom baa wɔn asase nyinaa so.
Ɔde asukɔtweaa yɛɛ nsuo tɔ guu wɔn so, maa ogyaframa tɔ guu wɔn asase so.
Ɛnna ɔbobɔɔ wɔn bobe ne wɔn borɔdɔma nnua, na ɔbubuu wɔn asase so nnua nyinaa.
Ɔkasae, na ntutummɛ bae ne mmɛbɛ a wɔn dodoɔ nni ano,
na wɔbɛwee wɔn asase no so nhahan nyinaa; na wɔn mfuo mu nnɔbaeɛ nso, wɔdiiɛ.
Ɛnna ɔbobɔɔ wɔn asase so mmakan nyinaa,
Ɔyii wɔn firii hɔ de dwetɛ ne sika kaa wɔn ho kɔe; na onipa a ɔyɛ mmerɛ biara nni ne mmusuakuo mu.
Wɔfirii hɔ no, Egyptfoɔ dii ahurisie, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔn ho hu atɔ wɔn so.
Ɔtrɛɛ mununkum mu yɛɛ nkatasoɔ, ne egya, sɛ ɛnyɛ hann anadwo.
Wɔbisaeɛ, na ɔmaa wɔn nkokɔhwedeɛ, na ɔde ɔsoro paanoo maa wɔn di meeɛ.
Ɔpaee ɔbotan mu maa nsuo firii mu baeɛ; ɛtenee anwea pradada so sɛ asubɔnten.
Na ɔkaee n’asɛm kronkron no,
Enti ɔyii ne man maa wɔde abotɔyam firii adi, ɔmaa wɔn a ɔyii wɔn no de ahurisie kɔe.
Nkakrankakra, ɔde amanaman no nsase maa wɔn, na wɔfaa amanaman no nsa ano adwuma a wɔbrɛ yɛeɛ no,
Na ama wɔadi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara so. Nyankopɔn adɔeɛ ne Israel bonniayɛ
106: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Monna Awurade ase, na ɔyɛ,
Hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka Awurade nnwuma akɛseɛ ho asɛm, na wama wɔate n’ayeyie nyinaa?
Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔkura atemmuo mu, ne deɛ ɔdi asɛntenenee daa nyinaa.
O Awurade, kae me sɛdeɛ wodom wo man no, wo nkwagyeɛ mu na bɛhwɛ me,
na menhunu wɔn a woayi wɔn no nnepa, na m’ani nnye wo nkurɔfoɔ no anigyeɛ ho bi, na me ne w’agyapadeɛ ahoahoa yɛn ho.
Yɛne yɛn agyanom ayɛ bɔne,
Yɛn agyanom a na wɔwɔ Egypt deɛ, wɔante w’anwanwadwuma ase. Wɔankae w’adɔeɛ bebrebe no, na mmom wɔtee atua wɔ po no ho, Po Kɔkɔɔ no.
Nanso ne din nti, ɔgyee wɔn,
Ɔteateaa Ɛpo Kɔkɔɔ no maa no wee, ɔne wɔn nantee subunu no mu sɛdeɛ wɔnam anwea pradada so.
Enti ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn a wɔkyiri wɔn no nsam, na ɔyii wɔn firii atamfo nsam.
Nsuo no twi faa wɔn atamfo no so;
Ɛnna wɔgyee ne nsɛm diiɛ, na wɔtoo ayeyi dwom maa no.
Nanso ankyɛ na wɔn werɛ firii ne nnwuma;
Na wɔn kɔn dɔɔ ntraso ɛserɛ so, na wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛeɛ wɔ anwea pradada no so.
Ɛnna ɔde wɔn abisadeɛ maa wɔn, nanso ɔmaa ɔfɔn baa wɔn kra mu.
Wɔn ani beree Mose wɔ nsraban no mu, na Awurade nipa kronkron Aaron nso, wɔn ani beree no.
Ɛno nti asase buee n’anom menee Datan, na ɛkataa Abiram asafo so.
Egya bɛhyee wɔn asafo no; gyaframa bɛtɔɔ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no mu.
Bio nso wɔyɛɛ nantwie ba wɔ Horeb, na wɔkotoo ohoni a wɔguiɛ no.
Na wɔsesaa wɔn animuonyam yɛɛ no nantwie a ɔwe wura nsɛsoɔ.
Wɔn werɛ firii Onyankopɔn, wɔn Gyefoɔ no, deɛ ɔyɛɛ nneɛma akɛseɛ wɔ Egypt no,
Deɛ ɔyɛɛ anwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham asase so, ne ahudeɛ wɔ Po Kɔkɔɔ no ho no.
Na ɔse anka ɔbɛsɛe wɔn, kɔgyinaa n’anim sii abuo no ano, sɛ ɔbɛyi n’abufuo, na wansɛe wɔn.
Wɔtoo asase fɛɛfɛ no ho mpe,
Wɔnwiinwii wɔn ntomadan mu,
Enti ɔmaa ne nsa so de kaa ntam tiaa wɔn sɛ ɔbɛma wɔatotɔ wɔ ɛserɛ no so,
na wabɔ wɔn asefoɔ agu amanaman mu, na wabɔ wɔn ahwete nsase no so.
Wɔde wɔn ho kɔbɔɔ Baal Peor ho, na wɔdii afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔde ma awufoɔ.
na wɔde wɔn nneyɛɛ huruu no,
Na Pinehas sɔre gyina patae,
Na wɔbuu yei tenenee maa no
Bio nso, wɔgyegyee no wɔ Meriba nsuo ho, na wɔn nti, ɛwiee Mose bɔne.
Wɔhyɛɛ ne honhom ahometeɛ,
Wɔankunkum aman a Awurade kaa wɔn ho asɛm no,
mmom wɔde wɔn ho kɔfrafraa amanaman no mu,
Na wɔsom wɔn ahoni,
Wɔde wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa bobɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa adaemone.
Enti wɔhwiee mogya a ɛdi bem guiɛ; wɔde wɔn mma mmarima ne wɔn mma mmaa mogya bɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Kanaanfoɔ ahoni, na mogyahwieguo maa asase no ho guu fi.
Na wɔde wɔn nnwuma guu wɔn ho fi, na wɔde wɔn nneyɛɛ bɔɔ adwaman.
Ɛnna Awurade abufuo dɛre tiaa ne man, na n’agyapadeɛ no bɛyɛɛ akyiwadeɛ maa no.
Enti ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ amanaman no nsa, na wɔn a wɔkyiri wɔn dii wɔn so.
Wɔn atamfo no hyɛɛ wɔn so, na wɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase hyɛɛ wɔn nsa ase.
Mprɛ pii na ɔgyee wɔn, nanso wɔkɔɔ so tee atua wɔn asoɔden mu, na wɔn amumuyɛ nti, ɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase.
Ɔhunuu wɔn ahohia; na ɔtiee wɔn sufrɛ.
Wɔn nti, ɔkaee apam a yɛeɛ no, na n’adɔeɛ dodoɔ nti, ɔyɛɛ ntimmɔborɔ.
Na ɔmaa wɔn a wɔfaa wɔn nnommum nyinaa
O Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn nkwa; na boaboa yɛn ano firi amanaman no mu bra, na yɛmfa aseda mma wo din kronkron no, na yɛmfa ahosɛpɛ nyi wo ayɛ.
Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn no firi mmerɛsanten kɔsi mmerɛsanten; na ma ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ, Amen. Wɔn a wɔagye wɔn nkwa no aseda dwom
107: O Monna Awurade ase, na ɔyɛ,
Ma wɔn a Awurade agye wɔn nka saa, wɔn a wagye wɔn afiri ɔtamfo nsam no,
na waboaboa wɔn ano afiri nsase no soɔ, afiri apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ, atifi ne anafoɔ.
Wɔkyinkyinii anwea pradada so, wɔanhunu kwan a ɛde wɔn bɛkɔ kuro a wɔbɛtena soɔ no mu.
Ɛkɔm dee wɔn, na sukɔm nso dee wɔn; wɔn kra totɔɔ piti wɔ wɔn mu.
Na wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade, wɔn ahohia mu, na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahokyerɛ no mu,
na ɔde wɔn faa ɔkwantenenee so, na ama wɔatumi akɔ kuro a wɔbɛtena soɔ no mu.
O Wɔnkamfo Awurade, n’adɔeɛ ho, ne n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ ama nnipa mma nti.
Na wama ɔkra a sukɔm de no amee; na ɔde nnepa ahyɛ ɔkra a ɛkɔm de no ma.
Wɔn a wɔtenaa sum ne sum kabii mu, na wɔkyeree wɔn guu amaneɛ ne dadeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu,
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔtee Onyankopɔn nsɛm ho atua; na wɔbuu Ɔsorosoroni no agyina animtia.
Enti ɔde ɔhaw brɛɛ wɔn akoma ase; wɔhwee ase na wɔannya boafoɔ biara.
Na wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade wɔn ahohia mu; na ɔsan gyee wɔn firii wɔn ahokyerɛ mu.
Ɔyii wɔn firii esum ne esum kabii mu; na ɔbubuu wɔn mpokyerɛ mu.
O Wɔnkamfo Awurade, n’adɔeɛ ho, ne n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ ama nnipa mma nti.
Sɛ wabubu kɔbere apono, na watwitwa adaban mu asinasini.
Agyimifoɔ, wɔn mmarato kwan ne wɔn amumuyɛ nti wɔhunuu amane.
Wɔn kra kyirii aduane biara, na wɔbɛnee owuo apono ano.
Na wɔsu frɛɛ Awurade wɔn ahohia mu, na ɔgyee wɔn firii wɔn ahokyere mu.
Ɔmaa n’asɛm bɛsaa wɔn yareɛ, na ɔyii wɔn firii amena mu.
O Wɔnkamfo Awurade, n’adɔeɛ ho, ne n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ ama nnipa mma nti.
Na wɔmmɔ aseda afɔdeɛ, na wɔmfa ahurisie dwom nka ne nneyɛɛ.
Wɔn a wɔde ahyɛn kɔ po soɔ, na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ nsuo akɛseɛ soɔ no,
wɔn na wɔahunu Awurade nnwuma, ne n’anwanwadeɛ wɔ subunu mu;
na ɔka ma ahum kɛseɛ tu,
Wɔkɔ sorosoro, na wɔsiane kɔ bunu donkodonko mu, ahohia nti wɔn kra hodwoe.
Wɔtɔ ntintan sɛ ɔsabofoɔ, na wɔn nyansa nyinaa tu yera wɔn tirim.
Ɛba saa a wɔsu frɛ Awurade wɔn ahohia mu; na ɔgye wɔn firi ahokyerɛ mu.
Ɔma ahum no yɛ komm, na po asorɔkye no yɛ dinn.
Na wɔn ani gye sɛ ayɛ komm, na ɔde wɔn kɔ bea a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkorɔ no.
O Wɔnkamfo Awurade, n’adɔeɛ ho, ne n’anwanwadeɛ a wayɛ ama nnipa mma nti.
Na wɔmma no so ɔman ahyiaeɛ mu, na wɔnyi no ayɛ mpanimfoɔ dwabɔ mu.
Ɔma nsubɔnten dane anwea pradada, ne nsuo aniwa ma no yɛ nkyɛkyerɛ.
Ɔma asase pa dane asase kɛsɛɛ, wɔn a wɔte soɔ no bɔneyɛ nti.
Ɔma anwea pradada nso dane tadeɛ, na nkyɛkyerɛ dane nsutire.
Ɛhɔ na ɔma wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn tena, na ama wɔakyekyere kuro atena mu.
Wɔyɛ mfuo, na wɔyeyɛ bobe nturo, na ama wɔanya nnɔbaeɛ pii.
Ɔhyira wɔn ma wɔdɔɔso bebree; na ɔmma wɔn afieboa dodoɔ so nhwan.
Nanso nhyɛsoɔ ne ɔhaw ne awerɛhoɔ nti, wɔn dodoɔ so te na wɔbrɛ wɔn ase a,
Ɔde animtiabuo gu mmapɔmma so, na ɔma wɔkyinkyini anwea pradada, baabi a ɛkwan nnie.
Nanso ɔma ohiani so firi amanehunu mu, na ɔyɛ ne mmusua sɛ nnwankuo.
Teneneefoɔ bɛhunu, na wɔn ani agye, na amumuyɛ nyinaa bɛmua n’ano.
Obiara a ɔyɛ onyansafoɔ no, ma no mmu yeinom, na ma wɔnwene Awurade adɔeɛ ho. Adɔeɛ ho ayeyie ne mmoa ho adesrɛ
108: Sankuo, nyane ɛ; sankuten, wo nso nyane.
O Awurade, mɛda wo ase, aman mu, na mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo, aman mu.
Na w’adɔeɛ so tra ɔsoro, na wo nokorɛ duru ewiem tɔnn.
O Onyankopɔn, ma wo ho so tra ɔsoro; na ma w’animuonyam ntra asase nyinaa.
Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔagye w’adɔfo nti, fa wo nifa gye yɛn nkwa, na gye me so.
Onyankopɔn akasa ne kronkronyɛ mu: Medi ahurisie, mɛkyɛ Sekem mu,
Gilead yɛ me dea; Manase yɛ me dea, na Efraim yɛ me tiri so dadeɛ kyɛ,
Moab yɛ me dwaresɛn. Edom na mɛto me mpaboa aguo,
Hwan na ɔde me bɛkɔ kuro denden no mu, hwan koraa na ɔbɛdi m’anim akɔduru Edom?
Ɛnyɛ wo, Onyankopɔn, na woato yɛn atwene yi, O Onyankopɔn, ne yɛn asafodɔm ankɔ?
O gye yɛn firi ahohia mu,
Yɛde Onyankopɔn na ɛbɛyɛ mmaninneɛ, na ɔno na ɔbɛtiatia yɛn atamfo soɔ.
109: O m’ayeyie Nyankopɔn, mmua w’ano.
Na abɔnefoɔ ne nkontompofoɔ abue wɔn ano atia me, wɔde atorɔ kɛtrɛma akeka me ho nsɛm;
na wɔde nitansɛm atwa me ho ahyia,
Wɔde ɔsɔretia tua me dɔ so ka; nanso me deɛ, mpaeɛ ara na mebɔ.
Wɔde bɔne tua me papayɛ so ka, na wɔde ɔtan tua me dɔ so ka.
Fa ɔbɔnefoɔ si ne so, na ma ɔsɔretiafoɔ [Satan] nnyina ne nsa nifa so.
Sɛ wɔbu no atɛn a, ma no nni fɔ, na ma ne mpaebɔ nnane no bɔne.
Ma ne nna nyɛ kakraa bi; na ne hwɛfoɔ adwuma no, ma obi foforɔ mfa.
Ma ne mma nyɛ nnyanka
Ma ne mma mmɔ asesa, nkyinkyini nsrɛsrɛ adeɛ, na wɔmfiri wɔn amamfo so nkɔhwehwɛ aduane.
Ma ɔpempensifoɔ nsa nka deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, na ma ahɔhoɔ mfom deɛ wabrɛ anya.
Mma obiara adɔeɛ nnkyɛre mmma no, na obiara nnnom ne nwisiaa.
Ma wɔnhye n’asefoɔ, ma wɔmpepa wɔn din mfiri nkyirimma a wɔbɛba no mu.
Ma Awurade nkae n’agyanom amumuyɛ, na ne na bɔne nso, mma wɔmmpepa mmfiri hɔ.
Ma no ntena Awurade anim daa; na ɔntwa wɔn nkaeɛ mfiri asase so;
Ɛfiri sɛ wankae anyi adɔeɛ adi, na mmom ɔtaa mmɔborɔni ne ohiani ne deɛ n’akoma abubuo, sɛ ɔbɛku wɔn.
Ɛsiane sɛ ɔdɔɔ nnuabɔ nti, ma no mmra ne so; ɛnam sɛ n’ani annye nhyira ho nti, mma no mmɛn no koraa;
Sɛ ɔfiraa nnome sɛ ntoma nti, ma no nkɔ ne nipadua mu sɛ nsuo,
Ma no nyɛ sɛ ntoma a ɔfira, ne abɔsoɔ a ɔde bɔ n’asene daa.
Ma yei nyɛ me ho asɛmpɛfoɔ akatua a ɛfiri Awurade nsam, ne wɔn a wɔka me kra ho asɛmmɔne no soɔ.
Na wo, O Onyankopɔn, m’Awurade, na w’adɔeɛ a ɛyɛ nti, gye me.
Na meyɛ mmɔborɔni ne ohiani, na m’akoma apira wɔ me mu.
Mekɔ sɛ anadwo sunsum, wɔwoso me twene sɛ ntutummɛ.
Mmuadadie nti, me nkotodwe popo, na me honam afɔn, emu sradeɛ asa.
Me deɛ, madane ahohora ama wɔn, wɔhwɛ me a,  wɔwoso wɔn ti.
Boa me, O Awurade, me Nyankopɔn, O gye me sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ teɛ.
Na ma wɔnhunu sɛ ɛyɛ wo nsa,
Ma wɔnnome, sɛ wɔsɔre a, ma wɔn ani nwu, nanso ma w’akoa nni ahurisie.
Ma wɔn a wɔne me di asie no mfira animguaseɛ, na wɔnfira wɔn ahohora sɛ ntoma.
Mede m’ano bɛkamfo Awurade pii, aane, mɛto ayeyie dwom ama no nnipa bebree mu.
Na ɔbɛgyina ohiani nifa so, na wagye no afiri wɔn a wɔbu ne kra atɛn nsam.
110: Awurade asɛm a ɔse me wura nie: Kɔsi sɛ mede w’atamfo bɛyɛ wo nan ase ntiasoɔ.”
Wo tumidie poma no, Awurade bɛsoma afiri Sion, “Di hene w’atamfo mfimfini!”
Wo man bɛyi wɔn yam ama koraa, da a wobɛkyerɛ wo tumi no. Wo mmeranteɛ asafodɔm bɛka wo ho wɔ aduradeɛ kronkron mu, sɛ bosuo a ɛfiri adekyeeɛ yam.
Awurade aka ntam, na ɔrennu ne ho:
Awurade a ɔwɔ wo nifa soɔ no bɛbobɔ ahemfo, n’abufuo da no.
Ɔbɛbu atɛn amanaman mu; Ɔbɛbobɔ tire asase a ɛtrɛ so.
Ɔbɛnom kwan ho asutene mu nsuo,
111: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Mede m’akoma nyinaa mɛkamfo Awurade, wɔ ateneneefoɔ dwabɔ ne asafo mu.
Awurade nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ, wɔn a ɛyɛ wɔn fɛ nyinaa hwehwɛ mu.
Ne nnwuma yɛ anidie ne animuonyam nko ara, na ne tenenee gyina hɔ daa.
Wama n’anwanwadeɛ ayɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ, Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ.
Ɔma wɔn a wɔsuro no no aduane.
Wayi ne nneyɛɛ tumi akyerɛ ne man, de amanaman agyapadeɛ ama wɔn.
Ne nsa ano adwuma yɛ nokorɛ ne atemmuo, n’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa tim hɔ pintinn.
Ɛtintim hɔ daa daa, wayɛ no nokorɛ ne teeyɛ mu.
Wasoma ɔgyeɛ abrɛ ne man, ne din yɛ kronkron na ɛyɛ hu.
Nyansa mfitiaseɛ ne Awurade suro, Wɔn a wɔdi n’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ nyinaa nya ntease pa.
112: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Nhyira ne onipa a ɔsuro Awurade, na ɔnya ne mmara ho anika pii.
N’asefoɔ bɛyɛ kɛseɛ asase so, wɔbɛhyira teneneefoɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ.
Ahonyadeɛ ne ade dodoɔ wɔ ne fie;
Hann pue sum mu ma nnipa tenenee, ɔne ɔdomfoɔ, mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔteneneeni.
Onipa a ɔyɛ adom na ɔde fɛm no yɛ onipa pa, ɔbɛwie ne nsɛm di, atemmuo mu.
Na ɔrenhinhim da biara da, ɔteneneeni deɛ, wɔbɛkae no daa.
Akwanmusɛmmɔne renyi no hu, n’akoma si hɔ pintinn da Awurade so.
N’akoma atim, ɔrensuro kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhunu deɛ ɔpɛ n’atamfo ho.
Ɔto pete, ɔyɛ ahiafoɔ yie; Wɔbɛma n’abɛn so, animuonyam mu.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ bɛhunu ama no ayɛ no ahi, ɔbɛtwɛre ne se na wahodwo, abɔnefoɔ akɔnnɔdeɛ bɛyera. Onyankopɔn dom ahobrɛasefoɔ
113: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! O mo Awurade nkoa, monyi no ayɛ,
Awurade wɔ ɔsorosoro, aman nyinaa so;
Hwan na ɔte sɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn,
na ɔbrɛ ne ho ase hwɛ fam,
Ɔma mmɔborɔni so firi mfuturo mu, na ɔma ohiani so firi sumina so,
sɛ ɔde no bɛtena mmapɔmma nkyɛn,
Ɔma ɔbaabonini nya efie tena mu, na ɔyɛ ɔbaatan a n’ani gyeɛ.
114: Berɛ a Israel firii Egypt, na Yakob fie firii ɔman a wɔnte wɔn kasa mu kɔeɛ no,
Yuda bɛyɛɛ ne kronkronbea, na Israel nso bɛyɛɛ ne tumidibea.
Ɛpo hunuiɛ, na ɛdwaneeɛ; na Yordan deɛ, ɛsan n’akyi.
Mmepɔ hurihurii sɛ adwennini, na nkokoɔ nso hurihurii sɛ nnwammaa.
Ɛpo, ɛdeɛn na ɛyɛɛ woɔ a enti wodwaneeɛ? na wo Yordan nso, wosane w’akyire yi?
O Mmepɔ, sɛ morehurihuri sɛ adwennini, O na mo nkokoɔ, moreyɛ sɛ nnwammaa yi?
Ɔno a ɔmaa ɔbotan danee tadeɛ, na ɔmaa twerɛboɔ nso danee asutire no. Onyankopɔn nko na anidie sɛ no
115: Ɛnyɛ yɛn, O Awurade, ɛnyɛ yɛn, na wo din mmom na fa animuonyam ma no, w’adɔeɛ nti, wo nokorɛ nti.
Adɛn nti na amanaman no nka sɛ: “Wɔn Nyankopɔn no, ɛhe na ɔwɔ?”
Wɔn ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sika,
Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔnkasa; wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ;
Wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm. wɔwɔ hwene, nanso wɔnte adeɛ hwa.
Wɔwɔ nsa, nanso wɔmfa nsɔ adeɛ mu; wɔwɔ nan, nanso wɔntumi nnante;
Wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn te sɛ wɔn ara, ne obiara a ɔde ne ho to wɔn soɔ no.
O Israel, fa wo ho to Awurade so. Wɔn mmoa ne wɔn kyɛm ne no.
O Aaron fie, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so; Wɔn mmoa ne wɔn kyɛm ne no.
Mo a mosuro Awurade, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so; Wɔn mmoa ne wɔn kyɛm ne no.
Mone wɔn a Awurade ahyira mo;
Ɔsoro yɛ Awurade soro, Na asase deɛ, ɔde ama nnipa mma.
Ɛnyɛ awufoɔ na wɔyi Awurade ayɛ, na ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔsiane kɔ kommyɛ mu no.
Na yɛn deɛ, yɛbɛhyira Awurade afiri nnɛ akɔsi mmerɛsanten. Deɛ wɔagye no nkwa no aseda ne ne bɔhyɛ
116: Medɔ Awurade, Ɛfiri sɛ ɔtie me nne ne me nkotosrɛ.
Sɛ wabrɛ n’aso ase ama me, na mete ase yi, mɛbɔ ne din daa.
Owuo nhoma kyekyeree me, na Asamando ahohia too me, mehunuu ahodwan ne awerɛhoɔ.
Na Awurade din na mebɔɔ sɛ: “O Awurade, mesrɛ wo, gye me kra.
Ɔdomfoɔ ne ɔteneneeni ne Awurade; aane, yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ mmɔborɔhunufoɔ.
Awurade hwɛ awiɛmfoɔ, mehodwoe, na ɔgyee me nkwa.
O me kra, sane kɔ wo homebea, na Awurade ne wo adi no yie.
Na woayi me kra afiri owuo mu, ne me nan afiri ahweaseɛ mu.
Magye adi, mpo berɛ a mekaa sɛ:
Ɛdeɛn na mede bɛhyɛ Awurade ananmu, ne yie a ɔyɛ me nyinaa ho?
Wo na mɛbɔ wo aseda afɔdeɛ,
117: Amanaman nyinaa, monyi Awurade ayɛ; aman mmusuakuo nyinaa, monkamfo no.
Na n’adɔeɛ so yɛn so, Na Awurade nokorɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
118: O Monna Awurade ase, na ɔyɛ,
Ma Israel nka sɛ:
Ma Aaron fiefoɔ nka sɛ:
Ma wɔn a wɔsuro Awurade no nka sɛ:
Mefiri ahohia mu mefrɛɛ Awurade, na Awurade gyee me so, deɛ ɛhɔ trɛ.
Awurade wɔ m’afa; merensuro. Ɛdeɛn na onipa dasani bɛtumi ayɛ me?
Awurade wɔ m’afa, sɛ me boafoɔ, na me nso mɛhunu deɛ mepɛ m’atamfoɔ soɔ.
Ɛyɛ sɛ wode wo ho bɛto Awurade soɔ, mmom sene sɛ wode ne ho bɛto onipa dasani soɔ.
Ɛyɛ sɛ wode wo ho bɛto Awurade soɔ, mmom sene sɛ wode ne ho bɛto ahemfo soɔ.
Amanaman nyinaa atwa me ho ahyia, Awurade din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn aguo.
Wɔtwaa me ho hyiaeɛ, aane, wɔtwaa me ho nyinaa hyiaeɛ koraa mpo, nanso Awurade din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn aguo.
Wɔtwaa me ho hyiaa sɛ nwowa, nanso wɔdumiiɛ sɛ nkasɛɛ mu gya, Awurade din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn aguo.
Wɔsum me sɛdeɛ mɛhwe aseɛ, Nanso Awurade na ɔboaa me.
M’ahoɔden ne m’ayeyie dwom ne Awurade,
Osebɔ ne nim gyegye ateneneefoɔ ntomadan mu, Awurade nsa nifa di mmaninsɛm.
Awurade ama ne nsa nifa so; Awurade nsa nifa di mmaninsɛm.
Merenwu, na mmom mɛnya nkwa, na maka Awurade nneyɛɛ akyerɛ.
Awurade  atwe m'aso dendeenden, Nanso wɔmfaa me nhyɛɛ owuo nsa.
Bue tenenee apono ma me, na mɛnfa mu; na menyi Awurade ayɛ.
Yei ne Awurade pono
Meda wo ase sɛ woagye me soɔ,
Ɛboɔ a adansifoɔ poeɛ no
Awurade na ɔyɛe yei;
Yei ne da a Awurade ayɛ;
O Awurade, yɛsrɛ wo, gye yɛn nkwa! O Awurade, yɛsrɛ wo, ma no nsi yɛn yie!
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam Awurade din mu reba no, Yɛfiri Awurade fie hyira mo.
Awurade ne Onyankopɔn, Na wama hann ahyerɛn ama yɛn. Momfa dua mman ntwa afahyɛ no ho nhyia nkɔduru afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho.
Wone me Nyankopɔn, na mɛda wo ase, Wone me Nyankopɔn, na mɛma wo so.
Monna Awurade ase, na ɔyɛ, Nyankopɔn mmara ho anigyeɛ
119: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔn kwan yɛ pɛ, na wɔnante Awurade mmara mu.
Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ n’adansesɛm soɔ, na wɔde wɔn akoma nyinaa di akyire,
nso wɔnyɛ amumuyɛdeɛ,
Wo na woahyɛ yɛn sɛ Yɛnhwɛ nni wo mmara so yie.
O sɛ anka wɔtenetene m’akwan
Sɛ mehwɛ wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa a,
Sɛ mesua w’atemmusɛm a ɛtene a, Mede akoma teeyɛ bɛda wo ase.
Mɛdi w’ahyɛdeɛ so,
Ɛdeɛn na aberanteɛ de bɛte ne kwan ho? Ɛne sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ ne ho so sɛdeɛ wo nsɛm seɛ.
Mede m’akoma nyinaa adi w’akyi, O mma mennnane mmfiri wo mmara nsɛm ho mennkyini.
Mede wo nsɛm asie m’akoma mu,
O Nhyira ne wo, Awurade,
Mede m’ano aka
W’adansesɛm kwan mu na m’ani gyeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛgye ahonyadeɛ bi ho.
W’ahyɛdeɛ ho na mɛdwendwene,
W’ahyɛdeɛ ho na me ho sɛpɛ me, na me werɛ remfiri w’asɛm nso.
Yɛ w’akoa yie, na mennya nkwa,
Bue m’ani, na menhwɛ
Meyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ asase so, mfa wo mmara nsɛm nhunta me.
Me kra posa daa nyinaa,
Woateatea ahantanfoɔ a wɔadome wɔn a wɔfom firi wo mmara nsɛm ho no.
Yi ahohora ne aniwuo firi me so,
Adehyeɛ nso tena ase keka me ho nsɛm a, w’akoa bɛdwene w’ahyɛdeɛ ho.
W’adansesɛm yɛ m’adɔdeɛ, Si nkete sɛ wobɛdi AWURADE mmara so
Me kra aka fam, ma mennya nkwa sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ.
Maka m’akwan akyerɛ wo na woagye me so,
Ma mente w’ahyɛdeɛ akwan ase, na ama madwendwene w’anwanwadwuma ho.
Awerɛhoɔ ama me kra anane, ma me so sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ.
Yi atorɔ kwan firi me ho,
Mafa nokorɛdie kwan, mede w’atemmusɛm agu m’anim.
Matim w’adansesɛm mu, O Awurade, mma m’ani nnwu.
Wo mmara nsɛm kwan so na mɛtu mmirika,
O Awurade, kyerɛkyerɛ me w’ahyɛdeɛ kwan,
Ma menhunu mu, na madi wo mmara so, na mede m’akoma nyinaa bɛdi so.
Ma mennante wo mmara nsɛm kwan so,
Kom m’akoma kɔ w’adansesɛm so,
Mma m’ani nnhwɛ ahuhudeɛ; ma mennya wo kwan mu nkwa.
Hyɛ w’asɛm mu den ma w’akoa
Ma m’ahohora a ɛyɛ me hu nsiane me ho nkɔ,
Hwɛ! M’ani agyina w’ahyɛdeɛ, ma mennya wo tenenee mu nkwa.
O Awurade, ma w’adɔeɛ mmra me so, ne wo nkwagyeɛ, sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ,
Na manya asɛm bi abua deɛ ɔbɔ me ahohora no, Ɛfiri sɛ mede me ho ato w’asɛm so.
Nyi nokwasɛm no mfiri m’anom koraa, na w’atemmusɛm so na m’ani da.
Mɛdi wo mmara so daa,
na mɛnante tɛtrɛtɛ mu,
Na mɛka w’adanseɛ ho asɛm ahemfo anim,
Na me ho bɛsɛpɛ me wo mmara nsɛm ho,
na mɛma me nsa so wo mmara nsɛm a medɔ no ho, AWURADE mmara mu awerɛhyɛmu
Kae asɛm a woka kyerɛɛ w’akoa no, ɛfiri sɛ womaa mede m’ani metoo so.
Yei ne m’awerɛkyekyerɛ, m’amanehunu mu, ɛfiri sɛ w’asɛm ma menya nkwa.
Ahantanfoɔ de me ayɛ fɛdie pii, nanso memmane mfirii wo mmara ho.
O Awurade, mekae w’atemmuo a ɛfiri teteete no,
Abufuhyeɛ ahyɛ me so, abɔnefoɔ a wɔgya wo mmara no nti.
W’ahyɛdeɛ adane me nnwom,
O Awurade, mekae wo din anadwo,
Yei ayɛ me adeɛ, Ahofama wɔ AWURADE mmara ho
O Awurade, wo ne me kyɛfa,
Mede m’akoma nyinaa masrɛ wo:
Meda medwene m’akwan ho, na medane me nan mekyerɛ w’adansesɛm.
Meyɛɛ ntɛm, na mantwentwɛn me nan ase sɛ mɛdi wo mmara nsɛm soɔ.
Abɔnefoɔ nhoma abebare me ho, nanso me werɛ mfirii wo mmara.
Mesɔre dasuom ada wo ase wɔ wo tenenee atemmusɛm ho.
Meyɛ wɔn a wɔsuro woɔ nyinaa adamfo, ne wɔn a wɔdi w’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ.
O Awurade, w’adɔeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma,
Wo ne w’akoa adi no yie, O Awurade, sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ.
Kyerɛkyerɛ me nhunumu pa ne nimdeɛ, na magye wo mmara nsɛm adi.
Wɔnnya mmrɛɛ me aseɛ no, mefomeeɛ,
Woyɛ na woyɛ adepa,
Ahantanfoɔ atoatoa atorɔ ato me so, na me deɛ, mede m’akoma nyinaa bɛdi w’ahyɛdeɛ so.
Wɔn akoma apirim sɛ sradeɛ, me deɛ, wo mmara ho na me ho sɛpɛ me.
Ɛyɛ ma me sɛ wobrɛɛ me aseɛ,
W’anom mmara yɛ ma me, sene sika ne dwetɛ mpempem.
Wo nsa na ɛyɛɛ me na ɛsiesiee me kama, ma me nteaseɛ, na mensua wo mmara nsɛm.
Wɔn a wɔsuro woɔ bɛhu me na wɔn ani agye, Ɛfiri sɛ wo nsɛm so na m’ani da.
O Awurade, menim sɛ w’atemmusɛm tene, na wode nokorɛdie abrɛ me ase.
Mesrɛ wo, Ma w’adɔeɛ nyɛ me awerɛkyekyerɛ, sɛdeɛ woaka akyerɛ w’akoa no.
Ma wo mmɔborɔhunu mmra me so na mennya nkwa,
Ma ahantanfoɔ ani nwu sɛ wɔbrɛɛ me ase nkontompo soɔ. Na me deɛ, w’ahyɛdeɛ na medwendwene ho.
Ma wɔn a wɔsuro woɔ no nnane mmra me nkyɛn, ne wɔn a wɔnim w’adansesɛm no.
Ma m’akoma nyɛ pɛ w’ahyɛdeɛ mu,
Me kra tɔ wo nkwagyeɛ ho piti,
W’asɛm nti m’ani ayɛ samoo. Mese: Da bɛn na wobɛkyekyere me werɛ?
Mayɛ sɛ nsa kotokuo a ɛsɛn wisie mu, nanso me werɛ mfiri w’ahyɛdeɛ.
W’akoa nna dodoɔ si ahe? Da bɛn na wobɛbu wɔn a wɔtaa me no atɛn?
Ahantanfoɔ atutu amena ama me, wɔn a wɔnte sɛdeɛ wo mmara kyerɛ.
Wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ. Wɔtaa me nkontompo so, boa me!
Ɛkaa kakraa bi sɛ anka wɔretɔre m’ase afiri asase so;
W’adɔeɛ nti ma mennya nkwa, na madi w’anomu adanseɛ so. Gyidie wɔ AWURADE mmara mu
O Awurade, w’asɛm wɔ hɔ daa, ɛtim ɔsoro.
Wo nokorɛdie wɔ hɔ ma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa; Wode asase timm hɔ pintinn, na ɛgyina hɔ.
Ɛgyina hɔ nnɛ sɛdeɛ w’atemmuo teɛ, na nneɛma nyinaa yɛ w’asomfoɔ.
Sɛ wo mmara anyɛ m’adɔdeɛ a,
Me werɛ remfiri w’ahyɛdeɛ da biara da, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno so na wonam ma menya nkwa.
Meyɛ wo dea, gye me nkwa,
Abɔnefoɔ tetɛ me sɛ wɔbɛnya me asɛe me. Nanso me deɛ, m’ani ku w’adansesɛm ho.
Mahunu pɛyɛ nyinaa awieeɛ, nanso wo mmara nsɛm trɛ pii.
O, Sɛdeɛ mesi dɔ wo mmara! Ɛno na medwene ho da mu nyinaa.
Wo mmara nsɛm ayɛ me onyansafoɔ asene m’atamfoɔ,
Mewɔ nimdeɛ sene m’akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ w’adansesɛm ne m’adwene.
Mewɔ nteaseɛ sene mpanimfoɔ deɛ, ɛfiri sɛ medi w’ahyɛdeɛ so.
Masianka me nan afiri kwammɔne nyinaa so,
Memmane memfirii w’atemmuo ho, na wo na woakyerɛkyerɛ me.
Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wo nsɛm si yɛ me dodom dɛ!
W’ahyɛdeɛ mu na menya nhunumu, enti mekyiri nkontompo kwan nyinaa.
W’asɛm yɛ me nan ase kanea,
Maka ntam, na mɛma no agyina, sɛ mɛdi wo tenenee atemmudeɛ so.
Mahunu amane dodo. O Awurade, ma mennya nkwa sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ.
O Awurade, mesrɛ wo, ma w’ani nsɔ m’anomu ayamyie afɔdeɛ, na kyerɛkyerɛ me w’atemmusɛm.
Me kra da me nsam daa; nanso wo mmara deɛ, me werɛ mfiriiɛ.
Abɔnefoɔ asum me fidie, nanso memmane mfirii w’ahyɛdeɛ ho.
Mafa w’adansesɛm ayɛ m’agyapadeɛ daa daa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno ne m’akomam ahurisidie.
Makom m’akoma mu sɛ mɛdi w’ahyɛdeɛ so
Mekyiri adwene ntantafoɔ,
Me dwanekɔbea ne me kyɛm ne wo,
Nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, momfiri me so nkɔ, na madi me Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so.
Wowa me sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ, na manya nkwa, na mma m’anim nngu ase, m’anidasoɔ ho.
Sɔ me mu, na manya nkwagyeɛ, na mahwɛ w’ahyɛdeɛ no daa.
Wopo wɔn a wɔmane firi w’ahyɛdeɛ ho nyinaa, wɔyɛ nkontompofoɔ nnaadaafoɔ.
Woyi asase so abɔnefoɔ nyinaa firi hɔ sɛ dadebini, enti na medɔ wo w’adansesɛm no.
Wo ho hu ma me honam popo,
Mayɛ atemmuo ne tenenee, O nnya me mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ me soɔ.
Di agyinamu pa ma w’akoa, mma ahantanfoɔ nnni me amim.
M’ani ayɛ samoo repɛ wo nkwagyeɛ
Wo ne w’akoa nni no sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ teɛ, na kyerɛkyerɛ me w’ahyɛdeɛ.
Meyɛ w’akoa, ma mennya nteaseɛ,
Berɛ aduru sɛ Awurade yɛ biribie, ɛfiri sɛ wɔabu wo mmara so.
Enti na medɔ wo mmara nsɛm sene sika kɔkɔɔ, ne sika amapa.
Ɛno nti mebu w'ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa sɛ ɛtene; mekyiri nkontompo kwan biara. Pere sɛ wobɛdi AWURADE mmara so
W’adansesɛm yɛ nwanwa,
Wo nsɛm mu bue ma hann, ɛma nkwaseafoɔ hunu nyansa.
Mebue m’anom hoo ahoperɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ m’ani gyina wo mmara nsɛm.
Dane w’ani kyerɛ me na dom me, sɛdeɛ woyɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no.
Ma m’anammɔn ntim w’asɛm mu, na mma amumuyɛ biara nnni me so.
Yi me firi onipa nhyɛsoɔ mu,
Ma w’anim nhran w’akoa so, na kyerɛkyerɛ me w’ahyɛdeɛ.
Asutene sene firi m’ani ase gu, ɛfiri sɛ nnipa nni wo mmara so.
Ɔteneneeni ne wo Awurade,
Woahyɛ w’adansesɛm, tenenee mu
Me mmɔdemmɔ ahye me sɛ ogya, ɛfiri sɛ m’atamfo werɛ afiri wo nsɛm.
W’asɛm yɛ gyenegyene pii,
Mesua, na memfra, nanso me werɛ mfirii w’ahyɛdeɛ.
Wo tenenee yɛ daa tenenee,
Ahohia ne ahoyera ato me, nanso wo mmara nsɛm ne m’adɔdeɛ.
W’adansesɛm yɛ tenenee daa, ma me nteaseɛ, na mennya nkwa.
Mede m’akoma nyinaa mesu mefrɛ: Gye me so. O Awurade, mɛdi w’ahyɛdeɛ so.
Mesu mefrɛ wo: Gye me so,
Mesɔre anɔpahema mesu hwehwɛ boafoɔ.
M’ani di adasuo anim
Tie me nne sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ teɛ. O Awurade, ma mennya nkwa sɛdeɛ w’atemmudeɛ teɛ.
Wɔn a wɔdi mmusuo akyire twe bɛn,
O Awurade, wobɛn, na wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokorɛ.
Mehunuu w’adansesɛm akyɛ, na ɛfiri tete na wode sii hɔ daa.
Hwɛ m’amanehunu, na yi me, na me werɛ mfiri wo mmara.
Di m’asɛm ma me na gye me; ma mennya nkwa sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ.
Abɔnefoɔ ne nkwagyeɛ ntam ware, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ w’ahyɛdeɛ akyiri kwan.
Wo mmɔborɔhunu dɔɔso, O Awurade, ma mennya nkwa sɛdeɛ w’atemmudeɛ teɛ.
M’ataafoɔ ne m’atamfo dɔɔso, nanso mentwe mfirii w’adansesɛm ho.
Mehunu nnabrabafoɔ nkontompofoɔ a, wɔn ho yɛ me nwunu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni w’asɛm so.
O hwɛ sɛdeɛ medɔ w’ahyɛdeɛ. O Awurade, ma mennya nkwa sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ teɛ.
W’asɛm ntoano yɛ nokorɛ, na wo tenenee atemmuo nyinaa wɔ hɔ daa. Nya atuhoakyɛ ma AWURADE mmara
Adehyeɛ taa me kwa, nanso w’asɛm nko na m’akoma suro.
W’asɛm na medi ho ahurisie sɛ obi a wanya asadeɛ pii.
Nkontompo deɛ, mekyiri, na ɛyɛ me tan koraa,
Meyi wo ayɛ mprɛ nson da koro,
Asomdwoeɛ pii wɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo mmara, na biribiara nto wɔn suntidua.
Mehwɛ wo nkwagyeɛ kwan, O Awurade,
Me kra di w’adansesɛm so,
Medi w’ahyɛdeɛ ne w’adansesɛm so; na m’akwan nyinaa wɔ w’anim.
O Awurade, ma me sufrɛ nnuru w’anim, ma me nteaseɛ sɛdeɛ w’asɛm teɛ.
Ma me nkotɔsrɛ nnuru w’anim,
M’ano bɛworo w’ayeyie, ɛfiri sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ me w’ahyɛdeɛ.
Me kɛtrɛma bɛka w’asɛm, ɛfiri sɛ wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ tenenee.
Ma wo nsa mmɛboa me, ɛfiri sɛ w’ahyɛdeɛ na mayie.
M’ani agyina wo nkwagyeɛ, O Awurade,
Ma me kra ntena ase nyi wo ayɛ, na ma w’atemmusɛm mmoa me.
Mafom kwan sɛ odwan a wayera. Hwehwɛ w’akoa, na me werɛ mfiri wo mmara nsɛm.
120: Awurade na m’ahohia mu mesu mefrɛɛ no,
Ɛdeɛn na wɔmfa mma woɔ, na ɛdeɛn na wɔmfa nka wo ho,
Mennue sɛ mabɛyɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ Mesek, na matena Kedar ntomadan mu!
Me kra ne wɔn a wɔtane asomdwoeɛ
Me deɛ, mepɛ asomdwoeɛ; nanso sɛ mebue m’ano a, wɔn deɛ wɔpɛ ɔko.
121: Mɛma m’ani so makyerɛ mmepɔ no,
Ɔremma wo nan nwatiri, deɛ ɔhwɛ woɔ no rentɔ nko.
Awurade  ne wo hwɛfoɔ, Awurade ne wo nwunu, wo nsa nifa so.
Awurade bɛhwɛ wo so bɔne nyinaa ho,
Awurade bɛhwɛ afiri seesei de akɔsi daa. Ɔkwantuni anigyeɛ ne apɛdeɛ
122: M’ani gyee sɛ wɔsee me sɛ:
Yɛn nan bɛgyinaa w’aponkɛseɛ mu, O Yerusalem.
Ɛhɔ na mmusuakuo no foro korɔ, sɛ wɔrekɔyi Awurade din ayɛ.
