Asomdwoeɛ ntena w’afasuo mu, na yiedie ntena w’aban mu.
Me nuanom ne me mfɛfoɔ nti mɛka sɛ asomdwoeɛ ntena wo mu.
123: Wo na mema m’ani so mehwɛ woɔ,
Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ nkoa sɛ afenaa ani hwɛ n’awuraa nsa ano no, saa ara na yɛn ani hwɛ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn kɔsi sɛ ɔbɛdom yɛn.
Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, O Awurade, na dom yɛn, na aniwuhyɛ afono yɛn dodo.
Taamudifoɔ fɛdie Onyankopɔn ne yɛn wɔ hɔ ahohia mu
124: “Sɛ ɛnyɛ Awurade na ɔwɔ yɛn afa a,
“Sɛ ɛnyɛ Awurade na ɔwɔ yɛn afa, berɛ a nnipa sɔre tiaa yɛn no a,
Anka wɔmemmene yɛn animono, berɛ a wɔn abufuo dɛre tiaa yɛn no.
Anka nsuo amene yɛn, anka asubɔntene atwi afa yɛn kra so.
Nhyira nka Awurade a wamfa yɛn anyɛ
Yɛn kra adwane sɛ anomaa afiri afirisumfoɔ fidie mu, fidie no abubu, na yɛn deɛ, yɛadwane.
Yɛn mmoa wɔ Awurade a ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase no din mu.
125: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade soɔ no te sɛ Sion bepɔ, ɛnhinhim, na ɛsi hɔ daa.
Sɛdeɛ mmepɔ atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no, saa ara na Awurade atwa ne man ho ahyia firi nnɛ de kɔsi daa.
Na bɔne ahempoma rentena ateneneefoɔ kyɛfa so, na ateneneefoɔ antene
O Awurade, yɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ no yie, ne wɔn a wɔtene wɔ wɔn akoma mu.
Wɔn a wɔmane kɔ wɔn akɔntɔnkyesɛm soɔ no deɛ, Awurade de wɔn bɛfra amumuyɛfoɔ akɔ. Wɔn a wɔde nisuo guo de ahurisie bɛtwa
126: Berɛ a Awurade de Sion firi nnommum sane baeɛ no,
Ɛno na sereɛ hyɛɛ yɛn anomu ma, na anigyeɛ dwom hyɛɛ yɛn kɛtrɛma so ma. Ɛno na wɔkaa no amanaman mu sɛ: “Awurade ayɛ ade kɛseɛ ama wɔn.”
Awurade ayɛ ade kɛseɛ ama yɛn,
O Awurade, fa yɛn firi nnommum sane bra sɛ anafoɔ fam asase so asutene.
Sɛ mpo wɔde nisuo nenam AWURADE nhyira ne ade kɛse
127: Sɛ Awurade ansi dan no a, wɔn a wɔsie yɛ ho adwuma kwa. Sɛ Awurade anwɛn kuro no a,
Sɛ mosɔre anɔpahema kɔsi anadwo, di ɔbrɛ aduane a, ɛyɛ kwa. Ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade ma n’adɔfoɔ nya saa wɔ nna mu.
Hwɛ! Mma yɛ agyapadeɛ a ɛfiri Awurade hɔ.
Sɛ ɔbrane nsam bɛmma teɛ no, sɛ mmeranteberɛm mmabanin teɛ ne no.
Nhyira ne ɔbarima a wɔahyɛ n’agyan kotokuo ma, wɔne wɔn atamfoɔ kasa kuro pono mu a, wɔn ani renwu.
128: Nhyira ne obiara a ɔsuro Awurade,
Na wobɛdi wo nsa ano adwuma, w’ani bɛgye, na ɛbɛsi wo yie.
Wo yere bɛyɛ sɛ bobe a ɛso aba Wo mma bɛyɛ sɛ ngodua a wɔatetɛ atwa wo pono ho ahyia.
Hwɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔhyira onipa a ɔsuro Awurade nie.
Aane, na hunu wo mma mma.
129: Wɔahiahia me ho pii firi me mmɔfraase,
Wɔahiahia me ho pii firi me mmɔfraase,
Awurade tene, watwitwa abɔnefoɔ nhoma mu.
Ma wɔnyɛ sɛ ɛdan atifi wira
ɛnhyɛ otwitwafoɔ nsa, na ɛnhyɛ deɛ ɔkyekyere no nso basa mu,
Na wɔn a wɔtwam mpo nka sɛ: “Awurade nhyira mmra mo so; yɛhyira mo Awurade din mu.”
130: Awurade, tie me nne. wɛn w'aso tie me nkotɔsrɛ nne.
Awurade, sɛ wodi amumuyɛdeɛ akyiri a, O Awurade, hwan na anka ɔbɛgyina?
Wo na fafirie wɔ wo nsam
Me kra twɛn Awurade sene awɛmfoɔ a wɔtwɛn adekyeeɛ, aane, sene awɛmfoɔ a wɔtwɛn adekyeeɛ.
O Israel, ma w’ani nna Awurade so, Awurade nkyɛn na adɔeɛ wɔ, na ɔgyeɛ a ɛdɔɔso wɔ ne nsam.
Ɔno na ɔbɛgye Israel afiri n’amumuyɛ nyinaa mu.
131: Awurade, m’akoma nyɛ dwaeɛ, na m’ani nso ntra ne ntɔn; na menyɛ apɔmpɔmpɛ [akokurokosɛm], na menhwehwɛ anwanwadeɛ a ɛkyɛn me.
Ampa, madwodwo me kra ama no ayɛ komm, sɛ abɔfra a wɔatwa no nufoɔ a ɔwɔ ne maame ho; me kra te sɛ abɔfra a afei na wɔatwa no nufoɔ wɔ me mu.
O Israel, ma w’ani nna Awurade so Mpaeɛ a Dawid nti wɔbɔ ma Sion
132: Sɛdeɛ ɔkaa Awurade ntam; na ɔhyɛɛ Yakob tumfoɔ no bɔ sɛ:
“Merenkɔ me fie ntomadan mu, na meremforo me mpa nkɔ me nnasoɔ so,
meremma m'aniwa nna, m’anisuatɛtɛ nso rentɔ nko,
Kɔsi sɛ mɛnya baabi ama Awurade, tenabea bi ama Yakob tumfoɔ no ansa.
Hwɛ, yɛkɔtee no Efrata, yɛkɔhunuu no kwaeɛ asase so.
Momma yɛnkɔ ne tenabea, nkɔkoto ne nan ntiasoɔ anim ɛ.
O Awurade, sɔre kɔ wo homebea ɛ,
Ma w’asɔfoɔ nhyɛ tenenee, na ma w’ahotefoɔ nni ahurisie.
Ɛsiane w’akoa Dawid nti, nnane deɛ woasra no no ani.
Awurade aka Dawid ntam nokorɛ mu a ɔnnane ani:
Sɛ wo mma di m’apam ne m’adanseɛ a mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn no so a, wɔn mma nso bɛtena w’adwa so daa.
Na Awurade ayi Sion, wapɛ hɔ de ayɛ ne tenabea.
Yei ne me homebea daapem, ɛha na mɛtena, na mepɛ ha.
Mede nhyira bɛhyira n’adidideɛ, mɛma n’ahiafoɔ aduane adi amee.
Na mede nkwagyeɛ bɛhyɛ n’asɔfoɔ, na n’ahotefoɔ bɛto ahurisie dwom.
Ɛhɔ na mɛma Dawid abɛn afifi; na masiesie kanea ama deɛ masra no no.
Mɛhyɛ n’atamfo aniwuo, na ɔno deɛ, n’ahenkyɛ bɛhyerɛn n’atifi.
133: Hwɛ! Yɛ a ɛyɛ ne ne fɛ a ɛyɛ sɛ anuanom bom tena faako!
Ɛte sɛ aboɔden ngo pa na ɛsiane fa ne ntadeɛ mmuano so.
Ɛte sɛ Hermon bosuo a Ɛhɔ na Awurade ahyɛ nhyira;
134: Hwɛ, mo Awurade nkoa a mogyina Awurade fie anadwo no,
Mommema mo nsa so kronkronbea no mu,
Awurade a ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase no Nyankopɔn tumi ne ahoni mmerɛyɛ
135: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Awurade nkoa, monyi no ayɛ,
Mo a mogyina Awurade fie, yɛn Nyankopɔn fie adihɔ no.
Monyi Awurade ayɛ, na Awurade yɛ, monto dwom mma ne din, na ɛyɛ dɛ.
Na Awurade ayi Yakob afa, na ɔde Israel ayɛ n’agyapadeɛ titire.
Me deɛ, menim sɛ Awurade so, na yɛn Awurade kyɛn anyame nyinaa.
Deɛ ɛsɔ Awurade ani biara wɔyɛ, ɔsoro ne asase so, ɛpo ne abunu nyinaa mu.
Ɔma amununkum firi asase ano ba, ɔyi mframa firi ne korabea.
Ɔno na ɔkunkum Egypt mmakan, firi nnipa so kɔsii mmoa so.
Ɔsomaa nsɛnkyerɛnne ne anwanwadeɛ baa wo mu, O Egypt; Farao ne ne nkoa nyinaa so.
Ɔno na ɔbobɔɔ aman bebree na ɔkunkum ahemfo atumfoɔ,
Amorifoɔ hene Sihon,
na ɔde wɔn asase maa sɛ agyapadeɛ, ɔde yɛɛ ne man Israel agyapadeɛ.
O Awurade, wo din wɔ hɔ kɔsi daa. O Awurade, wo nkaeɛ wɔ hɔ firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so.
Na Awurade bɛbu ne man atɛn,
Amanaman no ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ,
Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔnkasa; wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ,
Wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm, nso home biara nni wɔn anomu.
Wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara, obiara a ɔde ne ho to wɔn soɔ no.
O Israel fie, monhyira Awurade. O Aaron fie, monhyira Awurade.
O Lewi fie, monhyira Awurade. Mo a mosuro Awurade, monhyira Awurade.
Nhyira nka Awurade wɔ Sion; Nyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ abɔdeɛ ne abakɔsɛm mu
136: O Monna Awurade ase, na ɔyɛ:
Monna anyame mu Nyankopɔn no ase:
O Monna awuranom mu Awurade no ase:
Deɛ ɔno nko ara yɛ anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ no:
Deɛ ɔde nyansa yɛɛ ɔsoro no:
Deɛ ɔde asase trɛɛ nsuo soɔ no,
Deɛ ɔyɛɛ nkanea akɛseɛ no:
Awia sɛ ɛnni adekyeeɛ so,
Ɔsrane ne nsoromma, sɛ ɛnni anadwo so,
Deɛ ɔbobɔɔ Egypt wɔn mmakan mu no,
Na ɔyii Israel firii wɔn mu no,
Ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a watene mu na ɛyii wɔn:
Deɛ ɔpaee Po Kɔkɔɔ no mu mmienu no:
Deɛ ɔmaa Israel faa mfimfini no:
Deɛ ɔkaa Farao ne n’asraafoɔdɔm guu Po Kɔkɔɔ no mu no:
Deɛ ɔgyaa ne man faa ɛserɛ soɔ,
Deɛ ɔbobɔɔ ahemfo akɛseɛ no:
Na ɔkunkumm ahemfo animuonyamfoɔ no:
Ɔkum Amorifoɔ hene Sihon:
Ɛne Basan hene Og:
Na ɔde wɔn asase maa sɛ agyapadeɛ no:
Ɔde yɛɛ n’akoa Israel apɛgyadeɛ,
Deɛ ɔkaee yɛn wɔ yɛn ahobrɛaseɛ mu no:
Na ɔgyee yɛn firii yɛn atamfo nsam no:
Deɛ ɔma honam nyinaa aduane no:
O Monna ɔsoro Nyankopɔn ase:
137: Ɛhɔ nsuano nnua so na yɛde yɛn asankuo sensɛneeɛ.
Ɛhɔ na wɔn a wɔafa yɛn nnommum no bisaa yɛn dwom bi, na yɛn ateeteefoɔ pɛɛ yɛn hɔ anigyeɛ sɛ: Monto Sion dwom bi nkyerɛ yɛn.
O Yerusalem, sɛ me werɛ firi wo a, ma me nsa nifa werɛ mfiri ne ho keka.
Sɛ mankae wo a, ma me kɛtrɛma mfam me dodom, Yerusalem ansene m’anigyeɛ nyinaa a…!
O Awurade, kae Edom mma, Yerusalem sɛeɛ da no nti; wɔn na wɔkaa sɛ: “Monnwiri ngu! Monnwiri ngu nkɔsi ne fapem so!”
O Babilon babaa a wɔrebɛyɛ wo pasaa no, nhyira ne deɛ ɔhyɛ wo ananmu,
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔsɔ wo mma mu Nyankopɔn adɔeɛ ne ne nokorɛdie ho aseda
138: Mede m’akoma nyinaa bɛda wo ase, anyame no anim mɛto wo dwom.
Mɛkoto makyerɛ w’asɔrefie kronkron no, na mada wo din ase, sɛ woama w’asɛm aso atra wo din nyinaa.
Da a mesu mefrɛeɛ no, wogyee me so, wohyɛɛ me den maa me kra nyaa ahoɔden.
O Awurade, asase so ahemfo nyinaa bɛda wo ase,
Aane, wɔbɛto Awurade akwan ho dwom, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade animuonyam yɛ kɛseɛ.
Awurade wɔ sorosoro, nanso ɔhwɛ ahobrɛasefoɔ, na ahantanfoɔ deɛ, ɔhu wɔn wɔ akyirikyiri.
Sɛ menam ahohia mu mpo a, wobɛkora me nkwa so. Wobɛtene wo nsa m’atamfoɔ abufuo so, na wo nsa nifa bɛgye me nkwa.
Awurade bɛwie deɛ ɔreyɛ ama me no. O Awurade, w’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa; Wo nsa ano adwuma nso, nto ntwene.
139: O Awurade, woahwehwɛ me mu, na woahu me.
Wo na wonim m’asetena ne me sɔreɛ; wohunu m’adwene mu akyirikyiri.
Wohwehwɛ me nanteɛ ne me nna mu, na wonim m’akwan nyinaa mu yie.
Ansa na asɛm bi bɛtɔ  me kɛtrɛma so no, na wo, Awurade, wonim ne nyinaa dada.
Woaka me ahyɛm, m’akyiri ne m’anim,
Saa nimdeɛ yi yɛ me nwanwa dodo, ɛwɔ soro ma me dodo sɛ mɛhunu mu.
Ɛhe na mɛfiri wo honhom no anim adwane akorɔ? Na ɛhe na mɛfiri w’anim adwane akorɔ?
Sɛ meforo kɔ soro a, wowɔ hɔ; na sɛ mpo mekɔsɛ me kɛtɛ Asamando nso a, wonie.
Sɛ mefa adekyeeɛ ntaban metu kɔtena ɛpo akyiri nohoa a,
ɛhɔ nso na wo nsa bɛkɔ akɔgya me,
Sɛ nso mese: “Esum nko mmɛkata me so a, na anadwo adane hann atwa me ho ahyia;
Ampa ara, esum nso nnuru sum mma wo, na anadwo bɛhyerɛn sɛ adekyeeɛ, esum ne hann yɛ pɛ wɔ w'anim.
Wo na woyɛɛ m’asaabo; na wode me siee me maame yam.
Mɛkamfo wo, sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ me no yɛ hu na ɛyɛ nwanwa. Wo nnwuma yɛ nwanwa, na me kra nim saa yie.
Me nnompe anhunta wo, berɛ a woyɛɛ me ahuntaeɛ mu, na wonwonoo me asase mu tɔnn no.
Meyɛ mogya toa nko no, na wo nwoma mu, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa, nna a wɔahyɛ asie na emu baako pɛ nnya mmaeɛ no.
Hwɛ sɛdeɛ wo nsusuiɛ som bo ma me! O Onyankopɔn, sɛdeɛ ɛsi dɔɔso!
Sɛ mese merekan a, anka ɛbɛdɔɔso mpo asene anwea; sɛ menyane a, meda so wɔ wo ho ara.
O Onyankopɔn, sɛ wobɛkum abɔnefoɔ na mogyapɛfoɔ afiri me so akɔ ɛ!
Wɔn a wɔkasa tia wo mmusuo mu ne w’atamfo a wɔbɔ wo din ahuhudeɛ mu no.
O Awurade, wɔn a wɔtane woɔ no, mentane wɔn anaa? Na wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ no, me werɛ nho wɔn anaa?
Ɔtan fitaa na metan wɔn,
O Onyankopɔn, hwehwɛ me mu, na hunu m’akoma, sɔ me hwɛ, na hunu m’adwene,
na hwɛ sɛ amaneɛ kwan bi wɔ me hɔ a,
140: O Awurade, gye me firi nnipa abɔnefoɔ nsam; bɔ me ho ban firi awudifoɔ ho,
Wɔn a wɔbɔ pɔ bɔne wɔn akomam,
Wɔse wɔn kɛtrɛma ano sɛ ɔwɔ; ahuritia borɔ wɔ wɔn se ano. Sela.
O Awurade, hwɛ me so firi ɔbɔnefoɔ nsam, bɔ me ho ban firi awudifoɔ ho, na wɔabɔ wɔn tirim pɔ sɛ wɔbɛsum m’anammɔn atwene.
Ahantanfoɔ de fidie ne nhoma ahunta ama me; na wɔatrɛ atena mu wɔ kwankyɛn; wɔasunsum me mfidie. Sela.
Mesee Awurade sɛ: “Wone me Nyankopɔn. O Awurade, yɛ aso ma me nkotɔsrɛ nne.”
O Awurade, me Wura, me nkwagyeɛ ahoɔden, woakata me tiri so ɛko da.
O Awurade, mma ɔbɔnefoɔ deɛ ɔpɛ, mma n’agyina no nnkɔ so, na wɔamma wɔn ho so. Sela.
Wɔn a wɔtwa me ho hyia no deɛ, ma wɔn anom mmusuo nkata wɔn tiri so.
Ma nsramma a ɛredɛ ngu wɔn so, aku donkodonko mu a wɔrensɔre bio.
Mma ɔtɛkyerɛmafoɔ nntintim asase so, owudini deɛ, ma bɔne nti no yerɛdɛdɛ.
Me deɛ, menim sɛ Awurade bɛdi
Ampa, ateneneefoɔ bɛda wo din ase,
141: O Awurade,  mesu mefrɛ wo, yɛ ntɛm ma me; sɛ mesu mefrɛ wo a, yɛ aso ma me.
Ma me mpaebɔ mmɛsi w’anim sɛ ohwam, me nsa soma sɛ anwummerɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ.
O Awurade, fa ɔwɛn bɛwɛn m’ano, na hwɛ m’anofafa pono ano.
Nkom m’akoma nkɔ nsɛmmɔne ho, sɛ me ne nnipa amumuyɛfoɔ bɛdi nsɛmmɔne, na mma mennka wɔn nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwadeɛ bi nnhwɛ.
Ma ɔteneneeni mmɔ me, ɛbɛyɛ adɔeɛ ama me; na ɔka m’anim, ɛbɛyɛ ngo pa wɔ me tiri so, na mma me tiri rempo. Na me mpaebɔ ara na ɛda so tia wɔn nsɛmmɔne.
Wɔasum wɔn atemmufoɔ ahwe ɔbotan so, nanso wɔte me nsɛm, na ɛyɛ dɛ.
Sɛdeɛ obi dwiri asase funtum soɔ no, saa ara na wɔama yɛn nnompe apete Damena ano.
Nanso, wo, Awurade, so na m’ani da, wo na medwane bɛtoa wo, nto me kra ntwene.
Kora me firi apa a wɔasum me,
Ma abɔnefoɔ nhwe wɔn ankasa atena mu, na me deɛ, ma mensiane ho menkɔ prɛko.
142: Mede me nne mesu mefrɛ Awurade, mede me nne mekoto mesrɛ Awurade.
Me honhom tɔ piti me mu a,
Hwɛ nifa so, na hwɛ, obi nni hɔ a n’ani ku me ho, obiara mfa me kra nyɛ huu.
Mesu mefrɛ wo, O Awurade, mese sɛ: “Wone me dwankɔbea, me kyɛfa wɔ ateasefoɔ asase so.”
Wɛn w’aso tie me su, gye me firi m’ataafoɔ nsam,
Yi me kra firi afiase, Ateneneefoɔ bɛtwa me ho ahyia
143: O Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ; Firi wo nokorɛdie mu gye me so wo tenenee mu.
Na mfa w’akoa nkɔ atemmuo mu, na w’anim ɔteasefoɔ biara renni bem.
Na ɔtamfoɔ taa me kra, ɔma metena sum mu sɛ wɔn a wɔawuwu dadaada.
Na me honhom tɔ piti me mu,
Mekae tete nna; medwendwene wo nnwuma nyinaa ho; mesusu wo nsa ano nnwuma ho.
Metrɛ me nsam kyerɛ wo; wo ho sukɔm de me kra sɛ asase a awoɔ. Sela.
O Awurade, yɛ ntɛm gye me so, anyɛ saa a mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsiane kɔ Amena mu no.
Ma mente w’adɔeɛ anɔpa, na wo so na mede me ho metoɔ. Ma menhunu kwan a memfa soɔ, na wo na mema me kra so kyerɛ woɔ.
O Awurade, gye me firi m’atamfo nsam. Wo nkyɛn na mede me ho makora.
Kyerɛkyerɛ me ma menyɛ deɛ wopɛ, Wo honhom pa no nnya me asase tee so.
Wo din nti, Awurade, ma mennya nkwa, wo tenenee mu yi me kra firi ahohia mu,
na w’adɔeɛ mu yi m’atamfoɔ firi hɔ, na sɛe wɔn a wɔha me kra nyinaa,
144: M’adɔeɛ ne m’abankɛseɛ, m’abantenten ne me Gyefoɔ, me kyɛm ne deɛ medwane kɔtoa no; a ɔbrɛ me man ase hyɛ m’aseɛ.
O Awurade, onipa ne hwan a wohu no, ɔdasani ne hwan a wodwene ne ho?
Onipa te sɛ ahuhuo, ne nna te sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam.
O Awurade, kuntunu wo soro, na si fam, keka mmepɔ, na ɛmfiri wisie.
Tene wo nsa firi soro nohoa, gye me, na yi me firi nsuo akɛseɛ mu,
Wɔn na wɔn ano ka atosɛm, na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nkontompo nsa nifa.
O Onyankopɔn, mɛto dwom foforɔ mama wo. Sankuo a ɛso nhoma yɛ du so na mɛto dwom mama woɔ.
Wo a woma ahemfo di nkonim, na wogyee w’akoa Dawid firii nkrantɛ bɔne ano.
Gye me na yi me firi ananafoɔ mma a wɔn ano ka atosɛm, na wɔn nsa nifa yɛ nkontompo nsa nifa;
Na yɛn mmabanin ayɛ sɛ tɛ nnua na yɛn mmammaa ayɛ sɛ ntwea so adum a wɔasene no sɛ ahemfie deɛ.
Na yɛn aduane korabea ayeyɛ amaama; nneɛma ahodoɔ nyinaa bi wom, ayɛ mpem du du yɛn nsase so.
Yɛn anantwie mu ayeyɛ duru; a ɔsɛeɛ ne apɔn biara mma wɔn mu, na abooboo amma yɛn mmɔntene so.
Nhyira ne ɔman a wɔte sɛɛ, nhyira ne ɔman a Awurade ne wɔn Nyankopɔn. Onyankopɔn kɛseyɛ ne n’adɔeɛ
145: Mɛyi wo ayɛ, me Nyankopɔn, O Ɔhene, na mɛhyira wo din daa daa.
Mɛhyira wo daa nyinaa, na mɛyi wo din ayɛ daa daa.
Awurade so, na ɔsɛ ayeyie kɛse, ne kɛseyɛ mu nni hwehwɛeɛ.
Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bɛkamfo wo nnwuma akyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ, na wɔbɛka wo nnwuma akɛseɛ no ho asɛm.
W’animuonyam ne w’anidie a ɛhyerɛn, ne w’anwanwadwuma ho nsɛm na mɛdwendwene ho.
Nnipa bɛka wo nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ hu no tumi ho asɛm;
Wɔbɛka wo papayɛ bebrebe no ho nkaeɛ, na wɔato wo tenenee ho ahurisie dwom.
Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ, ne bo kyɛre fu na n’adɔeɛ dɔɔso.
Awurade yɛ ma nnipa nyinaa, na ne mmɔborɔhunu wɔ ne nnwuma nyinaa so.
O Awurade, wo nnwuma nyinaa bɛkamfo wo,
Wɔbɛka w’ahennie animuonyam ho asɛm, na wɔabɔ wo mmaninyɛ nso akyerɛ,
Na ama nnipa mma ahunu ne nnwuma akɛseɛ, ne n’ahennie animuonyam a ɛhyerɛn no.
W’ahennie yɛ daa ahennie, na wo tumidie fa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Awurade wowa wɔn a wɔhwe aseɛ nyinaa, na ɔma wɔn a wɔakotoɔ nyinaa so gyina hɔ.
Ani nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan, na woma wɔn, wɔn aduane ne berɛ mu.
Wobue wo nsam na woma ateasefoɔ nyinaa nya deɛ wɔpɛ di mee.
Awurade tene n’akwan nyinaa mu, na ɔyɛ adɔeɛ ne nnwuma nyinaa mu.
Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa, wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nokorɛ mu nyinaa.
Ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no no apɛdeɛ ma wɔn, na ɔtie wɔn sufrɛ na ɔgye wɔn.
Awurade hwɛ n’adɔfo nyinaa so, na abɔnefoɔ nyinaa deɛ, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn.
M’ano bɛka Awurade ayeyie, na ma honam nyinaa nhyira ne din kronkron no daa daa.
146: Mete ase yi, mɛyi Awurade ayɛ, mete aseɛ yi, mɛto dwom ama me Nyankopɔn.
Mommfa mo ho nnto adehyeɛ, anaa onipa ba a nkwagyeɛ biara nni ne mu so.
Ne honhom firi kɔ, na ɔsan kɔ ne dɔteɛ mu; da no ara, ne nsusuiɛ yera.
Nhyira ne deɛ Yakob Nyankopɔn ne ne boafoɔ; deɛ n’ani da Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn soɔ;
Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, ɔno na ɔkora nokorɛ so daa,
Ɔno na ɔbu atɛn ma wɔn a wɔdi wɔn amim, na ɔma wɔn a ɛkɔm de wɔn aduane. Awurade na ɔsane tu nneduafoɔ.
Awurade bue anifirafoɔ ani; Awurade ma wɔn a wɔakotoɔ so gyina hɔ;
Awurade kora ahɔhoɔ so, ɔno na ɔdi boa agyanka ne okunafoɔ, na abɔnefoɔ kwan deɛ, ɔdane ani.
Awurade bɛdi hene daapem, O Sion, wo Nyankopɔn bɛdi hene akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so. Nyankopɔn tumi, adɔeɛ ne nyansa
147: Monyi Awurade ayɛ, na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔto dwom ma yɛn Nyankopɔn,
Awurade na ɔkyekyere Yerusalem; ɔboaboa Israelfoɔ a wɔahweteɛ no ano.
Ɔsa wɔn a wɔn akoma abubuo yareɛ,
Ɔkan nsoromma dodoɔ, na ɔbobɔ wɔn nyinaa din frɛfrɛ wɔn.
Yɛn Awurade yɛ kɛseɛ na ne tumi dɔɔso;
Awurade ma ahobrɛasefoɔ gyina,
Monto aseda dwom mma Awurade; momfa sankuo nto dwom mma yɛn Nyankopɔn;
Ɔno na ɔde mununkum kata ɔsoro, na ɔma wura fifi mmepɔ soɔ.
Ɔno na ɔma mmoa nya wɔn ano aduane, na ɔma kwaakwaadabi mma a wɔsu frɛ no aduane.
Ɛnyɛ pɔnkɔ ahoɔden na ɛyɛ no fɛ, na ɛnyɛ onipa nan ase hare na ɛsɔ n’ani.
Awurade ani gye wɔn a wɔsuro no ho, wɔn a wɔn ani da n’adɔeɛ soɔ.
O Yerusalem, kamfo Awurade. O Sion, yi wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ wahyɛ w’aponkɛseɛ adaban den,
Ɔma w’ahyeɛ so dwo,
Ɔma ne kaseɛ ba asase so, n’asɛm tu mmirika ntɛmntɛm.
Ɔma sukyerɛmma tɔ sɛ asaawa fukuiɛ, ɔpete nkyenkyeneeɛ sɛ nso.
Ɔto asukɔtweaa gu sɛ mporoporowa, hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina n’awɔ ano?
Ɔsoma n’asɛm, na ɛnane no, ɔma ne mframa bɔ, na nsuo sosɔ.
Ɔyi n’asɛm kyerɛ Yakob, na ɔde n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmusɛm kyerɛ Israel.
Ɔnyɛɛ ɔman biara saa da; na n’atemmusɛm no, wɔnnim.
148: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Monyi Awurade ayɛ mfiri soro,
N’abɔfoɔ nyinaa, monyi no ayɛ. n’asafodɔm nyinaa, monyi no ayɛ.
Awia ne bosome, monyi no ayɛ. nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn nyinaa, monyi no ayɛ.
Mo soro mu soro, monyi no ayɛ, nsuo a ɛwɔ ɔsoro atifi nso, monyi no ayɛ.
Ma wɔnyi Awurade din ayɛ, na ɔno na ɔhyɛ maa no baeɛ.
Na ɔde wɔn tintim hɔ daa daa, wahyɛ ahyɛdeɛ a, ɛrentwam.
Monyi Awurade ayɛ wɔ asase so, nsuboa ahodoɔ ne abunu nyinaa;
Egya ne asukɔtweaa, sukyerɛmma ne huruhuro, ahum a ɛyɛ deɛ n’asɛm seɛ:
Mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ nyinaa, nnua a ɛso aba ne ntweneduro nyinaa,
Wuram mmoa ne afieboa nyinaa, mmoa a wɔwea ne ntakraboa.
Asase so ahemfo ne aman nyinaa, mmapɔmma ne asase so atemmufoɔ nyinaa,
Wɔnyi Awurade din ayɛ, na ne din nko ara na ɛkorɔn kyɛn soɔ. N’animuonyam tra asase ne ɔsoro so.
Na wama abɛn so ama ne man, ama n’ahotefoɔ nyinaa ayeyie, ama Israel mma, ɔman a wɔbɛn no no.
149: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Monto dwom foforɔ mma Awurade, monto n’ayeyie ahotefoɔ asafo mu.
Ma Israel ani nnye ne yɛfoɔ ho, ma Sion mma nni wɔn hene ho ahurisie.
Ma wɔmfa asa nyi ne din ayɛ, ma wɔmfa mpintin ne asankuo nto dwom mma no.
Awurade ani gye ne man ho, ɔde nkwagyeɛ hyehyɛ ahobrɛasefoɔ.
Ma Ahotefoɔ nni ahurisie wɔ animuonyam mu; ma wɔto ahosan dwom, wɔn mpa so.
Ma Onyankopɔn nnwom nnyegye wɔn anomu, na wɔnkura nkrantɛ anofanu wɔn nsam,
wɔmfa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nkyekyere wɔn ahemfo, ne dadeɛ mpokyerɛ ngu wɔn atitire;
sɛ wɔde atɛn a wɔatwerɛ no bɛbu wɔn; ɛne n’ahotefoɔ nyinaa animuonyam. Deɛ ɛhome nyinaa nyi AWURADE ayɛ!
150: Monyi Awurade ayɛ! Monyi Onyankopɔn ayɛ wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ, monyi no ayɛ ne tumi wiem no mu.
Monyi no ayɛ ne mmaninyɛ mu, monyi no ayɛ sɛdeɛ ne kɛseyɛ bebrebe no teɛ.
Monyi no ayɛ ntotorobɛnto nne so, monyi no ayɛ bɛnta ne sankuten so.
Momfa mpintin ne asa nyi no ayɛ, monyi no ayɛ asankuhan ne atɛntɛbɛn so.
Momfa nnawuta nnyegyeeɛ dɛdɛ nyi no ayɛ, monyi no ayɛ nnawuta a ɛgyegye denden so.
Momma deɛ ɛhome nyinaa nyi Awurade ayɛ.

1: Yesu Kristo adiyie a Onyankopɔn de maa no sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne nkoa deɛ ɛtwa sɛ ɛba ntɛm, na ɔnam ne bɔfoɔ so de bɛkyerɛɛ n’akoa Yohane
a wadi Nyankopɔn asɛm, ne Yesu Kristo ho adanseɛ ne deɛ ɔhunuiɛ nyinaa ho adanseɛ.
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔkenkan ne wɔn a wɔtie adiyie nsɛm no, na wɔde deɛ wɔatwerɛ wɔ mu no sie; na ɛberɛ no abɛn.
Yohane de kɔma asafo ahodoɔ nson a ɛwɔ Asia no: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ mfiri “Deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔtenaa hɔ, na ɔreba no,” ne ahonhom nson a ɛwɔ n’ahennwa no anim,
ne Yesu Kristo, a ɔyɛ “Ɔdanseni Nokwafoɔ no,” ne “awufoɔ mu abakan,” ne “asase so ahemfo Sodifoɔ” no nkyɛn nka mo. Deɛ ɔdɔ yɛn, na ɔde ne mogya adware yɛn afiri yɛn bɔne mu,
na wayɛ yɛn ahemman sɛ yɛnyɛ asɔfoɔ mma n’Agya Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na wɔmfa animuonyam ne tumi mma no daa daa. Amen.
Hwɛ! Ɔnam mununkum mu reba, na aniwa nyinaa bɛhu no, ne wɔn a wɔwɔɔ no mpea no; na ne nti, asase so mmusuakuo nyinaa bɛdi awerɛhoɔ asu. Aane, Amen.
“Mene Alfa ne Omega no, Odikanfoɔ ne Okyikafoɔ no”, Awurade na ɔseɛ, “Deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔda so wɔ hɔ dada, na ɔreba, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no.”
Me, Yohane a meyɛ mo nua ne Yesu ahohia ne ahennie ne boasetɔ no mu yɔnkoɔ no, ɛsiane Nyankopɔn asɛm ne Yesu adanseɛ nti, na mewɔ supɔ a wɔfrɛ no Patmo no so.
Na mewɔ honhom mu Awurade da no, na metee nne kɛseɛ bi wɔ m’akyi sɛ totorobɛnto

sɛ: “Mene Alfa ne Omega no, Odikanfoɔ ne Okyikafoɔ no: Deɛ wohunu no twerɛ no nwoma mu kɔma asafo ahodoɔ nson a ɛwɔ Efeso ne Smirna ne Pergamo ne Tiatira ne Sardi ne Filadelfia ne Laodikea.” Ɔgyefoɔ no ho anisoadehunu
Na medanee m’ani sɛ merehwɛ nne a ɛkasa kyerɛɛ me no. Na medanee me ho no, mehunuu sika nkaneadua nson,
na nkaneadua no mfimfini no, mehunuu obi a ɔte sɛ Onipa ba a ɔhyɛ atadeɛ yuu, na ɔde sika abɔsoɔ abɔ ne koko so.
Na ne tiri ne ne nwi hoa sɛ odwanten ho nwi fitaa, sɛ sukyerɛmma, na n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa,
na ne nan te sɛ yaawa fɛfɛ a adɔ fononoo mu, na ne nne te sɛ nsuo bebree nne,
na ɔkura nsoromma nson wɔ ne nsa nifa mu, na afena anofanu nnamnnam firi n’anomu, na n’anim te sɛ owia a rehyerɛn n’ahoɔden mu. Nkuranhyɛ, nkwa ne anidasoɔ
Na berɛ a mehunuu no no, mehwee ne nan ase sɛ owufoɔ. Ɛnna ɔde ne nsa nifa too me so kaa sɛ: “Nsuro; Mene Odikanfoɔ ne Okyikafoɔ,
ne Deɛ ɔte aseɛ no; na mewuiɛ, nanso, hwɛ! mete ase daa daa, na mekura owuo ne Asamando nsafoa.
Enti twerɛ deɛ woahunu, ne deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ, ne deɛ ɛbɛba yeinom akyi no to hɔ.
Ahuntasɛm kronkron a ɛfa nsoromma nson a wohunuu no me nsa nifa mu no ho, ne sika nkaneadua nson no ho deɛ: Nsoromma nson no yɛ asafo nson no abɔfoɔ, na nkaneadua nson a wohunuiɛ no yɛ asafo nson.
2: “Twerɛ kɔma Efeso asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔkura nsoromma nson wɔ ne nsa nifa mu, deɛ ɔnam sika nkaneadua nson no mfimfini no seɛ,
‘Menim wo nnwuma ne wo brɛ ne wo boasetɔ, ɛne sɛ wontumi nkura wɔn a wɔyɛ abɔnefoɔ, na woasɔ wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ asomafoɔ na wɔnyɛ no ahwɛ, na woahu wɔn sɛ atorofoɔ.
Na wowɔ boasetɔ, na me din nti, woaha wo ho, na wɔammrɛ.
Nanso mewɔ wo ho asɛm bi, ɛne sɛ, woagya wo kane dɔ no.
“‘Enti kae deɛ wofiri hwee aseɛ no, na sakra w'adwene, na yɛ kane nnwuma no bio. Anyɛ saa a, mɛba wo so ntɛm na mabɛyi wo kaneadua no afiri ne siberɛ, gye sɛ wosakra w’adwene.
Nanso yei na wowɔ, sɛ wotane Nikolaitanfoɔ nnwuma a me nso metane no.
Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma no adi nkwadua a ɛsi Onyankopɔn paradise mu no bi.’
“Na twerɛ kɔma Smirna asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Sɛɛ na ‘Odikanfoɔ ne Okyikafoɔ no,’ deɛ ɔwuiɛ na wasan aba nkwa mu bio no seɛ,
‘Menim w’ahohiahia ne wo hia no, nanso woyɛ ɔdefoɔ; ne abususɛm a wɔn a wɔse wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ nanso wɔnyɛ bie no na mmom wɔyɛ satan hyiadan no ka no.
Nsuro amaneɛ ɛrebɛto woɔ biara. Hwɛ! ɔbonsam de mo mu binom bɛgu afiase na ama wɔasɔ mo ahwɛ, na mobɛhunu amane dadu. Di nokorɛ kɔsi owuo mu, na mɛma wo nkwa abotire.
Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no reka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, owuprenu no renka no.’
“Na twerɛ kɔma Pergamo asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Yei na deɛ ɔwɔ nkrantɛ anofanu nnamnam no ka,
‘Menim wo nnwuma ne baabi a woteɛ, deɛ satan ahennwa sie; na wokura me din mu, na woampa me gyidie, nna a wɔkumm me danseni nokwafoɔ Antipa wɔ mo hɔ no mu, deɛ ɔbonsam teɛ hɔ.

“‘Nanso mewɔ nsɛm kakra tia wo, sɛ wowɔ nnipa binom wɔ hɔ a wɔkura Balaam nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, deɛ ɔkyerɛɛ Balak sɛ ɔmfa suntidua nto Israel mma anim mma wɔnni nnuane a wɔde abɔ afɔdeɛ ama abosom na wɔmmɔ adwaman no.
Saa ara nso na wowɔ nnipa bi a wɔkura Nikolaitanfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu.
Enti sakra w'adwene. Anyɛ saa a, mɛba wo so ntɛm, na mede nkrantɛ a ɛfiri m’anom no ne wɔn bɛko.

“‘Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no: Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no mɛma no mana a ahunta no bi adi, na mɛma no ɛboɔ fitaa, na ɛboɔ no so na wɔatwerɛ din foforɔ bi aguo a obiara nnim gye deɛ ne nsa ka no.’
“Na twerɛ kɔma Tiatira asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Sɛɛ na Onyankopɔn Ba a n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa na ne nan te sɛ yaawa fɛfɛ no seɛ,
‘Menim wo nnwuma ne wo dɔ ne wo gyidie ne wo som ne wo boasetɔ no ne sɛ wo nnwuma a ɛdi akyire sene deɛ ɛdi kan no.
“‘Nanso mewɔ wo ho asɛm, sɛ woma ɔbaa Yesebel a ɔfrɛ ne ho sɛ odiyifoɔ no kwan sɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔnnaadaa me nkoa na wɔmmɔ adwaman na wɔnni nnuane a wɔde abɔ afɔdeɛ ama abosom.
Na memaa no berɛ sɛ ɔmfa nsakra n'adwene mfiri n’adwamammɔ mu, nanso wansakra.
Hwɛ! Mede no bɛto yarepa so, na mede wɔn a wɔne no sɛe awareɛ no agu ahohiahia kɛseɛ mu, gye sɛ wɔsakra wɔn adwene firi wɔn nnwuma ho.
Na mede owuyareɛ bɛbobɔ ne mma, na asafo no nyinaa ahunu sɛ mene deɛ ɔhwehwɛ adwene ne akoma mu, na mɛma mo mu biara sɛdeɛ mo nnwuma teɛ.
“‘Nanso meka kyerɛ mo a moaka a mowɔ Tiatira, dodoɔ a wɔnni saa nkyerɛkyerɛ yi nyinaa, wɔn a wɔnhunuu “satan nneɛma a emu dɔ” no sɛdeɛ wɔka no no sɛ: Meremfa adesoa foforɔ biara nto mo so.
Nanso deɛ mowɔ no, monsɔ mu den nkɔsi sɛ mɛba.
Na deɛ ɔdi nkonim na ɔkura me nnwuma mu kɔsi awieeɛ no, ɔno na mɛma no amanaman no so tumi,
na ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛka wɔn na wɔabubu wɔn mu asinasini sɛ ɔnwomfoɔ nkukuo, sɛdeɛ me nso menyaa wɔ m’Agya nsam no.
Na mɛma no adekyeeɛ nsoromma.
Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.’
3: “Na twerɛ kɔma Sardi asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Sɛɛ na deɛ ɔwɔ Onyankopɔn ahonhom nson ne nsoromma nson no seɛ, ‘Menim wo nnwuma; sɛ wowɔ din sɛ wote ase, nanso woawu.
Wɛn, na hyɛ nkaeɛ a ɛrebɛwuo no den, na menhunuu wo nnwuma sɛ ɛyɛ pɛ me Nyankopɔn anim.
Enti kae sɛdeɛ woanya na woateɛ na di so, na sakra w’adwene! Na sɛ woanwɛn a, mɛba sɛ owifoɔ, na worenhunu dɔn ko a mɛba wo soɔ.
“‘Nanso wowɔ nnipa kakra bi wɔ Sardi a wɔnguu wɔn ntadeɛ ho fi, na wɔne me bɛnante ntade fitaa mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔfata.
Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no wɔde ntadeɛ fitaa bɛhyɛ no; na merempepa ne din mfiri nkwa nwoma no mu, na mmom mɛbɔ ne din wɔ m’Agya ne n’abɔfoɔ anim.
Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.’
“Na twerɛ kɔma Filadelfia asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Sɛɛ na Ɔkronkronni ne Ɔnokwafoɔ, deɛ ɔwɔ Dawid safoa, a sɛ ɔbue a obiara ntom, na ɔtom nso a obiara mmue, no seɛ,
‘Menim wo nnwuma. Hwɛ, mede ɛpono a wɔabue asi w’anim a obiara ntumi nto mu, ɛne sɛ wowɔ ahoɔden ketewa bi, na wodii m’asɛm so na woampa me din.
Hwɛ! mede wɔn a wɔfiri satan hyiadan mu a wɔka sɛ wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ, nanso wɔnyɛ bie na mmom wɔdi atorɔ no bɛma. Na hwɛ, mɛma wɔaba abɛkoto wo nan ase na wɔahunu sɛ madɔ wo.
Ɛsiane sɛ woadi me boasetɔ ho asɛm soɔ nti, me nso mɛkora wo so wɔ sɔhwɛ berɛ a ɛbɛba wiase nyinaa soɔ abɛsɔ wɔn a wɔte asase so ahwɛ no mu.
Hwɛ, mereba ntɛm. Sɔ deɛ wowɔ no mu dendeenden, na obi annye w’abotire.

“‘Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛyɛ no fadum wɔ me Nyankopɔn asɔredan mu, na ɔremfiri adi bio, na mɛtwerɛ me Nyankopɔn din wɔ ne so, ne me Nyankopɔn kuro a ɛyɛ Yerusalem foforɔ, a ɛfiri soro ba fam firi me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no din, ne me din foforɔ no.
Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ Honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo ahodoɔ no.’
“Na twerɛ kɔma Laodikea asafo no bɔfoɔ sɛ: Sɛɛ na Amen, ne Ɔdanseni Nokwafoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye no die, Onyankopɔn adebɔ mfitiaseɛ no seɛ,
‘Menim wo nnwuma sɛ woa wonyɛ nwunu ɛnna wonyɛ hyeɛ. Sɛ woyɛ nwunu anaa hye a, anka ɛyɛ.
Enti ɛsiane sɛ woyɛ boturobodwo na wonyɛ hye na wonyɛ nwunu nti, mɛfe wo afiri m’anom.
Ɛfiri sɛ woka sɛ: “Meyɛ ɔdefoɔ, na manya me ho, na hwee nhia me,” nanso wonnim sɛ woyɛ ɔmanehunufoɔ, mmɔborɔni, ohiani, onifirani ne ɔdagyani.

Metu wo fo sɛ tɔ sika kɔkɔɔ a wɔde gya apa mu firi me nkyɛn na woayɛ ɔdefoɔ, ne ntade fitaa na woatumi asiesie wo ho na wɔanyi w’adagya so amma w’ani anwu, na tɔ aniduro a wode bɛsra w’ani na woahunu adeɛ.
“‘Dodoɔ a medɔ wɔn no, meyi wɔn atɛn, twe wɔn aso. Enti bɔ mmɔden na sakra w’adwene!
Hwɛ, megyina ɛpono ano rebom. Sɛ obi te me nne na ɔbue pono no a, mɛba mu ne no abɛdidi na ɔno nso ne me adidi.
Deɛ ɔdi nkonim no, mɛma ɔne me atena m’ahennwa so, sɛdeɛ me nso medii nkonim na me ne m’Agya te n’ahennwa soɔ no.
Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no ntie deɛ honhom no ka kyerɛ asafo no.’”
4: Yeinom akyiri no, mehwɛe, na hwɛ! ɛpono bi a wɔabue ano da hɔ wɔ soro, na ɛnne a ɛdi kan a meteeɛ no te sɛ totorobɛnto, na ɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Foro bra ha, na mɛkyerɛ wo nneɛma a ɛtwa sɛ yeinom akyiri no ɛba.”
Na ntɛm ara na mewɔ Honhom mu, na hwɛ! ahennwa bi si soro, na Obi te ahennwa no so.
Na deɛ ɔte soɔ no, wohwɛ no a, ɔte sɛ ahwehwɛboɔ ne bogyanamboɔ, na nyankontɔn a wohwɛ a, ɛte sɛ ahahammonoboɔ atwa ahennwa no ho ahyia.
Na nhennwa aduonu nnan atwa ahennwa no ho ahyia, na mehunuu mpanimfoɔ aduonu nan sɛ wɔtete nhennwa no so hyehyɛ ntadeɛ fitaa na sika abotire bobɔ wɔn ti. Deɛ atwa ahennwa no ho ahyia
Na anyinam ne ɛnne ahodoɔ ne aprannaa firi ahennwa no mu firii adi, na egya nkanea nson a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ahonhom nson no redɛre ahennwa no anim.
Na ahwehwɛ po a ɛte sɛ ahwehwɛ wɔ ahennwa no anim, na ateasefoɔ baanan a ani ayeyɛ wɔn anim ne wɔn akyiri mama wowɔ ahennwa no ho wɔ mfimfini, na wɔatwa ahennwa no ho ahyia.
Na ɔteasefoɔ a ɔdi kan no te sɛ gyata, na ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no te sɛ nantwie ba, na ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no anim te sɛ onipa, na ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan no te sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔtuo.

Na ateasefoɔ baanan no mu biara wɔ ntaban nsia; na aniwa hyehyɛ wɔn ho ne wɔn mu mama. Na wɔnhome awia ne anadwo, ka sɛ: “Kronkron, kronkron, kronkron ne Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ, a ɔtenaa hɔ, na ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔrebɛba.” Onyankopɔn tumi ne n'animuonyam
Na berɛ biara a ateasefo no de animuonyam ne anidie ne aseda ma Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no so a ɔte ase daa daa no,
mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan no hwehwe ase wɔ Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no anim na wɔkoto sɔre Deɛ ɔte ase daa daa no, na wɔtutu wɔn abotire gu ahennwa no anim ka sɛ:
“O Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn, wofata sɛ wogye animuonyam ne anidie ne tumi, ɛfiri sɛ wo na wobɔɔ nneɛma nyinaa, na wo pɛ nti na ɛwowɔ hɔ na wobɔeɛ.”
5: Na mehunuu nwoma mmobɔeɛ bi a wɔatwerɛ emu ne akyire, a wɔde nsɔano nson asɔ ano, wɔ Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no nsa nifa mu.
Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi a ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: “Hwan na ɔfata sɛ ɔbue nwoma mmobɔeɛ no mu na ɔte ne nsɔano no?”
Nanso na obiara nni ɔsoro, asase so, anaa asase ase a, ɔbɛtumi abue nwoma mmonɔeɛ no mu anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu. Ɔgyefoɔ no nko na ɔbɛtumi abue nwoma no mu
Enti mesuu pii, ɛfiri sɛ wɔanhunu obiara a ɔfata sɛ ɔbue nwoma mmonɔeɛ no mu anaasɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu.
Nanso mpanimfoɔ no mu baako ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Nsu. Hwɛ! Yuda abusuakuo mu Gyata no, Dawid nhini no, adi nkonim sɛ ɔbɛbue nwoma no mu na watete ne nsɔano nson no.”

Na mehwɛe, na ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ntam ne mpanimfoɔ no ntam no, adwammaa bi gyina hɔ a ɔte sɛdeɛ wɔaku no. Ɔwɔ mmɛn nson ne ani nson a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ahonhom nson a wɔasoma wɔn kɔ asase nyinaa soɔ no.
Ɛnna ɔba bɛgyee nwoma no firii Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no nsa nifa mu.
Na berɛ a ɔgyee nwoma no, ateasefoɔ baanan no ne mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan no hwehwee ase Adwammaa no anim, na na wɔn mu biara kura sankuo ne sika nkuruwa a aduhwam ayɛ no ma; a ɛyɛ ahotefoɔ no mpaebɔ.
Na wɔtoo dwom foforɔ sɛ: “Wofata sɛ wogye nwoma no na wote ne nsɔano ano, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkuu wo na wode wo mogya atɔ yɛn ama Onyankopɔn, afiri mmusua ne kasa ne nkurɔfoɔ ne aman nyinaa mu,
na woayɛ wɔn ahemman ne asɔfoɔ ama yɛn Nyankopɔn, na wɔbɛdi asase so ahene.” Adwammaa no tumi ne n'animuonyam
Na mehwɛe, na metee abɔfoɔ bebree a wɔatwa ahennwa no ne ateasefoɔ no ne mpanimfoɔ no ho ahyia nne, na na wɔn dodoɔ yɛ ɔpedudu ne mpempem huhaa,
na wɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ: “Adwammaa a wɔkum no no fata sɛ ɔgye tumi ne ahonya ne nyansa ne ahoɔden ne anidie ne animuonyam ne nhyira.”

Na abɔdeɛ biara a ɛwɔ soro ne asase so ne asase ase ne ɛpo so, ne deɛ ɛwom nyinaa no, metee sɛ wɔreka sɛ: “Nhyira ne anidie ne animuonyam ne tumi nka Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no ne Adwammaa no daa daa.”
Ɛnna ateasefoɔ baanan no kaa sɛ: “Amen!” Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nan no hwehwee ase na wɔkoto sɔree Deɛ ɔte ase daa daa no.
6: Na mehunuu sɛ Adwammaa no ate nsɔano nson no baako ano, na metee sɛ ateasefoɔ baanan no mu baako de nne a ɛte sɛ aprannaa kaa sɛ: “Bra!”
Na mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ! ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa bi nie; na deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no kura agyan; na wɔmaa no abotire, na ɔfirii adi a ɔredi nkonim na wakɔdi nkonim.
Na berɛ a ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ano no, metee sɛ ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no reka sɛ: “Bra!”
Na ɔpɔnkɔ foforɔ kɔkɔɔ bi firii adi; na wɔmaa deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no kwan sɛ ɔnyi asomdwoeɛ mfiri asase so na wɔnkunkum wɔn ho wɔn ho; na wɔmaa no nkrantɛ kɛseɛ bi.
Na berɛ a ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ano no, metee sɛ ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no reka sɛ: “Bra!” Na mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ! ɔpɔnkɔ tuntum bi nie; na deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no kura nsania wɔ ne nsam.
Na metee nne bi ateasefoɔ baanan no mfimfini sɛ: “Ayuo susukoraa denare baako, na atokoɔ susukoraa mmiɛnsa denare baako; na ngo ne bobesa deɛ, nsɛe no.”
Na berɛ a ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nnan no ano no, metee sɛ ɔteasefoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan no reka sɛ: “Bra!”

Na mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ! ɔpɔnkɔ a ne ho nsonso bi nie; na deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no din de Owuo, na Asamando di n’akyi. Na wɔmaa wɔn asase nkyekyɛmu nnan mu baako so tumi sɛ wɔmfa nkrantɛ ne ɛkɔm ne owuyareɛ ne asase so nkekaboa nkunkum wɔn.
Na berɛ a ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nnum no ano no, mehunuu wɔn a Onyankopɔn asɛm ne wɔn adanseɛ a wɔdiiɛ nti wɔakunkum wɔn no akra, afɔrebukyia no ase.
Na wɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam sɛ: “O Awurade Tumfoɔ, Ɔkronkronni ne Ɔnokwafoɔ, wobɛtwentwɛn wo nan ase akɔsi da bɛn na wobɛtɔ wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ no yɛn mogya so werɛ?”
Na wɔmaa wɔn mu biara atadeɛ fitaa; na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnhome kakra nkɔsi sɛ wɔn nwurakwaa ne wɔn nuanom a wɔrebɛkunkum wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔkum wɔn no bɛba abɛka ho ama wɔn dodoɔ awie duro.
Na ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nsia no ano no, mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ, asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ bi siiɛ; na owia danee tumm sɛ enwi kotokuo, na ɔsrane danee sɛ mogya.
Na ɔsoro nsoromma hwehwee asase so te sɛ borɔdɔma dua a mframa kɛseɛ woso no tete n’aba bunu guo.
Na ɔsoro yii ne ho kɔe te sɛ nwoma a wɔabobɔ, na mmepɔ ne nsupɔ nyinaa tutu fifirii deɛ na ɛwowɔ.
Na asase so ahemfo ne nnipa akɛseɛ ne asafohene ne adefoɔ ne ahoɔdenfoɔ ne nkoa ne adehyeɛ nyinaa huntahuntaa abodan ne mmepɔ mu abotan mu.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ mmepɔ ne abotan no sɛ: Monhwe yɛn so mfa yɛn nhunta mfiri Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no ne Adwammaa no abufuo ho,
ɛfiri sɛ n'abufuo da kɛseɛ no aduru, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi agyina ano?”
7: Yei akyi no, mehunuu abɔfoɔ nnan sɛ wɔgyinagyina asase ntweasoɔ nnan no ano kurakura asase so mframa nnan no mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mframa biara remmɔ mfa asase anaa ɛpo anaa dua biara soɔ.
Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔde Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no nsɔano atu firi awiapueeɛ reba; na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam ka kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ nnan a wɔama wɔn kwan sɛ wɔnha asase ne ɛpo no
sɛ: “Monnha asase anaa ɛpo anaa nnua no kɔsi sɛ yɛde agyiraeɛ bɛsisi yɛn Nyankopɔn nkoa moma soɔ.” Nnipa mpem ɔha aduanan nnan no ho asɛm
Na metee wɔn a wɔasɔ wɔn ano no dodoɔ; Mpem ɔha aduanan nnan (144,000), a wɔasɔ wɔn ano afiri Israel mma mmusuakuo nyinaa mu:
Yuda abusuakuo mu nnipa mpem dumienu na wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano; Ruben abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Gad abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu;
Aser abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Naftali abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Manase abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu;
Simeon abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Lewi abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Isakar abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu;
Sebulon abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Yosef abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu; Benyamin abusuakuo mu mpem dumienu na wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano.

Yeinom akyi no, mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ! nnipakuo kɛseɛ bi a obiara ntumi nkan wɔn, a wɔfiri amanaman ne mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa nyinaa mu, gyinagyina ahennwa no ne Adwammaa no anim hyehyɛ ntade fitafitaa; na wɔkurakura berɛ.
Na wɔde nne kɛseɛ team sɛ: “Nkwagyeɛ no yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no soɔ ne Adwammaa no dea.”
Na abɔfoɔ no nyinaa gyinagyina hɔ atwa ahennwa no ne mpanimfoɔ no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ho ahyia, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam ahennwa no anim, na wɔkoto sɔree Onyankopɔn,
kaa sɛ: “Amen! Nhyira ne animuonyam ne nyansa ne aseda ne anidie ne tumi ne ahoɔden yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea daa daa. Amen.” Nkwagyeɛ a ɛnam Adwammaa no so ba
Ɛnna mpanimfoɔ no baako bisaa me sɛ: “Wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ ntade yuu fitafitaa yi yɛ hwannom na wɔfiri he?”
Enti meka mekyerɛɛ no sɛ: “Owura, wo na wonim.” Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔfiri ahohiahia kɛseɛ no mu, na wɔahoro wɔn ntadeɛ ama no ayɛ fitaa Adwammaa no mogya mu.
Ɛno nti na wɔwɔ Onyankopɔn ahennwa no anim; na wɔsom no awia ne anadwo wɔ n’asɔrefie; na Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no bɛkata wɔn so.
Ɛkɔm ne sukɔm renne wɔn bio, na awia renhye wɔn na ɔhyew biara renka wɔn,
ɛfiri sɛ Adwammaa a ɔwɔ ahennwa no mfimfini no bɛyɛ wɔn Hwɛfoɔ, na ɔbɛkyerɛ wɔn kwan akɔ nkwa asutire ho. Na Onyankopɔn bɛpepa wɔn ani so nisuo nyinaa.”
8: Na berɛ a ɔtee nsɔano a ɛtɔ so nson no ano no, ɔsoro yɛɛ dinn bɛyɛ dɔnhwere fa.
Na mehunuu abɔfoɔ nson a wɔgyinagyina Onyankopɔn anim no, na wɔmaa wɔn ntotorobɛnto nson.
Afei ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ ba bɛgyinaa afɔrebukyia no ho a ɔkura sika aduhwam kuruwa; na wɔmaa no nduhwam pii sɛ ɔmfa nka ahotefoɔ nyinaa mpaebɔ ho mmɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ sika afɔrebukyia a ɛsi ahennwa no anim no so.
Na nduhwam no wisie firii ɔbɔfoɔ no nsam kaa ahotefoɔ no mpaebɔ ho foro kɔɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ no faa aduhwam kuruwa no de afɔrebukyia no so gya no bi hyɛɛ no ma, na ɔto guu asase so. Na aprannaa ne nne ahodoɔ ne anyinam ne asasewosoɔ baeɛ.
Enti abɔfoɔ nson a wɔkurakura ntotorobɛnto nson no siesiee wɔn ho sɛ wɔrebɛhyɛne.

Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔdi kan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na asukɔtweaa ne egya a ɛne mogya adi afra baeɛ, na wɔto guu asase so; na asase nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako hyeeɛ, na nnua nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako hyeeɛ, na wura mono nyinaa nso hyeeɛ. Totorobɛnto a ɛtɔ so mmienu
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na wɔtoo biribi te sɛ bepɔ kɛseɛ a egya ɛrehyeɛ too po mu. Na ɛpo no nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako danee mogya;
na ɛpo mu abɔdeɛ a ɛwɔ nkwa nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako wuwuiɛ, na ɛpo ahyɛn nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako nso sɛeeɛ. Totorobɛnto a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na nsoromma kɛseɛ bi a ɛredɛre te sɛ ogyatɛnee firi soro bɛhwee fam, na ɛhwee nsubɔntene nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ne nsutire so.
Na nsoromma no din de Ɔnwono. Na nsuo no nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako danee ɔnwono, na nsuo no maa nnipa pii wuwuiɛ ɛfiri sɛ na ayɛ nwono.

Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na awia nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ne bosome nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ne nsoromma nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako ho kaeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na emu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛduru sum na adekyeeɛ nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako anhyerɛn na anadwo nso saa ara.
Na mehunuiɛ, na metee sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ bi a watu nam wiem de nne kɛseɛ reka sɛ: “Monnue, monnue, monnue, mo a mote asase soɔ, ntotorobɛnto a aka a abɔfoɔ mmiɛnsa no rebɛhyɛne no nnyegyeeɛ nti!”
9: Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnum no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na mehunuu nsoromma bi a ɛfiri soro abɛhwe asase so, na wɔde ebunu abura ano safoa maa no.
Na ɔbuee ebunu abura no ano, na wisie firii mu baa te sɛ fononoo kɛseɛ mu wisie, na owia ne ahunum duruu sum, abura no mu wisie no nti.
Na ntutummɛ firii wisie no mu baa asase so; na wɔmaa wɔn tumi a ɛte sɛ tumi a asase so nyanyankyerɛ wɔ no ara bi.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnka asase so wura anaa ahahammono anaa dua biara, na mmom gye nnipa a wɔnni Onyankopɔn nsɔano wɔn moma soɔ no nko ara.
Na wɔmaa ntutummɛ no kwan sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ abosome nnum, na mmom wɔnnku wɔn, na ayayadeɛ a ɛbaa wɔn soɔ no te sɛ ayayadeɛ a obi hunu berɛ a nyanyankyerɛ aka no no.
Na nna no mu no, nnipa bɛhwehwɛ owuo, na wɔrennya, wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔwuo, nanso owuo bɛdwane afiri wɔn nkyɛn.
Na ntutummɛ no suban te sɛ apɔnkɔ a wɔasiesie wɔn ama ɛko; na biribi wowɔ wɔn tiri so te sɛ sika abotire, na wɔn anim te sɛ nnipa anim.
Na wɔwowɔ tiri nwi te sɛ mmaa nwi. Na wɔn se te sɛ gyata se.
Na wɔwowɔ nkataboɔ te sɛ dadeɛ nkataboɔ, na wɔn ntaban mu gyegyeegye te sɛ apɔnkɔ bebree a wɔrekɔ ɔsa nteaseɛnam deɛ.
Na wɔwowɔ dua te sɛ anyanyankyerɛ, na nwowɔeɛ wowɔ wɔn dua mu, na wɔn dua mu na wɔn tumi a wɔde bɛha nnipa abosome nnum no wɔ.
Na wɔwɔ ɔhene a ɔdi wɔn so a ɔne bunu no bɔfoɔ no. Ne din wɔ Hebri kasa mu ne Abadon, na Hela kasa mu no, ne din de Apolion.
Mmusuo baako atwam. Hwɛ! Mmusuo mmienu reba yeinom akyi.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nsia no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na metee nne bi firii sika afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn anim no mmɛn nnan no mu,
sɛ ɛreka kyerɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nsia a ɔkura totorobɛnto no sɛ: “Sanesane abɔfoɔ nnan a wɔakyekyere wɔn asubɔnten kɛseɛ Eufrate ho no.”
Na wɔsanesanee abɔfoɔ nnan a wɔasiesie wɔn ama ɛdɔn ne ɛda ne bosome ne afe no sɛ wɔnkunkum nnipa mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako.
Na apɔnkɔsotefoɔ no dodoɔ si ɔpedu ahodoɔ ɔpeduonu: Metee wɔn dodoɔ a wɔyɛ.

Na sɛdeɛ mehunuu apɔnkɔ no ne wɔn a wɔtete wɔn so wɔ anisoadehunu no mu nie: na apɔnkɔsotefoɔ no wɔwɔ ogya ne afasebire ne sɔfe nkataboɔ; na apɔnkɔ no ti te sɛ agyata ti, na ogya ne wisie ne sɔfe firi wɔn anom.
Wɔnam ɔhaw mmiɛnsa yi so de ogya ne wisie ne sɔfe a ɛfifirii wɔn anomu no so kunkumm nnipa nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako.
Na apɔnkɔ no anom ne wɔn dua mu na wɔn tumi wɔ; na wɔn dua te sɛ awɔ a wɔn ti tua soɔ, na ɛno na wɔnam so de ɔhaw ba.

Nanso nnipa a aka a ɔhaw no ankunkum wɔn no ansakra wɔn adwene amfiri wɔn nsa ano nnwuma ho, sɛ wɔrensɔre ahonhommɔne (adaemone) ne sika ne dwetɛ ne kɔbere ne aboɔ ne dua ahoni a ɛntumi nhunu adeɛ, nte asɛm, na ɛntumi nnanteɛ nso.
Na wɔansakra wɔn adwene amfiri wɔn awudie ne wɔn adutoɔ ne wɔn adwamammɔ ne wɔn korɔno ho.
10: Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ foforɔ sɛ ɔresiane firi soro a ɔfira mununkum na nyankontɔn wɔ ne tiri so, na n’anim te sɛ owia, na ne nan te sɛ ogya fadum.
Na ɔkura nwoma mmobɔeɛ ketewa bi a emu abue wɔ ne nsam. Na ɔde ne nan nifa sii po so, na ɔde benkum no sii asase so,
na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam sɛdeɛ gyata bobɔ mu. Na berɛ a ɔteaam no, aprannaa nson no de wɔn nne kasaeɛ.
Afei berɛ a aprannaa nson no kasaeɛ no, meyɛɛ sɛ meretwerɛ; nanso metee nne bi firii soro sɛ: “Sɔ nsɛm a aprannaa nson no kaeɛ no ano, na ntwerɛ.”
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a mehunuu no sɛ ɔgyina ɛpo ne asase soɔ no maa ne nsa nifa so kɔɔ soro,
na ɔkaa Deɛ ɔte ase daa daa a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne deɛ ɛwom ne asase ne deɛ ɛwom ne ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwom no ho ntam sɛ: Berɛ bi nni hɔ bio: “Ɔrentwentwɛn nneɛma ase bio;
na mmom nna a ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no bɛhyɛne totorobɛnto no, na wɔawie Onyankopɔn ahuntasɛm kronkron no, sɛdeɛ ɔkaa ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ ne nkoa, adiyifoɔ no.”
Ɛnna ɛnne a mete firii soro no ne me kasaa bio sɛ: “Kɔ kɔgye nwoma a wɔabue mu a ɛwɔ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔgyina ɛpo ne asase so nsam no.”
Na mekɔɔ ɔbɔfoɔ no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa nwoma ketewa no mma me. Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Gye na di, na ɛbɛyɛ nwono wɔ wo yam, nanso w’anom deɛ, ɛbɛyɛ fremfrem sɛ ɛwoɔ.”
Ɛnna megyee nwoma ketewa no firii ɔbɔfoɔ no nsam diiɛ, na ɛyɛɛ fremfrem sɛ ɛwoɔ wɔ m’anom; nanso medi wieeɛ no, ɛyɛɛ nwononwono wɔ me yam.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Ɛsɛ sɛ woka nkurɔfoɔ ne aman ne ɔkasa ne ahemfo bebree ho adiyisɛm bio.”
11: Afei wɔde demmire bi a ɛte sɛ poma maa me, na ɔkaa sɛ: “Sɔre susu Onyankopɔn asɔredan no ne afɔrebukyia ne wɔn a wɔsɔre wɔ mu no.
Na adihɔ a ɛwɔ asɔredan no ho no deɛ, gya to hɔ, na nsusu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde ama amanaman mufoɔ, na wɔbɛtiatia kuro kronkron no so abosome aduanan mmienu.
Na mɛma m’adansefoɔ mmienu afira atweaatam (ayitoma) ahyɛ nkɔm nna apem ahanu aduosia (1,260).” Onyankopɔn adansefoɔ baanu
Yeinom ne ngodua mmienu ne nkaneadua mmienu a ɛgyinagyina asase Wura no anim no.
Na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn a, egya firi wɔn anom bɛhye wɔn atamfo; na sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔha wɔn a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔku no saa kwan yi so.
Yeinom wɔ tumi sɛ wɔto ɔsoro mu na nsuo antɔ wɔ nna a wɔde hyɛ nkɔm no mu, na wɔwɔ tumi wɔ nsuo so sɛ wɔma ɛdane mogya na wɔde ɔhaw nyinaa bi ba asase berɛ dodoɔ biara a wɔpɛ.
Na sɛ wɔwie wɔn adansedie no a, akekaboa a ɔfiri ebunu no mu no bɛtu wɔn so sa, na wadi wɔn so nkonim na waku wɔn.
Na wɔn afunu bɛdeda kuro kɛseɛ no abɔntene so, deɛ honhom mu no wɔfrɛ no Sodom ne Egypt, baabi a wɔbɔɔ wɔn Awurade nso asɛnnua mu no.
Na nkurɔfoɔ ne mmusuakuo ne kasa hodoɔ ne aman mu binom bɛhwɛ wɔn afunu nnansa ne fa, na wɔremma wɔmfa wɔn afunu no ntoto ɛda mu.
Na wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ ani bɛgye wɔn ho, na wɔn bo atɔ wɔn yamu, na wɔamanemane wɔn ho akyɛdeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ adiyifoɔ mmienu yi teetee wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ.
Na nnansa ne fa no akyi no, nkwa honhom firi Onyankopɔn hɔ bɛhyɛɛ wɔn mu, na wɔsɔre gyinaa wɔn nan so, na ehu kɛseɛ kaa wɔn a wɔhunuu wɔn no.
Na wɔtee nne kɛseɛ bi firii soro a ɛka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: “Momforo mmra ha.” Na wɔforo kɔɔ soro wɔ mununkum mu, na wɔn atamfo hunuu wɔn.
Na saa dɔn no ara mu asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ bi siiɛ, na kuro no mu nkyɛmu du mu baako hwee ase, na asasewosoɔ no kunkum nnipa mpem nson, na wɔn a aka no bɔɔ hu, na wɔhyɛɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn animuonyam.
Mmusuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no atwam. Hwɛ! Mmusuo a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no reba ntɛm.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no hyɛnee ne totorobɛnto no. Na nne akɛseɛ gyegyee soro sɛ: “Wiase ahennie ayɛ yɛn Awurade ne ne Kristo no dea, na ɔbɛdi hene daa daa.”
Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan a wɔtete wɔn nhennwa so wɔ Onyankopɔn anim no de wɔn anim butubutuu fam, koto sɔree Onyankopɔn,
kaa sɛ: “Yɛda wo ase, O Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ, wo a na wowɔ hɔ dada, na woda so wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ woafa wo tumi kɛseɛ no na woadi hene.

Nanso amanaman no bo fuiɛ, na w’abufuo ne awufoɔ berɛ no aduru sɛ wobɛbu atɛn, na wode akatua ama wo nkoa adiyifoɔ ne ahotefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔsuro wo din, nketewa ne akɛseɛ, na woasɛe wɔn a wɔasɛe asase no.”
Na wɔbuee Onyankopɔn asɔredan no ɔsoro, na wɔhunuu n’apam adaka no wɔ n’asɔredan no mu. Na anyinam ne nne ne aprannaa ne asasewosoɔ ne asukɔtweaa kɛseɛ bi baeɛ.
12: Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kɛseɛ bi yii ne ho adi ɔsoro. Ɔbaa bi a ɔfira owia, na ɔsrane wɔ ne nan aseɛ, na nsoromma dummienu abotire bobɔ ne ti,
na wafa afuro, na ɔretea mu reko awoɔ, na awoɔ aden no.
Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ foforɔ yii ne ho adi wɔ ɔsoro, na hwɛ, ɔtweaseɛ kakraka kɔkɔɔ a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn du, na ahemmotire nson bobɔ ne ti.
Na ɔde ne dua twee ɔsoro nsoromma nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako to guu asase so. Na ɔtweaseɛ no bɛgyinaa ɔbaa a ɔrebɛwoɔ no anim, na sɛ ɔwo a, wamene ne Ba no.
Na ɔwoo ɔbabanin a ɔde dadeɛ poma rebɛyɛne amanaman nyinaa. Na wɔhwim ne Ba no kɔɔ Onyankopɔn nkyɛn wɔ n’ahennwa ho.
Na ɔbaa no dwane kɔɔ serɛ so, faako a Onyankopɔn asiesie baabi ama no sɛ wɔmma no aduane nna apem ahanu aduosia (1,260). Wɔto ɔtweaseɛ no twene asase so
Na ɛko baa soro: Mikael ne n’abɔfoɔ tuu ɔtweaseɛ no so sa ne no koeɛ. Na ɔtweaseɛ no ne n’abɔfoɔ nso koeɛ,
nanso wɔantumi wɔn, na wɔannya tenabea ɔsoro bio.

Enti wɔtoo ɔtweaseɛ kɛseɛ no tweneeɛ, ɔwɔ dada no, deɛ wɔfrɛ no ɔbonsam ne satan, deɛ ɔdaadaa amanaman nyinaa no; wɔtoo no twenee asase so, na wɔtoo n’abɔfoɔ kaa ne ho guiɛ. Kristo ne ne manfoɔ nkonimdie

Na metee nne kɛseɛ bi wɔ ɔsoro sɛ: “Afei nkwagyeɛ ne tumi ne ahennie ayɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea, na tumi ayɛ ne Kristo no dea, ɛfiri sɛ wɔato yɛn nuanom anototofoɔ no atwene; ɔno na ɔtoto wɔn ano yɛn Nyankopɔn anim awia ne anadwo.
Na wɔnam Adwammaa no mogya ne wɔn adanseɛ asɛm no so dii ne so nkonim, na wɔannɔ wɔn kra de kɔsii owuo mu.
Yei nti, O ɔsoro ne mo a motete mu, momma mo ani nnye! Asase ne ɛpo nnue, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbonsam asiane aba mo nkyɛn na ne bo afu dendeenden, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnim sɛ ne berɛ a ɔwɔ yɛ tia.”
Afei berɛ a ɔtweaseɛ no hunuu sɛ wɔato no atwene asase soɔ no, ɔtaa ɔbaa a ɔwoo ɔbabanin no.
Nanso wɔde ɔkɔdeɛ kɛseɛ ntaban mmienu no maa ɔbaa no sɛ ɔmfa ntu nkɔ ne tenabea wɔ serɛ so; ɛhɔ na wɔmaa no aduane ɛberɛ ne mmerɛ ne berɛ fa firii ɔwɔ no anim.
Enti ɔwɔ no puu nsuo te sɛ asubɔnten firii n’anom dii ɔbaa no akyi sɛ asubɔnten no mfa no.
Nanso asase boaa ɔbaa no, na asase buee n’anom menee asubɔnten a ɔwɔ no pu firii n’anom no.
Ɛnna ɔtweaseɛ no bo fuu ɔbaa no pii, na ɔkɔtuu n’asefoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔdi Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ soɔ na wɔkura Yesu Kristo adanseɛ no so sa.
13: Na mekɔgyinaa mpoano anwea so. Na mehunuu aboa bi a ɔwɔ mmɛn du ne tire nson sɛ ɔfiri po mu repue, na ahemmotire du bobɔ ne mmɛn ho, na abusudin nso wowɔ ne tiri ho.
Na aboa a mehunuu no no te sɛ ɔsebɔ, na ne nan te sɛ sisire nan, na n’ano te sɛ gyata ano. Na ɔtweaseɛ no de n’ahoɔden ne n’ahennwa ne ne tumi kɛseɛ maa aboa no.
Na mehunuu sɛ ne tire no mu baako te sɛdeɛ wɔabɔ no bɔtorɔ, na wɔsaa ne pirakuro no. Na aboa no ho yɛɛ wiasefoɔ nyinaa nwanwa maa wɔdii n’akyi.
Enti wɔkoto sɔree ɔtweaseɛ no sɛ ɔde ne tumi ama aboa no, na wɔkoto sɔree aboa no kaa sɛ: “Hwan na ɔte sɛ aboa no, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi ne no ako?”
Na wɔmaa no ano a ɔde kaa nsɛm akɛseɛ ne abususɛm, na wɔmaa no tumi a ɔde bɛyɛ adwuma abosome aduanan mmienu.
Na ɔbuee n’ano kaa abususɛm tiaa Onyankopɔn, de tiaa ne din ne ne ntomadan, ne wɔn a wɔtete soro no.
Na wɔmaa no kwan sɛ ɔntu ahotefoɔ so sa, na ɔnni wɔn so nkonim. Na wɔmaa no mmusuakuo ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa ahodoɔ ne aman nyinaa so tumi.
Na wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ nyinaa bɛkoto no, wɔn a wɔamfiri wiase asehyɛ antwerɛ wɔn din Adwammaa a wɔkumm no no nkwa nwoma mu no.
Sɛ obi wɔ aso a, ma no ntie.
Sɛ obi fa nnommum a, wɔbɛfa no dommum. Sɛ obi de nkrantɛ kum a, ɛtwa sɛ wɔde nkrantɛ ku no. Ɛha na ahotefoɔ boasetɔ ne gyidie wɔ.
Na mehunuu aboa foforɔ sɛ ɔfiri asase mu repue, na na ɔwɔ mmɛn mmienu sɛ adwammaa, na ɔkasaa sɛ ɔtweaseɛ.
Na ɔyɛ aboa a ɔdi kan no ahoɔdenneɛ nyinaa wɔ n’anim. Na ɔma asase ne wɔn a wɔtete soɔ no koto sɔre aboa a ɔdi kan a wɔsaa ne pirakuro no.
Na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne akɛseɛ, na ɔma ogya mpo firi soro ba asase so, nnipa anim.
Na ɛsiane nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde maa no sɛ ɔnyɛ no aboa no anim nti, ɔdaadaa wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ no ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ ohoni mma aboa a nkrantɛ piraa no na ɔte ase bio no.
Na wɔmaa no kwan sɛ ɔmfa home mma aboa no honi no, na ama aboa no honi no akasa na wama wɔakum wɔn a wɔnkoto nsɔre aboa no honi no nyinaa.
Na ɔma obiara, nketewa ne akɛseɛ, adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ, adehyeɛ ne nkoa, nyinaa pene ma wɔhyɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ, wɔn nsa nifa anaa wɔn moma so,
na obiara ntumi ntɔ anaa ɔntɔn gye deɛ ɔwɔ agyiraeɛ no bie, anaa aboa no din, anaa ne din akonta ntwerɛeɛ nko.
Ɛha na nyansa wɔ: Ma deɛ ɔwɔ adwene mmu aboa no akonta nto ano, na ɛyɛ onipa akonta ntoano; na n’akonta ntoano yɛ ahansia aduosia nsia (666).
14: Na mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ! Adwammaa no gyina Sion Bepɔ so, na mpem ɔha aduanan nnan (144,000) a wɔatwerɛtwerɛ n’Agya din wɔn moma soɔ no ka ne ho.
Na metee nne bi firii soro, sɛ nsuo bebree a ɛreworo soɔ ne aprannaa a ano yɛ den nne. Na ɛnne a meteeɛ no te sɛ sankubɔfoɔ a wɔrebɔ wɔn asankuo dwontoɔ.
Na wɔtoo dwom foforɔ bi, ahennwa ne ateasefoɔ baanan ne mpanimfoɔ no anim; na obiara antumi ansua saa dwom no gye mpem ɔha aduanan nnan a wɔatɔ wɔn afiri asase soɔ no nko.
Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔamfa mmaa angu wɔn ho fi; na wɔyɛ mmabunu. Yeinom na wɔdi Adwammaa no akyi baabiara a ɔkorɔ. Yeinom na wɔtɔɔ wɔn firii nnipa mu sɛ aba a ɛdi kan maa Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no,
na wɔanhunu atorɔ biara wɔ wɔn anom; na wɔnni dɛm nso, Onyankopɔn ahennwa no anim.
Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a watu nam soro mfimfini a ɔkura daa asɛmpa a ɔrekɔka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ, aman ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa,
na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: “Monsuro Onyankopɔn na monhyɛ no animuonyam, ɛfiri sɛ n’atemmuo dɔn aduru, enti monkoto nsɔre Deɛ ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase ne ɛpo ne nsutire no.”
Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ, a ɔtɔ so mmienu, dii akyire kaa sɛ: “Wahwe ase oo! Babilon Kɛseɛ no ahwe ase, ɛfiri sɛ wama amanaman nyinaa anom n’adwamammɔ abufuo nsa no bi!”
Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa, dii wɔn akyi, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ kaa sɛ: “Sɛ obi koto sɔre aboa no ne ne honi no na ɔgye n'agyiraeɛ wɔ ne moma so anaa ne nsa ho a,
ɔno nso bɛnom Onyankopɔn abufuo nsa a wɔahwie no gyenegyene agu n’abufuo kuruwa mu no nso bi, na wɔbɛyɛ no ayayadeɛ wɔ ogya ne sɔfe mu wɔ abɔfoɔ kronkron no ne Adwammaa no anim.
Na wɔn ayayadeɛ wisie bɛforo soro daa daa, na wɔnnya home biara awia ne anadwo, wɔn a wɔbɛkoto asɔre aboa no ne ne honi no, ne obiara a ɔbɛgye ne din agyiraeɛ no bie no.
Ɛha na ahotefoɔ boasetɔ wɔ, wɔn a wɔkura Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne Yesu gyidie mu no.”
Na metee nne bi firii soro sɛ: “Twerɛ sɛ: Nhyira ne awufoɔ a wɔwu Awurade mu firi saa berɛ yi rekorɔ. Honhom no se: Aane, wɔbɛhome afiri wɔn brɛ no mu; na wɔn nnwuma di wɔn akyi.”
Na mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ! mununkum fitaa bi nie, na Obi a ɔte sɛ onipa ba te mununkum no so a ɔbɔ sika abotire wɔ ne ti na ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnam wɔ ne nsam.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firi asɔredan no mu baeɛ, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam ka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔte mununkum no soɔ no sɛ: “To wo kantankrankyi na twitwa, ɛfiri sɛ twaberɛ adu, na asase so nneɛma abere.”
Enti deɛ ɔte mununkum no soɔ no de ne kantankrankyi no too asase so na wɔtwaa asase so nneɛma.
Afei ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bio firi asɔredan a ɛwɔ soro no mu baeɛ, na ɔno nso kura kantankrankyi nnamnam.

Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ bio firi afɔrebukyia no mu baeɛ a ɔwɔ ogya so tumi. Na ɔteaam ka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnam no sɛ: “To wo kantankrankyi nnamnam no na twitwa asase so bobe asiasia no boaboa ano, ɛfiri sɛ n’aba no abere.”
Enti ɔbɔfoɔ no de ne kantankrankyi no too asase so, na ɔtwitwaa asase so bobe aba boaboaa ano, na ɔto guu Onyankopɔn abufuo nsa-kyi-amena kɛseɛ no mu.
Na wɔtiatiaa nsa-kyi-amena no so wɔ kuro no akyi, na mogya firii nsa-kyi-amena no mu kɔduruu apɔnkɔ nnareka ho, tenee nkwansimma apem ahansia.
15: Na mehunuu sɛnkyerɛnne foforɔ kɛseɛ bi a ɛyɛ nwanwa wɔ soro: Abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura ɔhaw mmusuo nson a ɛtwa toɔ a emu na wɔwie Onyankopɔn abufuo no. Wɔn a wɔagye wɔn anigyeɛ nnwom
Na mehunuu biribi a ɛte sɛ ahwehwɛ po a egya fra mu. Na wɔn a wɔdii aboa no, ne ne honi, ne ne din akontahyɛdeɛ ho nkonim no gyinagyina ahwehwɛ po no ano kurakura Nyankopɔn nsankuo.
Na wɔreto Onyankopɔn akoa Mose dwom ne Adwammaa no dwom sɛ: “Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ, wo nnwuma yɛ akɛseɛ na ɛyɛ nwanwa. Amanaman Hene, w’akwan tene na ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
O Awurade, hwan na ɔrensuro woɔ na ɔnhyɛ wo din animuonyam? Ɛfiri sɛ wo nko na woyɛ kronkron. Na amanaman nyinaa bɛba abɛkoto w’anim, ɛfiri sɛ w’atɛn tenenee ada adi.”
Na yeinom akyi no mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na wɔbuee adanseɛ ntomadan no asɔredan no wɔ soro.
Na abɔfoɔ nson a wɔkurakura ɔhaw nson no pue firii asɔredan no mu baeɛ a wɔhyehyɛ nwera fitafitaa a ɛhran, na wɔde sika abɔsoɔ abobɔ wɔn koko so.
Na ateasefoɔ baanan no mu baako maa abɔfoɔ baason no sika nkuruwa nson a wɔde Nyankopɔn a ɔte ase daa daa no abufuo ahyɛ mu mama.
Na Onyankopɔn animuonyam ne ne tumi nti, wisie hyɛɛ asɔredan no ma, na obiara antumi ankɔ asɔredan no mu kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee abɔfoɔ baason no haw mmusuo nson no ansa.
16: Na metee nne kɛseɛ bi a ɛfiri asɔredan no mu reka kyerɛ abɔfoɔ baason no sɛ: “Monkɔhwie Onyankopɔn abufuo nkuruwa nson no ngu asase so.”
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔdi kan no kɔeɛ, na ɔkɔhwiee ne kuruwa no guu asase so. Na nkudaa (akuro) bɔne a ɛtutuo baa nnipa a wɔwɔ aboa no agyiraeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkoto sɔree ne honi no so.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu ɛpo mu. Na ɛdanee sɛ owufoɔ mogya, na akra a ɛte aseɛ ɛpo mu nyinaa wuwuiɛ.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu nsubɔnten ne nsutire mu. Na ɛdanee mogya.
Na metee sɛ nsuo so bɔfoɔ no reka sɛ: “Woyɛ kronkron, O Awurade, wo a wowɔ hɔ, na wowɔ hɔ dada, na woreba; ɛfiri sɛ woabu atɛn saa.
Na wɔahwie ahotefoɔ ne adiyifoɔ mogya agu, na woama wɔn mogya anom. Wɔfata saa.”
Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi firi afɔrebukyia no mu reka sɛ: “Aane, Awurade Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ, w’atemmuo yɛ nokorɛ na ɛtene.”
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu awia so; na wɔmaa awia tumi sɛ ɔmfa egya nhyehye nnipa.
Na ɔhyew a ano yɛ den hyehyee nnipa, nanso wɔkaa Onyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ɔhaw yi so tumi no din ho abususɛm, na wɔansakra wɔn adwene anhyɛ no animuonyam.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnum no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu aboa no ahennwa so. Na n’ahennie duruu sum, na yea no nti wɔfirii aseɛ kekaa wɔn kɛtrɛma,
na wɔkaa ɔsoro Nyankopɔn ho abususɛm ɛsiane wɔn yea ne wɔn nkudaa no nti, na wɔansakra wɔn adwene amfiri wɔn nnwuma ho.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nsia no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu asubɔnten kɛseɛ Eufrate mu, na emu nsuo weeɛ, na ama wɔasiesie kwan ama ahemfo a wɔfiri awia apueeɛ nohoa.
Na mehunuu ahonhom fi mmiɛnsa a wɔte sɛ mponkyerɛne, sɛ wɔfiri ɔtweaseɛ no anomu ne aboa no anomu ne adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ no anomu.
Na wɔyɛ ahonhommɔne ahonhom a wɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na wɔfiri kɔ wiase nyinaa ahemfo nkyɛn kɔboaboa wɔn ano ma Onyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, da kɛseɛ no mu ko no.
“Hwɛ, mereba sɛ owifoɔ. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔwɛn na ɔhwɛ ne ntadeɛ soɔ, na wannante adagya mu, na wɔanhunu n'aniwuo.”
Na wɔboaboaa wɔn no ano kɔɔ baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Hebri kasa mu sɛ Harmagedon.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no hwiee ne kuruwa no guu mframa mu. Na ɛnne kɛseɛ bi firi asɔredan no mu, firii ahennwa no mu, sɛ: “Wɔawie!”
Na anyinam ne ɛnne ne aprannaa baeɛ, na asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ bi a ɛfiri berɛ a nnipa baa asase so ebi nsii saa da baeɛ, asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu.
Na kuro kɛseɛ no mu paepaee mmiɛnsa, na amanaman no nkuro no hwehwee ase; na wɔkaee Babilon Kɛseɛ no Onyankopɔn anim, sɛ wɔbɛma no n’abufuo a emu yɛ den no nsa kuruwa.
Afei nso nsupɔ nyinaa dwanedwanee, na wɔanhunu mmepɔ biara bio.

Na asukɔtweaa akɛseɛ a emu biara mu duro bɛyɛ sɛ dwetikɛseɛ baako firi soro bɛhwehwee nnipa so, na ɛsiane ɔhaw a asukɔtweaa no de baeɛ nti, nnipa kaa Onyankopɔn ho abususɛm, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔhaw no so kɛse.
17: Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura nkuruwa nson no mu baako bae ne me bɛkasaa sɛ: “Bra ma menkyerɛ wo odwamanfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔte nsuo pii soɔ no atemmuo;
ɔno na wiase ahemfo ne no abɔ adwaman, na n’adwamammɔ nsa no abobo wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ no.” Ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ ho anisoadehunu
Na ɔde me nam honhom mu kɔɔ ɛserɛ so. Na mehunuu ɔbaa bi a ɔte aboa kɔkɔɔ a abususɛm din ahyɛ no ma, na ɔwɔ tiri nson ne mmɛn du so.
Na ɔbaa no hyɛ atadeɛ afasebire ne nkrawoɔ (atade kɔkɔɔ), na ɔde sika kɔkɔɔ ne aboɔden aboɔ ne nhwene pa ahyehyɛ ne ho, na ɔkura sika kuruwa a akyiwadeɛ ne n’adwamammɔ fi ayɛ no ma wɔ ne nsam.
Na wɔatwerɛ din bi wɔ ne moma so sɛ: “AHUNTASƐM, BABILON KƐSEƐ NO, ASASE SO NNWAMANFOƆ NE AKYIWADEƐ NA.”
Na mehunuu sɛ ahotefoɔ mogya ne Yesu adansefoɔ mogya aboro ɔbaa no, na mehunuu no no, ɛyɛɛ me nwanwa kɛse.
Enti ɔbɔfoɔ no bisaa me sɛ: “Adɛn nti na ayɛ wo nwanwa? Mɛka ɔbaa no ne aboa a ɔbaa no te ne so a ɔwɔ tire nson ne mmɛn du no ho ahuntasɛm akyerɛ wo:

Aboa a wohunuu no no, da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ, nanso afei ɔnni hɔ, na ɔbɛfiri bunu no mu apue, na wabɛsene akɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu. Na ɛbɛyɛ wɔn a wɔtete asase soɔ a wɔamfiri wiase ahyɛaseɛ antwerɛ wɔn din nkwa nwoma mu no nwanwa sɛ wɔbɛhunu aboa no, sɛ da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ, na afei deɛ, ɔnni hɔ, nanso ɔwɔ hɔ ara.
“Ɛha na adwene a nyansa wɔ mu no wɔ. Etire nson no yɛ mmepɔ nson a ɔbaa no te soɔ.
Na wɔyɛ ahemfo nson: nnum ahwe ase, baako wɔ hɔ, ɔfoforɔ no nnya mmaeɛ, nanso sɛ ɔnya ba a, ɛtwa sɛ ɔtena hɔ kakraa bi.
Na aboa a da bi na ɔwɔ hɔ na afei deɛ ɔnni hɔ no, ɔno ara nso ne deɛ ɔtɔ so nwɔtwe, na ɔfiri nson no mu na ɛbaeɛ, na ɔrekɔ ɔsɛeɛ mu.
“Na mmɛn du a wohunuiɛ no yɛ ahemfo du a wɔnnya nnyaa ahennie, nanso wɔne aboa no bɛnya tumi sɛ ahemfo dɔnhwere baako.
Yeinom kura adwene korɔ, na wɔde wɔn tumi ne wɔn ahoɔden bɛma aboa no.
Yeinom ne Adwammaa no bɛko, na Adwammaa no bɛdi wɔn so nkonim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ awuranom mu Awurade ne ahemfo, mu Hene, — ɔno ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho a wɔafrɛ wɔn na wɔayi wɔn na wɔdi no nokorɛ no.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsuo a wohunuiɛ a odwamamfoɔ no te soɔ no yɛ nkuro ne nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo ne aman ne kasa ahodoɔ.
Na mmɛn du a wohunuiɛ no, ne aboa no, wɔn na wɔbɛtane odwamamfoɔ no, na wɔayɛ no pasaa, na wada adagya, na wɔadi ne nam, na wɔde ogya ahye no.
Na Onyankopɔn na ɔde hyɛɛ wɔn akomam sɛ wɔmma ne nsusuiɛ mmra mu, kyerɛ sɛ, wɔnyɛ adwenkorɔ mfa wɔn ahennie mma aboa no nkɔsi sɛ Onyankopɔn nsɛm bɛba mu.
Na ɔbaa a wohunuu no no ne kuro kɛseɛ a ɛdi asase so ahemfo so hene no.”
18: Na yeinom akyiri no, mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ sɛ ɔfiri soro resiane ba, na ɔwɔ tumi kɛseɛ, na n’animuonyam nti asase hyerɛnn.
Na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam sɛ: “Wahwe ase oo! Babilon kɛseɛ no ahwe ase, na adane ahonhommɔne tenabea ne ahonhom fi nyinaa atɛeɛ ne nnomaa a wɔyɛ fi na wɔkyiri wɔn nyinaa atɛeɛ!
Ɛfiri sɛ amanaman nyinaa anom n’adwamammɔ abufuo nsa no bi, na asase so ahemfo ne no abɔ adwaman, na asase so adwadifoɔ nam ne taamudie ahoɔden so anya wɔn ho.”
Na metee nne foforɔ firii soro sɛ: “Me man, momfiri ne mu, na moanyɛ ne nnebɔne no bi, na moannya ne haw no bi.
Ɛfiri sɛ ne nnebɔne atoatoa abɛduru soro, na Onyankopɔn akae n’amumuyɛ.
Montua no ka, sɛdeɛ ɔtuaa mo ka, na momfa mmɔ ho mmienu mma no, sɛdeɛ ne nnwuma teɛ. Kuruwa a ɔfraeɛ no, momfra mmu mmɔ ho mmienu mma no.
Dodoɔ a ɔhyɛɛ ne ho animuonyam na ɔdii taamu no, momma n’ayayadeɛ ne n’awerɛhoɔ nnɔɔso saa. Ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa no n’akoma mu sɛ: Mete hɔ sɛ ɔhemmaa, na menyɛ okunafoɔ, na merenni awerɛhoɔ da.
Yei nti na ne haw bɛba da koro pɛ, owuo ne awerɛhoɔ ne ɛkɔm, na wɔde ogya bɛhye no, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn a ɔbu no atɛn no yɛ ɔhoɔdenfoɔ. N'adɔfo awerɛhoɔ ne ɔsoro anigyeɛ
“Na asase so ahemfo a wɔne no bɔɔ adwaman na wɔdii taamu no, sɛ wɔhunu ne hyeɛ wisie no a, wɔbɛsu no, na wɔabobɔ ne ho abubuo.
N’aninyanneɛ no suro nti wɔbɛgyinagyina akyiri aka sɛ: Due, due, kuro kɛseɛ Babilon, kuro a ɛyɛ den, ɛfiri sɛ dɔnhwereɛ baako mu na w’atemmuo aba.
“Na asase so adwadifoɔ bɛsu no na wɔagyam no, ɛfiri sɛ obi ntɔ wɔn adwadeɛ bio:

adwadeɛ a ɛyɛ sika kɔkɔɔ, dwetɛ, aboɔden aboɔ, nhwene pa, nwera pa, ntoma afasebire, serekye ne nkrawoɔ adwadeɛ, ne nnua a ɛyɛ hwam nyinaa ne asommɛn adwinneɛ nyinaa ne adwinneɛ a wɔde nnua a ɛwɔ din, yaawa, dadeɛ, abohemmaa ayɛ nyinaa;
ne pɛprɛ (anoatre), mmorɔngo (India akakaduro), nnu hwamhwam ne ngohwam, esiam muhumuhu, bobesa, ngo, ayuo, anantwie, nnwan, apɔnkɔ, nteaseɛnam, nnipadua ne nnipa akra.
Na aduaba a wo kra kɔn dɔ no afiri wo nkyɛn, na nnepa ne animuonyanneɛ nyinaa afiri wo ho ayera, na worenhunu bio koraa.
“Nneɛma yi ho adwadifoɔ a ne nti wɔnyaa wɔn ho no bɛgyinagyina akyirikyiri ɛsiane sɛ wɔsuro n’ayayadeɛ no nti, na wɔasu na wɔagyam:
na wɔbɛka sɛ, Due, due, kuro kɛseɛ a ɔfira nwera pa ne ntoma afasebire ne nkrawoɔ, na ɔde sika ne aboɔden aboɔ ne nhwene pa ahyehyɛ ne ho!
Ɛfiri sɛ dɔnhwereɛ baako pɛ mu na saa ahonya no ayɛ pasaa yi. Na hyɛn akwankyerɛfoɔ nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔnam hyɛn mu kɔ baabi nyinaa, ne hyɛn mufoɔ ne dodoɔ a wɔyɛ ɛpo so adwuma gyinagyina akyiri,
na wɔhunuu ne hyeɛ wisie no, wɔteaa mu sɛ: Kuro bɛn na ɛte sɛ kuro kɛseɛ yi?

Na wɔde mfuturo guu wɔn atifi teaam, na wɔde osu ne gyam teaa mu sɛ: ‘Due, due, kuro kɛseɛ yi a n’aboɔdenneɛ nti wɔn a wɔwɔ hyɛn wɔ ɛpo soɔ nyinaa anyinya wɔn ho wɔ mu, ɛfiri sɛ dɔnhwereɛ baako pɛ mu na wɔayɛ no pasaa.’
“O ɔsoro ne mo ahotefoɔ ne asomafoɔ ne adiyifoɔ, momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam wɔ ne ho, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn abu no atɛn ama mo!”
Na ɔbɔfoɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi maa ɛboɔ a ɛte sɛ oyuyammoɔ kɛseɛ bi so to twenee ɛpo mu kaa sɛ: “Saa ara na wɔbɛto Babilon kuro kɛseɛ no hwii atwene, na wɔrenhu no bio koraa.
Na wɔrente asankubɔfoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ ne mmɛnhyɛnfoɔ ne totorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ nne wɔ wo mu bio, na wɔrenhunu adwinnie bi mu dwumfoɔ biara wɔ wo mu bio, na wɔrente oyuyammoɔ nnyegyeeɛ wɔ wo mu bio,

na kanea hann biara renhyerɛn wo mu bio, na wɔrente ayeforɔkunu ne ayeforɔ biara nne wɔ wo mu bio; ɛfiri sɛ w’adwadifoɔ na na wɔyɛ nnipa atitire wɔ asase so, na wonam w’adutoɔ so daadaa amanaman nyinaa.
Na ne mu na wɔhunuu adiyifoɔ ne ahotefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔakunkum wɔn asase soɔ nyinaa mogya.”
19: Yeinom akyi no, metee biribi te sɛ nnipakuo kɛseɛ bi nne a ano yɛ den wɔ ɔsoro sɛ: “Haleluia! Nkwagyeɛ ne animuonyam ne tumi yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea,
ɛfiri sɛ n’atemmuo yɛ nokorɛ na ɛtene. Na wabu odwamanfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔde n’adwamammɔ sɛee asase no atɛn, na watɔ ne nkoa mogya so werɛ wɔ ne nsam.”
Na wɔkaa bio sɛ: “Haleluia! Na ne wisie foro kɔ soro daa daa.”
Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan ne ateasefoɔ baanan no koto sɔree Onyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no sɛ: Amen, Haleluia!
Afei ɛnne bi firi ahennwa no mu baa sɛ: “Monyi yɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ, mo a moyɛ ne nkoa a mosuro no nyinaa, nketewa ne akɛseɛ.”
Na metee nne bi a ɛte sɛ nnipakuo kɛseɛ bi nne ne nsuo bebree nne ne aprannaa a ano yɛ den nnyegyeeɛ sɛ: “Haleluia, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no di hene.
Momma yɛn ani nnye, na yɛnni ahurisie, na yɛnhyɛ no animuonyam, ɛfiri sɛ Adwammaa no ayeforɔhyia aduru na ne yere asiesie ne ho.
Na wɔde nwera pa a ɛhoa fitaa, a ɛho teɛ maa no sɛ ɔmfira. Na nwera pa no ne ahotefoɔ tenenee.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Twerɛ: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn Adwammaa no ayeforɔhyia apontoɔ ase.” Bio nso, ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Nyankopɔn nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ nie.”

Na mehwee ne nan ase sɛ merekoto no. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Hwɛ yie! Nyɛ saa! Meyɛ w’awurakwaa ne wo nuanom a wɔkura Yesu adanseɛ no mu bi. Koto sɔre Onyankopɔn! Na Yesu adanseɛ ne adiyie honhom no.” Ogyefo no ho anisoadehu kɛse
Na mehunuu sɛ ɔsoro abue, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa bi nie, na Deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no, wɔfrɛ no Ɔseadeɛyɛ ne Ɔnokwafoɔ, na ɔbu atɛn, na ɔtu sa wɔ tenenee mu.
Na n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa, na ahemmotire bebree bobɔ ne ti. Ɔwɔ din bi a wɔatwerɛ a obiara nnim gye ɔno nko ara,
na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ bi a wɔde abɔ mogya mu, na ne din de: Onyankopɔn Asɛm.
Afei nso na asafodɔm a wɔwɔ soro no tete apɔnkɔ fitafitaa so di n’akyi hyehyɛ nwera pa fitaa a ɛho teɛ.
Na afena nnamnnam bi firi n’anomu a ɔde bɛbobɔ amanaman, na ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛyɛne wɔn. Na ɔno na ɔtiatia Onyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no, abufuo a ɛyɛ den no nsa-kyi-amena no soɔ.
Na ɔwɔ din bi a wɔatwerɛ agu n’atadeɛ mu wɔ ne srɛ so sɛ: AHENE MU HENE NE AWURANOM MU AWURADE.
Afei nso mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔgyina awia mu, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaam ka kyerɛɛ nnomaa a wɔtu fa wiem nyinaa sɛ: “Mommra mmɛhyia Onyankopɔn adidie kɛseɛ no ase,
na mommɛdi ahemfo nam, asafohene nam, atumfoɔ nam, apɔnkɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete wɔn soɔ nam, adehyeɛ ne nkoa, nketewa ne akɛseɛ nyinaa nam.”
Na mehunuu aboa no ne asase so ahemfo ne wɔn asafodɔm sɛ wɔaboaboa wɔn ano, ne Deɛ ɔte pɔnkɔ fitaa no soɔ no ne ne dɔm rebɛdi ako.

Na wɔkyeree aboa no ne odiyifoɔ torofoɔ no nso a ɔyɛɛ n’anim nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, de daadaa wɔn a wɔgyee aboa no agyiraeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkoto sɔree ne honi no kaa ne ho. Wɔtoo wɔn baanu yi animono guu ogya tadeɛ a sɔfe redɛre mu no mu.
Na wɔde Deɛ ɔte pɔnkɔ no soɔ afena a ɛfiri n’anomu no kunkumm wɔn a aka no, na nnomaa nyinaa dii wɔn nam mee.
20: Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔfiri soro resiane a ɔkura ebunu no ano safoa ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kɛseɛ bi.
Na ɔkyeree ɔtweaseɛ no, ɔwɔ dada a ɔne ɔbonsam ne satan no, kyekyeree no mfirinhyia apem,

na ɔtoo no twenee ebunu no mu, na ɔtoo mu, na ɔsɔɔ ano na wankɔdaadaa amanaman bio kɔsi sɛ mfirinhyia apem no bɛwie duro ansa; nanso ɛno akyiri no, ɛtwa sɛ wɔgyaa no kakra. Mogya adansefoɔ ne ahotefoɔ sɔre

Na mehunuu nhennwa bi, na wɔn a wɔtete soɔ no, wɔde atemmuo maa wɔn. Na mehunuu wɔn a Yesu adanseɛ ne Nyankopɔn asɛm nti wɔtwitwaa wɔn tire no akra, ne wɔn a wɔankoto asɔre aboa no anaa ne honi na wɔannye n'agyiraeɛ no wɔ wɔn moma so ne wɔn nsa ho no. Na wɔnyaa nkwa bio, na wɔne Kristo dii ahene mfirinhyia apem.
Nanso awufoɔ nkaeɛ no amma nkwa mu kɔsii sɛ mfeɛ apem no baa awieeɛ. Yei ne owusɔreɛ a ɛdi kan no.
Nhyira ne kronkron ne deɛ ɔnya kyɛfa owusɔreɛ a ɛdi kan no mu. Saafoɔ no so na owuprenu no nni tumi, na mmom wɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne Kristo asɔfoɔ, na wɔne no bɛdi ahene mfirinhyia apem.
Na sɛ mfirinhyia apem no wie duru a, wɔbɛsane satan afiri n’afiase,
na ɔbɛfiri adi akɔdaadaa amanaman a wɔwɔ asase afanan so, Gog ne Magog, akɔboaboa wɔn ano akɔ ɔsa, wɔn na wɔn ano dɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea.
Na wɔforo kɔgyinaa asase tɛtrɛtɛ no so, na wɔtwaa ahotefoɔ no ne kuro a wɔdɔ no no ho nsraban hyiaeɛ. Na egya firi soro bɛhyee wɔn.
Na ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa wɔn no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya ne sɔfe tadeɛ no mu, deɛ aboa no ne odiyifoɔ torofoɔ no wɔ, na wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ awia ne anadwo daa daa. Amansan nyinaa wusɔreɛ ne atemmuo
Na mehunuu ahennwa fitaa kokuroo bi ne Deɛ ɔte soɔ no, asase ne ɔsoro dwane firii n’anim; na wɔannya baabi amma wɔn.

Na mehunuu awufoɔ, nketewa ne akɛseɛ, sɛ wɔgyinagyina ahennwa no anim, na wɔbuebuee nwoma mu. Na wɔbuee nwoma foforɔ bi a ɛyɛ nkwa nwoma no mu, na wɔnam nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma no mu no so bubuu awufoɔ atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ.
Na ɛpo yii n’awufoɔ a ɛwɔ mu no mae, na owuo ne asamando yii awufoɔ a ɛwɔ mu no nso mae, na wɔbuu wɔn mu biara atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ.
Ɛnna wɔtoo owuo ne asamando twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu. Yei ne owuprenu no.
Na obiara a wɔanhu no sɛ wɔatwerɛ ne din wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu.
21: Na mehunuu ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ, na kane soro ne kane asase no atwam, na ɛpo nni hɔ bio.
Na me, Yohane, mehunuu kuro kronkron, Yerusalem Foforɔ no, sɛ ɛfiri Onyankopɔn nkyɛn wɔ ɔsoro resiane a wɔasiesie no sɛ ayeforɔ a wɔahyehyɛ no ama ne kunu.
Afei metee nne kɛseɛ bi firii ahennwa no mu a ɛse: “Hwɛ, Onyankopɔn ntomadan wɔ nnipa mu, na ɔne wɔn bɛtena na wɔayɛ ne man. Na Onyankopɔn no ara ne wɔn bɛtena, na wɔayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na Onyankopɔn bɛpepa wɔn aniwam nisuo nyinaa, na owuo nni hɔ bio, na awerɛhoɔ ne esu ne yea biara nso nni hɔ bio, ɛfiri sɛ kane nneɛma no atwam.”
Na Deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no kaa sɛ: “Hwɛ! Mereyɛ nneɛma nyinaa foforɔ.”  Na ɔsane ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Twerɛ, ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm yi wom, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ.”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Wɔawie! Mene Alfa ne Omega, mfitiaseɛ ne awieeɛ. Me na mede nkwa asutire mu nsuo bɛkyɛ obiara a sukɔm de no kwa.
Na obiara a ɔdi nkonim no bɛnya yeinom, na mɛyɛ ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔno nso ayɛ me ba.

Nanso ahufoɔ ne wɔn a wɔnnye nnie ne akyiwadeyɛfoɔ ne awudifoɔ ne nnwamammɔfoɔ ne adutofoɔ ne abosonsomfoɔ ne atorofoɔ nyinaa bɛnya wɔn kyɛfa wɔ ɔtadeɛ a egya ne sɔfe dɛre mu no mu. Yei ne owuprenu no.” Ɔsoro Yerusalem ne ayeforɔ
Na abɔfoɔ baason a wɔkurakura nkuruwa nson no a ɔhaw mmusuo nson a ɛdi akyire no ahyehyɛ mu mama no mu baako baa me nkyɛn, ne me bɛkasaa sɛ: “Bra na menkyerɛ wo ayeforɔ no, Adwammaa no yere no.”
Na ɔde me nam honhom mu kɔɔ bepɔ tentene kɛseɛ bi so, na ɔkyerɛɛ me kuro kronkron Yerusalem sɛ ɛfiri soro, Onyankopɔn nkyɛn, resiane,
na ɛkura Onyankopɔn animuonyam. Na ne hann te sɛ ɛboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den paa, te sɛ ahwehwɛboɔ a emu teɛ sɛ ahwehwɛ.
Na ɛwɔ ɔfasuo tentene kɛseɛ bi a ɛwɔ aponkɛseɛ dummienu, na abɔfoɔ dumienu gyinagyina apono no ano, apono no so na wɔatwerɛtwerɛ Israel mma mmusuakuo dumienu no din.
Na apono mmiɛnsa wɔ apueeɛ, apono mmiɛnsa wɔ atifi, apono mmiɛnsa wɔ anafoɔ, na apono mmiɛnsa wɔ atɔeɛ.
Na kuro no fasuo nso wɔ fapem dummienu a Adwammaa no asomafoɔ dummienu no din wowɔ soɔ.
Na deɛ ɔne me rekasa no kura sika susudua sɛ ɔde rebɛsusu kuro no ne n’apono ne ne fasuo no.
Na kuro no yɛ ahinanan, na ne tenten ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ nyinaa yɛ pɛ. Na ɔde susudua no susuu kuro no; na ɛyɛ nkwansimma mpem dumienu; na ne tenten, ne tɛtrɛtɛ, ne ne korɔn yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Afei ɔsusuu ne fasuo no, basafa ɔha aduanan nnan (144); sɛ onipa nsusuiɛ sɛdeɛ ɔbɔfoɔ deɛ no teɛ.
Na wɔde ahwehwɛboɔ na ɛtoo ɔfasuo no, na na kuro no yɛ sika amapa te sɛ ahwehwɛ kronkron a animu teɛ.

Na wɔde aboɔden aboɔ ahodoɔ nyinaa bi na ɛhyehyɛɛ kuro no fasuo no fapem: Fapem a ɛdi kan no yɛ ahwehwɛboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu no yɛ hoaboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no yɛ mununkumboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so nnan no yɛ ahahammonoboɔ,

deɛ ɛtɔ so nnum no yɛ ɛtɔnboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so nsia no yɛ bogyanamboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ sikabereɛboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no yɛ apopobibireboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so nkron no yɛ akraateboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so du no yɛ dɛnkyɛmmoɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so dubaako yɛ owisiboɔ, deɛ ɛtɔ so dumienu no yɛ beredumboɔ.
Na apono dumienu no nso yɛ nhwene pa dumienu; wɔde ahweneɛ baako na ɛyɛɛ apono no mu biara. Na kuro no abɔntene yɛ sika amapa, te sɛ ahwehwɛ a emu teɛ.
Na manhunu asɔredan biara wom, ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn, adeɛ nyinaa so Tumfoɔ, ne Adwammaa no ne n’asɔredan.
Na ɛnhia sɛ owia anaa ɔsrane bɛpae wɔ kuro no mu, ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn animuonyam hyerɛn wɔ mu, na ne kanea ne Adwammaa no.
Na amanaman a wɔanya nkwagyeɛ no bɛnante ne hann mu, na asase so ahemfo de wɔn animuonyam bɛba mu.
Na wɔrentoto n’apono mu awia, ɛfiri sɛ adeɛ rensa wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔde amanaman no animuonyam ne anidie bɛba mu.
Nanso ade hunu biara ne deɛ ɔyɛ akyiwadeɛ na ɔdi atorɔ renhyɛne mu koraa, gye wɔn a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din ahyɛ Adwammaa no nkwa nwoma no mu no nko ara.
22: Na ɔkyerɛɛ me nkwa nsuo asubɔnten a ani teɛ te sɛ ahwehwɛ a ɛsene firi Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no ahennwa no mu.
Kuro no abɔntene mfimfini ne asubɔntene no afanu nyinaa na nkwa dua a ɛso aba ahodoɔ dummienu sisie, na ɛsoso n’aba bosome biara. Na dua no ahahan na wɔde sa amanaman no yareɛ.
Na nnome biara remma bio. Na Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no ahennwa bɛsi kuro no mu, na ne nkoa bɛsom no;
na wɔbɛhunu n’anim, na ne din bɛwɔ wɔn moma so.
Na anadwo nni hɔ, na kanea anaa owia hann nhia wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn bɛhyerɛn wɔn so. Na wɔbɛdi ahene daa daa.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Nsɛm yi wom, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ; na Awurade, Nyankopɔn a ɔnam adiyifoɔ so kasaeɛ no somaa ne bɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ ne nkoa nneɛma a ɛtwa sɛ ɛba ntɛm.
Na hwɛ, mereba ntɛm. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔkura nwoma yi mu adiyisɛm mu.”
Na me, Yohane, ne deɛ ɔhunuu nneɛma yi na ɔteeɛ. Na meteeɛ na mehunuiɛ no, mehwee ase sɛ merekoto asɔre ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkyerɛɛ me nneɛma yi nan ase.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: “Hwɛ yie! Nyɛ saa! Meyɛ wo ne wo nuanom adiyifoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔkura nwoma yi mu nsɛm mu no awurakwaa. Koto sɔre Onyankopɔn!”
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsɔ nwoma yi mu adiyisɛm ano, na ɛberɛ no abɛn.
Deɛ ɔntene no nntene ara, na deɛ ɔyɛ fi no nyɛ fi ara. Na deɛ ɔtene no ntene ara, na deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron no nyɛ kronkron ara.
“‘Hwɛ, mereba ntɛm, na mekura m’akatua sɛ mede bɛma obiara sɛdeɛ n’adwuma teɛ.
Mene Alfa ne Omega, Ɔkannifoɔ ne Okyidifoɔ, Mfitiaseɛ ne Awieeɛ no.
Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔhoro wɔn ntadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔbɛnya nkwa dua no ho kwan, na wɔafa apono no ano akɔ kuro no mu.
Na kuro no akyiri na nkraman ne adutofoɔ ne nnwamammɔfoɔ ne awudifoɔ ne abosonsomfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ atorɔ na wɔdie nyinaa wɔ.
“‘Me, Yesu, na masoma me bɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛdi nneɛma yi ho adanseɛ asafo no mu. Mene Dawid nhini ne n’aseni, adekyeeɛ nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn no.’”
Na honhom no ne ayeforɔ no ka sɛ: “Bra!” Na deɛ ɔtie no nka sɛ: “Bra!” Na deɛ sukɔm de no mmra, na deɛ ɔpɛ no mmɛgye nkwa nsuo no kwa.
“Medi obiara a ɔte nwoma yi mu adiyie nsɛm no adanseɛ sɛ: Sɛ obi de biribi ka yeinom ho a, Onyankopɔn de ɔhaw ahodoɔ a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu no bɛka ne ho;
na sɛ obi yi adiyie nwoma yi mu nsɛm bi a, Onyankopɔn bɛyi ne kyɛfa afiri nkwa dua ne kuro kronkron a wɔatwerɛ ho nsɛm nwoma yi mu no mu.
“Deɛ ɔdi nneɛma yi ho adanseɛ no se, ‘Aane; mereba ntɛm.’” “Amen! Awurade Yesu, bra.”
Yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka mo nyinaa. Amen.

1: Paulo, Yesu Kristo akoa a wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ɔsomafoɔ, na wɔatu no asi hɔ ama Onyankopɔn asɛmpa no.
Asɛmpa yi na ɔnam n’adiyifoɔ so hyɛɛ ho bɔ siee Twerɛ kronkron no mu.
Wɔ ne ba a honam fam wɔwoo no Dawid aseni no ho,
nanso wɔde tumi daa no adi sɛ Onyankopɔn Ba wɔ Ahoteɛ Honhom fam, awufoɔ sɔreɛ mu; ɔno ne Yesu Kristo, yɛn Awurade.
Deɛ yɛnam ne so anya adom ne asomafodwuma sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ne din nti amanaman nyinaa bɛyɛ asoɔmmerɛ wɔ gyidie no mu.
Saa amanaman no mu na wɔafrɛ mo nso ama moabɛyɛ Yesu Kristo dea.
De kɔma Onyankopɔn adɔfo a wɔwɔ Roma a wɔafrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmɛyɛ ahotefoɔ nyinaa: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo. Kristofoɔ a wɔwɔ Roma ne Paulo
Deɛ ɛdi kan koraa no, menam Yesu Kristo so da me Nyankopɔn ase wɔ mo nyinaa mo ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔka mo gyidie ho asɛm wɔ wiase nyinaa.
Na Onyankopɔn a mede me honhom nyinaa som no a enti meka ne Ba no ho asɛmpa no ne me danseni sɛ mennyaee mo din bɔ da wɔ me mpaebɔ mu,
na mesrɛ sɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie na sɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ nko ara deɛ a, mɛnya hokwan aba mo nkyɛn,
ɛfiri sɛ m’ani agyina sɛ mɛhu mo, na mama mo honhom mu akyɛdeɛ bi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mo ase bɛtim;
ɛne sɛ ɛnam mo gyidie ne me deɛ so, yɛn nyinaa obiara bɛnya nkuranhyɛ afiri ne yɔnko hɔ.
Nanso anuanom, mempɛ sɛ mede bɛsie mo sɛ mabɔ me tirim mprɛ pii sɛ mɛba mo nkyɛn na mabɛnya aba wɔ mo mu sɛdeɛ menyaa no aman a aka mu no, nanso ɛde bɛsi nnɛ no, wɔasi me kwan.
Mede Helafoɔ ne Pɔtɔfoɔ ka; mede anyansafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔnnim nyansa nyinaa nso ka:
ne saa enti na me ho pere me sɛ mɛka asɛmpa no akyerɛ mo nso wɔ Roma. Nkwagyeɛ a ɛnam gyidie so ba
Na m’ani nwu Kristo asɛmpa no ho; ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn tumi a ɛde kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu ma wɔn a wɔgye die nyinaa, Yudafoɔ kane ne Helafoɔ nso.
Ɛfiri sɛ emu na wɔayi Onyankopɔn tenenee adi akyerɛ firi gyidie mu kɔ gyidie mu, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: “Na ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɛnam gyidie so na ɔbɛnya nkwa.” Onyankopɔn abufuo a etia bɔne
Na wɔayi Onyankopɔn abufuo adi afiri soro atia nnipa a wɔnam kwammɔne so si nokorɛ no kwan no amumuyɛ ne wɔn mmarato nyinaa,
ɛfiri sɛ adeɛ biara ɛfa Onyankopɔn ho no ada adi pefee wɔ wɔn mu, na Onyankopɔn ayi no adi akyerɛ wɔn.
Ɛfiri wiase mfitiaseɛ Onyankopɔn ho adeɛ biara a wɔnhunu no ada adi pefee, ɔnam nneɛma a wayɛ dada so na ɛhunu, ɛno ne ne daa tumi ne ne Nyamesu, enti wɔnni anoyie biara;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔnim Onyankopɔn deɛ, nanso wɔanhyɛ no animuonyam sɛ Onyankopɔn, na wɔanna no ase nso, mmom no, wɔsusuu nsɛnhuhuo ho, na wɔn akoma a asene no duruu sum.
Na wɔka sɛ wɔyɛ anyansafoɔ deɛ, nanso wɔbɛyɛɛ nkwaseafoɔ,
na wɔdanee Onyankopɔn a ɔmporɔ no animuonyam yɛɛ no sɛ onipa a ɔporɔ ne nnomaa ne ntɔteboa ne mmoa a wɔwea fam honi nsɛsoɔ.
Ɛno nti sɛdeɛ wɔn akoma mu akɔnnɔ teɛ no, Onyankopɔn nso gyaa wɔn maa efideɛ sɛ wɔngu wɔn nipadua ho fi wɔ wɔn mu;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔsesaa Nyankopɔn nokorɛ no gyee atorɔ, na wɔsɔree somm abɔdeɛ sene Ɔbɔadeɛ a wɔhyira no daa daa no. Amen.
Yei nti Onyankopɔn gyaa wɔn maa aniwuo akɔnnɔ. Na wɔn mmaa de honam fam ayɔnkofa yɛbea a ɛyɛ ne kwan soɔ no sesaa deɛ ɛmfa ne kwan soɔ,

na saa ara na mmarima no nso gyaa wɔne mmaa ntam nkutahodie a ɛyɛ ne kwan so deɛ no, maa wɔn mfɛfoɔ mmarima ho akɔnnɔ dɛree wɔn mu, na mmarima ne mmarima yɛɛ adapaadeɛ, na wɔnyaa akatua mua ɛfata wɔn bɔne no wɔ wɔn mu.
Na sɛdeɛ wɔammu sɛ wɔbɛkura Onyankopɔn wɔn nimdeɛ mu nti, Onyankopɔn nso yii wɔn maa adwene a ɛmfra, sɛ wɔnyɛ deɛ ɛmfata,
na deɛ ɛntene nyinaa, amumuyɛ, anibereɛ, nnebɔne ahyɛ wɔn ma; nitan (ahoɔyaa), awudie, akasakasa, nnaadaa, ne adwemmɔne ahyɛ wɔn ma; tutu nsɛm gu nkurɔfoɔ asom,
nsekubɔfoɔ, Onyankopɔn atamfoɔ, anoɔdenfoɔ, ahantanfoɔ, ahohoahoafoɔ, nnebɔne farebaefoɔ, awofoɔ so asoɔdenfoɔ,
wɔnni nteaseɛ, wɔyɛ apamsɛefoɔ, wɔnni tema, wɔnni mmɔborɔhunu.
Saa nkurɔfoɔ yi nim Onyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ a ɛtene no pefee sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ saa nneɛma no fata owuo, nanso ɛnyɛ yɛ nko na wɔyɛ na mmom wɔpene wɔn a wɔyɛ saa no nso so.
2: Enti wo onipa biara a wobu atɛn no, anoyie biara nni hɔ mma wo; ɛfiri sɛ deɛ wobu obi atɛn wɔ mu no, wobu wo ara wo ho fɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo a wobu atɛn no woyɛ saa adeɛ no ara.
Nanso yɛnim sɛ Onyankopɔn atemmuo a ɛyɛ nokorɛ no da hɔ ma wɔn a wɔkɔ so yɛ saa nneɛma no.
Na wo onipa a wobu wɔn a wɔyɛ saa nneɛma no atɛn na woyɛ saa ara no, wosusu sɛ wobɛdwane Nyankopɔn atemmuo no anaa?
Anaasɛ wote n’ayamyɛ ne ne boasetɔ ne n’abodwokyɛre bebrebe no ho atua a, wonim sɛ Nyankopɔn ayamyɛ de wo rekɔ adwensakra mu? Atemmuo da hɔ ma Yudafoɔ ne amanaman mufoɔ
Nanso mode mo akoma a ɛyɛ den na apirim no reboaboa abufuo ano aba mo so abufuo da ne berɛ a Onyankopɔn bɛyi ne tenenee atemmuo adie no.
Ɔno na ɔbɛtua obiara ka sɛdeɛ ne nnwuma teɛ:
Wɔn a wɔde papayɛ mu boasetɔ hwehwɛ animuonyam ne anidie ne adeɛ a ɛmporɔ no, ɔbɛma wɔn daa nkwa;
nanso wɔn a wɔfiri atutupɛ mu (pɛsɛ menko menya), na wɔntie nokorɛ, na wɔtie deɛ ɛntene no, abufuo ne abufuhyeɛ bɛba wɔn so.
Ahohiahia ne ɔhaw bɛba nnipa akra a wɔyɛ bɔne nyinaa so, Yudafoɔ kane ne afei Helafoɔ;
nanso animuonyam ne anidie ne asomdwoeɛ da hɔ ma obiara a ɔyɛ adepa, Yudafoɔ kane, ne afei Helafoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn nhwɛ nnipa anim.
Na wɔn a wɔnni mmara a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no nyinaa wɔbɛkwati mmara nso ayera; nanso wɔn a wɔhyɛ mmara ase a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no nyinaa, wɔde mmara na ɛbɛbu wɔn atɛn.
Na ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔtie mmara na wɔtene Onyankopɔn ani soɔ, na mmom wɔn a wɔdi mmara soɔ na wɔbɛbu wɔn bem.
Na sɛ amanaman mufoɔ a wɔnni mmara no firi awosuo mu yɛ mmara no mu nneɛma no a, ɛwom sɛ saa nnipa yi nni mmara deɛ, nanso deɛ wɔyɛ no yɛ mmara ma wɔn ara.
Wɔde yei kyerɛ sɛ, wɔatwerɛ mmara adwuma no wɔ wɔn akoma mu, na wɔn ahonim nso di wɔn adanseɛ, na wɔn nsusuiɛ toto wɔn ano, anaasɛ nso ɛtwitwa gye wɔn.
Yei bɛba da a Onyankopɔn nam Yesu Kristo so bɛbu adasamma nneɛma a ahunta ho atɛn sɛdeɛ asɛmpa a meka no teɛ no.
Afei sɛ wɔfrɛ wo Yudani na wode wo ho twere mmara sane hoahoa wo ho Onyankopɔn mu,
na wonim n’apɛdeɛ na wogye nneɛma a ɛkyɛn soɔ tom ɛsiane sɛ wɔde Mmara no akyerɛkyerɛ woɔ nti,
na wogye wo ho di sɛ woyɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ ma anifirafoɔ ne hann ma wɔn a wɔwɔ sum mu;
na woyɛ nkwasea fotufoɔ, nkɔkoaa kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, sɛ woawedare wɔ nimdeɛ ne nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mmara no mu a;
